/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Acc_SelectAccountStatement]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
/* ---------- Acc_SelectAccountStatement ---------- */
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Acc_SelectAccountStatement]
    @Cmp      INT,
    @UserID   Bigint = 0,         -- لا يؤثر على النتيجة (للاستخدام في ترويسة التقرير فقط)
    @Year     INT,
    @AccId    BIGINT = 0,      -- الحساب (تحليلي فقط)
    @FromDate DATE,
    @ToDate   DATE,
    @Debit    BIT = 0,         -- 1 = الحركات المدينة فقط
    @Credit   BIT = 0,         -- 1 = الحركات الدائنة فقط
    @CsCID    BIGINT = 0       -- 0 = بلا فلتر مركز تكلفة
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    /* ---------- التحقق من المدخلات ---------- */
    IF ISNULL(@AccId, 0) <= 0 THROW 50001, N'يجب تحديد الحساب.', 1;
    IF @FromDate IS NULL OR @ToDate IS NULL OR @FromDate > @ToDate THROW 50002, N'الفترة غير صحيحة.', 1;
    IF YEAR(@FromDate) <> @Year OR YEAR(@ToDate) <> @Year THROW 50003, N'يجب أن تقع الفترة داخل السنة المالية المحددة.', 1;
    IF @Debit = 1 AND @Credit = 1 THROW 50004, N'لا يمكن اختيار المدين والدائن معًا.', 1;

    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Mov;

    DECLARE @AccCode NVARCHAR(60), @AccName NVARCHAR(500);

    SELECT @AccCode = a.AccCode, @AccName = a.AccName FROM dbo.Acc_Account AS a WHERE a.AccID = @AccId AND a.AccCompany = @Cmp;

    IF @AccCode IS NULL THROW 50005, N'الحساب غير موجود أو لا يتبع الشركة.', 1;
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Acc_Account AS c WHERE c.AccParentID = @AccId) THROW 50006, N'كشف الحساب متاح للحسابات التحليلية فقط.', 1;

    /* ---------- مركز التكلفة وفروعه ---------- */
    DECLARE @CC TABLE (CsCID BIGINT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY);

    IF ISNULL(@CsCID, 0) > 0
    BEGIN
        IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Acc_CostCenter WHERE CsCID = @CsCID AND CsCCompany = @Cmp) THROW 50007, N'مركز التكلفة غير موجود أو لا يتبع الشركة.', 1;

        ;WITH Tree AS (
            SELECT CsCID, 0 AS Lvl
            FROM dbo.Acc_CostCenter
            WHERE CsCID = @CsCID AND CsCCompany = @Cmp

            UNION ALL

            SELECT c.CsCID, t.Lvl + 1
            FROM dbo.Acc_CostCenter AS c
            JOIN Tree AS t ON c.CsCParentID = t.CsCID
            WHERE c.CsCCompany = @Cmp
              AND t.Lvl < 30
        )
        INSERT INTO @CC (CsCID) SELECT CsCID FROM Tree;
    END;
    Declare @ReportTital NVarchar(500) =   @AccName + ' ' + @AccCode + ' من تاريخ ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @FromDate, 105) + ' إلى تاريخ ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @ToDate, 105);
    if(@Debit = 1) Set @ReportTital = @ReportTital + ' القيود المدينة فقط'
    if(@Credit = 1) Set @ReportTital = @ReportTital + ' القيود الدائنة فقط'
    if(@CsCID > 0) Set @ReportTital = @ReportTital + (Select ' لمركز التكلفة ' + CsCName From Acc_CostCenter Where CsCID = @CsCID)
    /* ---------- رصيد بداية المدة: كل الحركات قبل @FromDate من كل السنوات ---------- */
    DECLARE @Opening DECIMAL(18,3);
    SELECT @Opening = ISNULL(SUM(d.DayDDeb), 0) - ISNULL(SUM(d.DayDCrd), 0)
    FROM dbo.Acc_DayDetails AS d
    JOIN dbo.Acc_DayMaster  AS m ON m.DayMID = d.DayDMID
    WHERE d.DayDAccID = @AccId
      AND m.DayMCompany = @Cmp
      AND m.DayMState = 7
      AND m.DayMDate < @FromDate
      AND (ISNULL(@CsCID, 0) = 0 OR d.DayDCsCID IN (SELECT CsCID FROM @CC))
    OPTION (RECOMPILE);

    /* ---------- حركات الفترة الكاملة (مع حساب الرصيد الجاري الزمني بدقة) ---------- */
    SELECT
        CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY MONTH(m.DayMDate), m.DayMNo, d.DayDID) AS INT) AS Seq,
        m.DayMID, m.DayMNo, m.DayMDate,
        m.DayMDescription, d.DayDDescription, d.DayDNum,
        d.DayDCsCID, c.CsCCode, c.CsCName,
        d.DayDDeb, d.DayDCrd,
        @Opening + SUM(d.DayDDeb - d.DayDCrd) OVER (ORDER BY MONTH(m.DayMDate), m.DayMNo, d.DayDID ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS RunningBalance
    INTO #Mov
    FROM dbo.Acc_DayDetails AS d
    JOIN dbo.Acc_DayMaster  AS m ON m.DayMID = d.DayDMID
    LEFT JOIN dbo.Acc_CostCenter AS c ON c.CsCID = d.DayDCsCID
    WHERE d.DayDAccID = @AccId
      AND m.DayMCompany = @Cmp
      AND m.DayMState = 7
      AND m.DayMDate >= @FromDate AND m.DayMDate <= @ToDate
      AND (ISNULL(@CsCID, 0) = 0 OR d.DayDCsCID IN (SELECT CsCID FROM @CC))
    OPTION (RECOMPILE);

    -- مجاميع الفترة تحسب لكل الحركات بغض النظر عن فلاتر العرض
    DECLARE @PerDeb DECIMAL(18,3) = (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(DayDDeb), 0) FROM #Mov),
            @PerCrd DECIMAL(18,3) = (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(DayDCrd), 0) FROM #Mov);
    DECLARE @Closing DECIMAL(18,3) = @Opening + @PerDeb - @PerCrd;

    /* ---------- النتيجة: جدول واحد ---------- */
    SELECT R.RowType, R.Seq, R.RowLabel, R.DayMID, R.DayMNo,
           CASE WHEN R.RowType = 1
                THEN CONCAT(CAST(R.DayMNo AS NVARCHAR(10)), N' / ', RIGHT(CONCAT(N'0', MONTH(R.DayMDate)), 2))
           END AS EntryNo, R.DayMDate, R.EntryDescription, R.ItemDescription, R.DayDNum,
           R.CsCID, R.CsCCode, R.CsCName, R.Debit, R.Credit,
           R.Balance, CASE WHEN R.Balance > 0 THEN N'مدين' WHEN R.Balance < 0 THEN N'دائن' ELSE N'' END AS BalanceSide,
           @AccId AS AccID, @AccCode AS AccCode, @AccName AS AccName , @Opening  as Opening , @PerDeb - @PerCrd as RunningBalance , @Closing as Closing , @ReportTital as ReportTital
    FROM (
        -- الحركات الظاهرة فقط (مع تطبيق فلتر العرض دون التأثير على الأرصدة أو المجاميع)
        SELECT CAST(1 AS TINYINT) as RowType, 
               CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY Seq) AS INT) AS Seq, 
               CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(50)) as RowLabel,
               DayMID, DayMNo, DayMDate,
               DayMDescription as EntryDescription, DayDDescription as ItemDescription, DayDNum,
               DayDCsCID as CsCID, CsCCode, CsCName,
               DayDDeb as Debit, DayDCrd as Credit,
               RunningBalance AS Balance
        FROM #Mov
        WHERE (@Debit  = 0 OR DayDDeb > 0)
          AND (@Credit = 0 OR DayDCrd > 0)
       UNION ALL
        -- رصيد نهاية المدة
        SELECT CAST(3 AS TINYINT), 0, N'رصيد نهاية المدة',
               NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,
               NULL, NULL, NULL ) AS R
    ORDER BY R.RowType, R.Seq;
END;
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Acc_SelectAccountWithBalnce]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
   8) قائمة الحسابات المسموح اختيارها في القيد اليدوي (للقوائم)
      يخفي حسابات النظام التي ShowInVoucherLookup = 0.
   --------------------------------------------------------------------- */
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Acc_SelectAccountWithBalnce]
    @Cmp  INT,
    @Year INT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE @From DATE = DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, 1, 1),
            @To   DATE = DATEFROMPARTS(@Year + 1, 1, 1);

    ;WITH Tree AS
    (
        SELECT a.AccID,
               CAST(N'' AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS AccParintName,
               0 AS Lvl
        FROM dbo.Acc_Account AS a
        WHERE a.AccCompany = @Cmp
          AND a.AccParentID IS NULL

        UNION ALL

        SELECT c.AccID,
               CAST(CASE WHEN t.AccParintName = N'' THEN p.AccName
                         ELSE t.AccParintName + N' / ' + p.AccName END AS NVARCHAR(4000)),
               t.Lvl + 1
        FROM dbo.Acc_Account AS c
        JOIN Tree AS t ON c.AccParentID = t.AccID
        JOIN dbo.Acc_Account AS p ON p.AccID = t.AccID
        WHERE c.AccCompany = @Cmp AND p.AccCompany = @Cmp
          AND t.Lvl < 30
    ),
    Mov AS
    (
        SELECT d.DayDAccID AS AccID,
               SUM(d.DayDDeb) AS Deb,
               SUM(d.DayDCrd) AS Crd
        FROM dbo.Acc_DayMaster AS m
        JOIN dbo.Acc_DayDetails AS d ON d.DayDMID = m.DayMID
        WHERE m.DayMState = 7
          AND m.DayMDate >= @From
          AND m.DayMDate < @To
        GROUP BY d.DayDAccID
    )
    SELECT a.AccID,
           a.AccCode,
           a.AccName,
           a.AccState,
           t.AccParintName,
           CASE WHEN t.AccParintName = N'' THEN a.AccName
                ELSE t.AccParintName + N' / ' + a.AccName END AS Parents,
           CASE WHEN ISNULL(x.Deb, 0) > ISNULL(x.Crd, 0)
                THEN x.Deb - x.Crd ELSE 0 END AS AccDebet,
           CASE WHEN ISNULL(x.Crd, 0) > ISNULL(x.Deb, 0)
                THEN x.Crd - x.Deb ELSE 0 END AS AccCridit,
           a.AccCompany
    FROM dbo.Acc_Account AS a
    JOIN Tree AS t ON t.AccID = a.AccID
    LEFT JOIN Mov AS x ON x.AccID = a.AccID
    WHERE a.AccState = 0
      AND a.AccChid = 0
      AND a.AccCompany = @Cmp
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
                      FROM dbo.Acc_PostingRule  AS r
                      JOIN dbo.Acc_PostingState AS s ON s.StateID = r.StateID
                      WHERE r.AccID = a.AccID
                        AND s.ShowInVoucherLookup = 0)
    ORDER BY a.AccCode;
END;


GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Acc_SelectAccTrialBalance]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Acc_SelectAccTrialBalance]
@FromDate  DATE
= NULL,
@ToDate
DATE
= NULL,
@Cmp
INT
= 1,
@Year
INT
= 0,
@AllAcc
BIT
= 0,
@MoveAcc   BIT
= 0,
@BalnceAcc BIT
= 0,
@LevelAcc  TINYINT  = 0  AS  BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON;
SET XACT_ABORT ON;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Roll;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #LeafAmt;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Amount;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Kid;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Acc;
/* 1. التحقق من المدخلات */
IF @FromDate IS NULL
OR @ToDate IS NULL
OR @FromDate > @ToDate
THROW 50002, N'فترة التقرير غير صحيحة.', 1;
IF @Cmp IS NULL OR @Cmp <= 0
THROW 50008, N'الشركة المحددة غير صحيحة.', 1;
SET @Year = ISNULL(@Year, 0);
IF @Year = 0
SET @Year = YEAR(@FromDate);
IF YEAR(@FromDate) <> @Year
OR YEAR(@ToDate) <> @Year
THROW 50003, N'يجب أن تقع فترة التقرير داخل السنة المالية المحددة.', 1;
SET @AllAcc
= ISNULL(@AllAcc, 0);
SET @MoveAcc   = ISNULL(@MoveAcc, 0);
SET @BalnceAcc = ISNULL(@BalnceAcc, 0);
SET @LevelAcc  = ISNULL(@LevelAcc, 0);
/* 2. تحميل شجرة حسابات الشركة */
SELECT
a.AccID,
a.AccParentID,
a.AccLevel,
CAST(ISNULL(a.AccChid, 0) AS SMALLINT) AS AccChid,
ISNULL(a.AccCode, N'') AS AccCode,
ISNULL(a.AccName, N'') AS AccName
INTO #Acc
FROM dbo.Acc_Account AS a
WHERE a.AccCompany = @Cmp;
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #Acc)
THROW 50005, N'لا توجد حسابات لهذه الشركة.', 1;
CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_Acc
ON #Acc (AccID);
CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_Acc_Parent
ON #Acc (AccParentID);
/* 3. التحقق من الحسابات اليتيمة */
IF EXISTS
(
SELECT 1
FROM #Acc AS a
WHERE a.AccParentID > 0
AND NOT EXISTS
(
SELECT 1
FROM dbo.Acc_Account AS x
WHERE x.AccID = a.AccParentID
)
)
THROW 50011, N'شجرة الحسابات تحتوي على حسابات يتيمة؛ الحساب الأب غير موجود.', 1;
/* 4. التحقق من الربط بين الشركات */
IF EXISTS
(
SELECT 1
FROM #Acc AS a
WHERE a.AccParentID > 0
AND NOT EXISTS
(
SELECT 1
FROM #Acc AS p
WHERE p.AccID = a.AccParentID
)
AND EXISTS
(
SELECT 1
FROM dbo.Acc_Account AS x
WHERE x.AccID = a.AccParentID
)
)
THROW 50012, N'شجرة الحسابات تحتوي على ربط بين حسابات شركتين مختلفتين.', 1;
/* 5. التحقق من الحلقات والحسابات غير القابلة للوصول */
DECLARE
@Total   BIGINT,
@Reached BIGINT;
SELECT @Total = COUNT_BIG(*)
FROM #Acc;
;WITH Reach AS
(
SELECT a.AccID
FROM #Acc AS a
WHERE a.AccParentID IS NULL
OR a.AccParentID = 0
UNION ALL
SELECT c.AccID
FROM Reach AS r
INNER JOIN #Acc AS c
ON c.AccParentID = r.AccID
)
SELECT @Reached = COUNT_BIG(*)
FROM Reach
OPTION (MAXRECURSION 32767);
IF @Reached <> @Total
BEGIN
DECLARE @CycleMsg NVARCHAR(300);
SET @CycleMsg =
CONCAT(
N'شجرة الحسابات تحتوي على حلقة أو حساب غير قابل للوصول من الجذور. عدد الحسابات المتأثرة: ',
@Total - @Reached
);
THROW 50010, @CycleMsg, 1;
END;
/* 6. تحديد عدد الأبناء لكل حساب */
SELECT
c.AccParentID AS AccID,
COUNT_BIG(*) AS Cnt
INTO #Kid
FROM #Acc AS c
WHERE c.AccParentID IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.AccParentID;
CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_Kid
ON #Kid (AccID);
/* 7. تجميع الحركات المحاسبية */
SELECT
d.DayDAccID AS AccID,
CAST
(
SUM
(
CASE
WHEN m.DayMDate < @FromDate
THEN d.DayDDeb - d.DayDCrd
ELSE 0
END
)
AS DECIMAL(28,3)
) AS OpenNet,
CAST
(
SUM
(
CASE
WHEN m.DayMDate >= @FromDate
THEN d.DayDDeb
ELSE 0
END
)
AS DECIMAL(28,3)
) AS PerDeb,
CAST
(
SUM
(
CASE
WHEN m.DayMDate >= @FromDate
THEN d.DayDCrd
ELSE 0
END
)
AS DECIMAL(28,3)
) AS PerCrd,
SUM
(
CONVERT
(
BIGINT,
CASE
WHEN m.DayMDate >= @FromDate THEN 1
ELSE 0
END
)
) AS PerCnt
INTO #Amount
FROM dbo.Acc_DayMaster AS m
INNER JOIN dbo.Acc_DayDetails AS d
ON d.DayDMID = m.DayMID
WHERE m.DayMCompany = @Cmp
AND m.DayMState = 7
AND m.DayMDate <= @ToDate
GROUP BY d.DayDAccID
OPTION (RECOMPILE);
CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_Amount
ON #Amount (AccID);
/* 8. فحوص سلامة البيانات */
DECLARE
@ChkNonLeaf BIGINT = 0,
@ChkOrphan  BIGINT = 0,
@ChkCrossCo BIGINT = 0,
@ChkForeign BIGINT = 0,
@ChkChid
BIGINT = 0;
/* حركة على حساب أب */
SELECT @ChkNonLeaf = COUNT_BIG(*)
FROM #Amount AS am
INNER JOIN #Kid AS k
ON k.AccID = am.AccID;
/* الحسابات اليتيمة */
SELECT @ChkOrphan = COUNT_BIG(*)
FROM #Acc AS a
WHERE a.AccParentID > 0
AND NOT EXISTS
(
SELECT 1
FROM #Acc AS p
WHERE p.AccID = a.AccParentID
)
AND NOT EXISTS
(
SELECT 1
FROM dbo.Acc_Account AS x
WHERE x.AccID = a.AccParentID
);
/* الآباء التابعون لشركات أخرى */
SELECT @ChkCrossCo = COUNT_BIG(*)
FROM #Acc AS a
WHERE a.AccParentID > 0
AND NOT EXISTS
(
SELECT 1
FROM #Acc AS p
WHERE p.AccID = a.AccParentID
)
AND EXISTS
(
SELECT 1
FROM dbo.Acc_Account AS x
WHERE x.AccID = a.AccParentID
);
/* حركة على حساب خارج حسابات الشركة */
SELECT @ChkForeign = COUNT_BIG(*)
FROM #Amount AS am
WHERE NOT EXISTS
(
SELECT 1
FROM #Acc AS a
WHERE a.AccID = am.AccID
);
/* عدم تطابق AccChid مع وجود الأبناء الفعلي */
SELECT @ChkChid = COUNT_BIG(*)
FROM #Acc AS a
LEFT JOIN #Kid AS k
ON k.AccID = a.AccID
WHERE
(CASE WHEN a.AccChid > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
<>
(CASE WHEN k.AccID IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END);
/* 9. حركات الحسابات التحليلية فقط */
SELECT
am.AccID,
am.OpenNet,
am.PerDeb,
am.PerCrd,
am.PerCnt
INTO #LeafAmt
FROM #Amount AS am
INNER JOIN #Acc AS a
ON a.AccID = am.AccID
WHERE NOT EXISTS
(
SELECT 1
FROM #Kid AS k
WHERE k.AccID = am.AccID
);
CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_LeafAmt
ON #LeafAmt (AccID);
/* 10. إجماليات الميزان من الحسابات التحليلية */
DECLARE
@SumBlcOldDebit  DECIMAL(38,3),
@SumBlcOldCredit DECIMAL(38,3),
@SumTotDebit
DECIMAL(38,3),
@SumTotCredit
DECIMAL(38,3),
@SumBlcDebit
DECIMAL(38,3),
@SumBlcCredit
DECIMAL(38,3),
@SumTotBlcDebit  DECIMAL(38,3),
@SumTotBlcCredit DECIMAL(38,3);
SELECT
@SumBlcOldDebit =
ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN y.OpenNet > 0 THEN y.OpenNet ELSE 0 END), 0),
@SumBlcOldCredit =
ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN y.OpenNet < 0 THEN -y.OpenNet ELSE 0 END), 0),
@SumTotDebit =
ISNULL(SUM(y.PerDeb), 0),
@SumTotCredit =
ISNULL(SUM(y.PerCrd), 0),
@SumBlcDebit =
ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN y.PerNet > 0 THEN y.PerNet ELSE 0 END), 0),
@SumBlcCredit =
ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN y.PerNet < 0 THEN -y.PerNet ELSE 0 END), 0),
@SumTotBlcDebit =
ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN y.CloseNet > 0 THEN y.CloseNet ELSE 0 END), 0),
@SumTotBlcCredit =
ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN y.CloseNet < 0 THEN -y.CloseNet ELSE 0 END), 0)
FROM
(
SELECT
l.OpenNet,
l.PerDeb,
l.PerCrd,
CAST(l.PerDeb - l.PerCrd AS DECIMAL(28,3)) AS PerNet,
CAST
(
l.OpenNet + l.PerDeb - l.PerCrd
AS DECIMAL(28,3)
) AS CloseNet
FROM #LeafAmt AS l
) AS y;
/* ================================================================
11. التجميع التصاعدي من الحسابات التحليلية إلى الآباء
بدل إنشاء #Cl الذي يحتوي على كل حساب وكل أحفاده،
ننقل حركات الحساب التحليلي إلى أبيه ثم إلى الجد الأعلى.
================================================================ */
;WITH RollUp AS
(
/* بداية التجميع: الحسابات التحليلية ذات الحركات */
SELECT
l.AccID AS NodeID,
l.OpenNet,
l.PerDeb,
l.PerCrd,
l.PerCnt
FROM #LeafAmt AS l
UNION ALL
/* نقل الحركة إلى الحساب الأب */
SELECT
p.AccID AS NodeID,
r.OpenNet,
r.PerDeb,
r.PerCrd,
r.PerCnt
FROM RollUp AS r
INNER JOIN #Acc AS c
ON c.AccID = r.NodeID
INNER JOIN #Acc AS p
ON p.AccID = c.AccParentID
AND c.AccParentID > 0
),
RollTotals AS
(
SELECT
NodeID AS AccID,
SUM(OpenNet) AS OpenNet,
SUM(PerDeb) AS PerDeb,
SUM(PerCrd) AS PerCrd,
SUM(PerCnt) AS PerCnt
FROM RollUp
GROUP BY NodeID
)
SELECT
a.AccID,
a.AccCode,
a.AccName,
a.AccParentID,
a.AccLevel,
a.AccChid,
CAST(ISNULL(t.OpenNet, 0) AS DECIMAL(28,3)) AS OpenNet,
CAST(ISNULL(t.PerDeb, 0) AS DECIMAL(28,3)) AS PerDeb,
CAST(ISNULL(t.PerCrd, 0) AS DECIMAL(28,3)) AS PerCrd,
ISNULL(t.PerCnt, CONVERT(BIGINT, 0)) AS PerCnt
INTO #Roll
FROM #Acc AS a
LEFT JOIN RollTotals AS t
ON t.AccID = a.AccID
OPTION (MAXRECURSION 32767);
CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_Roll
ON #Roll (AccID);
/* 12. النتيجة النهائية */
SELECT
x.AccID,
x.AccCode,
x.AccName AS AccARName,
x.AccLevel,
x.AccParentID AS AccParint,
p.AccName AS AccParintName,
x.AccChid AS AccCountChid,
/* رصيد أول المدة */
CASE WHEN x.OpenNet > 0 THEN x.OpenNet ELSE 0 END AS OldDebit,
CASE WHEN x.OpenNet < 0 THEN -x.OpenNet ELSE 0 END AS OldCredit,
/* حركة الفترة */
x.PerDeb AS NewDebit,
x.PerCrd AS NewCredit,
/* صافي حركة الفترة */
CASE WHEN x.PerNet > 0 THEN x.PerNet ELSE 0 END AS BalanceDebit,
CASE WHEN x.PerNet < 0 THEN -x.PerNet ELSE 0 END AS BalanceCredit,
/* رصيد نهاية الفترة */
CASE WHEN x.CloseNet > 0 THEN x.CloseNet ELSE 0 END AS TotBlcDebit,
CASE WHEN x.CloseNet < 0 THEN -x.CloseNet ELSE 0 END AS TotBlcCredit,
/* إجماليات الميزان */
@SumBlcOldDebit AS SumBlcOldDebit,
@SumBlcOldCredit AS SumBlcOldCredit,
@SumTotDebit AS SumTotDebit,
@SumTotCredit AS SumTotCredit,
@SumBlcDebit AS SumBlcDebit,
@SumBlcCredit AS SumBlcCredit,
@SumTotBlcDebit AS SumTotBlcDebit,
@SumTotBlcCredit AS SumTotBlcCredit,
/* فحوص التوازن */
@SumBlcOldDebit - @SumBlcOldCredit AS ChkOpenDiff,
@SumTotDebit - @SumTotCredit AS ChkPeriodDiff,
@SumTotBlcDebit - @SumTotBlcCredit AS ChkCloseDiff,
/* فحوص سلامة البيانات */
@ChkNonLeaf AS ChkNonLeafAccounts,
@ChkOrphan AS ChkOrphanAccounts,
@ChkCrossCo AS ChkCrossCompanyParents,
@ChkForeign AS ChkForeignAccounts,
@ChkChid AS ChkChidMismatch
FROM
(
SELECT
r.*,
CAST(r.PerDeb - r.PerCrd AS DECIMAL(28,3)) AS PerNet,
CAST
(
r.OpenNet + r.PerDeb - r.PerCrd
AS DECIMAL(28,3)
) AS CloseNet
FROM #Roll AS r
) AS x
LEFT JOIN #Acc AS p
ON p.AccID = x.AccParentID
LEFT JOIN #Kid AS k
ON k.AccID = x.AccID
WHERE
(@AllAcc = 0 OR k.AccID IS NULL)
AND
(
@LevelAcc = 0
OR x.AccLevel = @LevelAcc
OR (x.AccLevel < @LevelAcc AND k.AccID IS NULL)
)
AND (@MoveAcc = 0 OR x.PerCnt > 0)
AND (@BalnceAcc = 0 OR x.CloseNet <> 0)
ORDER BY
x.AccCode,
x.AccID
OPTION (RECOMPILE);
END;

GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Acc_SelectAllCostCenters]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/

Create   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Acc_SelectAllCostCenters]
@Cmp  INT
AS  BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON;

SELECT CsCID, CsCCode, CsCName FROM Acc_CostCenter WHERE CsCState = 0 AND CsCCompany = @Cmp ORDER BY CsCCode

END;

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Acc_SelectCashFlow]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
/* =====================================================================
   قائمة التدفقات النقدية (الطريقة المباشرة) — IAS 7
   ---------------------------------------------------------------------
   Acc_CashFlowAccounts.CashFlowType:
       1 = النقدية وما يعادلها
       2 = أنشطة تشغيلية   3 = أنشطة استثمارية   4 = أنشطة تمويلية
   يُورَّث التصنيف من أقرب حساب أعلى مصنَّف (الأقرب يغلب).

   المبدأ:
   - لكل قيد مرحّل (DayMState = 7) يمس حسابات النقدية في الفترة، صافي حركة
     النقدية = صافي بنوده المقابلة (إن كان القيد متوازنًا).
   - داخل القيد الواحد تُجمَّع البنود المقابلة حسب نوع النشاط (2/3/4)،
     فيصبح لكل نشاط صافٍ واحد: موجب = متحصلات، سالب = مدفوعات.
     بهذا لا يُستثنى قيد صحيح لمجرد أن بنوده المقابلة باتجاهين.
   - الاستثناء فقط لخلل حقيقي: لا بنود مقابلة، أو حساب مقابل غير مصنف،
     أو صافي البنود لا يطابق صافي النقدية (قيد غير متوازن).
   - التسوية مضمونة: الافتتاحي + (تشغيلي + استثماري + تمويلي) + المستثنى = الختامي،
     وفرق التسوية يجب أن يكون صفرًا دائمًا.
   - حركة النقدية بين حسابات نقدية (صافيها صفر) لا تُعد تدفقًا.
   ===================================================================== */
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Acc_SelectCashFlow]
(
    @CompanyID INT,
    @DateFrom  DATE,
    @DateTo    DATE
)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    IF @CompanyID IS NULL OR @CompanyID <= 0
        THROW 50001, N'يجب تحديد الشركة بصورة صحيحة.', 1;

    IF @DateFrom IS NULL OR @DateTo IS NULL OR @DateFrom > @DateTo
        THROW 50002, N'نطاق التاريخ غير صحيح.', 1;

    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #EntryFlow;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Exceptions;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #JournalCheck;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #CounterLines;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #CashJournal;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #AccountClass;

    /*==============================================================
      1. تصنيف الحسابات وتوريث أقرب تصنيف من الحسابات الأعلى
    ==============================================================*/

    ;WITH AccountAncestors AS
    (
        SELECT
            A.AccID AS LeafAccID,
            A.AccID AS AncestorAccID,
            CAST(0 AS INT) AS Distance,
            CAST('/' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), A.AccID) + '/' AS VARCHAR(MAX)) AS VisitedPath
        FROM dbo.Acc_Account A
        WHERE A.AccCompany = @CompanyID

        UNION ALL

        SELECT
            H.LeafAccID,
            P.AccParentID,
            H.Distance + 1,
            CAST(H.VisitedPath + CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), P.AccParentID) + '/' AS VARCHAR(MAX))
        FROM AccountAncestors H
        INNER JOIN dbo.Acc_Account P
            ON P.AccID = H.AncestorAccID
           AND P.AccCompany = @CompanyID
        WHERE P.AccParentID IS NOT NULL
          AND CHARINDEX('/' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), P.AccParentID) + '/', H.VisitedPath) = 0
    ),
    RankedClassification AS
    (
        SELECT
            H.LeafAccID,
            C.CashFlowType,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY H.LeafAccID ORDER BY H.Distance ASC) AS RN
        FROM AccountAncestors H
        INNER JOIN dbo.Acc_CashFlowAccounts C
            ON C.AccID = H.AncestorAccID
    )
    SELECT
        A.AccID,
        R.CashFlowType
    INTO #AccountClass
    FROM dbo.Acc_Account A
    LEFT JOIN RankedClassification R
        ON R.LeafAccID = A.AccID
       AND R.RN = 1
    WHERE A.AccCompany = @CompanyID
    OPTION (MAXRECURSION 32767);

    CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_AccountClass
        ON #AccountClass (AccID);

    -- حسابات النقدية يجب أن تكون حسابات ميزانية من نوع أصول
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1
        FROM #AccountClass C
        INNER JOIN dbo.Acc_Account A
            ON A.AccID = C.AccID
        WHERE C.CashFlowType = 1
          AND (A.AccEnd <> 1 OR A.AccType <> 0)
    )
        THROW 50020, N'تصنيف النقدية (1) مطبق على حساب ليس من أصول الميزانية العمومية.', 1;


    /*==============================================================
      2. قيود الفترة التي تمس النقدية وصافي حركة النقدية لكل قيد
         (القيود التي صافي نقديتها صفر، كالتحويل بين الصناديق، لا تُعد تدفقًا)
    ==============================================================*/

    SELECT
        D.DayDMID,
        CAST(SUM(D.DayDDeb) AS DECIMAL(19,3)) AS CashDebit,
        CAST(SUM(D.DayDCrd) AS DECIMAL(19,3)) AS CashCredit,
        CAST(SUM(D.DayDDeb - D.DayDCrd) AS DECIMAL(19,3)) AS CashNet
    INTO #CashJournal
    FROM dbo.Acc_DayMaster M
    INNER JOIN dbo.Acc_DayDetails D
        ON D.DayDMID = M.DayMID
    INNER JOIN #AccountClass A
        ON A.AccID = D.DayDAccID
       AND A.CashFlowType = 1
    WHERE M.DayMCompany = @CompanyID
      AND M.DayMState = 7
      AND M.DayMDate >= @DateFrom
      AND M.DayMDate <= @DateTo
    GROUP BY D.DayDMID
    HAVING SUM(D.DayDDeb - D.DayDCrd) <> 0;

    CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_CashJournal
        ON #CashJournal (DayDMID);


    /*==============================================================
      3. البنود المقابلة (غير النقدية) في هذه القيود فقط
         FlowAmount: موجب = تدفق داخل، سالب = تدفق خارج
         CashFlowType = NULL يعني حسابًا غير مصنف
    ==============================================================*/

    SELECT
        D.DayDMID,
        D.DayDID,
        A.CashFlowType,
        CAST(D.DayDCrd - D.DayDDeb AS DECIMAL(19,3)) AS FlowAmount
    INTO #CounterLines
    FROM #CashJournal CJ
    INNER JOIN dbo.Acc_DayDetails D
        ON D.DayDMID = CJ.DayDMID
    LEFT JOIN #AccountClass A
        ON A.AccID = D.DayDAccID
    WHERE ISNULL(A.CashFlowType, 0) <> 1;

    CREATE INDEX IX_CounterLines_Journal
        ON #CounterLines (DayDMID);


    /*==============================================================
      4. فحص كل قيد
    ==============================================================*/

    SELECT
        CJ.DayDMID,
        CJ.CashNet,
        COUNT(CL.DayDID) AS CounterLineCount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN CL.DayDID IS NOT NULL AND CL.CashFlowType IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS UnclassifiedCount,
        CAST(ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN CL.CashFlowType BETWEEN 2 AND 4 THEN CL.FlowAmount END), 0)
             AS DECIMAL(19,3)) AS ClassifiedNet
    INTO #JournalCheck
    FROM #CashJournal CJ
    LEFT JOIN #CounterLines CL
        ON CL.DayDMID = CJ.DayDMID
    GROUP BY CJ.DayDMID, CJ.CashNet;

    CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_JournalCheck
        ON #JournalCheck (DayDMID);


    /*==============================================================
      5. القيود المستثناة وأسبابها
    ==============================================================*/

    SELECT
        X.DayDMID,
        X.ExceptionReason
    INTO #Exceptions
    FROM
    (
        SELECT
            JC.DayDMID,
            CASE
                WHEN JC.CounterLineCount = 0
                    THEN N'لا توجد بنود مقابلة لحركة النقدية'
                WHEN JC.UnclassifiedCount > 0
                    THEN N'يوجد حساب مقابل غير مصنف في قائمة التدفقات'
                WHEN ABS(JC.ClassifiedNet - JC.CashNet) > 0.001
                    THEN N'صافي البنود المقابلة لا يطابق صافي حركة النقدية (قيد غير متوازن)'
                ELSE NULL
            END AS ExceptionReason
        FROM #JournalCheck JC
    ) X
    WHERE X.ExceptionReason IS NOT NULL;

    CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_Exceptions
        ON #Exceptions (DayDMID);


    /*==============================================================
      6. صافي كل نشاط داخل كل قيد سليم
         (موجب = متحصلات، سالب = مدفوعات)
    ==============================================================*/

    SELECT
        CL.DayDMID,
        CL.CashFlowType,
        CAST(SUM(CL.FlowAmount) AS DECIMAL(19,3)) AS NetFlow
    INTO #EntryFlow
    FROM #CounterLines CL
    WHERE CL.CashFlowType BETWEEN 2 AND 4
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #Exceptions E WHERE E.DayDMID = CL.DayDMID)
    GROUP BY CL.DayDMID, CL.CashFlowType
    HAVING SUM(CL.FlowAmount) <> 0;


    /*==============================================================
      7. أرصدة النقدية وأرقام التسوية
    ==============================================================*/

    DECLARE
        @Opening       DECIMAL(19,3),
        @Period        DECIMAL(19,3),
        @NetClassified DECIMAL(19,3),
        @ExceptionsNet DECIMAL(19,3),
        @ExceptionCnt  INT;

    SELECT
        @Opening = ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN M.DayMDate <  @DateFrom THEN D.DayDDeb - D.DayDCrd ELSE 0 END), 0),
        @Period  = ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN M.DayMDate >= @DateFrom THEN D.DayDDeb - D.DayDCrd ELSE 0 END), 0)
    FROM dbo.Acc_DayDetails D
    INNER JOIN dbo.Acc_DayMaster M
        ON M.DayMID = D.DayDMID
    INNER JOIN #AccountClass A
        ON A.AccID = D.DayDAccID
       AND A.CashFlowType = 1
    WHERE M.DayMCompany = @CompanyID
      AND M.DayMState = 7
      AND M.DayMDate <= @DateTo;

    SELECT @NetClassified = ISNULL(SUM(NetFlow), 0)
    FROM #EntryFlow;

    SELECT
        @ExceptionsNet = ISNULL(SUM(CJ.CashNet), 0),
        @ExceptionCnt  = COUNT(*)
    FROM #Exceptions E
    INNER JOIN #CashJournal CJ
        ON CJ.DayDMID = E.DayDMID;


    /*==============================================================
      RESULT SET 1: التدفقات حسب النشاط
    ==============================================================*/

    SELECT
        V.CashFlowType,
        V.FlowName,
        CAST(ISNULL(F.CashInflows, 0)  AS DECIMAL(19,3)) AS CashInflows,
        CAST(ISNULL(F.CashOutflows, 0) AS DECIMAL(19,3)) AS CashOutflows,
        CAST(ISNULL(F.NetFlow, 0)      AS DECIMAL(19,3)) AS NetFlow
    FROM
    (
        VALUES
            (2, N'التدفقات النقدية من الأنشطة التشغيلية'),
            (3, N'التدفقات النقدية من الأنشطة الاستثمارية'),
            (4, N'التدفقات النقدية من الأنشطة التمويلية')
    ) V(CashFlowType, FlowName)
    LEFT JOIN
    (
        SELECT
            EF.CashFlowType,
            SUM(EF.NetFlow) AS NetFlow,
            SUM(CASE WHEN EF.NetFlow > 0 THEN  EF.NetFlow ELSE 0 END) AS CashInflows,
            SUM(CASE WHEN EF.NetFlow < 0 THEN -EF.NetFlow ELSE 0 END) AS CashOutflows
        FROM #EntryFlow EF
        GROUP BY EF.CashFlowType
    ) F
        ON F.CashFlowType = V.CashFlowType
    ORDER BY V.CashFlowType;


    /*==============================================================
      RESULT SET 2: أرصدة النقدية والتسوية
         ReconciliationDifference يجب أن يكون صفرًا دائمًا
    ==============================================================*/

    SELECT
        @Opening                 AS OpeningCashBalance,
        @Period                  AS PeriodCashMovement,
        @Opening + @Period       AS ClosingCashBalance,
        @NetClassified           AS NetClassifiedFlow,
        @ExceptionsNet           AS ExceptionsNet,
        @ExceptionCnt            AS ExceptionCount,
        @Period - @NetClassified - @ExceptionsNet AS ReconciliationDifference;


    /*==============================================================
      RESULT SET 3: القيود المستثناة للمراجعة
    ==============================================================*/

    SELECT
        M.DayMID,
        M.DayMNo,
        M.DayMDate,
        M.DayMDescription,
        M.DayMState,
        E.ExceptionReason,
        CJ.CashDebit,
        CJ.CashCredit,
        CJ.CashNet
    FROM #Exceptions E
    INNER JOIN dbo.Acc_DayMaster M
        ON M.DayMID = E.DayDMID
    INNER JOIN #CashJournal CJ
        ON CJ.DayDMID = E.DayDMID
    ORDER BY
        M.DayMDate,
        M.DayMNo,
        M.DayMID;

END;


GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Acc_SelectCompanySettings]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO


CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Acc_SelectCompanySettings]
    @Cmp INT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    IF @Cmp IS NULL OR @Cmp <= 0
        THROW 51001, N'رقم الشركة غير صحيح.', 1;

    IF NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1
        FROM dbo.Mng_Company
        WHERE CmpID = @Cmp
    )
        THROW 51002, N'الشركة غير موجودة.', 1;

    SELECT
        @Cmp AS AccSCmpID,
        ISNULL(S.AccSReview, CONVERT(BIT, 0)) AS AccSReview,
        ISNULL(S.AccSApproval, CONVERT(BIT, 0)) AS AccSApproval,
        ISNULL(S.AccSArchive, CONVERT(BIT, 0)) AS AccSArchive,
        ISNULL(S.AccSState, CONVERT(BIT, 0)) AS AccSState,
        ISNULL(S.AccSSeparateDuties, CONVERT(BIT, 1)) AS AccSSeparateDuties,
        S.AccSDateTime,
        S.AccSUser,
        CONVERT(BIT,
            CASE WHEN S.AccSCmpID IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
        ) AS HasSettings
    FROM (VALUES (@Cmp)) AS C(AccSCmpID)
    LEFT JOIN dbo.Acc_CompanySettings AS S
        ON S.AccSCmpID = C.AccSCmpID;
END;
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Acc_SelectCostCenterAnalysis]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
/* ---------- Acc_SelectCostCenterAnalysis ---------- */
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Acc_SelectCostCenterAnalysis]
    @Cmp       INT,
    @UserID    INT      = 0,   -- لا يؤثر على النتيجة (للترويسة فقط)
    @Year      INT,
    @CsCID     BIGINT   = 0,   -- مركز التكلفة الأب (0 = من الجذور)
    @FromDate  DATE,
    @ToDate    DATE,
    @AllCsC    BIT      = 0,   -- 1 = مراكز التكلفة التحليلية فقط ، 0 = الكل (آباء وتحليلية)
    @AllLevel  BIT      = 0,   -- 1 = كل المستويات (أبناء وأحفاد) ، 0 = الأبناء المباشرون فقط
    @MoveCsC   BIT      = 0,   -- 1 = المراكز التي لها حركة خلال الفترة فقط
    @BalnceCsC BIT      = 1,   -- 1 = المراكز التي رصيد نهاية مدتها <> 0 فقط
    @LevelCsC  TINYINT  = 0,   -- 0 = بلا فلتر ؛ المستوى المطلق CsCLevel (+ التحليلي الأقل مستوى)
    @Debit     BIT      = 0,   -- 1 = رصيد نهاية المدة مدين فقط
    @Credit    BIT      = 0,   -- 1 = رصيد نهاية المدة دائن فقط
    @AccId     BIGINT   = 0    -- الحساب (أب/جد/ابن) ؛ 0 = بلا فلتر
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #R;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Amt;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Cl;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Node;
    /* ---------- التحقق من المدخلات ---------- */
    IF @FromDate IS NULL OR @ToDate IS NULL OR @FromDate > @ToDate
        THROW 50002, N'الفترة غير صحيحة.', 1;
    IF YEAR(@FromDate) <> @Year OR YEAR(@ToDate) <> @Year
        THROW 50003, N'يجب أن تقع الفترة داخل السنة المالية المحددة.', 1;
    IF @Debit = 1 AND @Credit = 1
        THROW 50004, N'لا يمكن اختيار المدين والدائن معًا.', 1;

    SET @CsCID = ISNULL(@CsCID, 0);
    SET @AccId = ISNULL(@AccId, 0);

    IF @CsCID > 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Acc_CostCenter WHERE CsCID = @CsCID AND CsCCompany = @Cmp)
        THROW 50005, N'مركز التكلفة غير موجود أو لا يتبع الشركة.', 1;

    /* ---------- الحساب وفروعه (إن وُجد فلتر) ---------- */
    DECLARE @Acc TABLE (AccID BIGINT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY);

    IF @AccId > 0
    BEGIN
        IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Acc_Account WHERE AccID = @AccId AND AccCompany = @Cmp)
            THROW 50007, N'الحساب غير موجود أو لا يتبع الشركة.', 1;

        ;WITH AccTree AS
        (
            SELECT a.AccID, CAST(0 AS INT) AS Lvl
            FROM dbo.Acc_Account AS a
            WHERE a.AccID = @AccId AND a.AccCompany = @Cmp

            UNION ALL

            SELECT a.AccID, p.Lvl + 1
            FROM dbo.Acc_Account AS a
            JOIN AccTree AS p ON a.AccParentID = p.AccID
            WHERE a.AccCompany = @Cmp AND p.Lvl < 30
        )
        INSERT INTO @Acc (AccID) SELECT AccID FROM AccTree OPTION (MAXRECURSION 100);
    END;

    /* ---------- شجرة مراكز التكلفة تحت المركز المطلوب (Depth 1 = الأبناء المباشرون) ---------- */
    ;WITH CcTree AS
    (
        SELECT c.CsCID, c.CsCParentID, c.CsCLevel, c.CsCCode, c.CsCName, CAST(1 AS INT) AS Depth
        FROM dbo.Acc_CostCenter AS c
        WHERE c.CsCCompany = @Cmp
          AND c.CsCID <> ISNULL(c.CsCParentID, 0)
          AND (   (@CsCID > 0 AND c.CsCParentID = @CsCID)
               OR (@CsCID = 0 AND (c.CsCParentID IS NULL OR c.CsCParentID = 0)))

        UNION ALL

        SELECT c.CsCID, c.CsCParentID, c.CsCLevel, c.CsCCode, c.CsCName, p.Depth + 1
        FROM dbo.Acc_CostCenter AS c
        JOIN CcTree AS p ON c.CsCParentID = p.CsCID
        WHERE c.CsCCompany = @Cmp AND p.Depth < 30
    )
    SELECT CsCID, CsCParentID, CsCLevel, CsCCode, CsCName, Depth
    INTO #Node
    FROM CcTree
    OPTION (MAXRECURSION 100);

    CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_Node ON #Node (CsCID);

    /* ---------- (المركز ← كل أحفاده بما فيهم نفسه) لتجميع الأرصدة نحو الآباء ---------- */
    ;WITH Cl AS
    (
        SELECT n.CsCID AS NodeID, n.CsCID AS DescID
        FROM #Node AS n

        UNION ALL

        SELECT c.NodeID, k.CsCID
        FROM Cl AS c
        JOIN #Node AS k ON k.CsCParentID = c.DescID
    )
    SELECT NodeID, DescID
    INTO #Cl
    FROM Cl
    OPTION (MAXRECURSION 100);

    CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_Cl ON #Cl (NodeID, DescID);

    /* ---------- حركة كل مركز: مرة واحدة على الجداول الكبيرة ---------- */
    SELECT d.DayDCsCID AS CsCID,
           SUM(CASE WHEN m.DayMDate <  @FromDate THEN d.DayDDeb - d.DayDCrd ELSE 0 END) AS OpenNet,
           SUM(CASE WHEN m.DayMDate >= @FromDate THEN d.DayDDeb ELSE 0 END)              AS PerDeb,
           SUM(CASE WHEN m.DayMDate >= @FromDate THEN d.DayDCrd ELSE 0 END)              AS PerCrd,
           SUM(CASE WHEN m.DayMDate >= @FromDate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)                      AS PerCnt
    INTO #Amt
    FROM dbo.Acc_DayDetails AS d
    JOIN dbo.Acc_DayMaster  AS m ON m.DayMID = d.DayDMID
    JOIN #Node              AS n ON n.CsCID  = d.DayDCsCID
    WHERE m.DayMCompany = @Cmp
      AND m.DayMState = 7
      AND m.DayMDate   <= @ToDate
      AND (@AccId = 0 OR d.DayDAccID IN (SELECT AccID FROM @Acc))
    GROUP BY d.DayDCsCID
    OPTION (RECOMPILE);

    CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_Amt ON #Amt (CsCID);

    /* ---------- ملخص الترويسة: رصيد المركز المطلوب نفسه (يتجاهل فلاتر العرض) ---------- */
    DECLARE @HOpen DECIMAL(18,3), @HPerDeb DECIMAL(18,3), @HPerCrd DECIMAL(18,3);

    SELECT @HOpen   = CAST(ISNULL(SUM(OpenNet), 0) AS DECIMAL(18,3)),
           @HPerDeb = CAST(ISNULL(SUM(PerDeb ), 0) AS DECIMAL(18,3)),
           @HPerCrd = CAST(ISNULL(SUM(PerCrd ), 0) AS DECIMAL(18,3))
    FROM #Amt;

    DECLARE @HPerNet DECIMAL(18,3) = @HPerDeb - @HPerCrd;
    DECLARE @HClose  DECIMAL(18,3) = @HOpen + @HPerNet;

    /* ---------- تجميع كل مركز مع أحفاده ---------- */
    SELECT n.CsCID, n.CsCParentID, n.CsCLevel, n.CsCCode, n.CsCName, n.Depth,
           CAST(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #Node AS k WHERE k.CsCParentID = n.CsCID) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS BIT) AS IsLeaf,
           CAST(ISNULL(SUM(a.OpenNet), 0) AS DECIMAL(18,3)) AS OpenNet,
           CAST(ISNULL(SUM(a.PerDeb ), 0) AS DECIMAL(18,3)) AS PerDeb,
           CAST(ISNULL(SUM(a.PerCrd ), 0) AS DECIMAL(18,3)) AS PerCrd,
           CAST(ISNULL(SUM(a.PerCnt ), 0) AS INT)           AS PerCnt
    INTO #R
    FROM #Node AS n
    JOIN #Cl   AS c ON c.NodeID = n.CsCID
    LEFT JOIN #Amt AS a ON a.CsCID = c.DescID
    GROUP BY n.CsCID, n.CsCParentID, n.CsCLevel, n.CsCCode, n.CsCName, n.Depth;

    /* ---------- النتيجة ---------- */
    SELECT x.CsCID, x.CsCCode, x.CsCName, x.CsCLevel, x.CsCParentID,
           pc.CsCName AS CsCParentName,
           x.IsLeaf,

           -- رصيد أول المدة
           CASE WHEN x.OpenNet > 0 THEN  x.OpenNet ELSE 0 END AS OldDebit,
           CASE WHEN x.OpenNet < 0 THEN -x.OpenNet ELSE 0 END AS OldCredit,
           -- الحركة بالمجاميع
           x.PerDeb AS NewDebit,
           x.PerCrd AS NewCredit,
           -- الحركة بالأرصدة
           CASE WHEN x.PerNet > 0 THEN  x.PerNet ELSE 0 END AS BalanceDebit,
           CASE WHEN x.PerNet < 0 THEN -x.PerNet ELSE 0 END AS BalanceCredit,
           -- رصيد آخر المدة
           CASE WHEN x.CloseNet > 0 THEN  x.CloseNet ELSE 0 END AS TotDebit,
           CASE WHEN x.CloseNet < 0 THEN -x.CloseNet ELSE 0 END AS TotCredit,

           -- ملخص الترويسة (يتكرر على كل صف)
           CASE WHEN @HOpen   > 0 THEN  @HOpen   ELSE 0 END AS SumBlcOldDebit,
           CASE WHEN @HOpen   < 0 THEN -@HOpen   ELSE 0 END AS SumBlcOldCredit,
           @HPerDeb AS SumTotDebit,
           @HPerCrd AS SumTotCredit,
           CASE WHEN @HPerNet > 0 THEN  @HPerNet ELSE 0 END AS SumBlcDebit,
           CASE WHEN @HPerNet < 0 THEN -@HPerNet ELSE 0 END AS SumBlcCredit,
           CASE WHEN @HClose  > 0 THEN  @HClose  ELSE 0 END AS SumTotBlcDebit,
           CASE WHEN @HClose  < 0 THEN -@HClose  ELSE 0 END AS SumTotBlcCredit
    FROM
    (
        SELECT r.*,
               r.PerDeb - r.PerCrd               AS PerNet,
               r.OpenNet + r.PerDeb - r.PerCrd   AS CloseNet
        FROM #R AS r
    ) AS x
    LEFT JOIN dbo.Acc_CostCenter AS pc ON pc.CsCID = x.CsCParentID
    WHERE (@AllCsC   = 0 OR x.IsLeaf = 1)
      AND (@AllLevel = 1 OR x.Depth  = 1)
      AND (@LevelCsC = 0 OR x.CsCLevel = @LevelCsC OR (x.CsCLevel < @LevelCsC AND x.IsLeaf = 1))
      AND (@MoveCsC   = 0 OR x.PerCnt   > 0)
      AND (@BalnceCsC = 0 OR x.CloseNet <> 0)
      AND (@Debit     = 0 OR x.CloseNet > 0)
      AND (@Credit    = 0 OR x.CloseNet < 0)
    ORDER BY x.CsCCode, x.CsCLevel;
END;


GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Acc_SelectCostCenters]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Acc_SelectCostCenters]
@Cmp  INT,
@Year INT  AS  BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON;
DECLARE
@From DATE = DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, 1, 1),
@To   DATE = DATEFROMPARTS(@Year + 1, 1, 1);
;WITH CostCenters AS
(
SELECT
C.CsCID,
C.CsCCode,
C.CsCName,
C.CsCParentID,
C.CsCLevel,
C.CsCOrder,
C.CsCChid,
C.CsCState,
C.CsCCompany,
/* هل سبق استخدام مركز التكلفة في أي تفصيل قيد؟ */
CAST(
CASE
WHEN EXISTS
(
SELECT 1
FROM dbo.Acc_DayDetails AS D
WHERE D.DayDCsCID = C.CsCID
)
THEN 1
ELSE 0
END
AS BIT) AS CsCUsed
FROM dbo.Acc_CostCenter AS C
WHERE C.CsCCompany = @Cmp
),
Tree AS
(
SELECT
C.CsCID AS DescendantID,
C.CsCID AS AncestorID,
C.CsCParentID AS ParentID,
0 AS Lvl
FROM CostCenters AS C
UNION ALL
SELECT
T.DescendantID,
P.CsCID,
P.CsCParentID,
T.Lvl + 1
FROM Tree AS T
INNER JOIN CostCenters AS P
ON P.CsCID = T.ParentID
WHERE T.ParentID IS NOT NULL
AND T.ParentID <> 0
AND T.Lvl < 30
),
Hierarchy AS
(
/* الجذور ومسار الآباء */
SELECT
C.CsCID,
CAST(N'' AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS CsCParintName,
0 AS Lvl
FROM CostCenters AS C
WHERE C.CsCParentID IS NULL
OR C.CsCParentID = 0
UNION ALL
/* بناء مسار الآباء لكل مركز */
SELECT
C.CsCID,
CAST(
CASE
WHEN H.CsCParintName = N''
THEN P.CsCName
ELSE H.CsCParintName + N' / ' + P.CsCName
END
AS NVARCHAR(4000)
),
H.Lvl + 1
FROM CostCenters AS C
INNER JOIN Hierarchy AS H
ON C.CsCParentID = H.CsCID
INNER JOIN CostCenters AS P
ON P.CsCID = H.CsCID
WHERE H.Lvl < 30
),
Mov AS
(
/* الحركات المالية خلال السنة للقيود المؤرشفة فقط */
SELECT
D.DayDCsCID AS CsCID,
SUM(D.DayDDeb) AS Deb,
SUM(D.DayDCrd) AS Crd
FROM dbo.Acc_DayMaster AS M
INNER JOIN dbo.Acc_DayDetails AS D
ON D.DayDMID = M.DayMID
INNER JOIN CostCenters AS C
ON C.CsCID = D.DayDCsCID
WHERE M.DayMState = 7
AND M.DayMDate >= @From
AND M.DayMDate < @To
AND D.DayDCsCID IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY D.DayDCsCID
),
Rollup AS
(
/* تجميع حركات الأبناء نحو الآباء */
SELECT
T.AncestorID AS CsCID,
SUM(ISNULL(M.Deb, 0)) AS Deb,
SUM(ISNULL(M.Crd, 0)) AS Crd
FROM Tree AS T
LEFT JOIN Mov AS M
ON M.CsCID = T.DescendantID
GROUP BY T.AncestorID
)
SELECT
C.CsCID,
C.CsCCode,
C.CsCName,
CAST(ISNULL(R.Deb, 0) AS DECIMAL(15,3)) AS CsCDebet,
CAST(ISNULL(R.Crd, 0) AS DECIMAL(15,3)) AS CsCCridit,
C.CsCUsed,
C.CsCParentID,
C.CsCLevel,
C.CsCOrder,
C.CsCState,
ISNULL(H.CsCParintName, N'') AS CsCParintName,
CASE
WHEN H.CsCParintName IS NULL
OR H.CsCParintName = N''
THEN C.CsCName
ELSE H.CsCParintName + N' / ' + C.CsCName
END AS Parents,
C.CsCCompany
FROM CostCenters AS C
LEFT JOIN Rollup AS R
ON R.CsCID = C.CsCID
LEFT JOIN Hierarchy AS H
ON H.CsCID = C.CsCID
WHERE C.CsCState = 0
AND C.CsCChid = 0
AND C.CsCCompany = @Cmp
ORDER BY C.CsCCode
OPTION (MAXRECURSION 100);
END;

GO
