/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Acc_SelectCostCenterStatement]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
/* ---------- Acc_SelectCostCenterStatement ---------- */
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Acc_SelectCostCenterStatement]
    @Cmp      INT,
    @UserID   INT = 0,         -- لا يؤثر على النتيجة (للاستخدام في ترويسة التقرير فقط)
    @Year     INT,
    @CsCId    BIGINT = 0,      -- مركز التكلفة (تحليلي فقط)
    @FromDate DATE,
    @ToDate   DATE,
    @Debit    BIT = 0,         -- 1 = الحركات المدينة فقط
    @Credit   BIT = 0,         -- 1 = الحركات الدائنة فقط
    @AccID    BIGINT = 0       -- 0 = بلا فلتر الحسابات (يقبل أب/جد/ابن)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Mov;
    /* ---------- التحقق من المدخلات ---------- */
    IF ISNULL(@CsCId, 0) <= 0
        THROW 50001, N'يجب تحديد مركز التكلفة.', 1;
    IF @FromDate IS NULL OR @ToDate IS NULL OR @FromDate > @ToDate
        THROW 50002, N'الفترة غير صحيحة.', 1;
    IF YEAR(@FromDate) <> @Year OR YEAR(@ToDate) <> @Year
        THROW 50003, N'يجب أن تقع الفترة داخل السنة المالية المحددة.', 1;
    IF @Debit = 1 AND @Credit = 1
        THROW 50004, N'لا يمكن اختيار المدين والدائن معًا.', 1;

    SET @AccID = ISNULL(@AccID, 0);

    DECLARE @CsCCode NVARCHAR(60), @CsCName NVARCHAR(500);

    SELECT @CsCCode = c.CsCCode, @CsCName = c.CsCName
    FROM dbo.Acc_CostCenter AS c
    WHERE c.CsCID = @CsCId AND c.CsCCompany = @Cmp;

    IF @CsCCode IS NULL
        THROW 50005, N'مركز التكلفة غير موجود أو لا يتبع الشركة.', 1;
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Acc_CostCenter AS k WHERE k.CsCParentID = @CsCId)
        THROW 50006, N'كشف مركز التكلفة متاح لمراكز التكلفة التحليلية فقط.', 1;

    /* ---------- الحساب وفروعه (إن وُجد فلتر) ---------- */
    DECLARE @Acc TABLE (AccID BIGINT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY);

    IF @AccID > 0
    BEGIN
        IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Acc_Account WHERE AccID = @AccID AND AccCompany = @Cmp)
            THROW 50007, N'الحساب غير موجود أو لا يتبع الشركة.', 1;

        ;WITH AccTree AS
        (
            SELECT a.AccID, CAST(0 AS INT) AS Lvl
            FROM dbo.Acc_Account AS a
            WHERE a.AccID = @AccID AND a.AccCompany = @Cmp

            UNION ALL

            SELECT a.AccID, p.Lvl + 1
            FROM dbo.Acc_Account AS a
            JOIN AccTree AS p ON a.AccParentID = p.AccID
            WHERE a.AccCompany = @Cmp AND p.Lvl < 30
        )
        INSERT INTO @Acc (AccID) SELECT AccID FROM AccTree OPTION (MAXRECURSION 100);
    END;

    /* ---------- رصيد بداية المدة: كل الحركات قبل @FromDate من كل السنوات ---------- */
    DECLARE @Opening DECIMAL(18,3);

    SELECT @Opening = ISNULL(SUM(d.DayDDeb), 0) - ISNULL(SUM(d.DayDCrd), 0)
    FROM dbo.Acc_DayDetails AS d
    JOIN dbo.Acc_DayMaster  AS m ON m.DayMID = d.DayDMID
    WHERE d.DayDCsCID = @CsCId
      AND m.DayMCompany = @Cmp
      AND m.DayMState = 7
      AND m.DayMDate < @FromDate
      AND (@AccID = 0 OR d.DayDAccID IN (SELECT AccID FROM @Acc))
    OPTION (RECOMPILE);

    /* ---------- حركات الفترة (الترتيب: الشهر ثم DayMNo ثم البند) ---------- */
    SELECT
        CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY MONTH(m.DayMDate), m.DayMNo, d.DayDID) AS INT) AS Seq,
        m.DayMID, m.DayMNo, m.DayMDate,
        m.DayMDescription, d.DayDDescription, d.DayDNum,
        d.DayDAccID, a.AccCode, a.AccName,
        d.DayDDeb, d.DayDCrd
    INTO #Mov
    FROM dbo.Acc_DayDetails AS d
    JOIN dbo.Acc_DayMaster  AS m ON m.DayMID = d.DayDMID
    LEFT JOIN dbo.Acc_Account AS a ON a.AccID = d.DayDAccID
    WHERE d.DayDCsCID = @CsCId
      AND m.DayMCompany = @Cmp
      AND m.DayMState = 7
      AND m.DayMDate >= @FromDate AND m.DayMDate <= @ToDate
      AND (@AccID = 0 OR d.DayDAccID IN (SELECT AccID FROM @Acc))
      AND (@Debit  = 0 OR d.DayDDeb > 0)
      AND (@Credit = 0 OR d.DayDCrd > 0)
    OPTION (RECOMPILE);

    DECLARE @PerDeb DECIMAL(18,3) = (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(DayDDeb), 0) FROM #Mov),
            @PerCrd DECIMAL(18,3) = (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(DayDCrd), 0) FROM #Mov);
    DECLARE @Closing DECIMAL(18,3) = @Opening + @PerDeb - @PerCrd;

    /* ---------- النتيجة: جدول واحد ---------- */
    SELECT R.RowType, R.Seq, R.RowLabel,
           R.DayMID, R.DayMNo,
           CASE WHEN R.RowType = 1
                THEN CONCAT(CAST(R.DayMNo AS NVARCHAR(10)), N'/', RIGHT(CONCAT(N'0', MONTH(R.DayMDate)), 2))
           END AS EntryNo,
           R.DayMDate, R.EntryDescription, R.ItemDescription, R.DayDNum,
           R.AccountID AS AccID, R.AccountCode AS AccCode, R.AccountName AS AccName,
           R.Debit, R.Credit, R.Balance,
           CASE WHEN R.Balance > 0 THEN N'مدين' WHEN R.Balance < 0 THEN N'دائن' ELSE N'' END AS BalanceSide,
           @CsCId AS CsCID, @CsCCode AS CsCCode, @CsCName AS CsCName
    FROM
    (
        -- رصيد بداية المدة
        SELECT CAST(0 AS TINYINT) AS RowType, 0 AS Seq, N'رصيد بداية المدة' AS RowLabel,
               CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS DayMID, CAST(NULL AS INT) AS DayMNo, CAST(NULL AS DATE) AS DayMDate,
               CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(MAX)) AS EntryDescription, CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(MAX)) AS ItemDescription,
               CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(50)) AS DayDNum,
               CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS AccountID, CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(60)) AS AccountCode, CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(500)) AS AccountName,
               CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(18,3)) AS Debit, CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(18,3)) AS Credit,
               @Opening AS Balance

        UNION ALL
        -- الحركات مع الرصيد الجاري على الصفوف الظاهرة
        SELECT CAST(1 AS TINYINT), Seq, CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(50)),
               DayMID, DayMNo, DayMDate,
               DayMDescription, DayDDescription, DayDNum,
               DayDAccID, AccCode, AccName,
               DayDDeb, DayDCrd,
               @Opening + SUM(DayDDeb - DayDCrd) OVER (ORDER BY Seq ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING)
        FROM #Mov

        UNION ALL
        -- رصيد خلال الفترة
        SELECT CAST(2 AS TINYINT), 0, N'رصيد خلال الفترة',
               NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,
               @PerDeb, @PerCrd, @PerDeb - @PerCrd

        UNION ALL
        -- رصيد نهاية المدة
        SELECT CAST(3 AS TINYINT), 0, N'رصيد نهاية المدة',
               NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,
               NULL, NULL, @Closing
    ) AS R
    ORDER BY R.RowType, R.Seq;
END;


GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Acc_SelectCostCentersTree]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

/* شجرة مراكز التكلفة الكاملة (كل المراكز آباءً وأبناءً) مع تجميع الأرصدة نحو الآباء.
   إجراء القوائم Acc_SelectCostCenters يبقى كما هو (أوراق فقط). */
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Acc_SelectCostCentersTree]
    @Cmp  INT,
    @Year INT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE @From DATE = DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, 1, 1),
            @To   DATE = DATEFROMPARTS(@Year + 1, 1, 1);

    ;WITH CostCenters AS
    (
        SELECT
            C.CsCID,
            C.CsCCode,
            C.CsCName,
            NULLIF(C.CsCParentID, 0) AS CsCParentID,
            C.CsCLevel,
            C.CsCOrder,
            C.CsCChid,
            C.CsCState,
            C.CsCCompany,
            CAST(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Acc_DayDetails AS D
                                   WHERE D.DayDCsCID = C.CsCID)
                      THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BIT) AS CsCUsed
        FROM dbo.Acc_CostCenter AS C
        WHERE C.CsCCompany = @Cmp
    ),
    Tree AS
    (
        SELECT C.CsCID AS DescendantID, C.CsCID AS AncestorID, C.CsCParentID AS ParentID, 0 AS Lvl
        FROM CostCenters AS C

        UNION ALL

        SELECT T.DescendantID, P.CsCID, P.CsCParentID, T.Lvl + 1
        FROM Tree AS T
        INNER JOIN CostCenters AS P ON P.CsCID = T.ParentID
        WHERE T.ParentID IS NOT NULL
          AND T.Lvl < 30
    ),
    Mov AS
    (
        /* نفس شرط إجراء القوائم: القيود المؤرشفة (7) خلال السنة */
        SELECT D.DayDCsCID AS CsCID, SUM(D.DayDDeb) AS Deb, SUM(D.DayDCrd) AS Crd
        FROM dbo.Acc_DayMaster AS M
        INNER JOIN dbo.Acc_DayDetails AS D ON D.DayDMID = M.DayMID
        INNER JOIN CostCenters AS C ON C.CsCID = D.DayDCsCID
        WHERE M.DayMState = 7
          AND M.DayMDate >= @From
          AND M.DayMDate <  @To
          AND D.DayDCsCID IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY D.DayDCsCID
    ),
    Rollup AS
    (
        SELECT T.AncestorID AS CsCID,
               SUM(ISNULL(M.Deb, 0)) AS Deb,
               SUM(ISNULL(M.Crd, 0)) AS Crd
        FROM Tree AS T
        LEFT JOIN Mov AS M ON M.CsCID = T.DescendantID
        GROUP BY T.AncestorID
    )
    SELECT
        C.CsCID,
        C.CsCCode,
        C.CsCName,
        CAST(ISNULL(R.Deb, 0) AS DECIMAL(15,3)) AS CsCDebet,
        CAST(ISNULL(R.Crd, 0) AS DECIMAL(15,3)) AS CsCCridit,
        C.CsCUsed,
        C.CsCParentID,
        C.CsCLevel,
        C.CsCOrder,
        C.CsCState,
        C.CsCCompany
    FROM CostCenters AS C
    LEFT JOIN Rollup AS R ON R.CsCID = C.CsCID
    ORDER BY C.CsCCode
    OPTION (MAXRECURSION 100);
END;
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Acc_SelectCostCentersWithBalnce]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Acc_SelectCostCentersWithBalnce]
    @Cmp  INT,
    @Year INT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    IF @Cmp IS NULL OR @Cmp <= 0
        THROW 50001, N'رقم الشركة غير صحيح.', 1;

    IF @Year IS NULL OR @Year < 1900 OR @Year > 9998
        THROW 50002, N'السنة المالية غير صحيحة.', 1;

    DECLARE @From DATE = DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, 1, 1),
            @To   DATE = DATEFROMPARTS(@Year + 1, 1, 1);

    ;WITH Tree AS
    (
        -- المراكز الرئيسية
        SELECT
            a.CsCID,
            CAST(N'' AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS CsCParintName,
            0 AS Lvl
        FROM dbo.Acc_CostCenter AS a
        WHERE a.CsCCompany = @Cmp
          AND a.CsCParentID IS NULL

        UNION ALL

        -- المراكز الفرعية
        SELECT
            c.CsCID,
            CAST(
                CASE
                    WHEN t.CsCParintName = N''
                        THEN p.CsCName
                    ELSE t.CsCParintName + N' / ' + p.CsCName
                END AS NVARCHAR(4000)
            ) AS CsCParintName,
            t.Lvl + 1
        FROM dbo.Acc_CostCenter AS c
        INNER JOIN Tree AS t
            ON c.CsCParentID = t.CsCID
        INNER JOIN dbo.Acc_CostCenter AS p
            ON p.CsCID = t.CsCID
           AND p.CsCCompany = @Cmp
        WHERE c.CsCCompany = @Cmp
          AND t.Lvl < 30
    ),
    Mov AS
    (
        -- حركة مراكز التكلفة خلال السنة
        SELECT
            d.DayDCsCID AS CsCID,
            SUM(d.DayDDeb) AS Deb,
            SUM(d.DayDCrd) AS Crd
        FROM dbo.Acc_DayMaster AS m
        INNER JOIN dbo.Acc_DayDetails AS d
            ON d.DayDMID = m.DayMID
        WHERE m.DayMState = 7
          AND m.DayMDate >= @From
          AND m.DayMDate < @To
          AND d.DayDCsCID IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY d.DayDCsCID
    )
    SELECT
        a.CsCID,
        a.CsCCode,
        a.CsCName,
        a.CsCState,
        t.CsCParintName,
        CASE
            WHEN t.CsCParintName = N''
                THEN a.CsCName
            ELSE t.CsCParintName + N' / ' + a.CsCName
        END AS Parents,
        CASE
            WHEN ISNULL(x.Deb, 0) > ISNULL(x.Crd, 0)
                THEN x.Deb - x.Crd
            ELSE 0
        END AS CsCDebet,
        CASE
            WHEN ISNULL(x.Crd, 0) > ISNULL(x.Deb, 0)
                THEN x.Crd - x.Deb
            ELSE 0
        END AS CsCCridit,
        a.CsCCompany
    FROM dbo.Acc_CostCenter AS a
    INNER JOIN Tree AS t
        ON t.CsCID = a.CsCID
    LEFT JOIN Mov AS x
        ON x.CsCID = a.CsCID
    WHERE a.CsCState = 0
      AND a.CsCChid = 0
      AND a.CsCCompany = @Cmp
    ORDER BY a.CsCCode
    OPTION (MAXRECURSION 32);
END;


GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Acc_SelectCurrency]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 6. Acc_SelectCurrency
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Acc_SelectCurrency]
    @CurCmp     INT,
    @CurID      BIGINT = NULL,
    @CurState   TINYINT = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    IF ISNULL(@CurCmp, 0) <= 0
        THROW 50102, N'معرف الشركة غير صالح.', 1;

    SELECT C.CurID, C.CurCmp, C.CurCode, C.CurName, C.CurSymbol, C.CurDecimals,
           C.CurIsBase, C.CurState, C.CurDate, C.CurUser, U.UsrLogIn AS CurUserName
    FROM dbo.Acc_Currency AS C
    LEFT JOIN dbo.Mng_User AS U ON U.UsrID = C.CurUser
    WHERE C.CurCmp = @CurCmp
      AND (@CurID IS NULL OR C.CurID = @CurID)
      AND (@CurState IS NULL OR C.CurState = @CurState)
    ORDER BY C.CurIsBase DESC, C.CurCode;
END

GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Acc_SelectDashboard]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
/* =====================================================================
   Acc_SelectDashboard — بيانات لوحة المحاسبة (قراءة فقط)
   المدخلات: @Cmp, @Year
   القيود المحتسبة: DayMState من 1 إلى 7 (كل ما عدا المؤقت)
   المخرجات (7 مجموعات بالترتيب):
     1) KPI      : صف واحد بالمؤشرات
     2) Monthly  : 12 صفًا (الإيراد والمصروف لكل شهر)
     3) States   : 8 صفوف (عدد القيود لكل حالة 0..7 في السنة)
     4) Latest   : آخر 8 قيود
     5) TopExp   : أعلى 5 حسابات مصروفات
     6) Cash     : أرصدة حسابات النقدية (حتى 6 حسابات)
     7) Health   : مؤشرات سلامة (قيود مُرحّلة غير متوازنة، قيود مؤقتة قديمة)
   ===================================================================== */
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Acc_SelectDashboard]
    @Cmp  INT,
    @Year INT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #CashBal;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #CashLeaf;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Acc;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Y;
    IF @Cmp IS NULL OR @Cmp <= 0 THROW 53001, N'الشركة المحددة غير صحيحة.', 1;
    IF @Year IS NULL OR @Year < 1900 OR @Year > 2200 THROW 53002, N'السنة المالية غير صحيحة.', 1;

    DECLARE @From DATE = DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, 1, 1),
            @To   DATE = DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, 12, 31);

    /* حركات السنة (غير المؤقتة) مع تصنيف الحساب */
    SELECT m.DayMID, m.DayMDate, d.DayDAccID, d.DayDDeb, d.DayDCrd,
           a.AccEnd, a.AccType
    INTO #Y
    FROM dbo.Acc_DayMaster AS m
    JOIN dbo.Acc_DayDetails AS d ON d.DayDMID = m.DayMID
    JOIN dbo.Acc_Account   AS a ON a.AccID = d.DayDAccID
    WHERE m.DayMCompany = @Cmp
      AND m.DayMState = 7
      AND m.DayMDate >= @From AND m.DayMDate <= @To;

    /* ---------- النقدية: الحسابات التحليلية تحت تصنيف CashFlowType = 1 ---------- */
    SELECT AccID, AccParentID INTO #Acc FROM dbo.Acc_Account WHERE AccCompany = @Cmp;

    ;WITH Up AS
    (
        SELECT a.AccID AS LeafID, a.AccID AS NodeID, a.AccParentID AS ParentID, 0 AS Dist
        FROM #Acc AS a
        UNION ALL
        SELECT u.LeafID, p.AccID, p.AccParentID, u.Dist + 1
        FROM Up AS u JOIN #Acc AS p ON p.AccID = u.ParentID
        WHERE u.ParentID > 0
    )
    SELECT DISTINCT u.LeafID AS AccID
    INTO #CashLeaf
    FROM Up AS u
    JOIN dbo.Acc_CashFlowAccounts AS c ON c.AccID = u.NodeID AND c.CashFlowType = 1
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #Acc AS k WHERE k.AccParentID = u.LeafID)
    OPTION (MAXRECURSION 200);

    SELECT l.AccID,
           CAST(SUM(d.DayDDeb - d.DayDCrd) AS DECIMAL(28,3)) AS Bal
    INTO #CashBal
    FROM #CashLeaf AS l
    JOIN dbo.Acc_DayDetails AS d ON d.DayDAccID = l.AccID
    JOIN dbo.Acc_DayMaster  AS m ON m.DayMID = d.DayDMID
    WHERE m.DayMCompany = @Cmp AND m.DayMState = 7 AND m.DayMDate <= @To
    GROUP BY l.AccID;

    /* ---------- 1) KPI ---------- */
    DECLARE @Rev DECIMAL(28,3) =
        (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(DayDCrd - DayDDeb), 0) FROM #Y WHERE AccEnd = 2 AND AccType = 0);
    DECLARE @Exp DECIMAL(28,3) =
        (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(DayDDeb - DayDCrd), 0) FROM #Y WHERE AccEnd = 2 AND AccType = 1);

    SELECT
        @Rev AS Revenue,
        @Exp AS Expenses,
        @Rev - @Exp AS NetProfit,
        (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(Bal), 0) FROM #CashBal) AS CashBalance,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.Acc_DayMaster
          WHERE DayMCompany = @Cmp AND DayMState BETWEEN 1 AND 7
            AND DayMDate BETWEEN @From AND @To) AS PostedCount,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.Acc_DayMaster
          WHERE DayMCompany = @Cmp AND DayMState = 0
            AND DayMDate BETWEEN @From AND @To) AS DraftCount,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.Acc_DayMaster
          WHERE DayMCompany = @Cmp AND DayMState IN (2, 4, 6)
            AND DayMDate BETWEEN @From AND @To) AS ReturnedCount,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.Acc_DayMaster
          WHERE DayMCompany = @Cmp AND DayMState = 1
            AND DayMDate BETWEEN @From AND @To) AS AwaitingReviewCount;

    /* ---------- 2) الشهري ---------- */
    ;WITH M AS (SELECT 1 AS Mo UNION ALL SELECT Mo + 1 FROM M WHERE Mo < 12)
    SELECT M.Mo,
           CAST(ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN y.AccEnd = 2 AND y.AccType = 0 THEN y.DayDCrd - y.DayDDeb END), 0) AS DECIMAL(28,3)) AS Revenue,
           CAST(ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN y.AccEnd = 2 AND y.AccType = 1 THEN y.DayDDeb - y.DayDCrd END), 0) AS DECIMAL(28,3)) AS Expenses
    FROM M
    LEFT JOIN #Y AS y ON MONTH(y.DayMDate) = M.Mo
    GROUP BY M.Mo
    ORDER BY M.Mo;

    /* ---------- 3) الحالات ---------- */
    ;WITH S AS (SELECT CAST(0 AS TINYINT) AS St UNION ALL SELECT CAST(St + 1 AS TINYINT) FROM S WHERE St < 7)
    SELECT S.St AS DayMState,
           CASE S.St
                WHEN 0 THEN N'مؤقت'
                WHEN 1 THEN N'مُرحّل'
                WHEN 2 THEN N'مُعاد للمحاسب'
                WHEN 3 THEN N'اعتُمد من المراجعة'
                WHEN 4 THEN N'مُعاد للمراجعة'
                WHEN 5 THEN N'اعتمده المدير المالي'
                WHEN 6 THEN N'مُعاد للمدير المالي'
                WHEN 7 THEN N'مُؤرشف'
           END AS StateName,
           (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.Acc_DayMaster AS m
             WHERE m.DayMCompany = @Cmp AND m.DayMState = S.St
               AND m.DayMDate BETWEEN @From AND @To) AS Cnt
    FROM S
    ORDER BY S.St;

    /* ---------- 4) آخر القيود ---------- */
    SELECT TOP (8)
           m.DayMID,
           CASE WHEN m.DayMNo > 0
                THEN CONCAT(m.DayMNo, N'/', RIGHT(CONCAT(N'0', MONTH(m.DayMDate)), 2))
                ELSE N'—' END AS VoucherNo,
           m.DayMDate,
           m.DayMDescription,
           m.DayMState,
           CAST(ISNULL(t.TotDeb, 0) AS DECIMAL(28,3)) AS Amount
    FROM dbo.Acc_DayMaster AS m
    OUTER APPLY (SELECT SUM(d.DayDDeb) AS TotDeb FROM dbo.Acc_DayDetails AS d WHERE d.DayDMID = m.DayMID) AS t
    WHERE m.DayMCompany = @Cmp AND m.DayMDate BETWEEN @From AND @To
    ORDER BY m.DayMID DESC;

    /* ---------- 5) أعلى المصروفات ---------- */
    SELECT TOP (5)
           a.AccCode, a.AccName,
           CAST(SUM(y.DayDDeb - y.DayDCrd) AS DECIMAL(28,3)) AS Amount
    FROM #Y AS y
    JOIN dbo.Acc_Account AS a ON a.AccID = y.DayDAccID
    WHERE y.AccEnd = 2 AND y.AccType = 1
    GROUP BY a.AccID, a.AccCode, a.AccName
    HAVING SUM(y.DayDDeb - y.DayDCrd) <> 0
    ORDER BY SUM(y.DayDDeb - y.DayDCrd) DESC;

    /* ---------- 6) النقدية ---------- */
    SELECT TOP (6) a.AccCode, a.AccName, b.Bal AS Balance
    FROM #CashBal AS b
    JOIN dbo.Acc_Account AS a ON a.AccID = b.AccID
    WHERE b.Bal <> 0
    ORDER BY ABS(b.Bal) DESC;

    /* ---------- 7) السلامة ---------- */
    SELECT
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM
            (SELECT d.DayDMID
               FROM dbo.Acc_DayMaster AS m
               JOIN dbo.Acc_DayDetails AS d ON d.DayDMID = m.DayMID
              WHERE m.DayMCompany = @Cmp AND m.DayMState = 7
                AND m.DayMDate BETWEEN @From AND @To
              GROUP BY d.DayDMID
             HAVING SUM(d.DayDDeb) <> SUM(d.DayDCrd)) AS x) AS UnbalancedPosted,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.Acc_DayMaster
          WHERE DayMCompany = @Cmp AND DayMState = 0
            AND DayMDate BETWEEN @From AND @To
            AND DayMDateTime < DATEADD(DAY, -7, SYSUTCDATETIME())) AS StaleDrafts;
END;


GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Acc_SelectDashboardExecutive]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
/* =====================================================================
   لوحة المحاسبة التنفيذية — إجراءات قراءة فقط (لا تغيّر أي منطق ولا بيانات)
   القيود المحتسبة: DayMState من 1 إلى 7 (كل ما عدا المؤقت).
   الفترة: من 1/1/@Year حتى @AsOf، حيث
        @AsOf = اليوم إن وقع داخل السنة، وإلا نهاية السنة (أو بدايتها لسنة مستقبلية).
   المقارنة: نفس الفترة من السنة السابقة (من 1/1 حتى نفس اليوم والشهر).
   المعاملة @Part: 0 = كل المجموعات، أو رقم المجموعة المطلوبة وحدها
        (تسمح بالاختبار INSERT-EXEC وبتحميل جزء واحد في الصفحة).

   Acc_SelectDashboardExecutive  — المجموعات:
     1 KPI        صف واحد (الفترة، الإيراد، المصروف، النقدية، الأصول، الخصوم...)
     2 Monthly    12 صفًا (إيراد/مصروف/نقدية داخلة وخارجة + السنة السابقة)
     3 RevenueSrc أعلى 8 حسابات إيراد + «أخرى»
     4 ExpenseSrc أعلى 8 حسابات مصروف + «أخرى»
     5 CashAcc    أرصدة حسابات النقدية والبنوك (حتى 8)
     6 Health     مؤشرات الرقابة (صف واحد)
     7 Abnormal   أعلى 8 حسابات بأرصدة شاذة

   Acc_SelectDashboardProject    — المجموعات:
     1 Summary    ملخص المشروع المختار (أو كل المشاريع)
     2 Monthly    12 صفًا (الصرف الشهري + السنة السابقة + إجمالي الشركة)
     3 TopAcc     أعلى 8 حسابات صرفًا على المشروع
     4 Ranking    أعلى 12 مشروعًا بحسب الصرف المباشر على المشروع نفسه
     5 Children   المشاريع الفرعية المباشرة للمختار (أو الجذور)
     6 List       قائمة كل المشاريع للقائمة المنسدلة (إن @IncludeList = 1)
   ===================================================================== */

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Acc_SelectDashboardExecutive]
    @Cmp  INT,
    @Year INT,
    @Part TINYINT = 0
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Src;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #CV;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #CashLeaf;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Leaf;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Acc;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #M;
    IF @Cmp IS NULL OR @Cmp <= 0 THROW 53101, N'الشركة المحددة غير صحيحة.', 1;
    IF @Year IS NULL OR @Year < 1900 OR @Year > 2200 THROW 53102, N'السنة المالية غير صحيحة.', 1;

    DECLARE @Today  DATE = CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE);
    DECLARE @YStart DATE = DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, 1, 1);
    DECLARE @YEnd   DATE = DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, 12, 31);
    DECLARE @AsOf   DATE = CASE WHEN @Today > @YEnd THEN @YEnd
                                WHEN @Today < @YStart THEN @YStart
                                ELSE @Today END;
    DECLARE @PStart DATE = DATEADD(YEAR, -1, @YStart);
    DECLARE @PAsOf  DATE = DATEADD(YEAR, -1, @AsOf);
    DECLARE @PYEnd  DATE = DATEADD(YEAR, -1, @YEnd);
    DECLARE @MoAsOf INT  = MONTH(@AsOf);

    /* حركات الشركة (غير المؤقتة) حتى @AsOf، مع تصنيف الحساب */
    SELECT m.DayMID, m.DayMDate, d.DayDAccID AS AccID,
           d.DayDDeb AS Deb, d.DayDCrd AS Crd, a.AccEnd, a.AccType
    INTO #M
    FROM dbo.Acc_DayMaster  AS m
    JOIN dbo.Acc_DayDetails AS d ON d.DayDMID = m.DayMID
    JOIN dbo.Acc_Account    AS a ON a.AccID = d.DayDAccID
    WHERE m.DayMCompany = @Cmp
      AND m.DayMState = 7
      AND m.DayMDate <= @AsOf;

    CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_M ON #M (AccID, DayMDate);

    /* شجرة الحسابات + الأوراق */
    SELECT AccID, AccParentID, AccCode, AccName INTO #Acc
    FROM dbo.Acc_Account WHERE AccCompany = @Cmp;
    CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_Acc ON #Acc (AccID);

    SELECT a.AccID INTO #Leaf
    FROM #Acc AS a
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #Acc AS c WHERE c.AccParentID = a.AccID);
    CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_Leaf ON #Leaf (AccID);

    /* حسابات النقدية: الأوراق تحت تصنيف CashFlowType = 1 (يرث من الآباء) */
    ;WITH Up AS
    (
        SELECT a.AccID AS LeafID, a.AccID AS NodeID, a.AccParentID AS ParentID
        FROM #Acc AS a
        UNION ALL
        SELECT u.LeafID, p.AccID, p.AccParentID
        FROM Up AS u JOIN #Acc AS p ON p.AccID = u.ParentID
        WHERE u.ParentID > 0
    )
    SELECT DISTINCT u.LeafID AS AccID
    INTO #CashLeaf
    FROM Up AS u
    JOIN dbo.Acc_CashFlowAccounts AS c ON c.AccID = u.NodeID AND c.CashFlowType = 1
    WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #Leaf AS l WHERE l.AccID = u.LeafID)
    OPTION (MAXRECURSION 200);
    CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_CashLeaf ON #CashLeaf (AccID);

    /* حركة القيد على النقدية: الداخل = زيادة صافية، الخارج = نقص صافٍ.
       التحويل بين حسابي نقدية داخل القيد نفسه لا يُحتسب داخلًا ولا خارجًا. */
    SELECT m.DayMID, m.DayMDate,
           SUM(m.Deb) AS CDeb, SUM(m.Crd) AS CCrd
    INTO #CV
    FROM #M AS m
    JOIN #CashLeaf AS c ON c.AccID = m.AccID
    GROUP BY m.DayMID, m.DayMDate;

    /* --------------------------- 1) KPI --------------------------- */
    IF @Part IN (0, 1)
    BEGIN
        DECLARE @Rev  DECIMAL(28,3), @Exp  DECIMAL(28,3), @PRev DECIMAL(28,3), @PExp DECIMAL(28,3);

        SELECT
            @Rev  = ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN AccType = 0 AND DayMDate >= @YStart THEN Crd - Deb END), 0),
            @Exp  = ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN AccType = 1 AND DayMDate >= @YStart THEN Deb - Crd END), 0),
            @PRev = ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN AccType = 0 AND DayMDate BETWEEN @PStart AND @PAsOf THEN Crd - Deb END), 0),
            @PExp = ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN AccType = 1 AND DayMDate BETWEEN @PStart AND @PAsOf THEN Deb - Crd END), 0)
        FROM #M WHERE AccEnd = 2;

        SELECT
            @AsOf   AS AsOf,
            @PAsOf  AS PAsOf,
            @YStart AS YStart,
            @Rev    AS Revenue,
            @Exp    AS Expenses,
            @Rev - @Exp   AS NetResult,
            @PRev   AS PRevenue,
            @PExp   AS PExpenses,
            @PRev - @PExp AS PNetResult,
            -- النقدية
            ISNULL((SELECT SUM(m.Deb - m.Crd) FROM #M AS m JOIN #CashLeaf AS c ON c.AccID = m.AccID), 0) AS CashBalance,
            ISNULL((SELECT SUM(m.Deb - m.Crd) FROM #M AS m JOIN #CashLeaf AS c ON c.AccID = m.AccID
                     WHERE m.DayMDate < @YStart), 0) AS CashOpening,
            ISNULL((SELECT SUM(m.Deb - m.Crd) FROM #M AS m JOIN #CashLeaf AS c ON c.AccID = m.AccID
                     WHERE m.DayMDate <= @PAsOf), 0) AS PCashBalance,
            ISNULL((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN CDeb > CCrd THEN CDeb - CCrd ELSE 0 END) FROM #CV WHERE DayMDate >= @YStart), 0) AS CashIn,
            ISNULL((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN CCrd > CDeb THEN CCrd - CDeb ELSE 0 END) FROM #CV WHERE DayMDate >= @YStart), 0) AS CashOut,
            ISNULL((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN CDeb > CCrd THEN CDeb - CCrd ELSE 0 END) FROM #CV WHERE DayMDate BETWEEN @PStart AND @PAsOf), 0) AS PCashIn,
            ISNULL((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN CCrd > CDeb THEN CCrd - CDeb ELSE 0 END) FROM #CV WHERE DayMDate BETWEEN @PStart AND @PAsOf), 0) AS PCashOut,
            -- المركز المالي (تراكمي كل السنوات حتى @AsOf)
            ISNULL((SELECT SUM(Deb - Crd) FROM #M WHERE AccEnd = 1 AND AccType = 0), 0) AS Assets,
            ISNULL((SELECT SUM(Crd - Deb) FROM #M WHERE AccEnd = 1 AND AccType = 1), 0) AS Liabilities,
            ISNULL((SELECT SUM(Crd - Deb) FROM #M WHERE AccEnd = 1 AND AccType = 2), 0) AS Equity,
            ISNULL((SELECT SUM(Crd - Deb) FROM #M WHERE AccEnd = 2), 0) AS CumResult,
            ISNULL((SELECT SUM(Deb - Crd) FROM #M WHERE AccEnd = 1 AND AccType = 0), 0)
              - ISNULL((SELECT SUM(Crd - Deb) FROM #M WHERE AccEnd = 1 AND AccType IN (1, 2)), 0)
              - ISNULL((SELECT SUM(Crd - Deb) FROM #M WHERE AccEnd = 2), 0) AS BalanceDiff,
            ISNULL((SELECT SUM(Deb - Crd) FROM #M WHERE AccEnd = 1 AND AccType = 0 AND DayMDate <= @PAsOf), 0) AS PAssets,
            ISNULL((SELECT SUM(Crd - Deb) FROM #M WHERE AccEnd = 1 AND AccType = 1 AND DayMDate <= @PAsOf), 0) AS PLiabilities;
    END;

    /* --------------------------- 2) الشهري --------------------------- */
    IF @Part IN (0, 2)
    BEGIN
        ;WITH Mo AS (SELECT 1 AS N UNION ALL SELECT N + 1 FROM Mo WHERE N < 12)
        SELECT
            Mo.N AS Mo,
            CASE WHEN DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, Mo.N, 1) > @AsOf THEN NULL ELSE
                CAST(ISNULL((SELECT SUM(Crd - Deb) FROM #M WHERE AccEnd = 2 AND AccType = 0
                               AND DayMDate >= @YStart AND MONTH(DayMDate) = Mo.N), 0) AS DECIMAL(28,3)) END AS Revenue,
            CASE WHEN DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, Mo.N, 1) > @AsOf THEN NULL ELSE
                CAST(ISNULL((SELECT SUM(Deb - Crd) FROM #M WHERE AccEnd = 2 AND AccType = 1
                               AND DayMDate >= @YStart AND MONTH(DayMDate) = Mo.N), 0) AS DECIMAL(28,3)) END AS Expenses,
            CAST(ISNULL((SELECT SUM(Crd - Deb) FROM #M WHERE AccEnd = 2 AND AccType = 0
                           AND DayMDate BETWEEN @PStart AND @PYEnd AND MONTH(DayMDate) = Mo.N), 0) AS DECIMAL(28,3)) AS PRevenue,
            CAST(ISNULL((SELECT SUM(Deb - Crd) FROM #M WHERE AccEnd = 2 AND AccType = 1
                           AND DayMDate BETWEEN @PStart AND @PYEnd AND MONTH(DayMDate) = Mo.N), 0) AS DECIMAL(28,3)) AS PExpenses,
            CASE WHEN DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, Mo.N, 1) > @AsOf THEN NULL ELSE
                CAST(ISNULL((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN CDeb > CCrd THEN CDeb - CCrd ELSE 0 END) FROM #CV
                               WHERE DayMDate >= @YStart AND MONTH(DayMDate) = Mo.N), 0) AS DECIMAL(28,3)) END AS CashIn,
            CASE WHEN DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, Mo.N, 1) > @AsOf THEN NULL ELSE
                CAST(ISNULL((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN CCrd > CDeb THEN CCrd - CDeb ELSE 0 END) FROM #CV
                               WHERE DayMDate >= @YStart AND MONTH(DayMDate) = Mo.N), 0) AS DECIMAL(28,3)) END AS CashOut
        FROM Mo
        ORDER BY Mo.N;
    END;

    /* ------------------- 3) مصادر الإيراد / 4) أوجه المصروف ------------------- */
    IF @Part IN (0, 3, 4)
    BEGIN
        SELECT m.AccID, m.AccType,
               SUM(CASE WHEN m.DayMDate >= @YStart THEN
                        CASE WHEN m.AccType = 0 THEN m.Crd - m.Deb ELSE m.Deb - m.Crd END END) AS Cur,
               SUM(CASE WHEN m.DayMDate BETWEEN @PStart AND @PAsOf THEN
                        CASE WHEN m.AccType = 0 THEN m.Crd - m.Deb ELSE m.Deb - m.Crd END END) AS Prev
        INTO #Src
        FROM #M AS m
        WHERE m.AccEnd = 2 AND m.AccType IN (0, 1)
          AND m.DayMDate >= @PStart
        GROUP BY m.AccID, m.AccType;

        UPDATE #Src SET Cur = ISNULL(Cur, 0), Prev = ISNULL(Prev, 0);
        DELETE FROM #Src WHERE Cur = 0 AND Prev = 0;

        IF @Part IN (0, 3)
        BEGIN
            ;WITH R AS
            (
                SELECT s.AccID, a.AccCode, a.AccName, s.Cur, s.Prev,
                       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.Cur DESC, s.Prev DESC, s.AccID) AS Rk
                FROM #Src AS s JOIN #Acc AS a ON a.AccID = s.AccID
                WHERE s.AccType = 0
            )
            SELECT Rk AS [Rank], AccCode, AccName, CAST(Cur AS DECIMAL(28,3)) AS Cur, CAST(Prev AS DECIMAL(28,3)) AS Prev
            FROM R WHERE Rk <= 8
            UNION ALL
            SELECT 99, N'', N'أخرى', CAST(SUM(Cur) AS DECIMAL(28,3)), CAST(SUM(Prev) AS DECIMAL(28,3))
            FROM R WHERE Rk > 8 HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
            ORDER BY [Rank];
        END;

        IF @Part IN (0, 4)
        BEGIN
            ;WITH R AS
            (
                SELECT s.AccID, a.AccCode, a.AccName, s.Cur, s.Prev,
                       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.Cur DESC, s.Prev DESC, s.AccID) AS Rk
                FROM #Src AS s JOIN #Acc AS a ON a.AccID = s.AccID
                WHERE s.AccType = 1
            )
            SELECT Rk AS [Rank], AccCode, AccName, CAST(Cur AS DECIMAL(28,3)) AS Cur, CAST(Prev AS DECIMAL(28,3)) AS Prev
            FROM R WHERE Rk <= 8
            UNION ALL
            SELECT 99, N'', N'أخرى', CAST(SUM(Cur) AS DECIMAL(28,3)), CAST(SUM(Prev) AS DECIMAL(28,3))
            FROM R WHERE Rk > 8 HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
            ORDER BY [Rank];
        END;
    END;

    /* --------------------------- 5) حسابات النقدية --------------------------- */
    IF @Part IN (0, 5)
    BEGIN
        SELECT TOP (8) a.AccCode, a.AccName, CAST(b.Bal AS DECIMAL(28,3)) AS Balance
        FROM (SELECT m.AccID, SUM(m.Deb - m.Crd) AS Bal
              FROM #M AS m JOIN #CashLeaf AS c ON c.AccID = m.AccID
              GROUP BY m.AccID) AS b
        JOIN #Acc AS a ON a.AccID = b.AccID
        WHERE b.Bal <> 0
        ORDER BY ABS(b.Bal) DESC;
    END;

    /* --------------------------- 6) الرقابة --------------------------- */
    IF @Part IN (0, 6)
    BEGIN
        SELECT
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM
                (SELECT DayMID FROM #M WHERE DayMDate >= @YStart
                 GROUP BY DayMID HAVING SUM(Deb) <> SUM(Crd)) AS x) AS UnbalancedPosted,
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.Acc_DayMaster
              WHERE DayMCompany = @Cmp AND DayMState = 0
                AND DayMDate BETWEEN @YStart AND @YEnd
                AND DayMDateTime < DATEADD(DAY, -7, SYSUTCDATETIME())) AS StaleDrafts,
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.Acc_DayMaster
              WHERE DayMCompany = @Cmp AND DayMState IN (2, 4, 6)
                AND DayMDate BETWEEN @YStart AND @YEnd) AS ReturnedVouchers,
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM
                (SELECT m.AccID FROM #M AS m JOIN #CashLeaf AS c ON c.AccID = m.AccID
                 GROUP BY m.AccID HAVING SUM(m.Deb - m.Crd) < 0) AS x) AS NegativeCashAccounts,
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM
                (SELECT m.AccID FROM #M AS m JOIN #Leaf AS l ON l.AccID = m.AccID
                 WHERE m.AccEnd = 1
                 GROUP BY m.AccID, m.AccType
                 HAVING (m.AccType = 0 AND SUM(m.Deb - m.Crd) < 0)
                     OR (m.AccType IN (1, 2) AND SUM(m.Crd - m.Deb) < 0)) AS x) AS AbnormalBalances;
    END;

    /* --------------------------- 7) أرصدة شاذة --------------------------- */
    IF @Part IN (0, 7)
    BEGIN
        SELECT TOP (8) a.AccCode, a.AccName,
               CASE WHEN x.AccType = 0 THEN N'أصل برصيد دائن' ELSE N'خصم/ملكية برصيد مدين' END AS Kind,
               CAST(x.Amt AS DECIMAL(28,3)) AS Amount
        FROM
        (
            SELECT m.AccID, m.AccType,
                   CASE WHEN m.AccType = 0 THEN SUM(m.Deb - m.Crd) ELSE SUM(m.Crd - m.Deb) END AS Amt
            FROM #M AS m JOIN #Leaf AS l ON l.AccID = m.AccID
            WHERE m.AccEnd = 1
            GROUP BY m.AccID, m.AccType
        ) AS x
        JOIN #Acc AS a ON a.AccID = x.AccID
        WHERE x.Amt < 0
        ORDER BY x.Amt ASC;
    END;
END;


GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Acc_SelectDashboardProject]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
/* =====================================================================
   تحليل المشاريع (مراكز التكلفة): المصروفات فقط.
   الإيراد غير مقيّد على مراكز التكلفة في بياناتك (سطر واحد فقط)، لذلك لا يُحسب
   إيراد المشروع؛ يُعاد عدد أسطر الإيراد المقيّدة ليقرر العرض.
   @CsCID: NULL أو 0 = كل المشاريع.  المشروع الأب يشمل مشاريعه الفرعية.
   ===================================================================== */
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Acc_SelectDashboardProject]
    @Cmp         INT,
    @Year        INT,
    @CsCID       BIGINT  = NULL,
    @IncludeList BIT     = 0,
    @Part        TINYINT = 0
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #EP;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #E;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Anc;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #CC;
    IF @Cmp IS NULL OR @Cmp <= 0 THROW 53111, N'الشركة المحددة غير صحيحة.', 1;
    IF @Year IS NULL OR @Year < 1900 OR @Year > 2200 THROW 53112, N'السنة المالية غير صحيحة.', 1;

    SET @CsCID = NULLIF(@CsCID, 0);

    IF @CsCID IS NOT NULL
       AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Acc_CostCenter WHERE CsCID = @CsCID AND CsCCompany = @Cmp)
        THROW 53113, N'المشروع المحدد غير موجود أو لا يتبع الشركة.', 1;

    DECLARE @Today  DATE = CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE);
    DECLARE @YStart DATE = DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, 1, 1);
    DECLARE @YEnd   DATE = DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, 12, 31);
    DECLARE @AsOf   DATE = CASE WHEN @Today > @YEnd THEN @YEnd
                                WHEN @Today < @YStart THEN @YStart
                                ELSE @Today END;
    DECLARE @PStart DATE = DATEADD(YEAR, -1, @YStart);
    DECLARE @PAsOf  DATE = DATEADD(YEAR, -1, @AsOf);
    DECLARE @PYEnd  DATE = DATEADD(YEAR, -1, @YEnd);
    DECLARE @MoAsOf INT  = MONTH(@AsOf);

    /* مراكز التكلفة + علاقة الأب بالأحفاد (Desc → Anc) */
    SELECT CsCID, CsCParentID, CsCCode, CsCName, CsCLevel, CsCState INTO #CC
    FROM dbo.Acc_CostCenter WHERE CsCCompany = @Cmp;
    CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_CC ON #CC (CsCID);

    ;WITH Up AS
    (
        SELECT c.CsCID AS D, c.CsCID AS A, c.CsCParentID AS P FROM #CC AS c
        UNION ALL
        SELECT u.D, p.CsCID, p.CsCParentID
        FROM Up AS u JOIN #CC AS p ON p.CsCID = u.P
        WHERE u.P > 0
    )
    SELECT D, A INTO #Anc FROM Up OPTION (MAXRECURSION 200);
    CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_Anc ON #Anc (A, D);

    /* أسطر المصروفات للفترتين (الحالية والسابقة) */
    SELECT m.DayMID, m.DayMDate, d.DayDAccID AS AccID, d.DayDCsCID AS CsC,
           d.DayDDeb - d.DayDCrd AS Amt,
           CASE WHEN m.DayMDate >= @YStart THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IsCur
    INTO #E
    FROM dbo.Acc_DayMaster  AS m
    JOIN dbo.Acc_DayDetails AS d ON d.DayDMID = m.DayMID
    JOIN dbo.Acc_Account    AS a ON a.AccID = d.DayDAccID
    WHERE m.DayMCompany = @Cmp
      AND m.DayMState = 7
      AND a.AccEnd = 2 AND a.AccType = 1
      AND ((m.DayMDate >= @YStart AND m.DayMDate <= @AsOf)
        OR (m.DayMDate >= @PStart AND m.DayMDate <= @PAsOf));
    CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_E ON #E (CsC);

    /* أسطر المشروع المختار (الأب يشمل أحفاده) أو كل المقيّد على مراكز تكلفة */
    SELECT e.* INTO #EP
    FROM #E AS e
    WHERE e.CsC IS NOT NULL
      AND (@CsCID IS NULL
           OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #Anc AS n WHERE n.D = e.CsC AND n.A = @CsCID));

    /* ------------------------ 1) الملخص ------------------------ */
    IF @Part IN (0, 1)
    BEGIN
        DECLARE @Cur DECIMAL(28,3) = ISNULL((SELECT SUM(Amt) FROM #EP WHERE IsCur = 1), 0);
        DECLARE @Prv DECIMAL(28,3) = ISNULL((SELECT SUM(Amt) FROM #EP WHERE IsCur = 0), 0);
        DECLARE @All DECIMAL(28,3) = ISNULL((SELECT SUM(Amt) FROM #E WHERE IsCur = 1), 0);
        DECLARE @Tag DECIMAL(28,3) = ISNULL((SELECT SUM(Amt) FROM #E WHERE IsCur = 1 AND CsC IS NOT NULL), 0);
        DECLARE @MaxMo INT, @MaxAmt DECIMAL(28,3);

        SELECT TOP (1) @MaxMo = Mo, @MaxAmt = S
        FROM (SELECT MONTH(DayMDate) AS Mo, SUM(Amt) AS S FROM #EP WHERE IsCur = 1 GROUP BY MONTH(DayMDate)) AS z
        ORDER BY S DESC;

        SELECT
            @CsCID AS CsCID,
            ISNULL((SELECT CsCCode FROM #CC WHERE CsCID = @CsCID), N'') AS CsCCode,
            ISNULL((SELECT CsCName FROM #CC WHERE CsCID = @CsCID), N'كل المشاريع') AS CsCName,
            @AsOf  AS AsOf,
            @PAsOf AS PAsOf,
            @Cur   AS ProjExp,
            @Prv   AS ProjExpPrev,
            @All   AS CompanyExp,
            @Tag   AS TaggedExp,
            @All - @Tag AS UnallocatedExp,
            CASE WHEN @All = 0 THEN NULL ELSE CAST(@Cur * 100.0 / @All AS DECIMAL(9,2)) END AS SharePct,
            (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT MONTH(DayMDate)) FROM #EP WHERE IsCur = 1 AND Amt <> 0) AS ActiveMonths,
            @MoAsOf AS MonthsElapsed,
            CAST(@Cur / NULLIF(@MoAsOf, 0) AS DECIMAL(28,3)) AS AvgMonthly,
            @MaxMo  AS MaxMonth,
            @MaxAmt AS MaxMonthAmount,
            (SELECT COUNT(*)
               FROM dbo.Acc_DayMaster AS m
               JOIN dbo.Acc_DayDetails AS d ON d.DayDMID = m.DayMID
               JOIN dbo.Acc_Account AS a ON a.AccID = d.DayDAccID
              WHERE m.DayMCompany = @Cmp AND m.DayMState = 7
                AND m.DayMDate BETWEEN @YStart AND @AsOf
                AND a.AccEnd = 2 AND a.AccType = 0
                AND d.DayDCsCID IS NOT NULL) AS RevenueTaggedLines;
    END;

    /* ------------------------ 2) الشهري ------------------------ */
    IF @Part IN (0, 2)
    BEGIN
        ;WITH Mo AS (SELECT 1 AS N UNION ALL SELECT N + 1 FROM Mo WHERE N < 12)
        SELECT
            Mo.N AS Mo,
            CASE WHEN DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, Mo.N, 1) > @AsOf THEN NULL ELSE
                CAST(ISNULL((SELECT SUM(Amt) FROM #EP WHERE IsCur = 1 AND MONTH(DayMDate) = Mo.N), 0) AS DECIMAL(28,3)) END AS ProjExp,
            CAST(ISNULL((SELECT SUM(Amt) FROM #EP WHERE IsCur = 0 AND MONTH(DayMDate) = Mo.N), 0) AS DECIMAL(28,3)) AS ProjExpPrev,
            CASE WHEN DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, Mo.N, 1) > @AsOf THEN NULL ELSE
                CAST(ISNULL((SELECT SUM(Amt) FROM #E WHERE IsCur = 1 AND MONTH(DayMDate) = Mo.N), 0) AS DECIMAL(28,3)) END AS CompanyExp
        FROM Mo
        ORDER BY Mo.N;
    END;

    /* ------------------------ 3) أعلى الحسابات ------------------------ */
    IF @Part IN (0, 3)
    BEGIN
        SELECT TOP (8) a.AccCode, a.AccName,
               CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN p.IsCur = 1 THEN p.Amt ELSE 0 END) AS DECIMAL(28,3)) AS Cur,
               CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN p.IsCur = 0 THEN p.Amt ELSE 0 END) AS DECIMAL(28,3)) AS Prev
        FROM #EP AS p
        JOIN dbo.Acc_Account AS a ON a.AccID = p.AccID
        GROUP BY a.AccID, a.AccCode, a.AccName
        HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN p.IsCur = 1 THEN p.Amt ELSE 0 END) <> 0
        ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN p.IsCur = 1 THEN p.Amt ELSE 0 END) DESC;
    END;

    /* ------------------------ 4) ترتيب المشاريع (الصرف المباشر على كل مشروع) ------------------------ */
    IF @Part IN (0, 4)
    BEGIN
        DECLARE @TagAll DECIMAL(28,3) = ISNULL((SELECT SUM(Amt) FROM #E WHERE IsCur = 1 AND CsC IS NOT NULL), 0);

        SELECT TOP (12)
               c.CsCID, c.CsCCode, c.CsCName,
               CAST(SUM(e.Amt) AS DECIMAL(28,3)) AS Amount,
               CASE WHEN @TagAll = 0 THEN NULL ELSE CAST(SUM(e.Amt) * 100.0 / @TagAll AS DECIMAL(9,2)) END AS SharePct,
               CAST(CASE WHEN @CsCID IS NULL THEN 0
                         WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #Anc AS n WHERE n.D = c.CsCID AND n.A = @CsCID) THEN 1
                         ELSE 0 END AS BIT) AS IsSelected
        FROM #E AS e
        JOIN #CC AS c ON c.CsCID = e.CsC
        WHERE e.IsCur = 1
        GROUP BY c.CsCID, c.CsCCode, c.CsCName
        HAVING SUM(e.Amt) <> 0
        ORDER BY SUM(e.Amt) DESC;
    END;

    /* ------------------------ 5) المشاريع الفرعية المباشرة ------------------------ */
    IF @Part IN (0, 5)
    BEGIN
        SELECT TOP (20)
               c.CsCID, c.CsCCode, c.CsCName,
               CAST(ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN e.IsCur = 1 THEN e.Amt END), 0) AS DECIMAL(28,3)) AS Cur,
               CAST(ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN e.IsCur = 0 THEN e.Amt END), 0) AS DECIMAL(28,3)) AS Prev
        FROM #CC AS c
        LEFT JOIN #Anc AS n ON n.A = c.CsCID
        LEFT JOIN #E   AS e ON e.CsC = n.D
        WHERE (@CsCID IS NULL AND (c.CsCParentID IS NULL OR c.CsCParentID = 0))
           OR (@CsCID IS NOT NULL AND c.CsCParentID = @CsCID)
        GROUP BY c.CsCID, c.CsCCode, c.CsCName
        HAVING ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN e.IsCur = 1 THEN e.Amt END), 0) <> 0
            OR ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN e.IsCur = 0 THEN e.Amt END), 0) <> 0
        ORDER BY ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN e.IsCur = 1 THEN e.Amt END), 0) DESC;
    END;

    /* ------------------------ 6) قائمة المشاريع ------------------------ */
    IF @Part IN (0, 6)
    BEGIN
        SELECT c.CsCID, c.CsCCode, c.CsCName, c.CsCLevel, c.CsCParentID,
               CAST(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #CC AS k WHERE k.CsCParentID = c.CsCID) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BIT) AS HasChildren
        FROM #CC AS c
        WHERE @IncludeList = 1 AND c.CsCState = 0
        ORDER BY c.CsCCode;
    END;
END;

-- =============================================

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Acc_SelectDayDetailsss]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@DayDMID Bigint
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- Insert statements for procedure here
	SELECT DayDID
      ,DayDMID
      ,DayDAccID
      ,DayDDeb
      ,DayDCrd
      ,DayDCsCID
      ,DayDNum

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Acc_SelectDayEntry]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

/* =====================================================================
   2) فتح قيد: نتيجتان
      الأولى: رأس القيد   الثانية: البنود (مع اسم الحساب ومركز التكلفة)
   ===================================================================== */
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Acc_SelectDayEntry]
    @Cmp    INT,
    @DayMID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Acc_DayMaster WHERE DayMID = @DayMID AND DayMCompany = @Cmp)
        THROW 50120, N'القيد غير موجود أو لا يتبع الشركة.', 1;

    SELECT m.DayMID,
           m.DayMNo,
           CASE WHEN m.DayMNo > 0
                THEN CONCAT(m.DayMNo, N' / ', RIGHT(CONCAT(N'0', MONTH(m.DayMDate)), 2))
                ELSE N'' END AS VoucherNo,
           m.DayMDate,
           m.DayMDescription,
           m.DayMState,
           CASE m.DayMState
                WHEN 0 THEN N'مؤقت'
                WHEN 1 THEN N'مُرحّل'
                WHEN 2 THEN N'مُعاد من المراجعة للمحاسب'
                WHEN 3 THEN N'تم اعتماد المراجعة'
                WHEN 4 THEN N'مُعاد من المدير المالي للمراجعة'
                WHEN 5 THEN N'مُعتمد من المدير المالي'
                WHEN 6 THEN N'مُعاد من الأرشيف للمدير المالي'
                WHEN 7 THEN N'مُؤرشف'
           END AS StateName,
           CAST(CASE WHEN m.DayMState IN (0, 2) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BIT) AS IsEditable,
           (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(d.DayDDeb), 0) FROM dbo.Acc_DayDetails AS d WHERE d.DayDMID = m.DayMID) AS TotalDebit,
           (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(d.DayDCrd), 0) FROM dbo.Acc_DayDetails AS d WHERE d.DayDMID = m.DayMID) AS TotalCredit,
           m.DayMUser,
           m.DayMDateTime, E.EmpName
    FROM dbo.Acc_DayMaster AS m
    Inner Join Emp_Employee E ON E.EmpID = m.DayMUser
    WHERE m.DayMID = @DayMID AND m.DayMCompany = @Cmp;

    SELECT d.DayDID, d.DayDAccID, a.AccCode, a.AccName,
           d.DayDDeb, d.DayDCrd,
           d.DayDCsCID, c.CsCCode, c.CsCName,
           d.DayDNum, d.DayDDescription
    FROM dbo.Acc_DayDetails AS d
    JOIN dbo.Acc_Account AS a ON a.AccID = d.DayDAccID
    LEFT JOIN dbo.Acc_CostCenter AS c ON c.CsCID = d.DayDCsCID
    WHERE d.DayDMID = @DayMID
    ORDER BY d.DayDDeb desc, d.DayDID;
END;

GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Acc_SelectDayEntryViewType]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Acc_SelectDayEntryViewType]
    @Cmp       INT,
    @DayMID    BIGINT,
    @ViewType  TINYINT = 1
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    IF NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1
        FROM dbo.Acc_DayMaster
        WHERE DayMID = @DayMID
          AND DayMCompany = @Cmp
    )
        THROW 50120, N'القيد غير موجود أو لا يتبع الشركة.', 1;

    -- 1. رأس القيد
    SELECT
        m.DayMID,
        m.DayMNo,
        CASE
            WHEN m.DayMNo > 0
            THEN CONCAT(m.DayMNo, N' / ', RIGHT(CONCAT(N'0', MONTH(m.DayMDate)), 2))
            ELSE N''
        END AS VoucherNo,
        m.DayMDate,
        m.DayMDescription,
        m.DayMState,

        (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(d.DayDDeb), 0)
         FROM dbo.Acc_DayDetails AS d
         WHERE d.DayDMID = m.DayMID) AS TotalDebit,

        (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(d.DayDCrd), 0)
         FROM dbo.Acc_DayDetails AS d
         WHERE d.DayDMID = m.DayMID) AS TotalCredit,

        E.EmpName,

        CASE
            WHEN m.DayMState = 0 THEN E.EmpName
            ELSE Posted.EmpName
        END AS PostedName,

        Reviewer.EmpName AS ReviewerName,
        Approved.EmpName AS ApprovedName,
        Archived.EmpName AS ArchivedName,

        CASE
            WHEN m.DayMState IN (2, 4, 6)
            THEN Rejection.DayMSReason
            ELSE NULL
        END AS RejectReason

    FROM dbo.Acc_DayMaster AS m

    INNER JOIN dbo.Emp_Employee AS E
        ON E.EmpID = m.DayMUser

    -- آخر مرحّل
    OUTER APPLY
    (
        SELECT TOP (1) s.DayMSUser
        FROM dbo.Acc_DayMasterState AS s
        WHERE s.DayMSDayMID = m.DayMID
          AND s.DayMSState = 1
        ORDER BY s.DayMSID DESC
    ) AS PostedState

    OUTER APPLY
    (
        SELECT EmpName
        FROM dbo.Emp_Employee
        WHERE EmpID = PostedState.DayMSUser
    ) AS Posted

    -- آخر إجراء للمراجع
    OUTER APPLY
    (
        SELECT TOP (1) s.DayMSUser
        FROM dbo.Acc_DayMasterState AS s
        WHERE s.DayMSDayMID = m.DayMID
          AND s.DayMSState IN (2, 3)
        ORDER BY s.DayMSID DESC
    ) AS ReviewerState

    OUTER APPLY
    (
        SELECT EmpName
        FROM dbo.Emp_Employee
        WHERE EmpID = ReviewerState.DayMSUser
    ) AS Reviewer

    -- آخر إجراء للمدير المالي
    OUTER APPLY
    (
        SELECT TOP (1) s.DayMSUser
        FROM dbo.Acc_DayMasterState AS s
        WHERE s.DayMSDayMID = m.DayMID
          AND s.DayMSState IN (4, 5)
        ORDER BY s.DayMSID DESC
    ) AS ApprovedState

    OUTER APPLY
    (
        SELECT EmpName
        FROM dbo.Emp_Employee
        WHERE EmpID = ApprovedState.DayMSUser
    ) AS Approved

    -- آخر إجراء للأرشيف
    OUTER APPLY
    (
        SELECT TOP (1) s.DayMSUser
        FROM dbo.Acc_DayMasterState AS s
        WHERE s.DayMSDayMID = m.DayMID
          AND s.DayMSState IN (6, 7)
        ORDER BY s.DayMSID DESC
    ) AS ArchivedState

    OUTER APPLY
    (
        SELECT EmpName
        FROM dbo.Emp_Employee
        WHERE EmpID = ArchivedState.DayMSUser
    ) AS Archived

    -- أحدث سبب إرجاع
    OUTER APPLY
    (
        SELECT TOP (1) s.DayMSReason
        FROM dbo.Acc_DayMasterState AS s
        WHERE s.DayMSDayMID = m.DayMID
          AND s.DayMSState IN (2, 4, 6)
        ORDER BY s.DayMSID DESC
    ) AS Rejection

    WHERE m.DayMID = @DayMID
      AND m.DayMCompany = @Cmp;

    -- 2. بنود القيد
    IF @ViewType = 0
    BEGIN
        SELECT
            d.DayDID,
            d.DayDAccID,
            a.AccCode,
            a.AccName,
            d.DayDDeb,
            d.DayDCrd,
            d.DayDCsCID,
            c.CsCCode,
            c.CsCName,
            d.DayDNum,
            d.DayDDescription
        FROM dbo.Acc_DayDetails AS d
        JOIN dbo.Acc_Account AS a
            ON a.AccID = d.DayDAccID
        LEFT JOIN dbo.Acc_CostCenter AS c
            ON c.CsCID = d.DayDCsCID
        WHERE d.DayDMID = @DayMID
        ORDER BY d.DayDDeb DESC, d.DayDID;
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        SELECT
            CAST(0 AS BIGINT) AS DayDID,
            ISNULL(parent.AccID, a.AccID) AS DayDAccID,
            ISNULL(parent.AccCode, a.AccCode) AS AccCode,
            ISNULL(parent.AccName, a.AccName) AS AccName,
            SUM(d.DayDDeb) AS DayDDeb,
            SUM(d.DayDCrd) AS DayDCrd,
            d.DayDCsCID,
            ISNULL(c.CsCCode, N'') AS CsCCode,
            ISNULL(c.CsCName, N'') AS CsCName,
            N'' AS DayDNum,
            N'إجمالي ملخص' AS DayDDescription
        FROM dbo.Acc_DayDetails AS d
        JOIN dbo.Acc_Account AS a
            ON a.AccID = d.DayDAccID
        LEFT JOIN dbo.Acc_Account AS parent
            ON parent.AccID = a.AccParentID
        LEFT JOIN dbo.Acc_CostCenter AS c
            ON c.CsCID = d.DayDCsCID
        WHERE d.DayDMID = @DayMID
        GROUP BY
            ISNULL(parent.AccID, a.AccID),
            ISNULL(parent.AccCode, a.AccCode),
            ISNULL(parent.AccName, a.AccName),
            d.DayDCsCID,
            c.CsCCode,
            c.CsCName
        ORDER BY DayDDeb DESC, DayDCsCID;
    END
END;
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Acc_SelectDayMaster]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@DayMID BigInt
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
    -- Insert statements for procedure here
SELECT     DayMID, FORMAT(DayMDate, 'MM') + '/' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR, DayMNo) as DayNum , DayMDate ,  DayMDescription 
FROM   Acc_DayMaster  Where DayMID = @DayMID

END
