/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Acc_SelectDayVoucherLines]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Acc_SelectDayVoucherLines]
    @Cmp    INT,
    @User   BIGINT,
    @DayMID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE @St TINYINT, @Owner BIGINT;
    SELECT @St = m.DayMState, @Owner = m.DayMUser
    FROM dbo.Acc_DayMaster AS m
    WHERE m.DayMID = @DayMID AND m.DayMCompany = @Cmp;

    IF @St IS NULL OR (@St = 0 AND @Owner <> @User)
        THROW 50301, N'القيد غير موجود أو لا يتبع الشركة.', 1;

    DECLARE @Mapped BIT, @Allowed BIT;
    SELECT @Mapped = u.Mapped, @Allowed = u.Allowed FROM dbo.Acc_UserCanAct(@Cmp, @User, @St) AS u;
    IF ISNULL(@Mapped, 0) = 0
        THROW 50403, N'لم تُعرَّف قائمة حالة هذا القيد في جدول Acc_StateMenu.', 1;
    IF ISNULL(@Allowed, 0) = 0
        THROW 50402, N'لا تملك صلاحية عرض القيود في هذه الحالة.', 1;

    SELECT d.DayDID, d.DayDAccID, a.AccCode, a.AccName,
           d.DayDDeb, d.DayDCrd,
           d.DayDCsCID, c.CsCCode, c.CsCName,
           d.DayDNum, d.DayDDescription
    FROM dbo.Acc_DayDetails AS d
    JOIN dbo.Acc_Account AS a ON a.AccID = d.DayDAccID
    LEFT JOIN dbo.Acc_CostCenter AS c ON c.CsCID = d.DayDCsCID
    WHERE d.DayDMID = @DayMID
    ORDER BY d.DayDID;
END;

GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Acc_SelectDayVouchersByState]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Acc_SelectDayVouchersByState]
    @Cmp      INT,
    @Year     INT,
    @User     BIGINT,
    @State    TINYINT,
    @FromDate DATE          = NULL,
    @ToDate   DATE          = NULL,
    @Search   NVARCHAR(100) = NULL,
    @PageNo   INT           = 1,
    @PageSize INT           = 0
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    IF @State > 7
        THROW 50401, N'حالة القيد غير صحيحة.', 1;

    DECLARE @Mapped BIT, @Allowed BIT;
    SELECT @Mapped = u.Mapped, @Allowed = u.Allowed FROM dbo.Acc_UserCanAct(@Cmp, @User, @State) AS u;
    IF ISNULL(@Mapped, 0) = 0
        THROW 50403, N'لم تُعرَّف قائمة هذه الحالة في جدول Acc_StateMenu.', 1;
    IF ISNULL(@Allowed, 0) = 0
        THROW 50402, N'لا تملك صلاحية عرض القيود في هذه الحالة.', 1;

    IF ISNULL(@PageNo, 1) < 1 SET @PageNo = 1;
    IF ISNULL(@PageSize, 0) < 0 SET @PageSize = 0;

    DECLARE @Sep BIT = CAST(ISNULL((SELECT MAX(CAST(AccSSeparateDuties AS INT))
                                    FROM dbo.Acc_CompanySettings WHERE AccSCmpID = @Cmp), 1) AS BIT);
    DECLARE @YS DATE = DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, 1, 1), @YE DATE = DATEFROMPARTS(@Year + 1, 1, 1);

    DECLARE @Off INT = CASE WHEN @PageSize = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (@PageNo - 1) * @PageSize END;
    DECLARE @Fetch INT = CASE WHEN @PageSize = 0 THEN 2147483647 ELSE @PageSize END;

    DECLARE @S NVARCHAR(100) = NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@Search)), N'');
    DECLARE @Pat NVARCHAR(220) = CASE WHEN @S IS NULL THEN NULL
        ELSE N'%' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@S, N'\', N'\\'), N'%', N'\%'), N'_', N'\_'), N'[', N'\[') + N'%' END;

    SELECT m.DayMID,
           m.DayMNo,
           CASE WHEN m.DayMNo > 0
                THEN CONCAT(m.DayMNo, N' / ', RIGHT(CONCAT(N'0', MONTH(m.DayMDate)), 2))
                ELSE N'' END                                   AS VoucherNo,
           m.DayMDate,
           m.DayMDescription,
           m.DayMState,
           CASE m.DayMState
                WHEN 0 THEN N'مؤقت'
                WHEN 1 THEN N'مُرحّل'
                WHEN 2 THEN N'مُعاد من المراجعة للمحاسب'
                WHEN 3 THEN N'تم اعتماد المراجعة'
                WHEN 4 THEN N'مُعاد من المدير المالي للمراجعة'
                WHEN 5 THEN N'مُعتمد من المدير المالي'
                WHEN 6 THEN N'مُعاد من الأرشيف للمدير المالي'
                WHEN 7 THEN N'مُؤرشف'
           END                                                 AS StateName,
           CAST(ISNULL(t.Deb, 0) AS DECIMAL(38,3))             AS TotalDebit,
           CAST(ISNULL(t.Crd, 0) AS DECIMAL(38,3))             AS TotalCredit,
           CAST(ISNULL(t.Cnt, 0) AS INT)                       AS LinesCount,
           CAST(CASE WHEN ISNULL(t.Cnt, 0) >= 2 AND ISNULL(t.Deb, 0) = ISNULL(t.Crd, 0) AND ISNULL(t.Deb, 0) > 0
                     THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BIT)                 AS IsBalanced,
           m.DayMUser,
           m.DayMDateTime,
           f.AcceptState,
           f.RejectState,
           CAST(CASE WHEN f.ActStage IS NOT NULL AND (@Sep = 0 OR m.DayMUser <> @User) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BIT) AS CanAccept,
           CAST(CASE WHEN f.ActStage IS NOT NULL AND (@Sep = 0 OR m.DayMUser <> @User) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BIT) AS CanReject,
           CAST(CASE WHEN m.DayMState IN (0, 2) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BIT) AS CanEdit,
           CAST(1 AS BIT)                                       AS CanPrint,
           CAST(COUNT(*) OVER () AS INT)                        AS TotalRows
    FROM dbo.Acc_DayMaster AS m
    OUTER APPLY (SELECT SUM(d.DayDDeb) AS Deb, SUM(d.DayDCrd) AS Crd, COUNT(*) AS Cnt
                 FROM dbo.Acc_DayDetails AS d WHERE d.DayDMID = m.DayMID) AS t
    OUTER APPLY dbo.Acc_VoucherFlow(m.DayMCompany, m.DayMState) AS f
    WHERE m.DayMCompany = @Cmp
      AND m.DayMState   = @State
      AND m.DayMDate >= @YS AND m.DayMDate < @YE
      AND (@FromDate IS NULL OR m.DayMDate >= @FromDate)
      AND (@ToDate   IS NULL OR m.DayMDate <= @ToDate)
      AND (@State <> 0 OR m.DayMUser = @User)
      AND (@Pat IS NULL
           OR m.DayMDescription LIKE @Pat ESCAPE N'\'
           OR CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20), m.DayMNo) LIKE @Pat ESCAPE N'\')
    ORDER BY m.DayMDate DESC, m.DayMNo DESC, m.DayMID DESC
    OFFSET @Off ROWS FETCH NEXT @Fetch ROWS ONLY;
END;
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Acc_SelectExchangeRate]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 8. Acc_SelectExchangeRate
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Acc_SelectExchangeRate]
    @RateCmp    INT,
    @RateCurID  BIGINT = NULL,
    @FromDate   DATE = NULL,
    @ToDate     DATE = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    IF ISNULL(@RateCmp, 0) <= 0
        THROW 50120, N'معرف الشركة غير صالح.', 1;

    SELECT R.RateID, R.RateCmp, R.RateCurID, C.CurCode, C.CurName,
           R.RateDate, R.RateValue, R.RateUser, U.UsrLogIn AS RateUserName, R.RateDateTime
    FROM dbo.Acc_ExchangeRate AS R
    INNER JOIN dbo.Acc_Currency AS C ON C.CurCmp = R.RateCmp AND C.CurID = R.RateCurID
    LEFT JOIN dbo.Mng_User AS U ON U.UsrID = R.RateUser
    WHERE R.RateCmp = @RateCmp
      AND (@RateCurID IS NULL OR R.RateCurID = @RateCurID)
      AND (@FromDate IS NULL OR R.RateDate >= @FromDate)
      AND (@ToDate IS NULL OR R.RateDate <= @ToDate)
    ORDER BY C.CurCode, R.RateDate DESC;
END

GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Acc_SelectFinancialStatements]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Acc_SelectFinancialStatements]
    @FromDate  DATE = NULL,
    @ToDate    DATE,
    @Cmp       INT = 1,
    @Year      INT = 0,
    @AllAcc    BIT = 0,
    @MoveAcc   BIT = 0,
    @BalnceAcc BIT = 0,
    @LevelAcc  TINYINT = 0
AS
BEGIN
    /* =====================================================================
       اسم التقرير : القوائم المالية (Financial Statements)
       الإجراء     : dbo.Acc_SelectFinancialStatements
       المدخلات    : @ToDate و@Cmp و@Year؛ الفترة دائمًا من 1 يناير حتى @ToDate
                     (يُتجاهل @FromDate).
       النتائج     : 1 قائمة الدخل
                     2 قائمة المركز المالي (الميزانية العمومية)
                     3 حركة حقوق الملكية
                     4 ملخص القوائم المالية
                     5 فحوص سلامة البيانات
                     6-8 قائمة التدفقات النقدية (Acc_SelectCashFlow)
                     9 ميزان المراجعة
       القواعد     : القيود المرحّلة فقط (DayMState = 7)؛ القيد على الحساب
                     التحليلي فقط؛ السنة لا تُقفل.
                     حقوق الملكية = حساباتها + نتائج السنوات السابقة
                     + نتيجة السنة الحالية، وفرق الميزانية (BalanceSheetDifference)
                     يجب أن يكون صفرًا إذا كانت القيود متوازنة.
       ملاحظة     : معنى @AllAcc هنا: 0 = التحليلية فقط، 1 = كل الحسابات
                     (عكس بقية إجراءات التقارير).
       ===================================================================== */
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Acc;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Kid;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Leaf;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Roll;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #JournalBalance;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #BsOut;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #EqOut;
    /* =========================================================
       1. التحقق من المدخلات وتحديد السنة المالية
       ========================================================= */

    IF @ToDate IS NULL
        THROW 50201, N'تاريخ نهاية التقرير مطلوب.', 1;

    IF @Cmp IS NULL OR @Cmp <= 0
        THROW 50202, N'رقم الشركة غير صحيح.', 1;

    IF NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1
        FROM dbo.Mng_Company
        WHERE CmpID = @Cmp
    )
        THROW 50203, N'الشركة المحددة غير موجودة.', 1;

    SET @Year = ISNULL(@Year, 0);

    IF @Year = 0
        SET @Year = YEAR(@ToDate);

    IF @Year < 1900 OR @Year > 9999
        THROW 50204, N'السنة المالية غير صحيحة.', 1;

    IF YEAR(@ToDate) <> @Year
        THROW 50205, N'تاريخ نهاية التقرير لا يتوافق مع السنة المالية.', 1;

    SET @FromDate = DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, 1, 1);

    IF @ToDate < @FromDate
        THROW 50206, N'تاريخ نهاية التقرير يسبق بداية السنة المالية.', 1;

    SET @AllAcc    = ISNULL(@AllAcc, 0);
    SET @MoveAcc   = ISNULL(@MoveAcc, 0);
    SET @BalnceAcc = ISNULL(@BalnceAcc, 0);
    SET @LevelAcc  = ISNULL(@LevelAcc, 0);

    DECLARE @ToDateExclusive DATE = DATEADD(DAY, 1, @ToDate);

    IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Acc_SelectCashFlow', N'P') IS NULL
        THROW 50208, N'إجراء التدفقات النقدية غير موجود.', 1;


    /* =========================================================
       2. تحميل شجرة حسابات الشركة
       ========================================================= */

    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Acc;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Kid;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Leaf;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Roll;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #JournalBalance;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #BsOut;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #EqOut;

    SELECT
        A.AccID,
        A.AccParentID,
        A.AccLevel,
        CAST(ISNULL(A.AccChid, 0) AS SMALLINT) AS AccChid,
        ISNULL(A.AccCode, N'') AS AccCode,
        ISNULL(A.AccName, N'') AS AccName,
        A.AccEnd,
        A.AccType
    INTO #Acc
    FROM dbo.Acc_Account AS A
    WHERE A.AccCompany = @Cmp;

    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #Acc)
        THROW 50209, N'لا توجد حسابات مسجلة للشركة المحددة.', 1;

    CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_FS_Acc
        ON #Acc (AccID);

    CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_FS_AccParent
        ON #Acc (AccParentID);


    /* =========================================================
       3. التحقق من سلامة الشجرة
       ========================================================= */

    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1
        FROM #Acc AS C
        WHERE C.AccParentID > 0
          AND NOT EXISTS
          (
              SELECT 1
              FROM dbo.Acc_Account AS P
              WHERE P.AccID = C.AccParentID
          )
    )
        THROW 50210, N'توجد حسابات يتيمة؛ الحساب الأب غير موجود.', 1;

    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1
        FROM #Acc AS C
        INNER JOIN dbo.Acc_Account AS P
            ON P.AccID = C.AccParentID
        WHERE C.AccParentID > 0
          AND P.AccCompany <> @Cmp
    )
        THROW 50211, N'توجد علاقة أب وابن بين حسابات شركتين مختلفتين.', 1;

    DECLARE
        @AccountCount BIGINT,
        @ReachCount BIGINT;

    SELECT @AccountCount = COUNT_BIG(*)
    FROM #Acc;

    ;WITH AccountReach AS
    (
        SELECT AccID
        FROM #Acc
        WHERE AccParentID IS NULL
           OR AccParentID = 0

        UNION ALL

        SELECT C.AccID
        FROM #Acc AS C
        INNER JOIN AccountReach AS P
            ON C.AccParentID = P.AccID
    )
    SELECT @ReachCount = COUNT_BIG(*)
    FROM AccountReach
    OPTION (MAXRECURSION 32767);

    IF ISNULL(@ReachCount, 0) <> @AccountCount
        THROW 50212, N'توجد دورة أو حسابات غير مرتبطة بجذر شجرة الحسابات.', 1;


    /* =========================================================
       4. التحقق من التصنيف المالي

       الميزانية:
       AccEnd = 1
       AccType = 0 أصول
       AccType = 1 خصوم
       AccType = 2 حقوق ملكية

       قائمة الدخل:
       AccEnd = 2
       AccType = 0 إيرادات
       AccType = 1 مصروفات
       ========================================================= */

    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1
        FROM #Acc
        WHERE AccEnd IS NULL
           OR AccType IS NULL
           OR NOT
           (
               (AccEnd = 1 AND AccType IN (0,1,2))
               OR
               (AccEnd = 2 AND AccType IN (0,1))
           )
    )
        THROW 50213, N'توجد حسابات بتصنيف مالي غير صحيح.', 1;

    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1
        FROM #Acc AS C
        INNER JOIN #Acc AS P
            ON P.AccID = C.AccParentID
        WHERE C.AccEnd <> P.AccEnd
           OR C.AccType <> P.AccType
    )
        THROW 50214, N'يوجد اختلاف في التصنيف المالي بين حساب أب وأحد أبنائه.', 1;


    /* =========================================================
       5. تحديد الأبناء الفعليين
       ========================================================= */

    SELECT
        AccParentID AS AccID,
        COUNT_BIG(*) AS ChildCount
    INTO #Kid
    FROM #Acc
    WHERE AccParentID IS NOT NULL
      AND AccParentID > 0
    GROUP BY AccParentID;

    CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_FS_Kid
        ON #Kid (AccID);


    /* =========================================================
       6. فحص القيود المؤرشفة غير المتوازنة
       ========================================================= */

    SELECT
        M.DayMID,
        SUM(CONVERT(DECIMAL(38,3), D.DayDDeb)) AS TotalDebit,
        SUM(CONVERT(DECIMAL(38,3), D.DayDCrd)) AS TotalCredit
    INTO #JournalBalance
    FROM dbo.Acc_DayMaster AS M
    INNER JOIN dbo.Acc_DayDetails AS D
        ON D.DayDMID = M.DayMID
    WHERE M.DayMCompany = @Cmp
      AND M.DayMState = 7
      AND M.DayMDate < @ToDateExclusive
    GROUP BY M.DayMID;

    CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_FS_JournalBalance
        ON #JournalBalance (DayMID);

    DECLARE
        @UnbalancedJournalCount BIGINT = 0,
        @ForeignAccountCount BIGINT = 0,
        @OrphanAccountCount BIGINT = 0,
        @CrossCompanyParentCount BIGINT = 0,
        @InvalidClassCount BIGINT = 0,
        @NonLeafPostingCount BIGINT = 0;

    SELECT @UnbalancedJournalCount = COUNT_BIG(*)
    FROM #JournalBalance
    WHERE ABS(TotalDebit - TotalCredit) >= 0.001;


    /* =========================================================
       7. تجميع حركات الحسابات التحليلية
       ========================================================= */

    SELECT
        A.AccID,
        A.AccCode,
        A.AccName,
        A.AccParentID,
        A.AccLevel,
        A.AccChid,
        A.AccEnd,
        A.AccType,

        SUM
        (
            CASE
                WHEN M.DayMDate < @FromDate
                THEN
                    CONVERT(DECIMAL(38,3), D.DayDDeb)
                    - CONVERT(DECIMAL(38,3), D.DayDCrd)
                ELSE CONVERT(DECIMAL(38,3), 0)
            END
        ) AS OpeningNet,

        SUM
        (
            CASE
                WHEN M.DayMDate >= @FromDate
                THEN CONVERT(DECIMAL(38,3), D.DayDDeb)
                ELSE CONVERT(DECIMAL(38,3), 0)
            END
        ) AS PeriodDebit,

        SUM
        (
            CASE
                WHEN M.DayMDate >= @FromDate
                THEN CONVERT(DECIMAL(38,3), D.DayDCrd)
                ELSE CONVERT(DECIMAL(38,3), 0)
            END
        ) AS PeriodCredit,

        SUM
        (
            CASE
                WHEN M.DayMDate >= @FromDate
                THEN CONVERT(BIGINT, 1)
                ELSE CONVERT(BIGINT, 0)
            END
        ) AS MovementCount

    INTO #Leaf
    FROM dbo.Acc_DayMaster AS M
    INNER JOIN dbo.Acc_DayDetails AS D
        ON D.DayDMID = M.DayMID
    INNER JOIN #Acc AS A
        ON A.AccID = D.DayDAccID
    WHERE M.DayMCompany = @Cmp
      AND M.DayMState = 7
      AND M.DayMDate < @ToDateExclusive
      AND NOT EXISTS
      (
          SELECT 1
          FROM #Kid AS K
          WHERE K.AccID = A.AccID
      )
    GROUP BY
        A.AccID,
        A.AccCode,
        A.AccName,
        A.AccParentID,
        A.AccLevel,
        A.AccChid,
        A.AccEnd,
        A.AccType;

    CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_FS_Leaf
        ON #Leaf (AccID);


    /* =========================================================
       8. تجميع الحسابات التحليلية إلى الحسابات الأب
       ========================================================= */

    ;WITH AccountRollup AS
    (
        SELECT
            L.AccID AS NodeID,
            L.OpeningNet,
            L.PeriodDebit,
            L.PeriodCredit,
            L.MovementCount
        FROM #Leaf AS L

        UNION ALL

        SELECT
            P.AccID AS NodeID,
            R.OpeningNet,
            R.PeriodDebit,
            R.PeriodCredit,
            R.MovementCount
        FROM AccountRollup AS R
        INNER JOIN #Acc AS C
            ON C.AccID = R.NodeID
        INNER JOIN #Acc AS P
            ON P.AccID = C.AccParentID
        WHERE C.AccParentID > 0
    )
    SELECT
        NodeID AS AccID,
        SUM(OpeningNet) AS OpeningNet,
        SUM(PeriodDebit) AS PeriodDebit,
        SUM(PeriodCredit) AS PeriodCredit,
        SUM(MovementCount) AS MovementCount
    INTO #Roll
    FROM AccountRollup
    GROUP BY NodeID
    OPTION (MAXRECURSION 32767);

    CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_FS_Roll
        ON #Roll (AccID);


    /* =========================================================
       9. فحوص الحركات والتصنيفات
       ========================================================= */

    SELECT
        @ForeignAccountCount = COUNT_BIG(*)
    FROM dbo.Acc_DayMaster AS M
    INNER JOIN dbo.Acc_DayDetails AS D
        ON D.DayDMID = M.DayMID
    LEFT JOIN #Acc AS A
        ON A.AccID = D.DayDAccID
    WHERE M.DayMCompany = @Cmp
      AND M.DayMState = 7
      AND M.DayMDate < @ToDateExclusive
      AND A.AccID IS NULL;

    -- حركات مسجلة على حسابات أب (لا تدخل في الأرقام لأن القيد يُسجل على الحساب التحليلي فقط)
    SELECT
        @NonLeafPostingCount = COUNT_BIG(*)
    FROM dbo.Acc_DayMaster AS M
    INNER JOIN dbo.Acc_DayDetails AS D
        ON D.DayDMID = M.DayMID
    INNER JOIN #Kid AS K
        ON K.AccID = D.DayDAccID
    WHERE M.DayMCompany = @Cmp
      AND M.DayMState = 7
      AND M.DayMDate < @ToDateExclusive;

    SELECT
        @OrphanAccountCount = COUNT_BIG(*)
    FROM #Acc AS C
    WHERE C.AccParentID > 0
      AND NOT EXISTS
      (
          SELECT 1
          FROM #Acc AS P
          WHERE P.AccID = C.AccParentID
      );

    SELECT
        @CrossCompanyParentCount = COUNT_BIG(*)
    FROM #Acc AS C
    INNER JOIN dbo.Acc_Account AS P
        ON P.AccID = C.AccParentID
    WHERE P.AccCompany <> @Cmp;

    SELECT
        @InvalidClassCount = COUNT_BIG(*)
    FROM #Acc
    WHERE AccEnd IS NULL
       OR AccType IS NULL
       OR NOT
       (
           (AccEnd = 1 AND AccType IN (0,1,2))
           OR
           (AccEnd = 2 AND AccType IN (0,1))
       );


    /* =========================================================
       10. إجماليات قائمة الدخل
       ========================================================= */

    DECLARE
        @Revenue DECIMAL(38,3) = 0,
        @Expenses DECIMAL(38,3) = 0,
        @NetIncome DECIMAL(38,3) = 0;

    SELECT
        @Revenue =
            ISNULL
            (
                SUM
                (
                    CASE
                        WHEN AccType = 0
                        THEN PeriodCredit - PeriodDebit
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                ),
                0
            ),
        @Expenses =
            ISNULL
            (
                SUM
                (
                    CASE
                        WHEN AccType = 1
                        THEN PeriodDebit - PeriodCredit
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                ),
                0
            )
    FROM #Leaf
    WHERE AccEnd = 2;

    SET @NetIncome = @Revenue - @Expenses;

    /* السنة المالية لا تُقفل، فحسابات قائمة الدخل تتراكم:
       نتائج السنوات السابقة = كل ما قبل بداية السنة (الدائن موجب)،
       وصافي حركة حسابات قائمة الدخل خلال السنة = نتيجة السنة الحالية. */
    DECLARE
        @PriorResult DECIMAL(38,3) = 0,
        @IsDebit     DECIMAL(38,3) = 0,
        @IsCredit    DECIMAL(38,3) = 0,
        @IsCount     BIGINT = 0;

    SELECT
        @PriorResult = -ISNULL(SUM(OpeningNet), 0),
        @IsDebit     = ISNULL(SUM(PeriodDebit), 0),
        @IsCredit    = ISNULL(SUM(PeriodCredit), 0),
        @IsCount     = ISNULL(SUM(MovementCount), 0)
    FROM #Leaf
    WHERE AccEnd = 2;


    /* =========================================================
       11. إجماليات المركز المالي
       ========================================================= */

    DECLARE
        @Assets DECIMAL(38,3) = 0,
        @Liabilities DECIMAL(38,3) = 0,
        @EquityAcc DECIMAL(38,3) = 0;

    SELECT
        @Assets =
            ISNULL
            (
                SUM
                (
                    CASE
                        WHEN A.AccType = 0
                        THEN ISNULL(R.OpeningNet,0)
                           + ISNULL(R.PeriodDebit,0)
                           - ISNULL(R.PeriodCredit,0)
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                ),
                0
            ),

        @Liabilities =
            ISNULL
            (
                SUM
                (
                    CASE
                        WHEN A.AccType = 1
                        THEN -ISNULL(R.OpeningNet,0)
                             - ISNULL(R.PeriodDebit,0)
                             + ISNULL(R.PeriodCredit,0)
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                ),
                0
            ),

        @EquityAcc =
            ISNULL
            (
                SUM
                (
                    CASE
                        WHEN A.AccType = 2
                        THEN -ISNULL(R.OpeningNet,0)
                             - ISNULL(R.PeriodDebit,0)
                             + ISNULL(R.PeriodCredit,0)
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                ),
                0
            )
    FROM #Acc AS A
    LEFT JOIN #Roll AS R
        ON R.AccID = A.AccID
    WHERE A.AccEnd = 1
      AND
      (
          A.AccParentID IS NULL
          OR A.AccParentID = 0
      );


    /* =========================================================
       12. فروقات المطابقة
       ========================================================= */

    DECLARE
        @BalanceDifference DECIMAL(38,3),
        @Equity DECIMAL(38,3);

    /* حقوق الملكية = حساباتها + نتائج السنوات السابقة + نتيجة السنة الحالية */
    SET @Equity = @EquityAcc + @PriorResult + @NetIncome;

    SET @BalanceDifference =
        @Assets - @Liabilities - @Equity;



    /* =========================================================
       RESULT SET 1: قائمة الدخل
       ========================================================= */

    SELECT
        A.AccID,
        A.AccCode,
        A.AccName AS AccARName,
        A.AccParentID,
        P.AccName AS AccParentName,
        A.AccLevel,
        A.AccChid,
        A.AccType,

        CASE
            WHEN A.AccType = 0 THEN N'إيرادات'
            WHEN A.AccType = 1 THEN N'مصروفات'
        END AS AccountCategory,

        ISNULL(R.PeriodDebit,0) AS PeriodDebit,
        ISNULL(R.PeriodCredit,0) AS PeriodCredit,

        CAST
        (
            CASE
                WHEN A.AccType = 0
                    THEN ISNULL(R.PeriodCredit,0)
                       - ISNULL(R.PeriodDebit,0)
                WHEN A.AccType = 1
                    THEN ISNULL(R.PeriodDebit,0)
                       - ISNULL(R.PeriodCredit,0)
                ELSE 0
            END
            AS DECIMAL(38,3)
        ) AS PeriodAmount,

        ISNULL(R.MovementCount,0) AS MovementCount,

        @Revenue AS TotalRevenue,
        @Expenses AS TotalExpenses,
        @NetIncome AS NetIncome

    FROM #Acc AS A
    LEFT JOIN #Acc AS P
        ON P.AccID = A.AccParentID
    LEFT JOIN #Kid AS K
        ON K.AccID = A.AccID
    LEFT JOIN #Roll AS R
        ON R.AccID = A.AccID
    WHERE A.AccEnd = 2
      AND A.AccType IN (0,1)
      AND (@AllAcc = 1 OR K.AccID IS NULL)
      AND (@MoveAcc = 0 OR ISNULL(R.MovementCount,0) > 0)
      AND
      (
          @LevelAcc = 0
          OR A.AccLevel = @LevelAcc
          OR (A.AccLevel < @LevelAcc AND K.AccID IS NULL)
      )
    ORDER BY A.AccCode, A.AccID;


    /* =========================================================
       RESULT SET 2: قائمة المركز المالي
       ========================================================= */

    SELECT
        A.AccID,
        A.AccCode,
        A.AccName AS AccARName,
        A.AccParentID,
        P.AccName AS AccParentName,
        A.AccLevel,
        A.AccChid,
        A.AccType,

        CASE
            WHEN A.AccType = 0 THEN N'الأصول'
            WHEN A.AccType = 1 THEN N'الخصوم'
            WHEN A.AccType = 2 THEN N'حقوق الملكية'
        END AS AccountCategory,

        ISNULL(R.OpeningNet,0) AS OpeningNet,
        ISNULL(R.PeriodDebit,0) AS PeriodDebit,
        ISNULL(R.PeriodCredit,0) AS PeriodCredit,

        CAST
        (
            CASE
                WHEN A.AccType = 0
                    THEN ISNULL(R.OpeningNet,0)
                       + ISNULL(R.PeriodDebit,0)
                       - ISNULL(R.PeriodCredit,0)
                WHEN A.AccType IN (1,2)
                    THEN -ISNULL(R.OpeningNet,0)
                       - ISNULL(R.PeriodDebit,0)
                       + ISNULL(R.PeriodCredit,0)
                ELSE 0
            END
            AS DECIMAL(38,3)
        ) AS ClosingBalance,

        ISNULL(R.MovementCount,0) AS MovementCount,

        @Assets AS TotalAssets,
        @Liabilities AS TotalLiabilities,
        @Equity AS TotalEquity,
        CAST(0 AS TINYINT) AS RowKind
    INTO #BsOut

    FROM #Acc AS A
    LEFT JOIN #Acc AS P
        ON P.AccID = A.AccParentID
    LEFT JOIN #Kid AS K
        ON K.AccID = A.AccID
    LEFT JOIN #Roll AS R
        ON R.AccID = A.AccID
    WHERE A.AccEnd = 1
      AND A.AccType IN (0,1,2)
      AND (@AllAcc = 1 OR K.AccID IS NULL)
      AND (@MoveAcc = 0 OR ISNULL(R.MovementCount,0) > 0)
      AND
      (
          @BalnceAcc = 0
          OR
          (
              CASE
                  WHEN A.AccType = 0
                      THEN ISNULL(R.OpeningNet,0)
                         + ISNULL(R.PeriodDebit,0)
                         - ISNULL(R.PeriodCredit,0)
                  ELSE -ISNULL(R.OpeningNet,0)
                       - ISNULL(R.PeriodDebit,0)
                       + ISNULL(R.PeriodCredit,0)
              END
          ) <> 0
      )
      AND
      (
          @LevelAcc = 0
          OR A.AccLevel = @LevelAcc
          OR (A.AccLevel < @LevelAcc AND K.AccID IS NULL)
      )
    ALTER TABLE #BsOut ALTER COLUMN AccCode NVARCHAR(200) NULL;
    ALTER TABLE #BsOut ALTER COLUMN AccARName NVARCHAR(400) NULL;

    -- صفّا نتائج السنوات ضمن حقوق الملكية (يظهران حتى مع @AllAcc و@LevelAcc)
    IF @MoveAcc = 0 AND (@BalnceAcc = 0 OR @PriorResult <> 0)
        INSERT INTO #BsOut
        (
            AccID, AccCode, AccARName, AccParentID, AccParentName, AccLevel, AccChid, AccType,
            AccountCategory, OpeningNet, PeriodDebit, PeriodCredit, ClosingBalance, MovementCount,
            TotalAssets, TotalLiabilities, TotalEquity, RowKind
        )
        VALUES
        (
            -1, N'~1', N'نتائج السنوات السابقة', NULL, NULL, 1, 0, 2,
            N'حقوق الملكية', -@PriorResult, 0, 0, @PriorResult, 0,
            @Assets, @Liabilities, @Equity, 1
        );

    IF (@MoveAcc = 0 OR @IsCount > 0) AND (@BalnceAcc = 0 OR @NetIncome <> 0)
        INSERT INTO #BsOut
        (
            AccID, AccCode, AccARName, AccParentID, AccParentName, AccLevel, AccChid, AccType,
            AccountCategory, OpeningNet, PeriodDebit, PeriodCredit, ClosingBalance, MovementCount,
            TotalAssets, TotalLiabilities, TotalEquity, RowKind
        )
        VALUES
        (
            -2, N'~2', N'نتيجة السنة الحالية', NULL, NULL, 1, 0, 2,
            N'حقوق الملكية', 0, @IsDebit, @IsCredit, @NetIncome, @IsCount,
            @Assets, @Liabilities, @Equity, 2
        );

    SELECT *
    FROM #BsOut
    ORDER BY AccType, RowKind, AccCode, AccID;


    /* =========================================================
       RESULT SET 3: حركة حقوق الملكية
       ========================================================= */

    SELECT
        A.AccID,
        A.AccCode,
        A.AccName AS AccARName,
        A.AccParentID,
        A.AccLevel,

        CAST
        (
            -ISNULL(R.OpeningNet,0)
            AS DECIMAL(38,3)
        ) AS OpeningEquity,

        CAST
        (
            ISNULL(R.PeriodCredit,0)
            - ISNULL(R.PeriodDebit,0)
            AS DECIMAL(38,3)
        ) AS PeriodMovement,

        CAST
        (
            -ISNULL(R.OpeningNet,0)
            - ISNULL(R.PeriodDebit,0)
            + ISNULL(R.PeriodCredit,0)
            AS DECIMAL(38,3)
        ) AS ClosingEquity,

        ISNULL(R.MovementCount,0) AS MovementCount,
        CAST(0 AS TINYINT) AS RowKind
    INTO #EqOut

    FROM #Acc AS A
    LEFT JOIN #Kid AS K
        ON K.AccID = A.AccID
    LEFT JOIN #Roll AS R
        ON R.AccID = A.AccID
    WHERE A.AccEnd = 1
      AND A.AccType = 2
      AND (@AllAcc = 1 OR K.AccID IS NULL)
      AND (@MoveAcc = 0 OR ISNULL(R.MovementCount,0) > 0)
      AND
      (
          @LevelAcc = 0
          OR A.AccLevel = @LevelAcc
          OR (A.AccLevel < @LevelAcc AND K.AccID IS NULL)
      )
    ALTER TABLE #EqOut ALTER COLUMN AccCode NVARCHAR(200) NULL;
    ALTER TABLE #EqOut ALTER COLUMN AccARName NVARCHAR(400) NULL;

    IF @MoveAcc = 0
        INSERT INTO #EqOut
        (AccID, AccCode, AccARName, AccParentID, AccLevel, OpeningEquity, PeriodMovement, ClosingEquity, MovementCount, RowKind)
        VALUES
        (-1, N'~1', N'نتائج السنوات السابقة', NULL, 1, @PriorResult, 0, @PriorResult, 0, 1);

    IF @MoveAcc = 0 OR @IsCount > 0
        INSERT INTO #EqOut
        (AccID, AccCode, AccARName, AccParentID, AccLevel, OpeningEquity, PeriodMovement, ClosingEquity, MovementCount, RowKind)
        VALUES
        (-2, N'~2', N'نتيجة السنة الحالية', NULL, 1, 0, @NetIncome, @NetIncome, @IsCount, 2);

    SELECT *
    FROM #EqOut
    ORDER BY RowKind, AccCode, AccID;


    /* =========================================================
       RESULT SET 4: ملخص القوائم المالية
       ========================================================= */

    SELECT
        @Cmp AS CompanyID,
        @Year AS FinancialYear,
        @FromDate AS FromDate,
        @ToDate AS ToDate,

        @Revenue AS TotalRevenue,
        @Expenses AS TotalExpenses,
        @NetIncome AS NetIncome,
        @PriorResult AS PriorYearsResult,
        @EquityAcc AS EquityAccountsTotal,

        @Assets AS TotalAssets,
        @Liabilities AS TotalLiabilities,
        @Equity AS TotalEquity,

        @BalanceDifference AS BalanceSheetDifference,

        CASE
            WHEN ABS(@BalanceDifference) < 0.001
                THEN N'متوازن'
            ELSE N'توجد فروقات'
        END AS BalanceSheetStatus;


    /* =========================================================
       RESULT SET 5: فحوص سلامة البيانات
       ========================================================= */

    SELECT
        @ForeignAccountCount AS ForeignAccountMovementCount,
        @OrphanAccountCount AS OrphanAccountCount,
        @CrossCompanyParentCount AS CrossCompanyParentCount,
        @InvalidClassCount AS InvalidAccountClassificationCount,
        @UnbalancedJournalCount AS UnbalancedJournalCount,
        @NonLeafPostingCount AS NonLeafPostingCount,

        CASE
            WHEN @ForeignAccountCount = 0
             AND @OrphanAccountCount = 0
             AND @CrossCompanyParentCount = 0
             AND @InvalidClassCount = 0
             AND @UnbalancedJournalCount = 0
             AND @NonLeafPostingCount = 0
                THEN N'اجتازت البيانات فحوص السلامة المحددة'
            ELSE N'توجد ملاحظات تتطلب المراجعة'
        END AS DataIntegrityStatus;


    /* =========================================================
       RESULT SETS 6-8: التدفقات النقدية
       ========================================================= */

    EXEC dbo.Acc_SelectCashFlow
        @CompanyID = @Cmp,
        @DateFrom  = @FromDate,
        @DateTo    = @ToDate;


    /* =========================================================
       RESULT SET 9: ميزان المراجعة

       ملاحظة:
       OpenNet = صافي الرصيد الافتتاحي مديناً ناقص دائناً.
       PerDeb  = إجمالي مدين الفترة.
       PerCrd  = إجمالي دائن الفترة.
       PerCnt  = عدد تفاصيل الحركات خلال الفترة.
       ========================================================= */

    SELECT
        A.AccID,
        A.AccCode,
        A.AccName,
        A.AccLevel,
        A.AccParentID,
        A.AccChid,

        CAST(ISNULL(R.OpeningNet,0) AS DECIMAL(38,3))
            AS OpenNet,

        CAST(ISNULL(R.PeriodDebit,0) AS DECIMAL(38,3))
            AS PerDeb,

        CAST(ISNULL(R.PeriodCredit,0) AS DECIMAL(38,3))
            AS PerCrd,

        CAST(ISNULL(R.MovementCount,0) AS BIGINT)
            AS PerCnt,

        CAST
        (
            ISNULL(R.OpeningNet,0)
            + ISNULL(R.PeriodDebit,0)
            - ISNULL(R.PeriodCredit,0)
            AS DECIMAL(38,3)
        ) AS ClosingNet

    FROM #Acc AS A
    LEFT JOIN #Kid AS K
        ON K.AccID = A.AccID
    LEFT JOIN #Roll AS R
        ON R.AccID = A.AccID

    WHERE
        (@AllAcc = 1 OR K.AccID IS NULL)
        AND
        (
            @MoveAcc = 0
            OR ISNULL(R.MovementCount,0) > 0
        )
        AND
        (
            @BalnceAcc = 0
            OR
            (
                ISNULL(R.OpeningNet,0)
                + ISNULL(R.PeriodDebit,0)
                - ISNULL(R.PeriodCredit,0)
            ) <> 0
        )
        AND
        (
            @LevelAcc = 0
            OR A.AccLevel = @LevelAcc
            OR
            (
                A.AccLevel < @LevelAcc
                AND K.AccID IS NULL
            )
        )

    ORDER BY A.AccCode, A.AccID;

END;


GO

GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Acc_SelectMinMaxYear]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@Cmp int  , @Sys tinyint
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- Insert statements for procedure here
	if(@Sys = 1) SELECT  Min( [AccFYear]) as MinYear , Max( [AccFYear]) as MaxYear   FROM [dbo].[Acc_FiscalYear]  Where [AccFCmpID] = @Cmp
	--else SELECT  Max( [AccFYear]) as MinYear , Max( [AccFYear]) as MaxYear   FROM [dbo].[Acc_FiscalYear]  Where [AccFCmpID] = @Cmp
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Acc_UpdaeAccounting]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Acc_UpdaeAccounting]
    @AccName NVARCHAR(500),
    @original_AccID BIGINT,
    @AccUser BIGINT,
    @Cmp INT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;

        -- التحقق من الحساب وقفل سجله
        IF NOT EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM dbo.Acc_Account WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
            WHERE AccID = @original_AccID
              AND AccCompany = @Cmp
        )
            THROW 50001, N'الحساب غير موجود أو لا يتبع الشركة المحددة.', 1;

        -- تسجيل بيانات الحساب قبل التعديل
        INSERT INTO dbo.Acc_AccountHistory
        (
            AccHOpration,
            AccHAccID,
            AccHEnd,
            AccHType,
            AccHParentID,
            AccHOrder,
            AccHLevel,
            AccHChid,
            AccHCode,
            AccHName,
            AccHState,
            AccHDateTime,
            AccHUser,
            AccHCompany
        )
        SELECT
            2,
            AccID,
            AccEnd,
            AccType,
            AccParentID,
            AccOrder,
            AccLevel,
            AccChid,
            AccCode,
            AccName,
            AccState,
            SYSUTCDATETIME(),
            @AccUser,
            AccCompany
        FROM dbo.Acc_Account
        WHERE AccID = @original_AccID
          AND AccCompany = @Cmp;

        -- تعديل اسم الحساب
        UPDATE dbo.Acc_Account
        SET
            AccName = @AccName,
            AccDateTime = SYSUTCDATETIME(),
            AccUser = @AccUser
        WHERE AccID = @original_AccID
          AND AccCompany = @Cmp;

        IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0
            THROW 50002, N'تعذر تحديث بيانات الحساب.', 1;

        -- إعادة تنسيق أكواد الحسابات
        EXEC dbo.Acc_UpdateAccountCode @AccCompany = @Cmp;

        COMMIT TRANSACTION;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF XACT_STATE() <> 0
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;

        THROW;
    END CATCH;
END;
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Acc_UpdateAccountCode]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Acc_UpdateAccountCode]
    @AccCompany INT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;

        -- إعادة ترقيم الحسابات الفرعية والرئيسية داخل الشركة
        ;WITH AccountOrder AS
        (
            SELECT
                AccID,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER
                (
                    PARTITION BY AccParentID
                    ORDER BY AccOrder, AccID
                ) AS NewOrder
            FROM dbo.Acc_Account
            WHERE AccCompany = @AccCompany
        )
        UPDATE A
        SET
            AccOrder = O.NewOrder
        FROM dbo.Acc_Account AS A
        INNER JOIN AccountOrder AS O
            ON O.AccID = A.AccID;

        -- إعادة بناء الرموز من الحسابات الرئيسية إلى الفروع
        DECLARE @Level SMALLINT = 2;
        DECLARE @MaxLevel SMALLINT;

        SELECT @MaxLevel = MAX(AccLevel)
        FROM dbo.Acc_Account
        WHERE AccCompany = @AccCompany;

        WHILE @Level <= ISNULL(@MaxLevel, 0)
        BEGIN
            UPDATE C
            SET
                C.AccCode =
                    P.AccCode +
                    RIGHT(
                        REPLICATE(N'0', LEN(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), P.AccChid))) +
                        CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), C.AccOrder),
                        LEN(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), P.AccChid))
                    ),
                C.AccDateTime = SYSDATETIME()
            FROM dbo.Acc_Account AS C
            INNER JOIN dbo.Acc_Account AS P
                ON P.AccID = C.AccParentID
               AND P.AccCompany = C.AccCompany
            WHERE C.AccCompany = @AccCompany
              AND C.AccLevel = @Level;

            SET @Level += 1;
        END;

        COMMIT TRANSACTION;

        SELECT *
        FROM dbo.Acc_Account
        WHERE AccCompany = @AccCompany
        ORDER BY AccLevel, AccParentID, AccOrder, AccID;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF XACT_STATE() <> 0
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;

        THROW;
    END CATCH;
END;

GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[ACC_UpdateCostCenterCode]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

/* --- مراكز التكلفة: نفّذ هذا الجزء بعد التحقق فقط --- */
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[ACC_UpdateCostCenterCode]
    @CsCCompany INT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;

        -- إعادة ترتيب مراكز التكلفة الرئيسية والفرعية داخل الشركة
        ;WITH CostCenterOrder AS
        (
            SELECT
                CsCID,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER
                (
                    PARTITION BY CsCParentID
                    ORDER BY CsCOrder, CsCID
                ) AS NewOrder
            FROM dbo.Acc_CostCenter
            WHERE CsCCompany = @CsCCompany
        )
        UPDATE C
        SET CsCOrder = O.NewOrder
        FROM dbo.Acc_CostCenter AS C
        INNER JOIN CostCenterOrder AS O
            ON O.CsCID = C.CsCID;

        -- تحديد أعلى مستوى
        DECLARE @Level SMALLINT = 2;
        DECLARE @MaxLevel SMALLINT;

        SELECT @MaxLevel = MAX(CsCLevel)
        FROM dbo.Acc_CostCenter
        WHERE CsCCompany = @CsCCompany;

        -- إعادة بناء الأكواد من الأب إلى الابن
        WHILE @Level <= ISNULL(@MaxLevel, 0)
        BEGIN
            UPDATE C
            SET
                C.CsCCode =
                    P.CsCCode +
                    RIGHT
                    (
                        REPLICATE(N'0', LEN(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), P.CsCChid))) +
                        CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), C.CsCOrder),
                        LEN(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), P.CsCChid))
                    ),
                C.CsCDateTime = SYSUTCDATETIME()
            FROM dbo.Acc_CostCenter AS C
            INNER JOIN dbo.Acc_CostCenter AS P
                ON P.CsCID = C.CsCParentID
               AND P.CsCCompany = C.CsCCompany
            WHERE C.CsCCompany = @CsCCompany
              AND C.CsCLevel = @Level;

            SET @Level += 1;
        END;

        COMMIT TRANSACTION;

        SELECT *
        FROM dbo.Acc_CostCenter
        WHERE CsCCompany = @CsCCompany
        ORDER BY CsCLevel, CsCParentID, CsCOrder, CsCID;

    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF XACT_STATE() <> 0
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;

        THROW;
    END CATCH;
END;

GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Acc_UpdateCostCenters]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Acc_UpdateCostCenters]
    @CsCName NVARCHAR(500),
    @CsCUser BIGINT,
    @original_CsCID BIGINT,
    @Cmp INT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;

        -- التحقق من مركز التكلفة وقفل سجله
        IF NOT EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM dbo.Acc_CostCenter WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
            WHERE CsCID = @original_CsCID
              AND CsCCompany = @Cmp
        )
            THROW 50001, N'مركز التكلفة غير موجود أو لا يتبع الشركة المحددة.', 1;

        -- تسجيل بيانات مركز التكلفة قبل التعديل
        INSERT INTO dbo.Acc_CostCenterHistory
        (
            CsCHOpration,
            CsCHCsCID,
            CsCHParentID,
            CsCHOrder,
            CsCHLevel,
            CsCHChid,
            CsCHCode,
            CsCHName,
            CsCHState,
            CsCHDateTime,
            CsCHUser,
            CsCHCompany
        )
        SELECT
            2,
            CsCID,
            CsCParentID,
            CsCOrder,
            CsCLevel,
            CsCChid,
            CsCCode,
            CsCName,
            CsCState,
            SYSDATETIME(),
            @CsCUser,
            CsCCompany
        FROM dbo.Acc_CostCenter
        WHERE CsCID = @original_CsCID
          AND CsCCompany = @Cmp;

        -- تعديل اسم مركز التكلفة
        UPDATE dbo.Acc_CostCenter
        SET
            CsCName = @CsCName,
            CsCDateTime = SYSUTCDATETIME(),
            CsCUser = @CsCUser
        WHERE CsCID = @original_CsCID
          AND CsCCompany = @Cmp;

        IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0
            THROW 50002, N'تعذر تحديث بيانات مركز التكلفة.', 1;

        -- إعادة تنسيق أكواد مراكز التكلفة
        EXEC dbo.ACC_UpdateCostCenterCode
            @CsCCompany = @Cmp;

        COMMIT TRANSACTION;

    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH

        IF XACT_STATE() <> 0
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;

        THROW;

    END CATCH;
END;
GO

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Acc_UpDownAccount]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Acc_UpDownAccount]
    @AccID BIGINT,
    @AccUser BIGINT,
    @Cmp INT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    DECLARE
        @ParentID BIGINT,
        @CurrentOrder INT,
        @PreviousID BIGINT,
        @PreviousOrder INT;

    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;

        -- التحقق من الحساب وقفل سجله
        SELECT
            @ParentID = AccParentID,
            @CurrentOrder = AccOrder
        FROM dbo.Acc_Account WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
        WHERE AccID = @AccID
          AND AccCompany = @Cmp;

        IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0
            THROW 50001, N'الحساب غير موجود أو لا يتبع الشركة المحددة.', 1;

        IF @ParentID IS NULL
            THROW 50002, N'لا يمكن تغيير ترتيب الحساب الجذر.', 1;

        -- لا يوجد حساب سابق إذا كان الترتيب الأول
        IF @CurrentOrder <= 1
            THROW 50003, N'الحساب موجود بالفعل في أول الترتيب.', 1;

        -- البحث عن الحساب السابق مباشرة
        SELECT
            @PreviousID = AccID,
            @PreviousOrder = AccOrder
        FROM dbo.Acc_Account WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
        WHERE AccParentID = @ParentID
          AND AccCompany = @Cmp
          AND AccOrder = @CurrentOrder - 1;

        IF @PreviousID IS NULL
            THROW 50004, N'لم يتم العثور على الحساب السابق في الترتيب.', 1;

        -- حفظ صورة الحساب الأول قبل التعديل
        INSERT INTO dbo.Acc_AccountHistory
        (
            AccHOpration,
            AccHAccID,
            AccHEnd,
            AccHType,
            AccHParentID,
            AccHOrder,
            AccHLevel,
            AccHChid,
            AccHCode,
            AccHName,
            AccHState,
            AccHDateTime,
            AccHUser,
            AccHCompany
        )
        SELECT
            4,
            AccID,
            AccEnd,
            AccType,
            AccParentID,
            AccOrder,
            AccLevel,
            AccChid,
            AccCode,
            AccName,
            AccState,
            SYSUTCDATETIME(),
            @AccUser,
            AccCompany
        FROM dbo.Acc_Account
        WHERE AccID IN (@AccID, @PreviousID);

        -- تبديل الترتيب بين الحسابين
        UPDATE dbo.Acc_Account
        SET
            AccOrder = @PreviousOrder,
            AccUser = @AccUser,
            AccDateTime = SYSUTCDATETIME()
        WHERE AccID = @AccID
          AND AccCompany = @Cmp;

        UPDATE dbo.Acc_Account
        SET
            AccOrder = @CurrentOrder,
            AccUser = @AccUser,
            AccDateTime = SYSUTCDATETIME()
        WHERE AccID = @PreviousID
          AND AccCompany = @Cmp;

        -- إعادة تنسيق أكواد الحسابات
        EXEC dbo.Acc_UpdateAccountCode @AccCompany = @Cmp;

        COMMIT TRANSACTION;

        SELECT @AccID AS AccID;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF XACT_STATE() <> 0
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;

        THROW;
    END CATCH;
END;
GO

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Emp_ApproveLoanAndGenerateSchedule]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

/* ================================================================
   14. LOAN SCHEDULE AND PAYROLL-POSTING READINESS
   ================================================================ */
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Emp_ApproveLoanAndGenerateSchedule]
 @CmpID INT,@LoanID BIGINT,@ApproverID BIGINT,@StepNo SMALLINT=1,@Comments NVARCHAR(1000)=NULL
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@ApproverID;
 BEGIN TRY
  BEGIN TRAN;
 DECLARE @Principal DECIMAL(15,3),@Interest DECIMAL(15,3),@Count SMALLINT,@InstallmentAmount DECIMAL(15,3),@IntervalDays SMALLINT,@Start DATE,@State TINYINT,@CreatorID BIGINT;
 SELECT @Principal=Principal,@Interest=InterestAmount,@Count=InstallmentCount,@InstallmentAmount=InstallmentAmount,@IntervalDays=InstallmentIntervalDays,@Start=StartDate,@State=LoanState,@CreatorID=CreatedBy
 FROM dbo.Emp_Loans WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND LoanID=@LoanID;
 IF @Principal IS NULL OR @State<>0 THROW 54140,N'طلب السلفة غير موجود أو سبق اعتماده.',1;
 IF @CreatorID=@ApproverID THROW 54390,N'لا يجوز لمنشئ طلب السلفة اعتماده.',1;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_ApprovalRequests WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND ProcessType=4 AND EntityID=@LoanID)
 BEGIN
  DECLARE @ApprovalResult TINYINT,@NextApproval SMALLINT;
  EXEC dbo.Emp_DecideApprovalStep @CmpID,4,@LoanID,@StepNo,@ApproverID,1,@Comments,@ApprovalResult OUTPUT,@NextApproval OUTPUT,1;
  IF @ApprovalResult=0
  BEGIN
   COMMIT TRANSACTION;
   SELECT * FROM dbo.Emp_LoanInstallments WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND LoanID=@LoanID ORDER BY InstallmentNo;
   RETURN;
  END;
 END; IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_LoanInstallments WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND LoanID=@LoanID) THROW 54141,N'جدول الأقساط موجود مسبقاً.',1;
 DECLARE @Total DECIMAL(15,3)=@Principal+@Interest,@i INT=1,@Sum DECIMAL(15,3)=0;
 IF @Total<=@InstallmentAmount*(@Count-1) OR @Total>@InstallmentAmount*@Count THROW 54142,N'مبلغ القسط وعدد الأقساط لا يغطيان إجمالي السلفة.',1;
 WHILE @i<=@Count
 BEGIN
  DECLARE @Amount DECIMAL(15,3)=CASE WHEN @i=@Count THEN @Total-@Sum ELSE @InstallmentAmount END;
  INSERT dbo.Emp_LoanInstallments(CmpID,LoanID,InstallmentNo,DueDate,Amount)
  VALUES(@CmpID,@LoanID,@i,DATEADD(DAY,@IntervalDays*(@i-1),@Start),@Amount);
  SET @Sum+=@Amount; SET @i+=1;
 END;
 UPDATE dbo.Emp_Loans SET LoanState=1,ApprovedAt=SYSDATETIME(),ApprovedBy=@ApproverID WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND LoanID=@LoanID;
  COMMIT;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH
  IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
  THROW;
 END CATCH;
 SELECT * FROM dbo.Emp_LoanInstallments WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND LoanID=@LoanID ORDER BY InstallmentNo;
END;

GO

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Emp_AssignEmployeeLeavePolicy]
 @CmpID INT,@EmployeeID BIGINT,@PolicyID BIGINT,@EffectiveFrom DATE,@EffectiveTo DATE=NULL,@UserID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_Employee WHERE EmpCompany=@CmpID AND EmpID=@EmployeeID) THROW 54164,N'الموظف لا يتبع للشركة.',1;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_LeavePolicies WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND PolicyID=@PolicyID AND RecordState=0) THROW 54165,N'سياسة الإجازات غير نشطة أو غير موجودة.',1;
 IF @EffectiveTo IS NOT NULL AND @EffectiveTo<@EffectiveFrom THROW 54166,N'فترة الإسناد غير صحيحة.',1;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_EmployeeLeavePolicies WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND EmployeeID=@EmployeeID AND RecordState=0
  AND EffectiveFrom<=ISNULL(@EffectiveTo,'99991231') AND ISNULL(EffectiveTo,'99991231')>=@EffectiveFrom)
  THROW 54167,N'تتداخل سياسة الإجازات مع إسناد قائم للموظف.',1;
 INSERT dbo.Emp_EmployeeLeavePolicies(CmpID,EmployeeID,PolicyID,EffectiveFrom,EffectiveTo,CreatedBy)
 VALUES(@CmpID,@EmployeeID,@PolicyID,@EffectiveFrom,@EffectiveTo,@UserID);
 SELECT SCOPE_IDENTITY() EmployeePolicyID;
END;

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Emp_CalculatePayRun]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Emp_CalculatePayRun]
 @CmpID INT,@PayRunID BIGINT,@UserID BIGINT,@SuppressResult BIT=0
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON;
 EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 BEGIN TRAN;
 DECLARE @From DATE,@To DATE,@State TINYINT,@RunCurrencyID BIGINT;
 SELECT @From=p.DateFrom,@To=p.DateTo,@State=r.RunState,@RunCurrencyID=r.CurrencyID
 FROM dbo.Emp_PayRuns r WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) JOIN dbo.Emp_PayPeriods p ON p.CmpID=r.CmpID AND p.PeriodID=r.PeriodID
 WHERE r.CmpID=@CmpID AND r.PayRunID=@PayRunID;
 IF @From IS NULL OR @State<>0 THROW 54134,N'مسير الرواتب غير موجود أو غير قابل لإعادة الاحتساب.',1;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT EmpID FROM dbo.Emp_Salary WHERE EmpCompany=@CmpID AND SalStartDate<=@To AND (SalEndDate IS NULL OR SalEndDate>=@From) GROUP BY EmpID HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
  THROW 54137,N'توجد فترات راتب أساسي متداخلة لبعض الموظفين؛ صححها قبل احتساب المسير.',1;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_Employee e WHERE e.EmpCompany=@CmpID AND e.EmpState=0 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_Salary s WHERE s.EmpCompany=@CmpID AND s.EmpID=e.EmpID AND s.SalStartDate<=@To AND (s.SalEndDate IS NULL OR s.SalEndDate>=@From)))
  THROW 54159,N'يوجد موظفون نشطون بلا راتب أساسي سارٍ خلال فترة المسير.',1;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_Salary s JOIN dbo.Emp_Employee e ON e.EmpCompany=s.EmpCompany AND e.EmpID=s.EmpID WHERE s.EmpCompany=@CmpID AND e.EmpState=0 AND s.SalStartDate<=@To AND (s.SalEndDate IS NULL OR s.SalEndDate>=@From) AND s.SalCurrencyID<>@RunCurrencyID)
  THROW 54160,N'توجد رواتب بعملة تختلف عن العملة الأساسية للمسير؛ يلزم ضبط تحويل العملة قبل الاحتساب.',1;
 DELETE dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND PayRunID=@PayRunID;
 ;WITH ActiveEmployees AS
 (
  SELECT e.EmpID FROM dbo.Emp_Employee e
  WHERE e.EmpCompany=@CmpID AND e.EmpState=0
 ), BaseSalary AS
 (
  SELECT s.EmpID,s.SalAmount FROM dbo.Emp_Salary s
  JOIN ActiveEmployees e ON e.EmpID=s.EmpID
  WHERE s.EmpCompany=@CmpID AND s.SalStartDate<=@To AND (s.SalEndDate IS NULL OR s.SalEndDate>=@From)
 ), Lines AS
 (
  SELECT b.EmpID,CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) ComponentID,CAST(1 AS TINYINT) LineKind,N'الراتب الأساسي' Description,b.SalAmount Amount
  FROM BaseSalary b
  UNION ALL
  SELECT ec.EmployeeID,ec.ComponentID,pc.ComponentKind,pc.ComponentName,
    CASE pc.CalculationMethod WHEN 1 THEN ec.Amount WHEN 2 THEN b.SalAmount*ec.Amount/100.0 END
  FROM dbo.Emp_EmployeePayComponents ec
  JOIN dbo.Emp_PayComponents pc ON pc.CmpID=ec.CmpID AND pc.ComponentID=ec.ComponentID AND pc.RecordState=0
  JOIN BaseSalary b ON b.EmpID=ec.EmployeeID
  WHERE ec.CmpID=@CmpID AND ec.RecordState=0 AND ec.StartDate<=@To AND (ec.EndDate IS NULL OR ec.EndDate>=@From)
 )
 INSERT dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails(CmpID,PayRunID,EmployeeID,ComponentID,LineKind,Description,Amount)
 SELECT @CmpID,@PayRunID,EmpID,ComponentID,LineKind,Description,ROUND(Amount,3)
 FROM Lines WHERE Amount IS NOT NULL AND Amount>=0;
 DECLARE @Gross DECIMAL(19,3),@Ded DECIMAL(19,3);
 SELECT @Gross=ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN LineKind=1 THEN Amount ELSE 0 END),0),
        @Ded=ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN LineKind=2 THEN Amount ELSE 0 END),0)
 FROM dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND PayRunID=@PayRunID;
 UPDATE dbo.Emp_PayRuns SET GrossTotal=@Gross,DeductionTotal=@Ded,NetTotal=@Gross-@Ded,
  CalculatedAt=SYSDATETIME(),CalculatedBy=@UserID,RunState=1
 WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND PayRunID=@PayRunID AND RunState=0;
 COMMIT;
 IF @SuppressResult=0 SELECT @PayRunID PayRunID,@Gross GrossTotal,@Ded DeductionTotal,@Gross-@Ded NetTotal;
END;

GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Emp_ChangePayRunState]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Emp_ChangePayRunState]
 @CmpID INT,@PayRunID BIGINT,@UserID BIGINT,@Decision TINYINT
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 IF @Decision NOT IN(2,3) THROW 54135,N'الحالة المطلوبة غير صحيحة.',1;
 BEGIN TRAN;
 UPDATE dbo.Emp_PayRuns WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK)
 SET RunState=@Decision,
     ApprovedAt=CASE WHEN @Decision=2 THEN SYSDATETIME() ELSE ApprovedAt END,
     ApprovedBy=CASE WHEN @Decision=2 THEN @UserID ELSE ApprovedBy END,
     ClosedAt=CASE WHEN @Decision=3 THEN SYSDATETIME() ELSE ClosedAt END,
     ClosedBy=CASE WHEN @Decision=3 THEN @UserID ELSE ClosedBy END
 WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND PayRunID=@PayRunID AND ((@Decision=2 AND RunState=1 AND CreatedBy<>@UserID) OR (@Decision=3 AND RunState=2 AND VoucherID IS NOT NULL AND ApprovedBy<>@UserID));
 IF @@ROWCOUNT=0 THROW 54136,N'انتقال حالة المسير غير مسموح أو المسير غير موجود أو لم يُربط القيد المحاسبي قبل الإقفال.',1;
 COMMIT;
 SELECT PayRunID,RunState,NetTotal FROM dbo.Emp_PayRuns WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND PayRunID=@PayRunID;
END;

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Emp_CreatePayRun]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Emp_CreatePayRun]
 @CmpID INT,@PeriodID BIGINT,@UserID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 BEGIN TRY
  BEGIN TRAN;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_PayPeriods WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND PeriodID=@PeriodID AND PeriodState=0)
  THROW 54133,N'فترة الرواتب غير موجودة أو غير مفتوحة.',1;
 DECLARE @CurrencyID BIGINT;
 IF (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.Acc_Currency WHERE CurCmp=@CmpID AND CurIsBase=1 AND CurState=0)<>1
  THROW 54133,N'يجب ضبط عملة أساسية واحدة ونشطة للشركة قبل إنشاء مسير الرواتب.',1;
 SELECT @CurrencyID=CurID FROM dbo.Acc_Currency WHERE CurCmp=@CmpID AND CurIsBase=1 AND CurState=0;
 DECLARE @RunNo INT=(SELECT ISNULL(MAX(RunNo),0)+1 FROM dbo.Emp_PayRuns WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND PeriodID=@PeriodID);
 INSERT dbo.Emp_PayRuns(CmpID,PeriodID,RunNo,CurrencyID,CreatedBy) VALUES(@CmpID,@PeriodID,@RunNo,@CurrencyID,@UserID);
 DECLARE @PayRunID BIGINT=SCOPE_IDENTITY();
  COMMIT;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH
  IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
  THROW;
 END CATCH;
 SELECT @PayRunID AS PayRunID,@RunNo AS RunNo;
END;

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Emp_DecideLeaveRequest]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Emp_DecideLeaveRequest]
 @CmpID INT,@RequestID BIGINT,@ApproverID BIGINT,@Decision TINYINT,@StepNo SMALLINT=1,@Comments NVARCHAR(500)=NULL
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON;
 IF @Decision NOT IN(1,2) OR @StepNo<=0 THROW 54118,N'قرار الموافقة غير صحيح.',1;
 EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@ApproverID;
 BEGIN TRAN;
 DECLARE @EmpID BIGINT,@CreatorID BIGINT,@LeaveTypeID BIGINT,@Qty DECIMAL(9,2),@Start DATE,@Year SMALLINT,@State TINYINT;
 SELECT @EmpID=EmployeeID,@CreatorID=CreatedBy,@LeaveTypeID=LeaveTypeID,@Qty=Quantity,@Start=CONVERT(date,StartAt),@State=RequestState
 FROM dbo.Emp_LeaveRequests WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND RequestID=@RequestID;
 IF @EmpID IS NULL OR @State<>0 THROW 54119,N'الطلب غير موجود أو سبق اتخاذ قرار بشأنه.',1;
 IF @CreatorID=@ApproverID THROW 54120,N'لا يجوز لمنشئ الطلب اعتماده.',1;
 INSERT dbo.Emp_LeaveApprovals(CmpID,RequestID,StepNo,ApproverID,Decision,Comments) VALUES(@CmpID,@RequestID,@StepNo,@ApproverID,@Decision,@Comments);
 IF @Decision=2 UPDATE dbo.Emp_LeaveRequests SET RequestState=3 WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND RequestID=@RequestID;
 ELSE
 BEGIN
  SET @Year=YEAR(@Start);
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_LeaveBalances WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND EmployeeID=@EmpID AND LeaveTypeID=@LeaveTypeID AND BalanceYear=@Year)
   THROW 54121,N'لا يوجد رصيد إجازة للسنة المطلوبة.',1;
  IF (SELECT ClosingBalance FROM dbo.Emp_LeaveBalances WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND EmployeeID=@EmpID AND LeaveTypeID=@LeaveTypeID AND BalanceYear=@Year)<@Qty
   THROW 54122,N'رصيد الإجازة غير كافٍ.',1;
  UPDATE dbo.Emp_LeaveRequests SET RequestState=2 WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND RequestID=@RequestID;
  UPDATE dbo.Emp_LeaveBalances SET Used=Used+@Qty WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND EmployeeID=@EmpID AND LeaveTypeID=@LeaveTypeID AND BalanceYear=@Year;
  INSERT dbo.Emp_LeaveBalanceTransactions(CmpID,BalanceID,TransactionDate,TransactionType,Quantity,SourceType,SourceID,Description,CreatedBy)
  SELECT @CmpID,BalanceID,@Start,2,@Qty,2,@RequestID,N'اعتماد طلب إجازة',@ApproverID
  FROM dbo.Emp_LeaveBalances WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND EmployeeID=@EmpID AND LeaveTypeID=@LeaveTypeID AND BalanceYear=@Year;
 END;
 COMMIT;
 SELECT RequestID,RequestState FROM dbo.Emp_LeaveRequests WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND RequestID=@RequestID;
END;

GO

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Emp_DecideOvertimeRequest]
 @CmpID INT,@OvertimeID BIGINT,@ApproverID BIGINT,@Approve BIT
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@ApproverID;
 IF @Approve IS NULL THROW 54169,N'قرار اعتماد الإضافي مطلوب.',1;
 UPDATE dbo.Emp_OvertimeRequests SET RequestState=CASE WHEN @Approve=1 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,ApprovedAt=SYSDATETIME(),ApprovedBy=@ApproverID
 WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND OvertimeID=@OvertimeID AND RequestState=0 AND CreatedBy<>@ApproverID;
 IF @@ROWCOUNT=0 THROW 54173,N'طلب الإضافي غير موجود أو لا يسمح للمستخدم باعتماده.',1;
 SELECT OvertimeID,RequestState FROM dbo.Emp_OvertimeRequests WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND OvertimeID=@OvertimeID;
END;

SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Emp_DeleteEmployee]
    @EmpID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;

        IF NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_Employee WITH (UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK)
            WHERE EmpID=@EmpID
        )
            THROW 51601,N'الموظف المطلوب حذفه غير موجود.',1;

        IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_User WHERE UsrID=@EmpID)
            THROW 51602,N'لا يمكن حذف الموظف؛ لديه حساب مستخدم. عطّل الحساب أو احذفه أولًا.',1;

        IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_Employee WHERE EmpUser=@EmpID)
            THROW 51603,N'لا يمكن حذف الموظف؛ توجد سجلات موظفين تشير إليه في EmpUser.',1;

        IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_Company WHERE CmpUser=@EmpID)
            THROW 51604,N'لا يمكن حذف الموظف؛ توجد سجلات شركات تشير إليه في CmpUser.',1;

        DELETE dbo.Emp_Employee WHERE EmpID=@EmpID;

        COMMIT;
        SELECT CAST(1 AS BIT) AS Success;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK;
        THROW;
    END CATCH
END;
GO

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Emp_DeleteWorkCalendarDetails]
    @WCalDetID  BIGINT,
    @WCalDetCmp INT,
    @WCalDetUser BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @WCalDetCmp,@WCalDetUser;
    SET XACT_ABORT OFF;

    IF ISNULL(@WCalDetID, 0) <= 0
        THROW 50116, N'معرّف تفاصيل اليوم غير صحيح.', 1;

    IF ISNULL(@WCalDetCmp, 0) <= 0
        THROW 50117, N'يجب تحديد الشركة بشكل صحيح.', 1;

    IF ISNULL(@WCalDetUser, 0) <= 0
        THROW 50118, N'يجب تحديد المستخدم.', 1;

    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_Company WHERE CmpID = @WCalDetCmp)
        THROW 50119, N'الشركة غير موجودة.', 1;

    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_User WHERE UsrID = @WCalDetUser)
        THROW 50120, N'المستخدم غير موجود.', 1;

    DELETE FROM dbo.Emp_WorkCalendarDetails
    WHERE WCalDetID = @WCalDetID
      AND WCalDetCmp = @WCalDetCmp;

    IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0
        THROW 50121, N'تفاصيل اليوم غير موجودة أو لا تتبع للشركة.', 1;
END;

/* ================================================================

   ================================================================ */
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Emp_HRValidateActor]
 @CmpID INT, @UserID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON;
 IF ISNULL(@CmpID,0)<=0 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_Company WHERE CmpID=@CmpID)
  THROW 54100,N'الشركة غير صحيحة أو غير موجودة.',1;
 IF ISNULL(@UserID,0)<=0 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_User WHERE UsrID=@UserID)

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Emp_ImportAttendanceTransactions]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

/* =========================================================
   4. IMPORT ATTENDANCE FROM DEVICE
   ========================================================= */

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Emp_ImportAttendanceTransactions]
    @CmpID INT,
    @EmpID BIGINT,
    @DateTime DATETIME2(0),
    @Type TINYINT,
    @DeviceID BIGINT,
    @DeviceRecordID NVARCHAR(100),
    @UserID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;

    IF @DeviceID IS NULL OR @DeviceRecordID IS NULL
        THROW 50006, N'بيانات جهاز البصمة غير مكتملة.', 1;

    IF @Type NOT IN (1,2)
        THROW 50007, N'نوع الحركة غير صحيح.', 1;

    IF NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1
        FROM dbo.Emp_Employee
        WHERE EmpID = @EmpID
          AND EmpCompany = @CmpID
    )
        THROW 50008, N'الموظف غير موجود ضمن الشركة.', 1;

    IF NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1
        FROM dbo.Mng_User
        WHERE UsrID = @UserID
    )
        THROW 50009, N'المستخدم غير موجود.', 1;

    BEGIN TRY

        INSERT INTO dbo.Emp_AttendanceTransactions
        (
            AttCmp,
            AttEmpID,
            AttDateTime,
            AttType,
            AttSource,
            AttDeviceID,
            AttDeviceRecordID,
            AttUser
        )
        VALUES
        (
            @CmpID,
            @EmpID,
            @DateTime,
            @Type,
            1,
            @DeviceID,
            @DeviceRecordID,
            @UserID
        );

        SELECT
            CAST(1 AS BIT) AS Inserted,
            CAST(SCOPE_IDENTITY() AS BIGINT) AS AttID,
            N'تم استيراد الحركة.' AS Message;

    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH

        IF ERROR_NUMBER() IN (2601,2627)
        BEGIN
            SELECT
                CAST(0 AS BIT) AS Inserted,
                CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS AttID,
                N'الحركة مستوردة مسبقاً.' AS Message;
            RETURN;
        END;

        THROW;
    END CATCH;
END;

GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Emp_InsertAttendanceDevice]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO

/* =========================================================
   3. INSERT ATTENDANCE DEVICE
   ========================================================= */

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Emp_InsertAttendanceDevice]
    @CmpID INT,
    @Name NVARCHAR(150),
    @Type TINYINT,
    @SerialNo NVARCHAR(100) = NULL,
    @Code NVARCHAR(100) = NULL,
    @IPAddress VARCHAR(45) = NULL,
    @Port INT = NULL,
    @Location NVARCHAR(250) = NULL,
    @UserID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;

    IF NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@Name)), N'') IS NULL
        THROW 50301, N'اسم الجهاز مطلوب.', 1;

    IF @Type NOT IN (1,2,3,4)
        THROW 50302, N'نوع الجهاز غير صحيح.', 1;

    IF @Port IS NOT NULL AND @Port NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 65535
        THROW 50303, N'رقم المنفذ غير صحيح.', 1;

    IF NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1
        FROM dbo.Mng_Company
        WHERE CmpID = @CmpID
    )
        THROW 50304, N'الشركة غير موجودة.', 1;

    IF NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1
        FROM dbo.Mng_User
        WHERE UsrID = @UserID
    )
        THROW 50305, N'المستخدم غير موجود.', 1;

    INSERT INTO dbo.Emp_AttendanceDevices
    (
        DeviceCmp,
        DeviceName,
        DeviceType,
        DeviceSerialNo,
        DeviceCode,
        DeviceIPAddress,
        DevicePort,
        DeviceLocation,
        DeviceUser
    )
    VALUES
    (
        @CmpID,
        @Name,
        @Type,
        NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@SerialNo)), N''),
        NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@Code)), N''),
        @IPAddress,
        @Port,
        @Location,
        @UserID
    );

    SELECT CAST(SCOPE_IDENTITY() AS BIGINT) AS DeviceID;
END;

GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Emp_InsertAttendanceDeviceSyncLog]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

/* =========================================================
   6. INSERT SYNC LOG
   ========================================================= */

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Emp_InsertAttendanceDeviceSyncLog]
    @CmpID INT,
    @DeviceID BIGINT,
    @Source TINYINT,
    @UserID BIGINT = NULL,
    @FileName NVARCHAR(500) = NULL,
    @FileHash VARBINARY(32) = NULL,
    @AgentName NVARCHAR(150) = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;
    IF @UserID IS NULL
    BEGIN
        IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_Company WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND CmpState=0) THROW 54380,N'الشركة غير صحيحة أو غير نشطة.',1;
    END
    ELSE EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;

    IF @Source IS NULL OR @Source NOT IN (1,2,3)
        THROW 52605, N'مصدر المزامنة غير صحيح.', 1;

    IF NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1
        FROM dbo.Emp_AttendanceDevices
        WHERE DeviceCmp = @CmpID
          AND DeviceID = @DeviceID
    )
        THROW 52606, N'جهاز الحضور غير موجود ضمن الشركة المحددة.', 1;

    IF @UserID IS NOT NULL
       AND NOT EXISTS
       (
           SELECT 1
           FROM dbo.Mng_User
           WHERE UsrID = @UserID
       )
        THROW 52607, N'المستخدم غير موجود.', 1;

    IF @FileHash IS NOT NULL
       AND DATALENGTH(@FileHash) <> 32
        THROW 52608, N'بصمة الملف SHA-256 غير صحيحة.', 1;

    IF @Source = 3
       AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@FileName)), N'') IS NULL
        THROW 52609, N'اسم ملف الاستيراد مطلوب.', 1;

    INSERT INTO dbo.Emp_AttendanceDeviceSyncLog
    (
        SyncCmp,
        SyncDeviceID,
        SyncSource,
        SyncStatus,
        SyncStartedAt,
        SyncFileName,
        SyncFileHash,
        SyncAgentName,
        SyncUser
    )
    VALUES
    (
        @CmpID,
        @DeviceID,
        @Source,
        0,
        SYSDATETIME(),
        NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@FileName)), N''),
        @FileHash,
        NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@AgentName)), N''),
        @UserID
    );

    SELECT
        CAST(SCOPE_IDENTITY() AS BIGINT) AS SyncID,
        CAST(0 AS TINYINT) AS SyncStatus;
END;

GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Emp_InsertAttendanceException]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON

/* =========================================================
   5. INSERT ATTENDANCE EXCEPTION
   ========================================================= */

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Emp_InsertAttendanceException]
    @CmpID INT,
    @AttDayID BIGINT,
    @ProcID BIGINT = NULL,
    @Type TINYINT,
    @Description NVARCHAR(500),
    @Severity TINYINT = 1,
    @UserID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;

    IF @Type IS NULL OR @Type NOT IN (1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8)
        THROW 53105, N'نوع الاستثناء غير صحيح.', 1;

    IF @Severity IS NULL OR @Severity NOT IN (1,2,3)
        THROW 53106, N'درجة خطورة الاستثناء غير صحيحة.', 1;

    IF NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@Description)), N'') IS NULL
        THROW 53107, N'وصف الاستثناء مطلوب.', 1;

    IF NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1
        FROM dbo.Emp_AttendanceDaily
        WHERE AttDayCmp = @CmpID
          AND AttDayID = @AttDayID
    )
        THROW 53108, N'سجل الحضور اليومي غير موجود ضمن الشركة المحددة.', 1;

    IF @ProcID IS NOT NULL
       AND NOT EXISTS
       (
           SELECT 1
           FROM dbo.Emp_AttendanceProcessingLog
           WHERE ProcID = @ProcID
             AND ProcCmp = @CmpID
       )
        THROW 53109, N'سجل المعالجة غير موجود ضمن الشركة المحددة.', 1;

    IF NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1
        FROM dbo.Mng_User
        WHERE UsrID = @UserID
    )
        THROW 53110, N'المستخدم غير موجود.', 1;

    INSERT INTO dbo.Emp_AttendanceExceptions
    (
        ExcCmp,
        ExcAttDayID,
        ExcProcID,
        ExcType,
        ExcDescription,
        ExcSeverity,
        ExcUser
    )
    VALUES
    (
        @CmpID,
        @AttDayID,
        @ProcID,
        @Type,
        LTRIM(RTRIM(@Description)),
        @Severity,
        @UserID
    );

    SELECT
        CAST(SCOPE_IDENTITY() AS BIGINT) AS ExcID,
        CAST(0 AS TINYINT) AS ExcState;
END;

/* =========================================================
   5. INSERT PROCESSING LOG
   ========================================================= */

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Emp_InsertAttendanceProcessingLog]
    @CmpID INT,
    @DateFrom DATE,
    @DateTo DATE,
    @UserID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;

    IF @DateFrom IS NULL OR @DateTo IS NULL
        THROW 53003, N'فترة المعالجة مطلوبة.', 1;

    IF @DateTo < @DateFrom
        THROW 53004, N'تاريخ النهاية لا يمكن أن يسبق تاريخ البداية.', 1;

    IF NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1
        FROM dbo.Mng_User
        WHERE UsrID = @UserID
    )
        THROW 53005, N'المستخدم غير موجود.', 1;

    INSERT INTO dbo.Emp_AttendanceProcessingLog
    (
        ProcCmp,
        ProcDateFrom,
        ProcDateTo,
        ProcUser
    )
    VALUES
    (
        @CmpID,
        @DateFrom,
        @DateTo,
        @UserID
    );

    SELECT
        CAST(SCOPE_IDENTITY() AS BIGINT) AS ProcID,
        CAST(0 AS TINYINT) AS ProcStatus;
END;

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Emp_InsertAttendanceTransaction]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

/* =========================================================
   5. INSERT TRANSACTION
   ========================================================= */

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Emp_InsertAttendanceTransaction]
    @CmpID INT,
    @EmpID BIGINT,
    @DateTime DATETIME2(0),
    @Type TINYINT,
    @Source TINYINT,
    @DeviceID BIGINT = NULL,
    @SyncID BIGINT,
    @DeviceRecordID NVARCHAR(150) = NULL,
    @DedupHash VARBINARY(32),
    @UserID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    IF @Source NOT IN (1,2,3)
        THROW 52906, N'مصدر الحركة غير صحيح.', 1;

    IF @DateTime IS NULL
        THROW 52907, N'تاريخ ووقت الحركة مطلوبان.', 1;

    IF @DedupHash IS NULL OR DATALENGTH(@DedupHash) <> 32
        THROW 52908, N'بصمة الحركة يجب أن تكون SHA-256 بطول 32 بايت.', 1;

    IF @Source IN (1,2) AND @DeviceID IS NULL
        THROW 52909, N'يجب تحديد جهاز البصمة لهذا المصدر.', 1;

    IF NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1
        FROM dbo.Emp_Employee
        WHERE EmpID = @EmpID
          AND EmpCompany = @CmpID
    )
        THROW 52910, N'الموظف غير موجود ضمن الشركة المحددة.', 1;

    IF NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1
        FROM dbo.Mng_User
        WHERE UsrID = @UserID
    )
        THROW 52911, N'المستخدم غير موجود.', 1;

    IF NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1
        FROM dbo.Emp_AttendanceDeviceSyncLog
        WHERE SyncID = @SyncID
          AND SyncCmp = @CmpID
          AND SyncStatus = 0
    )
        THROW 52912, N'سجل المزامنة غير موجود أو لم يعد قيد التنفيذ.', 1;

    IF @DeviceID IS NOT NULL
       AND NOT EXISTS
       (
           SELECT 1
           FROM dbo.Emp_AttendanceDevices
           WHERE DeviceID = @DeviceID
             AND DeviceCmp = @CmpID
       )
        THROW 52913, N'جهاز البصمة غير موجود ضمن الشركة المحددة.', 1;

    BEGIN TRY
        INSERT INTO dbo.Emp_AttendanceTransactions
        (
            AttCmp,
            AttEmpID,
            AttDateTime,
            AttType,
            AttSource,
            AttDeviceID,
            AttSyncID,
            AttDeviceRecordID,
            AttDedupHash,
            AttUser
        )
        VALUES
        (
            @CmpID,
            @EmpID,
            @DateTime,
            @Type,
            @Source,
            @DeviceID,
            @SyncID,
            @DeviceRecordID,
            @DedupHash,
            @UserID
        );

        SELECT
            CAST(SCOPE_IDENTITY() AS BIGINT) AS AttID,
            CAST(1 AS BIT) AS Inserted,
            CAST(0 AS BIT) AS Duplicate;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF ERROR_NUMBER() IN (2601, 2627)
        BEGIN
            SELECT
                CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS AttID,
                CAST(0 AS BIT) AS Inserted,
                CAST(1 AS BIT) AS Duplicate;
            RETURN;
        END;

        THROW;
    END CATCH;
END;

GO

SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Emp_InsertContract]
    @ConID           BIGINT = NULL OUTPUT,
    @EmpCompany     INT,
    @EmpID          BIGINT,
    @ConType        BIGINT,
    @ConStartDate   DATE,
    @ConUser        BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @EmpCompany,@ConUser;
    SET XACT_ABORT OFF;

    IF XACT_STATE() = -1
        THROW 50219, N'المعاملة الحالية غير قابلة للاستمرار، لا يمكن متابعة الحفظ.', 1;

    IF @EmpCompany IS NULL OR @EmpCompany <= 0
        THROW 50210, N'معرف الشركة غير صالح.', 1;
    IF @EmpID IS NULL OR @EmpID <= 0
        THROW 50211, N'معرف الموظف غير صالح.', 1;
    IF @ConType IS NULL OR @ConType <= 0
        THROW 50212, N'نوع العقد إلزامي.', 1;
    IF @ConStartDate IS NULL
        THROW 50213, N'تاريخ البداية إلزامي.', 1;
    IF @ConUser IS NULL OR @ConUser <= 0
        THROW 50214, N'معرف المستخدم غير صالح.', 1;

    DECLARE @TranStarted INT = 0;
    DECLARE @LastStart DATE, @LastEnd DATE;

    BEGIN TRY
        IF @@TRANCOUNT = 0
        BEGIN
            BEGIN TRANSACTION;
            SET @TranStarted = 1;
        END
        ELSE
            SAVE TRANSACTION SavePoint_Emp_InsertContract;

        IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_Employee WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
                       WHERE EmpID = @EmpID AND EmpCompany = @EmpCompany)
            THROW 50215, N'الموظف غير موجود في نطاق هذه الشركة.', 1;

        IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_User WHERE UsrID = @ConUser)
            THROW 50216, N'مستخدم النظام غير مسجل.', 1;

        IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_EmploymentTypes WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
                       WHERE EmpTypeID = @ConType AND EmpTypeCmp = @EmpCompany AND EmpTypeState = 0)
            THROW 50220, N'نوع العقد غير موجود أو لا يتبع لهذه الشركة أو معطّل.', 1;

        SELECT @LastStart = MAX(ConStartDate), @LastEnd = MAX(ConEndDate)
        FROM dbo.Emp_Contract WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
        WHERE EmpCompany = @EmpCompany AND EmpID = @EmpID;

        IF @LastStart IS NOT NULL AND @ConStartDate <= @LastStart
            THROW 50217, N'تاريخ البداية يجب أن يكون بعد بداية آخر فترة مسجلة.', 1;
        IF @LastEnd IS NOT NULL AND @ConStartDate <= @LastEnd
            THROW 50218, N'تاريخ البداية يتداخل مع فترة سابقة.', 1;

        UPDATE dbo.Emp_Contract
        SET ConEndDate = DATEADD(DAY, -1, @ConStartDate)
        WHERE EmpCompany = @EmpCompany AND EmpID = @EmpID AND ConEndDate IS NULL;

        INSERT dbo.Emp_Contract
            (EmpCompany, EmpID, ConType, ConStartDate, ConEndDate, ConUser, ConDateTime)
        VALUES
            (@EmpCompany, @EmpID, @ConType, @ConStartDate, NULL, @ConUser, GETDATE());

        SET @ConID = SCOPE_IDENTITY();

        IF @TranStarted = 1
        BEGIN
            COMMIT TRANSACTION;
            SET @TranStarted = 0;
        END
    END TRY
    Begin CATCH
        IF @TranStarted = 1
        BEGIN
            IF XACT_STATE() <> 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        END
        ELSE IF XACT_STATE() = 1
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION SavePoint_Emp_InsertContract;

        THROW;
    END CATCH
END;
GO

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Emp_InsertEmployee]
    @EmpNum NVARCHAR(10)=NULL,
    @EmpName NVARCHAR(50)=NULL,
    @EmpPic VARBINARY(MAX)=NULL,
    @EmpState TINYINT=0,
    @EmpUser BIGINT=NULL,
    @EmpCompany INT=NULL,
    @HireDate DATE=NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @EmpCompany,@EmpUser;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;
    IF @HireDate IS NOT NULL AND (@HireDate < '19000101' OR @HireDate > CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE))
        THROW 50077,N'تاريخ مباشرة العمل غير منطقي.',1;

    INSERT dbo.Emp_Employee
        (EmpNum,EmpName,EmpPic,EmpState,EmpDateTime,EmpUser,EmpCompany,HireDate)
    VALUES
        (@EmpNum,@EmpName,@EmpPic,@EmpState,GETDATE(),@EmpUser,@EmpCompany,@HireDate);

    SELECT CONVERT(BIGINT,SCOPE_IDENTITY()) AS EmpID;
END;
