CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Emp_InsertSalary]
    @SalID           BIGINT = NULL OUTPUT,
    @EmpCompany     INT,
    @EmpID          BIGINT,
    @SalAmount      DECIMAL(15,3),
    @SalCurrencyID  BIGINT,
    @SalStartDate   DATE,
    @SalUser        BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @EmpCompany,@SalUser;
    SET XACT_ABORT OFF;

    IF XACT_STATE() = -1
        THROW 50239, N'المعاملة الحالية غير قابلة للاستمرار، لا يمكن متابعة الحفظ.', 1;

    IF @EmpCompany IS NULL OR @EmpCompany <= 0
        THROW 50230, N'معرف الشركة غير صالح.', 1;
    IF @EmpID IS NULL OR @EmpID <= 0
        THROW 50231, N'معرف الموظف غير صالح.', 1;
    IF @SalAmount IS NULL OR @SalAmount < 0
        THROW 50232, N'مبلغ الراتب غير صالح.', 1;
    IF @SalCurrencyID IS NULL OR @SalCurrencyID <= 0
        THROW 50240, N'عملة الراتب إلزامية.', 1;
    IF @SalStartDate IS NULL
        THROW 50233, N'تاريخ البداية إلزامي.', 1;
    IF @SalUser IS NULL OR @SalUser <= 0
        THROW 50234, N'معرف المستخدم غير صالح.', 1;

    DECLARE @TranStarted INT = 0;
    DECLARE @LastStart DATE, @LastEnd DATE;

    BEGIN TRY
        IF @@TRANCOUNT = 0
        BEGIN
            BEGIN TRANSACTION;
            SET @TranStarted = 1;
        END
        ELSE
            SAVE TRANSACTION SavePoint_Emp_InsertSalary;

        IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_Employee WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
                       WHERE EmpID = @EmpID AND EmpCompany = @EmpCompany)
            THROW 50235, N'الموظف غير موجود في نطاق هذه الشركة.', 1;

        IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_User WHERE UsrID = @SalUser)
            THROW 50236, N'مستخدم النظام غير مسجل.', 1;

        IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Acc_Currency WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
                       WHERE CurID = @SalCurrencyID AND CurCmp = @EmpCompany AND CurState = 0)
            THROW 50241, N'عملة الراتب غير موجودة في هذه الشركة أو معطّلة.', 1;

        SELECT @LastStart = MAX(SalStartDate), @LastEnd = MAX(SalEndDate)
        FROM dbo.Emp_Salary WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
        WHERE EmpCompany = @EmpCompany AND EmpID = @EmpID;

        IF @LastStart IS NOT NULL AND @SalStartDate <= @LastStart
            THROW 50237, N'تاريخ البداية يجب أن يكون بعد بداية آخر فترة مسجلة.', 1;
        IF @LastEnd IS NOT NULL AND @SalStartDate <= @LastEnd
            THROW 50238, N'تاريخ البداية يتداخل مع فترة سابقة.', 1;

        UPDATE dbo.Emp_Salary
        SET SalEndDate = DATEADD(DAY, -1, @SalStartDate)
        WHERE EmpCompany = @EmpCompany AND EmpID = @EmpID AND SalEndDate IS NULL;

        INSERT dbo.Emp_Salary
            (EmpCompany, EmpID, SalAmount, SalCurrencyID, SalStartDate, SalEndDate, SalUser, SalDateTime)
        VALUES
            (@EmpCompany, @EmpID, @SalAmount, @SalCurrencyID, @SalStartDate, NULL, @SalUser, GETDATE());

        SET @SalID = SCOPE_IDENTITY();

        IF @TranStarted = 1
        BEGIN
            COMMIT TRANSACTION;
            SET @TranStarted = 0;
        END
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @TranStarted = 1
        BEGIN
            IF XACT_STATE() <> 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        END
        ELSE IF XACT_STATE() = 1
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION SavePoint_Emp_InsertSalary;

        THROW;
    END CATCH
END;

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Emp_PostPayRun]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Emp_PostPayRun]
 @CmpID INT,@PayRunID BIGINT,@UserID BIGINT,@Description NVARCHAR(500)=NULL,@SuppressResult BIT=0
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 IF TYPE_ID(N'dbo.Acc_DayLineType') IS NULL THROW 54148,N'نوع بنود القيد المحاسبي غير موجود.',1;
 DECLARE @PeriodID BIGINT,@PeriodFrom DATE,@PeriodTo DATE,@RunState TINYINT,@ExistingVoucher BIGINT,@LoanDetailCount INT,@AdvanceDetailCount INT,@ExternalDeductionDetailCount INT,@ArrearDetailCount INT,@AdvanceArrearCount INT;
 SELECT @PeriodID=r.PeriodID,@PeriodFrom=p.DateFrom,@PeriodTo=p.DateTo,@RunState=r.RunState,@ExistingVoucher=r.VoucherID
 FROM dbo.Emp_PayRuns r JOIN dbo.Emp_PayPeriods p ON p.CmpID=r.CmpID AND p.PeriodID=r.PeriodID
 WHERE r.CmpID=@CmpID AND r.PayRunID=@PayRunID;
 IF @PeriodID IS NULL OR @RunState<>2 OR @ExistingVoucher IS NOT NULL THROW 54149,N'المسير غير معتمد أو غير موجود أو سبق ربطه بقيد.',1;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails d LEFT JOIN dbo.Emp_PayrollDeductionAllocations a ON a.CmpID=d.CmpID AND a.PayRunID=d.PayRunID AND a.CalculationVersion=(SELECT CalculationVersion FROM dbo.Emp_PayRuns WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND PayRunID=@PayRunID) AND a.PayrollDetailID=d.PayrollDetailID
  WHERE d.CmpID=@CmpID AND d.PayRunID=@PayRunID AND d.LineKind=2 AND (d.CollectedAmount IS NULL OR d.DeferredAmount IS NULL OR a.AllocationID IS NULL OR a.RequestedAmount<>d.Amount OR a.CollectedAmount<>d.CollectedAmount OR a.DeferredAmount<>d.DeferredAmount OR (a.CanDefer=0 AND a.DeferredAmount>0)))
  THROW 54915,N'لم تُطبق سياسة توزيع الاستقطاعات كاملة أو لا تطابق تفاصيل المسير؛ لا يمكن الترحيل.',1;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_PayRuns r WHERE r.CmpID=@CmpID AND r.PayRunID=@PayRunID AND r.DeferredDeductionTotal<>(SELECT ISNULL(SUM(DeferredAmount),0) FROM dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND PayRunID=@PayRunID AND LineKind=2))
  THROW 54916,N'إجمالي الأرصدة المؤجلة لا يطابق تفاصيل المسير؛ أعد احتساب المسير.',1;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails d WHERE d.CmpID=@CmpID AND d.PayRunID=@PayRunID AND (d.Amount<0 OR ISNULL(d.CollectedAmount,0)<0 OR ISNULL(d.DeferredAmount,0)<0 OR (d.LineKind=2 AND ISNULL(d.CollectedAmount,0)+ISNULL(d.DeferredAmount,0)<>d.Amount) OR (d.LineKind=1 AND (ISNULL(d.CollectedAmount,d.Amount)<>d.Amount OR ISNULL(d.DeferredAmount,0)<>0))))
   THROW 54953,N'توجد مبالغ سالبة أو تسوية استقطاع غير متوازنة؛ يمنع اعتماد أو ترحيل المسير.',1;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_PayRuns r CROSS APPLY(SELECT ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN d.LineKind=1 THEN d.Amount ELSE 0 END),0) GrossAmount,ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN d.LineKind=2 THEN ISNULL(d.CollectedAmount,d.Amount) ELSE 0 END),0) CollectedAmount FROM dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails d WHERE d.CmpID=r.CmpID AND d.PayRunID=r.PayRunID) x WHERE r.CmpID=@CmpID AND r.PayRunID=@PayRunID AND (r.NetTotal<0 OR r.NetTotal<>CASE WHEN x.GrossAmount>x.CollectedAmount THEN x.GrossAmount-x.CollectedAmount ELSE 0 END))
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_PayRuns r WHERE r.CmpID=@CmpID AND r.PayRunID=@PayRunID AND (r.NetDeficitTotal<>(SELECT ISNULL(SUM(s.NetDeficit),0) FROM dbo.Emp_PayrollDeficitSnapshots s WHERE s.CmpID=r.CmpID AND s.PayRunID=r.PayRunID AND s.CalculationVersion=r.CalculationVersion) OR r.RequestedDeductionTotal<>(SELECT ISNULL(SUM(s.RequestedDeductionTotal),0) FROM dbo.Emp_PayrollDeficitSnapshots s WHERE s.CmpID=r.CmpID AND s.PayRunID=r.PayRunID AND s.CalculationVersion=r.CalculationVersion))) THROW 54958,N'إجماليات عجز الرواتب لا تطابق سجل السياسات؛ يمنع الترحيل.',1;
   THROW 54954,N'صافي المسير غير متزن أو سالب؛ يمنع الترحيل والصرف.',1;
  IF EXISTS
  (
   SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT EmployeeID,SUM(CASE WHEN LineKind=1 THEN Amount ELSE 0 END) GrossAmount,SUM(CASE WHEN LineKind=2 THEN ISNULL(CollectedAmount,Amount) ELSE 0 END) CollectedAmount,SUM(CASE WHEN LineKind=2 THEN ISNULL(DeferredAmount,0) ELSE 0 END) DeferredAmount FROM dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND PayRunID=@PayRunID GROUP BY EmployeeID) x
   LEFT JOIN dbo.Emp_PayrollDeficitSnapshots s ON s.CmpID=@CmpID AND s.PayRunID=@PayRunID AND s.CalculationVersion=(SELECT CalculationVersion FROM dbo.Emp_PayRuns WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND PayRunID=@PayRunID) AND s.EmployeeID=x.EmployeeID
   WHERE s.SnapshotID IS NULL OR s.GrossEntitlement<>x.GrossAmount OR s.CollectedDeductionTotal<>x.CollectedAmount OR s.DeferredDeductionTotal<>x.DeferredAmount OR s.PolicyApplied=0
  ) THROW 54955,N'سجل سياسة العجز لا يطابق تفاصيل المسير؛ يمنع الترحيل.',1;
 IF EXISTS
 (
  SELECT d.PayrollDetailID FROM dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails d
  WHERE d.CmpID=@CmpID AND d.PayRunID=@PayRunID AND d.Amount<>0
    AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.Emp_PayrollAccountMappings m
         WHERE m.CmpID=d.CmpID AND (m.ComponentID=d.ComponentID OR (m.ComponentID IS NULL AND d.ComponentID IS NULL))
           AND m.RecordState=0 AND m.EffectiveFrom<=@PeriodTo AND (m.EffectiveTo IS NULL OR m.EffectiveTo>=@PeriodFrom))<>2
 ) THROW 54154,N'يجب تعريف ربط مدين وربط دائن فعال لكل مكون راتب مستخدم في المسير.',1;
 IF EXISTS
 (
  SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_PayrollAccountMappings m
  JOIN dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails d ON d.CmpID=m.CmpID AND d.PayRunID=@PayRunID AND (d.ComponentID=m.ComponentID OR (d.ComponentID IS NULL AND m.ComponentID IS NULL))
  JOIN dbo.Acc_Account a ON a.AccCompany=m.CmpID AND a.AccID=m.AccountID
  WHERE m.CmpID=@CmpID AND m.RecordState=0 AND m.EffectiveFrom<=@PeriodTo AND (m.EffectiveTo IS NULL OR m.EffectiveTo>=@PeriodFrom)
    AND (a.AccState<>0 OR a.AccChid<>0 OR (m.CostCenterID IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Acc_CostCenter c WHERE c.CsCCompany=@CmpID AND c.CsCID=m.CostCenterID AND c.CsCState=0 AND c.CsCChid=0)))
 ) THROW 54155,N'يوجد حساب أو مركز تكلفة غير صالح ضمن خرائط الترحيل.',1;
 DECLARE @Lines dbo.Acc_DayLineType;
 DECLARE @VoucherYear INT=YEAR(@PeriodTo);
 DECLARE @VoucherInfo NVARCHAR(MAX)=COALESCE(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@Description)),N''),N'قيد مسير الرواتب');
 ;WITH Mapped AS
 (
  SELECT d.PayrollDetailID,CASE WHEN d.LineKind=2 THEN ISNULL(d.CollectedAmount,d.Amount) ELSE d.Amount END AS Amount,m.AccountID,m.CostCenterID,m.DebitCredit,d.Description
  FROM dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails d
  JOIN dbo.Emp_PayrollAccountMappings m ON m.CmpID=d.CmpID AND (m.ComponentID=d.ComponentID OR (m.ComponentID IS NULL AND d.ComponentID IS NULL))
   AND m.RecordState=0 AND m.EffectiveFrom<=@PeriodTo AND (m.EffectiveTo IS NULL OR m.EffectiveTo>=@PeriodFrom)
  WHERE d.CmpID=@CmpID AND d.PayRunID=@PayRunID AND d.Amount<>0
 ), Grouped AS
 (
  SELECT AccountID,CostCenterID,DebitCredit,SUM(Amount) Amount,MAX(Description) Description
  FROM Mapped GROUP BY AccountID,CostCenterID,DebitCredit
 )
 INSERT @Lines(SeqNo,DayDAccID,DayDDeb,DayDCrd,DayDCsCID,DayDNum,DayDDescription)
 SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY AccountID,CostCenterID,DebitCredit),AccountID,
        CASE WHEN DebitCredit=1 THEN Amount ELSE 0 END,
        CASE WHEN DebitCredit=2 THEN Amount ELSE 0 END,
        CostCenterID,NULL,CONCAT(N'مسير رواتب: ',ISNULL(@Description,N''),N' - ',Description)
 FROM Grouped WHERE Amount>0;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM @Lines) THROW 54156,N'لا توجد بنود قابلة للترحيل.',1;
 IF (SELECT SUM(DayDDeb)-SUM(DayDCrd) FROM @Lines)<>0 THROW 54157,N'خرائط الرواتب لا تنتج قيداً متوازناً.',1;
 DECLARE @Result TABLE(DayMID BIGINT,DayMNo INT,DayMState TINYINT,VoucherNo NVARCHAR(40));
  DECLARE @CreatedArrears TABLE(ArrearID BIGINT NOT NULL,OriginPayrollDetailID BIGINT NOT NULL,Amount DECIMAL(19,3) NOT NULL);
 BEGIN TRY
  BEGIN TRAN;
  EXEC sys.sp_set_session_context @key=N'Acc.SystemOperation',@value=1;
  INSERT @Result EXEC dbo.Acc_SaveDayVoucher @Cmp=@CmpID,@Year=@VoucherYear,@User=@UserID,@DayMID=0,@Date=@PeriodTo,
   @Info=@VoucherInfo,@Post=0,@Lines=@Lines;
  IF (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM @Result)<>1 THROW 54158,N'لم يُرجع إجراء القيد المحاسبي معرف القيد المتوقع.',1;
  UPDATE dbo.Emp_PayRuns SET VoucherID=(SELECT TOP(1) DayMID FROM @Result) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND PayRunID=@PayRunID AND RunState=2 AND VoucherID IS NULL;
  IF @@ROWCOUNT=0 THROW 54158,N'تعذر ربط القيد بالمسير؛ تحقق من حالة المسير.',1;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails d JOIN dbo.Emp_LoanInstallments i ON i.CmpID=d.CmpID AND i.InstallmentID=d.SourceID WHERE d.CmpID=@CmpID AND d.PayRunID=@PayRunID AND d.SourceType=13 AND (i.InstallmentState<>0 OR i.PaidAmount+d.Amount>i.Amount))
   THROW 54359,N'تغير رصيد قسط السلفة بعد احتساب المسير؛ أعد الاحتساب قبل الترحيل.',1;
  SELECT @LoanDetailCount=COUNT(*) FROM dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND PayRunID=@PayRunID AND SourceType=13 AND ISNULL(CollectedAmount,Amount)>0;
  UPDATE i SET PaidAmount=i.PaidAmount+ISNULL(d.CollectedAmount,d.Amount),
      InstallmentState=CASE WHEN i.PaidAmount+ISNULL(d.CollectedAmount,d.Amount)>=i.Amount THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
      PaidAt=CASE WHEN i.PaidAmount+ISNULL(d.CollectedAmount,d.Amount)>=i.Amount THEN SYSDATETIME() ELSE NULL END
  FROM dbo.Emp_LoanInstallments i
  JOIN dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails d ON d.CmpID=i.CmpID AND d.SourceType=13 AND d.SourceID=i.InstallmentID
  WHERE d.CmpID=@CmpID AND d.PayRunID=@PayRunID AND i.InstallmentState=0 AND i.PaidAmount+ISNULL(d.CollectedAmount,d.Amount)<=i.Amount AND ISNULL(d.CollectedAmount,d.Amount)>0;
  IF @@ROWCOUNT<>@LoanDetailCount THROW 54360,N'تعذر تحديث جميع أقساط المسير؛ أُلغيت عملية الترحيل.',1;
  INSERT dbo.Emp_LoanPayments(CmpID,InstallmentID,Amount,PaymentDate,PaymentSource,PayRunID,CreatedBy)
  SELECT d.CmpID,d.SourceID,ISNULL(d.CollectedAmount,d.Amount),CONVERT(date,SYSDATETIME()),2,@PayRunID,@UserID
  FROM dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails d WHERE d.CmpID=@CmpID AND d.PayRunID=@PayRunID AND d.SourceType=13 AND ISNULL(d.CollectedAmount,d.Amount)>0;  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails d LEFT JOIN dbo.Emp_SalaryAdvanceInstallments i ON i.CmpID=d.CmpID AND i.InstallmentID=d.SourceID LEFT JOIN dbo.Emp_SalaryAdvances a ON a.CmpID=i.CmpID AND a.AdvanceID=i.AdvanceID
   WHERE d.CmpID=@CmpID AND d.PayRunID=@PayRunID AND d.SourceType=20 AND (i.InstallmentID IS NULL OR a.AdvanceState<>1 OR a.Disbursed<>1 OR a.PeriodID<>@PeriodID OR a.CalculationPayRunID<>@PayRunID OR i.InstallmentState<>0 OR d.Amount<=0 OR i.PaidAmount+d.Amount>i.Amount))
   THROW 54864,N'تغير رصيد قسط المرتب المقدم بعد احتساب المسير؛ أعد الاحتساب قبل الترحيل.',1;
  SELECT @AdvanceDetailCount=COUNT(*) FROM dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND PayRunID=@PayRunID AND SourceType=20 AND ISNULL(CollectedAmount,Amount)>0;
  UPDATE i SET PaidAmount=i.PaidAmount+ISNULL(d.CollectedAmount,d.Amount),InstallmentState=CASE WHEN i.PaidAmount+ISNULL(d.CollectedAmount,d.Amount)>=i.Amount THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,PaidAt=CASE WHEN i.PaidAmount+ISNULL(d.CollectedAmount,d.Amount)>=i.Amount THEN SYSDATETIME() ELSE NULL END
   FROM dbo.Emp_SalaryAdvanceInstallments i JOIN dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails d ON d.CmpID=i.CmpID AND d.SourceType=20 AND d.SourceID=i.InstallmentID
   WHERE d.CmpID=@CmpID AND d.PayRunID=@PayRunID AND i.InstallmentState=0 AND i.PaidAmount+ISNULL(d.CollectedAmount,d.Amount)<=i.Amount AND ISNULL(d.CollectedAmount,d.Amount)>0;
  IF @@ROWCOUNT<>@AdvanceDetailCount THROW 54865,N'تعذر تحديث جميع أقساط المرتب المقدم؛ أُلغيت عملية الترحيل.',1;
  INSERT dbo.Emp_SalaryAdvancePayments(CmpID,InstallmentID,Amount,PaymentDate,PaymentSource,PayRunID,CreatedBy)
   SELECT d.CmpID,d.SourceID,ISNULL(d.CollectedAmount,d.Amount),CONVERT(date,SYSDATETIME()),2,@PayRunID,@UserID FROM dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails d WHERE d.CmpID=@CmpID AND d.PayRunID=@PayRunID AND d.SourceType=20 AND ISNULL(d.CollectedAmount,d.Amount)>0;
  UPDATE a SET AdvanceState=3 FROM dbo.Emp_SalaryAdvances a WHERE a.CmpID=@CmpID AND a.AdvanceState=1 AND NOT EXISTS
   (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_SalaryAdvanceInstallments i WHERE i.CmpID=a.CmpID AND i.AdvanceID=a.AdvanceID AND i.InstallmentState=0)
   AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_SalaryAdvanceInstallments i JOIN dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails d ON d.CmpID=i.CmpID AND d.SourceType=20 AND d.SourceID=i.InstallmentID WHERE i.CmpID=a.CmpID AND i.AdvanceID=a.AdvanceID AND d.PayRunID=@PayRunID);

  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails d LEFT JOIN dbo.Emp_EmployeeExternalDeductions x ON x.CmpID=d.CmpID AND x.DeductionID=d.SourceID
   WHERE d.CmpID=@CmpID AND d.PayRunID=@PayRunID AND d.SourceType=21 AND (x.DeductionID IS NULL OR x.DeductionState<>1 OR d.Amount<=0 OR d.Amount>x.MonthlyAmount OR x.NextDueDate>@PeriodTo OR (x.EffectiveTo IS NOT NULL AND x.EffectiveTo<x.NextDueDate) OR (x.TotalAmount IS NOT NULL AND x.AssessedTotal+d.Amount>x.TotalAmount)))
   THROW 54866,N'تغير رصيد الاستقطاع الخارجي بعد احتساب المسير؛ أعد الاحتساب قبل الترحيل.',1;
  SELECT @ExternalDeductionDetailCount=COUNT(*) FROM dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND PayRunID=@PayRunID AND SourceType=21;
  UPDATE x SET WithheldTotal=x.WithheldTotal+ISNULL(d.CollectedAmount,0),AssessedTotal=x.AssessedTotal+d.Amount,NextDueDate=DATEADD(MONTH,x.FrequencyMonths,x.NextDueDate),DeductionState=CASE WHEN x.TotalAmount IS NOT NULL AND x.AssessedTotal+d.Amount>=x.TotalAmount THEN 3 ELSE 1 END
   FROM dbo.Emp_EmployeeExternalDeductions x JOIN dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails d ON d.CmpID=x.CmpID AND d.SourceType=21 AND d.SourceID=x.DeductionID
   WHERE d.CmpID=@CmpID AND d.PayRunID=@PayRunID AND x.DeductionState=1 AND (x.TotalAmount IS NULL OR x.AssessedTotal+d.Amount<=x.TotalAmount);
  IF @@ROWCOUNT<>@ExternalDeductionDetailCount THROW 54867,N'تعذر تحديث جميع الاستقطاعات الخارجية؛ أُلغيت عملية الترحيل.',1;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails d JOIN dbo.Emp_PayrollDeductionArrears a ON a.CmpID=d.CmpID AND a.ArrearID=d.SourceID
   WHERE d.CmpID=@CmpID AND d.PayRunID=@PayRunID AND d.SourceType=22 AND (a.ArrearState<>0 OR d.Amount>a.OutstandingAmount OR d.Amount<>d.CollectedAmount+d.DeferredAmount))
   THROW 54917,N'تغير رصيد الاستقطاع المؤجل بعد احتساب المسير؛ أعد الاحتساب قبل الترحيل.',1;
     IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails d JOIN dbo.Emp_PayrollDeductionArrears ar ON ar.CmpID=d.CmpID AND ar.ArrearID=d.SourceID AND ar.OriginalSourceType=20 LEFT JOIN dbo.Emp_SalaryAdvanceInstallments i ON i.CmpID=ar.CmpID AND i.InstallmentID=ar.OriginalSourceID
    WHERE d.CmpID=@CmpID AND d.PayRunID=@PayRunID AND d.SourceType=22 AND (i.InstallmentID IS NULL OR i.InstallmentState<>0 OR i.PaidAmount+ISNULL(d.CollectedAmount,0)>i.Amount))
    THROW 54956,N'رصيد المرتب المقدم المؤجل لا يطابق قسطه الأصلي؛ أُوقف الترحيل.',1;
SELECT @ArrearDetailCount=COUNT(*) FROM dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND PayRunID=@PayRunID AND SourceType=22;
   INSERT dbo.Emp_PayrollDeductionArrearEvents(CmpID,ArrearID,PayRunID,PayrollDetailID,EventType,Amount,OutstandingBefore,OutstandingAfter,CreatedBy)
   SELECT d.CmpID,a.ArrearID,@PayRunID,d.PayrollDetailID,2,d.CollectedAmount,a.OutstandingAmount,a.OutstandingAmount-d.CollectedAmount,@UserID
   FROM dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails d JOIN dbo.Emp_PayrollDeductionArrears a ON a.CmpID=d.CmpID AND a.ArrearID=d.SourceID
   WHERE d.CmpID=@CmpID AND d.PayRunID=@PayRunID AND d.SourceType=22 AND d.CollectedAmount>0;
  UPDATE a SET CollectedAmount=a.CollectedAmount+ISNULL(d.CollectedAmount,0),OutstandingAmount=a.OutstandingAmount-ISNULL(d.CollectedAmount,0),ArrearState=CASE WHEN a.OutstandingAmount-ISNULL(d.CollectedAmount,0)=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,UpdatedAt=SYSDATETIME()
   FROM dbo.Emp_PayrollDeductionArrears a JOIN dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails d ON d.CmpID=a.CmpID AND d.SourceType=22 AND d.SourceID=a.ArrearID
   WHERE d.CmpID=@CmpID AND d.PayRunID=@PayRunID AND a.ArrearState=0 AND ISNULL(d.CollectedAmount,0)<=a.OutstandingAmount;
  IF @@ROWCOUNT<>@ArrearDetailCount THROW 54918,N'تعذر تحديث جميع الأرصدة المؤجلة؛ أُلغيت عملية الترحيل.',1;
   SELECT @AdvanceArrearCount=COUNT(*) FROM dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails d JOIN dbo.Emp_PayrollDeductionArrears ar ON ar.CmpID=d.CmpID AND ar.ArrearID=d.SourceID AND ar.OriginalSourceType=20 WHERE d.CmpID=@CmpID AND d.PayRunID=@PayRunID AND d.SourceType=22 AND ISNULL(d.CollectedAmount,0)>0;
   UPDATE i SET PaidAmount=i.PaidAmount+d.CollectedAmount,InstallmentState=CASE WHEN i.PaidAmount+d.CollectedAmount>=i.Amount THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,PaidAt=CASE WHEN i.PaidAmount+d.CollectedAmount>=i.Amount THEN SYSDATETIME() ELSE NULL END
    FROM dbo.Emp_SalaryAdvanceInstallments i JOIN dbo.Emp_PayrollDeductionArrears ar ON ar.CmpID=i.CmpID AND ar.OriginalSourceType=20 AND ar.OriginalSourceID=i.InstallmentID
    JOIN dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails d ON d.CmpID=ar.CmpID AND d.SourceType=22 AND d.SourceID=ar.ArrearID
    WHERE d.CmpID=@CmpID AND d.PayRunID=@PayRunID AND i.InstallmentState=0 AND ISNULL(d.CollectedAmount,0)>0 AND i.PaidAmount+d.CollectedAmount<=i.Amount;
   IF @@ROWCOUNT<>@AdvanceArrearCount THROW 54957,N'تعذر تحديث أقساط المرتبات المقدمة المؤجلة؛ أُلغيت عملية الترحيل.',1;
   INSERT dbo.Emp_SalaryAdvancePayments(CmpID,InstallmentID,Amount,PaymentDate,PaymentSource,PayRunID,CreatedBy)
    SELECT ar.CmpID,ar.OriginalSourceID,d.CollectedAmount,CONVERT(date,SYSDATETIME()),2,@PayRunID,@UserID
    FROM dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails d JOIN dbo.Emp_PayrollDeductionArrears ar ON ar.CmpID=d.CmpID AND ar.ArrearID=d.SourceID AND ar.OriginalSourceType=20
    WHERE d.CmpID=@CmpID AND d.PayRunID=@PayRunID AND d.SourceType=22 AND d.CollectedAmount>0;
   UPDATE a SET AdvanceState=3 FROM dbo.Emp_SalaryAdvances a WHERE a.CmpID=@CmpID AND a.AdvanceState=1
    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_SalaryAdvanceInstallments i WHERE i.CmpID=a.CmpID AND i.AdvanceID=a.AdvanceID AND i.InstallmentState=0)
    AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_SalaryAdvanceInstallments i JOIN dbo.Emp_PayrollDeductionArrears ar ON ar.CmpID=i.CmpID AND ar.OriginalSourceType=20 AND ar.OriginalSourceID=i.InstallmentID JOIN dbo.Emp_PayrollDeductionArrearEvents ev ON ev.CmpID=ar.CmpID AND ev.ArrearID=ar.ArrearID JOIN dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails d ON d.CmpID=ev.CmpID AND d.PayrollDetailID=ev.PayrollDetailID WHERE i.CmpID=a.CmpID AND i.AdvanceID=a.AdvanceID AND ev.PayRunID=@PayRunID AND ev.EventType=2);
  INSERT dbo.Emp_PayrollDeductionArrears(CmpID,EmployeeID,ComponentID,OriginalSourceType,OriginalSourceID,OriginPeriodID,OriginPayRunID,OriginPayrollDetailID,CurrencyID,OriginalAmount,CollectedAmount,OutstandingAmount,DeductionPriority,IsMandatoryDeduction,CanDefer)
   OUTPUT inserted.ArrearID,inserted.OriginPayrollDetailID,inserted.OutstandingAmount INTO @CreatedArrears(ArrearID,OriginPayrollDetailID,Amount)
   SELECT d.CmpID,d.EmployeeID,d.ComponentID,d.SourceType,d.SourceID,@PeriodID,@PayRunID,d.PayrollDetailID,r.CurrencyID,d.Amount,ISNULL(d.CollectedAmount,0),d.DeferredAmount,a.DeductionPriority,a.IsMandatoryDeduction,a.CanDefer
   FROM dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails d JOIN dbo.Emp_PayRuns r ON r.CmpID=d.CmpID AND r.PayRunID=d.PayRunID
   JOIN dbo.Emp_PayrollDeductionAllocations a ON a.CmpID=d.CmpID AND a.PayRunID=d.PayRunID AND a.PayrollDetailID=d.PayrollDetailID AND a.CalculationVersion=r.CalculationVersion
   WHERE d.CmpID=@CmpID AND d.PayRunID=@PayRunID AND d.LineKind=2 AND d.SourceType IS DISTINCT FROM 13 AND d.SourceType IS DISTINCT FROM 22 AND d.DeferredAmount>0 AND a.CanDefer=1;
  UPDATE a SET ActionState=3,ProcessedAt=SYSDATETIME()
   INSERT dbo.Emp_PayrollDeductionArrearEvents(CmpID,ArrearID,PayRunID,PayrollDetailID,EventType,Amount,OutstandingBefore,OutstandingAfter,CreatedBy)
   SELECT @CmpID,ArrearID,@PayRunID,OriginPayrollDetailID,1,Amount,0,Amount,@UserID FROM @CreatedArrears;
  FROM dbo.Emp_RewardsPenalties a
  JOIN dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails d ON d.CmpID=a.CmpID AND d.SourceID=a.ActionID
    AND d.SourceType=CASE WHEN a.ActionType=1 THEN 10 ELSE 11 END
  WHERE d.CmpID=@CmpID AND d.PayRunID=@PayRunID AND a.ActionState=1;
  UPDATE o SET RequestState=3
  FROM dbo.Emp_OvertimeRequests o
  JOIN dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails d ON d.CmpID=o.CmpID AND d.SourceType=12 AND d.SourceID=o.OvertimeID
  WHERE d.CmpID=@CmpID AND d.PayRunID=@PayRunID AND o.RequestState=1;
  EXEC sys.sp_set_session_context @key=N'Acc.SystemOperation',@value=NULL;
  COMMIT;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH
  EXEC sys.sp_set_session_context @key=N'Acc.SystemOperation',@value=NULL;
  IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK;
  THROW;
 END CATCH;
 IF @SuppressResult=0 SELECT * FROM @Result;
 END;
 GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Emp_Proc_ApproveLeaveRequest]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Emp_Proc_ApproveLeaveRequest]
    @CmpID      INT,
    @User       BIGINT,
    @RequestID  BIGINT,
    @Decision   TINYINT, -- 1: موافقة، 2: رفض
    @Comments   NVARCHAR(500) = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    DECLARE @EmpID BIGINT, @LeaveTypeID BIGINT, @Qty DECIMAL(9,2), @ReqState TINYINT, @StartAt DATETIME2(0);

    SELECT 
        @EmpID = EmployeeID, 
        @LeaveTypeID = LeaveTypeID, 
        @Qty = Quantity, 
        @ReqState = RequestState,
        @StartAt = StartAt
    FROM dbo.Emp_LeaveRequests WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
    WHERE CmpID = @CmpID AND RequestID = @RequestID;

    IF @EmpID IS NULL
        THROW 55110, N'طلب الإجازة غير موجود.', 1;

    IF @ReqState <> 0
        THROW 55111, N'الطلب تم اعتماده او معالجته مسبقاً.', 1;

    BEGIN TRAN;
    BEGIN TRY
        IF @Decision = 1 -- موافقة نهائية
        BEGIN
            UPDATE dbo.Emp_LeaveRequests
            SET RequestState = 1 -- معتمد
            WHERE CmpID = @CmpID AND RequestID = @RequestID;

            DECLARE @BalanceID BIGINT;
            SELECT @BalanceID = BalanceID 
            FROM dbo.Emp_LeaveBalances 
            WHERE CmpID = @CmpID AND EmployeeID = @EmpID AND LeaveTypeID = @LeaveTypeID AND BalanceYear = YEAR(@StartAt);

            IF @BalanceID IS NULL
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO dbo.Emp_LeaveBalances (CmpID, EmployeeID, LeaveTypeID, BalanceYear, OpeningBalance, Earned, Used, Adjusted, RecordState, CreatedAt, CreatedBy)
                VALUES (@CmpID, @EmpID, @LeaveTypeID, YEAR(@StartAt), 0, 0, @Qty, 0, 1, SYSDATETIME(), @User);
                SET @BalanceID = SCOPE_IDENTITY();
            END
            ELSE
            BEGIN
                UPDATE dbo.Emp_LeaveBalances
                SET Used = Used + @Qty
                WHERE BalanceID = @BalanceID;
            END

            INSERT INTO dbo.Emp_LeaveBalanceTransactions
            (CmpID, BalanceID, TransactionDate, TransactionType, Quantity, SourceType, SourceID, Description, CreatedAt, CreatedBy)
            VALUES
            (@CmpID, @BalanceID, CAST(@StartAt AS DATE), 2, @Qty, 1, @RequestID, N'خصم إجازة معتمدة', SYSDATETIME(), @User);
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            UPDATE dbo.Emp_LeaveRequests
            SET RequestState = 2 -- مرفوض
            WHERE CmpID = @CmpID AND RequestID = @RequestID;
        END

        COMMIT TRAN;
        SELECT @RequestID AS RequestID, N'تم تحديث حالة طلب الإجازة بنجاح.' AS Message;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 ROLLBACK TRAN;
        THROW;
    END CATCH
END;
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Emp_Proc_CalculateFinalSettlement]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 5. وحدة إنهاء الخدمة والتسويات النهائية (Terminations & Settlements)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- احتساب التسوية النهائية ونهاية الخدمة
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Emp_Proc_CalculateFinalSettlement]
    @CmpID         INT,
    @User          BIGINT,
    @TerminationID BIGINT,
    @CurrencyID    BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    DECLARE @EmpID BIGINT, @LastWorkDate DATE;

    SELECT @EmpID = EmployeeID, @LastWorkDate = LastWorkingDate
    FROM dbo.Emp_Terminations
    WHERE CmpID = @CmpID AND TerminationID = @TerminationID;

    IF @EmpID IS NULL
        THROW 55401, N'طلب إنهاء الخدمة غير موجود.', 1;

    BEGIN TRAN;
    BEGIN TRY
        DECLARE @Entitlements DECIMAL(19,3) = 0;
        DECLARE @Deductions DECIMAL(19,3) = 0;

        -- احتساب رصيد الإجازات المتبقي وصرف قيمتها
        DECLARE @UnusedLeaves DECIMAL(9,2) = 0;
        SELECT @UnusedLeaves = ISNULL(SUM(ClosingBalance), 0)
        FROM dbo.Emp_LeaveBalances
        WHERE CmpID = @CmpID AND EmployeeID = @EmpID AND BalanceYear = YEAR(@LastWorkDate);

        -- الحصول على الراتب الأخير للموظف
        DECLARE @LastSalary DECIMAL(15,3) = 0;
        SELECT @LastSalary = SalAmount FROM dbo.Emp_Salary WHERE EmpCompany = @CmpID AND EmpID = @EmpID AND SalEndDate IS NULL;

        -- تقدير مكافأة نهاية الخدمة ورصيد الإجازات
        SET @Entitlements = (@LastSalary / 30.0) * @UnusedLeaves;

        -- خصم السلف أو المديونيات القائمة غير المكتملة
        SELECT @Deductions = ISNULL(SUM(Amount - PaidAmount), 0)
        FROM dbo.Emp_LoanInstallments i
        JOIN dbo.Emp_Loans l ON l.CmpID = i.CmpID AND l.LoanID = i.LoanID
        WHERE l.CmpID = @CmpID AND l.EmployeeID = @EmpID AND i.InstallmentState <> 2;

        -- إدراج التسوية النهائية
        INSERT INTO dbo.Emp_FinalSettlements
        (CmpID, TerminationID, CurrencyID, GrossEntitlements, Deductions, CalculationDetails, SettlementState, CalculatedAt, CalculatedBy)
        VALUES
        (@CmpID, @TerminationID, @CurrencyID, @Entitlements, @Deductions, N'تسوية نهاية الخدمة شاملة بدل الإجازات والخصومات والمستحقات.', 0, SYSDATETIME(), @User);

        COMMIT TRAN;
        SELECT @TerminationID AS TerminationID, @Entitlements AS GrossEntitlements, @Deductions AS Deductions, N'تم احتساب التسوية النهائية بنجاح.' AS Message;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 ROLLBACK TRAN;
        THROW;
    END CATCH
END;

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Emp_Proc_CalculatePayRun]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 3. وحدة الرواتب ومسيراتها (Payroll & Pay Runs)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Emp_Proc_CalculatePayRun]
    @CmpID      INT,
    @User       BIGINT,
    @PeriodID   BIGINT,
    @CurrencyID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    DECLARE @DateFrom DATE, @DateTo DATE, @PayRunID BIGINT;

    SELECT @DateFrom = DateFrom, @DateTo = DateTo 
    FROM dbo.Emp_PayPeriods 
    WHERE CmpID = @CmpID AND PeriodID = @PeriodID;

    IF @DateFrom IS NULL
        THROW 55201, N'فترة الرواتب المحددة غير موجودة.', 1;

    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_PayRuns WHERE CmpID = @CmpID AND PeriodID = @PeriodID AND RunState = 2)
        THROW 55202, N'مسير الرواتب لهذه الفترة مقفل نهائياً.', 1;

    BEGIN TRAN;
    BEGIN TRY
        SELECT @PayRunID = PayRunID FROM dbo.Emp_PayRuns WHERE CmpID = @CmpID AND PeriodID = @PeriodID AND RunNo = 1;
        
        IF @PayRunID IS NULL
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO dbo.Emp_PayRuns
            (CmpID, PeriodID, RunNo, CurrencyID, RunState, GrossTotal, DeductionTotal, NetTotal, CreatedAt, CreatedBy)
            VALUES
            (@CmpID, @PeriodID, 1, @CurrencyID, 0, 0, 0, 0, SYSDATETIME(), @User);

            SET @PayRunID = SCOPE_IDENTITY();
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            DELETE FROM dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails WHERE CmpID = @CmpID AND PayRunID = @PayRunID;
        END

        INSERT INTO dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails
        (CmpID, PayRunID, EmployeeID, ComponentID, LineKind, Description, Quantity, Rate, Amount, SourceType, SourceID)
        SELECT 
            @CmpID,
            @PayRunID,
            s.EmpID,
            NULL,
            1,
            N'الراتب الأساسي',
            1,
            s.SalAmount,
            s.SalAmount,
            NULL,
            NULL
        FROM dbo.Emp_Salary s
        WHERE s.EmpCompany = @CmpID
          AND s.SalCurrencyID = @CurrencyID
          AND s.SalEndDate IS NULL;

        INSERT INTO dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails
        (CmpID, PayRunID, EmployeeID, ComponentID, LineKind, Description, Quantity, Rate, Amount, SourceType, SourceID)
        SELECT 
            @CmpID,
            @PayRunID,
            ep.EmployeeID,
            ep.ComponentID,
            c.ComponentKind,
            c.ComponentName,
            1,
            ep.Amount,
            ep.Amount,
            2,
            ep.EmployeeComponentID
        FROM dbo.Emp_EmployeePayComponents ep
        JOIN dbo.Emp_PayComponents c ON c.CmpID = ep.CmpID AND c.ComponentID = ep.ComponentID
        WHERE ep.CmpID = @CmpID AND ep.RecordState = 1;

        DECLARE @Gross DECIMAL(19,3), @Ded DECIMAL(19,3);
        SELECT 
            @Gross = ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN LineKind = 1 THEN Amount ELSE 0 END), 0),
            @Ded = ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN LineKind = 2 THEN Amount ELSE 0 END), 0)
        FROM dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails
        WHERE CmpID = @CmpID AND PayRunID = @PayRunID;

        UPDATE dbo.Emp_PayRuns
        SET GrossTotal = @Gross,
            DeductionTotal = @Ded,
            NetTotal = @Gross - @Ded,
            CalculatedAt = SYSDATETIME(),
            CalculatedBy = @User,
            RunState = 1
        WHERE PayRunID = @PayRunID;

        COMMIT TRAN;
        SELECT @PayRunID AS PayRunID, N'تم احتساب مسير الرواتب بنجاح.' AS Message;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 ROLLBACK TRAN;
        THROW;
    END CATCH
END;
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Emp_Proc_ClosePayRun]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

-- ب. إقفال مسير الرواتب والربط المحاسبي (توليد قيد اليومية تلقائياً Acc_DayMaster & Acc_DayDetails)
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Emp_Proc_ClosePayRun]
    @CmpID      INT,
    @User       BIGINT,
    @PayRunID   BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    DECLARE @State TINYINT, @NetTotal DECIMAL(19,3), @CurrencyID BIGINT, @PeriodName NVARCHAR(100);

    SELECT 
        @State = r.RunState, 
        @NetTotal = r.NetTotal, 
        @CurrencyID = r.CurrencyID,
        @PeriodName = p.PeriodName
    FROM dbo.Emp_PayRuns r
    JOIN dbo.Emp_PayPeriods p ON p.CmpID = r.CmpID AND p.PeriodID = r.PeriodID
    WHERE r.CmpID = @CmpID AND r.PayRunID = @PayRunID;

    IF @State <> 1
        THROW 55210, N'مسير الرواتب غير محسوب أو مقفل مسبقاً.', 1;

    BEGIN TRAN;
    BEGIN TRY
        -- 1. إنشاء قيد اليومية الآلي (Acc_DayMaster) للرواتب
        DECLARE @DayMID BIGINT;
        DECLARE @VoucherNo INT;

        SELECT @VoucherNo = ISNULL(MAX(DayMNo), 0) + 1 
        FROM dbo.Acc_DayMaster 
        WHERE DayMCompany = @CmpID AND DayMYear = YEAR(GETDATE()) AND DayMMonth = MONTH(GETDATE());

        INSERT INTO dbo.Acc_DayMaster
        (DayMDate, DayMDescription, DayMNo, DayMState, DayMDateTime, DayMUser, DayMCompany)
        VALUES
        (CAST(SYSDATETIME() AS DATE), N'إثبات مسير رواتب الفترة: ' + @PeriodName, @VoucherNo, 1, SYSDATETIME(), @User, @CmpID);

        SET @DayMID = SCOPE_IDENTITY();

        -- 2. إدراج بنود قيد اليومية استناداً إلى حسابات التوجيه المحاسبي (Emp_PayrollAccountMappings) أو الحسابات الافتراضية
        -- بند إجمالي الصافي الدائن (التزامات الرواتب أو البنك)
        INSERT INTO dbo.Acc_DayDetails
        (DayDMID, DayDAccID, DayDDeb, DayDCrd, DayDNum, DayDDescription)
        SELECT 
            @DayMID,
            m.AccountID,
            0,
            @NetTotal,
            CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50), @PayRunID),
            N'صافي الرواتب المستحقة - ' + @PeriodName
        FROM dbo.Emp_PayrollAccountMappings m
        WHERE m.CmpID = @CmpID AND m.RecordState = 1 AND m.DebitCredit = 2; -- دائن

        -- بند إجمالي المصروفات (مدين)
        INSERT INTO dbo.Acc_DayDetails
        (DayDMID, DayDAccID, DayDDeb, DayDCrd, DayDNum, DayDDescription)
        SELECT 
            @DayMID,
            m.AccountID,
            @NetTotal,
            0,
            CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50), @PayRunID),
            N'مصروف الرواتب والأجور - ' + @PeriodName
        FROM dbo.Emp_PayrollAccountMappings m
        WHERE m.CmpID = @CmpID AND m.RecordState = 1 AND m.DebitCredit = 1; -- مدين

        -- 3. تحديث مسير الرواتب وإقفاله وربطه برقم القيد المحاسبي
        UPDATE dbo.Emp_PayRuns
        SET RunState = 2, -- مقفل
            ClosedAt = SYSDATETIME(),
            ClosedBy = @User,
            VoucherID = @DayMID
        WHERE PayRunID = @PayRunID;

        COMMIT TRAN;
        SELECT @PayRunID AS PayRunID, @DayMID AS VoucherID, N'تم إقفال مسير الرواتب وتوليد القيد المحاسبي بنجاح.' AS Message;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 ROLLBACK TRAN;
        THROW;
    END CATCH
END;
GO

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 4. وحدة التوظيف والتعيين (Recruitment & Hiring)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- تحويل مرشح مقبول إلى موظف رسمي دون تكرار البيانات
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Emp_Proc_ConvertCandidateToEmployee]
    @CmpID        INT,
    @User         BIGINT,
    @CandidateID  BIGINT,
    @EmpNum       NVARCHAR(10),
    @PosID        BIGINT,
    @ContractType BIGINT,
    @StartDate    DATE
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;
    EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@User;
    IF @StartDate IS NULL THROW 55303,N'تاريخ مباشرة العمل مطلوب.',1;

    DECLARE @FullName NVARCHAR(200), @Phone NVARCHAR(40), @Email NVARCHAR(254), @NatID BIGINT, @BirthDate DATE;

    SELECT 
        @FullName = FullName, 
        @Phone = Phone, 
        @Email = Email, 
        @NatID = NationalityID, 
        @BirthDate = BirthDate
    FROM dbo.Emp_Candidates
    WHERE CmpID = @CmpID AND CandidateID = @CandidateID AND CandidateState=0;

    IF @FullName IS NULL
        THROW 55301, N'المرشح غير موجود.', 1;

    -- التحقق من عدم وجود موظف برقم مرجعي مكرر
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_Employee WHERE EmpCompany = @CmpID AND EmpNum = @EmpNum)
        THROW 55302, N'رقم الموظف مستخدم مسبقاً.', 1;

    BEGIN TRAN;
    BEGIN TRY
        DECLARE @NewEmpID BIGINT;

        -- 1. إدراج الموظف الأساسي
        INSERT INTO dbo.Emp_Employee
        (EmpNum, EmpName, EmpState, EmpDateTime, EmpUser, EmpCompany, PosID, HireDate)
        VALUES
        (@EmpNum, @FullName, 0, SYSDATETIME(), @User, @CmpID, @PosID, @StartDate);

        SET @NewEmpID = SCOPE_IDENTITY();

        -- 2. إدراج التفاصيل الشخصية
        INSERT INTO dbo.Emp_PersonalDetails
        (EmpCompany, EmpID, EmpGender, EmpNat, EmpBDate, EmpPhone, EmpAddress, EmpUser, EmpDateTime)
        VALUES
        (@CmpID, @NewEmpID, NULL, @NatID, @BirthDate, @Phone, @Email, @User, SYSDATETIME());

        -- 3. إدراج عقد العمل
        INSERT INTO dbo.Emp_Contract
        (EmpCompany, EmpID, ConType, ConStartDate, ConUser, ConDateTime)
        VALUES
        (@CmpID, @NewEmpID, @ContractType, @StartDate, @User, SYSDATETIME());

        -- 4. تحديث حالة المرشح إلى مقبول ومعين
        UPDATE dbo.Emp_Candidates
        SET CandidateState = 2 -- تم تعيينه
        WHERE CmpID = @CmpID AND CandidateID = @CandidateID AND CandidateState=0;

        COMMIT TRAN;
        SELECT @NewEmpID AS EmployeeID, N'تم تحويل المرشح إلى موظف بنجاح.' AS Message;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 ROLLBACK TRAN;
        THROW;
    END CATCH
END;
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Emp_Proc_ProcessDailyAttendance]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 1. وحدة الحضور والانصراف (Attendance & Time Management)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Emp_Proc_ProcessDailyAttendance]
    @CmpID      INT,
    @User       BIGINT,
    @DateFrom   DATE,
    @DateTo     DATE
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    IF ISNULL(@CmpID, 0) <= 0 OR @DateFrom > @DateTo
        THROW 55001, N'بيانات الإدخال غير صالحة لمعالجة الحضور.', 1;

    DECLARE @ProcID BIGINT;
    DECLARE @RecCount INT = 0, @ProcCount INT = 0, @FailCount INT = 0;

    BEGIN TRAN;
    BEGIN TRY
        INSERT INTO dbo.Emp_AttendanceProcessingLog
        (ProcCmp, ProcDateFrom, ProcDateTo, ProcStartedAt, ProcStatus, ProcReceivedCount, ProcProcessedCount, ProcFailedCount, ProcUser, ProcDateTime)
        VALUES
        (@CmpID, @DateFrom, @DateTo, SYSDATETIME(), 1, 0, 0, 0, @User, SYSDATETIME());

        SET @ProcID = SCOPE_IDENTITY();

        SELECT 
            t.AttEmpID,
            CAST(t.AttDateTime AS DATE) AS WorkDate,
            MIN(CASE WHEN t.AttType = 1 THEN t.AttDateTime END) AS FirstIn,
            MAX(CASE WHEN t.AttType = 2 THEN t.AttDateTime END) AS LastOut
        INTO #RawPunches
        FROM dbo.Emp_AttendanceTransactions t
        WHERE t.AttCmp = @CmpID
          AND CAST(t.AttDateTime AS DATE) BETWEEN @DateFrom AND @DateTo
          AND t.AttState = 1
        GROUP BY t.AttEmpID, CAST(t.AttDateTime AS DATE);

        SET @RecCount = @@ROWCOUNT;

        MERGE dbo.Emp_AttendanceDaily AS target
        USING #RawPunches AS source
        ON target.AttDayCmp = @CmpID 
           AND target.AttDayEmpID = source.AttEmpID 
           AND target.AttDayDate = source.WorkDate
        WHEN MATCHED THEN
            UPDATE SET 
                AttDayFirstIn = source.FirstIn,
                AttDayLastOut = source.LastOut,
                AttDayWorkMinutes = CASE 
                    WHEN source.FirstIn IS NOT NULL AND source.LastOut IS NOT NULL AND source.LastOut >= source.FirstIn 
                    THEN DATEDIFF(MINUTE, source.FirstIn, source.LastOut) 
                    ELSE 0 END,
                AttDayDateTime = SYSDATETIME(),
                AttDayUser = @User
        WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
            INSERT (AttDayCmp, AttDayEmpID, AttDayDate, AttDayFirstIn, AttDayLastOut, AttDayWorkMinutes, AttDayLateMinutes, AttDayEarlyLeaveMinutes, AttDayOvertimeMinutes, AttDayState, AttDayDateTime, AttDayUser)
            VALUES (@CmpID, source.AttEmpID, source.WorkDate, source.FirstIn, source.LastOut,
                    CASE WHEN source.FirstIn IS NOT NULL AND source.LastOut IS NOT NULL AND source.LastOut >= source.FirstIn THEN DATEDIFF(MINUTE, source.FirstIn, source.LastOut) ELSE 0 END,
                    0, 0, 0, 1, SYSDATETIME(), @User);

        SET @ProcCount = @@ROWCOUNT;

        INSERT INTO dbo.Emp_AttendanceExceptions
        (ExcCmp, ExcAttDayID, ExcProcID, ExcType, ExcDescription, ExcSeverity, ExcState, ExcDateTime, ExcUser)
        SELECT 
            @CmpID,
            d.AttDayID,
            @ProcID,
            CASE 
                WHEN d.AttDayFirstIn IS NULL AND d.AttDayLastOut IS NULL THEN 1 
                WHEN d.AttDayFirstIn IS NOT NULL AND d.AttDayLastOut IS NULL THEN 2 
                WHEN d.AttDayFirstIn IS NULL AND d.AttDayLastOut IS NOT NULL THEN 3 
                ELSE 8
            END,
            N'استثناء في الحركة اليومية للموظف بتاريخ ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), d.AttDayDate, 23),
            2,
            0,
            SYSDATETIME(),
            @User
        FROM dbo.Emp_AttendanceDaily d
        WHERE d.AttDayCmp = @CmpID
          AND d.AttDayDate BETWEEN @DateFrom AND @DateTo
          AND (d.AttDayFirstIn IS NULL OR d.AttDayLastOut IS NULL)
          AND NOT EXISTS (
              SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_AttendanceExceptions ex 
              WHERE ex.ExcCmp = @CmpID AND ex.ExcAttDayID = d.AttDayID
          );

        UPDATE dbo.Emp_AttendanceProcessingLog
        SET ProcFinishedAt = SYSDATETIME(),
            ProcStatus = 2,
            ProcReceivedCount = @RecCount,
            ProcProcessedCount = @ProcCount,
            ProcFailedCount = @FailCount
        WHERE ProcID = @ProcID;

        COMMIT TRAN;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 ROLLBACK TRAN;
        DECLARE @ErrMsg NVARCHAR(MAX) = ERROR_MESSAGE();
        IF @ProcID IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            UPDATE dbo.Emp_AttendanceProcessingLog
            SET ProcFinishedAt = SYSDATETIME(),
                ProcStatus = 4,
                ProcError = @ErrMsg
            WHERE ProcID = @ProcID;
        END
    END CATCH
END;
GO

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 2. وحدة الإجازات وأرصدتها (Leaves & Balances)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Emp_Proc_SubmitLeaveRequest]
    @CmpID       INT,
    @User        BIGINT,
    @EmployeeID  BIGINT,
    @LeaveTypeID BIGINT,
    @StartAt     DATETIME2(0),
    @EndAt       DATETIME2(0),
    @Quantity    DECIMAL(9,2),
    @Reason      NVARCHAR(1000) = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    IF @StartAt >= @EndAt OR @Quantity <= 0
        THROW 55101, N'تواريخ أو كمية الإجازة غير صالحة.', 1;

    DECLARE @AllowNeg BIT = 0;
    SELECT @AllowNeg = ISNULL(p.AllowNegative, 0)
    FROM dbo.Emp_EmployeeLeavePolicies ep
    JOIN dbo.Emp_LeavePolicies p ON p.CmpID = ep.CmpID AND p.PolicyID = ep.PolicyID
    WHERE ep.CmpID = @CmpID AND ep.EmployeeID = @EmployeeID AND ep.RecordState = 1;

    DECLARE @CurrentBalance DECIMAL(9,2) = 0;
    SELECT @CurrentBalance = ISNULL(b.ClosingBalance, 0)
    FROM dbo.Emp_LeaveBalances b
    WHERE b.CmpID = @CmpID AND b.EmployeeID = @EmployeeID AND b.LeaveTypeID = @LeaveTypeID AND b.BalanceYear = YEAR(@StartAt);

    IF @AllowNeg = 0 AND (@CurrentBalance < @Quantity)
        THROW 55102, N'رصيد الإجازات غير كافٍ ولا تسمح سياسة الشركة بتجاوز الرصيد.', 1;

    BEGIN TRAN;
    BEGIN TRY
        DECLARE @ReqID BIGINT;

        INSERT INTO dbo.Emp_LeaveRequests
        (CmpID, EmployeeID, LeaveTypeID, StartAt, EndAt, Quantity, IsHourly, Reason, RequestState, SubmittedAt, CreatedBy, CreatedAt)
        VALUES
        (@CmpID, @EmployeeID, @LeaveTypeID, @StartAt, @EndAt, @Quantity, 0, @Reason, 0, SYSDATETIME(), @User, SYSDATETIME());

        SET @ReqID = SCOPE_IDENTITY();

        COMMIT TRAN;
        SELECT @ReqID AS RequestID, N'تم تقديم طلب الإجازة بنجاح.' AS Message;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 ROLLBACK TRAN;
        THROW;
    END CATCH
END;
GO

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 6. وحدة تقييم الأداء والتدريب (Performance & Training)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- تسجيل تقييم أداء الموظف
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Emp_Proc_SubmitPerformanceReview]
    @CmpID      INT,
    @User       BIGINT,
    @CycleID    BIGINT,
    @EmployeeID BIGINT,
    @ReviewerID BIGINT,
    @Score      DECIMAL(7,2),
    @ReviewText NVARCHAR(MAX)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    IF @Score < 0 OR @Score > 100
        THROW 55501, N'درجة تقييم الأداء يجب أن تكون بين 0 و 100.', 1;

    BEGIN TRAN;
    BEGIN TRY
        MERGE dbo.Emp_PerformanceReviews AS target
        USING (SELECT @CmpID AS Cmp, @CycleID AS Cyc, @EmployeeID AS Emp) AS source
        ON target.CmpID = source.Cmp AND target.CycleID = source.Cyc AND target.EmployeeID = source.Emp
        WHEN MATCHED THEN
            UPDATE SET 
                ReviewerID = @ReviewerID,
                Score = @Score,
                ReviewText = @ReviewText,
                ReviewState = 1, -- مكتمل
                ReviewedAt = SYSDATETIME()
        WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
            INSERT (CmpID, CycleID, EmployeeID, ReviewerID, Score, ReviewText, ReviewState, ReviewedAt, CreatedAt, CreatedBy)
            VALUES (@CmpID, @CycleID, @EmployeeID, @ReviewerID, @Score, @ReviewText, 1, SYSDATETIME(), SYSDATETIME(), @User);

        COMMIT TRAN;
        SELECT N'تم حفظ تقييم الأداء بنجاح.' AS Message;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 ROLLBACK TRAN;
        THROW;
    END CATCH
END;
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Emp_Proc_SyncDeviceTransactions]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

-- ب. إجراء استقبال وتزامن حركات الأجهزة (Batch Sync)
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Emp_Proc_SyncDeviceTransactions]
    @CmpID      INT,
    @DeviceID   BIGINT,
    @User       BIGINT,
    @Batch      dbo.Emp_AttendanceBatchType READONLY
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@User;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    IF ISNULL(@CmpID, 0) <= 0 OR ISNULL(@DeviceID, 0) <= 0
        THROW 55002, N'بيانات الجهاز أو الشركة غير صالحة.', 1;

    DECLARE @SyncID BIGINT;
    DECLARE @RecCount INT = 0, @InsCount INT = 0, @DupCount INT = 0, @RejCount INT = 0;

    SELECT @RecCount = COUNT(*) FROM @Batch;

    BEGIN TRAN;
    BEGIN TRY
        INSERT INTO dbo.Emp_AttendanceDeviceSyncLog
        (SyncCmp, SyncDeviceID, SyncSource, SyncStatus, SyncStartedAt, SyncReceivedCount, SyncInsertedCount, SyncDuplicateCount, SyncRejectedCount, SyncUser)
        VALUES
        (@CmpID, @DeviceID, 1, 1, SYSDATETIME(), @RecCount, 0, 0, 0, @User);

        SET @SyncID = SCOPE_IDENTITY();

        -- حساب الهاش لمنع التكرار وإدراج الحركات الصالحة
        INSERT INTO dbo.Emp_AttendanceTransactions
        (AttCmp, AttEmpID, AttDateTime, AttType, AttSource, AttDeviceID, AttDeviceRecordID, AttState, AttDateTimeCreated, AttUser, AttSyncID, AttDedupHash)
        SELECT 
            @CmpID,
            b.EmployeeID,
            b.PunchAt,
            b.PunchType,
            1, -- جهاز
            @DeviceID,
            b.DeviceRecordID,
            1, -- فعّال
            SYSDATETIME(),
            @User,
            @SyncID,
            HASHBYTES('SHA2_256', CONCAT(@CmpID, '_', b.EmployeeID, '_', CONVERT(VARCHAR(20), b.PunchAt, 126), '_', b.PunchType))
        FROM @Batch b
        WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_AttendanceTransactions t 
            WHERE t.AttCmp = @CmpID 
              AND t.AttDedupHash = HASHBYTES('SHA2_256', CONCAT(@CmpID, '_', b.EmployeeID, '_', CONVERT(VARCHAR(20), b.PunchAt, 126), '_', b.PunchType))
        );

        SET @InsCount = @@ROWCOUNT;
        SET @DupCount = @RecCount - @InsCount;

        UPDATE dbo.Emp_AttendanceDeviceSyncLog
        SET SyncFinishedAt = SYSDATETIME(),
            SyncStatus = 2,
            SyncInsertedCount = @InsCount,
            SyncDuplicateCount = @DupCount
        WHERE SyncID = @SyncID;

        COMMIT TRAN;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 ROLLBACK TRAN;
        DECLARE @Err NVARCHAR(MAX) = ERROR_MESSAGE();
        UPDATE dbo.Emp_AttendanceDeviceSyncLog
        SET SyncFinishedAt = SYSDATETIME(),
            SyncStatus = 4,
            SyncError = @Err
        WHERE SyncID = @SyncID;
        THROW;
    END CATCH
END;
GO

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Emp_ProcessAttendance]
    @CmpID    INT,
    @DateFrom DATE,
    @DateTo   DATE,
    @UserID   BIGINT,@SuppressResult BIT=0
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;
    EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;

    DECLARE
        @ProcID BIGINT,
        @ReceivedCount INT = 0,
        @ProcessedCount INT = 0,
        @SkippedCount INT = 0,
        @FailedCount INT = 0,
        @FinalStatus TINYINT = 1,
        @Error NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL;

    IF ISNULL(@CmpID, 0) <= 0
        THROW 53101, N'الشركة المحددة غير صحيحة.', 1;

    IF @DateFrom IS NULL OR @DateTo IS NULL OR @DateTo < @DateFrom
        THROW 53102, N'فترة المعالجة غير صحيحة.', 1;

    IF NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1
        FROM dbo.Mng_Company
        WHERE CmpID = @CmpID
    )
        THROW 53103, N'الشركة غير موجودة.', 1;

    IF NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1
        FROM dbo.Mng_User
        WHERE UsrID = @UserID
    )
        THROW 53104, N'المستخدم غير موجود.', 1;

    DECLARE @Log TABLE
    (
        ProcID BIGINT,
        ProcStatus TINYINT
    );

    INSERT INTO @Log
    EXEC dbo.Emp_InsertAttendanceProcessingLog
        @CmpID = @CmpID,
        @DateFrom = @DateFrom,
        @DateTo = @DateTo,
        @UserID = @UserID;

    SELECT @ProcID = ProcID
    FROM @Log;

    BEGIN TRY

        BEGIN TRANSACTION;

        /* 1. تحميل الحركات الجديدة */

        SELECT T.AttID,T.AttCmp,T.AttEmpID,T.AttDateTime,T.AttType,
            CASE WHEN EXISTS
            (
                SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_EmployeeSchedule ES
                JOIN dbo.Emp_WorkCalendar WC ON WC.WCalCmp=ES.SchCmp AND WC.WCalID=ES.SchWCalID AND WC.WCalState=0
                JOIN dbo.Emp_WorkCalendarDetails WD ON WD.WCalDetCmp=WC.WCalCmp AND WD.WCalDetWCalID=WC.WCalID AND WD.WCalDetDate=DATEADD(DAY,-1,CONVERT(date,T.AttDateTime)) AND WD.WCalDetType=1
                JOIN dbo.Emp_WorkScheduleTypes ST ON ST.SchTypeCmp=WD.WCalDetCmp AND ST.SchTypeID=WD.WCalDetSchTypeID AND ST.SchTypeState=0 AND ST.SchCrossesMidnight=1
                WHERE ES.SchCmp=T.AttCmp AND ES.SchEmpID=T.AttEmpID AND ES.SchState=0 AND ES.SchStartDate<=DATEADD(DAY,-1,CONVERT(date,T.AttDateTime)) AND (ES.SchEndDate IS NULL OR ES.SchEndDate>=DATEADD(DAY,-1,CONVERT(date,T.AttDateTime)))
                  AND CONVERT(time(0),T.AttDateTime)<=ST.SchEndTime
            ) THEN DATEADD(DAY,-1,CONVERT(date,T.AttDateTime)) ELSE CONVERT(date,T.AttDateTime) END AS WorkDate
        INTO #Raw
        FROM dbo.Emp_AttendanceTransactions T WITH (UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK)
        WHERE T.AttCmp=@CmpID AND T.AttState=0
          AND T.AttDateTime>=DATEADD(DAY,-1,CONVERT(datetime2(0),@DateFrom))
          AND T.AttDateTime<DATEADD(DAY,2,CONVERT(datetime2(0),@DateTo));

        SELECT @ReceivedCount = COUNT(*) FROM #Raw WHERE WorkDate BETWEEN @DateFrom AND @DateTo;

        /* 2. استبعاد الأيام التي سبق اعتمادها */

        SELECT DISTINCT
            R.AttEmpID,
            R.WorkDate
        INTO #ProtectedDays
        FROM #Raw AS R
        INNER JOIN dbo.Emp_AttendanceDaily AS D
            ON D.AttDayCmp = R.AttCmp
           AND D.AttDayEmpID = R.AttEmpID
           AND D.AttDayDate = R.WorkDate
        WHERE D.AttDayState <> 0;

        /* 3. الحركات القابلة للمعالجة */

        SELECT R.*
        INTO #Eligible
        FROM #Raw AS R
        WHERE R.WorkDate BETWEEN @DateFrom AND @DateTo AND NOT EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM #ProtectedDays AS P
            WHERE P.AttEmpID = R.AttEmpID
              AND P.WorkDate = R.WorkDate
        );

        SELECT @ProcessedCount = COUNT(*)
        FROM #Eligible;

        SET @SkippedCount = @ReceivedCount - @ProcessedCount;

        /* 4. ترتيب الحركات لكل موظف ويوم */

        ;WITH OrderedPunches AS
        (
            SELECT
                AttID,
                AttEmpID,
                WorkDate,
                AttDateTime,
                AttType,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER
                (
                    PARTITION BY AttEmpID, WorkDate
                    ORDER BY AttDateTime, AttID
                ) AS RowNo
            FROM #Eligible
        ),
        PairedPunches AS
        (
            SELECT A.AttEmpID,A.WorkDate,A.AttDateTime AS InTime,B.OutTime,A.AttType AS InType,CONVERT(tinyint,2) AS OutType
            FROM OrderedPunches A
            OUTER APPLY
            (
                SELECT TOP(1) X.AttDateTime AS OutTime
                FROM OrderedPunches X
                WHERE X.AttEmpID=A.AttEmpID AND X.WorkDate=A.WorkDate AND X.RowNo>A.RowNo AND X.AttType=2
                  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM OrderedPunches BetweenEvents WHERE BetweenEvents.AttEmpID=A.AttEmpID AND BetweenEvents.WorkDate=A.WorkDate AND BetweenEvents.RowNo>A.RowNo AND BetweenEvents.RowNo<X.RowNo AND BetweenEvents.AttType=1)
                ORDER BY X.RowNo
            ) B
            WHERE A.AttType=1
        )
        SELECT AttEmpID,WorkDate,MIN(CASE WHEN InTime IS NOT NULL THEN InTime END) AS FirstIn,
            MAX(OutTime) AS LastOut,
            SUM(CASE WHEN OutTime>=InTime THEN DATEDIFF(MINUTE,InTime,OutTime) ELSE 0 END) AS WorkMinutes
        INTO #Daily FROM PairedPunches GROUP BY AttEmpID,WorkDate;

        /* Compute schedule-based tardiness and early departure using the employee calendar. */
        UPDATE A SET
            A.AttDayLateMinutes=CASE WHEN A.FirstIn>DATEADD(MINUTE,S.GraceMinutes,S.StartAt) THEN DATEDIFF(MINUTE,DATEADD(MINUTE,S.GraceMinutes,S.StartAt),A.FirstIn) ELSE 0 END,
            A.AttDayEarlyLeaveMinutes=CASE WHEN A.LastOut IS NOT NULL AND A.LastOut<S.EndAt THEN DATEDIFF(MINUTE,A.LastOut,S.EndAt) ELSE 0 END,
            A.AttDayOvertimeMinutes=CASE WHEN A.WorkMinutes>S.RequiredMinutes THEN A.WorkMinutes-S.RequiredMinutes ELSE 0 END
        FROM #Daily A
        OUTER APPLY
        (
            SELECT TOP(1)
                DATEADD(SECOND,DATEDIFF(SECOND,CONVERT(time(0),'00:00:00'),ST.SchStartTime),CONVERT(datetime2(0),A.WorkDate)) AS StartAt,
                DATEADD(DAY,CASE WHEN ST.SchCrossesMidnight=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,DATEADD(SECOND,DATEDIFF(SECOND,CONVERT(time(0),'00:00:00'),ST.SchEndTime),CONVERT(datetime2(0),A.WorkDate))) AS EndAt,
                ST.SchGraceMinutes AS GraceMinutes,CONVERT(int,ROUND(ST.SchWorkingHours*60,0)) AS RequiredMinutes
            FROM dbo.Emp_EmployeeSchedule ES
            JOIN dbo.Emp_WorkCalendar WC ON WC.WCalCmp=ES.SchCmp AND WC.WCalID=ES.SchWCalID AND WC.WCalState=0
            JOIN dbo.Emp_WorkCalendarDetails WD ON WD.WCalDetCmp=WC.WCalCmp AND WD.WCalDetWCalID=WC.WCalID AND WD.WCalDetDate=A.WorkDate AND WD.WCalDetType=1
            JOIN dbo.Emp_WorkScheduleTypes ST ON ST.SchTypeCmp=WD.WCalDetCmp AND ST.SchTypeID=WD.WCalDetSchTypeID AND ST.SchTypeState=0
            WHERE ES.SchCmp=@CmpID AND ES.SchEmpID=A.AttEmpID AND ES.SchState=0 AND ES.SchStartDate<=A.WorkDate AND (ES.SchEndDate IS NULL OR ES.SchEndDate>=A.WorkDate)
            ORDER BY ES.SchStartDate DESC,ES.SchID DESC
        ) S;
        /* 5. تحديث الملخص اليومي الموجود */

        UPDATE D
        SET
            D.AttDayFirstIn = A.FirstIn,
            D.AttDayLastOut = A.LastOut,
            D.AttDayWorkMinutes = A.WorkMinutes,
            D.AttDayLateMinutes = A.AttDayLateMinutes,
            D.AttDayEarlyLeaveMinutes = A.AttDayEarlyLeaveMinutes,
            D.AttDayOvertimeMinutes = A.AttDayOvertimeMinutes,
            D.AttDayDateTime = SYSDATETIME(),
            D.AttDayUser = @UserID
        FROM dbo.Emp_AttendanceDaily AS D
        INNER JOIN #Daily AS A
            ON A.AttEmpID = D.AttDayEmpID
           AND A.WorkDate = D.AttDayDate
        WHERE D.AttDayCmp = @CmpID
          AND D.AttDayState = 0;

        /* 6. إضافة الأيام غير المسجلة */

        INSERT INTO dbo.Emp_AttendanceDaily
        (
            AttDayCmp,
            AttDayEmpID,
            AttDayDate,
            AttDayFirstIn,
            AttDayLastOut,
            AttDayWorkMinutes,
            AttDayLateMinutes,
            AttDayEarlyLeaveMinutes,
            AttDayOvertimeMinutes,
            AttDayUser
        )
        SELECT
            @CmpID,
            A.AttEmpID,
            A.WorkDate,
            A.FirstIn,
            A.LastOut,
            A.WorkMinutes,
            A.AttDayLateMinutes,
            A.AttDayEarlyLeaveMinutes,
            A.AttDayOvertimeMinutes,
            @UserID
        FROM #Daily AS A
        WHERE NOT EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM dbo.Emp_AttendanceDaily AS D
            WHERE D.AttDayCmp = @CmpID
              AND D.AttDayEmpID = A.AttEmpID
              AND D.AttDayDate = A.WorkDate
        );

        /* 7. تعليم الحركات التي تمت معالجتها */

        UPDATE T
        SET
            T.AttState = 1,
            T.AttStateDateTime = SYSDATETIME(),
            T.AttStateUser = @UserID
        FROM dbo.Emp_AttendanceTransactions AS T
        INNER JOIN #Eligible AS E
            ON E.AttID = T.AttID
        WHERE T.AttCmp = @CmpID
          AND T.AttState = 0;

        /* 8. إنهاء سجل المعالجة */

        SET @FinalStatus =
            CASE WHEN @SkippedCount > 0 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END;

        IF @SkippedCount > 0
            SET @Error = N'تم تجاوز حركات الأيام التي سبق اعتماد ملخص حضورها.';

        EXEC dbo.Emp_UpdateAttendanceProcessingLog
            @CmpID = @CmpID,
            @ProcID = @ProcID,
            @Status = @FinalStatus,
            @ReceivedCount = @ReceivedCount,
            @ProcessedCount = @ProcessedCount,
            @SkippedCount = @SkippedCount,
            @FailedCount = 0,
            @Error = @Error,
            @UserID = @UserID;

        COMMIT TRANSACTION;

        IF @SuppressResult=0 SELECT @ProcID AS ProcID,@FinalStatus AS ProcStatus,@ReceivedCount AS ReceivedCount,@ProcessedCount AS ProcessedCount,@SkippedCount AS SkippedCount,0 AS FailedCount;

    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH

        IF XACT_STATE() <> 0
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;

        SET @Error = ERROR_MESSAGE();
        SET @FailedCount = @ReceivedCount;

        UPDATE dbo.Emp_AttendanceProcessingLog
        SET
            ProcStatus = 3,
            ProcReceivedCount = @ReceivedCount,
            ProcProcessedCount = 0,
            ProcSkippedCount = 0,
            ProcFailedCount = @FailedCount,
            ProcError = @Error,
            ProcFinishedAt = SYSDATETIME()
        WHERE ProcCmp = @CmpID
          AND ProcID = @ProcID
          AND ProcStatus = 0;

        THROW;

    END CATCH;
END;

mp,AttEmpID,AttDateTime,AttType,AttSource,AttDeviceID,AttDeviceRecordID,AttState,AttDateTimeCreated,AttUser,AttSyncID,AttDedupHash)
 SELECT @CmpID,v.EmployeeID,v.PunchAt,v.PunchType,@Source,@DeviceID,v.DeviceRecordID,0,SYSDATETIME(),@UserID,@SyncID,v.DedupHash
 FROM Ranked v
 WHERE v.rn=1 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_AttendanceTransactions t WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE t.AttCmp=@CmpID AND t.AttDedupHash=v.DedupHash);
 SET @Inserted=@@ROWCOUNT;
 SET @Duplicates=@ValidCount-@Inserted;
 IF @SyncID IS NOT NULL
  UPDATE dbo.Emp_AttendanceDeviceSyncLog
   SET SyncReceivedCount=@Received,SyncInsertedCount=@Inserted,SyncDuplicateCount=@Duplicates,SyncRejectedCount=@Rejected,
       SyncFinishedAt=SYSDATETIME(),SyncStatus=CASE WHEN @Rejected>0 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END,SyncUser=@UserID
   WHERE SyncCmp=@CmpID AND SyncID=@SyncID;
 COMMIT;
 SELECT @Received ReceivedCount,@Inserted InsertedCount,@Duplicates DuplicateCount,@Rejected RejectedCount;
 SELECT r.* FROM @Rows r WHERE r.PunchType NOT IN(1,2)
    OR (@Source=1 AND NULLIF(r.DeviceRecordID,N'') IS NULL)
    OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_Employee e WHERE e.EmpCompany=@CmpID AND e.EmpID=r.EmployeeID);
END;

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Emp_RegisterLoanPayment]
 @CmpID INT,@InstallmentID BIGINT,@Amount DECIMAL(15,3),@UserID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 IF @Amount<=0 THROW 54178,N'مبلغ السداد يجب أن يكون أكبر من صفر.',1;
 BEGIN TRY
  BEGIN TRAN;
 UPDATE dbo.Emp_LoanInstallments WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK)
 SET PaidAmount=PaidAmount+@Amount,InstallmentState=CASE WHEN PaidAmount+@Amount=Amount THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
     PaidAt=CASE WHEN PaidAmount+@Amount=Amount THEN SYSDATETIME() ELSE NULL END
 WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND InstallmentID=@InstallmentID AND InstallmentState=0 AND PaidAmount+@Amount<=Amount;
 IF @@ROWCOUNT=0 THROW 54179,N'القسط غير موجود أو أن مبلغ السداد يتجاوز المتبقي.',1;
 INSERT dbo.Emp_LoanPayments(CmpID,InstallmentID,Amount,PaymentDate,PaymentSource,CreatedBy) VALUES(@CmpID,@InstallmentID,@Amount,CONVERT(date,SYSDATETIME()),1,@UserID);
  COMMIT;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH
  IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
  THROW;
 END CATCH;
 SELECT * FROM dbo.Emp_LoanInstallments WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND InstallmentID=@InstallmentID;
END;

/* =========================================================
   6. INSERT ATTENDANCE ADJUSTMENT
   ========================================================= */

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Emp_SaveAttendanceAdjustment]
    @CmpID INT,
    @AttDayID BIGINT,
    @Type TINYINT,
    @OldValue DATETIME2(0) = NULL,
    @NewValue DATETIME2(0),
    @Reason NVARCHAR(500),
    @UserID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;
    EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;

    IF @Type IS NULL OR @Type NOT IN (1,2)
        THROW 52806, N'نوع تسوية الحضور غير صحيح.', 1;

    IF @NewValue IS NULL
        THROW 52807, N'القيمة الجديدة مطلوبة.', 1;

    IF NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@Reason)), N'') IS NULL
        THROW 52808, N'سبب التسوية مطلوب.', 1;

    IF NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1
        FROM dbo.Emp_AttendanceDaily
        WHERE AttDayCmp = @CmpID
          AND AttDayID = @AttDayID
    )
        THROW 52809, N'سجل الحضور اليومي غير موجود ضمن الشركة المحددة.', 1;

    IF NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1
        FROM dbo.Mng_User
        WHERE UsrID = @UserID
    )
        THROW 52810, N'المستخدم غير موجود.', 1;

    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;
    INSERT INTO dbo.Emp_AttendanceAdjustments
    (
        AttAdjCmp,
        AttAdjAttDayID,
        AttAdjType,
        AttAdjOldValue,
        AttAdjNewValue,
        AttAdjReason,
        AttAdjState,
        AttAdjUser
    )
    VALUES
    (
        @CmpID,
        @AttDayID,
        @Type,
        @OldValue,
        @NewValue,
        LTRIM(RTRIM(@Reason)),
        0,
        @UserID
    );

    DECLARE @AttAdjID BIGINT=CONVERT(bigint,SCOPE_IDENTITY());
    IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_ApprovalRouteSteps WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND ProcessType=10 AND RecordState=0)
        EXEC dbo.Emp_StartApproval @CmpID,10,@AttAdjID,@UserID,1;
    SELECT @AttAdjID AS AttAdjID,CAST(0 AS TINYINT) AS AttAdjState;
        COMMIT TRANSACTION;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        THROW;
    END CATCH;
END;GO

/* =========================================================
   5. SAVE ATTENDANCE DAILY
   ========================================================= */

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Emp_SaveAttendanceDaily]
    @CmpID INT,
    @EmpID BIGINT,
    @DayDate DATE,
    @FirstIn DATETIME2(0) = NULL,
    @LastOut DATETIME2(0) = NULL,
    @WorkMinutes INT = 0,
    @LateMinutes INT = 0,
    @EarlyLeaveMinutes INT = 0,
    @OvertimeMinutes INT = 0,
    @UserID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;
    EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;

    IF @DayDate IS NULL
        THROW 52705, N'تاريخ يوم الحضور مطلوب.', 1;

    IF @WorkMinutes IS NULL OR @WorkMinutes < 0
       OR @LateMinutes IS NULL OR @LateMinutes < 0
       OR @EarlyLeaveMinutes IS NULL OR @EarlyLeaveMinutes < 0
       OR @OvertimeMinutes IS NULL OR @OvertimeMinutes < 0
        THROW 52706, N'قيم دقائق الحضور لا يمكن أن تكون سالبة أو فارغة.', 1;

    IF @FirstIn IS NOT NULL
       AND @LastOut IS NOT NULL
       AND @LastOut < @FirstIn
        THROW 52707, N'وقت آخر انصراف لا يمكن أن يسبق أول حضور.', 1;

    IF NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1
        FROM dbo.Emp_Employee
        WHERE EmpCompany = @CmpID
          AND EmpID = @EmpID
    )
        THROW 52708, N'الموظف غير موجود ضمن الشركة المحددة.', 1;

    IF NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1
        FROM dbo.Mng_User
        WHERE UsrID = @UserID
    )
        THROW 52709, N'المستخدم غير موجود.', 1;

    IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_AttendanceDaily WHERE AttDayCmp=@CmpID AND AttDayEmpID=@EmpID AND AttDayDate=@DayDate AND AttDayState<>0)
        THROW 54325,N'لا يمكن تعديل يوم حضور مقفل؛ سجّل تسوية واعتمدها.',1;

    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;

        UPDATE dbo.Emp_AttendanceDaily WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
        SET
            AttDayFirstIn = @FirstIn,
            AttDayLastOut = @LastOut,
            AttDayWorkMinutes = @WorkMinutes,
            AttDayLateMinutes = @LateMinutes,
            AttDayEarlyLeaveMinutes = @EarlyLeaveMinutes,
            AttDayOvertimeMinutes = @OvertimeMinutes,
            AttDayDateTime = SYSDATETIME(),
            AttDayUser = @UserID
        WHERE AttDayCmp = @CmpID
          AND AttDayEmpID = @EmpID
          AND AttDayDate = @DayDate
          AND AttDayState = 0;

        IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO dbo.Emp_AttendanceDaily
            (
                AttDayCmp,
                AttDayEmpID,
                AttDayDate,
                AttDayFirstIn,
                AttDayLastOut,
                AttDayWorkMinutes,
                AttDayLateMinutes,
                AttDayEarlyLeaveMinutes,
                AttDayOvertimeMinutes,
                AttDayUser
            )
            VALUES
            (
                @CmpID,
                @EmpID,
                @DayDate,
                @FirstIn,
                @LastOut,
                @WorkMinutes,
                @LateMinutes,
                @EarlyLeaveMinutes,
                @OvertimeMinutes,
                @UserID
            );
        END;

        COMMIT TRANSACTION;

        SELECT
            AttDayID,
            AttDayCmp,
            AttDayEmpID,
            AttDayDate,
            AttDayState
        FROM dbo.Emp_AttendanceDaily
        WHERE AttDayCmp = @CmpID
          AND AttDayEmpID = @EmpID
          AND AttDayDate = @DayDate
          AND AttDayState = 0;

    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF XACT_STATE() <> 0
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;

        THROW;
    END CATCH;
END;

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Emp_SaveCandidate]
 @CmpID INT,@CandidateID BIGINT=0,@CandidateNo NVARCHAR(40)=NULL,@FullName NVARCHAR(200),@Phone NVARCHAR(40)=NULL,
 @Email NVARCHAR(254)=NULL,@NationalityID BIGINT=NULL,@BirthDate DATE=NULL,@SourceName NVARCHAR(150)=NULL,
 @CVPath NVARCHAR(1000)=NULL,@Notes NVARCHAR(1000)=NULL,@UserID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 IF NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@FullName)),N'') IS NULL THROW 54166,N'اسم المرشح مطلوب.',1;
 IF @CandidateID=0
 BEGIN
  INSERT dbo.Emp_Candidates(CmpID,CandidateNo,FullName,Phone,Email,NationalityID,BirthDate,SourceName,CVPath,Notes,CreatedBy)
  VALUES(@CmpID,@CandidateNo,@FullName,@Phone,@Email,@NationalityID,@BirthDate,@SourceName,@CVPath,@Notes,@UserID);
  SET @CandidateID=SCOPE_IDENTITY();
 END
 ELSE
 BEGIN
  UPDATE dbo.Emp_Candidates SET CandidateNo=@CandidateNo,FullName=@FullName,Phone=@Phone,Email=@Email,NationalityID=@NationalityID,BirthDate=@BirthDate,SourceName=@SourceName,CVPath=@CVPath,Notes=@Notes
  WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND CandidateID=@CandidateID AND CandidateState=0;
  IF @@ROWCOUNT=0 THROW 54167,N'المرشح غير موجود أو غير قابل للتعديل.',1;
 END;
 SELECT @CandidateID CandidateID;
END;

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Emp_SaveClearanceItem]
 @CmpID INT,@ClearanceID BIGINT=0,@TerminationID BIGINT,@ItemName NVARCHAR(200),@ResponsibleUser BIGINT=NULL,
 @ItemState TINYINT=0,@Notes NVARCHAR(500)=NULL,@UserID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 IF @ItemState NOT IN(0,1,2) THROW 54189,N'حالة إخلاء الطرف غير صحيحة.',1;
 IF @ClearanceID=0
 BEGIN
  INSERT dbo.Emp_ClearanceItems(CmpID,TerminationID,ItemName,ResponsibleUser,ItemState,CompletedAt,Notes)
  VALUES(@CmpID,@TerminationID,@ItemName,@ResponsibleUser,@ItemState,CASE WHEN @ItemState=1 THEN SYSDATETIME() END,@Notes);
  SET @ClearanceID=SCOPE_IDENTITY();
 END
 ELSE
 BEGIN
  UPDATE dbo.Emp_ClearanceItems SET ItemName=@ItemName,ResponsibleUser=@ResponsibleUser,ItemState=@ItemState,
   CompletedAt=CASE WHEN @ItemState=1 THEN SYSDATETIME() ELSE NULL END,Notes=@Notes
  WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND ClearanceID=@ClearanceID;
  IF @@ROWCOUNT=0 THROW 54190,N'بند إخلاء الطرف غير موجود.',1;
 END;
 SELECT @ClearanceID ClearanceID;
END;

GO

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Emp_SaveDocumentTypes]
    @DocTypeID    BIGINT = NULL,
    @DocTypeName  NVARCHAR(255),
    @DocTypeCmp   INT,
    @DocTypeState TINYINT = 0,
    @DocTypeUser  BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @DocTypeCmp,@DocTypeUser;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    SET @DocTypeName = LTRIM(RTRIM(@DocTypeName));

    IF NULLIF(@DocTypeName, N'') IS NULL
        THROW 50001, N'اسم نوع الوثيقة مطلوب.', 1;

    IF ISNULL(@DocTypeCmp, 0) <= 0
        THROW 50002, N'معرّف الشركة غير صحيح.', 1;

    IF ISNULL(@DocTypeUser, 0) <= 0
        THROW 50003, N'يجب تحديد المستخدم.', 1;

    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_Company WHERE CmpID = @DocTypeCmp)
        THROW 50004, N'الشركة غير موجودة.', 1;

    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_User WHERE UsrID = @DocTypeUser)
        THROW 50005, N'المستخدم غير موجود.', 1;

    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;

        IF ISNULL(@DocTypeID, 0) = 0
        BEGIN
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT 1
                FROM dbo.Emp_DocumentTypes WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
                WHERE DocTypeCmp = @DocTypeCmp
                  AND DocTypeName = @DocTypeName
            )
                THROW 50006, N'نوع الوثيقة مسجل مسبقاً لهذه الشركة.', 1;

            INSERT INTO dbo.Emp_DocumentTypes
            (
                DocTypeName,
                DocTypeCmp,
                DocTypeState,
                DocTypeDate,
                DocTypeUser
            )
            VALUES
            (
                @DocTypeName,
                @DocTypeCmp,
                @DocTypeState,
                SYSDATETIME(),
                @DocTypeUser
            );

            SET @DocTypeID = CONVERT(BIGINT, SCOPE_IDENTITY());
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            IF NOT EXISTS
            (
                SELECT 1
                FROM dbo.Emp_DocumentTypes WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
                WHERE DocTypeID = @DocTypeID
                  AND DocTypeCmp = @DocTypeCmp
            )
                THROW 50007, N'نوع الوثيقة غير موجود أو لا يتبع الشركة المحددة.', 1;

            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT 1
                FROM dbo.Emp_DocumentTypes WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
                WHERE DocTypeCmp = @DocTypeCmp
                  AND DocTypeName = @DocTypeName
                  AND DocTypeID <> @DocTypeID
            )
                THROW 50006, N'اسم نوع الوثيقة مستخدم مسبقاً لهذه الشركة.', 1;

            UPDATE dbo.Emp_DocumentTypes
            SET
                DocTypeName  = @DocTypeName,
                DocTypeState = @DocTypeState,
                DocTypeDate  = SYSDATETIME(),
                DocTypeUser  = @DocTypeUser
            WHERE DocTypeID = @DocTypeID
              AND DocTypeCmp = @DocTypeCmp;
        END;

        COMMIT TRANSACTION;

        SELECT
            CAST(1 AS BIT) AS Success,
            @DocTypeID AS DocTypeID;

    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF XACT_STATE() <> 0
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;

        THROW;
    END CATCH;
END;
GO
