CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Emp_SaveEmployee]
    @EmpID              BIGINT = NULL OUTPUT,
    @EmpCompany         INT,
    @EmpNum             NVARCHAR(10) = NULL,
    @EmpName            NVARCHAR(50),
    @PosID              BIGINT = NULL,
    @EmpPicPath         NVARCHAR(500) = NULL,
    @EmpState           TINYINT = 0,
    @EmpUser            BIGINT,
    @EmpGender          TINYINT = NULL,
    @EmpNat             BIGINT = NULL,
    @EmpBDate           DATE = NULL,
    @EmpBPlace          NVARCHAR(50) = NULL,
    @EmpSocial          TINYINT = NULL,
    @EmpCardNum         NVARCHAR(25) = NULL,
    @EmpQualification   BIGINT = NULL,
    @EmpPhone           NVARCHAR(15) = NULL,
    @EmpAddress         NVARCHAR(500) = NULL,
    @EmpNots            NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL,
    @HireDate DATE = NULL,@EmpEmail NVARCHAR(254)=NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @EmpCompany,@EmpUser;
    SET XACT_ABORT OFF;

    IF XACT_STATE() = -1
        THROW 50069, N'المعاملة الحالية غير قابلة للاستمرار، لا يمكن متابعة الحفظ.', 1;

    SET @EmpNum        = NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@EmpNum)), N'');
    SET @EmpName       = NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@EmpName)), N'');
    SET @EmpPicPath    = NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@EmpPicPath)), N'');
    SET @EmpBPlace     = NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@EmpBPlace)), N'');
    SET @EmpCardNum    = NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@EmpCardNum)), N'');
    SET @EmpPhone      = NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@EmpPhone)), N'');
    SET @EmpAddress    = NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@EmpAddress)), N'');
    SET @EmpNots       = NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@EmpNots)), N'');
    SET @EmpEmail = NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@EmpEmail)),N'');

    IF @EmpID IS NOT NULL AND @EmpID < 0
        THROW 50068, N'معرف الموظف غير صالح.', 1;
    IF @EmpCompany IS NULL OR @EmpCompany <= 0
        THROW 50060, N'معرف الشركة غير صالح أو غير مدخل.', 1;
    IF @EmpName IS NULL
        THROW 50061, N'اسم الموظف إلزامي.', 1;
    IF @EmpUser IS NULL OR @EmpUser <= 0
        THROW 50062, N'معرف المستخدم غير صالح أو مفقود.', 1;
    IF @EmpState IS NULL OR @EmpState NOT IN (0, 1)
        THROW 50070, N'حالة الموظف غير صالحة.', 1;
    IF @EmpGender IS NOT NULL AND @EmpGender NOT IN (1, 2)
        THROW 50071, N'قيمة الجنس غير صالحة.', 1;
    IF @EmpSocial IS NOT NULL AND @EmpSocial NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 4
        THROW 50072, N'قيمة الحالة الاجتماعية غير صالحة.', 1;
    IF @EmpBDate IS NOT NULL AND (@EmpBDate < '19000101' OR @EmpBDate > CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE))
        THROW 50073, N'تاريخ الميلاد غير منطقي.', 1;
    IF @HireDate IS NOT NULL AND (@HireDate < '19000101' OR @HireDate > CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE))
        THROW 50077, N'تاريخ مباشرة العمل غير منطقي.', 1;

    DECLARE @TranStarted INT = 0;
    DECLARE @OldPos BIGINT = NULL, @OldNat BIGINT = NULL, @OldQual BIGINT = NULL;
    DECLARE @HasPersonal BIT = 0;

    BEGIN TRY
        IF @@TRANCOUNT = 0
        BEGIN
            BEGIN TRANSACTION;
            SET @TranStarted = 1;
        END
        ELSE
            SAVE TRANSACTION SavePoint_SaveEmployee;

        IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_Company WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) WHERE CmpID = @EmpCompany)
            THROW 50066, N'الشركة غير مسجلة.', 1;
        IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_User WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) WHERE UsrID = @EmpUser AND UsrState=0 AND UsrCompany=@EmpCompany)
            THROW 50067, N'مستخدم النظام غير مسجل.', 1;

        IF @EmpID IS NOT NULL AND @EmpID > 0
        BEGIN
            SELECT @OldPos = PosID
            FROM dbo.Emp_Employee WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
            WHERE EmpID = @EmpID AND EmpCompany = @EmpCompany;

            IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0
                THROW 50065, N'الموظف غير موجود في نطاق هذه الشركة.', 1;

            SELECT @OldNat = EmpNat, @OldQual = EmpQualification, @HasPersonal = 1
            FROM dbo.Emp_PersonalDetails WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
            WHERE EmpID = @EmpID AND EmpCompany = @EmpCompany;
        END

        IF @PosID IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_Position WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
            WHERE PosID = @PosID AND PosCmp = @EmpCompany
              AND (PosState = 0 OR PosID = @OldPos))
            THROW 50063, N'المنصب غير موجود أو لا يتبع لهذه الشركة أو معطّل.', 1;

        IF @EmpNat IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_Nationality WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
            WHERE NatID = @EmpNat AND NatCmp = @EmpCompany
              AND (NatState = 0 OR NatID = @OldNat))
            THROW 50074, N'الجنسية غير موجودة أو لا تتبع لهذه الشركة أو معطّلة.', 1;

        IF @EmpQualification IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_EducationalQualifications WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
            WHERE EduQualID = @EmpQualification AND EduQualCmp = @EmpCompany
              AND (EduQualState = 0 OR EduQualID = @OldQual))
            THROW 50075, N'المؤهل العلمي غير موجود أو لا يتبع لهذه الشركة أو معطّل.', 1;

        IF @EmpNum IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_Employee WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
            WHERE EmpCompany = @EmpCompany AND EmpNum = @EmpNum
              AND (@EmpID IS NULL OR @EmpID = 0 OR EmpID <> @EmpID))
            THROW 50064, N'رقم الموظف مستخدم لموظف آخر في هذه الشركة.', 1;

        IF @EmpCardNum IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_PersonalDetails WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
            WHERE EmpCompany = @EmpCompany AND EmpCardNum = @EmpCardNum
              AND (@EmpID IS NULL OR @EmpID = 0 OR EmpID <> @EmpID))
            THROW 50076, N'رقم الهوية مستخدم لموظف آخر في هذه الشركة.', 1;

        IF @EmpID IS NOT NULL AND @EmpID > 0
        BEGIN
            UPDATE dbo.Emp_Employee
            SET EmpNum      = @EmpNum,
                EmpName     = @EmpName,
                PosID       = @PosID,
                EmpPicPath  = COALESCE(@EmpPicPath, EmpPicPath),
                EmpState    = @EmpState,
                HireDate = COALESCE(@HireDate, HireDate),
                EmpUser     = @EmpUser,
                EmpDateTime = GETDATE()
            WHERE EmpID = @EmpID AND EmpCompany = @EmpCompany;
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            INSERT dbo.Emp_Employee
                (EmpCompany, EmpNum, EmpName, PosID, EmpPicPath, EmpState, HireDate, EmpUser, EmpDateTime)
            VALUES
                (@EmpCompany, @EmpNum, @EmpName, @PosID, @EmpPicPath, @EmpState, @HireDate, @EmpUser, GETDATE());

            SET @EmpID = SCOPE_IDENTITY();
        END

        IF @HasPersonal = 1
        BEGIN
            UPDATE dbo.Emp_PersonalDetails
            SET EmpGender = @EmpGender, EmpNat = @EmpNat, EmpBDate = @EmpBDate,
                EmpBPlace = @EmpBPlace, EmpSocial = @EmpSocial, EmpCardNum = @EmpCardNum,
                EmpQualification = @EmpQualification, EmpPhone = @EmpPhone, EmpEmail=@EmpEmail,
                EmpAddress = @EmpAddress, EmpNots = @EmpNots,
                EmpUser = @EmpUser, EmpDateTime = GETDATE()
            WHERE EmpID = @EmpID AND EmpCompany = @EmpCompany;
        END
        ELSE IF COALESCE(@EmpGender, @EmpSocial) IS NOT NULL
             OR COALESCE(@EmpNat, @EmpQualification) IS NOT NULL
             OR @EmpBDate IS NOT NULL
             OR COALESCE(@EmpBPlace, @EmpCardNum, @EmpPhone, @EmpAddress, @EmpNots) IS NOT NULL OR @EmpEmail IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            INSERT dbo.Emp_PersonalDetails
                (EmpCompany, EmpID, EmpGender, EmpNat, EmpBDate, EmpBPlace, EmpSocial,
                 EmpCardNum, EmpQualification, EmpPhone, EmpEmail, EmpAddress, EmpNots, EmpUser, EmpDateTime)
            VALUES
                (@EmpCompany, @EmpID, @EmpGender, @EmpNat, @EmpBDate, @EmpBPlace, @EmpSocial,
                 @EmpCardNum, @EmpQualification, @EmpPhone, @EmpEmail, @EmpAddress, @EmpNots, @EmpUser, GETDATE());
        END

        IF @TranStarted = 1
        BEGIN
            COMMIT TRANSACTION;
            SET @TranStarted = 0;
        END
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @TranStarted = 1
        BEGIN
            IF XACT_STATE() <> 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        END
        ELSE IF XACT_STATE() = 1
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION SavePoint_SaveEmployee;

        THROW;
    END CATCH
END;
GO

/* ================================================================
   11. EMPLOYEE DOCUMENTS - SAVE/SELECT/STATE
   ================================================================ */
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Emp_SaveEmployeeDocument]
 @CmpID INT,@DocumentID BIGINT=0,@EmployeeID BIGINT,@DocumentTypeID BIGINT,
 @DocumentNo NVARCHAR(100)=NULL,@IssueDate DATE=NULL,@ExpiryDate DATE=NULL,
 @Issuer NVARCHAR(255)=NULL,@FilePath NVARCHAR(1000)=NULL,@FileName NVARCHAR(260)=NULL,
 @MimeType NVARCHAR(150)=NULL,@FileSize BIGINT=NULL,@Notes NVARCHAR(1000)=NULL,@UserID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON;
 EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_Employee WHERE EmpCompany=@CmpID AND EmpID=@EmployeeID) THROW 54102,N'الموظف لا يتبع للشركة.',1;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_DocumentTypes WHERE DocTypeCmp=@CmpID AND DocTypeID=@DocumentTypeID AND DocTypeState=0) THROW 54103,N'نوع المستند غير صالح أو غير نشط.',1;
 IF @ExpiryDate IS NOT NULL AND @IssueDate IS NOT NULL AND @ExpiryDate<@IssueDate THROW 54104,N'تاريخ الانتهاء يسبق تاريخ الإصدار.',1;
 BEGIN TRY
  BEGIN TRAN;
 IF ISNULL(@DocumentID,0)=0
 BEGIN
  INSERT dbo.Emp_EmployeeDocuments(CmpID,EmployeeID,DocumentTypeID,DocumentNo,IssueDate,ExpiryDate,Issuer,FilePath,FileName,MimeType,FileSize,Notes,CreatedBy)
  VALUES(@CmpID,@EmployeeID,@DocumentTypeID,@DocumentNo,@IssueDate,@ExpiryDate,@Issuer,@FilePath,@FileName,@MimeType,@FileSize,@Notes,@UserID);
  SET @DocumentID=SCOPE_IDENTITY();
 END
 ELSE
 BEGIN
  UPDATE dbo.Emp_EmployeeDocuments WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK)
   SET DocumentTypeID=@DocumentTypeID,DocumentNo=@DocumentNo,IssueDate=@IssueDate,ExpiryDate=@ExpiryDate,Issuer=@Issuer,
       FilePath=@FilePath,FileName=@FileName,MimeType=@MimeType,FileSize=@FileSize,Notes=@Notes
   WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND DocumentID=@DocumentID AND RecordState=0;
  IF @@ROWCOUNT=0 THROW 54105,N'المستند غير موجود أو غير قابل للتعديل.',1;
 END;
  COMMIT;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH
  IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
  THROW;
 END CATCH;
 SELECT @DocumentID AS DocumentID;
END;

GO

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Emp_SaveEmployeePayComponent]
 @CmpID INT,@EmployeeComponentID BIGINT=0,@EmployeeID BIGINT,@ComponentID BIGINT,@Amount DECIMAL(15,3),
 @StartDate DATE,@EndDate DATE=NULL,@UserID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 IF @Amount<0 OR (@EndDate IS NOT NULL AND @EndDate<@StartDate) THROW 54161,N'قيمة أو فترة مكون الراتب غير صحيحة.',1;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_Employee WHERE EmpCompany=@CmpID AND EmpID=@EmployeeID) THROW 54162,N'الموظف لا يتبع للشركة.',1;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_PayComponents WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND ComponentID=@ComponentID AND RecordState=0) THROW 54163,N'مكون الراتب غير نشط أو غير موجود.',1;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_EmployeePayComponents WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND EmployeeID=@EmployeeID AND ComponentID=@ComponentID AND RecordState=0
  AND StartDate<=ISNULL(@EndDate,'99991231') AND ISNULL(EndDate,'99991231')>=@StartDate AND (@EmployeeComponentID=0 OR EmployeeComponentID<>@EmployeeComponentID))
  THROW 54164,N'تتداخل فترة مكون الراتب مع فترة أخرى للموظف.',1;
 IF @EmployeeComponentID=0
 BEGIN
  INSERT dbo.Emp_EmployeePayComponents(CmpID,EmployeeID,ComponentID,Amount,StartDate,EndDate,CreatedBy)
  VALUES(@CmpID,@EmployeeID,@ComponentID,@Amount,@StartDate,@EndDate,@UserID);
  SET @EmployeeComponentID=SCOPE_IDENTITY();
 END
 ELSE
 BEGIN
  UPDATE dbo.Emp_EmployeePayComponents SET Amount=@Amount,StartDate=@StartDate,EndDate=@EndDate
  WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND EmployeeComponentID=@EmployeeComponentID AND EmployeeID=@EmployeeID AND ComponentID=@ComponentID AND RecordState=0;
  IF @@ROWCOUNT=0 THROW 54165,N'مكون الموظف غير موجود أو غير قابل للتعديل.',1;
 END;
 SELECT @EmployeeComponentID EmployeeComponentID;
END;

GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Emp_SaveEmployeeSchedule]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Emp_SaveEmployeeSchedule]
    @SchID        BIGINT = NULL OUTPUT,
    @SchCmp       INT,
    @SchEmpID     BIGINT,
    @SchWCalID    BIGINT,
    @SchStartDate DATE,
    @SchEndDate   DATE = NULL,
    @SchState     TINYINT = 1,
    @SchUser      BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
    SET XACT_ABORT OFF;

    IF ISNULL(@SchCmp, 0) <= 0
        THROW 50201, N'يجب تحديد الشركة بشكل صحيح.', 1;

    IF ISNULL(@SchEmpID, 0) <= 0
        THROW 50202, N'معرّف الموظف غير صحيح.', 1;

    IF ISNULL(@SchWCalID, 0) <= 0
        THROW 50203, N'معرّف التقويم غير صحيح.', 1;

    IF @SchStartDate IS NULL
        THROW 50204, N'تاريخ بداية التطبيق مطلوب.', 1;

    IF @SchEndDate IS NOT NULL AND @SchEndDate < @SchStartDate
        THROW 50205, N'تاريخ النهاية لا يمكن أن يسبق تاريخ البداية.', 1;

    IF @SchState IS NULL OR @SchState NOT IN (0, 1)
        THROW 50206, N'حالة الربط غير صالحة.', 1;

    IF ISNULL(@SchUser, 0) <= 0
        THROW 50207, N'يجب تحديد المستخدم.', 1;

    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_Company WHERE CmpID = @SchCmp)
        THROW 50208, N'الشركة غير موجودة.', 1;

    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_User WHERE UsrID = @SchUser)
        THROW 50209, N'المستخدم غير موجود.', 1;

    IF NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1
        FROM dbo.Emp_Employee
        WHERE EmpID = @SchEmpID
          AND EmpCompany = @SchCmp
    )
        THROW 50210, N'الموظف غير موجود أو لا يتبع للشركة.', 1;

    IF NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1
        FROM dbo.Emp_WorkCalendar
        WHERE WCalID = @SchWCalID
          AND WCalCmp = @SchCmp
          AND @SchStartDate >= WCalStartDate
          AND
          (
              @SchEndDate IS NULL
              OR @SchEndDate <= WCalEndDate
          )
    )
        THROW 50211, N'التقويم غير موجود أو فترة الربط خارج فترة التقويم.', 1;

    DECLARE @TranStarted BIT = 0;

    BEGIN TRY
        IF @@TRANCOUNT = 0
        BEGIN
            BEGIN TRANSACTION;
            SET @TranStarted = 1;
        END
        ELSE
            SAVE TRANSACTION SaveEmpSch;

        IF @SchState = 1
        BEGIN
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT 1
                FROM dbo.Emp_EmployeeSchedule WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
                WHERE SchCmp = @SchCmp
                  AND SchEmpID = @SchEmpID
                  AND SchState = 1
                  AND SchID <> ISNULL(@SchID, 0)
                  AND SchStartDate <= ISNULL(@SchEndDate, CONVERT(DATE, '99991231'))
                  AND
                  (
                      SchEndDate IS NULL
                      OR SchEndDate >= @SchStartDate
                  )
            )
                THROW 50212, N'توجد فترة تقويم أخرى متداخلة للموظف.', 1;
        END;

        IF ISNULL(@SchID, 0) <= 0
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO dbo.Emp_EmployeeSchedule
            (
                SchCmp, SchEmpID, SchWCalID,
                SchStartDate, SchEndDate, SchState,
                SchDateTime, SchUser
            )
            VALUES
            (
                @SchCmp, @SchEmpID, @SchWCalID,
                @SchStartDate, @SchEndDate, @SchState,
                SYSDATETIME(), @SchUser
            );

            SET @SchID = CONVERT(BIGINT, SCOPE_IDENTITY());
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            UPDATE dbo.Emp_EmployeeSchedule
            SET
                SchWCalID = @SchWCalID,
                SchStartDate = @SchStartDate,
                SchEndDate = @SchEndDate,
                SchState = @SchState,
                SchDateTime = SYSDATETIME(),
                SchUser = @SchUser
            WHERE SchID = @SchID
              AND SchCmp = @SchCmp
              AND SchEmpID = @SchEmpID;

            IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0
                THROW 50213, N'ربط الموظف بالتقويم غير موجود.', 1;
        END;

        IF @TranStarted = 1
            COMMIT TRANSACTION;

        SELECT CAST(1 AS BIT) AS Success, @SchID AS SchID;

    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @TranStarted = 1 AND XACT_STATE() <> 0
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        ELSE IF @TranStarted = 0 AND XACT_STATE() = 1
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION SaveEmpSch;

        THROW;
    END CATCH
END;
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Emp_SaveEmploymentTypes]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Emp_SaveEmploymentTypes]
    @EmpTypeID    BIGINT = NULL,
    @EmpTypeName  NVARCHAR(255),
    @EmpTypeCmp   INT,
    @EmpTypeState TINYINT = 0,
    @EmpTypeUser  BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @EmpTypeCmp,@EmpTypeUser;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    SET @EmpTypeName = LTRIM(RTRIM(@EmpTypeName));

    IF NULLIF(@EmpTypeName, N'') IS NULL
        THROW 50001, N'اسم نوع التعيين مطلوب.', 1;

    IF ISNULL(@EmpTypeCmp, 0) <= 0
        THROW 50002, N'معرّف الشركة غير صحيح.', 1;

    IF ISNULL(@EmpTypeUser, 0) <= 0
        THROW 50003, N'يجب تحديد المستخدم.', 1;

    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_Company WHERE CmpID = @EmpTypeCmp)
        THROW 50004, N'الشركة غير موجودة.', 1;

    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_User WHERE UsrID = @EmpTypeUser)
        THROW 50005, N'المستخدم غير موجود.', 1;

    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;

        IF ISNULL(@EmpTypeID, 0) = 0
        BEGIN
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT 1
                FROM dbo.Emp_EmploymentTypes WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
                WHERE EmpTypeCmp = @EmpTypeCmp
                  AND EmpTypeName = @EmpTypeName
            )
                THROW 50006, N'نوع التعيين مسجل مسبقاً لهذه الشركة.', 1;

            INSERT INTO dbo.Emp_EmploymentTypes
            (
                EmpTypeName,
                EmpTypeCmp,
                EmpTypeState,
                EmpTypeDate,
                EmpTypeUser
            )
            VALUES
            (
                @EmpTypeName,
                @EmpTypeCmp,
                @EmpTypeState,
                SYSDATETIME(),
                @EmpTypeUser
            );

            SET @EmpTypeID = CONVERT(BIGINT, SCOPE_IDENTITY());
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            IF NOT EXISTS
            (
                SELECT 1
                FROM dbo.Emp_EmploymentTypes WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
                WHERE EmpTypeID = @EmpTypeID
                  AND EmpTypeCmp = @EmpTypeCmp
            )
                THROW 50007, N'نوع التعيين غير موجود أو لا يتبع الشركة المحددة.', 1;

            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT 1
                FROM dbo.Emp_EmploymentTypes WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
                WHERE EmpTypeCmp = @EmpTypeCmp
                  AND EmpTypeName = @EmpTypeName
                  AND EmpTypeID <> @EmpTypeID
            )
                THROW 50006, N'اسم نوع التعيين مستخدم مسبقاً لهذه الشركة.', 1;

            UPDATE dbo.Emp_EmploymentTypes
            SET
                EmpTypeName  = @EmpTypeName,
                EmpTypeState = @EmpTypeState,
                EmpTypeDate  = SYSDATETIME(),
                EmpTypeUser  = @EmpTypeUser
            WHERE EmpTypeID = @EmpTypeID
              AND EmpTypeCmp = @EmpTypeCmp;
        END;

        COMMIT TRANSACTION;

        SELECT
            CAST(1 AS BIT) AS Success,
            @EmpTypeID AS EmpTypeID;

    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF XACT_STATE() <> 0
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;

        THROW;
    END CATCH;
END;
GO

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Emp_SaveFinalSettlement]
 @CmpID INT,@TerminationID BIGINT,@CurrencyID BIGINT,@GrossEntitlements DECIMAL(19,3),@Deductions DECIMAL(19,3),
 @CalculationDetails NVARCHAR(MAX)=NULL,@UserID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 IF @GrossEntitlements<0 OR @Deductions<0 THROW 54191,N'مبالغ التسوية لا يمكن أن تكون سالبة.',1;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Acc_Currency WHERE CurCmp=@CmpID AND CurID=@CurrencyID AND CurState=0) THROW 54194,N'عملة التسوية غير صالحة للشركة.',1;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_ClearanceItems WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND TerminationID=@TerminationID AND ItemState<>1)
  THROW 54192,N'لا يمكن حفظ التسوية قبل اكتمال جميع بنود إخلاء الطرف.',1;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_FinalSettlements WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND TerminationID=@TerminationID AND SettlementState<>0)
  THROW 54193,N'التسوية ليست في حالة مسودة ولا تقبل التعديل.',1;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_FinalSettlements WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND TerminationID=@TerminationID)
  UPDATE dbo.Emp_FinalSettlements SET CurrencyID=@CurrencyID,GrossEntitlements=@GrossEntitlements,Deductions=@Deductions,CalculationDetails=@CalculationDetails,CalculatedAt=SYSDATETIME(),CalculatedBy=@UserID
  WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND TerminationID=@TerminationID AND SettlementState=0;
 ELSE
  INSERT dbo.Emp_FinalSettlements(CmpID,TerminationID,CurrencyID,GrossEntitlements,Deductions,CalculationDetails,CalculatedBy)
  VALUES(@CmpID,@TerminationID,@CurrencyID,@GrossEntitlements,@Deductions,@CalculationDetails,@UserID);
 SELECT SettlementID,NetAmount FROM dbo.Emp_FinalSettlements WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND TerminationID=@TerminationID;
END;

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Emp_SaveJobApplication]
 @CmpID INT,@ApplicationID BIGINT=0,@CandidateID BIGINT,@PositionID BIGINT=NULL,@InterviewAt DATETIME2(0)=NULL,
 @InterviewResult TINYINT=NULL,@OfferDate DATE=NULL,@OfferAmount DECIMAL(15,3)=NULL,@OfferCurrencyID BIGINT=NULL,
 @OfferExpiry DATE=NULL,@ApplicationState TINYINT=0,@Notes NVARCHAR(1000)=NULL,@UserID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_Candidates WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND CandidateID=@CandidateID AND CandidateState=0) THROW 54168,N'المرشح غير نشط أو لا يتبع للشركة.',1;
 IF @OfferAmount<0 OR (@OfferExpiry IS NOT NULL AND @OfferDate IS NOT NULL AND @OfferExpiry<@OfferDate) THROW 54169,N'بيانات عرض العمل غير صحيحة.',1;
 IF @OfferCurrencyID IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Acc_Currency WHERE CurCmp=@CmpID AND CurID=@OfferCurrencyID AND CurState=0) THROW 54170,N'عملة العرض غير صالحة للشركة.',1;
 IF @ApplicationID=0

  INSERT dbo.Emp_JobApplications(CmpID,CandidateID,PositionID,InterviewAt,InterviewResult,OfferDate,OfferAmount,OfferCurrencyID,OfferExpiry,ApplicationState,Notes,CreatedBy)
  VALUES(@CmpID,@CandidateID,@PositionID,@InterviewAt,@InterviewResult,@OfferDate,@OfferAmount,@OfferCurrencyID,@OfferExpiry,@ApplicationState,@Notes,@UserID);

 END

   OfferAmount=@OfferAmount,OfferCurrencyID=@OfferCurrencyID,OfferExpiry=@OfferExpiry,ApplicationState=@ApplicationState,Notes=@Notes
  WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND ApplicationID=@ApplicationID AND ApplicationState=0;
  IF @@ROWCOUNT=0 THROW 54171,N'طلب التوظيف غير موجود أو نهائي.',1;
 END;
 SELECT @ApplicationID ApplicationID;
END;

SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Emp_SaveJobTitles]
    @EmpJobID BIGINT = NULL,
    @EmpJobCompany INT,
    @EmpJobName NVARCHAR(255),
    @EmpJobState TINYINT = 0,
    @EmpJobUser BIGINT = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @EmpJobCompany,@EmpJobUser;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    SET @EmpJobName = LTRIM(RTRIM(@EmpJobName));

    IF NULLIF(@EmpJobName, N'') IS NULL
        THROW 50001, N'اسم الوظيفة مطلوب.', 1;

    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_Company WHERE CmpID = @EmpJobCompany)
        THROW 50002, N'الشركة غير موجودة.', 1;

    IF @EmpJobUser IS NOT NULL
       AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_User WHERE UsrID = @EmpJobUser)
        THROW 50003, N'المستخدم غير موجود.', 1;

    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM dbo.Emp_JobTitles
        WHERE EmpJobCompany = @EmpJobCompany
          AND EmpJobName = @EmpJobName
          AND (@EmpJobID IS NULL OR EmpJobID <> @EmpJobID)
    )
        THROW 50004, N'المسمى الوظيفي موجود مسبقاً في الشركة.', 1;

    IF @EmpJobID IS NULL
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO dbo.Emp_JobTitles
        (
            EmpJobCompany,
            EmpJobName,
            EmpJobState,
            EmpJobUser
        )
        VALUES
        (
            @EmpJobCompany,
            @EmpJobName,
            @EmpJobState,
            @EmpJobUser
        );

        SELECT CONVERT(BIGINT, SCOPE_IDENTITY()) AS EmpJobID;
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        IF NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM dbo.Emp_JobTitles
            WHERE EmpJobID = @EmpJobID
              AND EmpJobCompany = @EmpJobCompany
        )
            THROW 50005, N'المسمى الوظيفي غير موجود في الشركة المحددة.', 1;

        UPDATE dbo.Emp_JobTitles
        SET EmpJobName = @EmpJobName,
            EmpJobState = @EmpJobState
        WHERE EmpJobID = @EmpJobID
          AND EmpJobCompany = @EmpJobCompany;

        SELECT @EmpJobID AS EmpJobID;
    END
END;
GO

   12. LEAVE BALANCES AND REQUEST WORKFLOW

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Emp_SaveLeaveBalance]
 @CmpID INT,@EmployeeID BIGINT,@LeaveTypeID BIGINT,@BalanceYear SMALLINT,
 @OpeningBalance DECIMAL(9,2)=0,@Earned DECIMAL(9,2)=0,@Adjusted DECIMAL(9,2)=0,@UserID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 IF @BalanceYear NOT BETWEEN 1900 AND 9999 OR @OpeningBalance<0 OR @Earned<0 THROW 54110,N'بيانات رصيد الإجازة غير صحيحة.',1;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_Employee WHERE EmpCompany=@CmpID AND EmpID=@EmployeeID) THROW 54111,N'الموظف لا يتبع للشركة.',1;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_LeaveTypes WHERE LeaveTypeCmp=@CmpID AND LeaveTypeID=@LeaveTypeID AND LeaveTypeState=0) THROW 54112,N'نوع الإجازة غير صالح.',1;
 BEGIN TRY
  BEGIN TRAN;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_LeaveBalances WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND EmployeeID=@EmployeeID AND LeaveTypeID=@LeaveTypeID AND BalanceYear=@BalanceYear)
  UPDATE dbo.Emp_LeaveBalances SET OpeningBalance=@OpeningBalance,Earned=@Earned,Adjusted=@Adjusted,RecordState=0
  WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND EmployeeID=@EmployeeID AND LeaveTypeID=@LeaveTypeID AND BalanceYear=@BalanceYear;
 ELSE
  INSERT dbo.Emp_LeaveBalances(CmpID,EmployeeID,LeaveTypeID,BalanceYear,OpeningBalance,Earned,Adjusted,CreatedBy)
  VALUES(@CmpID,@EmployeeID,@LeaveTypeID,@BalanceYear,@OpeningBalance,@Earned,@Adjusted,@UserID);
  COMMIT;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH
  IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
  THROW;
 END CATCH;
 SELECT BalanceID,ClosingBalance FROM dbo.Emp_LeaveBalances WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND EmployeeID=@EmployeeID AND LeaveTypeID=@LeaveTypeID AND BalanceYear=@BalanceYear;
END;

GO

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Emp_SaveLeaveRequest]
 @CmpID INT,@RequestID BIGINT=0,@EmployeeID BIGINT,@LeaveTypeID BIGINT,
 @StartAt DATETIME2(0),@EndAt DATETIME2(0),@Quantity DECIMAL(9,2),@IsHourly BIT=0,
 @Reason NVARCHAR(1000)=NULL,@AttachmentPath NVARCHAR(1000)=NULL,@UserID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 IF @EndAt<=@StartAt OR @Quantity<=0 THROW 54113,N'فترة أو كمية الإجازة غير صحيحة.',1;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_Employee WHERE EmpCompany=@CmpID AND EmpID=@EmployeeID) THROW 54114,N'الموظف لا يتبع للشركة.',1;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_LeaveTypes WHERE LeaveTypeCmp=@CmpID AND LeaveTypeID=@LeaveTypeID AND LeaveTypeState=0 AND ((@IsHourly=0 AND LeaveTypeBalanceUnit=1) OR (@IsHourly=1 AND LeaveTypeAllowHourly=1 AND LeaveTypeBalanceUnit=2))) THROW 54115,N'نوع الإجازة أو وحدة رصيده لا تتوافق مع طلب الإجازة.',1;
 IF YEAR(@StartAt)<>YEAR(@EndAt) THROW 54123,N'قسّم طلب الإجازة على السنوات المالية حتى يُخصم كل جزء من رصيده الصحيح.',1;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_LeaveRequests WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND EmployeeID=@EmployeeID AND RequestState IN(0,1,2) AND @StartAt<EndAt AND @EndAt>StartAt AND (@RequestID=0 OR RequestID<>@RequestID))
  THROW 54116,N'توجد إجازة أخرى متداخلة للموظف.',1;
 IF @RequestID=0
 BEGIN
  INSERT dbo.Emp_LeaveRequests(CmpID,EmployeeID,LeaveTypeID,StartAt,EndAt,Quantity,IsHourly,Reason,AttachmentPath,CreatedBy)
  VALUES(@CmpID,@EmployeeID,@LeaveTypeID,@StartAt,@EndAt,@Quantity,@IsHourly,@Reason,@AttachmentPath,@UserID);
  SET @RequestID=SCOPE_IDENTITY();
 END
 ELSE
 BEGIN
  UPDATE dbo.Emp_LeaveRequests SET LeaveTypeID=@LeaveTypeID,StartAt=@StartAt,EndAt=@EndAt,Quantity=@Quantity,IsHourly=@IsHourly,Reason=@Reason,AttachmentPath=@AttachmentPath
  WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND RequestID=@RequestID AND EmployeeID=@EmployeeID AND RequestState=0;
  IF @@ROWCOUNT=0 THROW 54117,N'الطلب غير موجود أو لم يعد في حالة المسودة.',1;
 END;
 SELECT @RequestID AS RequestID;
END;

GO

 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Acc_Currency WHERE CurCmp=@CmpID AND CurID=@CurrencyID AND CurState=0) THROW 54175,N'عملة السلفة غير صالحة للشركة.',1;
 IF @Principal<=0 OR @InstallmentCount<=0 OR @InstallmentAmount<=0 OR @InstallmentIntervalDays<=0 OR @InterestAmount<0 THROW 54176,N'قيم السلفة أو الأقساط غير صحيحة.',1;
 IF @LoanID=0
 BEGIN
  INSERT dbo.Emp_Loans(CmpID,EmployeeID,LoanNo,Principal,CurrencyID,StartDate,InstallmentCount,InstallmentAmount,InstallmentIntervalDays,InterestAmount,CreatedBy)
  VALUES(@CmpID,@EmployeeID,@LoanNo,@Principal,@CurrencyID,@StartDate,@InstallmentCount,@InstallmentAmount,@InstallmentIntervalDays,@InterestAmount,@UserID);
  SET @LoanID=SCOPE_IDENTITY();
 END
 ELSE
 BEGIN
  UPDATE dbo.Emp_Loans SET LoanNo=@LoanNo,Principal=@Principal,CurrencyID=@CurrencyID,StartDate=@StartDate,InstallmentCount=@InstallmentCount,InstallmentAmount=@InstallmentAmount,InstallmentIntervalDays=@InstallmentIntervalDays,InterestAmount=@InterestAmount
  WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND LoanID=@LoanID AND EmployeeID=@EmployeeID AND LoanState=0;
  IF @@ROWCOUNT=0 THROW 54177,N'طلب السلفة غير موجود أو غير قابل للتعديل.',1;
 END;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_ApprovalRouteSteps WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND ProcessType=4 AND RecordState=0) EXEC dbo.Emp_StartApproval @CmpID,4,@LoanID,@UserID,1;

SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Emp_SaveNationality]
    @NatID    BIGINT = NULL,
    @NatName  NVARCHAR(255),
    @NatCmp   INT,
    @NatState TINYINT = 0,
    @NatUser  BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @NatCmp,@NatUser;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    SET @NatName = LTRIM(RTRIM(@NatName));

    IF NULLIF(@NatName, N'') IS NULL
        THROW 50001, N'اسم الجنسية مطلوب.', 1;

    IF ISNULL(@NatCmp, 0) <= 0
        THROW 50002, N'معرّف الشركة غير صحيح.', 1;

    IF ISNULL(@NatUser, 0) <= 0
        THROW 50003, N'يجب تحديد المستخدم.', 1;

    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_Company WHERE CmpID = @NatCmp)
        THROW 50004, N'الشركة غير موجودة.', 1;

    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_User WHERE UsrID = @NatUser)
        THROW 50005, N'المستخدم غير موجود.', 1;

    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;

        IF ISNULL(@NatID, 0) = 0
        BEGIN
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT 1
                FROM dbo.Emp_Nationality WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
                WHERE NatCmp = @NatCmp
                  AND NatName = @NatName
            )
                THROW 50006, N'الجنسية مسجلة مسبقاً لهذه الشركة.', 1;

            INSERT INTO dbo.Emp_Nationality
            (
                NatName,
                NatCmp,
                NatState,
                NatDate,
                NatUser
            )
            VALUES
            (
                @NatName,
                @NatCmp,
                @NatState,
                SYSDATETIME(),
                @NatUser
            );

            SET @NatID = CONVERT(BIGINT, SCOPE_IDENTITY());
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            IF NOT EXISTS
            (
                SELECT 1
                FROM dbo.Emp_Nationality WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
                WHERE NatID = @NatID
                  AND NatCmp = @NatCmp
            )
                THROW 50007, N'الجنسية غير موجودة أو لا تتبع الشركة المحددة.', 1;

            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT 1
                FROM dbo.Emp_Nationality WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
                WHERE NatCmp = @NatCmp
                  AND NatName = @NatName
                  AND NatID <> @NatID
            )
                THROW 50006, N'اسم الجنسية مستخدم مسبقاً لهذه الشركة.', 1;

            UPDATE dbo.Emp_Nationality
            SET
                NatName  = @NatName,
                NatState = @NatState,
                NatDate  = SYSDATETIME(),
                NatUser  = @NatUser
            WHERE NatID = @NatID
              AND NatCmp = @NatCmp;
        END;

        COMMIT TRANSACTION;

        SELECT
            CAST(1 AS BIT) AS Success,
            @NatID AS NatID;

    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF XACT_STATE() <> 0
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;

        THROW;
    END CATCH;
END;
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Emp_SaveOrganigramStructure]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Emp_SaveOrganigramStructure]
    @EmpOrgStrID BIGINT = NULL,
    @EmpOrgStrCompany INT,
    @EmpOrgStrParentID BIGINT = NULL,
    @EmpOrgStrName NVARCHAR(255),
    @EmpOrgStrState TINYINT = 0,
    @EmpOrgStrUser BIGINT = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @EmpOrgStrCompany,@EmpOrgStrUser;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    DECLARE
        @NewID BIGINT,
        @CycleID BIGINT,
        @LockResult INT,
        @LockResource NVARCHAR(255);

    BEGIN TRY
        IF @EmpOrgStrCompany IS NULL
            THROW 50001, N'يجب تحديد الشركة.', 1;

        IF NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@EmpOrgStrName)), N'') IS NULL
            THROW 50002, N'اسم الوحدة التنظيمية مطلوب.', 1;

        SET @EmpOrgStrName = LTRIM(RTRIM(@EmpOrgStrName));

        IF @EmpOrgStrID = 0
            SET @EmpOrgStrID = NULL;

        BEGIN TRANSACTION;

        SET @LockResource = N'Emp_OrganigramStructure_Company_' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20), @EmpOrgStrCompany);

        EXEC @LockResult = sys.sp_getapplock
            @Resource = @LockResource,
            @LockMode = 'Exclusive',
            @LockOwner = 'Transaction',
            @LockTimeout = 15000,
            @DbPrincipal = 'public';

        IF @LockResult < 0
            THROW 50003, N'تعذر الحصول على قفل الهيكل التنظيمي للشركة.', 1;

        IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [dbo].[Mng_Company] WHERE [CmpID] = @EmpOrgStrCompany)
            THROW 50004, N'الشركة المحددة غير موجودة.', 1;

        IF @EmpOrgStrUser IS NOT NULL
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [dbo].[Mng_User] WHERE [UsrID] = @EmpOrgStrUser)
            THROW 50005, N'المستخدم المحدد غير موجود.', 1;

        IF @EmpOrgStrID IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [dbo].[Emp_OrganigramStructure] WHERE [EmpOrgStrID] = @EmpOrgStrID AND [EmpOrgStrCompany] = @EmpOrgStrCompany)
                THROW 50006, N'الوحدة التنظيمية المطلوب تحديثها غير موجودة.', 1;
        END;

        IF @EmpOrgStrID IS NOT NULL AND @EmpOrgStrID = @EmpOrgStrParentID
            THROW 50007, N'لا يمكن تعيين الوحدة التنظيمية أباً لنفسها.', 1;

        IF @EmpOrgStrParentID IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [dbo].[Emp_OrganigramStructure] WHERE [EmpOrgStrID] = @EmpOrgStrParentID AND [EmpOrgStrCompany] = @EmpOrgStrCompany)
                THROW 50008, N'الوحدة الأب غير موجودة أو تتبع شركة أخرى.', 1;
        END;

        IF @EmpOrgStrID IS NOT NULL AND @EmpOrgStrParentID IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            SET @CycleID = NULL;

            ;WITH Descendants AS
            (
                SELECT E.[EmpOrgStrID], CAST(N'/' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20), E.[EmpOrgStrID]) + N'/' AS NVARCHAR(MAX)) AS VisitPath
                FROM [dbo].[Emp_OrganigramStructure] AS E
                WHERE E.[EmpOrgStrParentID] = @EmpOrgStrID AND E.[EmpOrgStrCompany] = @EmpOrgStrCompany

                UNION ALL

                SELECT Child.[EmpOrgStrID], CAST(D.VisitPath + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20), Child.[EmpOrgStrID]) + N'/' AS NVARCHAR(MAX))
                FROM [dbo].[Emp_OrganigramStructure] AS Child
                INNER JOIN Descendants AS D ON Child.[EmpOrgStrParentID] = D.[EmpOrgStrID]
                WHERE Child.[EmpOrgStrCompany] = @EmpOrgStrCompany
                  AND CHARINDEX(N'/' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20), Child.[EmpOrgStrID]) + N'/', D.VisitPath) = 0
            )
            SELECT TOP (1) @CycleID = [EmpOrgStrID]
            FROM Descendants
            WHERE [EmpOrgStrID] = @EmpOrgStrParentID
            OPTION (MAXRECURSION 0);

            IF @CycleID IS NOT NULL
                THROW 50009, N'لا يمكن نقل الوحدة إلى أحد أبنائها أو أحفادها.', 1;
        END;

        IF @EmpOrgStrID IS NULL
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO [dbo].[Emp_OrganigramStructure]
            ([EmpOrgStrCompany], [EmpOrgStrParentID], [EmpOrgStrName], [EmpOrgStrState], [EmpOrgStrUser])
            VALUES
            (@EmpOrgStrCompany, @EmpOrgStrParentID, @EmpOrgStrName, @EmpOrgStrState, @EmpOrgStrUser);

            SET @NewID = CONVERT(BIGINT, SCOPE_IDENTITY());
            COMMIT TRANSACTION;
            SELECT @NewID AS [NewEmpOrgStrID];
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            UPDATE [dbo].[Emp_OrganigramStructure]
            SET [EmpOrgStrParentID] = @EmpOrgStrParentID,
                [EmpOrgStrName] = @EmpOrgStrName,
                [EmpOrgStrState] = @EmpOrgStrState,
                [EmpOrgStrUser] = @EmpOrgStrUser
            WHERE [EmpOrgStrID] = @EmpOrgStrID AND [EmpOrgStrCompany] = @EmpOrgStrCompany;

            IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0
                THROW 50010, N'لم يتم تحديث الوحدة التنظيمية.', 1;

            COMMIT TRANSACTION;
            SELECT @EmpOrgStrID AS [UpdatedEmpOrgStrID];
        END;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF XACT_STATE() <> 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        THROW;
    END CATCH;
END;
GO

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Emp_SaveOvertimeRequest]
 @CmpID INT,@OvertimeID BIGINT=0,@EmployeeID BIGINT,@WorkDate DATE,@StartAt DATETIME2(0),@EndAt DATETIME2(0),
 @Hours DECIMAL(8,2),@Reason NVARCHAR(500),@Multiplier DECIMAL(8,4)=NULL,@UserID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_Employee WHERE EmpCompany=@CmpID AND EmpID=@EmployeeID) THROW 54170,N'الموظف لا يتبع للشركة.',1;
 IF @EndAt<=@StartAt OR @Hours<=0 OR (@Multiplier IS NOT NULL AND @Multiplier<=0) THROW 54171,N'بيانات العمل الإضافي غير صحيحة.',1;
 IF @OvertimeID=0
 BEGIN
  INSERT dbo.Emp_OvertimeRequests(CmpID,EmployeeID,WorkDate,StartAt,EndAt,Hours,Reason,Multiplier,CreatedBy)
  VALUES(@CmpID,@EmployeeID,@WorkDate,@StartAt,@EndAt,@Hours,@Reason,@Multiplier,@UserID);
  SET @OvertimeID=SCOPE_IDENTITY();
 END
 ELSE
 BEGIN
  UPDATE dbo.Emp_OvertimeRequests SET WorkDate=@WorkDate,StartAt=@StartAt,EndAt=@EndAt,Hours=@Hours,Reason=@Reason,Multiplier=@Multiplier
  WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND OvertimeID=@OvertimeID AND EmployeeID=@EmployeeID AND RequestState=0;
  IF @@ROWCOUNT=0 THROW 54172,N'طلب الإضافي غير موجود أو غير قابل للتعديل.',1;
 END;
 SELECT @OvertimeID OvertimeID;
END;

CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_SavePayComponent
 @CmpID INT,@ComponentID BIGINT=0,@ComponentCode NVARCHAR(30),@ComponentName NVARCHAR(150),
 @ComponentKind TINYINT,@CalculationMethod TINYINT,@IsTaxable BIT=0,@IsInsurable BIT=0,@IsRecurring BIT=1,@UserID BIGINT,
 @DeductionPriority SMALLINT=100,@IsMandatoryDeduction BIT=0,@CanDefer BIT=NULL
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 IF @ComponentKind NOT IN(1,2) OR @CalculationMethod NOT IN(1,2) OR NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@ComponentCode)),N'') IS NULL OR NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@ComponentName)),N'') IS NULL
  THROW 54138,N'نوع أو طريقة احتساب أو تعريف مكون الراتب غير صحيح.',1;
 IF @DeductionPriority IS NULL OR @DeductionPriority<0 OR @IsMandatoryDeduction IS NULL THROW 54901,N'أولوية الاستقطاع أو إلزاميته غير صحيحة.',1;
 IF @ComponentKind=1 AND @IsMandatoryDeduction=1 THROW 54902,N'لا يمكن تعريف مكون الاستحقاق كاستقطاع إلزامي.',1;
 SET @CanDefer=CASE WHEN @ComponentKind=2 THEN ISNULL(@CanDefer,1) ELSE 0 END;
 IF @ComponentID=0
 BEGIN
  INSERT dbo.Emp_PayComponents(CmpID,ComponentCode,ComponentName,ComponentKind,CalculationMethod,IsTaxable,IsInsurable,IsRecurring,DeductionPriority,IsMandatoryDeduction,CanDefer,CreatedBy)
  VALUES(@CmpID,LTRIM(RTRIM(@ComponentCode)),LTRIM(RTRIM(@ComponentName)),@ComponentKind,@CalculationMethod,@IsTaxable,@IsInsurable,@IsRecurring,@DeductionPriority,@IsMandatoryDeduction,@CanDefer,@UserID);
  SET @ComponentID=SCOPE_IDENTITY();
 END
 ELSE
 BEGIN
  UPDATE dbo.Emp_PayComponents SET ComponentCode=LTRIM(RTRIM(@ComponentCode)),ComponentName=LTRIM(RTRIM(@ComponentName)),ComponentKind=@ComponentKind,CalculationMethod=@CalculationMethod,
   IsTaxable=@IsTaxable,IsInsurable=@IsInsurable,IsRecurring=@IsRecurring,DeductionPriority=@DeductionPriority,IsMandatoryDeduction=@IsMandatoryDeduction,CanDefer=@CanDefer WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND ComponentID=@ComponentID AND RecordState=0;
  IF @@ROWCOUNT=0 THROW 54139,N'مكون الراتب غير موجود أو غير قابل للتعديل.',1;
 END;
 SELECT @ComponentID ComponentID;
END;
GO

/* ================================================================
   13. PAYROLL PERIOD AND RUN CONTROL
   ================================================================ */
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Emp_SavePayPeriod]
 @CmpID INT,@PeriodID BIGINT=0,@PeriodName NVARCHAR(100),@DateFrom DATE,@DateTo DATE,@UserID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 IF @DateTo<@DateFrom THROW 54130,N'نطاق فترة الرواتب غير صحيح.',1;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_PayPeriods WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND PeriodState IN(1,2,3) AND DateFrom<=@DateTo AND DateTo>=@DateFrom AND (@PeriodID=0 OR PeriodID<>@PeriodID))
  THROW 54131,N'تتداخل الفترة مع فترة رواتب قائمة أو مقفلة.',1;
 IF @PeriodID=0
 BEGIN
  INSERT dbo.Emp_PayPeriods(CmpID,PeriodName,DateFrom,DateTo,CreatedBy) VALUES(@CmpID,@PeriodName,@DateFrom,@DateTo,@UserID);
  SET @PeriodID=SCOPE_IDENTITY();
 END
 ELSE
 BEGIN
  UPDATE dbo.Emp_PayPeriods SET PeriodName=@PeriodName,DateFrom=@DateFrom,DateTo=@DateTo WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND PeriodID=@PeriodID AND PeriodState=0;
  IF @@ROWCOUNT=0 THROW 54132,N'الفترة غير موجودة أو غير قابلة للتعديل.',1;
 END;
 SELECT @PeriodID AS PeriodID;
END;

CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_SavePayPolicy
 @CmpID INT,@PayPolicyID BIGINT=0,@PolicyName NVARCHAR(150),@EffectiveFrom DATE,@EffectiveTo DATE=NULL,
 @StandardMonthlyHours DECIMAL(9,2)=NULL,@RoundingScale TINYINT=3,@CurrencyID BIGINT=NULL,@UserID BIGINT,
 @BaseSalaryTaxable BIT=0,@BaseSalaryInsurable BIT=0
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 IF NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@PolicyName)),N'') IS NULL OR @EffectiveFrom IS NULL OR (@EffectiveTo IS NOT NULL AND @EffectiveTo<@EffectiveFrom)
  OR (@StandardMonthlyHours IS NOT NULL AND @StandardMonthlyHours<=0) OR @RoundingScale IS NULL OR @RoundingScale>6
  OR @BaseSalaryTaxable IS NULL OR @BaseSalaryInsurable IS NULL
  THROW 54370,N'إعدادات سياسة الرواتب غير صحيحة.',1;
 IF @CurrencyID IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Acc_Currency WHERE CurCmp=@CmpID AND CurID=@CurrencyID AND CurState=0)
  THROW 54371,N'عملة سياسة الرواتب غير صالحة للشركة.',1;
 BEGIN TRY
  BEGIN TRANSACTION;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_PayPolicies WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND RecordState=0 AND PayPolicyID<>ISNULL(@PayPolicyID,0)
    AND EffectiveFrom<=ISNULL(@EffectiveTo,CONVERT(date,'99991231')) AND ISNULL(EffectiveTo,CONVERT(date,'99991231'))>=@EffectiveFrom)
   THROW 54372,N'تتداخل سياسة الرواتب مع سياسة فعالة أخرى.',1;
  IF ISNULL(@PayPolicyID,0)=0
  BEGIN
   INSERT dbo.Emp_PayPolicies(CmpID,PolicyName,EffectiveFrom,EffectiveTo,StandardMonthlyHours,RoundingScale,CurrencyID,BaseSalaryTaxable,BaseSalaryInsurable,CreatedBy)
   VALUES(@CmpID,@PolicyName,@EffectiveFrom,@EffectiveTo,@StandardMonthlyHours,@RoundingScale,@CurrencyID,@BaseSalaryTaxable,@BaseSalaryInsurable,@UserID);
   SET @PayPolicyID=SCOPE_IDENTITY();
  END
  ELSE
  BEGIN
   UPDATE dbo.Emp_PayPolicies SET PolicyName=@PolicyName,EffectiveFrom=@EffectiveFrom,EffectiveTo=@EffectiveTo,StandardMonthlyHours=@StandardMonthlyHours,
    RoundingScale=@RoundingScale,CurrencyID=@CurrencyID,BaseSalaryTaxable=@BaseSalaryTaxable,BaseSalaryInsurable=@BaseSalaryInsurable
   WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND PayPolicyID=@PayPolicyID AND RecordState=0;
   IF @@ROWCOUNT<>1 THROW 54373,N'سياسة الرواتب غير موجودة أو غير قابلة للتعديل.',1;
  END;
  COMMIT TRANSACTION;
  SELECT @PayPolicyID AS PayPolicyID;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH
  IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
  THROW;
 END CATCH;
END;
GO
GO

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Emp_SavePayrollAccountMapping]
 @CmpID INT,@MappingID BIGINT=0,@ComponentID BIGINT=NULL,@AccountID BIGINT,@CostCenterID BIGINT=NULL,
 @DebitCredit TINYINT,@EffectiveFrom DATE,@EffectiveTo DATE=NULL,@UserID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 IF @DebitCredit NOT IN(1,2) OR (@EffectiveTo IS NOT NULL AND @EffectiveTo<@EffectiveFrom) THROW 54142,N'بيانات ربط الحساب غير صحيحة.',1;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Acc_Account WHERE AccCompany=@CmpID AND AccID=@AccountID AND AccState=0 AND AccChid=0) THROW 54143,N'الحساب غير موجود أو غير نشط أو غير تحليلي للشركة.',1;
 IF @CostCenterID IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Acc_CostCenter WHERE CsCCompany=@CmpID AND CsCID=@CostCenterID AND CsCState=0 AND CsCChid=0) THROW 54144,N'مركز التكلفة غير موجود أو غير نشط أو غير تحليلي للشركة.',1;
 IF @ComponentID IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_PayComponents WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND ComponentID=@ComponentID) THROW 54145,N'مكون الراتب لا يتبع للشركة.',1;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_PayrollAccountMappings WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND ISNULL(ComponentID,0)=ISNULL(@ComponentID,0) AND DebitCredit=@DebitCredit AND RecordState=0
  AND EffectiveFrom<=ISNULL(@EffectiveTo,'99991231') AND ISNULL(EffectiveTo,'99991231')>=@EffectiveFrom AND (@MappingID=0 OR MappingID<>@MappingID))
  THROW 54146,N'يوجد ربط حسابي متداخل لنفس المكون والجهة.',1;
 IF @MappingID=0
 BEGIN
  INSERT dbo.Emp_PayrollAccountMappings(CmpID,ComponentID,AccountID,CostCenterID,DebitCredit,EffectiveFrom,EffectiveTo,CreatedBy)
  VALUES(@CmpID,@ComponentID,@AccountID,@CostCenterID,@DebitCredit,@EffectiveFrom,@EffectiveTo,@UserID);
  SET @MappingID=SCOPE_IDENTITY();
 END
 ELSE
 BEGIN
  UPDATE dbo.Emp_PayrollAccountMappings SET ComponentID=@ComponentID,AccountID=@AccountID,CostCenterID=@CostCenterID,DebitCredit=@DebitCredit,
   EffectiveFrom=@EffectiveFrom,EffectiveTo=@EffectiveTo WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND MappingID=@MappingID AND RecordState=0;
  IF @@ROWCOUNT=0 THROW 54147,N'ربط الحساب غير موجود أو غير قابل للتعديل.',1;
 END;
 SELECT @MappingID MappingID;
END;

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Emp_SavePosition]
    @PosID          BIGINT = NULL OUTPUT,
    @PosName        NVARCHAR(255),
    @PosCmp         INT,
    @EmpOrgStrID    BIGINT,
    @EmpJobID       BIGINT,
    @SpyID          BIGINT = NULL,
    @EduQualID      BIGINT = NULL,
    @SchTypeID      BIGINT,
    @PosState       TINYINT = 0,
    @PosUser        BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @PosCmp,@PosUser;
    SET XACT_ABORT OFF;

    IF ISNULL(@PosCmp, 0) <= 0
        THROW 50020, N'يجب تحديد الشركة بشكل صحيح.', 1;

    IF LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(@PosName, N''))) = N''
        THROW 50021, N'يجب إدخال اسم المنصب.', 1;

    IF ISNULL(@PosUser, 0) <= 0
        THROW 50022, N'يجب تحديد مستخدم النظام.', 1;

    IF @PosState IS NULL OR @PosState NOT IN (0, 1)
        THROW 50023, N'حالة المنصب غير صالحة.', 1;

    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_Company WHERE CmpID = @PosCmp)
        THROW 50024, N'الشركة غير موجودة.', 1;

    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_User WHERE UsrID = @PosUser)
        THROW 50025, N'مستخدم النظام غير موجود.', 1;

    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_OrganigramStructure WHERE EmpOrgStrCompany = @PosCmp AND EmpOrgStrID = @EmpOrgStrID)
        THROW 50026, N'الوحدة التنظيمية غير موجودة أو لا تتبع لهذه الشركة.', 1;

    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_JobTitles WHERE EmpJobCompany = @PosCmp AND EmpJobID = @EmpJobID)
        THROW 50027, N'المسمى الوظيفي غير موجود أو لا يتبع لهذه الشركة.', 1;

    IF @SpyID IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_Specialty WHERE SpyCmp = @PosCmp AND SpyID = @SpyID)
        THROW 50028, N'التخصص المطلوب غير موجود أو لا يتبع لهذه الشركة.', 1;

    IF @EduQualID IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_EducationalQualifications WHERE EduQualCmp = @PosCmp AND EduQualID = @EduQualID)
        THROW 50029, N'المؤهل العلمي غير موجود أو لا يتبع لهذه الشركة.', 1;

    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_WorkScheduleTypes WHERE SchTypeCmp = @PosCmp AND SchTypeID = @SchTypeID)
        THROW 50030, N'نوع جدول العمل غير موجود أو لا يتبع لهذه الشركة.', 1;

    DECLARE @TranStarted INT = 0;

    BEGIN TRY
        IF @@TRANCOUNT = 0
        BEGIN
            BEGIN TRANSACTION;
            SET @TranStarted = 1;
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            SAVE TRANSACTION SavePoint_Emp_Position;
        END

        IF ISNULL(@PosID, 0) <= 0
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO dbo.Emp_Position
            (
                PosName, PosCmp, EmpOrgStrID, EmpJobID, SpyID, EduQualID, SchTypeID, PosState, PosDate, PosUser
            )
            VALUES
            (
                LTRIM(RTRIM(@PosName)), @PosCmp, @EmpOrgStrID, @EmpJobID, @SpyID, @EduQualID, @SchTypeID, @PosState, SYSDATETIME(), @PosUser
            );

            SET @PosID = SCOPE_IDENTITY();
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_Position WHERE PosID = @PosID AND PosCmp = @PosCmp)
                THROW 50031, N'المنصب المراد تعديله غير موجود أو لا يتبع لهذه الشركة.', 1;

            UPDATE dbo.Emp_Position
            SET PosName     = LTRIM(RTRIM(@PosName)),
                EmpOrgStrID = @EmpOrgStrID,
                EmpJobID    = @EmpJobID,
                SpyID       = @SpyID,
                EduQualID   = @EduQualID,
                SchTypeID   = @SchTypeID,
                PosState    = @PosState,
                PosDate     = SYSDATETIME(),
                PosUser     = @PosUser
            WHERE PosID = @PosID
              AND PosCmp = @PosCmp;
        END

        IF @TranStarted = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT > 0
            COMMIT TRANSACTION;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @TranStarted = 1
        BEGIN
            IF XACT_STATE() <> 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        end
        ELSE IF XACT_STATE() = 1
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION SavePoint_Emp_Position;

        THROW;
    END CATCH
END;
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Emp_SaveSpecialty]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Emp_SaveSpecialty]
    @SpyID BIGINT = NULL,
    @SpyName NVARCHAR(255),
    @SpyCmp INT,
    @SpyState TINYINT = 0,
    @SpyUser BIGINT = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @SpyCmp,@SpyUser;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    SET @SpyName = LTRIM(RTRIM(@SpyName));

    IF NULLIF(@SpyName, N'') IS NULL
        THROW 50001, N'اسم التخصص مطلوب.', 1;

    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_Company WHERE CmpID = @SpyCmp)
        THROW 50002, N'الشركة غير موجودة.', 1;

    IF @SpyUser IS NOT NULL
       AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_User WHERE UsrID = @SpyUser)
        THROW 50003, N'المستخدم غير موجود.', 1;

    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM dbo.Emp_Specialty
        WHERE SpyCmp = @SpyCmp
          AND SpyName = @SpyName
          AND (@SpyID IS NULL OR SpyID <> @SpyID)
    )
        THROW 50004, N'التخصص موجود مسبقاً في الشركة.', 1;

    IF @SpyID IS NULL
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO dbo.Emp_Specialty (SpyName, SpyCmp, SpyState, SpyUser)
        VALUES (@SpyName, @SpyCmp, @SpyState, @SpyUser);

        SELECT CONVERT(BIGINT, SCOPE_IDENTITY()) AS SpyID;
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_Specialty WHERE SpyID = @SpyID AND SpyCmp = @SpyCmp)
            THROW 50005, N'التخصص غير موجود في الشركة المحددة.', 1;

        UPDATE dbo.Emp_Specialty
        SET SpyName = @SpyName,
            SpyState = @SpyState
        WHERE SpyID = @SpyID
          AND SpyCmp = @SpyCmp;

        SELECT @SpyID AS SpyID;
    END
END;
GO

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Emp_SaveTermination]
 @CmpID INT,@TerminationID BIGINT=0,@EmployeeID BIGINT,@NoticeDate DATE,@LastWorkingDate DATE,
 @TerminationReason TINYINT,@ReasonText NVARCHAR(1000)=NULL,@UserID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_Employee WHERE EmpCompany=@CmpID AND EmpID=@EmployeeID) THROW 54186,N'الموظف لا يتبع للشركة.',1;
 IF @LastWorkingDate<@NoticeDate THROW 54187,N'تاريخ آخر يوم عمل يسبق تاريخ الإشعار.',1;
 IF @TerminationID=0
 BEGIN
  INSERT dbo.Emp_Terminations(CmpID,EmployeeID,NoticeDate,LastWorkingDate,TerminationReason,ReasonText,CreatedBy)
  VALUES(@CmpID,@EmployeeID,@NoticeDate,@LastWorkingDate,@TerminationReason,@ReasonText,@UserID);
  SET @TerminationID=SCOPE_IDENTITY();
 END
 ELSE
 BEGIN
  UPDATE dbo.Emp_Terminations SET NoticeDate=@NoticeDate,LastWorkingDate=@LastWorkingDate,TerminationReason=@TerminationReason,ReasonText=@ReasonText
  WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND TerminationID=@TerminationID AND TerminationState=0;
  IF @@ROWCOUNT=0 THROW 54188,N'طلب إنهاء الخدمة غير موجود أو غير قابل للتعديل.',1;
 END;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_ApprovalRouteSteps WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND ProcessType=5 AND RecordState=0) EXEC dbo.Emp_StartApproval @CmpID,5,@TerminationID,@UserID,1;
END;

 @Result NVARCHAR(250)=NULL,@Score DECIMAL(7,2)=NULL,@CertificatePath NVARCHAR(1000)=NULL,@UserID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_Employee WHERE EmpCompany=@CmpID AND EmpID=@EmployeeID) THROW 54183,N'الموظف لا يتبع للشركة.',1;
 IF @DateTo<@DateFrom THROW 54184,N'فترة التدريب غير صحيحة.',1;
 IF @TrainingRecordID=0
 BEGIN
  INSERT dbo.Emp_TrainingRecords(CmpID,CourseID,EmployeeID,DateFrom,DateTo,Result,Score,CertificatePath,CreatedBy)
  VALUES(@CmpID,@CourseID,@EmployeeID,@DateFrom,@DateTo,@Result,@Score,@CertificatePath,@UserID);

SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Emp_SaveWorkCalendar]
    @WCalID        BIGINT = NULL OUTPUT,
    @WCalCmp       INT,
    @WCalName      NVARCHAR(100),
    @WCalStartDate DATE,
    @WCalEndDate   DATE,
    @WCalState     TINYINT = 0,
    @WCalUser      BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @WCalCmp,@WCalUser;
    SET XACT_ABORT OFF;

    IF ISNULL(@WCalCmp, 0) <= 0
        THROW 50001, N'يجب تحديد الشركة بشكل صحيح.', 1;

    SET @WCalName = LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(@WCalName, N'')));

    IF @WCalName = N''
        THROW 50002, N'اسم التقويم مطلوب.', 1;

    IF @WCalStartDate IS NULL OR @WCalEndDate IS NULL
        THROW 50003, N'يجب تحديد تاريخ بداية ونهاية التقويم.', 1;

    IF @WCalEndDate < @WCalStartDate
        THROW 50004, N'تاريخ نهاية التقويم لا يمكن أن يسبق تاريخ البداية.', 1;

    IF @WCalState IS NULL OR @WCalState NOT IN (0, 1)
        THROW 50005, N'حالة التقويم غير صالحة.', 1;

    IF ISNULL(@WCalUser, 0) <= 0
        THROW 50006, N'يجب تحديد مستخدم النظام.', 1;

    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_Company WHERE CmpID = @WCalCmp)
        THROW 50007, N'الشركة غير موجودة.', 1;

    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_User WHERE UsrID = @WCalUser)
        THROW 50008, N'مستخدم النظام غير موجود.', 1;

    DECLARE @TranStarted BIT = 0;

    BEGIN TRY
        IF @@TRANCOUNT = 0
        BEGIN
            BEGIN TRANSACTION;
            SET @TranStarted = 1;
        END
        ELSE
            SAVE TRANSACTION SaveWorkCal;

        IF ISNULL(@WCalID, 0) <= 0
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO dbo.Emp_WorkCalendar
            (
                WCalCmp, WCalName, WCalStartDate, WCalEndDate, WCalState, WCalDateTime, WCalUser
            )
            VALUES
            (
                @WCalCmp, @WCalName, @WCalStartDate, @WCalEndDate, @WCalState, SYSDATETIME(), @WCalUser
            );

            SET @WCalID = CONVERT(BIGINT, SCOPE_IDENTITY());
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            UPDATE dbo.Emp_WorkCalendar
            SET WCalName = @WCalName,
                WCalStartDate = @WCalStartDate,
                WCalEndDate = @WCalEndDate,
                WCalState = @WCalState,
                WCalDateTime = SYSDATETIME(),
                WCalUser = @WCalUser
            WHERE WCalID = @WCalID
              AND WCalCmp = @WCalCmp;

            IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0
                THROW 50009, N'التقويم غير موجود أو لا يتبع للشركة المحددة.', 1;
        END;

        IF @TranStarted = 1
            COMMIT TRANSACTION;

        SELECT CAST(1 AS BIT) AS Success, @WCalID AS WCalID;

    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @TranStarted = 1 AND XACT_STATE() <> 0
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        ELSE IF @TranStarted = 0 AND XACT_STATE() = 1
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION SaveWorkCal;

        THROW;
    END CATCH
END;
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Emp_SaveWorkCalendarDetails]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Emp_SaveWorkCalendarDetails]
    @WCalDetID        BIGINT = NULL OUTPUT,
    @WCalDetCmp       INT,
    @WCalDetWCalID    BIGINT,
    @WCalDetDate      DATE,
    @WCalDetType      TINYINT,
    @WCalDetSchTypeID BIGINT = NULL,
    @WCalDetName      NVARCHAR(100) = NULL,
    @WCalDetUser      BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @WCalDetCmp,@WCalDetUser;
    SET XACT_ABORT OFF;

    IF ISNULL(@WCalDetCmp, 0) <= 0
        THROW 50101, N'يجب تحديد الشركة بشكل صحيح.', 1;

    IF ISNULL(@WCalDetWCalID, 0) <= 0
        THROW 50102, N'معرّف التقويم غير صحيح.', 1;

    IF @WCalDetDate IS NULL
        THROW 50103, N'يجب تحديد التاريخ.', 1;

    IF @WCalDetType NOT IN (1, 2)
        THROW 50104, N'نوع اليوم غير صالح.', 1;

    IF ISNULL(@WCalDetUser, 0) <= 0
        THROW 50105, N'يجب تحديد المستخدم.', 1;

    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_Company WHERE CmpID = @WCalDetCmp)
        THROW 50106, N'الشركة غير موجودة.', 1;

    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_User WHERE UsrID = @WCalDetUser)
        THROW 50107, N'المستخدم غير موجود.', 1;

    DECLARE @TranStarted BIT = 0;

    BEGIN TRY
        IF @@TRANCOUNT = 0
        BEGIN
            BEGIN TRANSACTION;
            SET @TranStarted = 1;
        END
        ELSE
            SAVE TRANSACTION SaveWCalDet;

        IF NOT EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM dbo.Emp_WorkCalendar
            WHERE WCalID = @WCalDetWCalID
              AND WCalCmp = @WCalDetCmp
              AND @WCalDetDate BETWEEN WCalStartDate AND WCalEndDate
        )
            THROW 50108, N'التقويم غير موجود أو التاريخ خارج فترة التقويم.', 1;

        IF @WCalDetSchTypeID IS NOT NULL
           AND NOT EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM dbo.Emp_WorkScheduleTypes
            WHERE SchTypeID = @WCalDetSchTypeID
              AND SchTypeCmp = @WCalDetCmp
        )
            THROW 50109, N'نوع الدوام غير موجود أو لا يتبع للشركة.', 1;

        IF @WCalDetType = 2
            SET @WCalDetSchTypeID = NULL;

        IF ISNULL(@WCalDetID, 0) <= 0
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO dbo.Emp_WorkCalendarDetails
            (
                WCalDetCmp, WCalDetWCalID, WCalDetDate, WCalDetType,
                WCalDetSchTypeID, WCalDetName, WCalDetDateTime, WCalDetUser
            )
            VALUES
            (
                @WCalDetCmp, @WCalDetWCalID, @WCalDetDate, @WCalDetType,
                @WCalDetSchTypeID, @WCalDetName, SYSDATETIME(), @WCalDetUser
            );

            SET @WCalDetID = CONVERT(BIGINT, SCOPE_IDENTITY());
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            UPDATE dbo.Emp_WorkCalendarDetails
            SET WCalDetDate = @WCalDetDate,
                WCalDetType = @WCalDetType,
                WCalDetSchTypeID = @WCalDetSchTypeID,
                WCalDetName = @WCalDetName,
                WCalDetDateTime = SYSDATETIME(),
                WCalDetUser = @WCalDetUser
            WHERE WCalDetID = @WCalDetID
              AND WCalDetCmp = @WCalDetCmp
              AND WCalDetWCalID = @WCalDetWCalID;

            IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0
                THROW 50110, N'تفاصيل اليوم غير موجودة.', 1;
        END;

        IF @TranStarted = 1
            COMMIT TRANSACTION;

        SELECT CAST(1 AS BIT) AS Success, @WCalDetID AS WCalDetID;

    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @TranStarted = 1 AND XACT_STATE() <> 0
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        ELSE IF @TranStarted = 0 AND XACT_STATE() = 1
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION SaveWCalDet;

        THROW;
    END CATCH
END;
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Emp_SaveWorkScheduleTypes]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Emp_SaveWorkScheduleTypes]
    @SchTypeID          BIGINT = NULL,
    @SchTypeName        NVARCHAR(255),
    @SchTypeCmp         INT,
    @SchStartTime       TIME(0),
    @SchEndTime         TIME(0),
    @SchWorkingHours    DECIMAL(4,2),
    @SchGraceMinutes    SMALLINT = 0,
    @SchIsNightShift    TINYINT = 0,
    @SchCrossesMidnight TINYINT = 0,
    @SchTypeState       TINYINT = 0,
    @SchTypeUser        BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @SchTypeCmp,@SchTypeUser;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    IF @SchTypeName IS NULL
       OR @SchTypeCmp IS NULL
       OR @SchStartTime IS NULL
       OR @SchEndTime IS NULL
       OR @SchWorkingHours IS NULL
       OR @SchGraceMinutes IS NULL
       OR @SchIsNightShift IS NULL
       OR @SchCrossesMidnight IS NULL
       OR @SchTypeState IS NULL
       OR @SchTypeUser IS NULL
        THROW 50001, N'جميع الحقول الأساسية إجبارية ولا يمكن أن تكون قيمتها فارغة.', 1;

    SET @SchTypeName = LTRIM(RTRIM(@SchTypeName));

    IF NULLIF(@SchTypeName, N'') IS NULL
        THROW 50002, N'اسم جدول العمل أو الوردية مطلوب.', 1;

    IF @SchTypeCmp <= 0
        THROW 50003, N'معرّف الشركة غير صحيح.', 1;

    IF @SchTypeUser <= 0
        THROW 50004, N'يجب تحديد المستخدم المسؤول.', 1;

    IF @SchWorkingHours <= 0 OR @SchWorkingHours > 24
        THROW 50005, N'ساعات العمل الفعلية يجب أن تكون أكبر من صفر ولا تتجاوز 24 ساعة.', 1;

    IF @SchGraceMinutes < 0
        THROW 50006, N'فترة السماح لا يمكن أن تكون سالبة.', 1;

    IF @SchIsNightShift NOT IN (0, 1) OR @SchCrossesMidnight NOT IN (0, 1) OR @SchTypeState NOT IN (0, 1)
        THROW 50007, N'قيم الخيارات المنطقية أو الحالة غير صالحة.', 1;

    IF (@SchCrossesMidnight = 0 AND @SchEndTime <= @SchStartTime)
       OR (@SchCrossesMidnight = 1 AND @SchEndTime >= @SchStartTime)
        THROW 50008, N'يوجد تعارض بين أوقات البداية والنهاية ومؤشر عبور منتصف الليل.', 1;

    DECLARE @TotalSpanMinutes INT = DATEDIFF(MINUTE, @SchStartTime, @SchEndTime) + CASE WHEN @SchCrossesMidnight = 1 THEN 1440 ELSE 0 END;
    
    IF (CAST(@SchWorkingHours AS DECIMAL(4,2)) * 60) > @TotalSpanMinutes
        THROW 50009, N'صافي ساعات العمل لا يمكن أن يتجاوز المدة الزمنية الكلية بين البداية والنهاية.', 1;

    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_Company WHERE CmpID = @SchTypeCmp)
        THROW 50010, N'الشركة غير موجودة.', 1;

    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_User WHERE UsrID = @SchTypeUser)
        THROW 50011, N'المستخدم غير موجود.', 1;

    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;

        IF ISNULL(@SchTypeID, 0) = 0
        BEGIN
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT 1
                FROM dbo.Emp_WorkScheduleTypes WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
                WHERE SchTypeCmp = @SchTypeCmp
                  AND SchTypeName = @SchTypeName
            )
                THROW 50012, N'اسم الوردية أو جدول العمل مسجل مسبقاً لهذه الشركة.', 1;

            INSERT INTO dbo.Emp_WorkScheduleTypes
            (
                SchTypeName, SchTypeCmp, SchStartTime, SchEndTime,
                SchWorkingHours, SchGraceMinutes, SchIsNightShift,
                SchCrossesMidnight, SchTypeState, SchTypeDate, SchTypeUser
            )
            VALUES
            (
                @SchTypeName, @SchTypeCmp, @SchStartTime, @SchEndTime,
                @SchWorkingHours, @SchGraceMinutes, @SchIsNightShift,
                @SchCrossesMidnight, @SchTypeState, SYSDATETIME(), @SchTypeUser
            );

            SET @SchTypeID = CONVERT(BIGINT, SCOPE_IDENTITY());
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            IF NOT EXISTS
            (
                SELECT 1
                FROM dbo.Emp_WorkScheduleTypes WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
                WHERE SchTypeID = @SchTypeID
                  AND SchTypeCmp = @SchTypeCmp
            )
                THROW 50013, N'جدول العمل غير موجود أو لا يتبع الشركة المحددة.', 1;

            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT 1
                FROM dbo.Emp_WorkScheduleTypes WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
                WHERE SchTypeCmp = @SchTypeCmp
                  AND SchTypeName = @SchTypeName
                  AND SchTypeID <> @SchTypeID
            )
                THROW 50012, N'اسم الوردية أو جدول العمل مسجل مسبقاً لهذه الشركة.', 1;

            UPDATE dbo.Emp_WorkScheduleTypes
            SET SchTypeName        = @SchTypeName,
                SchStartTime       = @SchStartTime,
                SchEndTime         = @SchEndTime,
                SchWorkingHours    = @SchWorkingHours,
                SchGraceMinutes    = @SchGraceMinutes,
                SchIsNightShift    = @SchIsNightShift,
                SchCrossesMidnight = @SchCrossesMidnight,
                SchTypeState       = @SchTypeState,
                SchTypeDate        = SYSDATETIME(),
                SchTypeUser        = @SchTypeUser
            WHERE SchTypeID = @SchTypeID
              AND SchTypeCmp = @SchTypeCmp;
        END;

        COMMIT TRANSACTION;

        SELECT CAST(1 AS BIT) AS Success, @SchTypeID AS SchTypeID;

    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF XACT_STATE() <> 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        THROW;
    END CATCH;
END;
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Emp_SearchEmployee]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Emp_SearchEmployee]
    @EmpID BIGINT=NULL,
    @EmpNum NVARCHAR(10)=NULL,
    @EmpName NVARCHAR(50)=NULL,
    @EmpState TINYINT=NULL,
    @EmpCompany INT=NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    IF @EmpCompany IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_Company WHERE CmpID=@EmpCompany) THROW 54330,N'يجب تحديد شركة صحيحة للبحث عن الموظفين.',1;

    SELECT EmpID,EmpNum,EmpName,EmpPic,EmpState,HireDate,EmpDateTime,EmpUser,EmpCompany
    FROM dbo.Emp_Employee
    WHERE (@EmpID IS NULL OR EmpID=@EmpID)
      AND (@EmpNum IS NULL OR EmpNum LIKE N'%'+@EmpNum+N'%')
      AND (@EmpName IS NULL OR EmpName LIKE N'%'+@EmpName+N'%')
      AND (@EmpState IS NULL OR EmpState=@EmpState)
      AND (@EmpCompany IS NULL OR EmpCompany=@EmpCompany)
    ORDER BY EmpID;
END;

/* =========================================================
   7. SELECT ATTENDANCE ADJUSTMENTS
   ========================================================= */

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Emp_SelectAttendanceAdjustments]
    @CmpID INT,
    @AttDayID BIGINT = NULL,
    @AttAdjID BIGINT = NULL,
    @Type TINYINT = NULL,
    @State TINYINT = NULL,
    @DateFrom DATE = NULL,
    @DateTo DATE = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    IF @DateFrom IS NOT NULL
       AND @DateTo IS NOT NULL
       AND @DateTo < @DateFrom
        THROW 52811, N'تاريخ النهاية لا يمكن أن يسبق تاريخ البداية.', 1;

    SELECT
        A.AttAdjID,
        A.AttAdjCmp,
        A.AttAdjAttDayID,

        D.AttDayEmpID,
        E.EmpNum,
        E.EmpName,
        D.AttDayDate,

        A.AttAdjType,
        A.AttAdjOldValue,
        A.AttAdjNewValue,
        A.AttAdjReason,
        A.AttAdjState,
        A.AttAdjDateTime,
        A.AttAdjUser

    FROM dbo.Emp_AttendanceAdjustments AS A

    INNER JOIN dbo.Emp_AttendanceDaily AS D
        ON D.AttDayID = A.AttAdjAttDayID
       AND D.AttDayCmp = A.AttAdjCmp

    INNER JOIN dbo.Emp_Employee AS E
        ON E.EmpID = D.AttDayEmpID
       AND E.EmpCompany = D.AttDayCmp

    WHERE A.AttAdjCmp = @CmpID
      AND (@AttDayID IS NULL OR A.AttAdjAttDayID = @AttDayID)
      AND (@AttAdjID IS NULL OR A.AttAdjID = @AttAdjID)
      AND (@Type IS NULL OR A.AttAdjType = @Type)
      AND (@State IS NULL OR A.AttAdjState = @State)
      AND (@DateFrom IS NULL OR D.AttDayDate >= @DateFrom)
      AND (@DateTo IS NULL OR D.AttDayDate <= @DateTo)

    ORDER BY A.AttAdjDateTime DESC, A.AttAdjID DESC;
END;

GO

/* =========================================================
   8. SELECT SYNC LOGS
   ========================================================= */

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Emp_SelectAttendanceDeviceSyncLogs]
    @CmpID INT,
    @DeviceID BIGINT = NULL,
    @SyncID BIGINT = NULL,
    @Source TINYINT = NULL,
    @Status TINYINT = NULL,
    @DateFrom DATETIME2(0) = NULL,
    @DateTo DATETIME2(0) = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    SELECT
        S.SyncID,
        S.SyncCmp,
        S.SyncDeviceID,
        D.DeviceName,
        S.SyncSource,
        S.SyncStatus,
        S.SyncStartedAt,
        S.SyncFinishedAt,
        S.SyncReceivedCount,
        S.SyncInsertedCount,
        S.SyncDuplicateCount,
        S.SyncRejectedCount,
        S.SyncFileName,
        S.SyncFileHash,
        S.SyncAgentName,
        S.SyncError,
        S.SyncUser

    FROM dbo.Emp_AttendanceDeviceSyncLog AS S

    INNER JOIN dbo.Emp_AttendanceDevices AS D
        ON D.DeviceID = S.SyncDeviceID
       AND D.DeviceCmp = S.SyncCmp

    WHERE S.SyncCmp = @CmpID
      AND (@DeviceID IS NULL OR S.SyncDeviceID = @DeviceID)
      AND (@SyncID IS NULL OR S.SyncID = @SyncID)
      AND (@Source IS NULL OR S.SyncSource = @Source)
      AND (@Status IS NULL OR S.SyncStatus = @Status)
      AND (@DateFrom IS NULL OR S.SyncStartedAt >= @DateFrom)
      AND (@DateTo IS NULL OR S.SyncStartedAt <= @DateTo)

    ORDER BY S.SyncStartedAt DESC, S.SyncID DESC;
END;

   ========================================================= */

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Emp_SelectAttendanceExceptions]
    @CmpID INT,
    @ExcID BIGINT = NULL,
    @AttDayID BIGINT = NULL,
    @ProcID BIGINT = NULL,
    @Type TINYINT = NULL,
    @Severity TINYINT = NULL,
    @State TINYINT = NULL,
    @DateFrom DATE = NULL,
    @DateTo DATE = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    IF @DateFrom IS NOT NULL
       AND @DateTo IS NOT NULL
       AND @DateTo < @DateFrom
        THROW 53111, N'تاريخ النهاية لا يمكن أن يسبق تاريخ البداية.', 1;

    SELECT
        X.ExcID,
        X.ExcCmp,
        X.ExcAttDayID,
        D.AttDayEmpID,
        D.AttDayDate,
        X.ExcProcID,
        X.ExcType,
        X.ExcDescription,
        X.ExcSeverity,
        X.ExcState,
        X.ExcResolution,
        X.ExcDateTime,
        X.ExcResolvedAt,
        X.ExcResolvedBy,
        X.ExcUser

    FROM dbo.Emp_AttendanceExceptions AS X

    INNER JOIN dbo.Emp_AttendanceDaily AS D
        ON D.AttDayCmp = X.ExcCmp
       AND D.AttDayID = X.ExcAttDayID

    WHERE X.ExcCmp = @CmpID
      AND (@ExcID IS NULL OR X.ExcID = @ExcID)
      AND (@AttDayID IS NULL OR X.ExcAttDayID = @AttDayID)
      AND (@ProcID IS NULL OR X.ExcProcID = @ProcID)
      AND (@Type IS NULL OR X.ExcType = @Type)
      AND (@Severity IS NULL OR X.ExcSeverity = @Severity)
      AND (@State IS NULL OR X.ExcState = @State)
      AND (@DateFrom IS NULL OR D.AttDayDate >= @DateFrom)
      AND (@DateTo IS NULL OR D.AttDayDate <= @DateTo)

    ORDER BY
        X.ExcSeverity DESC,
        X.ExcDateTime DESC,
        X.ExcID DESC;
END;

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Emp_SelectContract]
    @EmpCompany INT,
    @EmpID      BIGINT,
    @OnlyActive BIT = 0
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    IF ISNULL(@EmpCompany, 0) <= 0 THROW 50260, N'معرف الشركة غير صالح.', 1;
    IF ISNULL(@EmpID, 0) <= 0      THROW 50261, N'معرف الموظف غير صالح.', 1;

    SELECT C.ConID, C.EmpCompany, C.EmpID, C.ConType, T.EmpTypeName AS ConTypeName,
           C.ConStartDate, C.ConEndDate,
           CAST(CASE WHEN C.ConEndDate IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BIT) AS IsActive,
           C.ConUser, U.UsrLogIn AS ConUserName, C.ConDateTime
    FROM dbo.Emp_Contract AS C
    INNER JOIN dbo.Emp_EmploymentTypes AS T ON T.EmpTypeCmp = C.EmpCompany AND T.EmpTypeID = C.ConType
    LEFT JOIN dbo.Mng_User AS U ON U.UsrID = C.ConUser
    WHERE C.EmpCompany = @EmpCompany AND C.EmpID = @EmpID
      AND (@OnlyActive = 0 OR C.ConEndDate IS NULL)
    ORDER BY C.ConStartDate DESC;
END;
GO

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Emp_SelectEmployee]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Emp_SelectEmployee]
    @Cmp    INT,
    @EmpID  BIGINT       = NULL,
    @Search NVARCHAR(50) = NULL,
    @State  TINYINT      = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    IF @Cmp IS NULL OR @Cmp <= 0
        THROW 50300, N'الشركة غير صحيحة.', 1;

    SET @Search = NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@Search)), N'');

    SELECT
        e.EmpID, e.EmpNum, e.EmpName, e.EmpState, e.EmpPicPath,e.HireDate,
        CAST(CASE WHEN e.EmpPic IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BIT) AS HasPic,
        e.PosID, p.PosName,
        d.EmpGender, d.EmpNat, n.NatName AS EmpNatName,
        d.EmpBDate, d.EmpBPlace, d.EmpSocial, d.EmpCardNum,
        d.EmpQualification, q.EduQualName AS EmpQualificationName,
        d.EmpPhone, d.EmpEmail, d.EmpAddress, d.EmpNots,
        c.ConID,  c.ConType, t.EmpTypeName AS ConTypeName, c.ConStartDate, c.ConEndDate,
        s.SalID,  s.SalAmount, s.SalCurrencyID, cu.CurCode AS SalCurrencyCode, s.SalStartDate,
        w.WsaID,  w.WsaSiteID, w.WsaStartDate
    FROM dbo.Emp_Employee AS e
    LEFT JOIN dbo.Emp_Position            AS p  ON p.PosCmp = e.EmpCompany AND p.PosID = e.PosID
    LEFT JOIN dbo.Emp_PersonalDetails     AS d  ON d.EmpCompany = e.EmpCompany AND d.EmpID = e.EmpID
    LEFT JOIN dbo.Emp_Nationality         AS n  ON n.NatCmp = e.EmpCompany AND n.NatID = d.EmpNat
    LEFT JOIN dbo.Emp_EducationalQualifications AS q
                                              ON q.EduQualCmp = e.EmpCompany AND q.EduQualID = d.EmpQualification
    OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP (1) * FROM dbo.Emp_Contract AS x
                 WHERE x.EmpCompany = e.EmpCompany AND x.EmpID = e.EmpID AND x.ConEndDate IS NULL
                 ORDER BY x.ConStartDate DESC) AS c
    LEFT JOIN dbo.Emp_EmploymentTypes     AS t  ON t.EmpTypeCmp = e.EmpCompany AND t.EmpTypeID = c.ConType
    OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP (1) * FROM dbo.Emp_Salary AS x
                 WHERE x.EmpCompany = e.EmpCompany AND x.EmpID = e.EmpID AND x.SalEndDate IS NULL
                 ORDER BY x.SalStartDate DESC) AS s
    LEFT JOIN dbo.Acc_Currency            AS cu ON cu.CurCmp = e.EmpCompany AND cu.CurID = s.SalCurrencyID
    OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP (1) * FROM dbo.Emp_WorkSiteAssignment AS x
                 WHERE x.EmpCompany = e.EmpCompany AND x.EmpID = e.EmpID AND x.WsaEndDate IS NULL
                 ORDER BY x.WsaStartDate DESC) AS w
    WHERE e.EmpCompany = @Cmp
      AND (@EmpID  IS NULL OR e.EmpID = @EmpID)
      AND (@State  IS NULL OR e.EmpState = @State)
      AND (@Search IS NULL OR e.EmpNum LIKE N'%' + @Search + N'%' OR e.EmpName LIKE N'%' + @Search + N'%')
    ORDER BY e.EmpID;
END;
GO

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Emp_SelectEmployeeDocuments]
 @CmpID INT,@EmployeeID BIGINT=NULL,@DocumentID BIGINT=NULL,@State TINYINT=NULL
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON;
 SELECT d.*,t.DocTypeName FROM dbo.Emp_EmployeeDocuments d
 JOIN dbo.Emp_DocumentTypes t ON t.DocTypeCmp=d.CmpID AND t.DocTypeID=d.DocumentTypeID
 WHERE d.CmpID=@CmpID AND (@EmployeeID IS NULL OR d.EmployeeID=@EmployeeID)

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Emp_SelectEmployeeSchedule]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Emp_SelectEmployeeSchedule]
    @SchCmp   INT,
    @SchID    BIGINT = NULL,
    @SchEmpID BIGINT = NULL,
    @SchState TINYINT = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    IF ISNULL(@SchCmp, 0) <= 0
        THROW 50214, N'يجب تحديد الشركة بشكل صحيح.', 1;

    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_Company WHERE CmpID = @SchCmp)
        THROW 50215, N'الشركة غير موجودة.', 1;

    IF @SchID IS NOT NULL AND @SchID <= 0
        THROW 50216, N'معرّف الربط غير صحيح.', 1;

    IF @SchEmpID IS NOT NULL AND @SchEmpID <= 0
        THROW 50217, N'معرّف الموظف غير صحيح.', 1;

    IF @SchState IS NOT NULL AND @SchState NOT IN (0, 1)
        THROW 50218, N'حالة الربط غير صالحة.', 1;

    SELECT
        S.SchID, S.SchCmp, S.SchEmpID, E.EmpNum, E.EmpName,
        S.SchWCalID, C.WCalName, S.SchStartDate, S.SchEndDate,
        S.SchState, S.SchDateTime, S.SchUser
    FROM dbo.Emp_EmployeeSchedule AS S
    INNER JOIN dbo.Emp_Employee AS E
        ON E.EmpID = S.SchEmpID AND E.EmpCompany = S.SchCmp
    INNER JOIN dbo.Emp_WorkCalendar AS C
        ON C.WCalID = S.SchWCalID AND C.WCalCmp = S.SchCmp
    WHERE S.SchCmp = @SchCmp
      AND (@SchID IS NULL OR S.SchID = @SchID)
      AND (@SchEmpID IS NULL OR S.SchEmpID = @SchEmpID)
      AND (@SchState IS NULL OR S.SchState = @SchState)
    ORDER BY S.SchStartDate DESC;
END;

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Emp_SelectLeaveBalances]
 @CmpID INT,@EmployeeID BIGINT=NULL,@BalanceYear SMALLINT=NULL
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON;
 SELECT b.*,t.LeaveTypeName FROM dbo.Emp_LeaveBalances b JOIN dbo.Emp_LeaveTypes t ON t.LeaveTypeCmp=b.CmpID AND t.LeaveTypeID=b.LeaveTypeID
 WHERE b.CmpID=@CmpID AND (@EmployeeID IS NULL OR b.EmployeeID=@EmployeeID) AND (@BalanceYear IS NULL OR b.BalanceYear=@BalanceYear)
 ORDER BY b.EmployeeID,b.BalanceYear,t.LeaveTypeName;
END;

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Emp_SelectLeaveRequests]
 @CmpID INT,@EmployeeID BIGINT=NULL,@RequestID BIGINT=NULL,@State TINYINT=NULL,@DateFrom DATE=NULL,@DateTo DATE=NULL
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON;
 SELECT r.*,t.LeaveTypeName FROM dbo.Emp_LeaveRequests r JOIN dbo.Emp_LeaveTypes t ON t.LeaveTypeCmp=r.CmpID AND t.LeaveTypeID=r.LeaveTypeID
 WHERE r.CmpID=@CmpID AND (@EmployeeID IS NULL OR r.EmployeeID=@EmployeeID) AND (@RequestID IS NULL OR r.RequestID=@RequestID)
 AND (@State IS NULL OR r.RequestState=@State) AND (@DateFrom IS NULL OR CONVERT(date,r.StartAt)>=@DateFrom) AND (@DateTo IS NULL OR CONVERT(date,r.EndAt)<=@DateTo)
 ORDER BY r.SubmittedAt DESC;
END;

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Emp_SelectNationality]
    @NatCmp   INT,
    @NatID    BIGINT = NULL,
    @NatState TINYINT = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    IF ISNULL(@NatCmp, 0) <= 0
        THROW 50008, N'يجب تحديد الشركة.', 1;

    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_Company WHERE CmpID = @NatCmp)
        THROW 50009, N'الشركة غير موجودة.', 1;

    IF @NatState IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT NatID, NatName, NatCmp, NatState, NatDate, NatUser
        FROM dbo.Emp_Nationality
        WHERE NatCmp = @NatCmp
          AND (@NatID IS NULL OR NatID = @NatID)
        ORDER BY NatName;
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        SELECT NatID, NatName, NatCmp, NatState, NatDate, NatUser
        FROM dbo.Emp_Nationality
        WHERE NatCmp = @NatCmp
          AND NatState = @NatState
          AND (@NatID IS NULL OR NatID = @NatID)
        ORDER BY NatName;
    END;
END;
