CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Emp_SelectPayrollAccountMappings]
 @CmpID INT,@ComponentID BIGINT=NULL,@Date DATE=NULL,@State TINYINT=NULL
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON;
 SELECT m.*,p.ComponentCode,p.ComponentName,a.AccCode,a.AccName,c.CsCCode,c.CsCName
 FROM dbo.Emp_PayrollAccountMappings m
 LEFT JOIN dbo.Emp_PayComponents p ON p.CmpID=m.CmpID AND p.ComponentID=m.ComponentID
 JOIN dbo.Acc_Account a ON a.AccCompany=m.CmpID AND a.AccID=m.AccountID
 LEFT JOIN dbo.Acc_CostCenter c ON c.CsCCompany=m.CmpID AND c.CsCID=m.CostCenterID
 WHERE m.CmpID=@CmpID AND (@ComponentID IS NULL OR m.ComponentID=@ComponentID)
 AND (@Date IS NULL OR (m.EffectiveFrom<=@Date AND (m.EffectiveTo IS NULL OR m.EffectiveTo>=@Date)))
 AND (@State IS NULL OR m.RecordState=@State) ORDER BY m.ComponentID,m.DebitCredit,m.EffectiveFrom DESC;
END;

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Emp_SelectPosition]
    @PosCmp   INT,
    @PosID    BIGINT = NULL,
    @PosState TINYINT = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    IF ISNULL(@PosCmp, 0) <= 0
        THROW 50020, N'يجب تحديد الشركة بشكل صحيح.', 1;

    IF @PosID IS NOT NULL AND @PosID <= 0
        THROW 50032, N'معرّف المنصب غير صحيح.', 1;

    IF @PosState IS NOT NULL AND @PosState NOT IN (0, 1)
        THROW 50023, N'حالة المنصب غير صالحة.', 1;

    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_Company WHERE CmpID = @PosCmp)
        THROW 50024, N'الشركة غير موجودة.', 1;

    IF @PosState IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT
            P.PosID, P.PosName, P.PosCmp,
            P.EmpOrgStrID, O.EmpOrgStrName,
            P.EmpJobID, J.EmpJobName,
            P.SpyID, S.SpyName,
            P.EduQualID, E.EduQualName,
            P.SchTypeID, W.SchTypeName,
            P.PosState, P.PosDate, P.PosUser, U.UsrLogIn AS PosUserName
        FROM dbo.Emp_Position AS P
        INNER JOIN dbo.Emp_OrganigramStructure AS O ON O.EmpOrgStrCompany = P.PosCmp AND O.EmpOrgStrID = P.EmpOrgStrID
        INNER JOIN dbo.Emp_JobTitles AS J ON J.EmpJobCompany = P.PosCmp AND J.EmpJobID = P.EmpJobID
        LEFT JOIN dbo.Emp_Specialty AS S ON S.SpyCmp = P.PosCmp AND S.SpyID = P.SpyID
        LEFT JOIN dbo.Emp_EducationalQualifications AS E ON E.EduQualCmp = P.PosCmp AND E.EduQualID = P.EduQualID
        INNER JOIN dbo.Emp_WorkScheduleTypes AS W ON W.SchTypeCmp = P.PosCmp AND W.SchTypeID = P.SchTypeID
        LEFT JOIN dbo.Mng_User AS U ON U.UsrID = P.PosUser
        WHERE P.PosCmp = @PosCmp
          AND (@PosID IS NULL OR P.PosID = @PosID)
        ORDER BY P.PosName ASC;
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        SELECT
            P.PosID, P.PosName, P.PosCmp,
            P.EmpOrgStrID, O.EmpOrgStrName,
            P.EmpJobID, J.EmpJobName,
            P.SpyID, S.SpyName,
            P.EduQualID, E.EduQualName,
            P.SchTypeID, W.SchTypeName,
            P.PosState, P.PosDate, P.PosUser, U.UsrLogIn AS PosUserName
        FROM dbo.Emp_Position AS P
        INNER JOIN dbo.Emp_OrganigramStructure AS O ON O.EmpOrgStrCompany = P.PosCmp AND O.EmpOrgStrID = P.EmpOrgStrID
        INNER JOIN dbo.Emp_JobTitles AS J ON J.EmpJobCompany = P.PosCmp AND J.EmpJobID = P.EmpJobID
        LEFT JOIN dbo.Emp_Specialty AS S ON S.SpyCmp = P.PosCmp AND S.SpyID = P.SpyID
        LEFT JOIN dbo.Emp_EducationalQualifications AS E ON E.EduQualCmp = P.PosCmp AND E.EduQualID = P.EduQualID
        INNER JOIN dbo.Emp_WorkScheduleTypes AS W ON W.SchTypeCmp = P.PosCmp AND W.SchTypeID = P.SchTypeID
        LEFT JOIN dbo.Mng_User AS U ON U.UsrID = P.PosUser
        WHERE P.PosCmp = @PosCmp
          AND P.PosState = @PosState
          AND (@PosID IS NULL OR P.PosID = @PosID)
        ORDER BY P.PosName ASC;
    END;
END;
GO

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Emp_SelectSalary]
    @EmpCompany INT,
    @EmpID      BIGINT,
    @OnlyActive BIT = 0
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    IF ISNULL(@EmpCompany, 0) <= 0 THROW 50260, N'معرف الشركة غير صالح.', 1;
    IF ISNULL(@EmpID, 0) <= 0      THROW 50261, N'معرف الموظف غير صالح.', 1;

    SELECT S.SalID, S.EmpCompany, S.EmpID, S.SalAmount, S.SalCurrencyID,
           CU.CurCode, CU.CurName,
           dbo.fn_Acc_GetExchangeRate(S.EmpCompany, S.SalCurrencyID, S.SalStartDate) AS RateAtStart,
           S.SalAmount * dbo.fn_Acc_GetExchangeRate(S.EmpCompany, S.SalCurrencyID, S.SalStartDate) AS SalAmountBase,
           S.SalStartDate, S.SalEndDate,
           CAST(CASE WHEN S.SalEndDate IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BIT) AS IsActive,
           S.SalUser, U.UsrLogIn AS SalUserName, S.SalDateTime
    FROM dbo.Emp_Salary AS S
    INNER JOIN dbo.Acc_Currency AS CU ON CU.CurCmp = S.EmpCompany AND CU.CurID = S.SalCurrencyID
    LEFT JOIN dbo.Mng_User AS U ON U.UsrID = S.SalUser
    WHERE S.EmpCompany = @EmpCompany AND S.EmpID = @EmpID
      AND (@OnlyActive = 0 OR S.SalEndDate IS NULL)
    ORDER BY S.SalStartDate DESC;
END;
GO

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Emp_SelectWorkCalendar]
    @WCalCmp   INT,
    @WCalID    BIGINT = NULL,
    @WCalState TINYINT = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    IF ISNULL(@WCalCmp, 0) <= 0
        THROW 50010, N'يجب تحديد الشركة بشكل صحيح.', 1;

    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_Company WHERE CmpID = @WCalCmp)
        THROW 50013, N'الشركة غير موجودة.', 1;

    IF @WCalID IS NOT NULL AND @WCalID <= 0
        THROW 50011, N'معرّف التقويم غير صحيح.', 1;

    IF @WCalState IS NOT NULL AND @WCalState NOT IN (0, 1)
        THROW 50012, N'حالة التقويم غير صالحة.', 1;

    IF @WCalState IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT WCalID, WCalCmp, WCalName, WCalStartDate, WCalEndDate, WCalState, WCalDateTime, WCalUser
        FROM dbo.Emp_WorkCalendar
        WHERE WCalCmp = @WCalCmp
          AND (@WCalID IS NULL OR WCalID = @WCalID)
        ORDER BY WCalStartDate DESC;
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        SELECT WCalID, WCalCmp, WCalName, WCalStartDate, WCalEndDate, WCalState, WCalDateTime, WCalUser
        FROM dbo.Emp_WorkCalendar
        WHERE WCalCmp = @WCalCmp
          AND WCalState = @WCalState
          AND (@WCalID IS NULL OR WCalID = @WCalID)
        ORDER BY WCalStartDate DESC;
    END;
END;

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Emp_SelectWorkCalendarDetails]
    @WCalDetCmp    INT,
    @WCalDetWCalID BIGINT,
    @WCalDetDate   DATE = NULL,
    @WCalDetType   TINYINT = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    IF ISNULL(@WCalDetCmp, 0) <= 0
        THROW 50111, N'يجب تحديد الشركة بشكل صحيح.', 1;

    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_Company WHERE CmpID = @WCalDetCmp)
        THROW 50112, N'الشركة غير موجودة.', 1;

    IF ISNULL(@WCalDetWCalID, 0) <= 0
        THROW 50113, N'معرّف التقويم غير صحيح.', 1;

    IF @WCalDetType IS NOT NULL AND @WCalDetType NOT IN (1, 2)
        THROW 50114, N'نوع اليوم غير صالح.', 1;

    IF NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_WorkCalendar
        WHERE WCalID = @WCalDetWCalID AND WCalCmp = @WCalDetCmp
    )
        THROW 50115, N'التقويم غير موجود أو لا يتبع للشركة.', 1;

    SELECT WCalDetID, WCalDetCmp, WCalDetWCalID, WCalDetDate, WCalDetType,
           WCalDetSchTypeID, WCalDetName, WCalDetDateTime, WCalDetUser
    FROM dbo.Emp_WorkCalendarDetails
    WHERE WCalDetCmp = @WCalDetCmp
      AND WCalDetWCalID = @WCalDetWCalID
      AND (@WCalDetDate IS NULL OR WCalDetDate = @WCalDetDate)
      AND (@WCalDetType IS NULL OR WCalDetType = @WCalDetType)
    ORDER BY WCalDetDate;
END;

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Emp_SelectWorkScheduleTypes]
    @SchTypeCmp   INT,

AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    IF ISNULL(@SchTypeCmp, 0) <= 0

    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_Company WHERE CmpID = @SchTypeCmp)

    IF @SchTypeState IS NULL

        FROM dbo.Emp_WorkScheduleTypes AS S

        WHERE S.SchTypeCmp = @SchTypeCmp
          AND (@SchTypeID IS NULL OR S.SchTypeID = @SchTypeID)
        ORDER BY S.SchTypeName ASC;
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        SELECT S.SchTypeID, S.SchTypeName, S.SchTypeCmp, S.SchStartTime, S.SchEndTime,
               S.SchWorkingHours, S.SchGraceMinutes, S.SchIsNightShift, S.SchCrossesMidnight,

        LEFT JOIN dbo.Mng_User AS U ON U.UsrID = S.SchTypeUser

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Emp_UpdateAttendanceDeviceSyncLog]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

/* =========================================================
   7. UPDATE SYNC LOG
   ========================================================= */

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Emp_UpdateAttendanceDeviceSyncLog]
    @CmpID INT,
    @SyncID BIGINT,
    @Status TINYINT,
    @ReceivedCount INT,
    @InsertedCount INT,
    @DuplicateCount INT,
    @RejectedCount INT,
    @Error NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL,
    @UserID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    IF @Status IS NULL OR @Status NOT IN (1,2,3,4)
        THROW 52610, N'حالة المزامنة المطلوبة غير صحيحة.', 1;

    IF @ReceivedCount IS NULL OR @ReceivedCount < 0
       OR @InsertedCount IS NULL OR @InsertedCount < 0
       OR @DuplicateCount IS NULL OR @DuplicateCount < 0
       OR @RejectedCount IS NULL OR @RejectedCount < 0
        THROW 52611, N'أعداد الحركات لا يمكن أن تكون سالبة أو فارغة.', 1;

    IF @InsertedCount + CONVERT(BIGINT, @DuplicateCount)
       + CONVERT(BIGINT, @RejectedCount) > @ReceivedCount
        THROW 52612, N'مجموع الحركات المدخلة والمكررة والمرفوضة يتجاوز عدد الحركات المستلمة.', 1;

    UPDATE dbo.Emp_AttendanceDeviceSyncLog
    SET
        SyncStatus = @Status,
        SyncFinishedAt = SYSDATETIME(),
        SyncReceivedCount = @ReceivedCount,
        SyncInsertedCount = @InsertedCount,
        SyncDuplicateCount = @DuplicateCount,
        SyncRejectedCount = @RejectedCount,
        SyncError = NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@Error)), N'')
    WHERE SyncCmp = @CmpID
      AND SyncID = @SyncID
      AND SyncStatus = 0;

    IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0
        THROW 52613, N'عملية المزامنة غير موجودة أو سبق إنهاؤها.', 1;
END;

GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Emp_UpdateAttendanceProcessingLog]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

/* =========================================================
   6. UPDATE PROCESSING LOG
   ========================================================= */

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Emp_UpdateAttendanceProcessingLog]
    @CmpID INT,
    @ProcID BIGINT,
    @Status TINYINT,
    @ReceivedCount INT,
    @ProcessedCount INT,
    @SkippedCount INT,
    @FailedCount INT,
    @Error NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL,
    @UserID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;

    IF @Status IS NULL OR @Status NOT IN (1,2,3,4)
        THROW 53006, N'حالة المعالجة النهائية غير صحيحة.', 1;

    IF @ReceivedCount < 0
       OR @ProcessedCount < 0
       OR @SkippedCount < 0
       OR @FailedCount < 0
       OR @ProcessedCount > @ReceivedCount
       OR @SkippedCount > @ReceivedCount
       OR @FailedCount > @ReceivedCount
        THROW 53007, N'أعداد الحركات المسجلة غير صحيحة.', 1;

    IF @ProcessedCount + @SkippedCount + @FailedCount
       <> @ReceivedCount
        THROW 53008, N'مجموع الحركات المعالجة والمستبعدة والفاشلة يجب أن يساوي إجمالي الحركات.', 1;

    UPDATE dbo.Emp_AttendanceProcessingLog
    SET
        ProcStatus = @Status,
        ProcReceivedCount = @ReceivedCount,
        ProcProcessedCount = @ProcessedCount,
        ProcSkippedCount = @SkippedCount,
        ProcFailedCount = @FailedCount,
        ProcError = @Error,
        ProcFinishedAt = SYSDATETIME()
    WHERE ProcCmp = @CmpID
      AND ProcID = @ProcID
      AND ProcStatus = 0;

    IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0
        THROW 53009, N'سجل المعالجة غير موجود أو سبق إنهاؤه.', 1;
END;

GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Emp_UpdateEmployee]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Emp_UpdateEmployee]
    @EmpID BIGINT,
    @EmpNum NVARCHAR(10),
    @EmpName NVARCHAR(50),
    @EmpPic VARBINARY(MAX)=NULL,
    @EmpState TINYINT,
    @EmpUser BIGINT=NULL,
    @EmpCompany INT=NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @EmpCompany,@EmpUser;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;

        IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_Employee WITH (UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE EmpID=@EmpID AND EmpCompany=@EmpCompany)
            THROW 51600,N'الموظف المطلوب تعديله غير موجود.',1;

        UPDATE dbo.Emp_Employee
        SET EmpNum=@EmpNum,
            EmpName=@EmpName,
            EmpPic=COALESCE(@EmpPic,EmpPic),
            EmpState=@EmpState,
            EmpDateTime=GETDATE(),
            EmpUser=@EmpUser
        WHERE EmpID=@EmpID AND EmpCompany=@EmpCompany;

        IF @EmpState<>0
            UPDATE dbo.Mng_User
            SET UsrState=1, UsrDateTime=GETDATE()
            WHERE UsrID=@EmpID AND UsrState=0;

        COMMIT;
        SELECT CAST(1 AS BIT) AS Success;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK;
        THROW;
    END CATCH
END;
GO

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Emp_UpdateStateAttendanceException]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

/* =========================================================
   7. UPDATE EXCEPTION STATE
   ========================================================= */

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Emp_UpdateStateAttendanceException]
    @CmpID INT,
    @ExcID BIGINT,
    @State TINYINT,
    @UserID BIGINT,
    @Resolution NVARCHAR(500) = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;

    IF @State IS NULL OR @State NOT IN (1,2,3)
        THROW 53112, N'حالة الاستثناء المطلوبة غير صحيحة.', 1;

    IF NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1
        FROM dbo.Mng_User
        WHERE UsrID = @UserID
    )
        THROW 53113, N'المستخدم غير موجود.', 1;

    IF @State = 2
       AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@Resolution)), N'') IS NULL
        THROW 53114, N'يجب إدخال نتيجة المعالجة قبل إغلاق الاستثناء.', 1;

    UPDATE dbo.Emp_AttendanceExceptions
    SET
        ExcState = @State,
        ExcResolution =
            CASE WHEN @State = 2
                 THEN LTRIM(RTRIM(@Resolution))
                 ELSE NULL
            END,
        ExcResolvedAt =
            CASE WHEN @State = 2
                 THEN SYSDATETIME()
                 ELSE NULL
            END,
        ExcResolvedBy =
            CASE WHEN @State = 2
                 THEN @UserID
                 ELSE NULL
            END
    WHERE ExcCmp = @CmpID
      AND ExcID = @ExcID
      AND ExcState IN (0,1);

    IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0
        THROW 53115, N'الاستثناء غير موجود أو لا يمكن تغيير حالته.', 1;
END;

GO

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Emp_UpdateStateEmployeeSchedule]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Emp_UpdateStateEmployeeSchedule]
    @SchID    BIGINT,
    @SchCmp   INT,
    @SchState TINYINT,
    @SchUser  BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
    SET XACT_ABORT OFF;

    IF ISNULL(@SchID, 0) <= 0
        THROW 50219, N'معرّف الربط غير صحيح.', 1;

    IF ISNULL(@SchCmp, 0) <= 0
        THROW 50220, N'يجب تحديد الشركة بشكل صحيح.', 1;

    IF @SchState IS NULL OR @SchState NOT IN (0, 1)
        THROW 50221, N'حالة الربط غير صالحة.', 1;

    IF ISNULL(@SchUser, 0) <= 0
        THROW 50222, N'يجب تحديد المستخدم.', 1;

    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_Company WHERE CmpID = @SchCmp)
        THROW 50223, N'الشركة غير موجودة.', 1;

    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_User WHERE UsrID = @SchUser)
        THROW 50224, N'المستخدم غير موجود.', 1;

    DECLARE @TranStarted BIT = 0;
    DECLARE @EmpID BIGINT;
    DECLARE @StartDate DATE;
    DECLARE @EndDate DATE;

    BEGIN TRY
        IF @@TRANCOUNT = 0
        BEGIN
            BEGIN TRANSACTION;
            SET @TranStarted = 1;
        END
        ELSE
            SAVE TRANSACTION SaveEmpSchState;

        SELECT @EmpID = SchEmpID, @StartDate = SchStartDate, @EndDate = SchEndDate
        FROM dbo.Emp_EmployeeSchedule WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
        WHERE SchID = @SchID AND SchCmp = @SchCmp;

        IF @EmpID IS NULL
            THROW 50225, N'ربط الموظف بالتقويم غير موجود.', 1;

        IF @SchState = 1
        BEGIN
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT 1
                FROM dbo.Emp_EmployeeSchedule WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
                WHERE SchCmp = @SchCmp
                  AND SchEmpID = @EmpID
                  AND SchState = 1
                  AND SchID <> @SchID
                  AND SchStartDate <= ISNULL(@EndDate, CONVERT(DATE, '99991231'))
                  AND (SchEndDate IS NULL OR SchEndDate >= @StartDate)
            )
                THROW 50226, N'توجد فترة تقويم أخرى متداخلة للموظف.', 1;
        END;

        UPDATE dbo.Emp_EmployeeSchedule
        SET SchState = @SchState,
            SchDateTime = SYSDATETIME(),
            SchUser = @SchUser
        WHERE SchID = @SchID AND SchCmp = @SchCmp;

        IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0
            THROW 50227, N'تعذر تحديث حالة الربط.', 1;

        IF @TranStarted = 1
            COMMIT TRANSACTION;

    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @TranStarted = 1 AND XACT_STATE() <> 0
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        ELSE IF @TranStarted = 0 AND XACT_STATE() = 1
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION SaveEmpSchState;

        THROW;
    END CATCH
END;
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Emp_UpdateStatePosition]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Emp_UpdateStatePosition]
    @PosID      BIGINT,
    @PosCmp     INT,
    @PosState   TINYINT,
    @PosUser    BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @PosCmp,@PosUser;
    SET XACT_ABORT OFF;

    IF ISNULL(@PosID, 0) <= 0
        THROW 50032, N'معرّف المنصب غير صحيح.', 1;

    IF ISNULL(@PosCmp, 0) <= 0
        THROW 50020, N'يجب تحديد الشركة بشكل صحيح.', 1;

    IF ISNULL(@PosUser, 0) <= 0
        THROW 50022, N'يجب تحديد مستخدم النظام.', 1;

    IF @PosState IS NULL OR @PosState NOT IN (0, 1)
        THROW 50023, N'حالة المنصب غير صالحة.', 1;

    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_Company WHERE CmpID = @PosCmp)
        THROW 50024, N'الشركة غير موجودة.', 1;

    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_User WHERE UsrID = @PosUser)
        THROW 50025, N'مستخدم النظام غير موجود.', 1;

    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_Position WHERE PosID = @PosID AND PosCmp = @PosCmp)
        THROW 50031, N'المنصب غير موجود أو لا يتبع لهذه الشركة.', 1;

    DECLARE @TranStarted INT = 0;

    BEGIN TRY
        IF @@TRANCOUNT = 0
        BEGIN
            BEGIN TRANSACTION;
            SET @TranStarted = 1;
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            SAVE TRANSACTION SavePoint_UpdateState_Pos;
        END

        UPDATE dbo.Emp_Position
        SET PosState = @PosState,
            PosDate  = SYSDATETIME(),
            PosUser  = @PosUser
        WHERE PosID = @PosID AND PosCmp = @PosCmp;

        IF @TranStarted = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT > 0
            COMMIT TRANSACTION;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @TranStarted = 1
        BEGIN
            IF XACT_STATE() <> 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        END
        ELSE IF XACT_STATE() = 1
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION SavePoint_UpdateState_Pos;

        THROW;
    END CATCH
END;
GO

SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

/* =========================================================
   1. Mng_DeleteSystem
   ========================================================= */
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Mng_DeleteSystem]
    @SysID TINYINT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;

        IF NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_System WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
            WHERE SysID = @SysID
        )
            THROW 51202, N'المنظومة المطلوب حذفها غير موجودة.', 1;

        IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_SystemMenu WHERE SysMSysID = @SysID)
            THROW 51203, N'لا يمكن حذف المنظومة قبل حذف قوائمها.', 1;

        IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_UserParmations WHERE USPSystemID = @SysID)
            THROW 51204, N'لا يمكن حذف المنظومة لوجود سجلات صلاحيات مرتبطة بها.', 1;

        IF EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM dbo.Mng_Company c
            CROSS APPLY STRING_SPLIT(COALESCE(c.CmpSystems,N''),N',') ss
            WHERE TRY_CONVERT(INT,LTRIM(RTRIM(ss.value))) = @SysID
        )
            THROW 51205, N'لا يمكن حذف المنظومة؛ ما زالت مرتبطة بإحدى الشركات.', 1;

        DELETE dbo.Mng_System WHERE SysID = @SysID;

        COMMIT;
        SELECT CAST(1 AS BIT) AS Success;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF XACT_STATE() <> 0 ROLLBACK;
        THROW;
    END CATCH
END;
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Mng_DeleteSystemMenu]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

/* =========================================================
   2. Mng_DeleteSystemMenu
   ========================================================= */
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Mng_DeleteSystemMenu]
    @SysMSysID TINYINT,
    @SysMID TINYINT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;

        IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_System WHERE SysID=@SysMSysID)
            THROW 51309, N'المنظومة المحددة للقائمة غير موجودة.', 1;

        IF NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_SystemMenu WITH (UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK)
            WHERE SysMSysID=@SysMSysID AND SysMID=@SysMID
        )
            THROW 51310, N'القائمة المطلوب حذفها غير موجودة.', 1;

        IF EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_SystemMenu
            WHERE SysMSysID=@SysMSysID AND SysMParent=@SysMID
        )
            THROW 51311, N'لا يمكن حذف القائمة قبل نقل قوائمها الفرعية أو حذفها.', 1;

        IF EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM dbo.Mng_UserParmations p
            CROSS APPLY STRING_SPLIT(COALESCE(p.USPParmations,N''),N',') ss
            WHERE p.USPSystemID=@SysMSysID
              AND TRY_CONVERT(INT,LTRIM(RTRIM(ss.value)))=@SysMID
        )
            THROW 51312, N'لا يمكن حذف القائمة لأنها موجودة في صلاحيات مستخدمين.', 1;

        DELETE dbo.Mng_SystemMenu
        WHERE SysMSysID=@SysMSysID AND SysMID=@SysMID;

        COMMIT;
        SELECT CAST(1 AS BIT) AS Success;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF XACT_STATE() <> 0 ROLLBACK;
        THROW;
    END CATCH
END;

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Mng_GetCompanyFiscalYears]
    @UsrID BIGINT,
    @CmpID INT,
    @ActiveState TINYINT = 0
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    SELECT f.AccFYear
    FROM dbo.Acc_FiscalYear AS f
    WHERE f.AccFCmpID = @CmpID
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM dbo.Mng_UserParmations p
          WHERE p.USPUserID = @UsrID
            AND p.USPCompanyID = @CmpID
            AND p.USPState = @ActiveState
      )
    ORDER BY f.AccFYear DESC;      -- الأحدث أولًا ليكون الاختيار المبدئي
END;
GO

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Mng_GetFiscalYearNeighbors]
    @UsrID BIGINT,
    @CmpID INT,
    @Year  INT,
    @ActiveState TINYINT = 0
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    SELECT
        (SELECT MAX(f.AccFYear) FROM dbo.Acc_FiscalYear f
          WHERE f.AccFCmpID = @CmpID AND f.AccFYear < @Year) AS PrevYear,
        (SELECT MIN(f.AccFYear) FROM dbo.Acc_FiscalYear f
          WHERE f.AccFCmpID = @CmpID AND f.AccFYear > @Year) AS NextYear
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM dbo.Mng_UserParmations p
        WHERE p.USPUserID = @UsrID
          AND p.USPCompanyID = @CmpID
          AND p.USPState = @ActiveState
    );
END;

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Mng_GetSystemNotifications]
    @Company INT,
    @System  TINYINT,
    @User    BIGINT,
    @Year    INT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- منظومة الحسابات
    IF @System = 1
    BEGIN
        DECLARE @From DATE = DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, 1, 1),
                @To   DATE = DATEFROMPARTS(@Year + 1, 1, 1);

        ;WITH Counts AS
        (
            SELECT
                DayMState,
                COUNT(*) AS DayCount
            FROM dbo.Acc_DayMaster
            WHERE DayMCompany = @Company
              AND DayMDate >= @From
              AND DayMDate <  @To
              -- المسودات خاصة بصاحبها فقط
              AND (DayMState <> 0 OR DayMUser = @User)
            GROUP BY DayMState
        )
        SELECT
            N.NafStateID,
            N.NafName AS NafState,
            C.DayCount AS NafCount,
            N.NafPage,
            N.NafBadge
        FROM dbo.Mng_Notifications AS N
        JOIN Counts AS C
            ON C.DayMState = N.NafStateID
        CROSS APPLY dbo.Acc_UserCanAct(@Company, @User, N.NafStateID) AS U
        WHERE N.NafSystem = @System
          AND N.NafActive = 1
          AND C.DayCount > 0
          AND U.Allowed = 1          -- يملك قائمة الحالة
        ORDER BY N.NafStateID;

        RETURN;
    END;

    -- باقي المنظومات: تُضاف هنا، وإلى ذلك يُعاد جدول فارغ بنفس الأعمدة
    SELECT
        CAST(NULL AS TINYINT)       AS NafStateID,
        CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(200)) AS NafState,
        CAST(0 AS INT)              AS NafCount,
        CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(260)) AS NafPage,
        CAST(0 AS BIT)              AS NafBadge
    WHERE 1 = 0;
END;

GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Mng_GetUserCompanies]
    @UsrID BIGINT,
    @ActiveState TINYINT = 0
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    SELECT c.CmpID, c.CmpName, c.CmpEName, c.CmpLogo, c.CmpState,
           fy.AccFYear AS LastFiscalYear          -- NULL إن لم تكن للشركة سنة مالية
    FROM dbo.Mng_Company AS c
    OUTER APPLY
    (
        SELECT TOP (1) f.AccFYear
        FROM dbo.Acc_FiscalYear AS f
        WHERE f.AccFCmpID = c.CmpID
        ORDER BY f.AccFYear DESC
    ) AS fy
    WHERE c.CmpState = @ActiveState
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM dbo.Mng_UserParmations p
          INNER JOIN dbo.Mng_User u ON u.UsrID = p.USPUserID
          INNER JOIN dbo.Mng_System s ON s.SysID = p.USPSystemID
          INNER JOIN dbo.Emp_Employee e ON e.EmpID = u.UsrID AND e.EmpState = 0
          WHERE p.USPUserID = @UsrID
            AND p.USPCompanyID = c.CmpID
            AND p.USPState = @ActiveState
            AND u.UsrState = @ActiveState
            AND s.SysState = @ActiveState
            AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM STRING_SPLIT(COALESCE(c.CmpSystems, N''), N',') ss
                WHERE TRY_CONVERT(INT, LTRIM(RTRIM(ss.value))) = p.USPSystemID
            )
      )
    ORDER BY c.CmpName, c.CmpID;
END;

/* =========================================================
   9. Mng_GetUserMenu
   ========================================================= */
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Mng_GetUserMenu]
    @USPUserID BIGINT,
    @USPCompanyID INT,
    @USPSystemID TINYINT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    ;WITH DirectAllowed AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT TRY_CONVERT(TINYINT,LTRIM(RTRIM(ss.value))) SysMID
        FROM dbo.Mng_UserParmations p
        CROSS APPLY STRING_SPLIT(COALESCE(p.USPParmations,N''),N',') ss
        WHERE p.USPUserID=@USPUserID
          AND p.USPCompanyID=@USPCompanyID
          AND p.USPSystemID=@USPSystemID
          AND TRY_CONVERT(TINYINT,LTRIM(RTRIM(ss.value))) IS NOT NULL
    ),
    MenuAndParents AS (
        SELECT m.SysMSysID,m.SysMID,m.SysMParent
        FROM dbo.Mng_SystemMenu m
        INNER JOIN DirectAllowed d ON d.SysMID=m.SysMID
        WHERE m.SysMSysID=@USPSystemID

        UNION ALL

        SELECT p.SysMSysID,p.SysMID,p.SysMParent
        FROM dbo.Mng_SystemMenu p
        INNER JOIN MenuAndParents ch
          ON p.SysMSysID=ch.SysMSysID
         AND p.SysMID=ch.SysMParent
        WHERE ch.SysMParent>0
    )
    SELECT DISTINCT m.SysMID,m.SysMSysID,m.SysMParent,
           m.SysMName,m.SysMEName,m.SysMLogo,m.SysMMap,
           m.SysMState,m.SysMDateTime
    FROM dbo.Mng_SystemMenu m
    INNER JOIN MenuAndParents ap
      ON ap.SysMSysID=m.SysMSysID AND ap.SysMID=m.SysMID
    WHERE m.SysMSysID=@USPSystemID
    ORDER BY m.SysMParent,m.SysMID
    OPTION (MAXRECURSION 255);
END;
GO

/* =========================================================
   10. Mng_GetUserMenuForNavigation
   ========================================================= */
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Mng_GetUserMenuForNavigation]
    @USPUserID BIGINT,
    @USPCompanyID INT,
    @USPSystemID TINYINT,
    @ActiveState TINYINT=1
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    ;WITH DirectAllowed AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT TRY_CONVERT(TINYINT,LTRIM(RTRIM(ss.value))) SysMID
        FROM dbo.Mng_UserParmations p
        INNER JOIN dbo.Mng_User u ON u.UsrID=p.USPUserID
        INNER JOIN dbo.Emp_Employee e ON e.EmpID=u.UsrID AND e.EmpState=0
        INNER JOIN dbo.Mng_Company c ON c.CmpID=p.USPCompanyID
        INNER JOIN dbo.Mng_System s ON s.SysID=p.USPSystemID
        CROSS APPLY STRING_SPLIT(COALESCE(p.USPParmations,N''),N',') ss
        WHERE p.USPUserID=@USPUserID
          AND p.USPCompanyID=@USPCompanyID
          AND p.USPSystemID=@USPSystemID
          AND p.USPState=@ActiveState
          AND u.UsrState=@ActiveState
          AND c.CmpState=@ActiveState
          AND s.SysState=@ActiveState
          AND TRY_CONVERT(TINYINT,LTRIM(RTRIM(ss.value))) IS NOT NULL
    ),
    MenuAndParents AS (
        SELECT m.SysMSysID,m.SysMID,m.SysMParent
        FROM dbo.Mng_SystemMenu m
        INNER JOIN DirectAllowed d ON d.SysMID=m.SysMID
        WHERE m.SysMSysID=@USPSystemID AND m.SysMState=@ActiveState

        UNION ALL

        SELECT p.SysMSysID,p.SysMID,p.SysMParent
        FROM dbo.Mng_SystemMenu p
        INNER JOIN MenuAndParents ch
          ON p.SysMSysID=ch.SysMSysID AND p.SysMID=ch.SysMParent
        WHERE ch.SysMParent>0 AND p.SysMState=@ActiveState
    ),
    VisibleMenus AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT m.SysMSysID,m.SysMID,m.SysMParent,m.SysMName,
               m.SysMEName,m.SysMLogo,m.SysMMap,m.SysMState,m.SysMDateTime
        FROM dbo.Mng_SystemMenu m
        INNER JOIN MenuAndParents v
          ON v.SysMSysID=m.SysMSysID AND v.SysMID=m.SysMID
        WHERE m.SysMSysID=@USPSystemID AND m.SysMState=@ActiveState
    ),
    MenuTree AS (
        SELECT v.SysMID,v.SysMSysID,v.SysMParent,v.SysMName,v.SysMEName,
               v.SysMLogo,v.SysMMap,v.SysMState,v.SysMDateTime,
               CAST(RIGHT(N'000'+CONVERT(NVARCHAR(3),v.SysMID),3) AS NVARCHAR(1000)) SortPath,
               CAST(0 AS INT) MenuLevel
        FROM VisibleMenus v
        WHERE COALESCE(v.SysMParent,0)=0

        UNION ALL

        SELECT c.SysMID,c.SysMSysID,c.SysMParent,c.SysMName,c.SysMEName,
               c.SysMLogo,c.SysMMap,c.SysMState,c.SysMDateTime,
               CAST(p.SortPath+N'.'+RIGHT(N'000'+CONVERT(NVARCHAR(3),c.SysMID),3) AS NVARCHAR(1000)),
               p.MenuLevel+1
        FROM VisibleMenus c
        INNER JOIN MenuTree p
          ON c.SysMSysID=p.SysMSysID AND c.SysMParent=p.SysMID
    )
    SELECT SysMID,SysMSysID,SysMParent,SysMName,SysMEName,
           SysMLogo,SysMMap,SysMState,SysMDateTime,MenuLevel
    FROM MenuTree
    ORDER BY SortPath
    OPTION (MAXRECURSION 255);
END;
GO

/* =========================================================
   11. Mng_GetUserSystemsForCompany
   ========================================================= */
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Mng_GetUserSystemsForCompany]
    @UsrID BIGINT,
    @CmpID INT,
    @ActiveState TINYINT=1
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    SELECT s.SysID,s.SysName,s.SysEName,s.SysLogo,s.SysState
    FROM dbo.Mng_System s
    WHERE s.SysState=@ActiveState
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM dbo.Mng_UserParmations p
          INNER JOIN dbo.Mng_User u ON u.UsrID=p.USPUserID
          INNER JOIN dbo.Emp_Employee e ON e.EmpID=u.UsrID AND e.EmpState=0
          INNER JOIN dbo.Mng_Company c ON c.CmpID=p.USPCompanyID
          WHERE p.USPUserID=@UsrID
            AND p.USPCompanyID=@CmpID
            AND p.USPSystemID=s.SysID
            AND p.USPState=@ActiveState
            AND u.UsrState=@ActiveState
            AND c.CmpState=@ActiveState
            AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM STRING_SPLIT(COALESCE(c.CmpSystems,N''),N',') ss
                WHERE TRY_CONVERT(INT,LTRIM(RTRIM(ss.value)))=s.SysID
            )
      )
    ORDER BY s.SysID;
END;
GO

SET ANSI_NULLS ON

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Mng_InsertCompany]
    @CmpName NVARCHAR(255) = NULL,
    @CmpEName NVARCHAR(255) = NULL,
    @CmpCode NVARCHAR(3) = NULL,
    @CmpLogo VARBINARY(MAX) = NULL,
    @CmpState TINYINT = NULL,
    @CmpDateTime DATETIME = NULL,
    @CmpUser BIGINT = NULL,
    @CmpSystems NVARCHAR(500) = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    SET @CmpSystems = NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@CmpSystems)), N'');
    SET @CmpCode = NULLIF(UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(@CmpCode))), N'');

    DECLARE @Now DATETIME = GETDATE();
    DECLARE @FiscalYear INT = YEAR(@Now);
    DECLARE @NewID BIGINT;
    DECLARE @CmpID INT;

    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;

        -- حجز جدول الشركات لمنع تعارض الإدخال المتزامن
        SELECT @NewID = ISNULL(MAX(CONVERT(BIGINT, CmpID)), 0) + 1
        FROM dbo.Mng_Company WITH (TABLOCKX, HOLDLOCK);

        -- منشئ الشركة إلزامي (يُنسب إليه الدليل والتهيئة)
        IF ISNULL(@CmpUser, 0) <= 0
           OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_User WHERE UsrID = @CmpUser)
            THROW 51104, N'منشئ الشركة إلزامي ويجب أن يكون مستخدماً موجوداً.', 1;

        -- التحقق من رمز الشركة
        IF @CmpCode IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            IF LEN(@CmpCode) <> 3
               OR @CmpCode COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2
                  LIKE N'%[^A-Z]%'
            BEGIN
                THROW 51100,
                    N'رمز الشركة يجب أن يتكون من ثلاثة أحرف إنجليزية كبيرة فقط.',
                    1;
            END;

            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT 1
                FROM dbo.Mng_Company
                WHERE CmpCode = @CmpCode
            )
            BEGIN
                THROW 51101,
                    N'رمز الشركة مستخدم مسبقاً، يرجى اختيار رمز آخر.',
                    1;
            END;
        END;

        -- التحقق من صحة المنظومات المدخلة
        IF @CmpSystems IS NOT NULL
           AND EXISTS
           (
               SELECT 1
               FROM STRING_SPLIT(@CmpSystems, N',') ss
               CROSS APPLY
               (
                   SELECT TRY_CONVERT(INT, LTRIM(RTRIM(ss.value))) AS ID
               ) x
               WHERE x.ID IS NULL
                  OR x.ID NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 255
                  OR NOT EXISTS
                  (
                      SELECT 1
                      FROM dbo.Mng_System s
                      WHERE s.SysID = x.ID
                  )
           )
        BEGIN
            THROW 51102,
                N'قائمة المنظومات تحتوي على معرّف غير صحيح أو منظومة غير موجودة.',
                1;
        END;

        -- المنظومات الأساسية لكل شركة + ما اختاره المستخدم (بلا تكرار)
        SELECT @CmpSystems = STRING_AGG(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), u.ID), N',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY u.ID)
        FROM
        (
            SELECT TRY_CONVERT(INT, LTRIM(RTRIM(ss.value))) AS ID
            FROM STRING_SPLIT(ISNULL(@CmpSystems, N''), N',') ss
            WHERE TRY_CONVERT(INT, LTRIM(RTRIM(ss.value))) IS NOT NULL
            UNION
            SELECT ID FROM (VALUES (1), (4), (11), (12), (21), (22)) AS b(ID)
        ) AS u;

        -- التحقق من الحد الأعلى لمعرف الشركة
        IF @NewID > 2147483647
        BEGIN
            THROW 51103,
                N'تم بلوغ الحد الأعلى لمعرّف الشركة.',
                1;
        END;

        SET @CmpID = CONVERT(INT, @NewID);

        -- إضافة الشركة
        INSERT INTO dbo.Mng_Company
        (
            CmpID, CmpName, CmpEName, CmpCode, CmpLogo,
            CmpState, CmpDateTime, CmpUser, CmpSystems
        )
        VALUES
        (
            @CmpID, @CmpName, @CmpEName, @CmpCode, @CmpLogo,
            COALESCE(@CmpState, 0), COALESCE(@CmpDateTime, @Now), @CmpUser, @CmpSystems
        );

        -- إنشاء السنة المالية للشركة الجديدة
        INSERT INTO dbo.Acc_FiscalYear
        (
            AccFYear, AccFName, AccFState, AccFDateTime, AccFUser, AccFCmpID
        )
        VALUES
        (
            @FiscalYear,
            N'السنة المالية ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(4), @FiscalYear),
            0, @Now, @CmpUser, @CmpID
        );

        -- تهيئة الشركة: الدليل الحسابي، مركز تكلفة الإدارة العامة، العملة، صلاحيات المنشئ
        EXEC dbo.Acc_InitializeCompany @Cmp = @CmpID, @User = @CmpUser, @Quiet = 1;

        COMMIT TRANSACTION;

        SELECT @CmpID AS CmpID;

    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF XACT_STATE() <> 0
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;

        THROW;
    END CATCH;
END;

GO

SET ANSI_NULLS ON

/* =========================================================
   13. Mng_InsertSystem
   SysUser removed because it does not exist in Mng_System.
   ========================================================= */
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Mng_InsertSystem]
    @SysName NVARCHAR(255)=NULL,
    @SysEName NVARCHAR(255)=NULL,
    @SysLogo VARBINARY(MAX)=NULL,
    @SysMenu NVARCHAR(500)=NULL,
    @SysState TINYINT=NULL,
    @SysDateTime DATETIME=NULL,
    @SysUser BIGINT=NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;

        DECLARE @NewID INT;
        SELECT @NewID=ISNULL(MAX(CONVERT(INT,SysID)),0)+1
        FROM dbo.Mng_System WITH (TABLOCKX,HOLDLOCK);

        IF @NewID NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 255
            THROW 51200,N'لا يمكن إضافة منظومة أخرى؛ الحد الأعلى لمعرّف TINYINT هو 255.',1;

        DECLARE @SysID TINYINT=CONVERT(TINYINT,@NewID);

        INSERT dbo.Mng_System
            (SysID,SysName,SysEName,SysLogo,SysMenu,SysState,SysDateTime)
        VALUES
            (@SysID,@SysName,@SysEName,@SysLogo,@SysMenu,
             COALESCE(@SysState,0),COALESCE(@SysDateTime,GETDATE()));

        COMMIT;
        SELECT @SysID AS SysID;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK;
        THROW;
    END CATCH
END;
GO

SET ANSI_NULLS ON

/* =========================================================
   14. Mng_InsertSystemMenu
   SysMUser removed from INSERT because it is not a table column.
   ========================================================= */
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Mng_InsertSystemMenu]
    @SysMSysID TINYINT,
    @SysMParent TINYINT=0,
    @SysMName NVARCHAR(50)=NULL,
    @SysMEName NVARCHAR(50)=NULL,
    @SysMLogo NVARCHAR(50)=NULL,
    @SysMMap NVARCHAR(50)=NULL,
    @SysMState TINYINT=NULL,
    @SysMDateTime DATETIME=NULL,
    @SysMUser BIGINT=NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;
    SET @SysMParent=COALESCE(@SysMParent,0);

    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;

        IF NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_System WITH (UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK)
            WHERE SysID=@SysMSysID
        )
            THROW 51300,N'المنظومة المحددة للقائمة غير موجودة.',1;

        IF @SysMParent<>0 AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_SystemMenu WITH (UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK)
            WHERE SysMSysID=@SysMSysID AND SysMID=@SysMParent
        )
            THROW 51301,N'القائمة الأم غير موجودة داخل المنظومة نفسها.',1;

        DECLARE @NewID INT;
        SELECT @NewID=ISNULL(MAX(CONVERT(INT,SysMID)),0)+1
        FROM dbo.Mng_SystemMenu WITH (TABLOCKX,HOLDLOCK)
        WHERE SysMSysID=@SysMSysID;

        IF @NewID NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 255
            THROW 51302,N'لا يمكن إضافة قائمة أخرى؛ الحد الأعلى هو 255.',1;

        DECLARE @SysMID TINYINT=CONVERT(TINYINT,@NewID);

        INSERT dbo.Mng_SystemMenu
            (SysMID,SysMSysID,SysMParent,SysMName,SysMEName,
             SysMLogo,SysMMap,SysMState,SysMDateTime)
        VALUES
            (@SysMID,@SysMSysID,NULLIF(@SysMParent,0),@SysMName,@SysMEName,
             @SysMLogo,@SysMMap,COALESCE(@SysMState,0),
             COALESCE(@SysMDateTime,GETDATE()));

        COMMIT;
        SELECT @SysMSysID AS SysMSysID,@SysMID AS SysMID;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK;
        THROW;
    END CATCH
END;
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Mng_InsertUser]
    @UsrID BIGINT = NULL,             -- EmpID
    @UsrPassWord NVARCHAR(255) = NULL,
    @UsrState TINYINT = NULL,
    @UsrDateTime DATETIME = NULL,
    @UsrUser BIGINT = NULL,
    @UsrCompany INT = NULL             -- الشركة الأصلية، للتحقق عند تمريرها
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    IF @UsrID IS NULL
        THROW 51400, N'يجب تحديد معرف الموظف EmpID.', 1;

    IF @UsrPassWord IS NULL
       OR @UsrPassWord NOT LIKE N'PBKDF2-SHA256$%'
        THROW 51401, N'يجب تمرير تجزئة كلمة المرور PBKDF2-SHA256 من التطبيق.', 1;

    DECLARE @EmpNum NVARCHAR(10);
    DECLARE @EmpCompany INT;
    DECLARE @CmpCode NVARCHAR(3);
    DECLARE @UsrLogIn NVARCHAR(50);

    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;

        -- جلب الرقم الوظيفي والشركة الأصلية من سجل الموظف
        SELECT
            @EmpNum = EmpNum,
            @EmpCompany = EmpCompany
        FROM dbo.Emp_Employee WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
        WHERE EmpID = @UsrID
          AND EmpState = 0;

        IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0
            THROW 51406, N'الموظف غير موجود أو غير فعال.', 1;

        IF NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@EmpNum)), N'') IS NULL
            THROW 51409, N'لا يوجد رقم وظيفي للموظف.', 1;

        IF @EmpCompany IS NULL
            THROW 51410, N'لم يتم تحديد الشركة الأصلية للموظف.', 1;

        -- إذا مررت الشركة من التطبيق، يجب أن تطابق شركة الموظف
        IF @UsrCompany IS NOT NULL
           AND @UsrCompany <> @EmpCompany
            THROW 51411, N'الشركة المحددة لا تطابق الشركة الأصلية للموظف.', 1;

        -- جلب رمز الشركة الأصلية
        SELECT @CmpCode = CmpCode
        FROM dbo.Mng_Company WITH (HOLDLOCK)
        WHERE CmpID = @EmpCompany;

        IF @CmpCode IS NULL
            THROW 51412, N'الشركة الأصلية غير موجودة أو لم يتم تحديد رمزها.', 1;

        -- تكوين اسم الدخول من رمز الشركة والرقم الوظيفي
        SET @UsrLogIn = UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(@CmpCode)))
                      + LTRIM(RTRIM(@EmpNum));

        IF LEN(@UsrLogIn) > 50
            THROW 51413, N'اسم الدخول الناتج يتجاوز الحد المسموح.', 1;

        -- التحقق من عدم وجود حساب سابق للموظف
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM dbo.Mng_User WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
            WHERE UsrID = @UsrID
        )
            THROW 51407, N'يوجد حساب مستخدم لهذا الموظف مسبقًا.', 1;

        -- التحقق من عدم تكرار اسم الدخول
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM dbo.Mng_User WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
            WHERE UsrLogIn = @UsrLogIn
        )
            THROW 51408, N'اسم الدخول مستخدم مسبقًا، تحقق من رمز الشركة والرقم الوظيفي.', 1;

        -- إنشاء حساب المستخدم
        INSERT INTO dbo.Mng_User
        (
            UsrID,
            UsrLogIn,
            UsrPassWord,
            UsrState,
            UsrDateTime,
            UsrUser,
            UsrCompany
        )
        VALUES
        (
            @UsrID,
            @UsrLogIn,
            @UsrPassWord,
            COALESCE(@UsrState, 0),
            COALESCE(@UsrDateTime, GETDATE()),
            @UsrUser,
            @EmpCompany
        );

        COMMIT TRANSACTION;

        SELECT
            @UsrID AS UsrID,
            @UsrLogIn AS UsrLogIn,
            @EmpCompany AS UsrCompany;

    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF XACT_STATE() <> 0
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;

        THROW;
    END CATCH;
END;
GO

/* =========================================================
   16. Mng_InsertUserParmations
   ========================================================= */
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Mng_InsertUserParmations]
    @USPUserID BIGINT,
    @USPCompanyID INT,
    @USPSystemID TINYINT,
    @USPParmations NVARCHAR(500)=NULL,
    @USPState TINYINT=NULL,
    @USPDateTime DATETIME=NULL,
    @USPUser BIGINT=NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;
    SET @USPParmations=NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@USPParmations)),N'');

    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;

        IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_System WHERE SysID=@USPSystemID)
            THROW 51500,N'المنظومة المحددة للصلاحية غير موجودة.',1;

        IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_Company WHERE CmpID=@USPCompanyID)
            THROW 51501,N'الشركة المحددة للصلاحية غير موجودة.',1;

        IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_User WHERE UsrID=@USPUserID)
            THROW 51502,N'المستخدم المحدد للصلاحية غير موجود.',1;

        IF NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_Employee
            WHERE EmpID=@USPUserID AND EmpState=0
        )
            THROW 51511,N'الموظف المرتبط بالحساب غير فعال.',1;

        IF NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM dbo.Mng_Company c
            CROSS APPLY STRING_SPLIT(COALESCE(c.CmpSystems,N''),N',') ss
            WHERE c.CmpID=@USPCompanyID
              AND TRY_CONVERT(INT,LTRIM(RTRIM(ss.value)))=@USPSystemID
        )
            THROW 51503,N'المنظومة غير مدرجة ضمن منظومات الشركة.',1;

        IF @USPParmations IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM STRING_SPLIT(@USPParmations,N',') ss
            CROSS APPLY (SELECT TRY_CONVERT(INT,LTRIM(RTRIM(ss.value)) ) ID) x
            WHERE x.ID IS NULL OR x.ID NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 255
               OR NOT EXISTS (
                   SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_SystemMenu m
                   WHERE m.SysMSysID=@USPSystemID AND m.SysMID=x.ID
               )
        )
            THROW 51504,N'قائمة الصلاحيات تحتوي على معرّف قائمة غير صحيح.',1;

        INSERT dbo.Mng_UserParmations
            (USPUserID,USPCompanyID,USPSystemID,USPParmations,
             USPState,USPDateTime,USPUser)
        VALUES
            (@USPUserID,@USPCompanyID,@USPSystemID,@USPParmations,
             COALESCE(@USPState,0),COALESCE(@USPDateTime,GETDATE()),@USPUser);

        DECLARE @USPID BIGINT=CONVERT(BIGINT,SCOPE_IDENTITY());

        COMMIT;
        SELECT @USPID AS USPID;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK;
        THROW;
    END CATCH
END;
GO

/* =========================================================
   17. Mng_SearchCompany
   ========================================================= */
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Mng_SearchCompany]
    @CmpID INT=NULL,
    @CmpName NVARCHAR(255)=NULL,
    @CmpEName NVARCHAR(255)=NULL,
    @CmpState TINYINT=NULL,
    @CmpSystems NVARCHAR(500)=NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    SELECT CmpID,CmpName,CmpEName,CmpState,CmpDateTime,CmpUser,CmpSystems
    FROM dbo.Mng_Company c
    WHERE (@CmpID IS NULL OR c.CmpID=@CmpID)
      AND (@CmpName IS NULL OR c.CmpName LIKE N'%'+@CmpName+N'%')
      AND (@CmpEName IS NULL OR c.CmpEName LIKE N'%'+@CmpEName+N'%')
      AND (@CmpState IS NULL OR c.CmpState=@CmpState)
      AND (
          @CmpSystems IS NULL OR EXISTS (
              SELECT 1
              FROM STRING_SPLIT(COALESCE(c.CmpSystems,N''),N',') ss
              CROSS APPLY (SELECT TRY_CONVERT(INT,LTRIM(RTRIM(ss.value))) ID) x
              WHERE x.ID=TRY_CONVERT(INT,LTRIM(RTRIM(@CmpSystems)))
          )
      )
    ORDER BY c.CmpID;
END;
GO

/* =========================================================
   20. Mng_SearchUser
   @UsrEmployeeID retained for compatibility; it is EmpID=UsrID.
   ========================================================= */
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Mng_SearchUser]
    @UsrID BIGINT=NULL,
    @UsrEmployeeID BIGINT=NULL,
    @UsrLogIn NVARCHAR(50)=NULL,
    @UsrState TINYINT=NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    SELECT u.UsrID,e.EmpNum,e.EmpName,u.UsrLogIn,u.UsrState,
           u.UsrDateTime,u.UsrUser
    FROM dbo.Mng_User u
    INNER JOIN dbo.Emp_Employee e ON e.EmpID=u.UsrID
    WHERE (@UsrID IS NULL OR u.UsrID=@UsrID)
      AND (@UsrEmployeeID IS NULL OR u.UsrID=@UsrEmployeeID)
      AND (@UsrLogIn IS NULL OR u.UsrLogIn LIKE N'%'+@UsrLogIn+N'%')
      AND (@UsrState IS NULL OR u.UsrState=@UsrState)
    ORDER BY u.UsrID;
END;

/* =========================================================
   Mng_UpdateCompany
   NULL logo means retain the existing logo.
   NULL CmpCode means retain the existing company code.
   ========================================================= */

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Mng_UpdateCompany]
    @CmpID INT,
    @CmpName NVARCHAR(255),
    @CmpEName NVARCHAR(255),
    @CmpCode NVARCHAR(3),
    @CmpLogo VARBINARY(MAX),
    @CmpState TINYINT,
    @CmpDateTime DATETIME,
    @CmpUser BIGINT,
    @CmpSystems NVARCHAR(500)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    SET @CmpSystems = NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@CmpSystems)), N'');
    SET @CmpCode = NULLIF(UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(@CmpCode))), N'');

    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;

        -- التحقق من وجود الشركة وحجز سجلها للتعديل
        IF NOT EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM dbo.Mng_Company WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
            WHERE CmpID = @CmpID
        )
        BEGIN
            THROW 51103,
                N'الشركة المطلوب تعديلها غير موجودة.',
                1;
        END;

        -- التحقق من رمز الشركة
        IF @CmpCode IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            IF LEN(@CmpCode) <> 3
               OR @CmpCode COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2
                  LIKE N'%[^A-Z]%'
            BEGIN
                THROW 51100,
                    N'رمز الشركة يجب أن يتكون من ثلاثة أحرف إنجليزية كبيرة فقط.',
                    1;
            END;

            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT 1
                FROM dbo.Mng_Company
                WHERE CmpCode = @CmpCode
                  AND CmpID <> @CmpID
            )
            BEGIN
                THROW 51101,
                    N'رمز الشركة مستخدم مسبقاً، يرجى اختيار رمز آخر.',
                    1;
            END;
        END;

        -- التحقق من صحة المنظومات
        IF @CmpSystems IS NOT NULL
           AND EXISTS
           (
               SELECT 1
               FROM STRING_SPLIT(@CmpSystems, N',') ss
               CROSS APPLY
               (
                   SELECT TRY_CONVERT(
                       INT,
                       LTRIM(RTRIM(ss.value))
                   ) AS ID
               ) x
               WHERE x.ID IS NULL
                  OR x.ID NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 255
                  OR NOT EXISTS
                  (
                      SELECT 1
                      FROM dbo.Mng_System s
                      WHERE s.SysID = x.ID
                  )
           )
        BEGIN
            THROW 51102,
                N'قائمة المنظومات تحتوي على معرّف غير صحيح أو منظومة غير موجودة.',
                1;
        END;

        -- منع إزالة منظومة مرتبطة بسجلات صلاحيات
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM dbo.Mng_UserParmations p
            WHERE p.USPCompanyID = @CmpID
              AND
              (
                  @CmpSystems IS NULL
                  OR NOT EXISTS
                  (
                      SELECT 1
                      FROM STRING_SPLIT(@CmpSystems, N',') ss
                      WHERE TRY_CONVERT(
                          INT,
                          LTRIM(RTRIM(ss.value))
                      ) = p.USPSystemID
                  )
              )
        )
        BEGIN
            THROW 51104,
                N'لا يمكن إزالة منظومة ما دامت لها سجلات صلاحيات مرتبطة بالشركة.',
                1;
        END;

        -- تحديث بيانات الشركة
        UPDATE dbo.Mng_Company
        SET
            CmpName = @CmpName,
            CmpEName = @CmpEName,
            CmpCode = COALESCE(@CmpCode, CmpCode),
            CmpState = COALESCE(@CmpState, CmpState),
            CmpDateTime = COALESCE(@CmpDateTime, GETDATE()),
            CmpUser = @CmpUser,
            CmpSystems = @CmpSystems,
            CmpLogo = COALESCE(@CmpLogo, CmpLogo)
        WHERE CmpID = @CmpID;

        COMMIT TRANSACTION;

        SELECT CAST(1 AS BIT) AS Success;

    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF XACT_STATE() <> 0
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;

        THROW;
    END CATCH;
END;
GO

BEGIN

        )

            SysEName=@SysEName,

            SysDateTime=COALESCE(@SysDateTime,GETDATE()),

            SysLogo=COALESCE(@SysLogo,SysLogo)

/* =========================================================
   24. Mng_UpdateSystemMenu
   SysMUser parameter retained for compatibility, but unused.
   ========================================================= */
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Mng_UpdateSystemMenu]
    @SysMSysID TINYINT,
    @SysMID TINYINT,
    @SysMParent TINYINT,
    @SysMName NVARCHAR(50),
    @SysMEName NVARCHAR(50),
    @SysMLogo NVARCHAR(50),
    @SysMMap NVARCHAR(50),
    @SysMState TINYINT,
    @SysMDateTime DATETIME,
    @SysMUser BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;
    SET @SysMParent=COALESCE(@SysMParent,0);

    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;

        IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_System WHERE SysID=@SysMSysID)
            THROW 51304,N'المنظومة المحددة للقائمة غير موجودة.',1;

        IF NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_SystemMenu WITH (UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK)
            WHERE SysMSysID=@SysMSysID AND SysMID=@SysMID
        )
            THROW 51305,N'القائمة المطلوب تعديلها غير موجودة.',1;

        IF @SysMParent=@SysMID
            THROW 51306,N'لا يمكن أن تكون القائمة أبًا لنفسها.',1;

        IF @SysMParent<>0 AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_SystemMenu
            WHERE SysMSysID=@SysMSysID AND SysMID=@SysMParent
        )
            THROW 51307,N'القائمة الأم غير موجودة داخل المنظومة نفسها.',1;

        DECLARE @Cycle BIT=0;

        ;WITH Descendants AS (
            SELECT SysMID,SysMParent
            FROM dbo.Mng_SystemMenu
            WHERE SysMSysID=@SysMSysID AND SysMParent=@SysMID

            UNION ALL

            SELECT c.SysMID,c.SysMParent
            FROM dbo.Mng_SystemMenu c
            INNER JOIN Descendants d
                ON c.SysMSysID=@SysMSysID
               AND c.SysMParent=d.SysMID
        )
        SELECT @Cycle=CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM Descendants WHERE SysMID=@SysMParent
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
        OPTION (MAXRECURSION 255);

        IF @Cycle=1
            THROW 51308,N'لا يمكن نقل القائمة إلى أحد فروعها.',1;

        UPDATE dbo.Mng_SystemMenu
        SET SysMParent=NULLIF(@SysMParent,0),
            SysMName=@SysMName,
            SysMEName=@SysMEName,
            SysMLogo=@SysMLogo,
            SysMMap=@SysMMap,
            SysMState=COALESCE(@SysMState,SysMState),
            SysMDateTime=COALESCE(@SysMDateTime,GETDATE())
        WHERE SysMSysID=@SysMSysID AND SysMID=@SysMID;

        COMMIT;
        SELECT CAST(1 AS BIT) AS Success;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK;
        THROW;
    END CATCH
END;
GO

/* =========================================================
   25. Mng_UpdateUser
   ========================================================= */
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Mng_UpdateUser]
    @UsrID BIGINT,
    @UsrState TINYINT,
    @UsrDateTime DATETIME,
    @UsrUser BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;

        IF NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_User WITH (UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK)
            WHERE UsrID=@UsrID
        )
            THROW 51401,N'المستخدم المطلوب تعديله غير موجود.',1;

        IF NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_Employee
            WHERE EmpID=@UsrID AND EmpState=0
        ) AND @UsrState=0
            THROW 51409,N'لا يمكن تفعيل حساب مستخدم لموظف غير فعال.',1;

        UPDATE dbo.Mng_User
        SET UsrState=COALESCE(@UsrState,UsrState),
            UsrDateTime=COALESCE(@UsrDateTime,GETDATE()),
            UsrUser=@UsrUser
        WHERE UsrID=@UsrID;

        COMMIT;
        SELECT CAST(1 AS BIT) AS Success;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK;
        THROW;
    END CATCH
END;

/* =========================================================
   26. Mng_UpdateUserParmations
   ========================================================= */
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Mng_UpdateUserParmations]
    @USPID BIGINT,
    @USPUserID BIGINT,
    @USPCompanyID INT,
    @USPSystemID TINYINT,
    @USPParmations NVARCHAR(500),
    @USPState TINYINT,
    @USPDateTime DATETIME,
    @USPUser BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;
    SET @USPParmations=NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@USPParmations)),N'');

    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;

        IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_UserParmations WHERE USPID=@USPID)
            THROW 51505,N'سجل الصلاحيات المطلوب تعديله غير موجود.',1;

        IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_System WHERE SysID=@USPSystemID)
            THROW 51506,N'المنظومة المحددة للصلاحية غير موجودة.',1;

        IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_Company WHERE CmpID=@USPCompanyID)
            THROW 51507,N'الشركة المحددة للصلاحية غير موجودة.',1;

        IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_User WHERE UsrID=@USPUserID)
            THROW 51508,N'المستخدم المحدد للصلاحية غير موجود.',1;

        IF NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_Employee
            WHERE EmpID=@USPUserID AND EmpState=0
        )
            THROW 51512,N'الموظف المرتبط بالحساب غير فعال.',1;

        IF NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_Company c
            CROSS APPLY STRING_SPLIT(COALESCE(c.CmpSystems,N''),N',') ss
            WHERE c.CmpID=@USPCompanyID
              AND TRY_CONVERT(INT,LTRIM(RTRIM(ss.value)))=@USPSystemID
        )
            THROW 51509,N'المنظومة غير مدرجة ضمن منظومات الشركة.',1;

        IF @USPParmations IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM STRING_SPLIT(@USPParmations,N',') ss
            CROSS APPLY (SELECT TRY_CONVERT(INT,LTRIM(RTRIM(ss.value))) ID) x
            WHERE x.ID IS NULL OR x.ID NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 255
               OR NOT EXISTS (
                   SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_SystemMenu m
                   WHERE m.SysMSysID=@USPSystemID AND m.SysMID=x.ID
               )
        )
            THROW 51510,N'قائمة الصلاحيات تحتوي على معرّف قائمة غير صحيح.',1;

        UPDATE dbo.Mng_UserParmations
        SET USPUserID=@USPUserID,
            USPCompanyID=@USPCompanyID,
            USPSystemID=@USPSystemID,
            USPParmations=@USPParmations,
            USPState=COALESCE(@USPState,USPState),
            USPDateTime=COALESCE(@USPDateTime,GETDATE()),
            USPUser=@USPUser
        WHERE USPID=@USPID;

        COMMIT;
        SELECT CAST(1 AS BIT) AS Success;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK;
        THROW;
    END CATCH
END;
GO

/* =========================================================
   27. Mng_UpdateUserPassword
   ========================================================= */
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Mng_UpdateUserPassword]
    @UsrID BIGINT,
    @UsrPassWord NVARCHAR(255),
    @UsrUser BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    IF @UsrPassWord IS NULL OR @UsrPassWord NOT LIKE N'PBKDF2-SHA256$%'
        THROW 51402,N'يجب تمرير تجزئة PBKDF2-SHA256 من التطبيق.',1;

    UPDATE dbo.Mng_User
    SET UsrPassWord=@UsrPassWord,
        UsrDateTime=GETDATE(),
        UsrUser=@UsrUser
    WHERE UsrID=@UsrID;

    IF @@ROWCOUNT=0
        THROW 51403,N'المستخدم المطلوب تغيير كلمة مروره غير موجود.',1;

    SELECT CAST(1 AS BIT) AS Success;
END;
GO

SET ANSI_NULLS ON

/*==============================================================
  11. ADD ATTACHMENT
==============================================================*/
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Msg_AddAttachment]
    @MessageID BIGINT,
    @UsrID BIGINT,
    @FileName NVARCHAR(260),
    @FileData VARBINARY(MAX),
    @CmpID INT,
    @ContentType NVARCHAR(150) = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    SET @FileName = LTRIM(RTRIM(@FileName));

    IF NULLIF(@FileName, N'') IS NULL
        THROW 51050, N'اسم الملف مطلوب.', 1;

    IF @FileData IS NULL OR DATALENGTH(@FileData) = 0
        THROW 51051, N'محتوى الملف فارغ.', 1;

    IF DATALENGTH(@FileData) > 10485760
        THROW 51052, N'حجم المرفق يتجاوز 10 ميبيبايت.', 1;

    IF NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1
        FROM dbo.Msg_Message AS M
        INNER JOIN dbo.Msg_Conversation AS C
            ON C.ConversationID = M.ConversationID
        INNER JOIN dbo.Msg_ConversationMember AS CM
            ON CM.ConversationID = C.ConversationID
        INNER JOIN dbo.Mng_User AS U
            ON U.UsrID = @UsrID
           AND U.UsrState = 0
        INNER JOIN dbo.Emp_Employee AS E
            ON E.EmpID = U.UsrID
           AND E.EmpState = 0
        INNER JOIN dbo.Mng_UserParmations AS UP
            ON UP.USPUserID = U.UsrID
           AND UP.USPCompanyID = @CmpID
           AND UP.USPState = 0
        WHERE M.MessageID = @MessageID
          AND M.SenderUserID = @UsrID
          AND M.State = 0
          AND M.IsDeleted = 0
          AND C.State = 0
          AND C.ConversationCompanyID = @CmpID
          AND CM.UserID = @UsrID
          AND CM.State = 0
          AND CM.LeftAt IS NULL
          AND NOT EXISTS
          (
              SELECT 1
              FROM dbo.Msg_ConversationMember AS CMX
              WHERE CMX.ConversationID = C.ConversationID
                AND CMX.State = 0
                AND CMX.LeftAt IS NULL
                AND NOT EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM dbo.Mng_User AS UX
                    INNER JOIN dbo.Emp_Employee AS EX
                        ON EX.EmpID = UX.UsrID
                       AND EX.EmpState = 0
                    INNER JOIN dbo.Mng_UserParmations AS UP
            ON UP.USPUserID = U.UsrID
           AND UP.USPCompanyID = @CmpID
           AND UP.USPState = 0
                    WHERE UX.UsrID = CMX.UserID
                      AND UX.UsrState = 0
                )
          )
    )
        THROW 51054, N'يمكن إرفاق الملفات برسالتك فقط داخل الشركة الحالية.', 1;

    INSERT INTO dbo.Msg_MessageAttachment
    (
        MessageID,
        FileName,
        ContentType,
        FileSize,
        FileData,
        State
    )
    VALUES
    (
        @MessageID,
        @FileName,
        @ContentType,
        DATALENGTH(@FileData),
        @FileData,
        0
    );

    SELECT CONVERT(BIGINT, SCOPE_IDENTITY()) AS AttachmentID;
END;
GO

/*==============================================================
  2. ADD CONVERSATION MEMBER
==============================================================*/
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Msg_AddConversationMember]
    @ConversationID BIGINT,
    @AddedUsrID BIGINT,
    @UsrID BIGINT,
    @CmpID INT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;

        IF NOT EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM dbo.Mng_User AS U
            INNER JOIN dbo.Emp_Employee AS E
                ON E.EmpID = U.UsrID
               AND E.EmpState = 0
             INNER JOIN dbo.Mng_UserParmations AS UP
            ON UP.USPUserID = U.UsrID
           AND UP.USPCompanyID = @CmpID
           AND UP.USPState = 0
            WHERE U.UsrID = @UsrID
              AND U.UsrState = 0
        )
            THROW 51010, N'المستخدم المنفذ غير مرتبط بالشركة الحالية.', 1;

        IF NOT EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM dbo.Mng_User AS U
            INNER JOIN dbo.Emp_Employee AS E
                ON E.EmpID = U.UsrID
               AND E.EmpState = 0
             INNER JOIN dbo.Mng_UserParmations AS UP
            ON UP.USPUserID = U.UsrID
           AND UP.USPCompanyID = @CmpID
           AND UP.USPState = 0
            WHERE U.UsrID = @AddedUsrID
              AND U.UsrState = 0
        )
            THROW 51011, N'العضو المراد إضافته لا يملك عضوية فعالة في الشركة الحالية.', 1;

        IF NOT EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM dbo.Msg_Conversation AS C WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
            INNER JOIN dbo.Msg_ConversationMember AS CM
                ON CM.ConversationID = C.ConversationID
               AND CM.UserID = @UsrID
               AND CM.State = 0
               AND CM.LeftAt IS NULL
            WHERE C.ConversationID = @ConversationID
              AND C.ConversationType = 1
              AND C.ConversationCompanyID = @CmpID
              AND C.State = 0
              AND C.CreatedByUserID = @UsrID
        )
            THROW 51112, N'إضافة الأعضاء متاحة لمنشئ المجموعة النشط داخل الشركة نفسها فقط.', 1;

        IF @AddedUsrID = @UsrID
            THROW 51013, N'منشئ المجموعة عضو فيها بالفعل.', 1;

        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM dbo.Msg_ConversationMember
            WHERE ConversationID = @ConversationID
              AND UserID = @AddedUsrID
              AND State = 0
              AND LeftAt IS NULL
        )
            THROW 51014, N'المستخدم عضو بالفعل في هذه المجموعة.', 1;

        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM dbo.Msg_ConversationMember AS CM
            WHERE CM.ConversationID = @ConversationID
              AND CM.State = 0
              AND CM.LeftAt IS NULL
              AND NOT EXISTS
              (
                  SELECT 1
                  FROM dbo.Mng_User AS U
                  INNER JOIN dbo.Emp_Employee AS E
                      ON E.EmpID = U.UsrID
                     AND E.EmpState = 0
                  INNER JOIN dbo.Mng_UserParmations AS UP
            ON UP.USPUserID = U.UsrID
           AND UP.USPCompanyID = @CmpID
           AND UP.USPState = 0
                  WHERE U.UsrID = CM.UserID
                    AND U.UsrState = 0
              )
        )
            THROW 51015, N'توجد عضوية في المجموعة لا تتبع الشركة الحالية.', 1;

        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM dbo.Msg_ConversationMember
            WHERE ConversationID = @ConversationID
              AND UserID = @AddedUsrID
        )
        BEGIN
            UPDATE dbo.Msg_ConversationMember
            SET State = 0,
                LeftAt = NULL,
                JoinedAt = SYSDATETIME()
            WHERE ConversationID = @ConversationID
              AND UserID = @AddedUsrID;
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO dbo.Msg_ConversationMember
                (ConversationID, UserID, MemberRole, State)
            VALUES
                (@ConversationID, @AddedUsrID, 0, 0);
        END;

        UPDATE dbo.Msg_Conversation
        SET UpdatedAt = SYSDATETIME()
        WHERE ConversationID = @ConversationID
          AND ConversationCompanyID = @CmpID;

        COMMIT TRANSACTION;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF XACT_STATE() <> 0
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;

        THROW;
    END CATCH;
END;
GO

/*==============================================================
  10. CHECK SENDER PERMISSION FOR ATTACHMENTS
==============================================================*/
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Msg_CanAddMessageAttachments]
    @MessageID BIGINT,
    @ConversationID BIGINT,
    @UsrID BIGINT,
    @CmpID INT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    SELECT CAST
    (
        CASE
            WHEN EXISTS
            (
                SELECT 1
                FROM dbo.Msg_Message AS M
                INNER JOIN dbo.Msg_Conversation AS C
                    ON C.ConversationID = M.ConversationID
                INNER JOIN dbo.Msg_ConversationMember AS CM
                    ON CM.ConversationID = C.ConversationID
                   AND CM.UserID = @UsrID
                   AND CM.State = 0
                   AND CM.LeftAt IS NULL
                INNER JOIN dbo.Mng_User AS U
                    ON U.UsrID = @UsrID
                   AND U.UsrState = 0
                INNER JOIN dbo.Emp_Employee AS E
                    ON E.EmpID = U.UsrID
                   AND E.EmpState = 0
                INNER JOIN dbo.Mng_UserParmations AS UP
            ON UP.USPUserID = U.UsrID
           AND UP.USPCompanyID = @CmpID
           AND UP.USPState = 0
                WHERE M.MessageID = @MessageID
                  AND M.ConversationID = @ConversationID
                  AND M.SenderUserID = @UsrID
                  AND M.IsDeleted = 0
                  AND M.State = 0
                  AND C.State = 0
                  AND C.ConversationCompanyID = @CmpID
            )
            THEN 1 ELSE 0
        END
        AS BIT
    ) AS IsAllowed;
END;
GO

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Msg_CreateConversation]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
/*==============================================================
  1. CREATE CONVERSATION
==============================================================*/
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Msg_CreateConversation]
    @ConversationType TINYINT,
    @UsrID BIGINT,
    @ConversationID BIGINT OUTPUT,
    @CmpID INT,
    @OtherUserID BIGINT = NULL,
    @ConversationTitle NVARCHAR(200) = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    SET @ConversationID = NULL;

    IF @ConversationType NOT IN (0, 1)
        THROW 51002, N'نوع المحادثة غير صحيح.', 1;

    IF NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1
        FROM dbo.Mng_User AS U
        INNER JOIN dbo.Emp_Employee AS E
            ON E.EmpID = U.UsrID
           AND E.EmpState = 0
        INNER JOIN dbo.Mng_UserParmations AS UP
            ON UP.USPUserID = U.UsrID
           AND UP.USPCompanyID = @CmpID
           AND UP.USPState = 0
        WHERE U.UsrID = @UsrID
          AND U.UsrState = 0
    )
        THROW 51001, N'المستخدم المنشئ غير فعال أو غير مرتبط بالشركة الحالية.', 1;

    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;

        IF @ConversationType = 0
        BEGIN
            IF @OtherUserID IS NULL
               OR @OtherUserID = @UsrID
                THROW 51003, N'حدد مستخدماً آخر للمحادثة الفردية.', 1;

            IF NOT EXISTS
            (
                SELECT 1
                FROM dbo.Mng_User AS U
                INNER JOIN dbo.Emp_Employee AS E
                    ON E.EmpID = U.UsrID
                   AND E.EmpState = 0
                 INNER JOIN dbo.Mng_UserParmations AS UP
            ON UP.USPUserID = U.UsrID
           AND UP.USPCompanyID = @CmpID
           AND UP.USPState = 0
                WHERE U.UsrID = @OtherUserID
                  AND U.UsrState = 0
            )
                THROW 51004, N'المستخدم الآخر غير فعال أو لا ينتمي إلى الشركة الحالية.', 1;

            DECLARE @U1 BIGINT =
                CASE WHEN @UsrID < @OtherUserID
                     THEN @UsrID ELSE @OtherUserID END;

            DECLARE @U2 BIGINT =
                CASE WHEN @UsrID < @OtherUserID
                     THEN @OtherUserID ELSE @UsrID END;

            SELECT TOP (1)
                @ConversationID = C.ConversationID
            FROM dbo.Msg_Conversation AS C WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
            WHERE C.ConversationType = 0
              AND C.State = 0
              AND C.ConversationCompanyID = @CmpID
              AND C.DirectUser1ID = @U1
              AND C.DirectUser2ID = @U2
            ORDER BY C.ConversationID DESC;

            IF @ConversationID IS NULL
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO dbo.Msg_Conversation
                (
                    ConversationType,
                    CreatedByUserID,
                    DirectUser1ID,
                    DirectUser2ID,
                    ConversationCompanyID,
                    State
                )
                VALUES
                (
                    0,
                    @UsrID,
                    @U1,
                    @U2,
                    @CmpID,
                    0
                );

                SET @ConversationID =
                    CONVERT(BIGINT, SCOPE_IDENTITY());
            END;

            IF NOT EXISTS
            (
                SELECT 1
                FROM dbo.Msg_ConversationMember
                WHERE ConversationID = @ConversationID
                  AND UserID = @U1
            )
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO dbo.Msg_ConversationMember
                    (ConversationID, UserID, MemberRole, State)
                VALUES
                    (@ConversationID, @U1, 0, 0);
            END
            ELSE
            BEGIN
                UPDATE dbo.Msg_ConversationMember
                SET State = 0,
                    LeftAt = NULL,
                    JoinedAt =
                        CASE
                            WHEN State <> 0 OR LeftAt IS NOT NULL
                                THEN SYSDATETIME()
                            ELSE JoinedAt
                        END
                WHERE ConversationID = @ConversationID
                  AND UserID = @U1;
            END;

            IF NOT EXISTS
            (
                SELECT 1
                FROM dbo.Msg_ConversationMember
                WHERE ConversationID = @ConversationID
                  AND UserID = @U2
            )
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO dbo.Msg_ConversationMember
                    (ConversationID, UserID, MemberRole, State)
                VALUES
                    (@ConversationID, @U2, 0, 0);
            END
            ELSE
            BEGIN
                UPDATE dbo.Msg_ConversationMember
                SET State = 0,
                    LeftAt = NULL,
                    JoinedAt =
                        CASE
                            WHEN State <> 0 OR LeftAt IS NOT NULL
                                THEN SYSDATETIME()
                            ELSE JoinedAt
                        END
                WHERE ConversationID = @ConversationID
                  AND UserID = @U2;
            END;
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            SET @ConversationTitle =
                LTRIM(RTRIM(@ConversationTitle));

            IF NULLIF(@ConversationTitle, N'') IS NULL
                THROW 51005, N'اسم المجموعة مطلوب.', 1;

            INSERT INTO dbo.Msg_Conversation
            (
                ConversationType,
                ConversationTitle,
                CreatedByUserID,
                ConversationCompanyID,
                State
            )
            VALUES
            (
                1,
                @ConversationTitle,
                @UsrID,
                @CmpID,
                0
            );

            SET @ConversationID =
                CONVERT(BIGINT, SCOPE_IDENTITY());

            INSERT INTO dbo.Msg_ConversationMember
                (ConversationID, UserID, MemberRole, State)
            VALUES
                (@ConversationID, @UsrID, 1, 0);
        END;

        UPDATE dbo.Msg_Conversation
        SET UpdatedAt = SYSDATETIME()
        WHERE ConversationID = @ConversationID
          AND ConversationCompanyID = @CmpID;

        COMMIT TRANSACTION;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF XACT_STATE() <> 0
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;

        SET @ConversationID = NULL;
        THROW;
    END CATCH;
END;
GO

/*==============================================================
  14. DELETE ATTACHMENT
==============================================================*/
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Msg_DeleteAttachment]
    @AttachmentID BIGINT,
    @UsrID BIGINT,
    @CmpID INT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    UPDATE A
    SET State = 1
    FROM dbo.Msg_MessageAttachment AS A
    INNER JOIN dbo.Msg_Message AS M
        ON M.MessageID = A.MessageID
    INNER JOIN dbo.Msg_Conversation AS C
        ON C.ConversationID = M.ConversationID
    INNER JOIN dbo.Msg_ConversationMember AS CM
        ON CM.ConversationID = C.ConversationID
    INNER JOIN dbo.Mng_User AS U
        ON U.UsrID = @UsrID
       AND U.UsrState = 0
    INNER JOIN dbo.Emp_Employee AS E
        ON E.EmpID = U.UsrID
       AND E.EmpState = 0
    INNER JOIN dbo.Mng_UserParmations AS UP
            ON UP.USPUserID = U.UsrID
           AND UP.USPCompanyID = @CmpID
           AND UP.USPState = 0
    WHERE A.AttachmentID = @AttachmentID
      AND A.State = 0
      AND M.State = 0
      AND M.IsDeleted = 0
      AND M.SenderUserID = @UsrID
      AND C.State = 0
      AND C.ConversationCompanyID = @CmpID
      AND CM.UserID = @UsrID
      AND CM.State = 0
      AND CM.LeftAt IS NULL
      AND NOT EXISTS
      (
          SELECT 1
          FROM dbo.Msg_ConversationMember AS CMX
          WHERE CMX.ConversationID = C.ConversationID
            AND CMX.State = 0
            AND CMX.LeftAt IS NULL
            AND NOT EXISTS
            (
                SELECT 1
                FROM dbo.Mng_User AS UX
                INNER JOIN dbo.Emp_Employee AS EX
                    ON EX.EmpID = UX.UsrID
                   AND EX.EmpState = 0
                 INNER JOIN dbo.Mng_UserParmations AS UP
            ON UP.USPUserID = U.UsrID
           AND UP.USPCompanyID = @CmpID
           AND UP.USPState = 0
                WHERE UX.UsrID = CMX.UserID
                  AND UX.UsrState = 0
            )
      );

    IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0
        THROW 51061, N'المرفق غير موجود أو لا تملك صلاحية حذفه في الشركة الحالية.', 1;
END;
GO

/*==============================================================
  7. DELETE MESSAGE
==============================================================*/
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Msg_DeleteMessage]
    @MessageID BIGINT,
    @UsrID BIGINT,
    @CmpID INT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    UPDATE M
    SET IsDeleted = 1,
        DeletedAt = SYSDATETIME()
    FROM dbo.Msg_Message AS M
    INNER JOIN dbo.Msg_Conversation AS C
        ON C.ConversationID = M.ConversationID
    INNER JOIN dbo.Msg_ConversationMember AS CM
        ON CM.ConversationID = C.ConversationID
    INNER JOIN dbo.Mng_User AS U
        ON U.UsrID = @UsrID
       AND U.UsrState = 0
    INNER JOIN dbo.Emp_Employee AS E
        ON E.EmpID = U.UsrID
       AND E.EmpState = 0
     INNER JOIN dbo.Mng_UserParmations AS UP
            ON UP.USPUserID = U.UsrID
           AND UP.USPCompanyID = @CmpID
           AND UP.USPState = 0
    WHERE M.MessageID = @MessageID
      AND M.SenderUserID = @UsrID
      AND M.IsDeleted = 0
      AND M.State = 0
      AND C.State = 0
      AND C.ConversationCompanyID = @CmpID
      AND CM.UserID = @UsrID
      AND CM.State = 0
      AND CM.LeftAt IS NULL
      AND NOT EXISTS
      (
          SELECT 1
          FROM dbo.Msg_ConversationMember AS CMX
          WHERE CMX.ConversationID = C.ConversationID
            AND CMX.State = 0
            AND CMX.LeftAt IS NULL
            AND NOT EXISTS
            (
                SELECT 1
                FROM dbo.Mng_User AS UX
                INNER JOIN dbo.Emp_Employee AS EX
                    ON EX.EmpID = UX.UsrID
                   AND EX.EmpState = 0
                INNER JOIN dbo.Mng_UserParmations AS UP
            ON UP.USPUserID = U.UsrID
           AND UP.USPCompanyID = @CmpID
           AND UP.USPState = 0
                WHERE UX.UsrID = CMX.UserID
                  AND UX.UsrState = 0
            )
      );

    IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0
        THROW 51233, N'لا يمكن حذف الرسالة أو أنها غير تابعة للشركة الحالية.', 1;
END;
GO
