/*==============================================================
  6. EDIT MESSAGE
==============================================================*/
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Msg_EditMessage]
    @MessageID BIGINT,
    @UsrID BIGINT,
    @MessageText NVARCHAR(MAX),
    @CmpID INT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    SET @MessageText = LTRIM(RTRIM(@MessageText));

    IF NULLIF(@MessageText, N'') IS NULL
        THROW 51230, N'نص الرسالة مطلوب.', 1;

    IF LEN(@MessageText) > 10000
        THROW 51231, N'تجاوز نص الرسالة الحد المسموح.', 1;

    DECLARE @Now DATETIME2(0) = SYSDATETIME();

    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;

        UPDATE M
        SET MessageText = @MessageText,
            EditedAt = @Now
        FROM dbo.Msg_Message AS M
        INNER JOIN dbo.Msg_Conversation AS C
            ON C.ConversationID = M.ConversationID
        INNER JOIN dbo.Msg_ConversationMember AS CM
            ON CM.ConversationID = C.ConversationID
        INNER JOIN dbo.Mng_User AS U
            ON U.UsrID = @UsrID
           AND U.UsrState = 0
        INNER JOIN dbo.Emp_Employee AS E
            ON E.EmpID = U.UsrID
           AND E.EmpState = 0
         INNER JOIN dbo.Mng_UserParmations AS UP
            ON UP.USPUserID = U.UsrID
           AND UP.USPCompanyID = @CmpID
           AND UP.USPState = 0
        WHERE M.MessageID = @MessageID
          AND M.SenderUserID = @UsrID
          AND M.IsDeleted = 0
          AND M.State = 0
          AND C.State = 0
          AND C.ConversationCompanyID = @CmpID
          AND CM.UserID = @UsrID
          AND CM.State = 0
          AND CM.LeftAt IS NULL
          AND NOT EXISTS
          (
              SELECT 1
              FROM dbo.Msg_ConversationMember AS CMX
              WHERE CMX.ConversationID = C.ConversationID
                AND CMX.State = 0
                AND CMX.LeftAt IS NULL
                AND NOT EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM dbo.Mng_User AS UX
                    INNER JOIN dbo.Emp_Employee AS EX
                        ON EX.EmpID = UX.UsrID
                       AND EX.EmpState = 0
                     INNER JOIN dbo.Mng_UserParmations AS UP
            ON UP.USPUserID = U.UsrID
           AND UP.USPCompanyID = @CmpID
           AND UP.USPState = 0
                    WHERE UX.UsrID = CMX.UserID
                      AND UX.UsrState = 0
                )
          );

        IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0
            THROW 51233, N'لا يمكن تعديل الرسالة أو أنها ليست ضمن الشركة الحالية.', 1;

        UPDATE R
        SET ReadAt =
            CASE
                WHEN R.UserID = @UsrID
                    THEN COALESCE(R.ReadAt, @Now)
                ELSE NULL
            END
        FROM dbo.Msg_MessageReceipt AS R
        INNER JOIN dbo.Msg_Message AS M
            ON M.MessageID = R.MessageID
        INNER JOIN dbo.Msg_Conversation AS C
            ON C.ConversationID = M.ConversationID
        INNER JOIN dbo.Msg_ConversationMember AS CM
            ON CM.ConversationID = C.ConversationID
           AND CM.UserID = R.UserID
           AND CM.State = 0
           AND CM.LeftAt IS NULL
        INNER JOIN dbo.Mng_User AS UR
            ON UR.UsrID = R.UserID
           AND UR.UsrState = 0
        INNER JOIN dbo.Emp_Employee AS ER
            ON ER.EmpID = UR.UsrID
           AND ER.EmpState = 0
         INNER JOIN dbo.Mng_UserParmations AS UP
            ON UP.USPUserID = UR.UsrID
           AND UP.USPCompanyID = @CmpID
           AND UP.USPState = 0
        WHERE R.MessageID = @MessageID
          AND R.State = 0
          AND C.ConversationCompanyID = @CmpID;

        COMMIT TRANSACTION;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF XACT_STATE() <> 0
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;

        THROW;
    END CATCH;
END;
GO

        INNER JOIN dbo.Emp_Employee AS E
            ON E.EmpID = U.UsrID
           AND E.EmpState = 0
        INNER JOIN dbo.Mng_UserParmations AS UP
            ON UP.USPUserID = U.UsrID
           AND UP.USPCompanyID = @CmpID
           AND UP.USPState = 0
        WHERE A.AttachmentID = @AttachmentID
          AND A.State = 0
          AND M.State = 0
          AND M.IsDeleted = 0
          AND C.State = 0
          AND C.ConversationCompanyID = @CmpID
          AND CM.UserID = @UsrID
          AND CM.State = 0
          AND CM.LeftAt IS NULL
          AND NOT EXISTS
          (
              SELECT 1
              FROM dbo.Msg_ConversationMember AS CMX
              WHERE CMX.ConversationID = C.ConversationID
                AND CMX.State = 0
                AND CMX.LeftAt IS NULL
                AND NOT EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM dbo.Mng_User AS UX
                    INNER JOIN dbo.Emp_Employee AS EX
                        ON EX.EmpID = UX.UsrID
                       AND EX.EmpState = 0
                    INNER JOIN dbo.Mng_UserParmations AS UP
            ON UP.USPUserID = U.UsrID
           AND UP.USPCompanyID = @CmpID
           AND UP.USPState = 0
                    WHERE UX.UsrID = CMX.UserID
                      AND UX.UsrState = 0
                )
          )
    )
        THROW 51061, N'المرفق غير موجود أو لا تملك صلاحية الوصول إليه في الشركة الحالية.', 1;

    SELECT

        A.MessageID,
        A.FileName,
        A.ContentType,
        A.FileSize,
        A.FileData,
        A.UploadedAt
    FROM dbo.Msg_MessageAttachment AS A

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>

-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Msg_GetAvailableConversationMembers]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@UsrID Bigint , @CmpID int ,@ConversationID bigint
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- Insert statements for procedure here
	SELECT DISTINCT U.UsrID, E.EmpName, E.EmpNum
        FROM dbo.Mng_User AS U
        INNER  JOIN dbo.Emp_Employee AS E
            ON E.EmpID = U.UsrID AND E.EmpState = 0
             INNER JOIN dbo.Mng_UserParmations AS UP
            ON UP.USPUserID = U.UsrID
           AND UP.USPCompanyID = @CmpID
           AND UP.USPState = 0
        WHERE U.UsrState = 0
          AND U.UsrID <> @UsrID
          AND E.EmpCompany = @CmpID
          AND NOT EXISTS
          (
              SELECT 1
              FROM dbo.Msg_ConversationMember AS CM
              WHERE CM.ConversationID = @ConversationID
                AND CM.UserID = U.UsrID
                AND CM.State = 0
                AND CM.LeftAt IS NULL
          )
        ORDER BY  E.EmpNum,  E.EmpName,U.UsrID;
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Msg_GetConversationHeader]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Msg_GetConversationHeader]
    @ConversationID BIGINT,
    @UsrID BIGINT,
    @CmpID INT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    SELECT
        C.ConversationType,
        C.ConversationTitle,
        CASE
            WHEN C.ConversationType = 0
                THEN CONCAT(
                    COALESCE(EO.EmpNum, N''),
                    CASE
                        WHEN EO.EmpNum IS NOT NULL
                         AND EO.EmpName IS NOT NULL
                            THEN N' - '
                        ELSE N''
                    END,
                    COALESCE(EO.EmpName, N'')
                )
            ELSE C.ConversationTitle
        END AS DisplayName
    FROM dbo.Msg_Conversation AS C
    LEFT JOIN dbo.Mng_User AS OtherU
        ON OtherU.UsrID =
            CASE
                WHEN C.DirectUser1ID = @UsrID
                    THEN C.DirectUser2ID
                ELSE C.DirectUser1ID
            END
       AND C.ConversationType = 0
       AND OtherU.UsrState = 0
    LEFT JOIN dbo.Emp_Employee AS EO
        ON EO.EmpID = OtherU.UsrID
       AND EO.EmpState = 0
    WHERE C.ConversationID = @ConversationID
      AND C.ConversationCompanyID = @CmpID
      AND C.State = 0
      AND EXISTS
      (
          SELECT 1
          FROM dbo.Msg_ConversationMember AS CM
          WHERE CM.ConversationID = C.ConversationID
            AND CM.UserID = @UsrID
            AND CM.State = 0
            AND CM.LeftAt IS NULL
      );
END;
GO

/*==============================================================
  15. GET CONVERSATION MEMBERS
==============================================================*/
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Msg_GetConversationMembers]
    @ConversationID BIGINT,
    @UsrID BIGINT,
    @CmpID INT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    IF NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1
        FROM dbo.Msg_Conversation AS C
        INNER JOIN dbo.Msg_ConversationMember AS CM
            ON CM.ConversationID = C.ConversationID
        INNER JOIN dbo.Mng_User AS U
            ON U.UsrID = @UsrID
           AND U.UsrState = 0
        INNER JOIN dbo.Emp_Employee AS E
            ON E.EmpID = U.UsrID
           AND E.EmpState = 0
         INNER JOIN dbo.Mng_UserParmations AS UP
            ON UP.USPUserID = U.UsrID
           AND UP.USPCompanyID = @CmpID
           AND UP.USPState = 0
        WHERE C.ConversationID = @ConversationID
          AND C.ConversationCompanyID = @CmpID
          AND C.State = 0
          AND CM.UserID = @UsrID
          AND CM.State = 0
          AND CM.LeftAt IS NULL
    )
        THROW 51081, N'لا تملك صلاحية عرض أعضاء هذه المحادثة في الشركة الحالية.', 1;

    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1
        FROM dbo.Msg_ConversationMember AS CM
        WHERE CM.ConversationID = @ConversationID
          AND CM.State = 0
          AND CM.LeftAt IS NULL
          AND NOT EXISTS
          (
              SELECT 1
              FROM dbo.Mng_User AS U
              INNER JOIN dbo.Emp_Employee AS E
                  ON E.EmpID = U.UsrID
                 AND E.EmpState = 0
              INNER JOIN dbo.Mng_UserParmations AS UP
            ON UP.USPUserID = U.UsrID
           AND UP.USPCompanyID = @CmpID
           AND UP.USPState = 0
              WHERE U.UsrID = CM.UserID
                AND U.UsrState = 0
          )
    )
        THROW 51082, N'تحتوي المحادثة على عضو لا ينتمي إلى الشركة المحددة.', 1;

    SELECT
        CM.UserID,
        CM.MemberRole,
        CM.JoinedAt,
        E.EmpNum,
        E.EmpName,
        CONCAT
        (
            COALESCE(E.EmpNum, N''),
            CASE
                WHEN E.EmpNum IS NOT NULL AND E.EmpName IS NOT NULL
                    THEN N' - '
                ELSE N''
            END,
            COALESCE(E.EmpName, U.UsrLogIn)
        ) AS EmployeeDisplayName
    FROM dbo.Msg_ConversationMember AS CM
    INNER JOIN dbo.Mng_User AS U
        ON U.UsrID = CM.UserID
       AND U.UsrState = 0
    INNER JOIN dbo.Emp_Employee AS E
        ON E.EmpID = U.UsrID
       AND E.EmpState = 0
    INNER JOIN dbo.Mng_UserParmations AS UP
            ON UP.USPUserID = U.UsrID
           AND UP.USPCompanyID = @CmpID
           AND UP.USPState = 0
    WHERE CM.ConversationID = @ConversationID
      AND CM.State = 0
      AND CM.LeftAt IS NULL
    ORDER BY CM.JoinedAt, E.EmpName;
END;
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Msg_GetConversations]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Msg_GetConversations]
    @UsrID BIGINT,
    @CmpID INT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    IF @CmpID IS NULL
        THROW 51090,N'يجب تحديد الشركة الحالية.',1;

    IF NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_User
        WHERE UsrID=@UsrID AND UsrState=0
    )
        THROW 51091,N'المستخدم غير موجود أو حسابه غير فعال.',1;

    SELECT
        C.ConversationID,
        C.ConversationType,
        C.ConversationTitle,
        C.CreatedAt,
        C.UpdatedAt,
        CASE
          WHEN C.ConversationType=1 THEN C.ConversationTitle
          ELSE COALESCE
          (
            NULLIF
            (
              LTRIM(RTRIM(CONCAT
              (
                COALESCE(EO.EmpNum,N''),
                CASE WHEN NULLIF(EO.EmpNum,N'') IS NOT NULL
                           AND NULLIF(EO.EmpName,N'') IS NOT NULL
                     THEN N' - ' ELSE N'' END,
                COALESCE(NULLIF(EO.EmpName,N''),
                         NULLIF(OU.UsrLogIn,N''),N'مستخدم')
              ))),N''),
            N'محادثة فردية'
          )
        END AS DisplayName,
        LM.MessageID AS LastMessageID,
        CASE WHEN LM.IsDeleted=1
             THEN N'تم حذف الرسالة' ELSE LM.MessageText END AS LastMessageText,
        LM.SentAt AS LastMessageAt,
        LM.SenderUserID AS LastSenderUserID,
        (
            SELECT COUNT_BIG(*)
            FROM dbo.Msg_MessageReceipt R
            JOIN dbo.Msg_Message M2 ON M2.MessageID=R.MessageID
            WHERE M2.ConversationID=C.ConversationID
              AND R.UserID=@UsrID
              AND R.ReadAt IS NULL AND R.State=0
              AND M2.SenderUserID<>@UsrID
              AND M2.IsDeleted=0 AND M2.State=0
        ) AS UnreadCount,
        C.CreatedByUserID
    FROM dbo.Msg_Conversation C
    JOIN dbo.Msg_ConversationMember Mine
      ON Mine.ConversationID=C.ConversationID
     AND Mine.UserID=@UsrID
     AND Mine.State=0 AND Mine.LeftAt IS NULL
    LEFT JOIN dbo.Mng_User OU
      ON OU.UsrID=
         CASE WHEN C.DirectUser1ID=@UsrID
              THEN C.DirectUser2ID ELSE C.DirectUser1ID END
     AND C.ConversationType=0 AND OU.UsrState=0
    LEFT JOIN dbo.Emp_Employee EO
      ON EO.EmpID=OU.UsrID AND EO.EmpState=0
    OUTER APPLY
    (
        SELECT TOP(1)
            M.MessageID,M.MessageText,M.SentAt,M.SenderUserID,M.IsDeleted
        FROM dbo.Msg_Message M
        WHERE M.ConversationID=C.ConversationID AND M.State=0
        ORDER BY M.MessageID DESC
    ) LM
    WHERE C.State=0
      AND C.ConversationCompanyID=@CmpID
    ORDER BY COALESCE(C.UpdatedAt,C.CreatedAt) DESC,
             C.ConversationID DESC;
END;

GO

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Msg_GetMessageAttachments]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Msg_GetMessageAttachments]
    @ConversationID BIGINT,
    @UsrID BIGINT,
    @CmpID INT,
    @MessageIDs NVARCHAR(MAX)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    ;WITH RequestedMessages AS
    (
        SELECT DISTINCT
            TRY_CONVERT(BIGINT, LTRIM(RTRIM(value))) AS MessageID
        FROM STRING_SPLIT(@MessageIDs, N',')
        WHERE TRY_CONVERT(BIGINT, LTRIM(RTRIM(value))) > 0
    )
    SELECT
        A.AttachmentID,
        A.MessageID,
        A.FileName,
        M.SenderUserID
    FROM dbo.Msg_MessageAttachment AS A
    INNER JOIN dbo.Msg_Message AS M
        ON M.MessageID = A.MessageID
    INNER JOIN dbo.Msg_Conversation AS C
        ON C.ConversationID = M.ConversationID
    INNER JOIN RequestedMessages AS RM
        ON RM.MessageID = M.MessageID
    WHERE M.ConversationID = @ConversationID
      AND A.State = 0
      AND M.IsDeleted = 0
      AND M.State = 0
      AND C.State = 0
      AND C.ConversationCompanyID = @CmpID
      AND EXISTS
      (
          SELECT 1
          FROM dbo.Msg_ConversationMember AS CM
          WHERE CM.ConversationID = C.ConversationID
            AND CM.UserID = @UsrID
            AND CM.State = 0
            AND CM.LeftAt IS NULL
      )
    ORDER BY A.AttachmentID;
END;
GO

/*==============================================================
  8. GET MESSAGE FOR EDIT
==============================================================*/
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Msg_GetMessageForEdit]
    @MessageID BIGINT,
    @ConversationID BIGINT,
    @UsrID BIGINT,
    @CmpID INT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    SELECT
        M.MessageID,
        M.MessageText
    FROM dbo.Msg_Message AS M
    INNER JOIN dbo.Msg_Conversation AS C
        ON C.ConversationID = M.ConversationID
    INNER JOIN dbo.Msg_ConversationMember AS CM
        ON CM.ConversationID = C.ConversationID
       AND CM.UserID = @UsrID
       AND CM.State = 0
       AND CM.LeftAt IS NULL
    INNER JOIN dbo.Mng_User AS U
        ON U.UsrID = @UsrID
       AND U.UsrState = 0
    INNER JOIN dbo.Emp_Employee AS E
        ON E.EmpID = U.UsrID
       AND E.EmpState = 0
    INNER JOIN dbo.Mng_UserParmations AS UP
            ON UP.USPUserID = U.UsrID
           AND UP.USPCompanyID = @CmpID
           AND UP.USPState = 0
    WHERE M.MessageID = @MessageID
      AND M.ConversationID = @ConversationID
      AND M.SenderUserID = @UsrID
      AND M.IsDeleted = 0
      AND M.State = 0
      AND C.State = 0
      AND C.ConversationCompanyID = @CmpID;
END;

SET ANSI_NULLS ON

/*==============================================================
  3. GET MESSAGES
==============================================================*/
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Msg_GetMessages]
    @ConversationID BIGINT,
    @UsrID BIGINT,
    @CmpID INT,
    @BeforeMessageID BIGINT = NULL,
    @PageSize INT = 50
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    IF @PageSize IS NULL OR @PageSize < 1
        SET @PageSize = 50;

    IF @PageSize > 100
        SET @PageSize = 100;

    IF NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1
        FROM dbo.Mng_User AS U
        INNER JOIN dbo.Emp_Employee AS E
            ON E.EmpID = U.UsrID
           AND E.EmpState = 0
        INNER JOIN dbo.Mng_UserParmations AS UP
            ON UP.USPUserID = U.UsrID
           AND UP.USPCompanyID = @CmpID
           AND UP.USPState = 0
        WHERE U.UsrID = @UsrID
          AND U.UsrState = 0
    )
        THROW 51100, N'المستخدم لا يملك عضوية فعالة في الشركة الحالية.', 1;

    IF NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1
        FROM dbo.Msg_Conversation AS C
        INNER JOIN dbo.Msg_ConversationMember AS CM
            ON CM.ConversationID = C.ConversationID
        WHERE C.ConversationID = @ConversationID
          AND C.ConversationCompanyID = @CmpID
          AND C.State = 0
          AND CM.UserID = @UsrID
          AND CM.State = 0
          AND CM.LeftAt IS NULL
    )
        THROW 51101, N'لا تملك صلاحية عرض هذه المحادثة في الشركة الحالية.', 1;

    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1
        FROM dbo.Msg_ConversationMember AS CM
        WHERE CM.ConversationID = @ConversationID
          AND CM.State = 0
          AND CM.LeftAt IS NULL
          AND NOT EXISTS
          (
              SELECT 1
              FROM dbo.Mng_User AS U
              INNER JOIN dbo.Emp_Employee AS E
                  ON E.EmpID = U.UsrID
                 AND E.EmpState = 0
              INNER JOIN dbo.Mng_UserParmations AS UP
            ON UP.USPUserID = U.UsrID
           AND UP.USPCompanyID = @CmpID
           AND UP.USPState = 0
              WHERE U.UsrID = CM.UserID
                AND U.UsrState = 0
          )
    )
        THROW 51102, N'تحتوي المحادثة على عضو لا يملك عضوية فعالة في الشركة الحالية.', 1;

    SELECT TOP (@PageSize)
        M.MessageID,
        M.ConversationID,
        M.SenderUserID,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(E.EmpName, N''), U.UsrLogIn, N'مستخدم') AS SenderName,
        E.EmpNum AS SenderEmpNum,
        E.EmpName AS SenderEmpName,
        CASE
            WHEN M.IsDeleted = 1 THEN N'تم حذف الرسالة'
            ELSE M.MessageText
        END AS MessageText,
        M.SentAt,
        M.EditedAt,
        M.IsDeleted,
        CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(MAX)) AS RecipientName,
        R.DeliveredAt,
        R.ReadAt,
        (
            SELECT COUNT_BIG(1)
            FROM dbo.Msg_MessageAttachment AS A
            WHERE A.MessageID = M.MessageID
              AND A.State = 0
              AND M.IsDeleted = 0
        ) AS AttachmentCount
    FROM dbo.Msg_Message AS M
    LEFT JOIN dbo.Mng_User AS U
        ON U.UsrID = M.SenderUserID
       AND U.UsrState = 0
    LEFT JOIN dbo.Emp_Employee AS E
        ON E.EmpID = U.UsrID
       AND E.EmpState = 0
    LEFT JOIN dbo.Msg_MessageReceipt AS R
        ON R.MessageID = M.MessageID
       AND R.UserID = @UsrID
       AND R.State = 0
    WHERE M.ConversationID = @ConversationID
      AND M.State = 0
      AND (@BeforeMessageID IS NULL OR M.MessageID < @BeforeMessageID)
    ORDER BY M.MessageID DESC;
END;
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Msg_GetOutgoingReceiptStatus]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Msg_GetOutgoingReceiptStatus]
    @ConversationID BIGINT,
    @UsrID BIGINT,
    @CmpID INT,
    @MessageIDs NVARCHAR(MAX)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    ;WITH RequestedMessages AS
    (
        SELECT DISTINCT
            TRY_CONVERT(BIGINT, LTRIM(RTRIM(value))) AS MessageID
        FROM STRING_SPLIT(@MessageIDs, N',')
        WHERE TRY_CONVERT(BIGINT, LTRIM(RTRIM(value))) > 0
    )
    SELECT
        M.MessageID,
        COUNT_BIG(R.ReceiptID) AS RecipientCount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN R.DeliveredAt IS NOT NULL
                 THEN CONVERT(BIGINT, 1) ELSE CONVERT(BIGINT, 0)
            END) AS DeliveredCount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN R.ReadAt IS NOT NULL
                 THEN CONVERT(BIGINT, 1) ELSE CONVERT(BIGINT, 0)
            END) AS ReadCount
    FROM dbo.Msg_Message AS M
    INNER JOIN dbo.Msg_MessageReceipt AS R
        ON R.MessageID = M.MessageID
       AND R.State = 0
       AND R.UserID <> M.SenderUserID
    INNER JOIN dbo.Msg_ConversationMember AS CM
        ON CM.ConversationID = M.ConversationID
       AND CM.UserID = R.UserID
       AND CM.State = 0
       AND CM.LeftAt IS NULL
    INNER JOIN dbo.Msg_Conversation AS C
        ON C.ConversationID = M.ConversationID
    INNER JOIN RequestedMessages AS RM
        ON RM.MessageID = M.MessageID
    WHERE M.ConversationID = @ConversationID
      AND M.SenderUserID = @UsrID
      AND C.ConversationCompanyID = @CmpID
      AND C.State = 0
      AND EXISTS
      (
          SELECT 1
          FROM dbo.Msg_ConversationMember AS SenderMember
          WHERE SenderMember.ConversationID = C.ConversationID
            AND SenderMember.UserID = @UsrID
            AND SenderMember.State = 0
            AND SenderMember.LeftAt IS NULL
      )
    GROUP BY M.MessageID;
END;
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Msg_GetUserForConversation]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@UsrID Bigint , @CmpID int
AS
BEGIN

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Msg_HideConversation]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Msg_HideConversation]
    @ConversationID BIGINT,
    @UsrID BIGINT,
    @CmpID INT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    UPDATE C
    SET C.State = 1,
        C.UpdatedAt = SYSDATETIME()
    FROM dbo.Msg_Conversation AS C
    WHERE C.ConversationID = @ConversationID
      AND C.ConversationCompanyID = @CmpID
      AND C.CreatedByUserID = @UsrID
      AND C.State = 0
      AND EXISTS
      (
          SELECT 1
          FROM dbo.Msg_ConversationMember AS CM
          WHERE CM.ConversationID = C.ConversationID
            AND CM.UserID = @UsrID
            AND CM.State = 0
            AND CM.LeftAt IS NULL
      )
      AND EXISTS
      (
          SELECT 1
          FROM dbo.Mng_User AS U
          INNER JOIN dbo.Emp_Employee AS E
              ON E.EmpID = U.UsrID
          WHERE U.UsrID = @UsrID
            AND U.UsrState = 0
            AND E.EmpState = 0
      );

    SELECT @@ROWCOUNT AS AffectedRows;
END;
GO

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Msg_IsGroupCreator]
    @ConversationID BIGINT,
    @UsrID BIGINT,
    @CmpID INT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    SELECT CAST(
        CASE WHEN EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM dbo.Msg_Conversation AS C
            WHERE C.ConversationID = @ConversationID
              AND C.ConversationType = 1
              AND C.CreatedByUserID = @UsrID
              AND C.ConversationCompanyID = @CmpID
              AND C.State = 0
              AND EXISTS
              (
                  SELECT 1
                  FROM dbo.Msg_ConversationMember AS CM
                  WHERE CM.ConversationID = C.ConversationID
                    AND CM.UserID = @UsrID
                    AND CM.State = 0
                    AND CM.LeftAt IS NULL
              )
        )
        THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
    AS BIT) AS IsCreator;
END;

/*==============================================================
  4. MARK CONVERSATION AS READ
==============================================================*/
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Msg_MarkConversationRead]
    @ConversationID BIGINT,
    @UsrID BIGINT,
    @CmpID INT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    IF NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1
        FROM dbo.Mng_User AS U
        INNER JOIN dbo.Emp_Employee AS E
            ON E.EmpID = U.UsrID
           AND E.EmpState = 0
       INNER JOIN dbo.Mng_UserParmations AS UP
            ON UP.USPUserID = U.UsrID
           AND UP.USPCompanyID = @CmpID
           AND UP.USPState = 0
        WHERE U.UsrID = @UsrID
          AND U.UsrState = 0
    )
        THROW 51110, N'المستخدم لا يملك عضوية فعالة في الشركة الحالية.', 1;

    IF NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1
        FROM dbo.Msg_Conversation AS C
        INNER JOIN dbo.Msg_ConversationMember AS CM
            ON CM.ConversationID = C.ConversationID
        WHERE C.ConversationID = @ConversationID
          AND C.ConversationCompanyID = @CmpID
          AND C.State = 0
          AND CM.UserID = @UsrID
          AND CM.State = 0
          AND CM.LeftAt IS NULL
          AND NOT EXISTS
          (
              SELECT 1
              FROM dbo.Msg_ConversationMember AS CMX
              WHERE CMX.ConversationID = C.ConversationID
                AND CMX.State = 0
                AND CMX.LeftAt IS NULL
                AND NOT EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM dbo.Mng_User AS UX
                    INNER JOIN dbo.Emp_Employee AS EX
                        ON EX.EmpID = UX.UsrID
                       AND EX.EmpState = 0
                    INNER JOIN dbo.Mng_UserParmations AS UP
            ON UP.USPUserID = UX.UsrID
           AND UP.USPCompanyID = @CmpID
           AND UP.USPState = 0
                    WHERE UX.UsrID = CMX.UserID
                      AND UX.UsrState = 0
                )
          )
    )
        THROW 51111, N'لا تملك صلاحية الوصول إلى هذه المحادثة في الشركة الحالية.', 1;

    UPDATE R
    SET DeliveredAt = COALESCE(R.DeliveredAt, SYSDATETIME()),
        ReadAt = COALESCE(R.ReadAt, SYSDATETIME())
    FROM dbo.Msg_MessageReceipt AS R
    INNER JOIN dbo.Msg_Message AS M
        ON M.MessageID = R.MessageID
    INNER JOIN dbo.Msg_Conversation AS C
        ON C.ConversationID = M.ConversationID
    WHERE C.ConversationID = @ConversationID
      AND C.ConversationCompanyID = @CmpID
      AND M.SenderUserID <> @UsrID
      AND R.UserID = @UsrID
      AND R.State = 0
      AND M.State = 0
      AND M.IsDeleted = 0;
END;
GO

UPDATE R

/*==============================================================
  16. REMOVE CONVERSATION MEMBER
==============================================================*/
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Msg_RemoveConversationMember]
    @ConversationID BIGINT,
    @UserID BIGINT,
    @RemovedByUserID BIGINT,
    @CompanyID INT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;

        IF NOT EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM dbo.Msg_Conversation AS C WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
            INNER JOIN dbo.Msg_ConversationMember AS CM
                ON CM.ConversationID = C.ConversationID
               AND CM.UserID = @RemovedByUserID
               AND CM.State = 0
               AND CM.LeftAt IS NULL
            INNER JOIN dbo.Mng_User AS U
                ON U.UsrID = @RemovedByUserID
               AND U.UsrState = 0
            INNER JOIN dbo.Emp_Employee AS E
                ON E.EmpID = U.UsrID
               AND E.EmpState = 0
            WHERE C.ConversationID = @ConversationID
              AND C.ConversationCompanyID = @CompanyID
              AND C.ConversationType = 1
              AND C.CreatedByUserID = @RemovedByUserID
              AND C.State = 0
        )
            THROW 51112, N'حذف الأعضاء متاح لمنشئ المجموعة النشط داخل الشركة نفسها فقط.', 1;

        IF @UserID = @RemovedByUserID
            THROW 51113, N'لا يمكن لمنشئ المجموعة حذف عضويته بنفسه.', 1;

      
        UPDATE dbo.Msg_ConversationMember
        SET State = 1,
            LeftAt = COALESCE(LeftAt, SYSDATETIME())
        WHERE ConversationID = @ConversationID
          AND UserID = @UserID
          AND State = 0
          AND LeftAt IS NULL;

        IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0
            THROW 51114, N'العضو غير موجود في المجموعة أو أن عضويته غير نشطة.', 1;

        UPDATE dbo.Msg_Conversation
        SET UpdatedAt = SYSDATETIME()
        WHERE ConversationID = @ConversationID
          AND ConversationCompanyID = @CompanyID;

        COMMIT TRANSACTION;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF XACT_STATE() <> 0
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;

        THROW;
    END CATCH;
END;
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Msg_SendMessage]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

/*==============================================================
  5. SEND MESSAGE
==============================================================*/
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Msg_SendMessage]
    @ConversationID BIGINT,
    @UsrID BIGINT,
    @MessageText NVARCHAR(MAX),
    @MessageID BIGINT OUTPUT,
    @CmpID INT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    SET @MessageID = NULL;
    SET @MessageText = LTRIM(RTRIM(@MessageText));

    IF NULLIF(@MessageText, N'') IS NULL
        THROW 51020, N'نص الرسالة مطلوب.', 1;

    IF DATALENGTH(@MessageText) > 20000
        THROW 51021, N'الحد الأقصى للرسالة 10000 حرف.', 1;

    IF NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1
        FROM dbo.Mng_User AS U
        INNER JOIN dbo.Emp_Employee AS E
            ON E.EmpID = U.UsrID
           AND E.EmpState = 0
       INNER JOIN dbo.Mng_UserParmations AS UP
            ON UP.USPUserID = U.UsrID
           AND UP.USPCompanyID = @CmpID
           AND UP.USPState = 0
        WHERE U.UsrID = @UsrID
          AND U.UsrState = 0
    )
        THROW 51022, N'المرسل لا يملك عضوية فعالة في الشركة الحالية.', 1;

    IF NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1
        FROM dbo.Msg_Conversation AS C
        INNER JOIN dbo.Msg_ConversationMember AS CM
            ON CM.ConversationID = C.ConversationID
        WHERE C.ConversationID = @ConversationID
          AND C.ConversationCompanyID = @CmpID
          AND C.State = 0
          AND CM.UserID = @UsrID
          AND CM.State = 0
          AND CM.LeftAt IS NULL
    )
        THROW 51023, N'لا تملك صلاحية إرسال رسالة إلى هذه المحادثة في الشركة الحالية.', 1;

    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1
        FROM dbo.Msg_ConversationMember AS CM
        WHERE CM.ConversationID = @ConversationID
          AND CM.State = 0
          AND CM.LeftAt IS NULL
          AND NOT EXISTS
          (
              SELECT 1
              FROM dbo.Mng_User AS U
              INNER JOIN dbo.Emp_Employee AS E
                  ON E.EmpID = U.UsrID
                 AND E.EmpState = 0
              INNER JOIN dbo.Mng_UserParmations AS UP
            ON UP.USPUserID = U.UsrID
           AND UP.USPCompanyID = @CmpID
           AND UP.USPState = 0
              WHERE U.UsrID = CM.UserID
                AND U.UsrState = 0
          )
    )
        THROW 51024, N'توجد عضوية في المحادثة لا تنتمي للشركة الحالية.', 1;

    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;

        INSERT INTO dbo.Msg_Message
        (
            ConversationID,
            SenderUserID,
            MessageText,
            State
        )
        VALUES
        (
            @ConversationID,
            @UsrID,
            @MessageText,
            0
        );

        SET @MessageID = CONVERT(BIGINT, SCOPE_IDENTITY());

        INSERT INTO dbo.Msg_MessageReceipt
        (
            MessageID,
            UserID,
            DeliveredAt,
            ReadAt,
            State
        )
        SELECT
            @MessageID,
            CM.UserID,
            CASE WHEN CM.UserID = @UsrID THEN SYSDATETIME() END,
            CASE WHEN CM.UserID = @UsrID THEN SYSDATETIME() END,
            0
        FROM dbo.Msg_ConversationMember AS CM
        INNER JOIN dbo.Mng_User AS U
            ON U.UsrID = CM.UserID
           AND U.UsrState = 0
        INNER JOIN dbo.Emp_Employee AS E
            ON E.EmpID = U.UsrID
           AND E.EmpState = 0
       INNER JOIN dbo.Mng_UserParmations AS UP
            ON UP.USPUserID = U.UsrID
           AND UP.USPCompanyID = @CmpID
           AND UP.USPState = 0
        WHERE CM.ConversationID = @ConversationID
          AND CM.State = 0
          AND CM.LeftAt IS NULL;

        UPDATE dbo.Msg_Conversation
        SET UpdatedAt = SYSDATETIME()
        WHERE ConversationID = @ConversationID
          AND ConversationCompanyID = @CmpID;

        COMMIT TRANSACTION;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF XACT_STATE() <> 0
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;

        SET @MessageID = NULL;
        THROW;
    END CATCH;
END;
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Prt_SaveParty]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Prt_SaveParty]
    @Cmp INT, @User BIGINT, @PrtID BIGINT, @Code NVARCHAR(30), @Name NVARCHAR(200),
    @Role TINYINT, @AccID BIGINT = NULL, @Active BIT = 1, @Whs NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    IF ISNULL(@Cmp, 0) <= 0 THROW 52201, N'الشركة غير صحيحة.', 1;
    IF ISNULL(@User, 0) <= 0 OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_User WHERE UsrID = @User) THROW 52200, N'المستخدم غير موجود.', 1;
    SET @Code = LTRIM(RTRIM(@Code)); SET @Name = LTRIM(RTRIM(@Name));
    IF ISNULL(@Name, N'') = N'' THROW 52202, N'الاسم مطلوب.', 1;
    IF ISNULL(@Code, N'') = N'' AND ISNULL(@PrtID, 0) <> 0 THROW 52202, N'الكود مطلوب.', 1;
    IF ISNULL(@Code, N'') = N''
    BEGIN   -- كود آلي: الرقم التالي للشركة بأربع خانات على الأقل
        DECLARE @pn INT = ISNULL((SELECT MAX(TRY_CAST(PrtCode AS INT)) FROM dbo.Prt_Party WHERE PrtCmpID = @Cmp), 0) + 1;
        SET @Code = RIGHT(CONCAT(N'0000', @pn), CASE WHEN LEN(CAST(@pn AS NVARCHAR(10))) > 4 THEN LEN(CAST(@pn AS NVARCHAR(10))) ELSE 4 END);
    END
    IF @Role IS NULL OR @Role NOT IN (1, 2, 3) THROW 52203, N'نوع الجهة غير صحيح (1 مورد، 2 جهة خدمات، 3 موظف عهدة).', 1;
    -- مخازن المورد (للموردين فقط): NULL = لا يُمسّ الربط؛ وإن مُرّرت فيجب أن يوجد مخزن واحد صحيح على الأقل
    DECLARE @W TABLE (WhID BIGINT PRIMARY KEY);
    IF @Role = 1 AND @Whs IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
        INSERT @W SELECT DISTINCT TRY_CAST(LTRIM(RTRIM(value)) AS BIGINT) FROM STRING_SPLIT(@Whs, N',')
                  WHERE TRY_CAST(LTRIM(RTRIM(value)) AS BIGINT) IS NOT NULL;
        IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM @W) THROW 52240, N'مخزن واحد على الأقل مطلوب للمورد.', 1;
        IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM @W AS x WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Wrh_Warehouse WHERE WhID = x.WhID AND WhCmpID = @Cmp))
            THROW 52240, N'مخزن غير موجود أو لا يتبع الشركة.', 1;
    END
    IF @AccID IS NOT NULL AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Acc_Account WHERE AccID = @AccID)
                               OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Acc_Account WHERE AccParentID = @AccID))
        THROW 52205, N'حساب الجهة غير موجود أو ليس حسابًا ورقيًا.', 1;
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Prt_Party WHERE PrtCmpID = @Cmp AND PrtCode = @Code AND PrtID <> ISNULL(@PrtID, 0))
        THROW 52204, N'كود الجهة مستخدم من قبل.', 1;

    DECLARE @Op SMALLINT = CASE @Role WHEN 1 THEN 201 WHEN 2 THEN 408 END; -- 201 الموردين ، 408 الدائنون المتنوعون
    DECLARE @Started BIT = 0, @Cur BIGINT, @New BIGINT;
    IF ISNULL(@PrtID, 0) <> 0
    BEGIN
        SELECT @Cur = PrtAccID FROM dbo.Prt_Party WHERE PrtID = @PrtID AND PrtCmpID = @Cmp;
        IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0 THROW 52206, N'الجهة غير موجودة أو لا تتبع الشركة.', 1;
    END

    IF @@TRANCOUNT = 0 BEGIN BEGIN TRAN; SET @Started = 1; END
    ELSE SAVE TRANSACTION Sp_Prt_SaveParty;
    BEGIN TRY
        IF @AccID IS NULL AND @Cur IS NULL AND @Op IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            EXEC dbo.Wrh_CreateSystemAccount @Cmp, @User, @Op, @Name, @New OUTPUT;
            SET @AccID = @New;
        END

        IF ISNULL(@PrtID, 0) = 0
        BEGIN
            INSERT dbo.Prt_Party (PrtCmpID, PrtCode, PrtName, PrtRole, PrtAccID, PrtActive, PrtCreatedBy)
            VALUES (@Cmp, @Code, @Name, @Role, @AccID, ISNULL(@Active, 1), @User);
            SET @PrtID = SCOPE_IDENTITY();
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            UPDATE dbo.Prt_Party
               SET PrtCode = @Code, PrtName = @Name, PrtRole = @Role, PrtAccID = COALESCE(@AccID, PrtAccID), PrtActive = ISNULL(@Active, 1)
             WHERE PrtID = @PrtID AND PrtCmpID = @Cmp;
            -- مزامنة اسم حساب النظام (الذي أنشأه النظام فقط) مع اسم الجهة
            IF @Cur IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Acc_PostingRule WHERE AccID = @Cur AND StateID = 1)
               AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Acc_Account WHERE AccID = @Cur AND AccName <> @Name)
                EXEC dbo.Acc_UpdaeAccounting @Name, @Cur, @User, @Cmp;
        END

        IF @Role = 1
        BEGIN
            IF @Whs IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN
                DELETE dbo.Prt_PartyWarehouse WHERE PwPrtID = @PrtID AND PwWhID NOT IN (SELECT WhID FROM @W);
                INSERT dbo.Prt_PartyWarehouse (PwPrtID, PwWhID)
                SELECT @PrtID, WhID FROM @W AS x
                WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Prt_PartyWarehouse WHERE PwPrtID = @PrtID AND PwWhID = x.WhID);
            END
            IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Prt_PartyWarehouse WHERE PwPrtID = @PrtID)
                THROW 52240, N'مخزن واحد على الأقل مطلوب للمورد.', 1;
        END
        IF @Started = 1 COMMIT;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @Started = 1 BEGIN IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 ROLLBACK; END
        ELSE IF XACT_STATE() = 1 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION Sp_Prt_SaveParty;
        THROW;
    END CATCH
    SELECT @PrtID AS PrtID;
END;

GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Prt_SelectPartyWarehouses]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Prt_SelectPartyWarehouses]
    @Cmp INT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SELECT p.PrtID,
           ISNULL(STUFF((SELECT N',' + CAST(l.PwWhID AS NVARCHAR(20)) FROM dbo.Prt_PartyWarehouse AS l
                         WHERE l.PwPrtID = p.PrtID ORDER BY l.PwWhID FOR XML PATH(N''), TYPE).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)'), 1, 1, N''), N'') AS WhIDs,
           ISNULL(STUFF((SELECT N'، ' + h.WhName FROM dbo.Prt_PartyWarehouse AS l JOIN dbo.Wrh_Warehouse AS h ON h.WhID = l.PwWhID
                         WHERE l.PwPrtID = p.PrtID ORDER BY h.WhName FOR XML PATH(N''), TYPE).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)'), 1, 2, N''), N'') AS WhNames
    FROM dbo.Prt_Party AS p
    WHERE p.PrtCmpID = @Cmp;
END;

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Prt_SelectWhParties]
    @Cmp INT, @WhID BIGINT, @ActiveOnly BIT = 1
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SELECT p.PrtID, p.PrtCode, p.PrtName
    FROM dbo.Prt_Party AS p
    WHERE p.PrtCmpID = @Cmp AND p.PrtRole = 1 AND (@ActiveOnly = 0 OR p.PrtActive = 1)
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Prt_PartyWarehouse AS l WHERE l.PwPrtID = p.PrtID AND l.PwWhID = @WhID)
    ORDER BY p.PrtCode;
END;

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Wrh_ApproveCount]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ اعتماد الجرد */
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Wrh_ApproveCount]
    @Cmp INT, @User BIGINT, @DocID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    IF ISNULL(@User, 0) <= 0 OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_User WHERE UsrID = @User) THROW 52707, N'المستخدم غير موجود.', 1;

    DECLARE @Started BIT = 0;
    IF @@TRANCOUNT = 0 BEGIN BEGIN TRAN; SET @Started = 1; END
    ELSE SAVE TRANSACTION Sp_Wrh_ApproveCount;

    BEGIN TRY
        DECLARE @Type TINYINT, @St TINYINT, @Wh BIGINT, @Date DATE, @By BIGINT, @No NVARCHAR(10);
        SELECT @Type = DocType, @St = DocStatus, @Wh = DocWhID, @Date = DocDate, @By = DocCreatedBy, @No = DocNo
        FROM dbo.Wrh_Doc WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) WHERE DocID = @DocID AND DocCmpID = @Cmp;
        IF @Type IS NULL OR @Type <> 13 THROW 52706, N'المستند غير موجود أو ليس جردًا.', 1;
        IF @St <> 1 THROW 52703, N'الجرد ليس مسودة.', 1;
        IF @By = @User AND ISNULL((SELECT WsSeparateDuties FROM dbo.Wrh_Settings WHERE WsCmpID = @Cmp), 1) = 1
            THROW 52702, N'فصل المهام: لا يعتمد الجرد من أنشأه.', 1;

        DECLARE @Method TINYINT = ISNULL((SELECT WsCostMethod FROM dbo.Wrh_Settings WHERE WsCmpID = @Cmp), 1);
        DECLARE @cl BIGINT, @neg BIGINT, @item BIGINT, @cq DECIMAL(18,3), @price DECIMAL(18,6), @cur DECIMAL(18,3), @rsv DECIMAL(18,3),
                @diff DECIMAL(18,3), @need DECIMAL(18,3), @tot DECIMAL(18,3), @cost DECIMAL(18,6), @val DECIMAL(18,3),
                @sq DECIMAL(18,3), @sv DECIMAL(18,3);

        DECLARE cur CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FORWARD_ONLY READ_ONLY FOR
            SELECT CntLineID, ItemID, CountedQty, Price FROM dbo.Wrh_CountLine WHERE CntDocID = @DocID ORDER BY ItemID;
        OPEN cur; FETCH NEXT FROM cur INTO @cl, @item, @cq, @price;
        WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        BEGIN
            SET @neg = -@cl;
            EXEC dbo.Wrh_StockEnsure @Cmp, @Wh, @item;
            SELECT @cur = StkQty, @rsv = StkReserved FROM dbo.Wrh_Stock WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) WHERE StkWhID = @Wh AND StkItemID = @item;
            SET @diff = @cq - @cur;

            IF @diff < 0
            BEGIN
                IF @cq < @rsv THROW 52701, N'الكمية الفعلية أقل من المحجوز لأوامر تحويل مفتوحة؛ عالجها أولًا.', 1;
                SET @need = -@diff;
                EXEC dbo.Wrh_ConsumeFifo @Wh, @item, @need, @neg, NULL, @tot OUTPUT;
                UPDATE dbo.Wrh_Stock SET StkQty = StkQty - @need WHERE StkWhID = @Wh AND StkItemID = @item;
                UPDATE dbo.Wrh_CountLine SET SysQty = @cur, DiffQty = @diff, UnitCost = ROUND(@tot / @need, 6), DiffValue = -@tot WHERE CntLineID = @cl;
            END
            ELSE IF @diff > 0
            BEGIN
                SET @cost = @price;
                IF @cost IS NULL AND @Method = 2
                BEGIN
                    SELECT @sq = SUM(LyQtyRem), @sv = SUM(LyValueRem) FROM dbo.Wrh_Layer WHERE LyWhID = @Wh AND LyItemID = @item AND LyQtyRem > 0;
                    IF ISNULL(@sq, 0) > 0 SET @cost = ROUND(@sv / @sq, 6);
                END
                IF @cost IS NULL
                    SELECT TOP 1 @cost = LyUnitCost FROM dbo.Wrh_Layer WHERE LyWhID = @Wh AND LyItemID = @item ORDER BY LyDate DESC, LayerID DESC;
                IF @cost IS NULL THROW 52705, N'لا توجد تكلفة لزيادة الجرد: أدخل سعر الوحدة في البند.', 1;
                SET @val = ROUND(@diff * @cost, 3);
                INSERT dbo.Wrh_Layer (LyCmpID, LyWhID, LyItemID, LyRootID, LyDate, LyQtyIn, LyQtyRem, LyValueIn, LyValueRem, LyUnitCost, LySrcLineID)
                VALUES (@Cmp, @Wh, @item, 0, @Date, @diff, @diff, @val, @val, @cost, @neg);
                UPDATE dbo.Wrh_Layer SET LyRootID = LayerID WHERE LySrcLineID = @neg AND LyRootID = 0;
                UPDATE dbo.Wrh_Stock SET StkQty = StkQty + @diff WHERE StkWhID = @Wh AND StkItemID = @item;
                UPDATE dbo.Wrh_CountLine SET SysQty = @cur, DiffQty = @diff, UnitCost = @cost, DiffValue = @val WHERE CntLineID = @cl;
            END
            ELSE
                UPDATE dbo.Wrh_CountLine SET SysQty = @cur, DiffQty = 0, UnitCost = NULL, DiffValue = 0 WHERE CntLineID = @cl;

            FETCH NEXT FROM cur INTO @cl, @item, @cq, @price;
        END
        CLOSE cur; DEALLOCATE cur;

        UPDATE dbo.Wrh_Doc SET DocStatus = 3 WHERE DocID = @DocID;
        INSERT dbo.Wrh_DocEvent (EvCmpID, EvDocID, EvDocNo, EvDocType, EvKind, EvUser) VALUES (@Cmp, @DocID, @No, 13, 5, @User);

        IF @Started = 1 COMMIT;
        SELECT @DocID AS DocID, @No AS DocNo;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @Started = 1 BEGIN IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 ROLLBACK; END
        ELSE IF XACT_STATE() = 1 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION Sp_Wrh_ApproveCount;
        THROW;
    END CATCH
END;

GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Wrh_AutoBuild]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ بناء الأسطر الخام لمستندات #AD
   يتوقع المستدعي إنشاء: #AD(DocID) ، #L(DocID,Kind,AccID,CcID,Deb,Crd,Tag) ، #Bad(DocID,Reason)
   Kind 1 = طرف مشترك يُجمَّع في القيد، Kind 2 = أسطر المستند نفسه */
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Wrh_AutoBuild]
    @Cmp INT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    DECLARE @Diff BIGINT, @CN BIGINT, @CA BIGINT;
    SELECT @Diff = WsDiffAccID, @CN = WsCreditNoteAccID, @CA = WsCountAccID FROM dbo.Wrh_Settings WHERE WsCmpID = @Cmp;

    CREATE TABLE #X (DocID BIGINT PRIMARY KEY, Typ TINYINT, Wh BIGINT, Wh2 BIGINT, Party BIGINT, CC BIGINT, RefDoc BIGINT,
                     WhAcc BIGINT, Wh2Acc BIGINT, PartyAcc BIGINT);
    INSERT #X (DocID, Typ, Wh, Wh2, Party, CC, RefDoc, WhAcc, Wh2Acc, PartyAcc)
    SELECT d.DocID, d.DocType, d.DocWhID, d.DocWh2ID, d.DocPartyID, d.DocCostCID, d.DocRefDocID, w.WhAccID, w2.WhAccID, p.PrtAccID
    FROM #AD AS a JOIN dbo.Wrh_Doc AS d ON d.DocID = a.DocID
    LEFT JOIN dbo.Wrh_Warehouse AS w ON w.WhID = d.DocWhID
    LEFT JOIN dbo.Wrh_Warehouse AS w2 ON w2.WhID = d.DocWh2ID
    LEFT JOIN dbo.Prt_Party AS p ON p.PrtID = d.DocPartyID;

    -- قيم البنود
    CREATE TABLE #LV (DocID BIGINT, LineID BIGINT, GrpAcc BIGINT, Amount DECIMAL(18,3), UseVal DECIMAL(18,3), LayerVal DECIMAL(18,3));
    INSERT #LV (DocID, LineID, GrpAcc, Amount, UseVal, LayerVal)
    SELECT l.DocID, l.LineID, g.GrpAccID, l.Amount,
           ISNULL((SELECT SUM(u.UseValue) FROM dbo.Wrh_LayerUse AS u WHERE u.UseLineID = l.LineID), 0),
           ISNULL((SELECT SUM(y.LyValueIn) FROM dbo.Wrh_Layer AS y WHERE y.LySrcLineID = l.LineID AND y.LyWhID = x.Wh), 0)
    FROM #X AS x JOIN dbo.Wrh_DocLine AS l ON l.DocID = x.DocID
    JOIN dbo.Wrh_Item AS i ON i.ItemID = l.ItemID JOIN dbo.Wrh_ItemGroup AS g ON g.GrpID = i.ItemGrpID;

    -- 4 استلام مخزني: من المخزن ← إلى الجهة
    INSERT #L SELECT x.DocID, 1, x.WhAcc, NULL, s.v, 0, N'حساب المخزن' FROM #X x JOIN (SELECT DocID, SUM(Amount) v FROM #LV GROUP BY DocID) s ON s.DocID = x.DocID WHERE x.Typ = 4;
    INSERT #L SELECT x.DocID, 2, x.PartyAcc, NULL, 0, s.v, N'حساب الجهة' FROM #X x JOIN (SELECT DocID, SUM(Amount) v FROM #LV GROUP BY DocID) s ON s.DocID = x.DocID WHERE x.Typ = 4;
    -- 5 صرف مخزني: من مجموعة المواد (مركز الجهة) ← إلى المخزن
    INSERT #L SELECT x.DocID, 2, s.GrpAcc, x.CC, s.v, 0, N'حساب مجموعة المواد' FROM #X x JOIN (SELECT DocID, GrpAcc, SUM(UseVal) v FROM #LV GROUP BY DocID, GrpAcc) s ON s.DocID = x.DocID WHERE x.Typ = 5;
    INSERT #L SELECT x.DocID, 1, x.WhAcc, NULL, 0, s.v, N'حساب المخزن' FROM #X x JOIN (SELECT DocID, SUM(UseVal) v FROM #LV GROUP BY DocID) s ON s.DocID = x.DocID WHERE x.Typ = 5;
    -- 6 صرف مباشر: من مجموعة المواد (مركز الجهة) ← إلى الجهة
    INSERT #L SELECT x.DocID, 2, s.GrpAcc, x.CC, s.v, 0, N'حساب مجموعة المواد' FROM #X x JOIN (SELECT DocID, GrpAcc, SUM(Amount) v FROM #LV GROUP BY DocID, GrpAcc) s ON s.DocID = x.DocID WHERE x.Typ = 6;
    INSERT #L SELECT x.DocID, 2, x.PartyAcc, NULL, 0, s.v, N'حساب الجهة' FROM #X x JOIN (SELECT DocID, SUM(Amount) v FROM #LV GROUP BY DocID) s ON s.DocID = x.DocID WHERE x.Typ = 6;
    -- 8 استلام تحويل: من المخزن المستلم ← إلى المخزن الصارف
    INSERT #L SELECT x.DocID, 1, x.WhAcc, NULL, s.v, 0, N'حساب المخزن' FROM #X x JOIN (SELECT DocID, SUM(UseVal) v FROM #LV GROUP BY DocID) s ON s.DocID = x.DocID WHERE x.Typ = 8;
    INSERT #L SELECT x.DocID, 2, x.Wh2Acc, NULL, 0, s.v, N'حساب المخزن الصارف' FROM #X x JOIN (SELECT DocID, SUM(UseVal) v FROM #LV GROUP BY DocID) s ON s.DocID = x.DocID WHERE x.Typ = 8;
    -- 9 استرجاع من جهة: من المخزن ← إلى مجموعة المواد (مركز الجهة)
    INSERT #L SELECT x.DocID, 1, x.WhAcc, NULL, s.v, 0, N'حساب المخزن' FROM #X x JOIN (SELECT DocID, SUM(LayerVal) v FROM #LV GROUP BY DocID) s ON s.DocID = x.DocID WHERE x.Typ = 9;
    INSERT #L SELECT x.DocID, 2, s.GrpAcc, x.CC, 0, s.v, N'حساب مجموعة المواد' FROM #X x JOIN (SELECT DocID, GrpAcc, SUM(LayerVal) v FROM #LV GROUP BY DocID, GrpAcc) s ON s.DocID = x.DocID WHERE x.Typ = 9;
    -- 10 ترجيع مخزني للمورد: من الجهة ← إلى المخزن
    INSERT #L SELECT x.DocID, 2, x.PartyAcc, NULL, s.v, 0, N'حساب الجهة' FROM #X x JOIN (SELECT DocID, SUM(UseVal) v FROM #LV GROUP BY DocID) s ON s.DocID = x.DocID WHERE x.Typ = 10;
    INSERT #L SELECT x.DocID, 1, x.WhAcc, NULL, 0, s.v, N'حساب المخزن' FROM #X x JOIN (SELECT DocID, SUM(UseVal) v FROM #LV GROUP BY DocID) s ON s.DocID = x.DocID WHERE x.Typ = 10;
    -- 11 ترجيع مباشر للمورد: من الجهة ← إلى مجموعة المواد (مركز الجهة)
    INSERT #L SELECT x.DocID, 2, x.PartyAcc, NULL, s.v, 0, N'حساب الجهة' FROM #X x JOIN (SELECT DocID, SUM(Amount) v FROM #LV GROUP BY DocID) s ON s.DocID = x.DocID WHERE x.Typ = 11;
    INSERT #L SELECT x.DocID, 2, s.GrpAcc, x.CC, 0, s.v, N'حساب مجموعة المواد' FROM #X x JOIN (SELECT DocID, GrpAcc, SUM(Amount) v FROM #LV GROUP BY DocID, GrpAcc) s ON s.DocID = x.DocID WHERE x.Typ = 11;
    -- 12 إشعار دائن: من الجهة ← إلى حساب الإعدادات
    INSERT #L SELECT x.DocID, 2, x.PartyAcc, NULL, s.v, 0, N'حساب الجهة' FROM #X x JOIN (SELECT DocID, SUM(Amount) v FROM #LV GROUP BY DocID) s ON s.DocID = x.DocID WHERE x.Typ = 12;
    INSERT #L SELECT x.DocID, 2, @CN, NULL, 0, s.v, N'حساب مقابل إشعار الدائن (الإعدادات)' FROM #X x JOIN (SELECT DocID, SUM(Amount) v FROM #LV GROUP BY DocID) s ON s.DocID = x.DocID WHERE x.Typ = 12;
    -- 13 جرد: الزيادة من المخزن ← إلى فروق الجرد، والعجز بالعكس
    CREATE TABLE #CV (DocID BIGINT PRIMARY KEY, S DECIMAL(18,3), D DECIMAL(18,3));
    INSERT #CV SELECT c.CntDocID, SUM(CASE WHEN c.DiffValue > 0 THEN c.DiffValue ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN c.DiffValue < 0 THEN -c.DiffValue ELSE 0 END)
    FROM dbo.Wrh_CountLine AS c JOIN #X x ON x.DocID = c.CntDocID WHERE x.Typ = 13 GROUP BY c.CntDocID;
    INSERT #L SELECT x.DocID, 1, x.WhAcc, NULL, v.S, 0, N'حساب المخزن' FROM #X x JOIN #CV v ON v.DocID = x.DocID WHERE v.S > 0;
    INSERT #L SELECT x.DocID, 1, x.WhAcc, NULL, 0, v.D, N'حساب المخزن' FROM #X x JOIN #CV v ON v.DocID = x.DocID WHERE v.D > 0;
    INSERT #L SELECT x.DocID, 2, @CA, NULL, 0, v.S, N'حساب فروق الجرد (الإعدادات)' FROM #X x JOIN #CV v ON v.DocID = x.DocID WHERE v.S > 0;
    INSERT #L SELECT x.DocID, 2, @CA, NULL, v.D, 0, N'حساب فروق الجرد (الإعدادات)' FROM #X x JOIN #CV v ON v.DocID = x.DocID WHERE v.D > 0;
    -- 14 تكلفة إضافية: من المخزن (وفروق التكلفة) ← إلى الجهات؛ 15 تسوية: بالإشارة
    CREATE TABLE #WV (DocID BIGINT, Wh BIGINT, Val DECIMAL(18,3));
    INSERT #WV (DocID, Wh, Val)
    SELECT a.AdjDocID, ly.LyWhID, SUM(y.AddValue)
    FROM dbo.Wrh_CostAdj AS a JOIN #X x ON x.DocID = a.AdjDocID AND x.Typ IN (14, 15)
    JOIN dbo.Wrh_CostAdjLayer AS y ON y.AdjID = a.AdjID JOIN dbo.Wrh_Layer AS ly ON ly.LayerID = y.LayerID
    GROUP BY a.AdjDocID, ly.LyWhID;
    INSERT #WV (DocID, Wh, Val)   -- ما لم تغطّه طبقات حيّة (مؤرشفة مثلًا) يُنسب لمخزن المستند المرجعي
    SELECT x.DocID, r.DocWhID, t.Rem - ISNULL(w.V, 0)
    FROM #X x JOIN dbo.Wrh_Doc AS r ON r.DocID = x.RefDoc
    JOIN (SELECT AdjDocID, SUM(AdjRemPart) AS Rem FROM dbo.Wrh_CostAdj GROUP BY AdjDocID) AS t ON t.AdjDocID = x.DocID
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT DocID, SUM(Val) AS V FROM #WV GROUP BY DocID) AS w ON w.DocID = x.DocID
    WHERE x.Typ IN (14, 15) AND t.Rem - ISNULL(w.V, 0) <> 0;
    INSERT #L SELECT w.DocID, 1, wh.WhAccID, NULL, CASE WHEN w.Val > 0 THEN w.Val ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN w.Val < 0 THEN -w.Val ELSE 0 END, N'حساب المخزن'
    FROM #WV w JOIN dbo.Wrh_Warehouse wh ON wh.WhID = w.Wh WHERE w.Val <> 0;
    INSERT #L SELECT x.DocID, 1, @Diff, NULL, CASE WHEN s.v > 0 THEN s.v ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN s.v < 0 THEN -s.v ELSE 0 END, N'حساب فروق التكلفة (الإعدادات)'
    FROM #X x JOIN (SELECT AdjDocID, SUM(AdjConsPart) v FROM dbo.Wrh_CostAdj GROUP BY AdjDocID) s ON s.AdjDocID = x.DocID WHERE x.Typ IN (14, 15) AND s.v <> 0;
    INSERT #L SELECT x.DocID, 2, p.PrtAccID, NULL, 0, c.CostAmount, N'حساب الجهة'
    FROM #X x JOIN dbo.Wrh_CostLine c ON c.CostDocID = x.DocID JOIN dbo.Prt_Party p ON p.PrtID = c.CostPartyID WHERE x.Typ = 14;
    INSERT #L SELECT x.DocID, 2, x.PartyAcc, NULL, CASE WHEN s.v < 0 THEN -s.v ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN s.v > 0 THEN s.v ELSE 0 END, N'حساب الجهة'
    FROM #X x JOIN (SELECT AdjDocID, SUM(AdjAmount) v FROM dbo.Wrh_CostAdj GROUP BY AdjDocID) s ON s.AdjDocID = x.DocID WHERE x.Typ = 15 AND s.v <> 0;

    DELETE #L WHERE Deb = 0 AND Crd = 0;

    -- أسباب التعليق
    INSERT #Bad (DocID, Reason)
    SELECT t.DocID, N'حساب غير محدد: ' + STUFF((SELECT DISTINCT N'، ' + l2.Tag FROM #L l2 WHERE l2.DocID = t.DocID AND l2.AccID IS NULL FOR XML PATH(N'')), 1, 2, N'')
    FROM (SELECT DISTINCT DocID FROM #L WHERE AccID IS NULL) t;
    INSERT #Bad (DocID, Reason)
    SELECT DISTINCT l.DocID, N'حساب غير صالح للقيد (غير موجود أو لشركة أخرى أو غير تحليلي): ' + l.Tag
    FROM #L l WHERE l.AccID IS NOT NULL AND l.DocID NOT IN (SELECT DocID FROM #Bad)
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Acc_Account a WHERE a.AccID = l.AccID AND a.AccCompany = @Cmp
                      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Acc_Account c WHERE c.AccParentID = a.AccID)
                      AND ((a.AccEnd = 1 AND a.AccType IN (0, 1, 2)) OR (a.AccEnd = 2 AND a.AccType IN (0, 1))));
    INSERT #Bad (DocID, Reason)
    SELECT l.DocID, N'قيد غير متوازن لهذا المستند (راجع طبقاته أو تكاليفه)'
    FROM #L l WHERE l.DocID NOT IN (SELECT DocID FROM #Bad) GROUP BY l.DocID HAVING SUM(l.Deb) <> SUM(l.Crd);
    INSERT #Bad (DocID, Reason)
    SELECT a.DocID, N'قيمته صفر: لا قيد له'
    FROM #AD a WHERE a.DocID NOT IN (SELECT DocID FROM #L) AND a.DocID NOT IN (SELECT DocID FROM #Bad);

    DELETE #L WHERE DocID IN (SELECT DocID FROM #Bad);
END;

GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Wrh_CancelDoc]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Wrh_CancelDoc]
    @Cmp INT, @User BIGINT, @DocID BIGINT, @LineID BIGINT = NULL, @Reason NVARCHAR(200)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    IF ISNULL(@User, 0) <= 0 OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_User WHERE UsrID = @User)
        THROW 52302, N'المستخدم غير موجود.', 1;
    SET @Reason = LTRIM(RTRIM(@Reason));
    IF ISNULL(@Reason, N'') = N'' THROW 52308, N'سبب الإلغاء مطلوب.', 1;

    DECLARE @Started BIT = 0;
    IF @@TRANCOUNT = 0 BEGIN BEGIN TRAN; SET @Started = 1; END
    ELSE SAVE TRANSACTION Sp_Wrh_CancelDoc;

    BEGIN TRY
        DECLARE @Type TINYINT, @No NVARCHAR(10), @Class TINYINT;
        SELECT @Type = d.DocType, @No = d.DocNo, @Class = t.DtClass
        FROM dbo.Wrh_Doc AS d WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
        JOIN dbo.Wrh_DocTypeDef AS t ON t.DtType = d.DocType
        WHERE d.DocID = @DocID AND d.DocCmpID = @Cmp;
        IF @Type IS NULL THROW 52309, N'المستند غير موجود أو لا يتبع الشركة.', 1;
        IF @Class <> 1 THROW 52307, N'الإلغاء للمستندات التجارية فقط.', 1;

        IF @Type = 7   -- أمر التحويل: يُفرَج عن حجز المتبقي الملغى
        BEGIN
            DECLARE @RWh BIGINT = (SELECT DocWhID FROM dbo.Wrh_Doc WHERE DocID = @DocID);
            UPDATE s SET StkReserved = s.StkReserved - x.q
              FROM dbo.Wrh_Stock AS s
              JOIN (SELECT ItemID, SUM(BaseQty - QtyReferred - QtyCancelled) AS q
                    FROM dbo.Wrh_DocLine
                    WHERE DocID = @DocID AND (@LineID IS NULL OR LineID = @LineID) AND BaseQty - QtyReferred - QtyCancelled > 0
                    GROUP BY ItemID) AS x ON x.ItemID = s.StkItemID
             WHERE s.StkWhID = @RWh;
        END

        UPDATE dbo.Wrh_DocLine
           SET QtyCancelled = BaseQty - QtyReferred
         WHERE DocID = @DocID AND (@LineID IS NULL OR LineID = @LineID)
           AND BaseQty - QtyReferred - QtyCancelled > 0;
        IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0 THROW 52307, N'لا يوجد متبقٍ ليُلغى.', 1;

        EXEC dbo.Wrh_RecalcDocStatus @DocID;
        INSERT dbo.Wrh_DocEvent (EvCmpID, EvDocID, EvDocNo, EvDocType, EvKind, EvLineID, EvUser, EvReason)
        VALUES (@Cmp, @DocID, @No, @Type, 4, @LineID, @User, @Reason);

        IF @Started = 1 COMMIT;
        SELECT DocStatus FROM dbo.Wrh_Doc WHERE DocID = @DocID;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @Started = 1 BEGIN IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 ROLLBACK; END
        ELSE IF XACT_STATE() = 1 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION Sp_Wrh_CancelDoc;
        THROW;
    END CATCH
END;

GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Wrh_CloseYear]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ إقفال السنة والأرشفة */
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Wrh_CloseYear]
    @Cmp INT, @User BIGINT, @CloseDate DATE
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    IF ISNULL(@Cmp, 0) <= 0 OR @CloseDate IS NULL THROW 52712, N'الشركة وتاريخ الإقفال مطلوبان.', 1;
    IF ISNULL(@User, 0) <= 0 OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_User WHERE UsrID = @User) THROW 52707, N'المستخدم غير موجود.', 1;
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Wrh_Settings WHERE WsCmpID = @Cmp AND WsClosedUpTo IS NOT NULL AND WsClosedUpTo >= @CloseDate)
        THROW 52712, N'تاريخ الإقفال يجب أن يكون بعد تاريخ آخر إقفال.', 1;
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Wrh_Doc WHERE DocCmpID = @Cmp AND DocType = 13 AND DocStatus = 1 AND DocDate <= @CloseDate)
        THROW 52711, N'توجد مسودات جرد غير معتمدة حتى تاريخ الإقفال.', 1;
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Wrh_Doc WHERE DocCmpID = @Cmp AND DocStatus IN (1, 2) AND DocDate <= @CloseDate)
        THROW 52710, N'توجد مستندات مفتوحة حتى تاريخ الإقفال؛ أنهِها أو ألغِها أولًا.', 1;

    DECLARE @Started BIT = 0;
    IF @@TRANCOUNT = 0 BEGIN BEGIN TRAN; SET @Started = 1; END
    ELSE SAVE TRANSACTION Sp_Wrh_CloseYear;
    BEGIN TRY
        IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Wrh_Settings WHERE WsCmpID = @Cmp) INSERT dbo.Wrh_Settings (WsCmpID) VALUES (@Cmp);

        INSERT dbo.Wrh_YearClose (CloseCmpID, CloseDate, CloseBy, LayersMoved, UsesMoved) VALUES (@Cmp, @CloseDate, @User, 0, 0);
        DECLARE @CloseID BIGINT = SCOPE_IDENTITY(), @nl INT, @nu INT;

        CREATE TABLE #A (LayerID BIGINT PRIMARY KEY);
        INSERT #A (LayerID)
        SELECT l.LayerID FROM dbo.Wrh_Layer AS l WITH (UPDLOCK)
        WHERE l.LyCmpID = @Cmp AND l.LyQtyRem = 0 AND l.LyDate <= @CloseDate
          AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Wrh_Layer AS y WHERE y.LyRootID = l.LyRootID AND y.LyQtyRem > 0);

        INSERT dbo.Wrh_LayerUseArchive (UseID, UseLineID, UseLayerID, UseQty, UseValue, ArchCloseID)
        SELECT u.UseID, u.UseLineID, u.UseLayerID, u.UseQty, u.UseValue, @CloseID FROM dbo.Wrh_LayerUse AS u JOIN #A AS a ON a.LayerID = u.UseLayerID;
        SET @nu = @@ROWCOUNT;
        DELETE u FROM dbo.Wrh_LayerUse AS u JOIN #A AS a ON a.LayerID = u.UseLayerID;
        DELETE x FROM dbo.Wrh_CostAdjLayer AS x JOIN #A AS a ON a.LayerID = x.LayerID;

        INSERT dbo.Wrh_LayerArchive (LayerID, LyCmpID, LyWhID, LyItemID, LyRootID, LyDate, LyQtyIn, LyQtyRem, LyValueIn, LyValueRem, LyUnitCost, LySrcLineID, ArchCloseID)
        SELECT l.LayerID, l.LyCmpID, l.LyWhID, l.LyItemID, l.LyRootID, l.LyDate, l.LyQtyIn, l.LyQtyRem, l.LyValueIn, l.LyValueRem, l.LyUnitCost, l.LySrcLineID, @CloseID
        FROM dbo.Wrh_Layer AS l JOIN #A AS a ON a.LayerID = l.LayerID;
        SET @nl = @@ROWCOUNT;
        DELETE l FROM dbo.Wrh_Layer AS l JOIN #A AS a ON a.LayerID = l.LayerID;
        DROP TABLE #A;

        UPDATE dbo.Wrh_YearClose SET LayersMoved = @nl, UsesMoved = @nu WHERE CloseID = @CloseID;
        UPDATE dbo.Wrh_Settings SET WsClosedUpTo = @CloseDate WHERE WsCmpID = @Cmp;

        IF @Started = 1 COMMIT;
        SELECT @CloseID AS CloseID, @nl AS LayersMoved, @nu AS UsesMoved;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @Started = 1 BEGIN IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 ROLLBACK; END
        ELSE IF XACT_STATE() = 1 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION Sp_Wrh_CloseYear;
        THROW;
    END CATCH
END;

GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Wrh_ConsumeFifo]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Wrh_ConsumeFifo]
    @Wh BIGINT, @Item BIGINT, @Qty DECIMAL(18,3), @UseLineID BIGINT,
    @LayerOnly BIGINT = NULL, @Total DECIMAL(18,3) OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    DECLARE @need DECIMAL(18,3) = @Qty, @lid BIGINT, @rem DECIMAL(18,3), @vrem DECIMAL(18,3),
            @cost DECIMAL(18,6), @take DECIMAL(18,3), @val DECIMAL(18,3);
    SET @Total = 0;

    -- المتوسط المرجح: نوحّد تكلفة طبقات المخزن/الصنف قبل الصرف فيخرج الصرف بالمتوسط تمامًا
    IF @LayerOnly IS NULL AND ISNULL((SELECT s.WsCostMethod FROM dbo.Wrh_Settings AS s
         WHERE s.WsCmpID = (SELECT TOP 1 LyCmpID FROM dbo.Wrh_Layer WHERE LyWhID = @Wh AND LyItemID = @Item)), 1) = 2
        EXEC dbo.Wrh_Rebalance @Wh, @Item;

    DECLARE cur CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FORWARD_ONLY READ_ONLY FOR
        SELECT LayerID, LyQtyRem, LyValueRem, LyUnitCost
        FROM dbo.Wrh_Layer WITH (UPDLOCK)
        WHERE LyWhID = @Wh AND LyItemID = @Item AND LyQtyRem > 0 AND (@LayerOnly IS NULL OR LayerID = @LayerOnly)
        ORDER BY LyDate, LayerID;
    OPEN cur;
    FETCH NEXT FROM cur INTO @lid, @rem, @vrem, @cost;
    WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 AND @need > 0
    BEGIN
        SET @take = CASE WHEN @need < @rem THEN @need ELSE @rem END;
        SET @val  = CASE WHEN @take = @rem THEN @vrem ELSE ROUND(@take * @cost, 3) END;   -- آخر ما يتبقى يأخذ الباقي كاملًا
        IF @val > @vrem SET @val = @vrem;

        UPDATE dbo.Wrh_Layer SET LyQtyRem = LyQtyRem - @take, LyValueRem = LyValueRem - @val WHERE LayerID = @lid;
        INSERT dbo.Wrh_LayerUse (UseLineID, UseLayerID, UseQty, UseValue) VALUES (@UseLineID, @lid, @take, @val);

        SET @need = @need - @take;
        SET @Total = @Total + @val;
        FETCH NEXT FROM cur INTO @lid, @rem, @vrem, @cost;
    END
    CLOSE cur; DEALLOCATE cur;

    IF @need > 0 THROW 52401, N'الكمية المتاحة في طبقات المخزن لا تكفي.', 1;
END;

GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Wrh_CostReverse]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ عكس أثر مستند تكلفة/تسوية */
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Wrh_CostReverse]
    @DocID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Wrh_CostAdjLayer AS x
               JOIN dbo.Wrh_CostAdj AS a ON a.AdjID = x.AdjID
               JOIN dbo.Wrh_Layer AS l WITH (UPDLOCK) ON l.LayerID = x.LayerID
               WHERE a.AdjDocID = @DocID AND l.LyQtyRem <> x.RemAtAdj)
        THROW 52510, N'لا يمكن عكس التكلفة/التسوية: تغيّر المتبقي في الطبقات بعد تطبيقها (استُهلك أو نُقل).', 1;

    UPDATE l
       SET LyUnitCost = CASE WHEN l.LyQtyRem > 0 THEN ROUND((l.LyValueRem - s.v) / l.LyQtyRem, 6) ELSE l.LyUnitCost END,
           LyValueIn  = l.LyValueIn  - s.v,
           LyValueRem = l.LyValueRem - s.v
      FROM dbo.Wrh_Layer AS l
      JOIN (SELECT x.LayerID, SUM(x.AddValue) AS v
            FROM dbo.Wrh_CostAdjLayer AS x JOIN dbo.Wrh_CostAdj AS a ON a.AdjID = x.AdjID
            WHERE a.AdjDocID = @DocID GROUP BY x.LayerID) AS s ON s.LayerID = l.LayerID;

    DELETE x FROM dbo.Wrh_CostAdjLayer AS x JOIN dbo.Wrh_CostAdj AS a ON a.AdjID = x.AdjID WHERE a.AdjDocID = @DocID;
    DELETE dbo.Wrh_CostAdj WHERE AdjDocID = @DocID;
END;

GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Wrh_CreateSystemAccount]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Wrh_CreateSystemAccount]
    @Cmp INT, @User BIGINT, @Op SMALLINT, @Name NVARCHAR(500), @AccID BIGINT OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET @Name = LEFT(LTRIM(RTRIM(@Name)), 500);
    IF ISNULL(@Name, N'') = N'' THROW 52202, N'اسم الحساب مطلوب.', 1;

    DECLARE @Parent BIGINT, @n INT, @OpName NVARCHAR(100), @m NVARCHAR(500);
    SELECT @n = COUNT(*), @Parent = MIN(r.AccID)
    FROM dbo.Acc_PostingRule AS r JOIN dbo.Acc_Account AS a ON a.AccID = r.AccID
    WHERE r.OpID = @Op AND r.StateID IN (3, 4) AND a.AccCompany = @Cmp;
    SELECT @OpName = OpName FROM dbo.Acc_Operation WHERE OpID = @Op;

    IF @n = 0
    BEGIN
        SET @m = CONCAT(N'لا توجد قاعدة ربط حسابات لعملية (', ISNULL(@OpName, CAST(@Op AS NVARCHAR(10))), N') في هذه الشركة؛ أنشئها من شاشة ربط الحسابات.');
        THROW 52960, @m, 1;
    END
    IF @n > 1
    BEGIN
        SET @m = CONCAT(N'يوجد أكثر من حساب أب مسجَّل لعملية (', ISNULL(@OpName, CAST(@Op AS NVARCHAR(10))), N') في هذه الشركة.');
        THROW 52961, @m, 1;
    END

    DECLARE @Started BIT = 0;
    IF @@TRANCOUNT = 0 BEGIN BEGIN TRAN; SET @Started = 1; END
    ELSE SAVE TRANSACTION Sp_Wrh_CreateSystemAccount;
    BEGIN TRY
        EXEC sp_set_session_context N'Acc.SystemOperation', 1;

        DECLARE @ParentChid SMALLINT, @ParentCode NVARCHAR(60), @Ord INT;
        SELECT @ParentChid = AccChid, @ParentCode = AccCode
        FROM dbo.Acc_Account WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
        WHERE AccID = @Parent AND AccCompany = @Cmp AND AccState = 0;
        IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0 THROW 52962, N'الحساب الأب المسجَّل للعملية غير فعّال أو لا يتبع الشركة.', 1;
        IF @ParentChid = 32767 THROW 52962, N'تم تجاوز الحد الأقصى لعدد أبناء الحساب الأب.', 1;
        SET @Ord = CONVERT(INT, @ParentChid) + 1;
        IF LEN(@ParentCode) + LEN(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @Ord)) > 60 THROW 52962, N'رمز الحساب الجديد يتجاوز الحد المسموح.', 1;

        UPDATE dbo.Acc_Account SET AccChid = AccChid + 1 WHERE AccID = @Parent;

        INSERT dbo.Acc_Account (AccEnd, AccType, AccParentID, AccOrder, AccLevel, AccChid, AccCode, AccName, AccState, AccDateTime, AccUser, AccCompany)
        SELECT AccEnd, AccType, AccID, @Ord, AccLevel + 1, 0, @ParentCode + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @Ord), @Name, 0, SYSUTCDATETIME(), @User, AccCompany
        FROM dbo.Acc_Account WHERE AccID = @Parent;
        SET @AccID = CONVERT(BIGINT, SCOPE_IDENTITY());

        EXEC dbo.Acc_UpdateAccountCode @AccCompany = @Cmp;

        INSERT dbo.Acc_AccountHistory (AccHOpration, AccHAccID, AccHEnd, AccHType, AccHParentID, AccHOrder, AccHLevel, AccHChid, AccHCode, AccHName, AccHState, AccHDateTime, AccHUser, AccHCompany)
        SELECT 1, AccID, AccEnd, AccType, AccParentID, AccOrder, AccLevel, AccChid, AccCode, AccName, AccState, AccDateTime, AccUser, AccCompany
        FROM dbo.Acc_Account WHERE AccID = @AccID;

        INSERT dbo.Acc_PostingRule (OpID, AccID, StateID) VALUES (@Op, @AccID, 1);

        EXEC sp_set_session_context N'Acc.SystemOperation', 0;
        IF @Started = 1 COMMIT;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        EXEC sp_set_session_context N'Acc.SystemOperation', 0;
        IF @Started = 1 BEGIN IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 ROLLBACK; END
        ELSE IF XACT_STATE() = 1 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION Sp_Wrh_CreateSystemAccount;
        THROW;
    END CATCH
END;

GO

SET ANSI_NULLS ON

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ حذف مستند تكلفة/تسوية */
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Wrh_DeleteCostDoc]
    @Cmp INT, @User BIGINT, @DocID BIGINT, @Reason NVARCHAR(200) = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    IF ISNULL(@User, 0) <= 0 OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_User WHERE UsrID = @User)
        THROW 52506, N'المستخدم غير موجود.', 1;

    DECLARE @Started BIT = 0;
    IF @@TRANCOUNT = 0 BEGIN BEGIN TRAN; SET @Started = 1; END
    ELSE SAVE TRANSACTION Sp_Wrh_DeleteCostDoc;

    BEGIN TRY
        DECLARE @Type TINYINT, @No NVARCHAR(10);
        SELECT @Type = DocType, @No = DocNo FROM dbo.Wrh_Doc WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
        WHERE DocID = @DocID AND DocCmpID = @Cmp AND DocType IN (14, 15);
        IF @Type IS NULL THROW 52509, N'المستند غير موجود أو لا يتبع الشركة أو ليس تكلفة/تسوية.', 1;

        EXEC dbo.Wrh_CostReverse @DocID;
        DELETE dbo.Wrh_CostLine WHERE CostDocID = @DocID;
        DELETE dbo.Wrh_Doc WHERE DocID = @DocID;

        INSERT dbo.Wrh_DocEvent (EvCmpID, EvDocID, EvDocNo, EvDocType, EvKind, EvUser, EvReason)
        VALUES (@Cmp, @DocID, @No, @Type, 3, @User, NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@Reason)), N''));

        IF @Started = 1 COMMIT;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @Started = 1 BEGIN IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 ROLLBACK; END
        ELSE IF XACT_STATE() = 1 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION Sp_Wrh_DeleteCostDoc;
        THROW;
    END CATCH
END;

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ حذف مسودة جرد */
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Wrh_DeleteCount]
    @Cmp INT, @User BIGINT, @DocID BIGINT, @Reason NVARCHAR(200) = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    IF ISNULL(@User, 0) <= 0 OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_User WHERE UsrID = @User) THROW 52707, N'المستخدم غير موجود.', 1;
    DECLARE @Started BIT = 0;
    IF @@TRANCOUNT = 0 BEGIN BEGIN TRAN; SET @Started = 1; END
    ELSE SAVE TRANSACTION Sp_Wrh_DeleteCount;
    BEGIN TRY
        DECLARE @Type TINYINT, @St TINYINT, @No NVARCHAR(10);
        SELECT @Type = DocType, @St = DocStatus, @No = DocNo FROM dbo.Wrh_Doc WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) WHERE DocID = @DocID AND DocCmpID = @Cmp;
        IF @Type IS NULL OR @Type <> 13 THROW 52706, N'المستند غير موجود أو ليس جردًا.', 1;
        IF @St <> 1 THROW 52703, N'الجرد المعتمد لا يُحذف؛ صحّحه بجرد جديد.', 1;
        DELETE dbo.Wrh_CountLine WHERE CntDocID = @DocID;
        DELETE dbo.Wrh_Doc WHERE DocID = @DocID;
        INSERT dbo.Wrh_DocEvent (EvCmpID, EvDocID, EvDocNo, EvDocType, EvKind, EvUser, EvReason)
        VALUES (@Cmp, @DocID, @No, 13, 3, @User, NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@Reason)), N''));
        IF @Started = 1 COMMIT;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @Started = 1 BEGIN IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 ROLLBACK; END
        ELSE IF XACT_STATE() = 1 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION Sp_Wrh_DeleteCount;
        THROW;
    END CATCH
END;

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Wrh_DeleteDoc]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Wrh_DeleteDoc]
    @Cmp INT, @User BIGINT, @DocID BIGINT, @Reason NVARCHAR(200) = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    IF ISNULL(@User, 0) <= 0 OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_User WHERE UsrID = @User)
        THROW 52302, N'المستخدم غير موجود.', 1;

    DECLARE @Started BIT = 0;
    IF @@TRANCOUNT = 0 BEGIN BEGIN TRAN; SET @Started = 1; END
    ELSE SAVE TRANSACTION Sp_Wrh_DeleteDoc;

    BEGIN TRY
        DECLARE @Type TINYINT, @No NVARCHAR(10), @Ref BIGINT;
        SELECT @Type = DocType, @No = DocNo, @Ref = DocRefDocID
        FROM dbo.Wrh_Doc WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) WHERE DocID = @DocID AND DocCmpID = @Cmp;
        IF @Type IS NULL THROW 52309, N'المستند غير موجود أو لا يتبع الشركة.', 1;
        IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Wrh_DocLine WHERE DocID = @DocID AND (QtyReferred > 0 OR QtyCancelled > 0))
            THROW 52305, N'لا يجوز حذف مستند استُعمل منه شيء في مستند لاحق أو أُلغي منه.', 1;

        EXEC dbo.Wrh_StockReverse @DocID;

        UPDATE r SET QtyReferred = r.QtyReferred - s.q
          FROM dbo.Wrh_DocLine AS r
          JOIN (SELECT RefLineID, SUM(BaseQty) AS q FROM dbo.Wrh_DocLine
                WHERE DocID = @DocID AND RefLineID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY RefLineID) AS s ON s.RefLineID = r.LineID;

        DELETE dbo.Wrh_DocLine WHERE DocID = @DocID;
        DELETE dbo.Wrh_Doc WHERE DocID = @DocID;
        EXEC dbo.Wrh_RecalcDocStatus @Ref;

        INSERT dbo.Wrh_DocEvent (EvCmpID, EvDocID, EvDocNo, EvDocType, EvKind, EvUser, EvReason)
        VALUES (@Cmp, @DocID, @No, @Type, 3, @User, NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@Reason)), N''));

        IF @Started = 1 COMMIT;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @Started = 1 BEGIN IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 ROLLBACK; END
        ELSE IF XACT_STATE() = 1 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION Sp_Wrh_DeleteDoc;
        THROW;
    END CATCH
END;

GO

-- حذف المسودة فقط (مع الإبقاء على Wrh_DeleteDoc للمحرك)
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Wrh_DeleteDraftRequest]
    @Cmp INT, @User BIGINT, @DocID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Wrh_Doc WHERE DocID = @DocID AND DocCmpID = @Cmp AND DocType = 1)
        THROW 52309, N'طلب المواد غير موجود أو لا يتبع الشركة.', 1;
    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Wrh_Doc WHERE DocID = @DocID AND DocFlow = 0)
        THROW 52324, N'يُحذف الطلب وهو مسودة فقط.', 1;
    EXEC dbo.Wrh_DeleteDoc @Cmp, @User, @DocID, N'حذف مسودة';
END;

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Wrh_DeleteItemUnit]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Wrh_DeleteItemUnit]
    @Cmp INT, @User BIGINT, @ItemID BIGINT, @UnitID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    IF ISNULL(@Cmp, 0) <= 0 THROW 52201, N'الشركة غير صحيحة.', 1;
    IF ISNULL(@User, 0) <= 0 OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_User WHERE UsrID = @User) THROW 52200, N'المستخدم غير موجود.', 1;
    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Wrh_Item WHERE ItemID = @ItemID AND ItemCmpID = @Cmp)
        THROW 52206, N'الصنف غير موجود أو لا يتبع الشركة.', 1;
    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Wrh_ItemUnit WHERE ItemID = @ItemID AND UnitID = @UnitID)
        THROW 52210, N'الوحدة الثانوية غير موجودة لهذا الصنف.', 1;
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Wrh_DocLine WHERE ItemID = @ItemID AND UnitID = @UnitID)
        THROW 52212, N'الوحدة مستعملة في بنود مستندات فلا تُحذف.', 1;
    DELETE dbo.Wrh_ItemUnit WHERE ItemID = @ItemID AND UnitID = @UnitID;
END;
