/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Wrh_EnsurePartyAccounts]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ معالجة الأطراف بلا حساب */
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Wrh_EnsurePartyAccounts]
    @Cmp INT, @User BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    IF ISNULL(@Cmp, 0) <= 0 OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_User WHERE UsrID = @User) THROW 52807, N'الشركة أو المستخدم غير صحيح.', 1;
    DECLARE @id BIGINT, @name NVARCHAR(500), @role TINYINT, @op SMALLINT, @acc BIGINT, @n INT = 0;
    DECLARE @Started BIT = 0;
    IF @@TRANCOUNT = 0 BEGIN BEGIN TRAN; SET @Started = 1; END
    ELSE SAVE TRANSACTION Sp_Wrh_EnsurePartyAccounts;
    BEGIN TRY
        DECLARE pc CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR
            SELECT PrtID, PrtName, PrtRole FROM dbo.Prt_Party WHERE PrtCmpID = @Cmp AND PrtAccID IS NULL AND PrtRole IN (1, 2) ORDER BY PrtID;
        OPEN pc; FETCH NEXT FROM pc INTO @id, @name, @role;
        WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        BEGIN
            SET @op = CASE @role WHEN 1 THEN 201 ELSE 408 END;
            EXEC dbo.Wrh_CreateSystemAccount @Cmp, @User, @op, @name, @acc OUTPUT;
            UPDATE dbo.Prt_Party SET PrtAccID = @acc WHERE PrtID = @id;
            SET @n += 1;
            FETCH NEXT FROM pc INTO @id, @name, @role;
        END
        CLOSE pc; DEALLOCATE pc;
        IF @Started = 1 COMMIT;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF CURSOR_STATUS('local', 'pc') >= 0 BEGIN CLOSE pc; DEALLOCATE pc; END
        IF @Started = 1 BEGIN IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 ROLLBACK; END
        ELSE IF XACT_STATE() = 1 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION Sp_Wrh_EnsurePartyAccounts;
        THROW;
    END CATCH
    SELECT @n AS PartiesFixed;
END;

GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Wrh_GenerateAutoVouchers]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ توليد القيود
   @Type NULL = كل الأنواع. @Preview = 1 يعرض ما سيُولَّد ويُعلَّق بلا كتابة. @Quiet = 1 بلا نتائج (للاختبار). */
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Wrh_GenerateAutoVouchers]
    @Cmp INT, @User BIGINT, @Type TINYINT = NULL, @FromDate DATE = NULL, @ToDate DATE = NULL,
    @Preview BIT = 0, @Quiet BIT = 0
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    IF ISNULL(@Cmp, 0) <= 0 OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_User WHERE UsrID = @User) THROW 52807, N'الشركة أو المستخدم غير صحيح.', 1;
    IF @Type IS NOT NULL AND @Type NOT IN (4, 5, 6, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15) THROW 52807, N'نوع مستند لا يُولَّد له قيد.', 1;

    DECLARE @Max INT = ISNULL((SELECT WsMaxAutoVoucherDocs FROM dbo.Wrh_Settings WHERE WsCmpID = @Cmp), 500);
    DECLARE @Post BIT = ISNULL((SELECT WsAutoVoucherState FROM dbo.Wrh_Settings WHERE WsCmpID = @Cmp), 1);

    CREATE TABLE #AD (DocID BIGINT PRIMARY KEY);
    CREATE TABLE #L (DocID BIGINT, Kind TINYINT, AccID BIGINT, CcID BIGINT, Deb DECIMAL(18,3), Crd DECIMAL(18,3), Tag NVARCHAR(60));
    CREATE TABLE #Bad (DocID BIGINT, Reason NVARCHAR(300));

    INSERT #AD (DocID)
    SELECT d.DocID FROM dbo.Wrh_Doc AS d
    WHERE d.DocCmpID = @Cmp AND d.DocStatus = 3 AND d.DocType IN (4, 5, 6, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15)
      AND (@Type IS NULL OR d.DocType = @Type) AND (@FromDate IS NULL OR d.DocDate >= @FromDate) AND (@ToDate IS NULL OR d.DocDate <= @ToDate)
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Acc_AutoVoucherLine AS l WHERE l.SourceDocID = d.DocID AND l.LineSource = 1000 + d.DocType);

    EXEC dbo.Wrh_AutoBuild @Cmp;

    CREATE TABLE #G (DocID BIGINT PRIMARY KEY, Src INT, Unit BIGINT, Dt DATE, Seq INT);
    INSERT #G (DocID, Src, Unit, Dt, Seq)
    SELECT d.DocID, 1000 + d.DocType, CASE WHEN d.DocType IN (4, 5, 8, 9, 10, 13) THEN d.DocWhID END, d.DocDate, 0
    FROM dbo.Wrh_Doc d WHERE d.DocID IN (SELECT DocID FROM #L);

    UPDATE g SET Seq = b.Base + (g2.rn - 1) / @Max + 1
    FROM #G g
    JOIN (SELECT DocID, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY Src, Unit, Dt ORDER BY DocID) AS rn FROM #G) g2 ON g2.DocID = g.DocID
    CROSS APPLY (SELECT ISNULL(MAX(v.AvSeq), 0) AS Base FROM dbo.Acc_AutoVoucher v
                 WHERE v.AvCompany = @Cmp AND v.AvSource = g.Src AND ISNULL(v.AvSourceUnit, 0) = ISNULL(g.Unit, 0) AND v.AvDate = g.Dt) b;

    CREATE TABLE #Made (AvID BIGINT, DayMID BIGINT, VoucherNo NVARCHAR(20), Src INT, Unit BIGINT, Dt DATE, Seq INT, Docs INT, Total DECIMAL(18,3));

    IF @Preview = 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #G)
    BEGIN
        DECLARE @Started BIT = 0;
        IF @@TRANCOUNT = 0 BEGIN BEGIN TRAN; SET @Started = 1; END
        ELSE SAVE TRANSACTION Sp_Wrh_GenerateAutoVouchers;

        BEGIN TRY
            EXEC sp_set_session_context N'Acc.SystemOperation', 1;
            EXEC sp_set_session_context N'Wrh.AutoGen', 1;

            DECLARE @Src INT, @Unit BIGINT, @Dt DATE, @Seq INT, @n INT, @dm BIGINT, @av BIGINT, @info NVARCHAR(400), @sname NVARCHAR(100), @tot DECIMAL(18,3), @vno NVARCHAR(20), @Yr INT;
            DECLARE vc CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FORWARD_ONLY READ_ONLY FOR
                SELECT Src, Unit, Dt, Seq, COUNT(*) FROM #G GROUP BY Src, Unit, Dt, Seq ORDER BY Src, Unit, Dt, Seq;
            OPEN vc; FETCH NEXT FROM vc INTO @Src, @Unit, @Dt, @Seq, @n;
            WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
            BEGIN
                SELECT @sname = SourceName FROM dbo.Acc_AutoSource WHERE SourceID = @Src;
                CREATE TABLE #VL (SeqNo INT IDENTITY(1,1), DocID BIGINT NULL, AccID BIGINT, CcID BIGINT, Deb DECIMAL(18,3), Crd DECIMAL(18,3), Num NVARCHAR(50), Txt NVARCHAR(200));
                INSERT #VL (DocID, AccID, CcID, Deb, Crd, Num, Txt)
                SELECT l.DocID, l.AccID, l.CcID, l.Deb, l.Crd, d.DocNo, CONCAT(@sname, N' رقم ', d.DocNo)
                FROM #L l JOIN #G g ON g.DocID = l.DocID JOIN dbo.Wrh_Doc d ON d.DocID = l.DocID
                WHERE l.Kind = 2 AND g.Src = @Src AND ISNULL(g.Unit, 0) = ISNULL(@Unit, 0) AND g.Dt = @Dt AND g.Seq = @Seq
                ORDER BY l.DocID, l.Deb DESC;
                INSERT #VL (DocID, AccID, CcID, Deb, Crd, Num, Txt)
                SELECT NULL, x.AccID, x.CcID, CASE WHEN x.Net > 0 THEN x.Net ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN x.Net < 0 THEN -x.Net ELSE 0 END, NULL, CONCAT(N'إجمالي ', @sname)
                FROM (SELECT l.AccID, l.CcID, SUM(l.Deb) - SUM(l.Crd) AS Net FROM #L l JOIN #G g ON g.DocID = l.DocID
                      WHERE l.Kind = 1 AND g.Src = @Src AND ISNULL(g.Unit, 0) = ISNULL(@Unit, 0) AND g.Dt = @Dt AND g.Seq = @Seq
                      GROUP BY l.AccID, l.CcID HAVING SUM(l.Deb) <> SUM(l.Crd)) x;

                DECLARE @Lines dbo.Acc_DayLineType;
                DELETE @Lines;
                INSERT @Lines (SeqNo, DayDAccID, DayDDeb, DayDCrd, DayDCsCID, DayDNum, DayDDescription)
                SELECT SeqNo, AccID, Deb, Crd, CcID, Num, Txt FROM #VL;
                SELECT @tot = SUM(Deb) FROM #VL;
                SET @info = CONCAT(N'قيد آلي - ', @sname, N' - ', CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @Dt, 23), N' (', @n, N' مستند)');

                CREATE TABLE #SR (DayMID BIGINT, DayMNo INT, DayMState TINYINT, VoucherNo NVARCHAR(20));
                SET @Yr = YEAR(@Dt);
                INSERT #SR EXEC dbo.Acc_SaveDayVoucher @Cmp, @Yr, @User, 0, @Dt, @info, @Post, @Lines;
                SELECT @dm = DayMID, @vno = VoucherNo FROM #SR; DROP TABLE #SR;

                INSERT dbo.Acc_AutoVoucher (AvCompany, AvDayMID, AvSource, AvSourceUnit, AvDate, AvSeq, AvCreatedBy)
                VALUES (@Cmp, @dm, @Src, @Unit, @Dt, @Seq, @User);
                SET @av = SCOPE_IDENTITY();

                INSERT dbo.Acc_AutoVoucherLine (AvID, SourceDocID, LineSource, DayDID)
                SELECT @av, g.DocID, @Src,
                       (SELECT MIN(m.DayDID) FROM (SELECT DayDID, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY DayDID) AS rn FROM dbo.Acc_DayDetails WHERE DayDMID = @dm) m
                        JOIN #VL v ON v.SeqNo = m.rn WHERE v.DocID = g.DocID)
                FROM #G g WHERE g.Src = @Src AND ISNULL(g.Unit, 0) = ISNULL(@Unit, 0) AND g.Dt = @Dt AND g.Seq = @Seq;

                INSERT #Made VALUES (@av, @dm, @vno, @Src, @Unit, @Dt, @Seq, @n, @tot);
                DROP TABLE #VL;
                FETCH NEXT FROM vc INTO @Src, @Unit, @Dt, @Seq, @n;
            END
            CLOSE vc; DEALLOCATE vc;

            EXEC sp_set_session_context N'Wrh.AutoGen', 0;
            EXEC sp_set_session_context N'Acc.SystemOperation', 0;
            IF @Started = 1 COMMIT;
        END TRY
        BEGIN CATCH
            EXEC sp_set_session_context N'Wrh.AutoGen', 0;
            EXEC sp_set_session_context N'Acc.SystemOperation', 0;
            IF @Started = 1 BEGIN IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 ROLLBACK; END
            ELSE IF XACT_STATE() = 1 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION Sp_Wrh_GenerateAutoVouchers;
            THROW;
        END CATCH
    END

    IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#PendingOut') IS NOT NULL
        INSERT #PendingOut (DocID, DocType, Reason)
        SELECT b.DocID, d.DocType, b.Reason FROM #Bad b JOIN dbo.Wrh_Doc d ON d.DocID = b.DocID;

    IF @Quiet = 0
    BEGIN
        IF @Preview = 1
            SELECT g.Src AS SourceID, s.SourceName, COUNT(*) AS ReadyDocs
            FROM #G g JOIN dbo.Acc_AutoSource s ON s.SourceID = g.Src GROUP BY g.Src, s.SourceName ORDER BY g.Src;
        ELSE
            SELECT m.AvID, m.DayMID, m.VoucherNo, s.SourceName, m.Unit AS WarehouseID, m.Dt AS VoucherDate, m.Seq, m.Docs, m.Total
            FROM #Made m JOIN dbo.Acc_AutoSource s ON s.SourceID = m.Src ORDER BY m.Src, m.Dt, m.Seq;
        SELECT b.DocID, d.DocType, t.DtName AS DocTypeName, d.DocNo, d.DocDate, b.Reason
        FROM #Bad b JOIN dbo.Wrh_Doc d ON d.DocID = b.DocID JOIN dbo.Wrh_DocTypeDef t ON t.DtType = d.DocType ORDER BY d.DocType, d.DocDate, d.DocNo;
    END
END;

GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Wrh_NextDocNo]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Wrh_NextDocNo]
    @Cmp     INT,
    @Year    INT,
    @DocType TINYINT,
    @DocNo   NVARCHAR(10) OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    IF ISNULL(@Cmp, 0) <= 0 OR @Year NOT BETWEEN 2000 AND 2099 OR ISNULL(@DocType, 0) = 0
        THROW 52101, N'معاملات ترقيم المستند غير صحيحة.', 1;

    DECLARE @n INT;

    UPDATE dbo.Wrh_DocSeq WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
       SET @n = DsLastNo = DsLastNo + 1
     WHERE DsCmpID = @Cmp AND DsYear = @Year AND DsDocType = @DocType
       AND DsLastNo < 99999999;

    IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0
    BEGIN
        IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Wrh_DocSeq WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
                   WHERE DsCmpID = @Cmp AND DsYear = @Year AND DsDocType = @DocType)
            THROW 52102, N'تجاوز تسلسل ترقيم هذا النوع في هذه السنة (99999999).', 1;

        INSERT dbo.Wrh_DocSeq (DsCmpID, DsYear, DsDocType, DsLastNo) VALUES (@Cmp, @Year, @DocType, 1);
        SET @n = 1;
    END

    SET @DocNo = RIGHT(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(4), @Year), 2) + RIGHT(N'00000000' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(8), @n), 8);
END;

GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Wrh_Rebalance]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Wrh_Rebalance]
    @Wh BIGINT, @Item BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    CREATE TABLE #B (Seq INT IDENTITY(1,1), LayerID BIGINT, Q DECIMAL(18,3), V DECIMAL(18,3));
    INSERT #B (LayerID, Q, V)
    SELECT LayerID, LyQtyRem, LyValueRem FROM dbo.Wrh_Layer WITH (UPDLOCK)
    WHERE LyWhID = @Wh AND LyItemID = @Item AND LyQtyRem > 0 ORDER BY LyDate, LayerID;

    DECLARE @n INT = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #B), @tq DECIMAL(18,3), @tv DECIMAL(18,3), @i INT = 1, @given DECIMAL(18,3) = 0,
            @lid BIGINT, @q DECIMAL(18,3), @nv DECIMAL(18,3);
    IF @n >= 2
    BEGIN
        SELECT @tq = SUM(Q), @tv = SUM(V) FROM #B;
        WHILE @i <= @n
        BEGIN
            SELECT @lid = LayerID, @q = Q FROM #B WHERE Seq = @i;
            SET @nv = CASE WHEN @i = @n THEN @tv - @given ELSE ROUND(@tv * CAST(@q AS DECIMAL(18,6)) / @tq, 3) END;
            UPDATE dbo.Wrh_Layer SET LyValueRem = @nv, LyUnitCost = ROUND(@nv / @q, 6) WHERE LayerID = @lid;
            SET @given = @given + @nv;
            SET @i = @i + 1;
        END
    END
    DROP TABLE #B;
END;

GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Wrh_RecalcDocStatus]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ حساب حالة التجاري من بنوده */
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Wrh_RecalcDocStatus]
    @DocID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    IF @DocID IS NULL RETURN;
    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Wrh_Doc AS d JOIN dbo.Wrh_DocTypeDef AS t ON t.DtType = d.DocType
                   WHERE d.DocID = @DocID AND t.DtClass = 1)
        RETURN;

    UPDATE d
       SET DocStatus = x.St
      FROM dbo.Wrh_Doc AS d
      CROSS APPLY (SELECT CASE
                            WHEN MIN(CASE WHEN l.QtyCancelled >= l.BaseQty THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN 9
                            WHEN MIN(CASE WHEN l.QtyReferred + l.QtyCancelled >= l.BaseQty THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN 3
                            WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN l.QtyReferred + l.QtyCancelled > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN 2
                            ELSE 1 END AS St
                   FROM dbo.Wrh_DocLine AS l WHERE l.DocID = d.DocID) AS x
     WHERE d.DocID = @DocID;
END;

GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Wrh_RequestAction]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Wrh_RequestAction]
    @Cmp INT, @User BIGINT, @DocID BIGINT, @Action TINYINT, @Reason NVARCHAR(200) = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    IF ISNULL(@User, 0) <= 0 OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_User WHERE UsrID = @User)
        THROW 52302, N'المستخدم غير موجود.', 1;
    SET @Reason = NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@Reason)), N'');

    DECLARE @Started BIT = 0;
    IF @@TRANCOUNT = 0 BEGIN BEGIN TRAN; SET @Started = 1; END
    ELSE SAVE TRANSACTION Sp_Wrh_RequestAction;
    BEGIN TRY
        DECLARE @Flow TINYINT, @No NVARCHAR(10), @Status TINYINT, @DYear SMALLINT, @To TINYINT, @NeedReason BIT, @NeedRem BIT, @Ok BIT = 0;
        SELECT @Flow = DocFlow, @No = DocNo, @Status = DocStatus, @DYear = DocYear
        FROM dbo.Wrh_Doc WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) WHERE DocID = @DocID AND DocCmpID = @Cmp AND DocType = 1;
        IF @No IS NULL THROW 52309, N'طلب المواد غير موجود أو لا يتبع الشركة.', 1;

        SELECT @Ok = 1, @To = t.ToFlow, @NeedReason = t.NeedReason, @NeedRem = t.NeedRem
        FROM (VALUES (1,0,1,0,0), (2,1,2,0,1), (3,1,3,1,1), (3,2,3,1,1), (4,2,4,1,1),
                     (5,4,1,0,0), (6,4,2,1,0), (7,3,1,0,1), (8,3,3,1,1)) AS t(Act, FromFlow, ToFlow, NeedReason, NeedRem)
        WHERE t.Act = @Action AND t.FromFlow = ISNULL(@Flow, 255);
        IF @Ok = 0 THROW 52324, N'هذا الإجراء غير مسموح في المرحلة الحالية للطلب.', 1;
        IF @NeedReason = 1 AND @Reason IS NULL THROW 52326, N'السبب مطلوب.', 1;
        IF @Status IN (3, 9) THROW 52325, N'الطلب منتهٍ (منفذ كليًا أو ملغى).', 1;
        IF @NeedRem = 1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Wrh_DocLine WHERE DocID = @DocID AND BaseQty - QtyReferred - QtyCancelled > 0)
            THROW 52325, N'لا يوجد متبقٍ في الطلب.', 1;

        IF @Action = 8
            EXEC dbo.Wrh_CancelDoc @Cmp, @User, @DocID, NULL, @Reason;   -- يسجّل حدث الإلغاء بنفسه
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            IF @Action = 1 AND @No LIKE N'T%'
            BEGIN   -- الإرسال الأول: الرقم الرسمي المتسلسل (يُحدَّث في سجل الأحداث أيضًا)
                EXEC dbo.Wrh_NextDocNo @Cmp, @DYear, 1, @No OUTPUT;
                UPDATE dbo.Wrh_Doc SET DocNo = @No WHERE DocID = @DocID;
                UPDATE dbo.Wrh_DocEvent SET EvDocNo = @No WHERE EvDocID = @DocID;
            END
            UPDATE dbo.Wrh_Doc SET DocFlow = @To WHERE DocID = @DocID;
            INSERT dbo.Wrh_DocEvent (EvCmpID, EvDocID, EvDocNo, EvDocType, EvKind, EvUser, EvReason)
            VALUES (@Cmp, @DocID, @No, 1, 10 + @Action, @User, @Reason);
        END

        IF @Started = 1 COMMIT;
        SELECT d.DocID, d.DocNo, d.DocStatus, d.DocFlow FROM dbo.Wrh_Doc AS d WHERE d.DocID = @DocID;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @Started = 1 BEGIN IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 ROLLBACK; END
        ELSE IF XACT_STATE() = 1 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION Sp_Wrh_RequestAction;
        THROW;
    END CATCH
END;

GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Wrh_SaveCostDoc]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ حفظ مستند تكلفة إضافية/تسوية
   @Items نوع 14: [{"PartyID":1,"Kind":1,"Amount":200}, ...]      نوع 15: [{"RefLineID":5,"Delta":-50}, ...]
   @OnlyLines (نوع 14 فقط، اختياري): [5,6]  أرقام بنود المستند المرجعي المقصودة. */
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Wrh_SaveCostDoc]
    @Cmp INT, @User BIGINT, @DocID BIGINT, @Type TINYINT, @Date DATE, @RefDocID BIGINT,
    @PartyID BIGINT = NULL, @Notes NVARCHAR(500) = NULL, @Items NVARCHAR(MAX), @OnlyLines NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    IF ISNULL(@Cmp, 0) <= 0 OR @Date IS NULL THROW 52506, N'الشركة والتاريخ مطلوبان.', 1;
    IF ISNULL(@User, 0) <= 0 OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_User WHERE UsrID = @User)
        THROW 52506, N'المستخدم غير موجود.', 1;
    IF @Type IS NULL OR @Type NOT IN (14, 15) THROW 52501, N'هذا الإجراء لمستندات التكلفة الإضافية (14) والتسوية (15) فقط.', 1;

    DECLARE @RefType TINYINT, @RefWh BIGINT;
    SELECT @RefType = DocType, @RefWh = DocWhID FROM dbo.Wrh_Doc WHERE DocID = @RefDocID AND DocCmpID = @Cmp;
    IF @RefType IS NULL OR (@Type = 15 AND @RefType <> 4) OR (@Type = 14 AND @RefType NOT IN (4, 8))
        THROW 52501, N'المستند المرجعي غير مناسب (التكلفة: استلام مخزني أو استلام تحويل، والتسوية: استلام مخزني).', 1;

    SET @Notes = NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@Notes)), N'');
    IF @Type = 15
    BEGIN
        IF @Notes IS NULL THROW 52502, N'سبب التسوية مطلوب.', 1;
        IF @PartyID IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Prt_Party WHERE PrtID = @PartyID AND PrtCmpID = @Cmp AND PrtActive = 1)
            THROW 52502, N'الجهة الدائنة (المورد) مطلوبة وصالحة.', 1;
    END
    ELSE SET @PartyID = NULL;

    IF @Items IS NULL OR ISJSON(@Items) <> 1 THROW 52506, N'بنود التكلفة غير صحيحة.', 1;

    CREATE TABLE #C (Ord INT, PartyID BIGINT, Kind TINYINT, Amount DECIMAL(18,3));
    CREATE TABLE #S (Ord INT, RefLineID BIGINT, Delta DECIMAL(18,3));
    CREATE TABLE #T (LineID BIGINT, Ord INT, Weight DECIMAL(18,3), Delta DECIMAL(18,3));

    IF @Type = 14
    BEGIN
        INSERT #C (Ord, PartyID, Kind, Amount)
        SELECT CAST(x.[key] AS INT), j.PartyID, j.Kind, j.Amount
        FROM OPENJSON(@Items) AS x
        CROSS APPLY OPENJSON(x.[value]) WITH (PartyID BIGINT '$.PartyID', Kind TINYINT '$.Kind', Amount DECIMAL(18,3) '$.Amount') AS j;
        IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #C) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #C WHERE PartyID IS NULL OR Kind IS NULL OR Kind NOT IN (1,2,3,4,5,6,9) OR Amount IS NULL OR Amount <= 0)
            THROW 52506, N'كل بند تكلفة يحتاج جهة ونوعًا (1 شحن، 2 جمارك، 3 تحميل، 4 تفريغ، 5 تعبئة، 6 نقل، 9 أخرى) ومبلغًا أكبر من صفر.', 1;
        IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #C AS c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Prt_Party WHERE PrtID = c.PartyID AND PrtCmpID = @Cmp AND PrtActive = 1))
            THROW 52506, N'جهة تكلفة غير موجودة أو معطّلة أو لا تتبع الشركة.', 1;
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        INSERT #S (Ord, RefLineID, Delta)
        SELECT CAST(x.[key] AS INT), j.RefLineID, j.Delta
        FROM OPENJSON(@Items) AS x
        CROSS APPLY OPENJSON(x.[value]) WITH (RefLineID BIGINT '$.RefLineID', Delta DECIMAL(18,3) '$.Delta') AS j;
        IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #S) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #S WHERE RefLineID IS NULL OR Delta IS NULL OR Delta = 0)
            THROW 52506, N'كل بند تسوية يحتاج بندًا مرجعيًا ومبلغًا غير صفري.', 1;
        IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #S GROUP BY RefLineID HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)
            THROW 52506, N'بند مرجعي مكرر في التسوية.', 1;
        IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #S AS s WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Wrh_DocLine WHERE LineID = s.RefLineID AND DocID = @RefDocID))
            THROW 52506, N'بند مرجعي لا يتبع المستند المرجعي.', 1;
    END

    DECLARE @Basis TINYINT = ISNULL((SELECT WsAllocBasis FROM dbo.Wrh_Settings WHERE WsCmpID = @Cmp), 1);
    IF @Type = 14
    BEGIN
        IF @Basis = 3 THROW 52504, N'أساس التوزيع بالوزن غير متاح بعد (لا وزن للأصناف).', 1;
        IF @OnlyLines IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            IF ISJSON(@OnlyLines) <> 1 THROW 52506, N'قائمة البنود المحددة غير صحيحة.', 1;
            INSERT #T (LineID, Ord, Weight)
            SELECT l.LineID, l.DocLineNo, CASE WHEN @Basis = 1 THEN l.Amount ELSE l.BaseQty END
            FROM dbo.Wrh_DocLine AS l
            WHERE l.DocID = @RefDocID AND l.LineID IN (SELECT CAST(o.[value] AS BIGINT) FROM OPENJSON(@OnlyLines) AS o);
            IF (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #T) <> (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM OPENJSON(@OnlyLines))
                THROW 52506, N'بند محدد لا يتبع المستند المرجعي.', 1;
        END
        ELSE
            INSERT #T (LineID, Ord, Weight)
            SELECT l.LineID, l.DocLineNo, CASE WHEN @Basis = 1 THEN l.Amount ELSE l.BaseQty END
            FROM dbo.Wrh_DocLine AS l WHERE l.DocID = @RefDocID;

        IF @RefType = 8   -- أساس القيمة لاستلام التحويل = قيمة الطبقات الناتجة
            IF @Basis = 1
                UPDATE t SET Weight = ISNULL((SELECT SUM(LyValueIn) FROM dbo.Wrh_Layer WHERE LySrcLineID = t.LineID), 0) FROM #T AS t;

        DECLARE @Total DECIMAL(18,3) = (SELECT SUM(Amount) FROM #C), @WSum DECIMAL(18,3) = (SELECT SUM(Weight) FROM #T);
        IF ISNULL(@WSum, 0) <= 0 THROW 52505, N'مجموع أساس التوزيع صفر؛ جرّب التوزيع بالكمية أو حدّد بنودًا.', 1;

        UPDATE t SET Delta = ROUND(@Total * t.Weight / @WSum, 3) FROM #T AS t;
        DECLARE @LastLine BIGINT = (SELECT TOP 1 LineID FROM #T ORDER BY Ord DESC, LineID DESC);
        UPDATE #T SET Delta = @Total - ISNULL((SELECT SUM(Delta) FROM #T WHERE LineID <> @LastLine), 0) WHERE LineID = @LastLine;
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        INSERT #T (LineID, Ord, Weight, Delta)
        SELECT s.RefLineID, s.Ord, 0, s.Delta FROM #S AS s;
    END

    DECLARE @Started BIT = 0;
    IF @@TRANCOUNT = 0 BEGIN BEGIN TRAN; SET @Started = 1; END
    ELSE SAVE TRANSACTION Sp_Wrh_SaveCostDoc;

    BEGIN TRY
        DECLARE @Year INT = YEAR(@Date), @DocNo NVARCHAR(10), @Kind TINYINT = 1;

        IF ISNULL(@DocID, 0) > 0
        BEGIN
            DECLARE @OType TINYINT, @OYear SMALLINT;
            SELECT @OType = DocType, @OYear = DocYear, @DocNo = DocNo
            FROM dbo.Wrh_Doc WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) WHERE DocID = @DocID AND DocCmpID = @Cmp;
            IF @OType IS NULL THROW 52509, N'المستند غير موجود أو لا يتبع الشركة.', 1;
            IF @OType <> @Type THROW 52501, N'لا يُغيَّر نوع المستند.', 1;
            IF @OYear <> @Year THROW 52506, N'لا يجوز تغيير تاريخ المستند إلى سنة أخرى.', 1;
            EXEC dbo.Wrh_CostReverse @DocID;
            DELETE dbo.Wrh_CostLine WHERE CostDocID = @DocID;
            UPDATE dbo.Wrh_Doc SET DocDate = @Date, DocPartyID = @PartyID, DocRefDocID = @RefDocID, DocNotes = @Notes WHERE DocID = @DocID;
            SET @Kind = 2;
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            EXEC dbo.Wrh_NextDocNo @Cmp, @Year, @Type, @DocNo OUTPUT;
            INSERT dbo.Wrh_Doc (DocCmpID, DocType, DocYear, DocNo, DocDate, DocStatus, DocPartyID, DocRefDocID, DocNotes, DocCreatedBy)
            VALUES (@Cmp, @Type, @Year, @DocNo, @Date, 3, @PartyID, @RefDocID, @Notes, @User);
            SET @DocID = SCOPE_IDENTITY();
        END

        IF @Type = 14
            INSERT dbo.Wrh_CostLine (CostDocID, CostPartyID, CostKind, CostAmount)
            SELECT @DocID, PartyID, Kind, Amount FROM #C ORDER BY Ord;

        -- التطبيق على كل بند مرجعي
        DECLARE @Line BIGINT, @Delta DECIMAL(18,3), @Base DECIMAL(18,3), @Rem DECIMAL(18,3), @Root BIGINT,
                @RemPart DECIMAL(18,3), @AdjID BIGINT, @n INT, @i INT, @lyid BIGINT, @lyrem DECIMAL(18,3),
                @remSum DECIMAL(18,3), @share DECIMAL(18,3), @given DECIMAL(18,3);

        DECLARE cur CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FORWARD_ONLY READ_ONLY FOR SELECT LineID, Delta FROM #T ORDER BY Ord, LineID;
        OPEN cur; FETCH NEXT FROM cur INTO @Line, @Delta;
        WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        BEGIN
            CREATE TABLE #LY (Seq INT IDENTITY(1,1), LayerID BIGINT, Rem DECIMAL(18,3));

            IF @RefType = 4
            BEGIN
                SET @Root = NULL;
                SELECT @Root = LayerID, @Base = LyQtyIn FROM dbo.Wrh_Layer WHERE LySrcLineID = @Line AND LyWhID = @RefWh;
                IF @Root IS NULL THROW 52501, N'بند الاستلام بلا طبقة (غير صالح للتكلفة).', 1;
                INSERT #LY (LayerID, Rem) SELECT LayerID, LyQtyRem FROM dbo.Wrh_Layer WITH (UPDLOCK)
                    WHERE LyRootID = @Root AND LyQtyRem > 0 ORDER BY LayerID;
            END
            ELSE
            BEGIN
                SELECT @Base = SUM(LyQtyIn) FROM dbo.Wrh_Layer WHERE LySrcLineID = @Line;
                IF ISNULL(@Base, 0) <= 0 THROW 52501, N'بند الاستلام بلا طبقات (غير صالح للتكلفة).', 1;
                INSERT #LY (LayerID, Rem) SELECT LayerID, LyQtyRem FROM dbo.Wrh_Layer WITH (UPDLOCK)
                    WHERE LySrcLineID = @Line AND LyQtyRem > 0 ORDER BY LayerID;
            END

            SELECT @Rem = ISNULL(SUM(Rem), 0), @n = COUNT(*) FROM #LY;
            SET @RemPart = CASE WHEN @Rem = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(@Delta * CAST(@Rem AS DECIMAL(18,6)) / @Base, 3) END;

            INSERT dbo.Wrh_CostAdj (AdjDocID, AdjRefLineID, AdjAmount, AdjRemPart, AdjConsPart, AdjBaseQty, AdjRemQty)
            VALUES (@DocID, @Line, @Delta, @RemPart, @Delta - @RemPart, @Base, @Rem);
            SET @AdjID = SCOPE_IDENTITY();

            SET @i = 1; SET @given = 0; SET @remSum = @Rem;
            WHILE @i <= @n AND @RemPart <> 0
            BEGIN
                SELECT @lyid = LayerID, @lyrem = Rem FROM #LY WHERE Seq = @i;
                SET @share = CASE WHEN @i = @n THEN @RemPart - @given ELSE ROUND(@RemPart * CAST(@lyrem AS DECIMAL(18,6)) / @remSum, 3) END;
                IF @share <> 0
                BEGIN
                    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Wrh_Layer WHERE LayerID = @lyid AND LyValueRem + @share < 0)
                        THROW 52503, N'التخفيض يتجاوز قيمة المتبقي في الطبقات.', 1;
                    UPDATE dbo.Wrh_Layer
                       SET LyValueIn = LyValueIn + @share, LyValueRem = LyValueRem + @share,
                           LyUnitCost = ROUND((LyValueRem + @share) / LyQtyRem, 6)
                     WHERE LayerID = @lyid;
                    INSERT dbo.Wrh_CostAdjLayer (AdjID, LayerID, AddValue, RemAtAdj) VALUES (@AdjID, @lyid, @share, @lyrem);
                    SET @given = @given + @share;
                END
                SET @i = @i + 1;
            END

            DROP TABLE #LY;
            FETCH NEXT FROM cur INTO @Line, @Delta;
        END
        CLOSE cur; DEALLOCATE cur;

        INSERT dbo.Wrh_DocEvent (EvCmpID, EvDocID, EvDocNo, EvDocType, EvKind, EvUser, EvReason)
        VALUES (@Cmp, @DocID, @DocNo, @Type, @Kind, @User, @Notes);

        IF @Started = 1 COMMIT;
        SELECT @DocID AS DocID, @DocNo AS DocNo;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @Started = 1 BEGIN IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 ROLLBACK; END
        ELSE IF XACT_STATE() = 1 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION Sp_Wrh_SaveCostDoc;
        THROW;
    END CATCH
END;

GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Wrh_SaveCount]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ حفظ مسودة جرد
   @Lines: [{"ItemID":1,"UnitID":1,"Qty":95,"Price":null}, ...]   Qty = 0 للمعدوم فعليًا */
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Wrh_SaveCount]
    @Cmp INT, @User BIGINT, @DocID BIGINT, @Date DATE, @WhID BIGINT, @Notes NVARCHAR(500) = NULL, @Lines NVARCHAR(MAX)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    IF ISNULL(@Cmp, 0) <= 0 OR @Date IS NULL THROW 52707, N'الشركة والتاريخ مطلوبان.', 1;
    IF ISNULL(@User, 0) <= 0 OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_User WHERE UsrID = @User) THROW 52707, N'المستخدم غير موجود.', 1;
    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Wrh_Warehouse WHERE WhID = @WhID AND WhCmpID = @Cmp AND WhActive = 1)
        THROW 52707, N'المخزن غير موجود أو معطّل أو لا يتبع الشركة.', 1;
    IF @Lines IS NULL OR ISJSON(@Lines) <> 1 THROW 52704, N'بنود الجرد غير صحيحة.', 1;

    CREATE TABLE #L (Ord INT, ItemID BIGINT, UnitID BIGINT, Qty DECIMAL(18,3), Price DECIMAL(18,6), Factor DECIMAL(18,6), Base DECIMAL(18,3));
    INSERT #L (Ord, ItemID, UnitID, Qty, Price)
    SELECT CAST(x.[key] AS INT), j.ItemID, j.UnitID, j.Qty, j.Price
    FROM OPENJSON(@Lines) AS x
    CROSS APPLY OPENJSON(x.[value]) WITH (ItemID BIGINT '$.ItemID', UnitID BIGINT '$.UnitID', Qty DECIMAL(18,3) '$.Qty', Price DECIMAL(18,6) '$.Price') AS j;

    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #L) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #L WHERE ItemID IS NULL OR UnitID IS NULL OR Qty IS NULL OR Qty < 0 OR (Price IS NOT NULL AND Price < 0))
        THROW 52704, N'كل بند جرد يحتاج صنفًا ووحدة وكمية (صفر فأكثر).', 1;
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #L GROUP BY ItemID HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) THROW 52704, N'صنف مكرر في الجرد.', 1;
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #L AS l WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Wrh_Item WHERE ItemID = l.ItemID AND ItemCmpID = @Cmp))
        THROW 52704, N'صنف غير موجود أو لا يتبع الشركة.', 1;

    UPDATE l SET Factor = CASE WHEN l.UnitID = i.ItemBaseUnitID THEN CAST(1 AS DECIMAL(18,6)) ELSE iu.Factor END
      FROM #L AS l JOIN dbo.Wrh_Item AS i ON i.ItemID = l.ItemID
      LEFT JOIN dbo.Wrh_ItemUnit AS iu ON iu.ItemID = l.ItemID AND iu.UnitID = l.UnitID;
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #L WHERE Factor IS NULL) THROW 52704, N'وحدة غير معرّفة لأحد الأصناف.', 1;
    UPDATE #L SET Base = ROUND(Qty * Factor, 3);

    DECLARE @Started BIT = 0;
    IF @@TRANCOUNT = 0 BEGIN BEGIN TRAN; SET @Started = 1; END
    ELSE SAVE TRANSACTION Sp_Wrh_SaveCount;

    BEGIN TRY
        DECLARE @Year INT = YEAR(@Date), @DocNo NVARCHAR(10), @Kind TINYINT = 1;
        SET @Notes = NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@Notes)), N'');

        IF ISNULL(@DocID, 0) > 0
        BEGIN
            DECLARE @OType TINYINT, @OSt TINYINT, @OYear SMALLINT;
            SELECT @OType = DocType, @OSt = DocStatus, @OYear = DocYear, @DocNo = DocNo
            FROM dbo.Wrh_Doc WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) WHERE DocID = @DocID AND DocCmpID = @Cmp;
            IF @OType IS NULL OR @OType <> 13 THROW 52706, N'المستند غير موجود أو ليس جردًا.', 1;
            IF @OSt <> 1 THROW 52703, N'الجرد المعتمد لا يُعدَّل.', 1;
            IF @OYear <> @Year THROW 52707, N'لا يجوز تغيير تاريخ الجرد إلى سنة أخرى.', 1;
            DELETE dbo.Wrh_CountLine WHERE CntDocID = @DocID;
            UPDATE dbo.Wrh_Doc SET DocDate = @Date, DocWhID = @WhID, DocNotes = @Notes WHERE DocID = @DocID;
            SET @Kind = 2;
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            EXEC dbo.Wrh_NextDocNo @Cmp, @Year, 13, @DocNo OUTPUT;
            INSERT dbo.Wrh_Doc (DocCmpID, DocType, DocYear, DocNo, DocDate, DocStatus, DocWhID, DocNotes, DocCreatedBy)
            VALUES (@Cmp, 13, @Year, @DocNo, @Date, 1, @WhID, @Notes, @User);
            SET @DocID = SCOPE_IDENTITY();
        END

        INSERT dbo.Wrh_CountLine (CntDocID, ItemID, UnitID, Factor, Qty, CountedQty, Price)
        SELECT @DocID, ItemID, UnitID, Factor, Qty, Base, Price FROM #L ORDER BY Ord;

        INSERT dbo.Wrh_DocEvent (EvCmpID, EvDocID, EvDocNo, EvDocType, EvKind, EvUser)
        VALUES (@Cmp, @DocID, @DocNo, 13, @Kind, @User);

        IF @Started = 1 COMMIT;
        SELECT @DocID AS DocID, @DocNo AS DocNo;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @Started = 1 BEGIN IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 ROLLBACK; END
        ELSE IF XACT_STATE() = 1 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION Sp_Wrh_SaveCount;
        THROW;
    END CATCH
END;

GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Wrh_SaveDoc]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Wrh_SaveDoc]
    @Cmp INT, @User BIGINT, @DocID BIGINT, @Type TINYINT, @Date DATE,
    @WhID BIGINT = NULL, @Wh2ID BIGINT = NULL, @PartyID BIGINT = NULL, @CostCID BIGINT = NULL,
    @RefDocID BIGINT = NULL, @Notes NVARCHAR(500) = NULL, @Lines NVARCHAR(MAX)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    IF ISNULL(@Cmp, 0) <= 0 OR @Date IS NULL THROW 52302, N'الشركة والتاريخ مطلوبان.', 1;
    IF ISNULL(@User, 0) <= 0 OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_User WHERE UsrID = @User)
        THROW 52302, N'المستخدم غير موجود.', 1;

    DECLARE @Class TINYINT, @NW BIT, @NW2 BIT, @NP BIT, @NC BIT, @NR BIT, @RT TINYINT;
    SELECT @Class = DtClass, @NW = DtNeedWh, @NW2 = DtNeedWh2, @NP = DtNeedParty, @NC = DtNeedCost,
           @NR = DtNeedRef, @RT = DtRefType
    FROM dbo.Wrh_DocTypeDef WHERE DtType = @Type AND DtEngine = 1;
    IF @Class IS NULL THROW 52301, N'نوع المستند غير صحيح أو غير مدعوم في هذا المحرك.', 1;

    -- متطلبات الرأس
    IF @NW = 1 AND @WhID IS NULL THROW 52302, N'المخزن مطلوب لهذا النوع.', 1;
    IF @NW2 = 1 AND @Wh2ID IS NULL THROW 52302, N'المخزن المقابل مطلوب لهذا النوع.', 1;
    IF @NP = 1 AND @PartyID IS NULL THROW 52302, N'الجهة (المورد/العهدة) مطلوبة لهذا النوع.', 1;
    IF @NC = 1 AND @CostCID IS NULL THROW 52302, N'الجهة الطالبة (مركز التكلفة) مطلوبة لهذا النوع.', 1;
    IF @NR = 1 AND @RefDocID IS NULL THROW 52302, N'المستند المرجعي مطلوب لهذا النوع.', 1;

    IF @WhID IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Wrh_Warehouse WHERE WhID = @WhID AND WhCmpID = @Cmp AND WhActive = 1)
        THROW 52310, N'المخزن غير موجود أو معطّل أو لا يتبع الشركة.', 1;
    IF @Wh2ID IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Wrh_Warehouse WHERE WhID = @Wh2ID AND WhCmpID = @Cmp AND WhActive = 1)
        THROW 52310, N'المخزن المقابل غير موجود أو معطّل أو لا يتبع الشركة.', 1;
    IF @WhID IS NOT NULL AND @Wh2ID IS NOT NULL AND @WhID = @Wh2ID
        THROW 52310, N'المخزنان في التحويل يجب أن يكونا مختلفين.', 1;
    IF @PartyID IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Prt_Party WHERE PrtID = @PartyID AND PrtCmpID = @Cmp AND PrtActive = 1)
        THROW 52310, N'الجهة غير موجودة أو معطّلة أو لا تتبع الشركة.', 1;
    IF @CostCID IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Acc_CostCenter WHERE CsCID = @CostCID)
        THROW 52310, N'مركز التكلفة غير موجود.', 1;

    -- المستند المرجعي
    IF @RefDocID IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
        IF @RT IS NULL THROW 52306, N'هذا النوع لا يقبل مستندًا مرجعيًا.', 1;
        IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Wrh_Doc WHERE DocID = @RefDocID AND DocCmpID = @Cmp AND DocType = @RT AND DocStatus <> 9)
            THROW 52306, N'المستند المرجعي غير صحيح (غير موجود أو نوعه لا يناسب أو ملغى أو لا يتبع الشركة).', 1;
    END

    -- دورة طلب المواد: الصرف من الطلب وهو عند المخزن ومن مخزنه، وطلب الشراء منه وهو عند المشتريات (عند الإدخال فقط)
    IF ISNULL(@DocID, 0) = 0 AND @RefDocID IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
        IF @Type = 5 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Wrh_Doc WHERE DocID = @RefDocID AND DocType = 1
                                 AND (ISNULL(DocFlow, 1) <> 1 OR ISNULL(DocWhID, 0) <> ISNULL(@WhID, 0)))
            THROW 52322, N'الصرف من الطلب يكون وهو عند المخزن وفي مخزن الطلب نفسه.', 1;
        IF @Type = 2 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Wrh_Doc WHERE DocID = @RefDocID AND DocType = 1 AND ISNULL(DocFlow, 2) <> 2)
            THROW 52323, N'طلب الشراء من طلب المواد يكون وهو عند المشتريات.', 1;
    END

    -- دور الجهة (خيار الشركة WsEnforcePartyRole)
    IF @PartyID IS NOT NULL AND ISNULL((SELECT WsEnforcePartyRole FROM dbo.Wrh_Settings WHERE WsCmpID = @Cmp), 1) = 1
    BEGIN
        IF @Type IN (3, 4, 6) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Prt_Party WHERE PrtID = @PartyID AND PrtRole IN (1, 3))
            THROW 52901, N'هذا النوع يقبل مورّدًا أو موظف عهدة فقط.', 1;
        IF @Type IN (10, 11, 12) AND @RefDocID IS NOT NULL
           AND ISNULL((SELECT DocPartyID FROM dbo.Wrh_Doc WHERE DocID = @RefDocID), 0) <> @PartyID
            THROW 52902, N'يجب أن تكون الجهة هي نفس جهة المستند الأصلي.', 1;
    END

    -- البنود
    IF @Lines IS NULL OR ISJSON(@Lines) <> 1 THROW 52303, N'بنود المستند غير صحيحة.', 1;

    CREATE TABLE #L (Ord INT, ItemID BIGINT, UnitID BIGINT, Qty DECIMAL(18,3), Price DECIMAL(18,6),
                     RefLineID BIGINT, Factor DECIMAL(18,6), BaseQty DECIMAL(18,3));

    INSERT #L (Ord, ItemID, UnitID, Qty, Price, RefLineID)
    SELECT CAST(x.[key] AS INT), j.ItemID, j.UnitID, j.Qty, j.Price, j.RefLineID
    FROM OPENJSON(@Lines) AS x
    CROSS APPLY OPENJSON(x.[value]) WITH (ItemID BIGINT '$.ItemID', UnitID BIGINT '$.UnitID',
                                          Qty DECIMAL(18,3) '$.Qty', Price DECIMAL(18,6) '$.Price',
                                          RefLineID BIGINT '$.RefLineID') AS j;

    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #L) THROW 52303, N'يجب أن يحتوي المستند على بند واحد على الأقل.', 1;
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #L WHERE ItemID IS NULL OR UnitID IS NULL OR Qty IS NULL OR Qty <= 0 OR Price < 0)
        THROW 52303, N'كل بند يحتاج صنفًا ووحدة وكمية أكبر من صفر وسعرًا غير سالب.', 1;
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #L AS l WHERE NOT EXISTS
               (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Wrh_Item AS i WHERE i.ItemID = l.ItemID AND i.ItemCmpID = @Cmp AND i.ItemActive = 1))
        THROW 52303, N'صنف غير موجود أو معطّل أو لا يتبع الشركة.', 1;

    -- أصناف الطلب (طلب مواد / طلب شراء) تخص مجموعات المخزن؛ والمخزن الذي لا ربط له بعد يبقى بلا قيد
    IF @Type IN (1, 2) AND @WhID IS NOT NULL
       AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Wrh_GroupWarehouse WHERE GwWhID = @WhID)
       AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #L AS l JOIN dbo.Wrh_Item AS i ON i.ItemID = l.ItemID
                   WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Wrh_GroupWarehouse AS gw WHERE gw.GwGrpID = i.ItemGrpID AND gw.GwWhID = @WhID))
        THROW 52231, N'يوجد صنف لا يتبع مجموعات هذا المخزن.', 1;

    UPDATE l
       SET Factor = CASE WHEN l.UnitID = i.ItemBaseUnitID THEN CAST(1 AS DECIMAL(18,6)) ELSE iu.Factor END
      FROM #L AS l
      JOIN dbo.Wrh_Item AS i ON i.ItemID = l.ItemID
      LEFT JOIN dbo.Wrh_ItemUnit AS iu ON iu.ItemID = l.ItemID AND iu.UnitID = l.UnitID;
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #L WHERE Factor IS NULL)
        THROW 52304, N'وحدة غير معرّفة لهذا الصنف (ليست الأساس ولا ثانوية بمعامل تحويل).', 1;
    UPDATE #L SET BaseQty = ROUND(Qty * Factor, 3);
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #L WHERE BaseQty <= 0) THROW 52303, N'الكمية بالوحدة الأساس تساوي صفرًا.', 1;

    -- ربط البنود بالمرجع
    IF @RefDocID IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
        IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #L AS l WHERE l.RefLineID IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS
                   (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Wrh_DocLine AS r WHERE r.LineID = l.RefLineID AND r.DocID = @RefDocID AND r.ItemID = l.ItemID))
            THROW 52306, N'كل بند يجب أن يرتبط ببند من المستند المرجعي ولنفس الصنف.', 1;
    END
    ELSE IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #L WHERE RefLineID IS NOT NULL)
        THROW 52306, N'لا يجوز ربط بند بمرجع دون تحديد المستند المرجعي.', 1;

    DECLARE @Started BIT = 0;
    IF @@TRANCOUNT = 0 BEGIN BEGIN TRAN; SET @Started = 1; END
    ELSE SAVE TRANSACTION Sp_Wrh_SaveDoc;

    BEGIN TRY
        DECLARE @OldRef BIGINT = NULL, @DocNo NVARCHAR(10), @Year INT = YEAR(@Date), @Kind TINYINT = 1;

        IF ISNULL(@DocID, 0) > 0
        BEGIN
            DECLARE @OType TINYINT, @OYear SMALLINT, @OWh BIGINT, @OFlow TINYINT;
            SELECT @OType = DocType, @OYear = DocYear, @DocNo = DocNo, @OldRef = DocRefDocID, @OWh = DocWhID, @OFlow = DocFlow
            FROM dbo.Wrh_Doc WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) WHERE DocID = @DocID AND DocCmpID = @Cmp;

            IF @OType IS NULL THROW 52309, N'المستند غير موجود أو لا يتبع الشركة.', 1;
            IF @OType <> @Type THROW 52301, N'لا يُغيَّر نوع المستند.', 1;
            IF @OYear <> @Year THROW 52312, N'لا يجوز تغيير تاريخ المستند إلى سنة أخرى.', 1;
            IF @OType = 1 AND ISNULL(@OFlow, 1) <> 0 THROW 52320, N'الطلب المُرسَل لا يُعدَّل (ألغِه أو أعد إرساله كما هو).', 1;
            IF @OType = 1 AND ISNULL(@OWh, 0) <> ISNULL(@WhID, 0) THROW 52321, N'لا يُغيَّر مخزن الطلب بعد حفظه؛ احذف المسودة وأنشئ طلبًا جديدًا.', 1;
            IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Wrh_DocLine WHERE DocID = @DocID AND (QtyReferred > 0 OR QtyCancelled > 0))
                THROW 52305, N'لا يجوز تعديل مستند استُعمل منه شيء في مستند لاحق أو أُلغي منه.', 1;

            EXEC dbo.Wrh_StockReverse @DocID;   -- يعكس أثر المخزون القديم
            -- تراجع أثر الربط القديم ثم حذف البنود القديمة
            UPDATE r SET QtyReferred = r.QtyReferred - s.q
              FROM dbo.Wrh_DocLine AS r
              JOIN (SELECT RefLineID, SUM(BaseQty) AS q FROM dbo.Wrh_DocLine
                    WHERE DocID = @DocID AND RefLineID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY RefLineID) AS s ON s.RefLineID = r.LineID;
            DELETE dbo.Wrh_DocLine WHERE DocID = @DocID;

            UPDATE dbo.Wrh_Doc
               SET DocDate = @Date, DocWhID = @WhID, DocWh2ID = @Wh2ID, DocPartyID = @PartyID,
                   DocCostCID = @CostCID, DocRefDocID = @RefDocID, DocNotes = @Notes
             WHERE DocID = @DocID;
            SET @Kind = 2;
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            IF @Type = 1   -- مسودة طلب مواد: رقم مؤقت يبدأ بـ T، والرقم الرسمي يُعطى عند الإرسال
                SET @DocNo = N'T' + LEFT(REPLACE(CAST(NEWID() AS NVARCHAR(36)), N'-', N''), 9);
            ELSE
                EXEC dbo.Wrh_NextDocNo @Cmp, @Year, @Type, @DocNo OUTPUT;
            INSERT dbo.Wrh_Doc (DocCmpID, DocType, DocYear, DocNo, DocDate, DocStatus, DocWhID, DocWh2ID,
                                DocPartyID, DocCostCID, DocRefDocID, DocNotes, DocCreatedBy, DocFlow)
            VALUES (@Cmp, @Type, @Year, @DocNo, @Date, CASE WHEN @Class = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 3 END, @WhID, @Wh2ID,
                    @PartyID, @CostCID, @RefDocID, @Notes, @User, CASE WHEN @Type = 1 THEN 0 END);
            SET @DocID = SCOPE_IDENTITY();
        END

        INSERT dbo.Wrh_DocLine (DocID, DocLineNo, ItemID, UnitID, Factor, Qty, BaseQty, UnitPrice, Amount, RefLineID)
        SELECT @DocID, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY l.Ord), l.ItemID, l.UnitID, l.Factor, l.Qty, l.BaseQty, l.Price,
               CAST(ROUND(l.Qty * ISNULL(l.Price, 0), 3) AS DECIMAL(18,3)), l.RefLineID
        FROM #L AS l;

        -- أثر الربط الجديد (مع التحقق من المتبقي)
        IF EXISTS (SELECT 1
                   FROM (SELECT RefLineID, SUM(BaseQty) AS q FROM #L WHERE RefLineID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY RefLineID) AS s
                   JOIN dbo.Wrh_DocLine AS r WITH (UPDLOCK) ON r.LineID = s.RefLineID
                   WHERE r.BaseQty - r.QtyReferred - r.QtyCancelled < s.q)
            THROW 52306, N'الكمية تتجاوز المتبقي في البند المرجعي.', 1;

        UPDATE r SET QtyReferred = r.QtyReferred + s.q
          FROM dbo.Wrh_DocLine AS r
          JOIN (SELECT RefLineID, SUM(BaseQty) AS q FROM #L WHERE RefLineID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY RefLineID) AS s
            ON s.RefLineID = r.LineID;

        EXEC dbo.Wrh_StockApply @DocID;     -- أثر المخزون الجديد

        EXEC dbo.Wrh_RecalcDocStatus @RefDocID;
        IF @OldRef IS NOT NULL AND ISNULL(@OldRef, 0) <> ISNULL(@RefDocID, 0)
            EXEC dbo.Wrh_RecalcDocStatus @OldRef;

        INSERT dbo.Wrh_DocEvent (EvCmpID, EvDocID, EvDocNo, EvDocType, EvKind, EvUser)
        VALUES (@Cmp, @DocID, @DocNo, @Type, @Kind, @User);

        IF @Started = 1 COMMIT;
        SELECT @DocID AS DocID, @DocNo AS DocNo, d.DocStatus FROM dbo.Wrh_Doc AS d WHERE d.DocID = @DocID;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @Started = 1 BEGIN IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 ROLLBACK; END
        ELSE IF XACT_STATE() = 1 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION Sp_Wrh_SaveDoc;
        THROW;
    END CATCH
END;

GO

SET ANSI_NULLS ON

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Wrh_SaveItem]
    @Cmp INT, @User BIGINT, @ItemID BIGINT, @GrpID BIGINT, @Code NVARCHAR(30), @Name NVARCHAR(200),
    @BaseUnitID BIGINT, @Active BIT = 1
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    IF ISNULL(@Cmp, 0) <= 0 THROW 52201, N'الشركة غير صحيحة.', 1;
    IF ISNULL(@User, 0) <= 0 OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_User WHERE UsrID = @User) THROW 52200, N'المستخدم غير موجود.', 1;
    SET @Code = LTRIM(RTRIM(@Code)); SET @Name = LTRIM(RTRIM(@Name));
    IF ISNULL(@Name, N'') = N'' THROW 52202, N'الاسم مطلوب.', 1;
    IF ISNULL(@Code, N'') = N'' AND ISNULL(@ItemID, 0) <> 0 THROW 52202, N'الكود مطلوب.', 1;
    IF ISNULL(@Code, N'') = N''
    BEGIN   -- كود آلي: الرقم التالي للشركة بأربع خانات على الأقل
        DECLARE @n INT = ISNULL((SELECT MAX(TRY_CAST(ItemCode AS INT)) FROM dbo.Wrh_Item WHERE ItemCmpID = @Cmp), 0) + 1;
        SET @Code = RIGHT(CONCAT(N'0000', @n), CASE WHEN LEN(CAST(@n AS NVARCHAR(10))) > 4 THEN LEN(CAST(@n AS NVARCHAR(10))) ELSE 4 END);
    END

    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Wrh_ItemGroup WHERE GrpID = @GrpID AND GrpCmpID = @Cmp)
        THROW 52206, N'المجموعة غير موجودة أو لا تتبع الشركة.', 1;
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Wrh_ItemGroup WHERE GrpParentID = @GrpID)
       OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Wrh_ItemGroup WHERE GrpID = @GrpID AND GrpAccID IS NULL)
        THROW 52208, N'الصنف يُربط بمجموعة ورقية (بلا مجموعات فرعية) ولها حساب مصروف.', 1;
    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Wrh_Unit WHERE UnitID = @BaseUnitID AND UnitCmpID = @Cmp)
        THROW 52210, N'الوحدة الأساس غير موجودة أو لا تتبع الشركة.', 1;
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Wrh_Item WHERE ItemCmpID = @Cmp AND ItemCode = @Code AND ItemID <> ISNULL(@ItemID, 0))
        THROW 52204, N'كود الصنف مستخدم من قبل.', 1;

    IF ISNULL(@ItemID, 0) = 0
    BEGIN
        INSERT dbo.Wrh_Item (ItemCmpID, ItemCode, ItemName, ItemGrpID, ItemBaseUnitID, ItemActive)
        VALUES (@Cmp, @Code, @Name, @GrpID, @BaseUnitID, ISNULL(@Active, 1));
        SET @ItemID = SCOPE_IDENTITY();
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Wrh_Item WHERE ItemID = @ItemID AND ItemCmpID = @Cmp)
            THROW 52206, N'الصنف غير موجود أو لا يتبع الشركة.', 1;
        IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Wrh_Item WHERE ItemID = @ItemID AND ItemBaseUnitID <> @BaseUnitID)
           AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Wrh_DocLine WHERE ItemID = @ItemID)
            THROW 52213, N'لا يجوز تغيير الوحدة الأساس لصنف ورد في مستندات.', 1;
        UPDATE dbo.Wrh_Item
           SET ItemCode = @Code, ItemName = @Name, ItemGrpID = @GrpID, ItemBaseUnitID = @BaseUnitID, ItemActive = ISNULL(@Active, 1)
         WHERE ItemID = @ItemID AND ItemCmpID = @Cmp;
        -- لا يبقى للوحدة الأساس صف تحويل ثانوي
        DELETE dbo.Wrh_ItemUnit WHERE ItemID = @ItemID AND UnitID = @BaseUnitID;
    END
    SELECT @ItemID AS ItemID;
END;

GO

SET ANSI_NULLS ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Wrh_SaveItemGroup]
    @Cmp INT, @User BIGINT, @GrpID BIGINT, @ParentID BIGINT = NULL, @Code NVARCHAR(30), @Name NVARCHAR(200),
    @AccID BIGINT = NULL, @Active BIT = 1, @Whs NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    IF ISNULL(@Cmp, 0) <= 0 THROW 52201, N'الشركة غير صحيحة.', 1;
    IF ISNULL(@User, 0) <= 0 OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_User WHERE UsrID = @User) THROW 52200, N'المستخدم غير موجود.', 1;
    SET @Code = LTRIM(RTRIM(@Code)); SET @Name = LTRIM(RTRIM(@Name));
    IF ISNULL(@Name, N'') = N'' THROW 52202, N'الاسم مطلوب.', 1;
    IF ISNULL(@Code, N'') = N'' AND ISNULL(@GrpID, 0) <> 0 THROW 52202, N'الكود مطلوب.', 1;
    IF ISNULL(@Code, N'') = N''
    BEGIN   -- كود آلي: الرقم التالي للشركة بأربع خانات على الأقل
        DECLARE @gn INT = ISNULL((SELECT MAX(TRY_CAST(GrpCode AS INT)) FROM dbo.Wrh_ItemGroup WHERE GrpCmpID = @Cmp), 0) + 1;
        SET @Code = RIGHT(CONCAT(N'0000', @gn), CASE WHEN LEN(CAST(@gn AS NVARCHAR(10))) > 4 THEN LEN(CAST(@gn AS NVARCHAR(10))) ELSE 4 END);
    END
    IF @AccID IS NOT NULL AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Acc_Account WHERE AccID = @AccID)
                               OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Acc_Account WHERE AccParentID = @AccID))
        THROW 52205, N'حساب المجموعة غير موجود أو ليس حسابًا ورقيًا.', 1;
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Wrh_ItemGroup WHERE GrpCmpID = @Cmp AND GrpCode = @Code AND GrpID <> ISNULL(@GrpID, 0))
        THROW 52204, N'كود المجموعة مستخدم من قبل.', 1;

    -- الأب: للشركة نفسها، لا يحمل أصنافًا، ولا حلقة
    IF @ParentID IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
        IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Wrh_ItemGroup WHERE GrpID = @ParentID AND GrpCmpID = @Cmp)
            THROW 52207, N'المجموعة الأب غير موجودة أو لا تتبع الشركة.', 1;
        IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Wrh_Item WHERE ItemGrpID = @ParentID)
            THROW 52207, N'المجموعة الأب تحمل أصنافًا فلا تقبل مجموعات فرعية.', 1;
        IF ISNULL(@GrpID, 0) > 0
        BEGIN
            DECLARE @Cyc INT = 0;
            ;WITH D AS
            (
                SELECT GrpID FROM dbo.Wrh_ItemGroup WHERE GrpID = @GrpID
                UNION ALL
                SELECT g.GrpID FROM dbo.Wrh_ItemGroup AS g JOIN D ON g.GrpParentID = D.GrpID
            )
            SELECT @Cyc = COUNT(*) FROM D WHERE GrpID = @ParentID;
            IF @Cyc > 0 THROW 52207, N'لا يجوز جعل المجموعة أبًا لنفسها أو لأحد فروعها.', 1;
        END
    END

    -- مخازن المجموعة: NULL = لا يُمسّ الربط؛ وإن مُرّرت فيجب أن يوجد مخزن واحد صحيح على الأقل
    DECLARE @W TABLE (WhID BIGINT PRIMARY KEY);
    IF @Whs IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
        INSERT @W SELECT DISTINCT TRY_CAST(LTRIM(RTRIM(value)) AS BIGINT) FROM STRING_SPLIT(@Whs, N',')
                  WHERE TRY_CAST(LTRIM(RTRIM(value)) AS BIGINT) IS NOT NULL;
        IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM @W) THROW 52230, N'مخزن واحد على الأقل مطلوب للمجموعة.', 1;
        IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM @W AS x WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Wrh_Warehouse WHERE WhID = x.WhID AND WhCmpID = @Cmp))
            THROW 52230, N'مخزن غير موجود أو لا يتبع الشركة.', 1;
    END

    DECLARE @Started BIT = 0, @New BIGINT, @Cur BIGINT, @PAcc BIGINT, @PName NVARCHAR(200), @IsNew BIT = 0;
    IF ISNULL(@GrpID, 0) <> 0
    BEGIN
        SELECT @Cur = GrpAccID FROM dbo.Wrh_ItemGroup WHERE GrpID = @GrpID AND GrpCmpID = @Cmp;
        IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0 THROW 52206, N'المجموعة غير موجودة أو لا تتبع الشركة.', 1;
    END

    IF @@TRANCOUNT = 0 BEGIN BEGIN TRAN; SET @Started = 1; END
    ELSE SAVE TRANSACTION Sp_Wrh_SaveItemGroup;
    BEGIN TRY
        -- حساب المصروف آلي (عملية 15 مواد تشغيل) إن لم يُمرَّر ولم يكن للمجموعة حساب
        IF @ParentID IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            -- فرعية: تستعمل حساب الأب (يُنشأ للأب إن لم يوجد)
            SELECT @PAcc = GrpAccID, @PName = GrpName FROM dbo.Wrh_ItemGroup WHERE GrpID = @ParentID;
            IF @PAcc IS NULL
            BEGIN
                EXEC dbo.Wrh_CreateSystemAccount @Cmp, @User, 203, @PName, @New OUTPUT;
                UPDATE dbo.Wrh_ItemGroup SET GrpAccID = @New WHERE GrpID = @ParentID;
                SET @PAcc = @New;
            END
            SET @AccID = @PAcc;
        END
        ELSE IF @AccID IS NULL AND @Cur IS NULL
        BEGIN
            EXEC dbo.Wrh_CreateSystemAccount @Cmp, @User, 203, @Name, @New OUTPUT;
            SET @AccID = @New;
        END
        IF ISNULL(@GrpID, 0) = 0
        BEGIN
            INSERT dbo.Wrh_ItemGroup (GrpCmpID, GrpParentID, GrpCode, GrpName, GrpAccID, GrpActive)
            VALUES (@Cmp, @ParentID, @Code, @Name, @AccID, ISNULL(@Active, 1));
            SET @GrpID = SCOPE_IDENTITY(); SET @IsNew = 1;
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            UPDATE dbo.Wrh_ItemGroup
               SET GrpParentID = @ParentID, GrpCode = @Code, GrpName = @Name, GrpAccID = CASE WHEN @ParentID IS NOT NULL THEN @AccID ELSE COALESCE(@AccID, GrpAccID) END, GrpActive = ISNULL(@Active, 1)
             WHERE GrpID = @GrpID AND GrpCmpID = @Cmp;
            -- مزامنة اسم حساب النظام مع اسم المجموعة
            IF @ParentID IS NULL AND @Cur IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Acc_PostingRule WHERE AccID = @Cur AND StateID = 1)
               AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Acc_Account WHERE AccID = @Cur AND AccName <> @Name)
                EXEC dbo.Acc_UpdaeAccounting @Name, @Cur, @User, @Cmp;
        END
        IF @Whs IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            DELETE dbo.Wrh_GroupWarehouse WHERE GwGrpID = @GrpID AND GwWhID NOT IN (SELECT WhID FROM @W);
            INSERT dbo.Wrh_GroupWarehouse (GwGrpID, GwWhID)
            SELECT @GrpID, WhID FROM @W AS x
            WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Wrh_GroupWarehouse WHERE GwGrpID = @GrpID AND GwWhID = x.WhID);
        END
        -- تغيير مخازن الرئيسية يسري على فروعها (الفرع يتبع أباه)
        IF @Whs IS NOT NULL AND @ParentID IS NULL
        BEGIN
            DELETE l FROM dbo.Wrh_GroupWarehouse AS l JOIN dbo.Wrh_ItemGroup AS c ON c.GrpID = l.GwGrpID
             WHERE c.GrpParentID = @GrpID AND l.GwWhID NOT IN (SELECT WhID FROM @W);
            INSERT dbo.Wrh_GroupWarehouse (GwGrpID, GwWhID)
            SELECT c.GrpID, w.WhID FROM dbo.Wrh_ItemGroup AS c CROSS JOIN @W AS w
             WHERE c.GrpParentID = @GrpID
               AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Wrh_GroupWarehouse WHERE GwGrpID = c.GrpID AND GwWhID = w.WhID);
        END
        -- فرعية جديدة بلا مخازن مُمرَّرة: تنسخ روابط الأب
        IF @Whs IS NULL AND @IsNew = 1 AND @ParentID IS NOT NULL
            INSERT dbo.Wrh_GroupWarehouse (GwGrpID, GwWhID)
            SELECT @GrpID, GwWhID FROM dbo.Wrh_GroupWarehouse WHERE GwGrpID = @ParentID;
        IF @Started = 1 COMMIT;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @Started = 1 BEGIN IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 ROLLBACK; END
        ELSE IF XACT_STATE() = 1 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION Sp_Wrh_SaveItemGroup;
        THROW;
    END CATCH
    SELECT @GrpID AS GrpID;
END;

GO

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Wrh_SaveItemUnit]
    @Cmp INT, @User BIGINT, @ItemID BIGINT, @UnitID BIGINT, @Factor DECIMAL(18,6)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    IF ISNULL(@Cmp, 0) <= 0 THROW 52201, N'الشركة غير صحيحة.', 1;
    IF ISNULL(@User, 0) <= 0 OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_User WHERE UsrID = @User) THROW 52200, N'المستخدم غير موجود.', 1;
    DECLARE @Base BIGINT;
    SELECT @Base = ItemBaseUnitID FROM dbo.Wrh_Item WHERE ItemID = @ItemID AND ItemCmpID = @Cmp;
    IF @Base IS NULL THROW 52206, N'الصنف غير موجود أو لا يتبع الشركة.', 1;
    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Wrh_Unit WHERE UnitID = @UnitID AND UnitCmpID = @Cmp)
        THROW 52210, N'الوحدة غير موجودة أو لا تتبع الشركة.', 1;
    IF @UnitID = @Base OR @Factor IS NULL OR @Factor <= 0
        THROW 52209, N'معامل التحويل يجب أن يكون أكبر من صفر، والوحدة الأساس لا يُضاف لها معامل.', 1;

    UPDATE dbo.Wrh_ItemUnit SET Factor = @Factor WHERE ItemID = @ItemID AND UnitID = @UnitID;
    IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0
        INSERT dbo.Wrh_ItemUnit (ItemID, UnitID, Factor) VALUES (@ItemID, @UnitID, @Factor);
END;

GO

SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Wrh_SaveSettings]
    @Cmp                  INT,
    @User                 BIGINT,
    @CostMethod           TINYINT,
    @AllocBasis           TINYINT,
    @AllowPartialIssue    BIT,
    @AllowNegative        BIT,
    @ReserveOnRequest     BIT,
    @SeparateDuties       BIT,
    @MaxAutoVoucherDocs   INT,
    @AutoVoucherState     TINYINT,
    @DiffAccID            BIGINT = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    IF ISNULL(@Cmp, 0) <= 0
        THROW 52006, N'الشركة غير صحيحة.', 1;
    IF ISNULL(@User, 0) <= 0 OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_User WHERE UsrID = @User)
        THROW 52005, N'المستخدم غير موجود.', 1;
    IF @CostMethod IS NULL OR @CostMethod NOT IN (1, 2)
        THROW 52001, N'طريقة التكلفة غير صحيحة (1 = FIFO، 2 = متوسط مرجح).', 1;
    IF @AllocBasis IS NULL OR @AllocBasis NOT IN (1, 2, 3)
        THROW 52002, N'أساس توزيع التكاليف الإضافية غير صحيح (1 قيمة، 2 كمية، 3 وزن).', 1;
    IF @MaxAutoVoucherDocs IS NULL OR @MaxAutoVoucherDocs NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 5000
        THROW 52003, N'الحد الأقصى لمستندات القيد الآلي يجب أن يكون بين 1 و 5000.', 1;
    IF @AutoVoucherState IS NULL OR @AutoVoucherState NOT IN (0, 1)
        THROW 52004, N'حالة القيد الآلي الناتج يجب أن تكون 0 (مؤقت) أو 1 (مُرحّل).', 1;

    UPDATE dbo.Wrh_Settings WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
       SET WsCostMethod = @CostMethod, WsAllocBasis = @AllocBasis,
           WsAllowPartialIssue = ISNULL(@AllowPartialIssue, 1), WsAllowNegative = ISNULL(@AllowNegative, 0),
           WsReserveOnRequest = ISNULL(@ReserveOnRequest, 1), WsSeparateDuties = ISNULL(@SeparateDuties, 1),
           WsMaxAutoVoucherDocs = @MaxAutoVoucherDocs, WsAutoVoucherState = @AutoVoucherState,
           WsDiffAccID = @DiffAccID, WsUpdatedBy = @User, WsUpdatedAt = SYSUTCDATETIME()
     WHERE WsCmpID = @Cmp;

    IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0
        INSERT dbo.Wrh_Settings
            (WsCmpID, WsCostMethod, WsAllocBasis, WsAllowPartialIssue, WsAllowNegative, WsReserveOnRequest,
             WsSeparateDuties, WsMaxAutoVoucherDocs, WsAutoVoucherState, WsDiffAccID, WsUpdatedBy, WsUpdatedAt)
        VALUES
            (@Cmp, @CostMethod, @AllocBasis, ISNULL(@AllowPartialIssue, 1), ISNULL(@AllowNegative, 0),
             ISNULL(@ReserveOnRequest, 1), ISNULL(@SeparateDuties, 1), @MaxAutoVoucherDocs, @AutoVoucherState,
             @DiffAccID, @User, SYSUTCDATETIME());
END;

GO

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ الوحدات */
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Wrh_SaveUnit]
    @Cmp INT, @User BIGINT, @UnitID BIGINT, @Name NVARCHAR(60)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    IF ISNULL(@Cmp, 0) <= 0 THROW 52201, N'الشركة غير صحيحة.', 1;
    IF ISNULL(@User, 0) <= 0 OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_User WHERE UsrID = @User) THROW 52200, N'المستخدم غير موجود.', 1;
    SET @Name = LTRIM(RTRIM(@Name));
    IF ISNULL(@Name, N'') = N'' THROW 52202, N'اسم الوحدة مطلوب.', 1;
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Wrh_Unit WHERE UnitCmpID = @Cmp AND UnitName = @Name AND UnitID <> ISNULL(@UnitID, 0))
        THROW 52204, N'اسم الوحدة مستخدم من قبل.', 1;

    IF ISNULL(@UnitID, 0) = 0
    BEGIN
        INSERT dbo.Wrh_Unit (UnitCmpID, UnitName) VALUES (@Cmp, @Name);
        SET @UnitID = SCOPE_IDENTITY();
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        UPDATE dbo.Wrh_Unit SET UnitName = @Name WHERE UnitID = @UnitID AND UnitCmpID = @Cmp;
        IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0 THROW 52206, N'الوحدة غير موجودة أو لا تتبع الشركة.', 1;
    END
    SELECT @UnitID AS UnitID;
END;

GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Wrh_SaveWarehouse]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ المخازن */
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Wrh_SaveWarehouse]
    @Cmp INT, @User BIGINT, @WhID BIGINT, @Code NVARCHAR(30), @Name NVARCHAR(200),
    @AccID BIGINT = NULL, @Keeper BIGINT = NULL, @Active BIT = 1
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    IF ISNULL(@Cmp, 0) <= 0 THROW 52201, N'الشركة غير صحيحة.', 1;
    IF ISNULL(@User, 0) <= 0 OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_User WHERE UsrID = @User) THROW 52200, N'المستخدم غير موجود.', 1;
    SET @Code = LTRIM(RTRIM(@Code)); SET @Name = LTRIM(RTRIM(@Name));
    IF ISNULL(@Name, N'') = N'' THROW 52202, N'الاسم مطلوب.', 1;
    IF ISNULL(@Code, N'') = N'' AND ISNULL(@WhID, 0) <> 0 THROW 52202, N'الكود مطلوب.', 1;
    IF ISNULL(@Code, N'') = N''
    BEGIN   -- كود آلي: الرقم التالي للشركة بأربع خانات على الأقل
        DECLARE @wn INT = ISNULL((SELECT MAX(TRY_CAST(WhCode AS INT)) FROM dbo.Wrh_Warehouse WHERE WhCmpID = @Cmp), 0) + 1;
        SET @Code = RIGHT(CONCAT(N'0000', @wn), CASE WHEN LEN(CAST(@wn AS NVARCHAR(10))) > 4 THEN LEN(CAST(@wn AS NVARCHAR(10))) ELSE 4 END);
    END
    IF @AccID IS NOT NULL AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Acc_Account WHERE AccID = @AccID)
                               OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Acc_Account WHERE AccParentID = @AccID))
        THROW 52205, N'حساب المخزن غير موجود أو ليس حسابًا ورقيًا.', 1;
    IF @Keeper IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_User WHERE UsrID = @Keeper)
        THROW 52200, N'أمين المخزن غير موجود.', 1;
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Wrh_Warehouse WHERE WhCmpID = @Cmp AND WhCode = @Code AND WhID <> ISNULL(@WhID, 0))
        THROW 52204, N'كود المخزن مستخدم من قبل.', 1;

    DECLARE @Started BIT = 0, @New BIGINT;
    DECLARE @CurW BIGINT;
    IF ISNULL(@WhID, 0) <> 0
    BEGIN
        SELECT @CurW = WhAccID FROM dbo.Wrh_Warehouse WHERE WhID = @WhID AND WhCmpID = @Cmp;
        IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0 THROW 52206, N'المخزن غير موجود أو لا يتبع الشركة.', 1;
    END

    IF @@TRANCOUNT = 0 BEGIN BEGIN TRAN; SET @Started = 1; END
    ELSE SAVE TRANSACTION Sp_Wrh_SaveWarehouse;
    BEGIN TRY
        IF ISNULL(@WhID, 0) = 0
        BEGIN
            IF @AccID IS NULL
            BEGIN
                EXEC dbo.Wrh_CreateSystemAccount @Cmp, @User, 202, @Name, @New OUTPUT;   -- 1 المخازن
                SET @AccID = @New;
            END
            INSERT dbo.Wrh_Warehouse (WhCmpID, WhCode, WhName, WhAccID, WhKeeper, WhActive)
            VALUES (@Cmp, @Code, @Name, @AccID, @Keeper, ISNULL(@Active, 1));
            SET @WhID = SCOPE_IDENTITY();
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            UPDATE dbo.Wrh_Warehouse
               SET WhCode = @Code, WhName = @Name, WhAccID = COALESCE(@AccID, WhAccID), WhKeeper = @Keeper, WhActive = ISNULL(@Active, 1)
             WHERE WhID = @WhID AND WhCmpID = @Cmp;
            -- مزامنة اسم حساب النظام مع اسم المخزن
            IF @CurW IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Acc_PostingRule WHERE AccID = @CurW AND StateID = 1)
               AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Acc_Account WHERE AccID = @CurW AND AccName <> @Name)
                EXEC dbo.Acc_UpdaeAccounting @Name, @CurW, @User, @Cmp;
        END
        IF @Started = 1 COMMIT;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @Started = 1 BEGIN IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 ROLLBACK; END
        ELSE IF XACT_STATE() = 1 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION Sp_Wrh_SaveWarehouse;
        THROW;
    END CATCH
    SELECT @WhID AS WhID;
END;

GO

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ المستندات العالقة (للإشعار) */
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Wrh_SelectAutoPending]
    @Cmp INT, @User BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    CREATE TABLE #PendingOut (DocID BIGINT, DocType TINYINT, Reason NVARCHAR(300));
    EXEC dbo.Wrh_GenerateAutoVouchers @Cmp, @User, NULL, NULL, NULL, 1, 1;
    SELECT p.DocType, t.DtName AS DocTypeName, p.Reason, COUNT(*) AS Docs
    FROM #PendingOut p JOIN dbo.Wrh_DocTypeDef t ON t.DtType = p.DocType
    GROUP BY p.DocType, t.DtName, p.Reason ORDER BY p.DocType, p.Reason;
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS PendingDocs FROM #PendingOut;
END;

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ تاريخ المستند كاملًا */
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Wrh_SelectAutoVoucherHistory]
    @Cmp INT, @DocID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Wrh_Doc WHERE DocID = @DocID AND DocCmpID = @Cmp)
       AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Wrh_DocEvent WHERE EvDocID = @DocID AND EvCmpID = @Cmp)
        THROW 52807, N'المستند غير موجود أو لا يتبع الشركة.', 1;

    SELECT x.Src, x.At, x.Code, x.Label, x.UserID, x.Reason
    FROM (
        SELECT N'doc' AS Src, e.EvAt AS At, CAST(e.EvKind AS INT) AS Code,
               CASE e.EvKind WHEN 1 THEN N'إنشاء' WHEN 2 THEN N'تعديل' WHEN 3 THEN N'حذف' WHEN 4 THEN N'إلغاء'
                             WHEN 5 THEN N'اعتماد جرد' WHEN 6 THEN N'إرجاع من القيد الآلي' ELSE N'حدث' END AS Label,
               e.EvUser AS UserID, e.EvReason AS Reason
        FROM dbo.Wrh_DocEvent e WHERE e.EvCmpID = @Cmp AND e.EvDocID = @DocID
        UNION ALL
        SELECT N'voucher', s.DayMSDateTime, CAST(s.DayMSState AS INT), CONCAT(N'حالة القيد ', s.DayMSState), s.DayMSUser, s.DayMSReason
        FROM dbo.Acc_AutoVoucherLine l
        JOIN dbo.Acc_AutoVoucher v ON v.AvID = l.AvID AND v.AvCompany = @Cmp
        JOIN dbo.Acc_DayMasterState s ON s.DayMSDayMID = v.AvDayMID
        WHERE l.SourceDocID = @DocID
    ) x
    ORDER BY x.At, x.Src;
END;

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ قراءة مستند تكلفة/تسوية: الرأس ثم بنود التكلفة ثم الأثر على البنود */
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Wrh_SelectCostDoc]
    @Cmp INT, @DocID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Wrh_Doc WHERE DocID = @DocID AND DocCmpID = @Cmp AND DocType IN (14, 15))
        THROW 52509, N'المستند غير موجود أو لا يتبع الشركة أو ليس تكلفة/تسوية.', 1;

    SELECT d.DocID, d.DocType, t.DtName AS DocTypeName, d.DocNo, d.DocDate, d.DocRefDocID, r.DocNo AS RefDocNo,
           d.DocPartyID, p.PrtName, d.DocNotes, d.DocCreatedBy, d.DocCreatedAt
    FROM dbo.Wrh_Doc AS d
    JOIN dbo.Wrh_DocTypeDef AS t ON t.DtType = d.DocType
    LEFT JOIN dbo.Wrh_Doc AS r ON r.DocID = d.DocRefDocID
    LEFT JOIN dbo.Prt_Party AS p ON p.PrtID = d.DocPartyID
    WHERE d.DocID = @DocID;

    SELECT c.CostLineID, c.CostPartyID, p.PrtName, c.CostKind, c.CostAmount
    FROM dbo.Wrh_CostLine AS c JOIN dbo.Prt_Party AS p ON p.PrtID = c.CostPartyID
    WHERE c.CostDocID = @DocID ORDER BY c.CostLineID;

    SELECT a.AdjID, a.AdjRefLineID, l.ItemID, i.ItemCode, i.ItemName, a.AdjAmount, a.AdjRemPart, a.AdjConsPart, a.AdjBaseQty, a.AdjRemQty
    FROM dbo.Wrh_CostAdj AS a
    JOIN dbo.Wrh_DocLine AS l ON l.LineID = a.AdjRefLineID
    JOIN dbo.Wrh_Item AS i ON i.ItemID = l.ItemID
    WHERE a.AdjDocID = @DocID ORDER BY a.AdjID;
END;

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Wrh_SelectCount]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ قراءة جرد: الرأس ثم البنود (الرصيد الحالي للمسودة) */
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Wrh_SelectCount]
    @Cmp INT, @DocID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Wrh_Doc WHERE DocID = @DocID AND DocCmpID = @Cmp AND DocType = 13)
        THROW 52706, N'المستند غير موجود أو ليس جردًا.', 1;
    SELECT d.DocID, d.DocNo, d.DocDate, d.DocStatus, d.DocWhID, w.WhName, d.DocNotes, d.DocCreatedBy, d.DocCreatedAt
    FROM dbo.Wrh_Doc AS d JOIN dbo.Wrh_Warehouse AS w ON w.WhID = d.DocWhID WHERE d.DocID = @DocID;
    SELECT c.CntLineID, c.ItemID, i.ItemCode, i.ItemName, c.UnitID, c.Qty, c.CountedQty,
           CASE WHEN d.DocStatus = 1 THEN ISNULL(s.StkQty, 0) ELSE c.SysQty END AS SysQty,
           CASE WHEN d.DocStatus = 1 THEN c.CountedQty - ISNULL(s.StkQty, 0) ELSE c.DiffQty END AS DiffQty,
           c.Price, c.UnitCost, c.DiffValue
    FROM dbo.Wrh_CountLine AS c
    JOIN dbo.Wrh_Doc AS d ON d.DocID = c.CntDocID
    JOIN dbo.Wrh_Item AS i ON i.ItemID = c.ItemID
    LEFT JOIN dbo.Wrh_Stock AS s ON s.StkWhID = d.DocWhID AND s.StkItemID = c.ItemID
    WHERE c.CntDocID = @DocID ORDER BY i.ItemCode;
END;

SET ANSI_NULLS ON

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ قراءة مستند (مجموعتا نتائج: الرأس ثم البنود) */
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Wrh_SelectDoc]
    @Cmp INT, @DocID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Wrh_Doc WHERE DocID = @DocID AND DocCmpID = @Cmp)
        THROW 52309, N'المستند غير موجود أو لا يتبع الشركة.', 1;

    SELECT d.DocID, d.DocType, t.DtName AS DocTypeName, d.DocNo, d.DocDate, d.DocStatus,
           CASE d.DocStatus WHEN 1 THEN N'مفتوح' WHEN 2 THEN N'منفذ جزئيًا' WHEN 3 THEN N'منفذ كليًا' WHEN 9 THEN N'ملغى' END AS StatusName,
           d.DocWhID, w.WhName, d.DocWh2ID, w2.WhName AS Wh2Name, d.DocPartyID, p.PrtName,
           d.DocCostCID, d.DocRefDocID, r.DocNo AS RefDocNo, d.DocNotes, d.DocCreatedBy, d.DocCreatedAt
    FROM dbo.Wrh_Doc AS d
    JOIN dbo.Wrh_DocTypeDef AS t ON t.DtType = d.DocType
    LEFT JOIN dbo.Wrh_Warehouse AS w  ON w.WhID  = d.DocWhID
    LEFT JOIN dbo.Wrh_Warehouse AS w2 ON w2.WhID = d.DocWh2ID
    LEFT JOIN dbo.Prt_Party     AS p  ON p.PrtID = d.DocPartyID
    LEFT JOIN dbo.Wrh_Doc       AS r  ON r.DocID = d.DocRefDocID
    WHERE d.DocID = @DocID AND d.DocCmpID = @Cmp;

    SELECT l.LineID, l.DocLineNo, l.ItemID, i.ItemCode, i.ItemName, l.UnitID, u.UnitName, l.Factor, l.Qty, l.BaseQty,
           l.UnitPrice, l.Amount, l.RefLineID, l.QtyReferred, l.QtyCancelled,
           CAST(l.BaseQty - l.QtyReferred - l.QtyCancelled AS DECIMAL(18,3)) AS QtyRemaining
    FROM dbo.Wrh_DocLine AS l
    JOIN dbo.Wrh_Item AS i ON i.ItemID = l.ItemID
    JOIN dbo.Wrh_Unit AS u ON u.UnitID = l.UnitID
    WHERE l.DocID = @DocID
    ORDER BY l.DocLineNo;
END;

GO

/* فهرس المستندات (كل الأنواع) بالصفحات. الحالة: 1 مفتوح 2 جزئي 3 منفَّذ 9 ملغى */
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Wrh_SelectDocs]
    @Cmp INT, @Type TINYINT = NULL, @FromDate DATE = NULL, @ToDate DATE = NULL, @Status TINYINT = NULL,
    @Search NVARCHAR(100) = NULL, @PageNo INT = 1, @PageSize INT = 50
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET @Search = NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@Search)), N'');
    IF @PageNo IS NULL OR @PageNo < 1 SET @PageNo = 1;
    IF @PageSize IS NULL OR @PageSize < 1 SET @PageSize = 50;
    IF @PageSize > 500 SET @PageSize = 500;

    SELECT d.DocID, d.DocType, t.DtName AS DocTypeName, d.DocNo, d.DocDate, d.DocStatus,
           d.DocWhID, w.WhName, d.DocWh2ID, w2.WhName AS Wh2Name, d.DocPartyID, p.PrtName,
           d.DocCostCID, cc.CsCName AS CostCenterName, d.DocRefDocID, r.DocNo AS RefDocNo, d.DocNotes,
           (SELECT SUM(l.Amount) FROM dbo.Wrh_DocLine l WHERE l.DocID = d.DocID) AS TotalAmount,
           COUNT(*) OVER () AS TotalRows
    FROM dbo.Wrh_Doc AS d
    JOIN dbo.Wrh_DocTypeDef AS t ON t.DtType = d.DocType
    LEFT JOIN dbo.Wrh_Warehouse AS w ON w.WhID = d.DocWhID
    LEFT JOIN dbo.Wrh_Warehouse AS w2 ON w2.WhID = d.DocWh2ID
    LEFT JOIN dbo.Prt_Party AS p ON p.PrtID = d.DocPartyID
    LEFT JOIN dbo.Acc_CostCenter AS cc ON cc.CsCID = d.DocCostCID
    LEFT JOIN dbo.Wrh_Doc AS r ON r.DocID = d.DocRefDocID
    WHERE d.DocCmpID = @Cmp AND (@Type IS NULL OR d.DocType = @Type)
      AND (@FromDate IS NULL OR d.DocDate >= @FromDate) AND (@ToDate IS NULL OR d.DocDate <= @ToDate)
      AND (@Status IS NULL OR d.DocStatus = @Status)
      AND (@Search IS NULL OR d.DocNo LIKE N'%' + @Search + N'%' OR d.DocNotes LIKE N'%' + @Search + N'%' OR p.PrtName LIKE N'%' + @Search + N'%')
    ORDER BY d.DocDate DESC, d.DocID DESC
    OFFSET (@PageNo - 1) * @PageSize ROWS FETCH NEXT @PageSize ROWS ONLY;
END;

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Wrh_SelectGroupWarehouses]
    @Cmp INT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SELECT g.GrpID,
           ISNULL(STUFF((SELECT N',' + CAST(w.GwWhID AS NVARCHAR(20)) FROM dbo.Wrh_GroupWarehouse AS w
                         WHERE w.GwGrpID = g.GrpID ORDER BY w.GwWhID FOR XML PATH(N''), TYPE).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)'), 1, 1, N''), N'') AS WhIDs,
           ISNULL(STUFF((SELECT N'، ' + h.WhName FROM dbo.Wrh_GroupWarehouse AS w JOIN dbo.Wrh_Warehouse AS h ON h.WhID = w.GwWhID
                         WHERE w.GwGrpID = g.GrpID ORDER BY h.WhName FOR XML PATH(N''), TYPE).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)'), 1, 2, N''), N'') AS WhNames
    FROM dbo.Wrh_ItemGroup AS g
    WHERE g.GrpCmpID = @Cmp;
END;

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Wrh_SelectItemGroups]
    @Cmp INT, @ActiveOnly BIT = 0
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SELECT g.GrpID, g.GrpParentID, g.GrpCode, g.GrpName, g.GrpAccID, a.AccName, g.GrpActive,
           CAST(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Wrh_ItemGroup c WHERE c.GrpParentID = g.GrpID) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BIT) AS HasChildren,
           (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.Wrh_Item i WHERE i.ItemGrpID = g.GrpID) AS ItemsCount
    FROM dbo.Wrh_ItemGroup AS g LEFT JOIN dbo.Acc_Account AS a ON a.AccID = g.GrpAccID
    WHERE g.GrpCmpID = @Cmp AND (@ActiveOnly = 0 OR g.GrpActive = 1)
    ORDER BY g.GrpCode;
END;

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Wrh_SelectItems]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

/* الأصناف: @GrpID يشمل أبناء المجموعة */
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Wrh_SelectItems]
    @Cmp INT, @GrpID BIGINT = NULL, @ActiveOnly BIT = 0, @Search NVARCHAR(100) = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET @Search = NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@Search)), N'');
    ;WITH G AS (
        SELECT GrpID FROM dbo.Wrh_ItemGroup WHERE GrpID = @GrpID AND GrpCmpID = @Cmp
        UNION ALL
        SELECT c.GrpID FROM dbo.Wrh_ItemGroup c JOIN G ON c.GrpParentID = G.GrpID
    )
    SELECT i.ItemID, i.ItemCode, i.ItemName, i.ItemGrpID, g.GrpName, i.ItemBaseUnitID, u.UnitName AS BaseUnitName, i.ItemActive
    FROM dbo.Wrh_Item AS i
    JOIN dbo.Wrh_ItemGroup AS g ON g.GrpID = i.ItemGrpID
    JOIN dbo.Wrh_Unit AS u ON u.UnitID = i.ItemBaseUnitID
    WHERE i.ItemCmpID = @Cmp AND (@ActiveOnly = 0 OR i.ItemActive = 1)
      AND (@GrpID IS NULL OR i.ItemGrpID IN (SELECT GrpID FROM G))
      AND (@Search IS NULL OR i.ItemCode LIKE N'%' + @Search + N'%' OR i.ItemName LIKE N'%' + @Search + N'%')
    ORDER BY i.ItemCode
    OPTION (MAXRECURSION 100);
END;

GO

/* وحدات الصنف: الأساس (معامل 1) ثم الثانوية */
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Wrh_SelectItemUnits]
    @Cmp INT, @ItemID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SELECT x.UnitID, x.UnitName, x.Factor, x.IsBase
    FROM (
        SELECT u.UnitID, u.UnitName, CAST(1 AS DECIMAL(18,6)) AS Factor, CAST(1 AS BIT) AS IsBase
        FROM dbo.Wrh_Item i JOIN dbo.Wrh_Unit u ON u.UnitID = i.ItemBaseUnitID
        WHERE i.ItemID = @ItemID AND i.ItemCmpID = @Cmp
        UNION ALL
        SELECT u.UnitID, u.UnitName, iu.Factor, CAST(0 AS BIT)
        FROM dbo.Wrh_ItemUnit iu JOIN dbo.Wrh_Item i ON i.ItemID = iu.ItemID JOIN dbo.Wrh_Unit u ON u.UnitID = iu.UnitID
        WHERE iu.ItemID = @ItemID AND i.ItemCmpID = @Cmp
    ) x
    ORDER BY x.IsBase DESC, x.UnitName;
END;

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Wrh_SelectLeafAccounts]
    @Cmp INT, @Search NVARCHAR(100) = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET @Search = NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@Search)), N'');
    SELECT a.AccID, a.AccCode, a.AccName, CONCAT(a.AccCode, N' - ', a.AccName) AS AccDisplay
    FROM dbo.Acc_Account AS a
    WHERE a.AccCompany = @Cmp
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Acc_Account AS c WHERE c.AccParentID = a.AccID)
      AND ((a.AccEnd = 1 AND a.AccType IN (0, 1, 2)) OR (a.AccEnd = 2 AND a.AccType IN (0, 1)))
      AND (@Search IS NULL OR a.AccCode LIKE N'%' + @Search + N'%' OR a.AccName LIKE N'%' + @Search + N'%')
    ORDER BY a.AccCode;
END;

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Wrh_SelectParties]
    @Cmp INT, @Role TINYINT = NULL, @ActiveOnly BIT = 0, @Search NVARCHAR(100) = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET @Search = NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@Search)), N'');
    SELECT p.PrtID, p.PrtCode, p.PrtName, p.PrtRole, p.PrtAccID, a.AccName, p.PrtActive
    FROM dbo.Prt_Party AS p LEFT JOIN dbo.Acc_Account AS a ON a.AccID = p.PrtAccID
    WHERE p.PrtCmpID = @Cmp AND (@Role IS NULL OR p.PrtRole = @Role) AND (@ActiveOnly = 0 OR p.PrtActive = 1)
      AND (@Search IS NULL OR p.PrtCode LIKE N'%' + @Search + N'%' OR p.PrtName LIKE N'%' + @Search + N'%')
    ORDER BY p.PrtCode;
END;

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Wrh_SelectRefDocs]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Wrh_SelectRefDocs]
    @Cmp INT, @Type TINYINT, @PartyID BIGINT = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    DECLARE @RT TINYINT;
    SELECT @RT = DtRefType FROM dbo.Wrh_DocTypeDef WHERE DtType = @Type;
    IF @RT IS NULL THROW 52301, N'هذا النوع لا يقبل مرجعًا.', 1;

    SELECT d.DocID, d.DocNo, d.DocDate, d.DocPartyID, p.PrtName, d.DocWhID, w.WhName,
           CAST(SUM(l.BaseQty - l.QtyReferred - l.QtyCancelled) AS DECIMAL(18,3)) AS RemainingQty,
           CONCAT(d.DocNo, N' - ', CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), d.DocDate, 23), ISNULL(CONCAT(N' - ', p.PrtName), N'')) AS DocDisplay
    FROM dbo.Wrh_Doc AS d
    JOIN dbo.Wrh_DocLine AS l ON l.DocID = d.DocID
    LEFT JOIN dbo.Prt_Party AS p ON p.PrtID = d.DocPartyID
    LEFT JOIN dbo.Wrh_Warehouse AS w ON w.WhID = d.DocWhID
    WHERE d.DocCmpID = @Cmp AND d.DocType = @RT AND d.DocStatus <> 9
      AND (@PartyID IS NULL OR d.DocPartyID = @PartyID)
    GROUP BY d.DocID, d.DocNo, d.DocDate, d.DocPartyID, p.PrtName, d.DocWhID, w.WhName
    HAVING SUM(l.BaseQty - l.QtyReferred - l.QtyCancelled) > 0
    ORDER BY d.DocDate DESC, d.DocID DESC;
END;

-- سجل مسار الطلب
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Wrh_SelectRequestEvents]
    @Cmp INT, @DocID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SELECT e.EvID, e.EvKind,
           CASE e.EvKind WHEN 1 THEN N'إنشاء مسودة' WHEN 2 THEN N'تعديل' WHEN 4 THEN N'إلغاء المتبقي'
                         WHEN 11 THEN N'إرسال للمخزن' WHEN 12 THEN N'إحالة للمشتريات' WHEN 13 THEN N'إرجاع للجهة الطالبة'
                         WHEN 14 THEN N'إرجاع للمخزن' WHEN 15 THEN N'قبول المخزن' WHEN 16 THEN N'رفض المخزن'
                         WHEN 17 THEN N'إعادة إرسال' ELSE N'حدث' END AS EvName,
           e.EvUser, e.EvAt, e.EvReason
    FROM dbo.Wrh_DocEvent AS e
    WHERE e.EvCmpID = @Cmp AND e.EvDocID = @DocID AND e.EvDocType = 1
    ORDER BY e.EvID;
END;

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[Wrh_SelectRequestHeader]    Script Date: 2026-11-16 5:27:54 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Wrh_SelectRequestHeader]
    @Cmp INT, @DocID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SELECT d.DocID, d.DocNo, d.DocDate, d.DocWhID, w.WhName, d.DocCostCID, c.CsCName, d.DocNotes, d.DocFlow,
           CASE d.DocFlow WHEN 0 THEN N'مسودة' WHEN 1 THEN N'عند المخزن' WHEN 2 THEN N'عند المشتريات'
                          WHEN 3 THEN N'معاد للجهة الطالبة' WHEN 4 THEN N'معاد للمخزن بانتظار القبول' END AS FlowName,
           d.DocStatus, d.DocCreatedBy,
           e.EvReason AS LastReason, e.EvAt AS LastAt
    FROM dbo.Wrh_Doc AS d
    JOIN dbo.Wrh_Warehouse AS w ON w.WhID = d.DocWhID
    LEFT JOIN dbo.Acc_CostCenter AS c ON c.CsCID = d.DocCostCID
    OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 ev.EvReason, ev.EvAt FROM dbo.Wrh_DocEvent AS ev
                 WHERE ev.EvDocID = d.DocID AND ev.EvKind >= 11 ORDER BY ev.EvID DESC) AS e
    WHERE d.DocCmpID = @Cmp AND d.DocID = @DocID AND d.DocType = 1;
END;

-- بنود الطلب مع الكميات
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Wrh_SelectRequestLines]
    @Cmp INT, @DocID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SELECT l.LineID, l.DocLineNo, l.ItemID, i.ItemCode, i.ItemName, l.UnitID, u.UnitName, l.Qty, l.BaseQty,
           l.QtyReferred AS QtyIssued, l.QtyCancelled, l.BaseQty - l.QtyReferred - l.QtyCancelled AS QtyRemaining
    FROM dbo.Wrh_DocLine AS l
    JOIN dbo.Wrh_Doc AS d ON d.DocID = l.DocID AND d.DocCmpID = @Cmp AND d.DocType = 1
    JOIN dbo.Wrh_Item AS i ON i.ItemID = l.ItemID
    JOIN dbo.Wrh_Unit AS u ON u.UnitID = l.UnitID
    WHERE l.DocID = @DocID
    ORDER BY l.DocLineNo;
END;
