   INSERT dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails(CmpID,PayRunID,EmployeeID,ComponentID,LineKind,Description,Quantity,Rate,Amount,SourceType,SourceID)
   SELECT @CmpID,@PayRunID,d.AttDayEmpID,@LateComponentID,2,N'خصم تأخير وفق سياسة الشركة',d.AttDayLateMinutes,@LateAmountPerMinute,ROUND(d.AttDayLateMinutes*@LateAmountPerMinute,ISNULL(@RoundingScale,3)),17,d.AttDayID FROM dbo.Emp_AttendanceDaily d WHERE d.AttDayCmp=@CmpID AND d.AttDayDate BETWEEN @DateFrom AND @DateTo AND d.AttDayState=@EligibleAttendanceState AND d.AttDayLateMinutes>0;
  IF @AttendanceRuleID IS NOT NULL AND @DeductEarlyLeave=1
   INSERT dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails(CmpID,PayRunID,EmployeeID,ComponentID,LineKind,Description,Quantity,Rate,Amount,SourceType,SourceID)
   SELECT @CmpID,@PayRunID,d.AttDayEmpID,@EarlyComponentID,2,N'خصم انصراف مبكر وفق سياسة الشركة',d.AttDayEarlyLeaveMinutes,@EarlyAmountPerMinute,ROUND(d.AttDayEarlyLeaveMinutes*@EarlyAmountPerMinute,ISNULL(@RoundingScale,3)),18,d.AttDayID FROM dbo.Emp_AttendanceDaily d WHERE d.AttDayCmp=@CmpID AND d.AttDayDate BETWEEN @DateFrom AND @DateTo AND d.AttDayState=@EligibleAttendanceState AND d.AttDayEarlyLeaveMinutes>0;
  IF @AttendanceRuleID IS NOT NULL AND @DeductRecordedAbsence=1
   INSERT dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails(CmpID,PayRunID,EmployeeID,ComponentID,LineKind,Description,Quantity,Rate,Amount,SourceType,SourceID)
   SELECT @CmpID,@PayRunID,d.AttDayEmpID,@AbsenceComponentID,2,N'خصم غياب مسجل وفق سياسة الشركة',1,ROUND(s.SalAmount/@DailySalaryDivisor,6),ROUND(s.SalAmount/@DailySalaryDivisor,ISNULL(@RoundingScale,3)),19,d.AttDayID
   FROM dbo.Emp_AttendanceDaily d JOIN dbo.Emp_Salary s ON s.EmpCompany=d.AttDayCmp AND s.EmpID=d.AttDayEmpID AND s.SalStartDate<=d.AttDayDate AND (s.SalEndDate IS NULL OR s.SalEndDate>=d.AttDayDate) AND s.SalCurrencyID=@CurrencyID
   WHERE d.AttDayCmp=@CmpID AND d.AttDayDate BETWEEN @DateFrom AND @DateTo AND d.AttDayState=@EligibleAttendanceState AND d.AttDayWorkMinutes=0 AND d.AttDayFirstIn IS NULL AND d.AttDayLastOut IS NULL
    AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_EmployeeSchedule es JOIN dbo.Emp_WorkCalendar wc ON wc.WCalCmp=es.SchCmp AND wc.WCalID=es.SchWCalID AND wc.WCalState=0 JOIN dbo.Emp_WorkCalendarDetails wd ON wd.WCalDetCmp=wc.WCalCmp AND wd.WCalDetWCalID=wc.WCalID AND wd.WCalDetDate=d.AttDayDate AND wd.WCalDetType=1 WHERE es.SchCmp=@CmpID AND es.SchEmpID=d.AttDayEmpID AND es.SchState=0 AND es.SchStartDate<=d.AttDayDate AND (es.SchEndDate IS NULL OR es.SchEndDate>=d.AttDayDate))
    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_LeaveRequests lr WHERE lr.CmpID=@CmpID AND lr.EmployeeID=d.AttDayEmpID AND lr.RequestState=1 AND lr.StartAt<DATEADD(DAY,1,d.AttDayDate) AND lr.EndAt>d.AttDayDate);
  IF @AttendanceRuleID IS NOT NULL AND @DeductUnpaidLeave=1
  BEGIN
   IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_LeaveRequests r JOIN dbo.Emp_LeaveTypes lt ON lt.LeaveTypeCmp=r.CmpID AND lt.LeaveTypeID=r.LeaveTypeID WHERE r.CmpID=@CmpID AND r.RequestState=1 AND lt.LeaveTypePaid=0 AND r.StartAt<DATEADD(DAY,1,@DateTo) AND r.EndAt>CONVERT(datetime2(0),@DateFrom) AND r.IsHourly=1 AND ISNULL(@StandardMonthlyHours,0)<=0) THROW 54662,N'يلزم ضبط ساعات الشهر القياسية لحساب خصم الإجازة الساعية.',1;
   IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_LeaveRequests r JOIN dbo.Emp_LeaveTypes lt ON lt.LeaveTypeCmp=r.CmpID AND lt.LeaveTypeID=r.LeaveTypeID WHERE r.CmpID=@CmpID AND r.RequestState=1 AND lt.LeaveTypePaid=0 AND r.StartAt<DATEADD(DAY,1,@DateTo) AND r.EndAt>CONVERT(datetime2(0),@DateFrom) AND r.IsHourly=0 AND @DailySalaryDivisor IS NULL) THROW 54663,N'يلزم ضبط مقسوم الراتب اليومي لحساب خصم الإجازة غير المدفوعة.',1;
   IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_LeaveRequests r JOIN dbo.Emp_LeaveTypes lt ON lt.LeaveTypeCmp=r.CmpID AND lt.LeaveTypeID=r.LeaveTypeID WHERE r.CmpID=@CmpID AND r.RequestState=1 AND lt.LeaveTypePaid=0 AND r.IsHourly=0 AND r.StartAt<DATEADD(DAY,1,@DateTo) AND r.EndAt>CONVERT(datetime2(0),@DateFrom) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_EmployeeSchedule es JOIN dbo.Emp_WorkCalendar wc ON wc.WCalCmp=es.SchCmp AND wc.WCalID=es.SchWCalID AND wc.WCalState=0 JOIN dbo.Emp_WorkCalendarDetails wd ON wd.WCalDetCmp=wc.WCalCmp AND wd.WCalDetWCalID=wc.WCalID AND wd.WCalDetType=1 AND wd.WCalDetDate BETWEEN CONVERT(date,r.StartAt) AND CONVERT(date,DATEADD(SECOND,-1,r.EndAt)) WHERE es.SchCmp=r.CmpID AND es.SchEmpID=r.EmployeeID AND es.SchState=0 AND es.SchStartDate<=CONVERT(date,DATEADD(SECOND,-1,r.EndAt)) AND (es.SchEndDate IS NULL OR es.SchEndDate>=CONVERT(date,r.StartAt)))) THROW 54665,N'لا يمكن توزيع خصم الإجازة اليومية دون تقويم عمل يحتوي أيام الدوام.',1;
   ;WITH U AS
   (
    SELECT r.RequestID,r.EmployeeID,r.Quantity,r.IsHourly,r.StartAt,r.EndAt,
     CASE WHEN r.StartAt<CONVERT(datetime2(0),@DateFrom) THEN CONVERT(datetime2(0),@DateFrom) ELSE r.StartAt END AS ClipStart,
     CASE WHEN r.EndAt>=DATEADD(DAY,1,@DateTo) THEN CONVERT(datetime2(0),DATEADD(DAY,1,@DateTo)) ELSE r.EndAt END AS ClipEnd
    FROM dbo.Emp_LeaveRequests r JOIN dbo.Emp_LeaveTypes lt ON lt.LeaveTypeCmp=r.CmpID AND lt.LeaveTypeID=r.LeaveTypeID
    WHERE r.CmpID=@CmpID AND r.RequestState=1 AND lt.LeaveTypePaid=0 AND r.StartAt<DATEADD(DAY,1,@DateTo) AND r.EndAt>CONVERT(datetime2(0),@DateFrom)
   ), W AS
   (
    SELECT U.RequestID,COUNT(DISTINCT wd.WCalDetDate) AS TotalDays,COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN wd.WCalDetDate BETWEEN @DateFrom AND @DateTo THEN wd.WCalDetDate END) AS PeriodDays
    FROM U JOIN dbo.Emp_EmployeeSchedule es ON es.SchCmp=@CmpID AND es.SchEmpID=U.EmployeeID AND es.SchState=0 AND es.SchStartDate<=CONVERT(date,DATEADD(SECOND,-1,U.EndAt)) AND (es.SchEndDate IS NULL OR es.SchEndDate>=CONVERT(date,U.StartAt))
    JOIN dbo.Emp_WorkCalendar wc ON wc.WCalCmp=es.SchCmp AND wc.WCalID=es.SchWCalID AND wc.WCalState=0
    JOIN dbo.Emp_WorkCalendarDetails wd ON wd.WCalDetCmp=wc.WCalCmp AND wd.WCalDetWCalID=wc.WCalID AND wd.WCalDetType=1 AND wd.WCalDetDate BETWEEN CONVERT(date,U.StartAt) AND CONVERT(date,DATEADD(SECOND,-1,U.EndAt)) AND wd.WCalDetDate BETWEEN es.SchStartDate AND ISNULL(es.SchEndDate,CONVERT(date,'99991231'))
    WHERE U.IsHourly=0 GROUP BY U.RequestID
   )
   INSERT dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails(CmpID,PayRunID,EmployeeID,ComponentID,LineKind,Description,Quantity,Rate,Amount,SourceType,SourceID)
   SELECT @CmpID,@PayRunID,U.EmployeeID,@UnpaidLeaveComponentID,2,N'خصم إجازة يومية غير مدفوعة وفق سياسة الشركة',U.Quantity,ROUND(S.SalAmount/@DailySalaryDivisor,6),ROUND(U.Quantity*CONVERT(decimal(19,6),W.PeriodDays)/NULLIF(W.TotalDays,0)*S.SalAmount/@DailySalaryDivisor,ISNULL(@RoundingScale,3)),16,U.RequestID
   FROM U JOIN W ON W.RequestID=U.RequestID AND W.TotalDays>0 AND W.PeriodDays>0
   JOIN dbo.Emp_Salary S ON S.EmpCompany=@CmpID AND S.EmpID=U.EmployeeID AND S.SalStartDate<=@DateTo AND (S.SalEndDate IS NULL OR S.SalEndDate>=@DateFrom) AND S.SalCurrencyID=@CurrencyID WHERE U.IsHourly=0
   UNION ALL
   SELECT @CmpID,@PayRunID,U.EmployeeID,@UnpaidLeaveComponentID,2,N'خصم إجازة ساعية غير مدفوعة وفق سياسة الشركة',U.Quantity,ROUND(S.SalAmount/@StandardMonthlyHours,6),ROUND(U.Quantity*CONVERT(decimal(19,6),DATEDIFF(MINUTE,U.ClipStart,U.ClipEnd))/NULLIF(DATEDIFF(MINUTE,U.StartAt,U.EndAt),0)*S.SalAmount/@StandardMonthlyHours,ISNULL(@RoundingScale,3)),16,U.RequestID
   FROM U JOIN dbo.Emp_Salary S ON S.EmpCompany=@CmpID AND S.EmpID=U.EmployeeID AND S.SalStartDate<=@DateTo AND (S.SalEndDate IS NULL OR S.SalEndDate>=@DateFrom) AND S.SalCurrencyID=@CurrencyID WHERE U.IsHourly=1 AND DATEDIFF(MINUTE,U.ClipStart,U.ClipEnd)>0 AND DATEDIFF(MINUTE,U.StartAt,U.EndAt)>0;
  END;
  /* Apply company-configured tax and insurance rules using progressive bands. */
  DECLARE @RuleID BIGINT,@RuleType TINYINT,@BaseType TINYINT,@WithholdComponent BIGINT,@BaseCap DECIMAL(19,3),@BandCount INT,@BadBands INT,@WithholdSource TINYINT;
  DECLARE WithholdingRules CURSOR LOCAL FAST_FORWARD FOR
   SELECT RuleID,RuleType,BaseType,ComponentID,BaseCap FROM dbo.Emp_PayrollWithholdingRules
   WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND RecordState=0 AND EffectiveFrom<=@DateTo AND (EffectiveTo IS NULL OR EffectiveTo>=@DateFrom) ORDER BY RuleType,RuleID;
  OPEN WithholdingRules;
  FETCH NEXT FROM WithholdingRules INTO @RuleID,@RuleType,@BaseType,@WithholdComponent,@BaseCap;
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS=0
  BEGIN
   SELECT @BandCount=COUNT(*) FROM dbo.Emp_PayrollWithholdingBands WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND RuleID=@RuleID;
   SELECT @BadBands=COUNT(*) FROM dbo.Emp_PayrollWithholdingBands b WHERE b.CmpID=@CmpID AND b.RuleID=@RuleID AND ((b.BandFrom<>0 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_PayrollWithholdingBands prev WHERE prev.CmpID=b.CmpID AND prev.RuleID=b.RuleID AND prev.BandTo=b.BandFrom)) OR (b.BandTo IS NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_PayrollWithholdingBands nxt WHERE nxt.CmpID=b.CmpID AND nxt.RuleID=b.RuleID AND nxt.BandFrom>b.BandFrom)));
   IF ISNULL(@BandCount,0)=0 OR ISNULL(@BadBands,0)>0 OR (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.Emp_PayrollWithholdingBands WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND RuleID=@RuleID AND BandTo IS NULL)<>1
    THROW 54298,N'شرائح قاعدة الاستقطاع ناقصة أو غير متصلة؛ لم يُحتسب المسير.',1;
   SET @WithholdSource=CASE WHEN @RuleType=1 THEN 14 ELSE 15 END;
   ;WITH EmployeeBase AS
   (
    SELECT d.EmployeeID,CONVERT(decimal(19,3),SUM(d.Amount)) AS BaseAmount
    FROM dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails d LEFT JOIN dbo.Emp_PayComponents c ON c.CmpID=d.CmpID AND c.ComponentID=d.ComponentID
    WHERE d.CmpID=@CmpID AND d.PayRunID=@PayRunID AND d.LineKind=1
      AND ((d.ComponentID IS NULL AND CASE WHEN @BaseType=1 THEN @BaseSalaryTaxable ELSE @BaseSalaryInsurable END=1)
        OR (d.ComponentID IS NOT NULL AND CASE WHEN @BaseType=1 THEN c.IsTaxable ELSE c.IsInsurable END=1))
    GROUP BY d.EmployeeID
   ), AmountDue AS
   (
    SELECT eb.EmployeeID,CONVERT(decimal(19,3),ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN x.CalculationBase>b.BandFrom THEN (CASE WHEN b.BandTo IS NULL OR x.CalculationBase<b.BandTo THEN x.CalculationBase ELSE b.BandTo END)-b.BandFrom ELSE 0 END)*b.RatePercent/100.0,ISNULL(@RoundingScale,3))) Amount
    FROM EmployeeBase eb CROSS JOIN dbo.Emp_PayrollWithholdingBands b
    CROSS APPLY(SELECT CASE WHEN @BaseCap IS NOT NULL AND eb.BaseAmount>@BaseCap THEN @BaseCap ELSE eb.BaseAmount END AS CalculationBase) x
    WHERE b.CmpID=@CmpID AND b.RuleID=@RuleID AND eb.BaseAmount>0
    GROUP BY eb.EmployeeID
   )
   INSERT dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails(CmpID,PayRunID,EmployeeID,ComponentID,LineKind,Description,Quantity,Rate,Amount,SourceType,SourceID)
   SELECT @CmpID,@PayRunID,a.EmployeeID,@WithholdComponent,2,CASE WHEN @RuleType=1 THEN N'استقطاع ضريبي حسب سياسة الشركة' ELSE N'استقطاع تأميني حسب سياسة الشركة' END,1,NULL,a.Amount,@WithholdSource,@RuleID
   FROM AmountDue a WHERE a.Amount>0;
   FETCH NEXT FROM WithholdingRules INTO @RuleID,@RuleType,@BaseType,@WithholdComponent,@BaseCap;
  END;
  CLOSE WithholdingRules; DEALLOCATE WithholdingRules;

  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_PayrollDeductionArrears a JOIN dbo.Emp_PayComponents c ON c.CmpID=a.CmpID AND c.ComponentID=a.ComponentID
   WHERE a.CmpID=@CmpID AND a.ArrearState=0 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails p WHERE p.CmpID=a.CmpID AND p.PayRunID=@PayRunID AND p.EmployeeID=a.EmployeeID AND p.LineKind=1) AND (a.CurrencyID<>@CurrencyID OR c.RecordState<>0 OR c.ComponentKind<>2))
   THROW 54912,N'يوجد استقطاع مؤجل بعملة أو مكون غير صالح للمسير؛ راجع إعدادات الشركة.',1;
  INSERT dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails(CmpID,PayRunID,EmployeeID,ComponentID,LineKind,Description,Quantity,Rate,Amount,SourceType,SourceID)
  SELECT @CmpID,@PayRunID,a.EmployeeID,a.ComponentID,2,N'تحصيل رصيد استقطاع مؤجل من فترة سابقة',1,a.OutstandingAmount,a.OutstandingAmount,22,a.ArrearID
  FROM dbo.Emp_PayrollDeductionArrears a JOIN dbo.Emp_Employee e ON e.EmpCompany=a.CmpID AND e.EmpID=a.EmployeeID AND e.EmpState=0
  WHERE a.CmpID=@CmpID AND a.ArrearState=0 AND a.OutstandingAmount>0 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails p WHERE p.CmpID=a.CmpID AND p.PayRunID=@PayRunID AND p.EmployeeID=a.EmployeeID AND p.LineKind=1);

  ;WITH ExternalBase AS
  (
   SELECT EmployeeID,SUM(CASE WHEN LineKind=1 THEN Amount ELSE 0 END) AS GrossAmount,SUM(CASE WHEN LineKind=1 THEN Amount ELSE -Amount END) AS NetAmount
   FROM dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND PayRunID=@PayRunID GROUP BY EmployeeID
  )
  INSERT dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails(CmpID,PayRunID,EmployeeID,ComponentID,LineKind,Description,Quantity,Rate,Amount,SourceType,SourceID)
  SELECT @CmpID,@PayRunID,x.EmployeeID,x.ComponentID,2,LEFT(CONCAT(N'استقطاع لصالح ',p.PayeeName,N' - ',x.Description),250),1,
   CASE WHEN x.DeductionMethod=1 THEN x.MonthlyAmount ELSE x.PercentageRate END,
   CASE WHEN x.TotalAmount IS NOT NULL AND x.TotalAmount-x.AssessedTotal<q.PlannedAmount THEN x.TotalAmount-x.AssessedTotal ELSE q.PlannedAmount END,21,x.DeductionID
  FROM dbo.Emp_EmployeeExternalDeductions x
  JOIN dbo.Emp_ExternalDeductionPayees p ON p.CmpID=x.CmpID AND p.PayeeID=x.PayeeID AND p.RecordState=0
  JOIN dbo.Emp_PayComponents c ON c.CmpID=x.CmpID AND c.ComponentID=x.ComponentID AND c.ComponentKind=2 AND c.RecordState=0
  JOIN dbo.Emp_Employee e ON e.EmpCompany=x.CmpID AND e.EmpID=x.EmployeeID AND e.EmpState=0
  JOIN ExternalBase b ON b.EmployeeID=x.EmployeeID
  CROSS APPLY(SELECT CASE WHEN x.DeductionMethod=1 THEN x.MonthlyAmount WHEN ROUND(CONVERT(decimal(19,6),CASE WHEN x.CalculationBase=1 THEN b.GrossAmount ELSE b.NetAmount END)*x.PercentageRate/100.0,ISNULL(@RoundingScale,3))>x.MonthlyAmount THEN x.MonthlyAmount ELSE ROUND(CONVERT(decimal(19,6),CASE WHEN x.CalculationBase=1 THEN b.GrossAmount ELSE b.NetAmount END)*x.PercentageRate/100.0,ISNULL(@RoundingScale,3)) END AS PlannedAmount) q
  WHERE x.CmpID=@CmpID AND x.DeductionState=1 AND x.NextDueDate<=@DateTo AND (x.EffectiveTo IS NULL OR x.EffectiveTo>=x.NextDueDate)
   AND (x.TotalAmount IS NULL OR x.AssessedTotal<x.TotalAmount) AND x.CurrencyID=@CurrencyID AND q.PlannedAmount>0;

  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails d LEFT JOIN dbo.Emp_PayrollDeductionArrears a ON a.CmpID=d.CmpID AND a.ArrearID=d.SourceID AND a.ArrearState=0
    WHERE d.CmpID=@CmpID AND d.PayRunID=@PayRunID AND d.LineKind=2 AND (d.ComponentID IS NULL OR (d.SourceType=22 AND a.ArrearID IS NULL)))
   THROW 54913,N'يوجد استقطاع بلا مكون أو رصيد مؤجل صالح؛ لم يُعتمد احتساب المسير.',1;
  UPDATE dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails SET CollectedAmount=Amount,DeferredAmount=0 WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND PayRunID=@PayRunID AND LineKind=1;
  ;WITH Gross AS
  (
   SELECT EmployeeID,SUM(Amount) AS GrossAmount FROM dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND PayRunID=@PayRunID AND LineKind=1 GROUP BY EmployeeID
  ), Ranked AS
  (
   SELECT d.CmpID,d.PayRunID,d.PayrollDetailID,d.EmployeeID,d.ComponentID,d.SourceType,d.SourceID,d.Amount,
    COALESCE(a.DeductionPriority,c.DeductionPriority) AS DeductionPriority,
    COALESCE(a.IsMandatoryDeduction,c.IsMandatoryDeduction) AS IsMandatoryDeduction,
    COALESCE(a.CanDefer,c.CanDefer) AS CanDefer,a.ArrearID,ISNULL(g.GrossAmount,0) AS GrossAmount,
    SUM(d.Amount) OVER(PARTITION BY d.EmployeeID ORDER BY COALESCE(a.IsMandatoryDeduction,c.IsMandatoryDeduction) DESC,COALESCE(a.DeductionPriority,c.DeductionPriority),ISNULL(d.SourceType,0),ISNULL(d.SourceID,0),d.PayrollDetailID ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS CumulativeDemand
   FROM dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails d
   JOIN dbo.Emp_PayComponents c ON c.CmpID=d.CmpID AND c.ComponentID=d.ComponentID
   LEFT JOIN dbo.Emp_PayrollDeductionArrears a ON d.SourceType=22 AND a.CmpID=d.CmpID AND a.ArrearID=d.SourceID AND a.ArrearState=0
   LEFT JOIN Gross g ON g.EmployeeID=d.EmployeeID
   WHERE d.CmpID=@CmpID AND d.PayRunID=@PayRunID AND d.LineKind=2
  ), Allocation AS
  (
   SELECT *,CASE WHEN GrossAmount-(CumulativeDemand-Amount)>=Amount THEN Amount WHEN GrossAmount-(CumulativeDemand-Amount)>0 THEN GrossAmount-(CumulativeDemand-Amount) ELSE 0 END AS CurrentCollection
   FROM Ranked
  )
  INSERT dbo.Emp_PayrollDeductionAllocations(CmpID,PayRunID,CalculationVersion,PayrollDetailID,EmployeeID,ComponentID,SourceType,SourceID,ArrearID,RequestedAmount,CollectedAmount,DeferredAmount,DeductionPriority,IsMandatoryDeduction,CanDefer)
  SELECT CmpID,PayRunID,@CalculationVersion,PayrollDetailID,EmployeeID,ComponentID,SourceType,SourceID,ArrearID,Amount,CurrentCollection,Amount-CurrentCollection,DeductionPriority,IsMandatoryDeduction,CanDefer FROM Allocation;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_PayrollDeductionAllocations WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND PayRunID=@PayRunID AND CalculationVersion=@CalculationVersion AND CanDefer=0 AND DeferredAmount>0)
   THROW 54914,N'سياسة الشركة تمنع تأجيل استقطاع يتجاوز صافي المتاح؛ صحح السياسات أو المستحقات قبل الاعتماد.',1;
  UPDATE d SET CollectedAmount=a.CollectedAmount,DeferredAmount=a.DeferredAmount
   FROM dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails d JOIN dbo.Emp_PayrollDeductionAllocations a ON a.CmpID=d.CmpID AND a.PayRunID=d.PayRunID AND a.CalculationVersion=@CalculationVersion AND a.PayrollDetailID=d.PayrollDetailID
   WHERE d.CmpID=@CmpID AND d.PayRunID=@PayRunID AND d.LineKind=2;
  IF @PayPolicyID IS NULL THROW 54944,N'سياسة العجز للشركة غير محددة للفترة.',1;
  IF @MaxDeferredPerEmployee IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT d.EmployeeID FROM dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails d WHERE d.CmpID=@CmpID AND d.PayRunID=@PayRunID AND d.LineKind=2 GROUP BY d.EmployeeID HAVING SUM(ISNULL(d.DeferredAmount,0))>@MaxDeferredPerEmployee)
   THROW 54945,N'تجاوز الرصيد المؤجل حد الشركة للموظف؛ لا يمكن اعتماد المسير.',1;
  IF @MaxDeferredPerRun IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(ISNULL(DeferredAmount,0)),0) FROM dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND PayRunID=@PayRunID AND LineKind=2)>@MaxDeferredPerRun
   THROW 54946,N'تجاوز الرصيد المؤجل حد الشركة للمسير؛ لا يمكن اعتماد المسير.',1;
  DECLARE @Gross DECIMAL(19,3),@Ded DECIMAL(19,3),@Requested DECIMAL(19,3),@Deferred DECIMAL(19,3),@Net DECIMAL(19,3),@NetDeficitTotal DECIMAL(19,3);
  ;WITH EmployeeTotals AS
  (
   SELECT EmployeeID,SUM(CASE WHEN LineKind=1 THEN Amount ELSE 0 END) GrossEntitlement,
    SUM(CASE WHEN LineKind=2 THEN Amount ELSE 0 END) RequestedDeductionTotal,
    SUM(CASE WHEN LineKind=2 THEN ISNULL(CollectedAmount,0) ELSE 0 END) CollectedDeductionTotal,
    SUM(CASE WHEN LineKind=2 THEN ISNULL(DeferredAmount,0) ELSE 0 END) DeferredDeductionTotal
   FROM dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND PayRunID=@PayRunID GROUP BY EmployeeID
  )
  INSERT dbo.Emp_PayrollDeficitSnapshots(CmpID,PayRunID,CalculationVersion,EmployeeID,PayPolicyID,CurrencyID,GrossEntitlement,RequestedDeductionTotal,CollectedDeductionTotal,DeferredDeductionTotal,NetBeforeAllocation,NetDeficit,NetPayable,MaxDeferredPerEmployee,MaxDeferredPerRun,ZeroNetApprovalMode,DeferralApprovalRequired,PolicyApplied)
  SELECT @CmpID,@PayRunID,@CalculationVersion,EmployeeID,@PayPolicyID,@CurrencyID,GrossEntitlement,RequestedDeductionTotal,CollectedDeductionTotal,DeferredDeductionTotal,GrossEntitlement-RequestedDeductionTotal,CASE WHEN GrossEntitlement<RequestedDeductionTotal THEN RequestedDeductionTotal-GrossEntitlement ELSE 0 END,CASE WHEN GrossEntitlement>CollectedDeductionTotal THEN GrossEntitlement-CollectedDeductionTotal ELSE 0 END,@MaxDeferredPerEmployee,@MaxDeferredPerRun,@ZeroNetApprovalMode,@DeferralApprovalRequired,1
  FROM EmployeeTotals;
  SELECT @Gross=ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN LineKind=1 THEN Amount ELSE 0 END),0),@Ded=ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN LineKind=2 THEN ISNULL(CollectedAmount,0) ELSE 0 END),0),@Requested=ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN LineKind=2 THEN Amount ELSE 0 END),0),@Deferred=ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN LineKind=2 THEN ISNULL(DeferredAmount,0) ELSE 0 END),0)
  FROM dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND PayRunID=@PayRunID;
  SELECT @NetDeficitTotal=ISNULL(SUM(NetDeficit),0) FROM dbo.Emp_PayrollDeficitSnapshots WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND PayRunID=@PayRunID AND CalculationVersion=@CalculationVersion;
  SET @Net=CASE WHEN @Gross>@Ded THEN @Gross-@Ded ELSE 0 END;
  UPDATE dbo.Emp_PayRuns SET GrossTotal=@Gross,DeductionTotal=@Ded,RequestedDeductionTotal=@Requested,DeferredDeductionTotal=@Deferred,NetDeficitTotal=@NetDeficitTotal,NetTotal=@Net WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND PayRunID=@PayRunID AND RunState=1;
  COMMIT TRANSACTION;
  SELECT @PayRunID AS PayRunID,@Gross AS GrossTotal,@Ded AS DeductionTotal,@Net AS NetTotal;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH
  IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
  THROW;
 END CATCH;
END;
GO
/* Company-configured, effective-dated final-settlement rules; no statutory constants are embedded. */
CREATE TABLE dbo.Emp_FinalSettlementPolicies
(
 PolicyID BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT PK_Emp_FinalSettlementPolicies PRIMARY KEY,
 CmpID INT NOT NULL,
 EffectiveFrom DATE NOT NULL,
 EffectiveTo DATE NULL,
 SalaryBasis TINYINT NOT NULL,
 DailySalaryDivisor DECIMAL(12,6) NOT NULL,
 LeaveDayDivisor DECIMAL(12,6) NOT NULL,
 ServiceYearBasisDays DECIMAL(12,6) NOT NULL,
 EntitlementDaysPerServiceYear DECIMAL(12,6) NOT NULL,
 MaxServiceYears DECIMAL(9,4) NULL,
 RecordState TINYINT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Emp_FinalSettlementPolicies_State DEFAULT(0),
 CreatedAt DATETIME2(0) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Emp_FinalSettlementPolicies_Created DEFAULT(SYSDATETIME()),
 CreatedBy BIGINT NOT NULL,
 CONSTRAINT UQ_Emp_FinalSettlementPolicies_Cmp_ID UNIQUE(CmpID,PolicyID),
 CONSTRAINT CK_Emp_FinalSettlementPolicies_Values CHECK(SalaryBasis IN(1,2) AND DailySalaryDivisor>0 AND LeaveDayDivisor>0 AND ServiceYearBasisDays>0 AND EntitlementDaysPerServiceYear>=0 AND (MaxServiceYears IS NULL OR MaxServiceYears>0) AND (EffectiveTo IS NULL OR EffectiveTo>=EffectiveFrom)),
 CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_FinalSettlementPolicies_Company FOREIGN KEY(CmpID) REFERENCES dbo.Mng_Company(CmpID),
 CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_FinalSettlementPolicies_User FOREIGN KEY(CreatedBy) REFERENCES dbo.Mng_User(UsrID)
);
CREATE INDEX IX_Emp_FinalSettlementPolicies_Effective ON dbo.Emp_FinalSettlementPolicies(CmpID,RecordState,EffectiveFrom,EffectiveTo);
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_SaveFinalSettlementPolicy
 @CmpID INT,@PolicyID BIGINT=0,@EffectiveFrom DATE,@EffectiveTo DATE=NULL,@SalaryBasis TINYINT,
 @DailySalaryDivisor DECIMAL(12,6),@LeaveDayDivisor DECIMAL(12,6),@ServiceYearBasisDays DECIMAL(12,6),
 @EntitlementDaysPerServiceYear DECIMAL(12,6),@MaxServiceYears DECIMAL(9,4)=NULL,@RecordState TINYINT=0,@UserID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 IF @EffectiveFrom IS NULL OR (@EffectiveTo IS NOT NULL AND @EffectiveTo<@EffectiveFrom) OR @SalaryBasis NOT IN(1,2) OR @DailySalaryDivisor<=0 OR @LeaveDayDivisor<=0 OR @ServiceYearBasisDays<=0 OR @EntitlementDaysPerServiceYear<0 OR @MaxServiceYears<=0 OR @RecordState NOT IN(0,1)
  THROW 54220,N'قيم سياسة التسوية غير صحيحة.',1;
 BEGIN TRY
  BEGIN TRANSACTION;
  IF @RecordState=0 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_FinalSettlementPolicies WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND RecordState=0 AND PolicyID<>ISNULL(@PolicyID,0) AND EffectiveFrom<=ISNULL(@EffectiveTo,CONVERT(date,'99991231')) AND ISNULL(EffectiveTo,CONVERT(date,'99991231'))>=@EffectiveFrom)
   THROW 54221,N'تتداخل سياسة التسوية مع سياسة فعالة أخرى.',1;
  IF ISNULL(@PolicyID,0)=0
  BEGIN
   INSERT dbo.Emp_FinalSettlementPolicies(CmpID,EffectiveFrom,EffectiveTo,SalaryBasis,DailySalaryDivisor,LeaveDayDivisor,ServiceYearBasisDays,EntitlementDaysPerServiceYear,MaxServiceYears,RecordState,CreatedBy)
   VALUES(@CmpID,@EffectiveFrom,@EffectiveTo,@SalaryBasis,@DailySalaryDivisor,@LeaveDayDivisor,@ServiceYearBasisDays,@EntitlementDaysPerServiceYear,@MaxServiceYears,@RecordState,@UserID);
   SET @PolicyID=SCOPE_IDENTITY();
  END
  ELSE
  BEGIN
   UPDATE dbo.Emp_FinalSettlementPolicies SET EffectiveFrom=@EffectiveFrom,EffectiveTo=@EffectiveTo,SalaryBasis=@SalaryBasis,DailySalaryDivisor=@DailySalaryDivisor,LeaveDayDivisor=@LeaveDayDivisor,ServiceYearBasisDays=@ServiceYearBasisDays,EntitlementDaysPerServiceYear=@EntitlementDaysPerServiceYear,MaxServiceYears=@MaxServiceYears,RecordState=@RecordState
   WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND PolicyID=@PolicyID;
   IF @@ROWCOUNT=0 THROW 54222,N'سياسة التسوية غير موجودة في الشركة.',1;
  END;
  COMMIT TRANSACTION;
  SELECT @PolicyID AS PolicyID;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH
  IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
  THROW;
 END CATCH;
END;
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_DecideTermination
 @CmpID INT,@TerminationID BIGINT,@ApproverID BIGINT,@Decision TINYINT,@StepNo SMALLINT=1,@Comments NVARCHAR(1000)=NULL
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@ApproverID;
 IF @Decision NOT IN(1,2) THROW 54223,N'قرار إنهاء الخدمة غير صحيح.',1;
 BEGIN TRY
  BEGIN TRANSACTION;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_ApprovalRequests WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND ProcessType=5 AND EntityID=@TerminationID)
  BEGIN
   DECLARE @ApprovalResult TINYINT,@NextApproval SMALLINT;
   EXEC dbo.Emp_DecideApprovalStep @CmpID,5,@TerminationID,@StepNo,@ApproverID,@Decision,@Comments,@ApprovalResult OUTPUT,@NextApproval OUTPUT,1;
   IF @Decision=1 AND @ApprovalResult=0
   BEGIN
    COMMIT TRANSACTION;
    SELECT TerminationID,TerminationState FROM dbo.Emp_Terminations WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND TerminationID=@TerminationID;
    RETURN;
   END;
  END;  UPDATE dbo.Emp_Terminations WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK)
   SET TerminationState=@Decision,ApprovedAt=SYSDATETIME(),ApprovedBy=@ApproverID
  WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND TerminationID=@TerminationID AND TerminationState=0 AND CreatedBy<>@ApproverID;
  IF @@ROWCOUNT<>1 THROW 54224,N'طلب الإنهاء غير موجود أو غير قابل للقرار.',1;
  COMMIT TRANSACTION;
  SELECT TerminationID,TerminationState FROM dbo.Emp_Terminations WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND TerminationID=@TerminationID;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH
  IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
  THROW;
 END CATCH;
END;
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_Proc_CalculateFinalSettlement
 @CmpID INT,@User BIGINT,@TerminationID BIGINT,@CurrencyID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@User;
 DECLARE @EmployeeID BIGINT,@LastDate DATE,@HireDate DATE,@PolicyID BIGINT,@SalaryBasis TINYINT,@DailyDivisor DECIMAL(12,6),@LeaveDivisor DECIMAL(12,6),@YearBasis DECIMAL(12,6),@DaysPerYear DECIMAL(12,6),@MaxYears DECIMAL(9,4),@BaseSalary DECIMAL(19,6),@Salary DECIMAL(19,6),@LeaveDays DECIMAL(19,6),@Loans DECIMAL(19,6),@Gross DECIMAL(19,3),@Ded DECIMAL(19,3),@State TINYINT;
 BEGIN TRY
  BEGIN TRANSACTION;
  SELECT @EmployeeID=t.EmployeeID,@LastDate=t.LastWorkingDate,@State=t.TerminationState,@HireDate=e.HireDate
  FROM dbo.Emp_Terminations t WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK)
  JOIN dbo.Emp_Employee e ON e.EmpCompany=t.CmpID AND e.EmpID=t.EmployeeID
  WHERE t.CmpID=@CmpID AND t.TerminationID=@TerminationID;
  IF @EmployeeID IS NULL OR @State<>1 THROW 54225,N'يجب اعتماد طلب الإنهاء قبل احتساب التسوية.',1;
  IF @HireDate IS NULL OR @HireDate>@LastDate THROW 54226,N'تاريخ مباشرة الخدمة غير مضبوط أو يتجاوز آخر يوم عمل.',1;
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Acc_Currency WHERE CurCmp=@CmpID AND CurID=@CurrencyID AND CurState=0) THROW 54227,N'عملة التسوية غير نشطة أو لا تتبع للشركة.',1;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_ClearanceItems WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND TerminationID=@TerminationID AND ItemState<>1) THROW 54228,N'أكمل جميع بنود إخلاء الطرف قبل الحساب.',1;
  SELECT @PolicyID=PolicyID,@SalaryBasis=SalaryBasis,@DailyDivisor=DailySalaryDivisor,@LeaveDivisor=LeaveDayDivisor,@YearBasis=ServiceYearBasisDays,@DaysPerYear=EntitlementDaysPerServiceYear,@MaxYears=MaxServiceYears
  FROM dbo.Emp_FinalSettlementPolicies WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND RecordState=0 AND EffectiveFrom<=@LastDate AND (EffectiveTo IS NULL OR EffectiveTo>=@LastDate);
  IF @PolicyID IS NULL THROW 54229,N'لا توجد سياسة تسوية فعالة للشركة في تاريخ الإنهاء.',1;
  IF (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.Emp_FinalSettlementPolicies WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND RecordState=0 AND EffectiveFrom<=@LastDate AND (EffectiveTo IS NULL OR EffectiveTo>=@LastDate))<>1 THROW 54230,N'توجد أكثر من سياسة تسوية فعالة في تاريخ الإنهاء.',1;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_Salary WHERE EmpCompany=@CmpID AND EmpID=@EmployeeID AND SalStartDate<=@LastDate AND (SalEndDate IS NULL OR SalEndDate>=@LastDate) GROUP BY EmpID HAVING COUNT(*)<>1) THROW 54231,N'يلزم وجود راتب أساسي واحد سارٍ في تاريخ الإنهاء.',1;
  SELECT @BaseSalary=SalAmount FROM dbo.Emp_Salary WHERE EmpCompany=@CmpID AND EmpID=@EmployeeID AND SalStartDate<=@LastDate AND (SalEndDate IS NULL OR SalEndDate>=@LastDate) AND SalCurrencyID=@CurrencyID;
  IF @BaseSalary IS NULL THROW 54232,N'عملة الراتب الأساسي لا تطابق عملة التسوية.',1;
  SET @Salary=@BaseSalary;
  IF @SalaryBasis=2
   SELECT @Salary=@BaseSalary+ISNULL(SUM(CASE pc.CalculationMethod WHEN 1 THEN ep.Amount WHEN 2 THEN @BaseSalary*ep.Amount/100.0 END),0)
   FROM dbo.Emp_EmployeePayComponents ep JOIN dbo.Emp_PayComponents pc ON pc.CmpID=ep.CmpID AND pc.ComponentID=ep.ComponentID
   WHERE ep.CmpID=@CmpID AND ep.EmployeeID=@EmployeeID AND ep.RecordState=0 AND pc.RecordState=0 AND pc.ComponentKind=1 AND ep.StartDate<=@LastDate AND (ep.EndDate IS NULL OR ep.EndDate>=@LastDate);
  SELECT @LeaveDays=ISNULL(SUM(b.ClosingBalance),0)
  FROM dbo.Emp_LeaveBalances b JOIN dbo.Emp_LeaveTypes t ON t.LeaveTypeCmp=b.CmpID AND t.LeaveTypeID=b.LeaveTypeID
  WHERE b.CmpID=@CmpID AND b.EmployeeID=@EmployeeID AND b.BalanceYear=YEAR(@LastDate) AND b.RecordState=0 AND t.LeaveTypePaid=1 AND t.LeaveTypeBalanceUnit=1 AND t.LeaveTypeState=0;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_Loans l JOIN dbo.Emp_LoanInstallments i ON i.CmpID=l.CmpID AND i.LoanID=l.LoanID WHERE l.CmpID=@CmpID AND l.EmployeeID=@EmployeeID AND l.LoanState=1 AND l.CurrencyID<>@CurrencyID AND i.PaidAmount<i.Amount) THROW 54233,N'عملة أحد الديون تختلف عن عملة التسوية.',1;
  SELECT @Loans=ISNULL(SUM(i.Amount-i.PaidAmount),0)
  FROM dbo.Emp_Loans l JOIN dbo.Emp_LoanInstallments i ON i.CmpID=l.CmpID AND i.LoanID=l.LoanID
  WHERE l.CmpID=@CmpID AND l.EmployeeID=@EmployeeID AND l.LoanState=1 AND i.PaidAmount<i.Amount;
  DECLARE @ServiceDays INT=DATEDIFF(DAY,@HireDate,@LastDate)+1;
  DECLARE @ServiceYears DECIMAL(19,8)=CONVERT(DECIMAL(19,8),@ServiceDays)/@YearBasis;
  IF @MaxYears IS NOT NULL AND @ServiceYears>@MaxYears SET @ServiceYears=@MaxYears;
  SET @Gross=ROUND(@Salary/@DailyDivisor*@DaysPerYear*@ServiceYears,3)+ROUND(@Salary/@LeaveDivisor*ISNULL(@LeaveDays,0),3);
  SET @Ded=ROUND(ISNULL(@Loans,0),3);
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_FinalSettlements WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND TerminationID=@TerminationID AND SettlementState<>0) THROW 54234,N'التسوية معتمدة أو مقفلة ولا تقبل إعادة الاحتساب.',1;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_FinalSettlements WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND TerminationID=@TerminationID)
   UPDATE dbo.Emp_FinalSettlements SET CurrencyID=@CurrencyID,GrossEntitlements=@Gross,Deductions=@Ded,CalculationDetails=CONCAT(N'PolicyID=',@PolicyID,N'; ServiceDays=',@ServiceDays,N'; ServiceYears=',@ServiceYears,N'; LeaveDays=',ISNULL(@LeaveDays,0),N'; OutstandingLoans=',ISNULL(@Loans,0)),CalculatedAt=SYSDATETIME(),CalculatedBy=@User WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND TerminationID=@TerminationID AND SettlementState=0;
  ELSE
   INSERT dbo.Emp_FinalSettlements(CmpID,TerminationID,CurrencyID,GrossEntitlements,Deductions,CalculationDetails,CalculatedBy)
   VALUES(@CmpID,@TerminationID,@CurrencyID,@Gross,@Ded,CONCAT(N'PolicyID=',@PolicyID,N'; ServiceDays=',@ServiceDays,N'; ServiceYears=',@ServiceYears,N'; LeaveDays=',ISNULL(@LeaveDays,0),N'; OutstandingLoans=',ISNULL(@Loans,0)),@User);
  COMMIT TRANSACTION;
  SELECT @TerminationID AS TerminationID,@Gross AS GrossEntitlements,@Ded AS Deductions,N'تم احتساب التسوية النهائية وفق سياسة الشركة.' AS Message;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH
  IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
  THROW;
 END CATCH;
END;
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_ApproveFinalSettlement
 @CmpID INT,@TerminationID BIGINT,@ApproverID BIGINT,@StepNo SMALLINT=1,@Comments NVARCHAR(1000)=NULL
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@ApproverID;
 BEGIN TRY
  BEGIN TRANSACTION;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_ApprovalRouteSteps WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND ProcessType=6 AND RecordState=0)
  BEGIN
   DECLARE @SettlementSubmitter BIGINT,@ApprovalResult TINYINT,@NextApproval SMALLINT;
   SELECT @SettlementSubmitter=CalculatedBy FROM dbo.Emp_FinalSettlements WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND TerminationID=@TerminationID AND SettlementState=0;
   IF @SettlementSubmitter IS NULL THROW 54720,N'التسوية غير محسوبة أو غير موجودة.',1;
   IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_ApprovalRequests WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND ProcessType=6 AND EntityID=@TerminationID) EXEC dbo.Emp_StartApproval @CmpID,6,@TerminationID,@SettlementSubmitter,1;
   EXEC dbo.Emp_DecideApprovalStep @CmpID,6,@TerminationID,@StepNo,@ApproverID,1,@Comments,@ApprovalResult OUTPUT,@NextApproval OUTPUT,1;
   IF @ApprovalResult=0
   BEGIN
    COMMIT TRANSACTION;
    SELECT SettlementID,SettlementState,NetAmount FROM dbo.Emp_FinalSettlements WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND TerminationID=@TerminationID;
    RETURN;
   END;
  END;  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_FinalSettlements s JOIN dbo.Emp_Terminations t ON t.CmpID=s.CmpID AND t.TerminationID=s.TerminationID WHERE s.CmpID=@CmpID AND s.TerminationID=@TerminationID AND (s.CalculatedBy=@ApproverID OR t.CreatedBy=@ApproverID)) THROW 54395,N'لا يجوز لمنشئ طلب الإنهاء أو حاسب التسوية اعتماد التسوية.',1;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_ClearanceItems WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND TerminationID=@TerminationID AND ItemState<>1) THROW 54235,N'لا يمكن اعتماد التسوية قبل اكتمال إخلاء الطرف.',1;
  UPDATE dbo.Emp_FinalSettlements WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK)
   SET SettlementState=1,ApprovedAt=SYSDATETIME(),ApprovedBy=@ApproverID
  WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND TerminationID=@TerminationID AND SettlementState=0 AND CalculatedAt IS NOT NULL;
  IF @@ROWCOUNT<>1 THROW 54236,N'التسوية غير موجودة أو سبق اعتمادها.',1;
  UPDATE t SET TerminationState=2 FROM dbo.Emp_Terminations t WHERE t.CmpID=@CmpID AND t.TerminationID=@TerminationID AND t.TerminationState=1;
  IF @@ROWCOUNT<>1 THROW 54237,N'طلب الإنهاء غير معتمد.',1;
  UPDATE e SET EmpState=1 FROM dbo.Emp_Employee e JOIN dbo.Emp_Terminations t ON t.CmpID=e.EmpCompany AND t.EmployeeID=e.EmpID WHERE t.CmpID=@CmpID AND t.TerminationID=@TerminationID AND e.EmpState=0;
  IF @@ROWCOUNT<>1 THROW 54238,N'تعذر إغلاق خدمة الموظف.',1;
  COMMIT TRANSACTION;
  SELECT s.SettlementID,s.SettlementState,s.NetAmount,t.TerminationState,e.EmpState
  FROM dbo.Emp_FinalSettlements s JOIN dbo.Emp_Terminations t ON t.CmpID=s.CmpID AND t.TerminationID=s.TerminationID JOIN dbo.Emp_Employee e ON e.EmpCompany=t.CmpID AND e.EmpID=t.EmployeeID
  WHERE s.CmpID=@CmpID AND s.TerminationID=@TerminationID;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH
  IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
  THROW;
 END CATCH;
END;
GO
/* Missing employee dependents and measurable performance goals. */
CREATE TABLE dbo.Emp_EmployeeDependents
(
 DependentID BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT PK_Emp_EmployeeDependents PRIMARY KEY,
 CmpID INT NOT NULL,EmployeeID BIGINT NOT NULL,FullName NVARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
 RelationshipCode TINYINT NOT NULL,BirthDate DATE NULL,Gender TINYINT NULL,
 IsFinancialDependent BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Emp_EmployeeDependents_Financial DEFAULT(0),
 NationalID NVARCHAR(40) NULL,Notes NVARCHAR(500) NULL,RecordState TINYINT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Emp_EmployeeDependents_State DEFAULT(0),
 CreatedAt DATETIME2(0) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Emp_EmployeeDependents_Created DEFAULT(SYSDATETIME()),CreatedBy BIGINT NOT NULL,
 CONSTRAINT UQ_Emp_EmployeeDependents_Cmp_ID UNIQUE(CmpID,DependentID),
 CONSTRAINT CK_Emp_EmployeeDependents_Values CHECK(RelationshipCode>0 AND (Gender IS NULL OR Gender IN(1,2)) AND RecordState IN(0,1)),
 CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_EmployeeDependents_Employee FOREIGN KEY(CmpID,EmployeeID) REFERENCES dbo.Emp_Employee(EmpCompany,EmpID),
 CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_EmployeeDependents_User FOREIGN KEY(CreatedBy) REFERENCES dbo.Mng_User(UsrID)
);
CREATE INDEX IX_Emp_EmployeeDependents_Employee ON dbo.Emp_EmployeeDependents(CmpID,EmployeeID,RecordState);
GO
CREATE TABLE dbo.Emp_PerformanceGoals
(
 GoalID BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT PK_Emp_PerformanceGoals PRIMARY KEY,
 CmpID INT NOT NULL,CycleID BIGINT NOT NULL,EmployeeID BIGINT NOT NULL,
 GoalName NVARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,GoalDescription NVARCHAR(1000) NULL,
 Weight DECIMAL(7,4) NOT NULL,TargetValue DECIMAL(19,4) NULL,ResultValue DECIMAL(19,4) NULL,
 Score DECIMAL(7,2) NULL,EmployeeComment NVARCHAR(1000) NULL,ReviewerComment NVARCHAR(1000) NULL,
 GoalState TINYINT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Emp_PerformanceGoals_State DEFAULT(0),
 CreatedAt DATETIME2(0) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Emp_PerformanceGoals_Created DEFAULT(SYSDATETIME()),CreatedBy BIGINT NOT NULL,
 CONSTRAINT UQ_Emp_PerformanceGoals_Cmp_ID UNIQUE(CmpID,GoalID),
 CONSTRAINT UQ_Emp_PerformanceGoals_Name UNIQUE(CmpID,CycleID,EmployeeID,GoalName),
 CONSTRAINT CK_Emp_PerformanceGoals_Values CHECK(Weight>0 AND Weight<=100 AND (Score IS NULL OR Score BETWEEN 0 AND 100) AND GoalState IN(0,1,2)),
 CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_PerformanceGoals_Cycle FOREIGN KEY(CmpID,CycleID) REFERENCES dbo.Emp_PerformanceCycles(CmpID,CycleID),
 CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_PerformanceGoals_Employee FOREIGN KEY(CmpID,EmployeeID) REFERENCES dbo.Emp_Employee(EmpCompany,EmpID),
 CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_PerformanceGoals_User FOREIGN KEY(CreatedBy) REFERENCES dbo.Mng_User(UsrID)
);
CREATE INDEX IX_Emp_PerformanceGoals_Employee ON dbo.Emp_PerformanceGoals(CmpID,CycleID,EmployeeID,GoalState);
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_SaveEmployeeDependent
 @CmpID INT,@DependentID BIGINT=0,@EmployeeID BIGINT,@FullName NVARCHAR(150),@RelationshipCode TINYINT,
 @BirthDate DATE=NULL,@Gender TINYINT=NULL,@IsFinancialDependent BIT=0,@NationalID NVARCHAR(40)=NULL,@Notes NVARCHAR(500)=NULL,@RecordState TINYINT=0,@UserID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 IF NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@FullName)),N'') IS NULL OR @RelationshipCode<=0 OR (@Gender IS NOT NULL AND @Gender NOT IN(1,2)) OR @RecordState NOT IN(0,1)
  THROW 54240,N'بيانات المعال غير صحيحة.',1;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_Employee WHERE EmpCompany=@CmpID AND EmpID=@EmployeeID) THROW 54241,N'الموظف لا يتبع للشركة.',1;
 IF @DependentID=0
 BEGIN
  INSERT dbo.Emp_EmployeeDependents(CmpID,EmployeeID,FullName,RelationshipCode,BirthDate,Gender,IsFinancialDependent,NationalID,Notes,RecordState,CreatedBy)
  VALUES(@CmpID,@EmployeeID,@FullName,@RelationshipCode,@BirthDate,@Gender,@IsFinancialDependent,@NationalID,@Notes,@RecordState,@UserID);
  SET @DependentID=SCOPE_IDENTITY();
 END
 ELSE
 BEGIN
  UPDATE dbo.Emp_EmployeeDependents SET FullName=@FullName,RelationshipCode=@RelationshipCode,BirthDate=@BirthDate,Gender=@Gender,IsFinancialDependent=@IsFinancialDependent,NationalID=@NationalID,Notes=@Notes,RecordState=@RecordState
  WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND DependentID=@DependentID AND EmployeeID=@EmployeeID;
  IF @@ROWCOUNT=0 THROW 54242,N'سجل المعال غير موجود.',1;
 END;
 SELECT @DependentID AS DependentID;
END;
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_SelectEmployeeDependents @CmpID INT,@EmployeeID BIGINT,@IncludeInactive BIT=0
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON;
 SELECT DependentID,EmployeeID,FullName,RelationshipCode,BirthDate,Gender,IsFinancialDependent,NationalID,Notes,RecordState,CreatedAt
 FROM dbo.Emp_EmployeeDependents WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND EmployeeID=@EmployeeID AND (@IncludeInactive=1 OR RecordState=0) ORDER BY FullName,DependentID;
END;
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_SavePerformanceCycle
 @CmpID INT,@CycleID BIGINT=0,@CycleName NVARCHAR(150),@DateFrom DATE,@DateTo DATE,@CycleState TINYINT=0,@UserID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 IF NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@CycleName)),N'') IS NULL OR @DateFrom IS NULL OR @DateTo<@DateFrom OR @CycleState NOT IN(0,1,2) THROW 54243,N'بيانات دورة التقييم غير صحيحة.',1;
 IF @CycleID=0
 BEGIN
  INSERT dbo.Emp_PerformanceCycles(CmpID,CycleName,DateFrom,DateTo,CycleState,CreatedBy) VALUES(@CmpID,@CycleName,@DateFrom,@DateTo,@CycleState,@UserID);
  SET @CycleID=SCOPE_IDENTITY();
 END
 ELSE
 BEGIN
  UPDATE dbo.Emp_PerformanceCycles SET CycleName=@CycleName,DateFrom=@DateFrom,DateTo=@DateTo,CycleState=@CycleState WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND CycleID=@CycleID AND CycleState=0;
  IF @@ROWCOUNT=0 THROW 54244,N'الدورة غير موجودة أو بدأت ولا تقبل التعديل.',1;
 END;
 SELECT @CycleID AS CycleID;
END;
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_SavePerformanceGoal
 @CmpID INT,@GoalID BIGINT=0,@CycleID BIGINT,@EmployeeID BIGINT,@GoalName NVARCHAR(200),@GoalDescription NVARCHAR(1000)=NULL,
 @Weight DECIMAL(7,4),@TargetValue DECIMAL(19,4)=NULL,@ResultValue DECIMAL(19,4)=NULL,@Score DECIMAL(7,2)=NULL,
 @EmployeeComment NVARCHAR(1000)=NULL,@ReviewerComment NVARCHAR(1000)=NULL,@GoalState TINYINT=0,@UserID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 IF NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@GoalName)),N'') IS NULL OR @Weight<=0 OR @Weight>100 OR (@Score IS NOT NULL AND @Score NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 100) OR @GoalState NOT IN(0,1,2) THROW 54245,N'بيانات الهدف أو الدرجة غير صحيحة.',1;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_PerformanceCycles WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND CycleID=@CycleID AND CycleState IN(0,1)) THROW 54246,N'دورة التقييم غير مفتوحة.',1;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_Employee WHERE EmpCompany=@CmpID AND EmpID=@EmployeeID) THROW 54247,N'الموظف لا يتبع للشركة.',1;
 IF @GoalID=0
 BEGIN
  INSERT dbo.Emp_PerformanceGoals(CmpID,CycleID,EmployeeID,GoalName,GoalDescription,Weight,TargetValue,ResultValue,Score,EmployeeComment,ReviewerComment,GoalState,CreatedBy)
  VALUES(@CmpID,@CycleID,@EmployeeID,@GoalName,@GoalDescription,@Weight,@TargetValue,@ResultValue,@Score,@EmployeeComment,@ReviewerComment,@GoalState,@UserID);
  SET @GoalID=SCOPE_IDENTITY();
 END
 ELSE
 BEGIN
  UPDATE dbo.Emp_PerformanceGoals SET GoalName=@GoalName,GoalDescription=@GoalDescription,Weight=@Weight,TargetValue=@TargetValue,ResultValue=@ResultValue,Score=@Score,EmployeeComment=@EmployeeComment,ReviewerComment=@ReviewerComment,GoalState=@GoalState
  WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND GoalID=@GoalID AND CycleID=@CycleID AND EmployeeID=@EmployeeID AND GoalState<>2;
  IF @@ROWCOUNT=0 THROW 54248,N'الهدف غير موجود أو مغلق.',1;
 END;
 SELECT @GoalID AS GoalID;
END;
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_SelectPerformanceGoals @CmpID INT,@CycleID BIGINT,@EmployeeID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON;
 SELECT GoalID,GoalName,GoalDescription,Weight,TargetValue,ResultValue,Score,EmployeeComment,ReviewerComment,GoalState
 FROM dbo.Emp_PerformanceGoals WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND CycleID=@CycleID AND EmployeeID=@EmployeeID ORDER BY GoalID;
END;
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_SaveTrainingCourse
 @CmpID INT,@CourseID BIGINT=0,@CourseName NVARCHAR(200),@Provider NVARCHAR(200)=NULL,@CourseHours DECIMAL(8,2)=NULL,
 @Cost DECIMAL(15,3)=NULL,@CurrencyID BIGINT=NULL,@RecordState TINYINT=0,@UserID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 IF NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@CourseName)),N'') IS NULL OR @CourseHours<0 OR @Cost<0 OR @RecordState NOT IN(0,1) THROW 54249,N'بيانات الدورة التدريبية غير صحيحة.',1;
 IF @Cost IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Acc_Currency WHERE CurCmp=@CmpID AND CurID=@CurrencyID AND CurState=0) THROW 54250,N'عملة تكلفة التدريب غير صالحة للشركة.',1;
 IF @CourseID=0
 BEGIN
  INSERT dbo.Emp_TrainingCourses(CmpID,CourseName,Provider,CourseHours,Cost,CurrencyID,RecordState,CreatedBy) VALUES(@CmpID,@CourseName,@Provider,@CourseHours,@Cost,@CurrencyID,@RecordState,@UserID);
  SET @CourseID=SCOPE_IDENTITY();
 END
 ELSE
 BEGIN
  UPDATE dbo.Emp_TrainingCourses SET CourseName=@CourseName,Provider=@Provider,CourseHours=@CourseHours,Cost=@Cost,CurrencyID=@CurrencyID,RecordState=@RecordState WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND CourseID=@CourseID;
  IF @@ROWCOUNT=0 THROW 54251,N'الدورة التدريبية غير موجودة في الشركة.',1;
 END;
 SELECT @CourseID AS CourseID;
END;
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_SelectTrainingCourses @CmpID INT,@IncludeInactive BIT=0
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON;
 SELECT CourseID,CourseName,Provider,CourseHours,Cost,CurrencyID,RecordState FROM dbo.Emp_TrainingCourses WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND (@IncludeInactive=1 OR RecordState=0) ORDER BY CourseName,CourseID;
END;
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_Proc_SubmitPerformanceReview
 @CmpID INT,@User BIGINT,@CycleID BIGINT,@EmployeeID BIGINT,@ReviewerID BIGINT,@Score DECIMAL(7,2),@ReviewText NVARCHAR(MAX)
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@User;
 IF @Score IS NULL OR @Score NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 100 THROW 55501,N'درجة تقييم الأداء يجب أن تكون بين 0 و 100.',1;
 IF @ReviewerID<>@User THROW 55507,N'يجب أن ينفذ التقييم المستخدم المسجل كمقيّم.',1;
 IF @ReviewerID=@EmployeeID THROW 55502,N'لا يجوز للموظف تقييم نفسه.',1;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_Employee WHERE EmpCompany=@CmpID AND EmpID=@EmployeeID) THROW 55503,N'الموظف لا يتبع للشركة.',1;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_User WHERE UsrID=@ReviewerID AND UsrCompany=@CmpID AND UsrState=0) THROW 55504,N'المقيّم غير نشط أو لا يتبع للشركة.',1;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_PerformanceCycles WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND CycleID=@CycleID AND CycleState=1) THROW 55505,N'دورة التقييم غير مفتوحة لاستقبال التقييمات.',1;
 BEGIN TRY
  BEGIN TRANSACTION;
  UPDATE dbo.Emp_PerformanceReviews WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK)
   SET ReviewerID=@ReviewerID,Score=@Score,ReviewText=@ReviewText,ReviewState=1,ReviewedAt=SYSDATETIME()
  WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND CycleID=@CycleID AND EmployeeID=@EmployeeID AND ReviewState=0;
  IF @@ROWCOUNT=0
  BEGIN
   IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_PerformanceReviews WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND CycleID=@CycleID AND EmployeeID=@EmployeeID)
    THROW 55506,N'التقييم سبق اعتماده ولا يقبل التعديل.',1;
   INSERT dbo.Emp_PerformanceReviews(CmpID,CycleID,EmployeeID,ReviewerID,Score,ReviewText,ReviewState,ReviewedAt,CreatedAt,CreatedBy)
   VALUES(@CmpID,@CycleID,@EmployeeID,@ReviewerID,@Score,@ReviewText,1,SYSDATETIME(),SYSDATETIME(),@User);
  END;
  COMMIT TRANSACTION;
  SELECT N'تم حفظ تقييم الأداء بنجاح.' AS Message;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH
  IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
  THROW;
 END CATCH;
END;
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_SelectPerformanceCycles @CmpID INT,@DateFrom DATE=NULL,@DateTo DATE=NULL,@State TINYINT=NULL
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON;
 SELECT CycleID,CycleName,DateFrom,DateTo,CycleState,CreatedAt FROM dbo.Emp_PerformanceCycles
 WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND (@DateFrom IS NULL OR DateTo>=@DateFrom) AND (@DateTo IS NULL OR DateFrom<=@DateTo) AND (@State IS NULL OR CycleState=@State)
 ORDER BY DateFrom DESC,CycleID DESC;
END;
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_SelectCandidates @CmpID INT,@CandidateID BIGINT=NULL,@State TINYINT=NULL,@Search NVARCHAR(200)=NULL
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON;
 SELECT CandidateID,CandidateNo,FullName,Phone,Email,NationalityID,BirthDate,SourceName,CVPath,Notes,CandidateState,CreatedAt
 FROM dbo.Emp_Candidates WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND (@CandidateID IS NULL OR CandidateID=@CandidateID) AND (@State IS NULL OR CandidateState=@State)
  AND (@Search IS NULL OR FullName LIKE N'%'+@Search+N'%' OR CandidateNo LIKE N'%'+@Search+N'%' OR Email LIKE N'%'+@Search+N'%')
 ORDER BY FullName,CandidateID;
END;
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_SelectJobApplications @CmpID INT,@ApplicationID BIGINT=NULL,@CandidateID BIGINT=NULL,@State TINYINT=NULL
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON;
 SELECT ApplicationID,CandidateID,PositionID,RequisitionID,AppliedAt,InterviewAt,InterviewResult,OfferDate,OfferAmount,OfferCurrencyID,OfferExpiry,ApplicationState,Notes
 FROM dbo.Emp_JobApplications WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND (@ApplicationID IS NULL OR ApplicationID=@ApplicationID) AND (@CandidateID IS NULL OR CandidateID=@CandidateID) AND (@State IS NULL OR ApplicationState=@State)
 ORDER BY AppliedAt DESC,ApplicationID DESC;
END;
GO
/* Preserve employee history: legacy delete becomes a soft deactivation. */
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_DeleteEmployee @EmpID BIGINT,@CmpID INT=NULL,@UserID BIGINT=NULL
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 IF ISNULL(@EmpID,0)<=0 THROW 51601,N'معرّف الموظف غير صحيح.',1;
 BEGIN TRY
  BEGIN TRANSACTION;
  UPDATE dbo.Emp_Employee WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK)
   SET EmpState=1,EmpDateTime=SYSDATETIME()
  WHERE EmpID=@EmpID AND EmpCompany=@CmpID AND EmpState=0;
  IF @@ROWCOUNT=0 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_Employee WHERE EmpID=@EmpID AND EmpCompany=@CmpID)
   THROW 51602,N'الموظف المطلوب غير موجود.',1;
  COMMIT TRANSACTION;
  SELECT CAST(1 AS BIT) AS Success,CAST(1 AS BIT) AS Deactivated;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH
  IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
  THROW;
 END CATCH;
END;
GO
/* Workforce requisitions, structured interviews and explicit job offers. */
CREATE TABLE dbo.Emp_WorkforceRequisitions
(
 RequisitionID BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT PK_Emp_WorkforceRequisitions PRIMARY KEY,
 CmpID INT NOT NULL,PositionID BIGINT NOT NULL,RequestedCount SMALLINT NOT NULL,ApprovedCount SMALLINT NULL,
 NeedByDate DATE NULL,Justification NVARCHAR(1000) NOT NULL,RequestState TINYINT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Emp_WorkforceRequisitions_State DEFAULT(0),
 CreatedAt DATETIME2(0) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Emp_WorkforceRequisitions_Created DEFAULT(SYSDATETIME()),CreatedBy BIGINT NOT NULL,
 ApprovedAt DATETIME2(0) NULL,ApprovedBy BIGINT NULL,
 CONSTRAINT UQ_Emp_WorkforceRequisitions_Cmp_ID UNIQUE(CmpID,RequisitionID),
 CONSTRAINT CK_Emp_WorkforceRequisitions_Count CHECK(RequestedCount>0 AND (ApprovedCount IS NULL OR (ApprovedCount>=0 AND ApprovedCount<=RequestedCount)) AND RequestState IN(0,1,2,3)),
 CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_WorkforceRequisitions_Position FOREIGN KEY(CmpID,PositionID) REFERENCES dbo.Emp_Position(PosCmp,PosID),
 CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_WorkforceRequisitions_Creator FOREIGN KEY(CreatedBy) REFERENCES dbo.Mng_User(UsrID),
 CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_WorkforceRequisitions_Approver FOREIGN KEY(ApprovedBy) REFERENCES dbo.Mng_User(UsrID)
);
CREATE INDEX IX_Emp_WorkforceRequisitions_State ON dbo.Emp_WorkforceRequisitions(CmpID,RequestState,NeedByDate);
GO
ALTER TABLE dbo.Emp_JobApplications ADD CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_JobApplications_Requisition FOREIGN KEY(CmpID,RequisitionID) REFERENCES dbo.Emp_WorkforceRequisitions(CmpID,RequisitionID);
GO

);
