CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_SaveWorkforceRequisition
 @CmpID INT,@RequisitionID BIGINT=0,@PositionID BIGINT,@RequestedCount SMALLINT,@NeedByDate DATE=NULL,@Justification NVARCHAR(1000),@UserID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 IF @RequestedCount<=0 OR NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@Justification)),N'') IS NULL THROW 54260,N'عدد الشواغر ومبرر الطلب مطلوبان.',1;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_Position WHERE PosCmp=@CmpID AND PosID=@PositionID AND PosState=0) THROW 54261,N'الوظيفة غير نشطة أو لا تتبع للشركة.',1;
 IF @RequisitionID=0
 BEGIN
  INSERT dbo.Emp_WorkforceRequisitions(CmpID,PositionID,RequestedCount,NeedByDate,Justification,CreatedBy) VALUES(@CmpID,@PositionID,@RequestedCount,@NeedByDate,@Justification,@UserID);
  SET @RequisitionID=SCOPE_IDENTITY();
 END
 ELSE
 BEGIN
  UPDATE dbo.Emp_WorkforceRequisitions SET PositionID=@PositionID,RequestedCount=@RequestedCount,NeedByDate=@NeedByDate,Justification=@Justification WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND RequisitionID=@RequisitionID AND RequestState=0;
  IF @@ROWCOUNT=0 THROW 54262,N'طلب الاحتياج غير موجود أو لم يعد مسودة.',1;
 END;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_ApprovalRouteSteps WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND ProcessType=8 AND RecordState=0) EXEC dbo.Emp_StartApproval @CmpID,8,@RequisitionID,@UserID,1;
END;
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_DecideWorkforceRequisition
 @CmpID INT,@RequisitionID BIGINT,@ApproverID BIGINT,@Decision TINYINT,@ApprovedCount SMALLINT=NULL,@StepNo SMALLINT=1,@Comments NVARCHAR(1000)=NULL
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@ApproverID;
 IF @Decision NOT IN(1,2) THROW 54263,N'قرار طلب الاحتياج غير صحيح.',1;
 BEGIN TRY
  BEGIN TRANSACTION;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_ApprovalRequests WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND ProcessType=8 AND EntityID=@RequisitionID)
  BEGIN
   DECLARE @ApprovalResult TINYINT,@NextApproval SMALLINT;
   EXEC dbo.Emp_DecideApprovalStep @CmpID,8,@RequisitionID,@StepNo,@ApproverID,@Decision,@Comments,@ApprovalResult OUTPUT,@NextApproval OUTPUT,1;
   IF @Decision=1 AND @ApprovalResult=0 BEGIN COMMIT TRANSACTION; SELECT RequisitionID,RequestState,ApprovedCount FROM dbo.Emp_WorkforceRequisitions WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND RequisitionID=@RequisitionID; RETURN; END;
  END;
 UPDATE dbo.Emp_WorkforceRequisitions
 SET RequestState=@Decision,ApprovedCount=CASE WHEN @Decision=1 THEN ISNULL(@ApprovedCount,RequestedCount) ELSE 0 END,ApprovedAt=SYSDATETIME(),ApprovedBy=@ApproverID
 WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND RequisitionID=@RequisitionID AND RequestState=0 AND CreatedBy<>@ApproverID
  AND (@Decision=2 OR (ISNULL(@ApprovedCount,RequestedCount)>0 AND ISNULL(@ApprovedCount,RequestedCount)<=RequestedCount));
 IF @@ROWCOUNT<>1 THROW 54264,N'طلب الاحتياج غير موجود أو قرار الاعتماد غير مسموح.',1;
  COMMIT TRANSACTION;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH
  IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
  THROW;
 END CATCH;
 SELECT RequisitionID,RequestState,ApprovedCount FROM dbo.Emp_WorkforceRequisitions WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND RequisitionID=@RequisitionID;
END;
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_SelectWorkforceRequisitions @CmpID INT,@State TINYINT=NULL
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON;
 SELECT RequisitionID,PositionID,RequestedCount,ApprovedCount,NeedByDate,Justification,RequestState,CreatedAt,ApprovedAt,ApprovedBy
 FROM dbo.Emp_WorkforceRequisitions WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND (@State IS NULL OR RequestState=@State) ORDER BY CreatedAt DESC,RequisitionID DESC;
END;
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_SaveJobInterview
 @CmpID INT,@InterviewID BIGINT=0,@ApplicationID BIGINT,@InterviewAt DATETIME2(0),@InterviewerID BIGINT,
 @Score DECIMAL(7,2)=NULL,@Result TINYINT=NULL,@Notes NVARCHAR(2000)=NULL,@InterviewState TINYINT=0,@UserID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 IF @Score IS NOT NULL AND @Score NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 100 OR @InterviewState NOT IN(0,1,2) THROW 54265,N'بيانات المقابلة غير صحيحة.',1;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_JobApplications WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND ApplicationID=@ApplicationID) THROW 54266,N'طلب التوظيف غير موجود في الشركة.',1;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_User WHERE UsrID=@InterviewerID AND UsrCompany=@CmpID AND UsrState=0) THROW 54267,N'المقابل غير نشط أو لا يتبع للشركة.',1;
 IF @InterviewID=0
 BEGIN
  INSERT dbo.Emp_JobInterviews(CmpID,ApplicationID,InterviewAt,InterviewerID,Score,Result,Notes,InterviewState,CreatedBy) VALUES(@CmpID,@ApplicationID,@InterviewAt,@InterviewerID,@Score,@Result,@Notes,@InterviewState,@UserID);
  SET @InterviewID=SCOPE_IDENTITY();
 END
 ELSE
 BEGIN
  UPDATE dbo.Emp_JobInterviews SET InterviewAt=@InterviewAt,InterviewerID=@InterviewerID,Score=@Score,Result=@Result,Notes=@Notes,InterviewState=@InterviewState
  WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND InterviewID=@InterviewID AND ApplicationID=@ApplicationID AND InterviewState=0;
  IF @@ROWCOUNT=0 THROW 54268,N'المقابلة غير موجودة أو أغلقت.',1;
 END;
 SELECT @InterviewID AS InterviewID;
END;
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_SaveJobOffer
 @CmpID INT,@OfferID BIGINT=0,@ApplicationID BIGINT,@OfferDate DATE,@ExpiryDate DATE,@SalaryAmount DECIMAL(15,3),@CurrencyID BIGINT,@UserID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 IF @OfferDate IS NULL OR @ExpiryDate<@OfferDate OR @SalaryAmount<=0 THROW 54269,N'بيانات عرض العمل غير صحيحة.',1;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Acc_Currency WHERE CurCmp=@CmpID AND CurID=@CurrencyID AND CurState=0) THROW 54270,N'عملة العرض غير نشطة أو لا تتبع للشركة.',1;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_JobApplications WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND ApplicationID=@ApplicationID) THROW 54271,N'طلب التوظيف غير موجود.',1;
 IF @OfferID=0
 BEGIN
  INSERT dbo.Emp_JobOffers(CmpID,ApplicationID,OfferDate,ExpiryDate,SalaryAmount,CurrencyID,CreatedBy) VALUES(@CmpID,@ApplicationID,@OfferDate,@ExpiryDate,@SalaryAmount,@CurrencyID,@UserID);
  SET @OfferID=SCOPE_IDENTITY();
 END
 ELSE
 BEGIN
  UPDATE dbo.Emp_JobOffers SET OfferDate=@OfferDate,ExpiryDate=@ExpiryDate,SalaryAmount=@SalaryAmount,CurrencyID=@CurrencyID
  WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND OfferID=@OfferID AND ApplicationID=@ApplicationID AND OfferState=0;
  IF @@ROWCOUNT=0 THROW 54272,N'العرض غير موجود أو لم يعد مسودة.',1;
 END;
 UPDATE dbo.Emp_JobApplications SET OfferDate=@OfferDate,OfferAmount=@SalaryAmount,OfferCurrencyID=@CurrencyID,OfferExpiry=@ExpiryDate WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND ApplicationID=@ApplicationID;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_ApprovalRouteSteps WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND ProcessType=7 AND RecordState=0) EXEC dbo.Emp_StartApproval @CmpID,7,@OfferID,@UserID,1;
END;
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_DecideJobOffer @CmpID INT,@OfferID BIGINT,@UserID BIGINT,@Decision TINYINT,@StepNo SMALLINT=1,@Comments NVARCHAR(1000)=NULL
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 IF @Decision NOT IN(1,2) OR @StepNo<=0 THROW 54273,N'قرار العرض أو مرحلته غير صحيح.',1;
 BEGIN TRY
  BEGIN TRANSACTION;
  DECLARE @ApprovalResult TINYINT,@NextApproval SMALLINT;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_ApprovalRequests WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND ProcessType=7 AND EntityID=@OfferID)
  BEGIN
   EXEC dbo.Emp_DecideApprovalStep @CmpID,7,@OfferID,@StepNo,@UserID,@Decision,@Comments,@ApprovalResult OUTPUT,@NextApproval OUTPUT,1;
   IF @Decision=1 AND @ApprovalResult=0
   BEGIN
    COMMIT TRANSACTION;
    SELECT OfferID,OfferState,DecidedAt FROM dbo.Emp_JobOffers WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND OfferID=@OfferID;
    RETURN;
   END;
  END;
  UPDATE dbo.Emp_JobOffers SET OfferState=@Decision,DecidedAt=SYSDATETIME(),DecidedBy=@UserID
  WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND OfferID=@OfferID AND OfferState=0 AND CreatedBy<>@UserID AND (@Decision=2 OR ExpiryDate>=CONVERT(date,SYSDATETIME()));
  IF @@ROWCOUNT<>1 THROW 54274,N'العرض غير موجود أو منتهي أو القرار غير مسموح.',1;
  COMMIT TRANSACTION;
  SELECT OfferID,OfferState,DecidedAt FROM dbo.Emp_JobOffers WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND OfferID=@OfferID;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH
  IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
  THROW;
 END CATCH;
END;GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_SelectJobOffers @CmpID INT,@ApplicationID BIGINT=NULL,@State TINYINT=NULL
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON;
 SELECT OfferID,ApplicationID,OfferDate,ExpiryDate,SalaryAmount,CurrencyID,OfferState,CreatedAt,DecidedAt,DecidedBy
 FROM dbo.Emp_JobOffers WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND (@ApplicationID IS NULL OR ApplicationID=@ApplicationID) AND (@State IS NULL OR OfferState=@State) ORDER BY OfferDate DESC,OfferID DESC;
END;
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_SaveJobApplication
 @CmpID INT,@ApplicationID BIGINT=0,@CandidateID BIGINT,@PositionID BIGINT=NULL,@InterviewAt DATETIME2(0)=NULL,
 @InterviewResult TINYINT=NULL,@OfferDate DATE=NULL,@OfferAmount DECIMAL(15,3)=NULL,@OfferCurrencyID BIGINT=NULL,
 @OfferExpiry DATE=NULL,@ApplicationState TINYINT=0,@Notes NVARCHAR(1000)=NULL,@UserID BIGINT,@RequisitionID BIGINT=NULL
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_Candidates WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND CandidateID=@CandidateID AND CandidateState=0) THROW 54168,N'المرشح غير نشط أو لا يتبع للشركة.',1;
 IF @OfferAmount<0 OR (@OfferExpiry IS NOT NULL AND @OfferDate IS NOT NULL AND @OfferExpiry<@OfferDate) THROW 54169,N'بيانات عرض العمل غير صحيحة.',1;
 IF @OfferCurrencyID IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Acc_Currency WHERE CurCmp=@CmpID AND CurID=@OfferCurrencyID AND CurState=0) THROW 54170,N'عملة العرض غير صالحة للشركة.',1;
 IF @PositionID IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_Position WHERE PosCmp=@CmpID AND PosID=@PositionID) THROW 54280,N'المنصب غير موجود في الشركة.',1;
 BEGIN TRY
  BEGIN TRANSACTION;
  IF @RequisitionID IS NOT NULL
  BEGIN
   DECLARE @ReqPosition BIGINT,@ApprovedCount SMALLINT,@ReqState TINYINT;
   SELECT @ReqPosition=PositionID,@ApprovedCount=ApprovedCount,@ReqState=RequestState
   FROM dbo.Emp_WorkforceRequisitions WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND RequisitionID=@RequisitionID;
   IF @ReqState<>1 OR ISNULL(@ApprovedCount,0)<=0 THROW 54281,N'طلب الاحتياج غير معتمد أو لا توجد شواغر معتمدة.',1;
   IF @PositionID IS NOT NULL AND @PositionID<>@ReqPosition THROW 54282,N'المنصب لا يطابق طلب الاحتياج.',1;
   SET @PositionID=@ReqPosition;
   IF (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.Emp_JobApplications WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND RequisitionID=@RequisitionID AND ApplicationState<>3 AND (@ApplicationID=0 OR ApplicationID<>@ApplicationID))>=@ApprovedCount
    THROW 54283,N'اكتمل عدد طلبات المرشحين للشاغر المعتمد.',1;
  END;
  IF ISNULL(@ApplicationID,0)=0
  BEGIN
   INSERT dbo.Emp_JobApplications(CmpID,CandidateID,PositionID,RequisitionID,InterviewAt,InterviewResult,OfferDate,OfferAmount,OfferCurrencyID,OfferExpiry,ApplicationState,Notes,CreatedBy)
   VALUES(@CmpID,@CandidateID,@PositionID,@RequisitionID,@InterviewAt,@InterviewResult,@OfferDate,@OfferAmount,@OfferCurrencyID,@OfferExpiry,@ApplicationState,@Notes,@UserID);
   SET @ApplicationID=SCOPE_IDENTITY();
  END
  ELSE
  BEGIN
   UPDATE dbo.Emp_JobApplications SET PositionID=@PositionID,RequisitionID=@RequisitionID,InterviewAt=@InterviewAt,InterviewResult=@InterviewResult,OfferDate=@OfferDate,OfferAmount=@OfferAmount,OfferCurrencyID=@OfferCurrencyID,OfferExpiry=@OfferExpiry,ApplicationState=@ApplicationState,Notes=@Notes
   WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND ApplicationID=@ApplicationID AND CandidateID=@CandidateID AND ApplicationState=0;
   IF @@ROWCOUNT=0 THROW 54171,N'طلب التوظيف غير موجود أو نهائي.',1;
  END;
  COMMIT TRANSACTION;
  SELECT @ApplicationID AS ApplicationID;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH
  IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
  THROW;
 END CATCH;
END;
GO

CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_Proc_ConvertCandidateToEmployee
 @CmpID INT,@User BIGINT,@CandidateID BIGINT,@EmpNum NVARCHAR(10),@PosID BIGINT,
 @ContractType BIGINT,@StartDate DATE,@OfferID BIGINT=NULL
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@User;
 IF @StartDate IS NULL THROW 55303,N'تاريخ مباشرة العمل مطلوب.',1;
 BEGIN TRY
  BEGIN TRANSACTION;
  DECLARE @FullName NVARCHAR(200),@Phone NVARCHAR(40),@Email NVARCHAR(254),@NatID BIGINT,@BirthDate DATE,
          @OfferCount INT,@ApplicationID BIGINT,@OfferAmount DECIMAL(15,3),@OfferCurrency BIGINT,@ApplicationPosition BIGINT;
  SELECT @FullName=FullName,@Phone=Phone,@Email=Email,@NatID=NationalityID,@BirthDate=BirthDate
  FROM dbo.Emp_Candidates WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND CandidateID=@CandidateID AND CandidateState=0;
  IF @FullName IS NULL THROW 55301,N'المرشح غير موجود أو سبق تحويله.',1;
  IF @OfferID IS NULL
  BEGIN
   SELECT @OfferCount=COUNT(*) FROM dbo.Emp_JobOffers o JOIN dbo.Emp_JobApplications a ON a.CmpID=o.CmpID AND a.ApplicationID=o.ApplicationID
   WHERE o.CmpID=@CmpID AND a.CandidateID=@CandidateID AND o.OfferState=1;
   IF @OfferCount<>1 THROW 55304,N'يجب اختيار عرض عمل مقبول واحد للمرشح.',1;
   SELECT @OfferID=o.OfferID FROM dbo.Emp_JobOffers o JOIN dbo.Emp_JobApplications a ON a.CmpID=o.CmpID AND a.ApplicationID=o.ApplicationID
   WHERE o.CmpID=@CmpID AND a.CandidateID=@CandidateID AND o.OfferState=1;
  END;
  SELECT @ApplicationID=o.ApplicationID,@OfferAmount=o.SalaryAmount,@OfferCurrency=o.CurrencyID,@ApplicationPosition=a.PositionID
  FROM dbo.Emp_JobOffers o WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK)
  JOIN dbo.Emp_JobApplications a ON a.CmpID=o.CmpID AND a.ApplicationID=o.ApplicationID
  WHERE o.CmpID=@CmpID AND o.OfferID=@OfferID AND o.OfferState=1 AND a.CandidateID=@CandidateID;
  IF @ApplicationID IS NULL THROW 55305,N'العرض غير مقبول أو لا يخص المرشح.',1;
  IF @PosID IS NULL SET @PosID=@ApplicationPosition;
  IF @ApplicationPosition IS NOT NULL AND @PosID<>@ApplicationPosition THROW 55306,N'المنصب لا يطابق العرض المقبول.',1;
  IF @PosID IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_Position WHERE PosCmp=@CmpID AND PosID=@PosID AND PosState=0) THROW 55307,N'المنصب غير نشط أو لا يتبع للشركة.',1;
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_EmploymentTypes WHERE EmpTypeCmp=@CmpID AND EmpTypeID=@ContractType AND EmpTypeState=0) THROW 55308,N'نوع التعاقد غير نشط أو لا يتبع للشركة.',1;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_Employee WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE EmpCompany=@CmpID AND EmpNum=@EmpNum) THROW 55302,N'رقم الموظف مستخدم مسبقاً.',1;

  DECLARE @NewEmpID BIGINT;
  INSERT dbo.Emp_Employee(EmpNum,EmpName,EmpState,EmpDateTime,EmpUser,EmpCompany,PosID,HireDate)
  VALUES(@EmpNum,@FullName,0,SYSDATETIME(),@User,@CmpID,@PosID,@StartDate);
  SET @NewEmpID=SCOPE_IDENTITY();
  INSERT dbo.Emp_PersonalDetails(EmpCompany,EmpID,EmpGender,EmpNat,EmpBDate,EmpPhone,EmpEmail,EmpUser,EmpDateTime)
  VALUES(@CmpID,@NewEmpID,NULL,@NatID,@BirthDate,@Phone,@Email,@User,SYSDATETIME());
  INSERT dbo.Emp_Contract(EmpCompany,EmpID,ConType,ConStartDate,ConUser,ConDateTime)
  VALUES(@CmpID,@NewEmpID,@ContractType,@StartDate,@User,SYSDATETIME());
  INSERT dbo.Emp_Salary(EmpCompany,EmpID,SalAmount,SalCurrencyID,SalStartDate,SalUser,SalDateTime)
  VALUES(@CmpID,@NewEmpID,@OfferAmount,@OfferCurrency,@StartDate,@User,SYSDATETIME());
  INSERT dbo.Emp_ServiceHistory(CmpID,EmployeeID,EffectiveDate,EventType,NewPositionID,NewSalary,CurrencyID,ReferenceNo,Reason,CreatedAt,CreatedBy,RecordState)
  VALUES(@CmpID,@NewEmpID,@StartDate,1,@PosID,@OfferAmount,@OfferCurrency,CONVERT(NVARCHAR(100),@OfferID),N'تعيين من عرض عمل مقبول',SYSDATETIME(),@User,0);
  UPDATE dbo.Emp_Candidates SET CandidateState=2 WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND CandidateID=@CandidateID AND CandidateState=0;
  IF @@ROWCOUNT<>1 THROW 55309,N'تغيرت حالة المرشح أثناء التحويل.',1;
  UPDATE dbo.Emp_JobOffers SET OfferState=3 WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND OfferID=@OfferID AND OfferState=1;
  IF @@ROWCOUNT<>1 THROW 55310,N'تغيرت حالة العرض أثناء التحويل.',1;
  COMMIT TRANSACTION;
  SELECT @NewEmpID AS EmployeeID,N'تم تحويل المرشح المقبول إلى موظف مع إنشاء ملف الخدمة والعقد والراتب.' AS Message;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH
  IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
  THROW;
 END CATCH;
END;
GO
/* Company-defined progressive payroll withholding rules; no rates or thresholds are preset. */
CREATE TABLE dbo.Emp_PayrollWithholdingRules
(
 RuleID BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT PK_Emp_PayrollWithholdingRules PRIMARY KEY,
 CmpID INT NOT NULL,RuleType TINYINT NOT NULL,BaseType TINYINT NOT NULL,ComponentID BIGINT NOT NULL,
 BaseCap DECIMAL(19,3) NULL,EffectiveFrom DATE NOT NULL,EffectiveTo DATE NULL,
 RecordState TINYINT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Emp_PayrollWithholdingRules_State DEFAULT(0),
 CreatedAt DATETIME2(0) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Emp_PayrollWithholdingRules_Created DEFAULT(SYSDATETIME()),CreatedBy BIGINT NOT NULL,
 CONSTRAINT UQ_Emp_PayrollWithholdingRules_Cmp_ID UNIQUE(CmpID,RuleID),
 CONSTRAINT CK_Emp_PayrollWithholdingRules_Values CHECK(RuleType IN(1,2) AND BaseType IN(1,2) AND (BaseCap IS NULL OR BaseCap>0) AND RecordState IN(0,1) AND (EffectiveTo IS NULL OR EffectiveTo>=EffectiveFrom)),
 CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_PayrollWithholdingRules_Company FOREIGN KEY(CmpID) REFERENCES dbo.Mng_Company(CmpID),
 CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_PayrollWithholdingRules_Component FOREIGN KEY(CmpID,ComponentID) REFERENCES dbo.Emp_PayComponents(CmpID,ComponentID),
 CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_PayrollWithholdingRules_User FOREIGN KEY(CreatedBy) REFERENCES dbo.Mng_User(UsrID)
);
CREATE INDEX IX_Emp_PayrollWithholdingRules_Effective ON dbo.Emp_PayrollWithholdingRules(CmpID,RuleType,RecordState,EffectiveFrom,EffectiveTo);
GO
CREATE TABLE dbo.Emp_PayrollWithholdingBands
(
 BandID BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT PK_Emp_PayrollWithholdingBands PRIMARY KEY,
 CmpID INT NOT NULL,RuleID BIGINT NOT NULL,BandFrom DECIMAL(19,3) NOT NULL,BandTo DECIMAL(19,3) NULL,RatePercent DECIMAL(9,6) NOT NULL,
 CONSTRAINT UQ_Emp_PayrollWithholdingBands_Start UNIQUE(CmpID,RuleID,BandFrom),
 CONSTRAINT CK_Emp_PayrollWithholdingBands_Values CHECK(BandFrom>=0 AND (BandTo IS NULL OR BandTo>BandFrom) AND RatePercent BETWEEN 0 AND 100),
 CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_PayrollWithholdingBands_Rule FOREIGN KEY(CmpID,RuleID) REFERENCES dbo.Emp_PayrollWithholdingRules(CmpID,RuleID)
);
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_SavePayrollWithholdingRule
 @CmpID INT,@RuleID BIGINT=0,@RuleType TINYINT,@BaseType TINYINT,@ComponentID BIGINT,@BaseCap DECIMAL(19,3)=NULL,
 @EffectiveFrom DATE,@EffectiveTo DATE=NULL,@RecordState TINYINT=0,@UserID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 IF @RuleType NOT IN(1,2) OR @BaseType NOT IN(1,2) OR @EffectiveFrom IS NULL OR (@EffectiveTo IS NOT NULL AND @EffectiveTo<@EffectiveFrom) OR @BaseCap<=0 OR @RecordState NOT IN(0,1)
  THROW 54290,N'بيانات قاعدة الاستقطاع غير صحيحة.',1;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_PayComponents WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND ComponentID=@ComponentID AND ComponentKind=2 AND RecordState=0)
  THROW 54291,N'مكون الاستقطاع غير نشط أو ليس مكون خصم.',1;
 BEGIN TRY
  BEGIN TRANSACTION;
  IF @RecordState=0 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_PayrollWithholdingRules WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND RuleType=@RuleType AND RecordState=0 AND RuleID<>ISNULL(@RuleID,0) AND EffectiveFrom<=ISNULL(@EffectiveTo,CONVERT(date,'99991231')) AND ISNULL(EffectiveTo,CONVERT(date,'99991231'))>=@EffectiveFrom)
   THROW 54292,N'تتداخل قاعدة استقطاع فعالة من النوع نفسه.',1;
  IF ISNULL(@RuleID,0)=0
  BEGIN
   INSERT dbo.Emp_PayrollWithholdingRules(CmpID,RuleType,BaseType,ComponentID,BaseCap,EffectiveFrom,EffectiveTo,RecordState,CreatedBy) VALUES(@CmpID,@RuleType,@BaseType,@ComponentID,@BaseCap,@EffectiveFrom,@EffectiveTo,@RecordState,@UserID);
   SET @RuleID=SCOPE_IDENTITY();
  END
  ELSE
  BEGIN
   UPDATE dbo.Emp_PayrollWithholdingRules SET RuleType=@RuleType,BaseType=@BaseType,ComponentID=@ComponentID,BaseCap=@BaseCap,EffectiveFrom=@EffectiveFrom,EffectiveTo=@EffectiveTo,RecordState=@RecordState WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND RuleID=@RuleID;
   IF @@ROWCOUNT=0 THROW 54293,N'قاعدة الاستقطاع غير موجودة في الشركة.',1;
  END;
  COMMIT TRANSACTION;
  SELECT @RuleID AS RuleID;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH
  IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
  THROW;
 END CATCH;
END;
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_SavePayrollWithholdingBand
 @CmpID INT,@BandID BIGINT=0,@RuleID BIGINT,@BandFrom DECIMAL(19,3),@BandTo DECIMAL(19,3)=NULL,@RatePercent DECIMAL(9,6),@UserID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 IF @BandFrom IS NULL OR @RatePercent IS NULL OR @BandFrom<0 OR (@BandTo IS NOT NULL AND @BandTo<=@BandFrom) OR @RatePercent NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 100 THROW 54294,N'حدود أو نسبة شريحة الاستقطاع غير صحيحة.',1;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_PayrollWithholdingRules WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND RuleID=@RuleID) THROW 54295,N'قاعدة الاستقطاع غير موجودة.',1;
 BEGIN TRY
  BEGIN TRANSACTION;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_PayrollWithholdingBands WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND RuleID=@RuleID AND BandID<>ISNULL(@BandID,0) AND BandFrom<ISNULL(@BandTo,CONVERT(decimal(19,3),9999999999999999.999)) AND ISNULL(BandTo,CONVERT(decimal(19,3),9999999999999999.999))>@BandFrom)
   THROW 54296,N'تتداخل شريحة الاستقطاع مع شريحة أخرى.',1;
  IF ISNULL(@BandID,0)=0
  BEGIN
   INSERT dbo.Emp_PayrollWithholdingBands(CmpID,RuleID,BandFrom,BandTo,RatePercent) VALUES(@CmpID,@RuleID,@BandFrom,@BandTo,@RatePercent);
   SET @BandID=SCOPE_IDENTITY();
  END
  ELSE
  BEGIN
   UPDATE dbo.Emp_PayrollWithholdingBands SET BandFrom=@BandFrom,BandTo=@BandTo,RatePercent=@RatePercent WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND RuleID=@RuleID AND BandID=@BandID;
   IF @@ROWCOUNT=0 THROW 54297,N'شريحة الاستقطاع غير موجودة.',1;
  END;
  COMMIT TRANSACTION;
  SELECT @BandID AS BandID;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH
  IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
  THROW;
 END CATCH;
END;
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_SelectPayrollWithholdingRules @CmpID INT,@RuleType TINYINT=NULL,@AsOfDate DATE=NULL
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON;
 SELECT r.RuleID,r.RuleType,r.BaseType,r.ComponentID,c.ComponentName,r.BaseCap,r.EffectiveFrom,r.EffectiveTo,r.RecordState,b.BandID,b.BandFrom,b.BandTo,b.RatePercent
 FROM dbo.Emp_PayrollWithholdingRules r JOIN dbo.Emp_PayComponents c ON c.CmpID=r.CmpID AND c.ComponentID=r.ComponentID
 LEFT JOIN dbo.Emp_PayrollWithholdingBands b ON b.CmpID=r.CmpID AND b.RuleID=r.RuleID
 WHERE r.CmpID=@CmpID AND (@RuleType IS NULL OR r.RuleType=@RuleType) AND (@AsOfDate IS NULL OR (r.EffectiveFrom<=@AsOfDate AND (r.EffectiveTo IS NULL OR r.EffectiveTo>=@AsOfDate)))
 ORDER BY r.RuleType,r.EffectiveFrom,r.RuleID,b.BandFrom;
END;
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_SelectJobInterviews
 @CmpID INT,@ApplicationID BIGINT=NULL,@InterviewerID BIGINT=NULL,@State TINYINT=NULL
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON;
 SELECT i.InterviewID,i.ApplicationID,a.CandidateID,c.FullName AS CandidateName,a.PositionID,p.PosName AS PositionName,
        i.InterviewAt,i.InterviewerID,u.UsrLogIn AS InterviewerName,i.Score,i.Result,i.Notes,i.InterviewState,i.CreatedAt,i.CreatedBy
 FROM dbo.Emp_JobInterviews i
 JOIN dbo.Emp_JobApplications a ON a.CmpID=i.CmpID AND a.ApplicationID=i.ApplicationID
 JOIN dbo.Emp_Candidates c ON c.CmpID=a.CmpID AND c.CandidateID=a.CandidateID
 LEFT JOIN dbo.Emp_Position p ON p.PosCmp=a.CmpID AND p.PosID=a.PositionID
 LEFT JOIN dbo.Mng_User u ON u.UsrID=i.InterviewerID
 WHERE i.CmpID=@CmpID AND (@ApplicationID IS NULL OR i.ApplicationID=@ApplicationID)
   AND (@InterviewerID IS NULL OR i.InterviewerID=@InterviewerID) AND (@State IS NULL OR i.InterviewState=@State)
 ORDER BY i.InterviewAt DESC,i.InterviewID DESC;
END;
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_CancelLeaveRequest
 @CmpID INT,@RequestID BIGINT,@UserID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 BEGIN TRY
  BEGIN TRANSACTION;
  DECLARE @EmployeeID BIGINT,@LeaveTypeID BIGINT,@Qty DECIMAL(9,2),@StartAt DATETIME2(0),@State TINYINT,@BalanceID BIGINT;
  SELECT @EmployeeID=EmployeeID,@LeaveTypeID=LeaveTypeID,@Qty=Quantity,@StartAt=StartAt,@State=RequestState
  FROM dbo.Emp_LeaveRequests WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND RequestID=@RequestID;
  IF @EmployeeID IS NULL OR @State NOT IN(0,1) OR @StartAt<=SYSDATETIME() THROW 54310,N'الطلب غير موجود أو بدأ أو لا يمكن إلغاؤه.',1;
  IF @State=1
  BEGIN
   SELECT @BalanceID=BalanceID FROM dbo.Emp_LeaveBalances WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK)
   WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND EmployeeID=@EmployeeID AND LeaveTypeID=@LeaveTypeID AND BalanceYear=YEAR(@StartAt);
   IF @BalanceID IS NULL THROW 54311,N'رصيد الإجازة المرتبط بالطلب غير موجود.',1;
   UPDATE dbo.Emp_LeaveBalances SET Used=Used-@Qty WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND BalanceID=@BalanceID AND Used>=@Qty;
   IF @@ROWCOUNT<>1 THROW 54312,N'رصيد الإجازة لا يسمح بعكس الخصم بالكامل.',1;
   INSERT dbo.Emp_LeaveBalanceTransactions(CmpID,BalanceID,TransactionDate,TransactionType,Quantity,BalanceDelta,SourceType,SourceID,Description,CreatedBy)
   VALUES(@CmpID,@BalanceID,CONVERT(date,SYSDATETIME()),3,@Qty,@Qty,2,@RequestID,N'إلغاء إجازة معتمدة وإعادة الرصيد',@UserID);
  END;
  UPDATE dbo.Emp_LeaveRequests SET RequestState=3 WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND RequestID=@RequestID AND RequestState=@State;
  IF @@ROWCOUNT<>1 THROW 54313,N'تغيرت حالة الطلب أثناء الإلغاء.',1;
  COMMIT TRANSACTION;
  SELECT RequestID,RequestState FROM dbo.Emp_LeaveRequests WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND RequestID=@RequestID;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH
  IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
  THROW;
 END CATCH;
END;
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_SelectLoans
 @CmpID INT,@LoanID BIGINT=NULL,@EmployeeID BIGINT=NULL,@State TINYINT=NULL,@IncludeInstallments BIT=0
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON;
 SELECT l.LoanID,l.EmployeeID,e.EmpNum,e.EmpName,l.LoanNo,l.Principal,l.CurrencyID,l.StartDate,l.InstallmentCount,l.InstallmentAmount,l.InstallmentIntervalDays,l.InterestAmount,l.LoanState,l.CreatedAt,l.CreatedBy,l.ApprovedAt,l.ApprovedBy,
        i.InstallmentID,i.InstallmentNo,i.DueDate,i.Amount,i.PaidAmount,i.PaidAt,i.InstallmentState
 FROM dbo.Emp_Loans l JOIN dbo.Emp_Employee e ON e.EmpCompany=l.CmpID AND e.EmpID=l.EmployeeID
 LEFT JOIN dbo.Emp_LoanInstallments i ON i.CmpID=l.CmpID AND i.LoanID=l.LoanID AND @IncludeInstallments=1
 WHERE l.CmpID=@CmpID AND (@LoanID IS NULL OR l.LoanID=@LoanID) AND (@EmployeeID IS NULL OR l.EmployeeID=@EmployeeID) AND (@State IS NULL OR l.LoanState=@State)
 ORDER BY l.CreatedAt DESC,l.LoanID DESC,i.InstallmentNo;
END;
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_SelectOvertimeRequests
 @CmpID INT,@OvertimeID BIGINT=NULL,@EmployeeID BIGINT=NULL,@DateFrom DATE=NULL,@DateTo DATE=NULL,@State TINYINT=NULL
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON;
 SELECT o.*,e.EmpNum,e.EmpName FROM dbo.Emp_OvertimeRequests o JOIN dbo.Emp_Employee e ON e.EmpCompany=o.CmpID AND e.EmpID=o.EmployeeID
 WHERE o.CmpID=@CmpID AND (@OvertimeID IS NULL OR o.OvertimeID=@OvertimeID) AND (@EmployeeID IS NULL OR o.EmployeeID=@EmployeeID)
  AND (@DateFrom IS NULL OR o.WorkDate>=@DateFrom) AND (@DateTo IS NULL OR o.WorkDate<=@DateTo) AND (@State IS NULL OR o.RequestState=@State)
 ORDER BY o.WorkDate DESC,o.OvertimeID DESC;
END;
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_SelectRewardPenalties
 @CmpID INT,@ActionID BIGINT=NULL,@EmployeeID BIGINT=NULL,@DateFrom DATE=NULL,@DateTo DATE=NULL,@State TINYINT=NULL
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON;
 SELECT a.*,e.EmpNum,e.EmpName,c.ComponentName FROM dbo.Emp_RewardsPenalties a
 JOIN dbo.Emp_Employee e ON e.EmpCompany=a.CmpID AND e.EmpID=a.EmployeeID
 LEFT JOIN dbo.Emp_PayComponents c ON c.CmpID=a.CmpID AND c.ComponentID=a.PayrollComponentID
 WHERE a.CmpID=@CmpID AND (@ActionID IS NULL OR a.ActionID=@ActionID) AND (@EmployeeID IS NULL OR a.EmployeeID=@EmployeeID)
  AND (@DateFrom IS NULL OR a.ActionDate>=@DateFrom) AND (@DateTo IS NULL OR a.ActionDate<=@DateTo) AND (@State IS NULL OR a.ActionState=@State)
 ORDER BY a.ActionDate DESC,a.ActionID DESC;
END;
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_SelectTrainingRecords
 @CmpID INT,@TrainingRecordID BIGINT=NULL,@EmployeeID BIGINT=NULL,@CourseID BIGINT=NULL,@State TINYINT=NULL
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON;
 SELECT t.*,e.EmpNum,e.EmpName,c.CourseName,c.Provider,c.CourseHours,c.Cost
 FROM dbo.Emp_TrainingRecords t JOIN dbo.Emp_Employee e ON e.EmpCompany=t.CmpID AND e.EmpID=t.EmployeeID
 JOIN dbo.Emp_TrainingCourses c ON c.CmpID=t.CmpID AND c.CourseID=t.CourseID
 WHERE t.CmpID=@CmpID AND (@TrainingRecordID IS NULL OR t.TrainingRecordID=@TrainingRecordID) AND (@EmployeeID IS NULL OR t.EmployeeID=@EmployeeID)
  AND (@CourseID IS NULL OR t.CourseID=@CourseID) AND (@State IS NULL OR t.RecordState=@State)
 ORDER BY t.DateFrom DESC,t.TrainingRecordID DESC;
END;
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_SelectFinalSettlements
 @CmpID INT,@TerminationID BIGINT=NULL,@EmployeeID BIGINT=NULL,@State TINYINT=NULL
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON;
 SELECT fs.*,t.EmployeeID,e.EmpNum,e.EmpName,t.LastWorkingDate,t.TerminationReason
 FROM dbo.Emp_FinalSettlements fs JOIN dbo.Emp_Terminations t ON t.CmpID=fs.CmpID AND t.TerminationID=fs.TerminationID
 JOIN dbo.Emp_Employee e ON e.EmpCompany=t.CmpID AND e.EmpID=t.EmployeeID
 WHERE fs.CmpID=@CmpID AND (@TerminationID IS NULL OR fs.TerminationID=@TerminationID) AND (@EmployeeID IS NULL OR t.EmployeeID=@EmployeeID) AND (@State IS NULL OR fs.SettlementState=@State)
 ORDER BY fs.CalculatedAt DESC,fs.SettlementID DESC;
END;
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_SelectServiceHistory
 @CmpID INT,@EmployeeID BIGINT,@DateFrom DATE=NULL,@DateTo DATE=NULL
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON;
 SELECT h.*,op.PosName AS OldPositionName,np.PosName AS NewPositionName,ou.EmpOrgStrName AS OldDepartmentName,nu.EmpOrgStrName AS NewDepartmentName
 FROM dbo.Emp_ServiceHistory h
 LEFT JOIN dbo.Emp_Position op ON op.PosCmp=h.CmpID AND op.PosID=h.OldPositionID
 LEFT JOIN dbo.Emp_Position np ON np.PosCmp=h.CmpID AND np.PosID=h.NewPositionID
 LEFT JOIN dbo.Emp_OrganigramStructure ou ON ou.EmpOrgStrCompany=h.CmpID AND ou.EmpOrgStrID=h.OldDepartmentID
 LEFT JOIN dbo.Emp_OrganigramStructure nu ON nu.EmpOrgStrCompany=h.CmpID AND nu.EmpOrgStrID=h.NewDepartmentID
 WHERE h.CmpID=@CmpID AND h.EmployeeID=@EmployeeID AND (@DateFrom IS NULL OR h.EffectiveDate>=@DateFrom) AND (@DateTo IS NULL OR h.EffectiveDate<=@DateTo)
 ORDER BY h.EffectiveDate DESC,h.ServiceID DESC;
END;
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_UpdateStateAttendanceAdjustment
 @CmpID INT,@AttAdjID BIGINT,@State TINYINT,@UserID BIGINT,@StepNo SMALLINT=1,@Comments NVARCHAR(1000)=NULL
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 IF @State NOT IN(1,2,3) THROW 54320,N'حالة التسوية المطلوبة غير صحيحة.',1;
 BEGIN TRY
  BEGIN TRANSACTION;
  DECLARE @AttDayID BIGINT,@Type TINYINT,@NewValue DATETIME2(0),@OldValue DATETIME2(0),@CurrentIn DATETIME2(0),@CurrentOut DATETIME2(0),@RouteDecision TINYINT;
  SELECT @AttDayID=AttAdjAttDayID,@Type=AttAdjType,@NewValue=AttAdjNewValue,@OldValue=AttAdjOldValue
  FROM dbo.Emp_AttendanceAdjustments WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE AttAdjCmp=@CmpID AND AttAdjID=@AttAdjID AND AttAdjState=0;
  IF @AttDayID IS NULL THROW 54321,N'التسوية غير موجودة أو سبق البت فيها.',1;
  SET @RouteDecision=CASE WHEN @State=1 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END;
  IF @State IN(1,2) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_ApprovalRequests WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND ProcessType=10 AND EntityID=@AttAdjID)
  BEGIN
   DECLARE @ApprovalResult TINYINT,@NextApproval SMALLINT;
   EXEC dbo.Emp_DecideApprovalStep @CmpID,10,@AttAdjID,@StepNo,@UserID,@RouteDecision,@Comments,@ApprovalResult OUTPUT,@NextApproval OUTPUT,1;
   IF @State=1 AND @ApprovalResult=0
   BEGIN
    COMMIT TRANSACTION;
    SELECT AttAdjID,AttAdjState,AttAdjDecidedAt,AttAdjDecidedBy FROM dbo.Emp_AttendanceAdjustments WHERE AttAdjCmp=@CmpID AND AttAdjID=@AttAdjID;
    RETURN;
   END;
  END;  IF @State=1
  BEGIN
   SELECT @CurrentIn=AttDayFirstIn,@CurrentOut=AttDayLastOut FROM dbo.Emp_AttendanceDaily WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE AttDayCmp=@CmpID AND AttDayID=@AttDayID;
   IF (@Type=1 AND @CurrentOut IS NOT NULL AND @NewValue>@CurrentOut) OR (@Type=2 AND @CurrentIn IS NOT NULL AND @NewValue<@CurrentIn)
    THROW 54322,N'القيمة المصححة تتعارض مع الحركة المقابلة.',1;
   UPDATE dbo.Emp_AttendanceDaily
    SET AttDayFirstIn=CASE WHEN @Type=1 THEN @NewValue ELSE AttDayFirstIn END,
        AttDayLastOut=CASE WHEN @Type=2 THEN @NewValue ELSE AttDayLastOut END,
        AttDayWorkMinutes=CASE WHEN (CASE WHEN @Type=1 THEN @NewValue ELSE AttDayFirstIn END) IS NOT NULL AND (CASE WHEN @Type=2 THEN @NewValue ELSE AttDayLastOut END) IS NOT NULL
          THEN DATEDIFF(MINUTE,CASE WHEN @Type=1 THEN @NewValue ELSE AttDayFirstIn END,CASE WHEN @Type=2 THEN @NewValue ELSE AttDayLastOut END) ELSE 0 END,
        AttDayDateTime=SYSDATETIME(),AttDayUser=@UserID
   WHERE AttDayCmp=@CmpID AND AttDayID=@AttDayID;
   IF @@ROWCOUNT<>1 THROW 54323,N'سجل اليوم المرتبط بالتسوية غير موجود.',1;
  END;
  UPDATE dbo.Emp_AttendanceAdjustments SET AttAdjState=@State,AttAdjDecidedAt=SYSDATETIME(),AttAdjDecidedBy=@UserID WHERE AttAdjCmp=@CmpID AND AttAdjID=@AttAdjID AND AttAdjState=0;
  IF @@ROWCOUNT<>1 THROW 54324,N'تغيرت حالة التسوية أثناء البت فيها.',1;
  COMMIT TRANSACTION;
  SELECT AttAdjID,AttAdjState,AttAdjDecidedAt,AttAdjDecidedBy FROM dbo.Emp_AttendanceAdjustments WHERE AttAdjCmp=@CmpID AND AttAdjID=@AttAdjID;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH
  IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
  THROW;
 END CATCH;
END;
GO
ALTER TABLE dbo.Emp_AttendanceAdjustments ADD CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_AttendanceAdjustments_Decider FOREIGN KEY(AttAdjDecidedBy) REFERENCES dbo.Mng_User(UsrID);
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_ApplyServiceChange
 @CmpID INT,@EmployeeID BIGINT,@EffectiveDate DATE,@EventType TINYINT,@NewPositionID BIGINT=NULL,
 @NewSalary DECIMAL(15,3)=NULL,@CurrencyID BIGINT=NULL,@ReferenceNo NVARCHAR(100)=NULL,@Reason NVARCHAR(1000)=NULL,@UserID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 IF @EffectiveDate IS NULL OR @EffectiveDate>CONVERT(date,SYSDATETIME()) OR @EventType IS NULL OR (@NewPositionID IS NULL AND @NewSalary IS NULL) OR (@NewSalary IS NOT NULL AND (@NewSalary<=0 OR @CurrencyID IS NULL))
  THROW 54340,N'بيانات التغيير الوظيفي أو تاريخ سريانه غير صحيح.',1;
 IF @NewPositionID IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_Position WHERE PosCmp=@CmpID AND PosID=@NewPositionID AND PosState=0) THROW 54341,N'المنصب الجديد غير نشط أو لا يتبع للشركة.',1;
 IF @CurrencyID IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Acc_Currency WHERE CurCmp=@CmpID AND CurID=@CurrencyID AND CurState=0) THROW 54342,N'عملة الراتب غير نشطة أو لا تتبع للشركة.',1;
 BEGIN TRY
  BEGIN TRANSACTION;
  DECLARE @OldPositionID BIGINT,@OldDepartmentID BIGINT,@NewDepartmentID BIGINT,@OldSalary DECIMAL(15,3),@OldCurrencyID BIGINT;
  SELECT @OldPositionID=e.PosID FROM dbo.Emp_Employee e WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE e.EmpCompany=@CmpID AND e.EmpID=@EmployeeID AND e.EmpState=0;
  IF @@ROWCOUNT<>1 THROW 54343,N'الموظف غير نشط أو لا يتبع للشركة.',1;
  SELECT @OldDepartmentID=Pos.EmpOrgStrID FROM dbo.Emp_Position Pos WHERE Pos.PosCmp=@CmpID AND Pos.PosID=@OldPositionID;
  IF @NewPositionID IS NOT NULL SELECT @NewDepartmentID=Pos.EmpOrgStrID FROM dbo.Emp_Position Pos WHERE Pos.PosCmp=@CmpID AND Pos.PosID=@NewPositionID;
  SELECT @OldSalary=SalAmount,@OldCurrencyID=SalCurrencyID FROM dbo.Emp_Salary WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK)
   WHERE EmpCompany=@CmpID AND EmpID=@EmployeeID AND SalStartDate<=@EffectiveDate AND (SalEndDate IS NULL OR SalEndDate>=@EffectiveDate);
  IF @NewSalary IS NOT NULL AND @OldSalary IS NULL THROW 54344,N'لا يوجد راتب سارٍ لإغلاقه؛ صحح سجل الراتب قبل التغيير.',1;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails d JOIN dbo.Emp_PayRuns r ON r.CmpID=d.CmpID AND r.PayRunID=d.PayRunID JOIN dbo.Emp_PayPeriods p ON p.CmpID=r.CmpID AND p.PeriodID=r.PeriodID WHERE d.CmpID=@CmpID AND d.EmployeeID=@EmployeeID AND r.RunState>=1 AND p.DateTo>=@EffectiveDate)
   THROW 54345,N'يوجد مسير محسوب أو معتمد يغطي تاريخ التغيير؛ لا يمكن تغيير بياناته بأثر رجعي.',1;
  IF @NewSalary IS NOT NULL
  BEGIN
   IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_Salary WHERE EmpCompany=@CmpID AND EmpID=@EmployeeID AND SalStartDate>=@EffectiveDate)
    THROW 54346,N'يوجد راتب مستقبلي أو راتب يبدأ في تاريخ التغيير؛ راجعه قبل إضافة التغيير.',1;
   UPDATE dbo.Emp_Salary SET SalEndDate=DATEADD(DAY,-1,@EffectiveDate) WHERE EmpCompany=@CmpID AND EmpID=@EmployeeID AND SalStartDate<=@EffectiveDate AND (SalEndDate IS NULL OR SalEndDate>=@EffectiveDate);
   INSERT dbo.Emp_Salary(EmpCompany,EmpID,SalAmount,SalCurrencyID,SalStartDate,SalUser,SalDateTime) VALUES(@CmpID,@EmployeeID,@NewSalary,@CurrencyID,@EffectiveDate,@UserID,SYSDATETIME());
  END;
  IF @NewPositionID IS NOT NULL UPDATE dbo.Emp_Employee SET PosID=@NewPositionID,EmpDateTime=SYSDATETIME(),EmpUser=@UserID WHERE EmpCompany=@CmpID AND EmpID=@EmployeeID;
  INSERT dbo.Emp_ServiceHistory(CmpID,EmployeeID,EffectiveDate,EventType,OldPositionID,NewPositionID,OldDepartmentID,NewDepartmentID,OldSalary,NewSalary,CurrencyID,ReferenceNo,Reason,CreatedAt,CreatedBy,RecordState)
  VALUES(@CmpID,@EmployeeID,@EffectiveDate,@EventType,@OldPositionID,COALESCE(@NewPositionID,@OldPositionID),@OldDepartmentID,COALESCE(@NewDepartmentID,@OldDepartmentID),@OldSalary,COALESCE(@NewSalary,@OldSalary),COALESCE(@CurrencyID,@OldCurrencyID),@ReferenceNo,@Reason,SYSDATETIME(),@UserID,0);
  COMMIT TRANSACTION;
  SELECT TOP(1) ServiceID,EmployeeID,EffectiveDate,EventType FROM dbo.Emp_ServiceHistory WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND EmployeeID=@EmployeeID ORDER BY ServiceID DESC;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH
  IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
  THROW;
 END CATCH;
END;
GO

CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_SavePerformanceReview
 @CmpID INT,@ReviewID BIGINT=0,@CycleID BIGINT,@EmployeeID BIGINT,@ReviewerID BIGINT,@Score DECIMAL(7,2)=NULL,@ReviewText NVARCHAR(MAX)=NULL,@UserID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 IF @Score IS NOT NULL AND @Score NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 100 THROW 54410,N'درجة التقييم يجب أن تكون بين 0 و100.',1;
 IF @ReviewerID<>@UserID THROW 54417,N'يجب أن ينفذ التقييم المستخدم المسجل كمقيّم.',1;
 IF @ReviewerID=@EmployeeID THROW 54411,N'لا يجوز للموظف تقييم نفسه.',1;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_Employee WHERE EmpCompany=@CmpID AND EmpID=@EmployeeID) THROW 54412,N'الموظف لا يتبع للشركة.',1;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_User WHERE UsrID=@ReviewerID AND UsrCompany=@CmpID AND UsrState=0) THROW 54413,N'المقيّم غير نشط أو لا يتبع للشركة.',1;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_PerformanceCycles WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND CycleID=@CycleID AND CycleState=1) THROW 54414,N'دورة التقييم غير مفتوحة.',1;
 BEGIN TRY
  BEGIN TRANSACTION;
  IF ISNULL(@ReviewID,0)=0
  BEGIN
   IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_PerformanceReviews WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND CycleID=@CycleID AND EmployeeID=@EmployeeID)
    THROW 54415,N'يوجد تقييم سابق لهذا الموظف في الدورة المحددة.',1;
   INSERT dbo.Emp_PerformanceReviews(CmpID,CycleID,EmployeeID,ReviewerID,Score,ReviewText,ReviewState,CreatedBy)
   VALUES(@CmpID,@CycleID,@EmployeeID,@ReviewerID,@Score,@ReviewText,0,@UserID);
   SET @ReviewID=SCOPE_IDENTITY();
  END
  ELSE
  BEGIN
   UPDATE dbo.Emp_PerformanceReviews SET ReviewerID=@ReviewerID,Score=@Score,ReviewText=@ReviewText
   WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND ReviewID=@ReviewID AND CycleID=@CycleID AND EmployeeID=@EmployeeID AND ReviewState=0;
   IF @@ROWCOUNT<>1 THROW 54416,N'التقييم غير موجود أو سبق اعتماده.',1;
  END;
  COMMIT TRANSACTION;
  SELECT @ReviewID AS ReviewID;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH
  IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
  THROW;
 END CATCH;
END;
GO

 @CmpID INT,@TrainingRecordID BIGINT=0,@CourseID BIGINT,@EmployeeID BIGINT,@DateFrom DATE,@DateTo DATE,

AS
BEGIN

 IF @DateFrom IS NULL OR @DateTo IS NULL OR @DateTo<@DateFrom OR (@Score IS NOT NULL AND @Score NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 100) THROW 54420,N'فترة التدريب أو نتيجته غير صحيحة.',1;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_Employee WHERE EmpCompany=@CmpID AND EmpID=@EmployeeID) THROW 54421,N'الموظف لا يتبع للشركة.',1;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_TrainingCourses WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND CourseID=@CourseID) THROW 54422,N'الدورة التدريبية لا تتبع للشركة.',1;
 BEGIN TRY

   WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND TrainingRecordID=@TrainingRecordID AND RecordState=0;
   IF @@ROWCOUNT<>1 THROW 54423,N'سجل التدريب غير موجود أو غير قابل للتعديل.',1;
  END;
  COMMIT TRANSACTION;
  SELECT @TrainingRecordID AS TrainingRecordID;
 END TRY

CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_SaveOvertimeRequest
 @CmpID INT,@OvertimeID BIGINT=0,@EmployeeID BIGINT,@WorkDate DATE,@StartAt DATETIME2(0),@EndAt DATETIME2(0),
 @Hours DECIMAL(8,2),@Reason NVARCHAR(500),@Multiplier DECIMAL(8,4)=NULL,@UserID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 IF @WorkDate IS NULL OR @StartAt IS NULL OR @EndAt IS NULL OR CONVERT(date,@StartAt)<>@WorkDate OR CONVERT(date,@EndAt)<@WorkDate
  OR @EndAt<=@StartAt OR @Hours<=0 OR @Hours>CONVERT(decimal(8,2),DATEDIFF(MINUTE,@StartAt,@EndAt)/60.0)
  OR (@Multiplier IS NOT NULL AND @Multiplier<=0) OR NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@Reason)),N'') IS NULL
  THROW 54450,N'بيانات فترة العمل الإضافي أو مدتها غير صحيحة.',1;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_Employee WHERE EmpCompany=@CmpID AND EmpID=@EmployeeID AND EmpState=0) THROW 54451,N'الموظف غير نشط أو لا يتبع للشركة.',1;
 BEGIN TRY
  BEGIN TRANSACTION;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_OvertimeRequests WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND EmployeeID=@EmployeeID AND RequestState<>2 AND (@OvertimeID=0 OR OvertimeID<>@OvertimeID) AND @StartAt<EndAt AND @EndAt>StartAt)
   THROW 54452,N'تتداخل فترة الإضافي مع طلب آخر للموظف.',1;
  IF ISNULL(@OvertimeID,0)=0
  BEGIN
   INSERT dbo.Emp_OvertimeRequests(CmpID,EmployeeID,WorkDate,StartAt,EndAt,Hours,Reason,Multiplier,CreatedBy)
   VALUES(@CmpID,@EmployeeID,@WorkDate,@StartAt,@EndAt,@Hours,LTRIM(RTRIM(@Reason)),@Multiplier,@UserID);
   SET @OvertimeID=SCOPE_IDENTITY();
  END
  ELSE
  BEGIN
   UPDATE dbo.Emp_OvertimeRequests SET WorkDate=@WorkDate,StartAt=@StartAt,EndAt=@EndAt,Hours=@Hours,Reason=@Reason,Multiplier=@Multiplier
   WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND OvertimeID=@OvertimeID AND EmployeeID=@EmployeeID AND RequestState=0;
   IF @@ROWCOUNT<>1 THROW 54453,N'طلب الإضافي غير موجود أو غير قابل للتعديل.',1;
  END;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_ApprovalRouteSteps WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND ProcessType=2 AND RecordState=0) EXEC dbo.Emp_StartApproval @CmpID,2,@OvertimeID,@UserID,1;
  SELECT @OvertimeID AS OvertimeID;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH
  IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
  THROW;
 END CATCH;
END;
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_DecideOvertimeRequest
 @CmpID INT,@OvertimeID BIGINT,@ApproverID BIGINT,@Approve BIT,@StepNo SMALLINT=1,@Comments NVARCHAR(1000)=NULL
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@ApproverID;
 IF @Approve IS NULL THROW 54454,N'قرار اعتماد الإضافي مطلوب.',1;
 BEGIN TRY
  BEGIN TRANSACTION;
  DECLARE @EmployeeID BIGINT,@WorkDate DATE,@Hours DECIMAL(8,2),@CreatorID BIGINT,@ActualOvertime INT,@ApprovalResult TINYINT,@NextApproval SMALLINT;
  SELECT @EmployeeID=EmployeeID,@WorkDate=WorkDate,@Hours=Hours,@CreatorID=CreatedBy
  FROM dbo.Emp_OvertimeRequests WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND OvertimeID=@OvertimeID AND RequestState=0;
  IF @EmployeeID IS NULL THROW 54455,N'طلب الإضافي غير موجود أو سبق البت فيه.',1;
  IF @CreatorID=@ApproverID THROW 54456,N'لا يجوز لمنشئ طلب الإضافي اعتماده.',1;
  SET @RouteDecision=CASE WHEN @Approve=1 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_ApprovalRequests WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND ProcessType=2 AND EntityID=@OvertimeID)
  BEGIN
   EXEC dbo.Emp_DecideApprovalStep @CmpID,2,@OvertimeID,@StepNo,@ApproverID,@RouteDecision,@Comments,@ApprovalResult OUTPUT,@NextApproval OUTPUT,1;
   IF @Approve=1 AND @ApprovalResult=0
   BEGIN
    COMMIT TRANSACTION;
    SELECT OvertimeID,RequestState,ApprovedAt,ApprovedBy FROM dbo.Emp_OvertimeRequests WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND OvertimeID=@OvertimeID;
    RETURN;
   END;
  END;  IF @Approve=1
  BEGIN
   SELECT @ActualOvertime=AttDayOvertimeMinutes FROM dbo.Emp_AttendanceDaily WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK)
    WHERE AttDayCmp=@CmpID AND AttDayEmpID=@EmployeeID AND AttDayDate=@WorkDate;
   IF @ActualOvertime IS NULL THROW 54457,N'يجب معالجة الحضور لليوم قبل اعتماد الإضافي.',1;
   IF (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(Hours),0) FROM dbo.Emp_OvertimeRequests WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND EmployeeID=@EmployeeID AND WorkDate=@WorkDate AND RequestState IN(1,3) AND OvertimeID<>@OvertimeID)+@Hours>CONVERT(decimal(10,2),@ActualOvertime/60.0)
    THROW 54458,N'ساعات الإضافي المعتمدة تتجاوز الزيادة المسجلة في الحضور.',1;
  END;
  UPDATE dbo.Emp_OvertimeRequests SET RequestState=CASE WHEN @Approve=1 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,ApprovedAt=SYSDATETIME(),ApprovedBy=@ApproverID
  WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND OvertimeID=@OvertimeID AND RequestState=0;
  IF @@ROWCOUNT<>1 THROW 54459,N'تغيرت حالة طلب الإضافي أثناء البت فيه.',1;
  COMMIT TRANSACTION;
  SELECT OvertimeID,RequestState,ApprovedAt,ApprovedBy FROM dbo.Emp_OvertimeRequests WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND OvertimeID=@OvertimeID;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH
  IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
  THROW;
 END CATCH;
END;
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_SaveEmployeeAddress
 @CmpID INT,@AddressID BIGINT=0,@EmployeeID BIGINT,@AddressType TINYINT,@Country NVARCHAR(100)=NULL,@City NVARCHAR(100)=NULL,
 @District NVARCHAR(150)=NULL,@AddressText NVARCHAR(500),@PostalCode NVARCHAR(30)=NULL,@StartDate DATE=NULL,@EndDate DATE=NULL,
 @IsPrimary BIT=0,@RecordState TINYINT=0,@UserID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 IF @AddressType IS NULL OR NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@AddressText)),N'') IS NULL OR (@StartDate IS NOT NULL AND @EndDate IS NOT NULL AND @EndDate<@StartDate) OR @IsPrimary IS NULL OR @RecordState NOT IN(0,1) THROW 54510,N'بيانات عنوان الموظف غير صحيحة.',1;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_Employee WHERE EmpCompany=@CmpID AND EmpID=@EmployeeID) THROW 54511,N'الموظف لا يتبع للشركة.',1;
 BEGIN TRY
  BEGIN TRANSACTION;
  IF @IsPrimary=1 AND @RecordState=0
   UPDATE dbo.Emp_EmployeeAddresses SET IsPrimary=0 WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND EmployeeID=@EmployeeID AND RecordState=0 AND AddressID<>ISNULL(@AddressID,0)
    AND ISNULL(StartDate,CONVERT(date,'19000101'))<=ISNULL(@EndDate,CONVERT(date,'99991231')) AND ISNULL(EndDate,CONVERT(date,'99991231'))>=ISNULL(@StartDate,CONVERT(date,'19000101'));
  IF ISNULL(@AddressID,0)=0
  BEGIN
   INSERT dbo.Emp_EmployeeAddresses(CmpID,EmployeeID,AddressType,Country,City,District,AddressText,PostalCode,StartDate,EndDate,IsPrimary,RecordState,CreatedBy)
   VALUES(@CmpID,@EmployeeID,@AddressType,@Country,@City,@District,LTRIM(RTRIM(@AddressText)),@PostalCode,@StartDate,@EndDate,@IsPrimary,@RecordState,@UserID);
   SET @AddressID=SCOPE_IDENTITY();
  END
  ELSE
  BEGIN
   UPDATE dbo.Emp_EmployeeAddresses SET AddressType=@AddressType,Country=@Country,City=@City,District=@District,AddressText=@AddressText,PostalCode=@PostalCode,StartDate=@StartDate,EndDate=@EndDate,IsPrimary=@IsPrimary,RecordState=@RecordState
   WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND EmployeeID=@EmployeeID AND AddressID=@AddressID;
   IF @@ROWCOUNT<>1 THROW 54512,N'عنوان الموظف غير موجود.',1;
  END;
  COMMIT TRANSACTION;
  SELECT @AddressID AS AddressID;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH
  IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
  THROW;
 END CATCH;
END;
GO

/* Effective dated contract maintenance with tenant checks and overlap protection. */
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_SaveEmploymentContract
 @CmpID INT,@ConID BIGINT=0,@EmployeeID BIGINT,@ContractTypeID BIGINT,@StartDate DATE,@EndDate DATE=NULL,@UserID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 IF @StartDate IS NULL OR (@EndDate IS NOT NULL AND @EndDate<@StartDate) THROW 54530,N'فترة العقد غير صحيحة.',1;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_Employee WHERE EmpCompany=@CmpID AND EmpID=@EmployeeID) THROW 54531,N'الموظف لا يتبع للشركة.',1;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_EmploymentTypes WHERE EmpTypeCmp=@CmpID AND EmpTypeID=@ContractTypeID AND EmpTypeState=0) THROW 54532,N'نوع العقد غير فعال أو لا يتبع للشركة.',1;
 BEGIN TRY
  BEGIN TRANSACTION;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_Contract WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE EmpCompany=@CmpID AND EmpID=@EmployeeID AND ConID<>ISNULL(@ConID,0)
   AND @StartDate<=ISNULL(ConEndDate,CONVERT(date,'99991231')) AND ISNULL(@EndDate,CONVERT(date,'99991231'))>=ConStartDate
   AND NOT(ISNULL(@ConID,0)=0 AND ConEndDate IS NULL AND ConStartDate<@StartDate))
   THROW 54533,N'فترة العقد تتداخل مع عقد آخر للموظف.',1;
  IF ISNULL(@ConID,0)=0
  BEGIN
   UPDATE dbo.Emp_Contract SET ConEndDate=DATEADD(DAY,-1,@StartDate)
   WHERE EmpCompany=@CmpID AND EmpID=@EmployeeID AND ConEndDate IS NULL AND ConStartDate<@StartDate;
   INSERT dbo.Emp_Contract(EmpCompany,EmpID,ConType,ConStartDate,ConEndDate,ConUser,ConDateTime)
   VALUES(@CmpID,@EmployeeID,@ContractTypeID,@StartDate,@EndDate,@UserID,SYSDATETIME());
   SET @ConID=SCOPE_IDENTITY();
  END
  ELSE
  BEGIN
   UPDATE dbo.Emp_Contract SET ConType=@ContractTypeID,ConStartDate=@StartDate,ConEndDate=@EndDate,ConUser=@UserID,ConDateTime=SYSDATETIME()
   WHERE EmpCompany=@CmpID AND EmpID=@EmployeeID AND ConID=@ConID;
   IF @@ROWCOUNT<>1 THROW 54534,N'العقد غير موجود ضمن الشركة والموظف المحددين.',1;
  END;
  COMMIT TRANSACTION;
  SELECT @ConID AS ContractID;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH
  IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
  THROW;
 END CATCH;
END;
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_SelectContracts @CmpID INT,@EmployeeID BIGINT,@IncludeExpired BIT=0
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON;
 SELECT c.ConID AS ContractID,c.EmpID AS EmployeeID,c.ConType AS ContractTypeID,t.EmpTypeName AS ContractTypeName,c.ConStartDate AS StartDate,c.ConEndDate AS EndDate,c.ConUser AS CreatedBy,c.ConDateTime AS CreatedAt
 FROM dbo.Emp_Contract c JOIN dbo.Emp_EmploymentTypes t ON t.EmpTypeCmp=c.EmpCompany AND t.EmpTypeID=c.ConType
 WHERE c.EmpCompany=@CmpID AND c.EmpID=@EmployeeID AND (@IncludeExpired=1 OR c.ConEndDate IS NULL OR c.ConEndDate>=CONVERT(date,SYSDATETIME()))
 ORDER BY c.ConStartDate DESC,c.ConID DESC;
END;

/* Replace permissive leave policy writes with effective-date and tenant-safe variants. */
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_SaveLeavePolicy
 @CmpID INT,@PolicyID BIGINT=0,@PolicyName NVARCHAR(150),@EffectiveFrom DATE,@EffectiveTo DATE=NULL,
 @AccrualFrequency TINYINT,@ProrationMethod TINYINT,@AllowNegative BIT=0,@UserID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 IF NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@PolicyName)),N'') IS NULL OR @EffectiveFrom IS NULL OR (@EffectiveTo IS NOT NULL AND @EffectiveTo<@EffectiveFrom) OR @AllowNegative IS NULL THROW 54560,N'بيانات سياسة الإجازات غير صحيحة.',1;
 BEGIN TRY
  BEGIN TRANSACTION;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_LeavePolicies WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND RecordState=0 AND PolicyID<>ISNULL(@PolicyID,0) AND EffectiveFrom<=ISNULL(@EffectiveTo,CONVERT(date,'99991231')) AND ISNULL(EffectiveTo,CONVERT(date,'99991231'))>=@EffectiveFrom) THROW 54561,N'تتداخل سياسة الإجازات مع سياسة فعالة أخرى للشركة.',1;
  IF ISNULL(@PolicyID,0)<>0 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_EmployeeLeavePolicies ep WHERE ep.CmpID=@CmpID AND ep.PolicyID=@PolicyID AND ep.RecordState=0
   AND (ep.EffectiveFrom<@EffectiveFrom OR (@EffectiveTo IS NOT NULL AND (ep.EffectiveTo IS NULL OR ep.EffectiveTo>@EffectiveTo))))
   THROW 54567,N'تعديل مدة السياسة سيترك إسناداً وظيفياً خارج فترة السياسة.',1;
  IF ISNULL(@PolicyID,0)=0
  BEGIN
   INSERT dbo.Emp_LeavePolicies(CmpID,PolicyName,EffectiveFrom,EffectiveTo,AccrualFrequency,ProrationMethod,AllowNegative,CreatedBy) VALUES(@CmpID,LTRIM(RTRIM(@PolicyName)),@EffectiveFrom,@EffectiveTo,@AccrualFrequency,@ProrationMethod,@AllowNegative,@UserID);
   SET @PolicyID=SCOPE_IDENTITY();
  END
  ELSE
  BEGIN
   UPDATE dbo.Emp_LeavePolicies SET PolicyName=LTRIM(RTRIM(@PolicyName)),EffectiveFrom=@EffectiveFrom,EffectiveTo=@EffectiveTo,AccrualFrequency=@AccrualFrequency,ProrationMethod=@ProrationMethod,AllowNegative=@AllowNegative WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND PolicyID=@PolicyID AND RecordState=0;
   IF @@ROWCOUNT<>1 THROW 54562,N'سياسة الإجازات غير موجودة أو غير قابلة للتعديل.',1;
  END;
  COMMIT TRANSACTION;
  SELECT @PolicyID AS PolicyID;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH
  IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
  THROW;
 END CATCH;
END;
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_SaveLeavePolicyType
 @CmpID INT,@PolicyTypeID BIGINT=0,@PolicyID BIGINT,@LeaveTypeID BIGINT,@AnnualEntitlement DECIMAL(9,2),@MaxBalance DECIMAL(9,2)=NULL,@MinimumServiceMonths INT=0,@CarryForwardLimit DECIMAL(9,2)=NULL,@UserID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 IF @AnnualEntitlement IS NULL OR @AnnualEntitlement<0 OR (@MaxBalance IS NOT NULL AND @MaxBalance<0) OR @MinimumServiceMonths IS NULL OR @MinimumServiceMonths<0 OR (@CarryForwardLimit IS NOT NULL AND @CarryForwardLimit<0) THROW 54563,N'قيم استحقاق الإجازة غير صحيحة.',1;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_LeavePolicies WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND PolicyID=@PolicyID AND RecordState=0) THROW 54564,N'سياسة الإجازات غير نشطة أو لا تتبع للشركة.',1;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_LeaveTypes WHERE LeaveTypeCmp=@CmpID AND LeaveTypeID=@LeaveTypeID AND LeaveTypeState=0) THROW 54565,N'نوع الإجازة غير نشط أو لا يتبع للشركة.',1;
 BEGIN TRY
  BEGIN TRANSACTION;
  IF ISNULL(@PolicyTypeID,0)=0
  BEGIN
   INSERT dbo.Emp_LeavePolicyTypes(CmpID,PolicyID,LeaveTypeID,AnnualEntitlement,MaxBalance,MinimumServiceMonths,CarryForwardLimit) VALUES(@CmpID,@PolicyID,@LeaveTypeID,@AnnualEntitlement,@MaxBalance,@MinimumServiceMonths,@CarryForwardLimit);
   SET @PolicyTypeID=SCOPE_IDENTITY();
  END
  ELSE
  BEGIN
   UPDATE dbo.Emp_LeavePolicyTypes SET PolicyID=@PolicyID,LeaveTypeID=@LeaveTypeID,AnnualEntitlement=@AnnualEntitlement,MaxBalance=@MaxBalance,MinimumServiceMonths=@MinimumServiceMonths,CarryForwardLimit=@CarryForwardLimit WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND PolicyTypeID=@PolicyTypeID AND RecordState=0;
   IF @@ROWCOUNT<>1 THROW 54566,N'تفصيل سياسة الإجازة غير موجود أو غير قابل للتعديل.',1;
  END;
  COMMIT TRANSACTION;
  SELECT @PolicyTypeID AS PolicyTypeID;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH
  IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
  THROW;
 END CATCH;
END;
GO

CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_AssignEmployeeLeavePolicy
 @CmpID INT,@EmployeeID BIGINT,@PolicyID BIGINT,@EffectiveFrom DATE,@EffectiveTo DATE=NULL,@UserID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 IF @EffectiveFrom IS NULL OR (@EffectiveTo IS NOT NULL AND @EffectiveTo<@EffectiveFrom) THROW 54570,N'فترة إسناد سياسة الإجازات غير صحيحة.',1;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_Employee WHERE EmpCompany=@CmpID AND EmpID=@EmployeeID AND EmpState=0) THROW 54571,N'الموظف غير نشط أو لا يتبع للشركة.',1;
 BEGIN TRY
  BEGIN TRANSACTION;
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_LeavePolicies WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND PolicyID=@PolicyID AND RecordState=0 AND EffectiveFrom<=@EffectiveFrom AND (EffectiveTo IS NULL OR ( @EffectiveTo IS NOT NULL AND EffectiveTo>=@EffectiveTo))) THROW 54572,N'سياسة الإجازات لا تغطي كامل فترة الإسناد المطلوبة.',1;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_EmployeeLeavePolicies WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND EmployeeID=@EmployeeID AND RecordState=0 AND EffectiveFrom<=ISNULL(@EffectiveTo,CONVERT(date,'99991231')) AND ISNULL(EffectiveTo,CONVERT(date,'99991231'))>=@EffectiveFrom) THROW 54573,N'تتداخل سياسة الإجازات مع إسناد قائم للموظف.',1;
  INSERT dbo.Emp_EmployeeLeavePolicies(CmpID,EmployeeID,PolicyID,EffectiveFrom,EffectiveTo,CreatedBy) VALUES(@CmpID,@EmployeeID,@PolicyID,@EffectiveFrom,@EffectiveTo,@UserID);
  DECLARE @EmployeePolicyID BIGINT=SCOPE_IDENTITY();
  COMMIT TRANSACTION;
  SELECT @EmployeePolicyID AS EmployeePolicyID;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH
  IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
  THROW;
 END CATCH;
END;
GO

IF COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.Emp_LeaveBalanceTransactions',N'BalanceDelta') IS NULL
 ALTER TABLE dbo.Emp_LeaveBalanceTransactions ADD BalanceDelta DECIMAL(9,2) NULL;
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_SaveLeaveBalance
 @CmpID INT,@EmployeeID BIGINT,@LeaveTypeID BIGINT,@BalanceYear SMALLINT,
 @OpeningBalance DECIMAL(9,2)=0,@Earned DECIMAL(9,2)=0,@Adjusted DECIMAL(9,2)=0,@UserID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 IF @BalanceYear NOT BETWEEN 1900 AND 9999 OR @OpeningBalance IS NULL OR @OpeningBalance<0 OR @Earned IS NULL OR @Earned<0 OR @Adjusted IS NULL THROW 54580,N'بيانات رصيد الإجازة غير صحيحة.',1;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_Employee WHERE EmpCompany=@CmpID AND EmpID=@EmployeeID) THROW 54581,N'الموظف لا يتبع للشركة.',1;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_LeaveTypes WHERE LeaveTypeCmp=@CmpID AND LeaveTypeID=@LeaveTypeID AND LeaveTypeState=0) THROW 54582,N'نوع الإجازة غير صالح.',1;
 BEGIN TRY
  BEGIN TRANSACTION;
  DECLARE @BalanceID BIGINT,@OldOpening DECIMAL(9,2),@OldEarned DECIMAL(9,2),@OldAdjusted DECIMAL(9,2),@Used DECIMAL(9,2),@OpeningDelta DECIMAL(9,2),@EarnedDelta DECIMAL(9,2),@AdjustedDelta DECIMAL(9,2),@ActorText NVARCHAR(500)=N'تحديث إداري لرصيد الإجازة';
  SELECT @BalanceID=BalanceID,@OldOpening=OpeningBalance,@OldEarned=Earned,@OldAdjusted=Adjusted,@Used=Used FROM dbo.Emp_LeaveBalances WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK)
  WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND EmployeeID=@EmployeeID AND LeaveTypeID=@LeaveTypeID AND BalanceYear=@BalanceYear;
  IF @BalanceID IS NULL
  BEGIN
   INSERT dbo.Emp_LeaveBalances(CmpID,EmployeeID,LeaveTypeID,BalanceYear,OpeningBalance,Earned,Used,Adjusted,RecordState,CreatedAt,CreatedBy)
   VALUES(@CmpID,@EmployeeID,@LeaveTypeID,@BalanceYear,@OpeningBalance,@Earned,0,@Adjusted,0,SYSDATETIME(),@UserID);
   SET @BalanceID=SCOPE_IDENTITY();
   IF @OpeningBalance<>0 INSERT dbo.Emp_LeaveBalanceTransactions(CmpID,BalanceID,TransactionDate,TransactionType,Quantity,BalanceDelta,Description,CreatedBy) VALUES(@CmpID,@BalanceID,DATEFROMPARTS(@BalanceYear,1,1),4,@OpeningBalance,@OpeningBalance,N'رصيد افتتاحي',@UserID);
   IF @Earned<>0 INSERT dbo.Emp_LeaveBalanceTransactions(CmpID,BalanceID,TransactionDate,TransactionType,Quantity,BalanceDelta,Description,CreatedBy) VALUES(@CmpID,@BalanceID,DATEFROMPARTS(@BalanceYear,1,1),1,@Earned,@Earned,N'استحقاق مرحل عند إنشاء الرصيد',@UserID);
   IF @Adjusted<>0 INSERT dbo.Emp_LeaveBalanceTransactions(CmpID,BalanceID,TransactionDate,TransactionType,Quantity,BalanceDelta,Description,CreatedBy) VALUES(@CmpID,@BalanceID,DATEFROMPARTS(@BalanceYear,1,1),4,ABS(@Adjusted),@Adjusted,N'تسوية إدارية ابتدائية',@UserID);
  END
  ELSE
  BEGIN
   SET @OpeningDelta=@OpeningBalance-@OldOpening; SET @EarnedDelta=@Earned-@OldEarned; SET @AdjustedDelta=@Adjusted-@OldAdjusted;
   IF @OpeningDelta<>0 AND (@Used<>0 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_LeaveBalanceTransactions WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND BalanceID=@BalanceID)) THROW 54583,N'لا يمكن تغيير الرصيد الافتتاحي بعد تسجيل استعمال أو حركات؛ استخدم التسوية الإدارية.',1;
   UPDATE dbo.Emp_LeaveBalances SET OpeningBalance=@OpeningBalance,Earned=@Earned,Adjusted=@Adjusted,RecordState=0 WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND BalanceID=@BalanceID;
   IF @OpeningDelta<>0 INSERT dbo.Emp_LeaveBalanceTransactions(CmpID,BalanceID,TransactionDate,TransactionType,Quantity,BalanceDelta,Description,CreatedBy) VALUES(@CmpID,@BalanceID,DATEFROMPARTS(@BalanceYear,1,1),4,ABS(@OpeningDelta),@OpeningDelta,N'تصحيح رصيد افتتاحي',@UserID);
   IF @EarnedDelta>0 INSERT dbo.Emp_LeaveBalanceTransactions(CmpID,BalanceID,TransactionDate,TransactionType,Quantity,BalanceDelta,Description,CreatedBy) VALUES(@CmpID,@BalanceID,CONVERT(date,SYSDATETIME()),1,@EarnedDelta,@EarnedDelta,N'إضافة استحقاق',@UserID);
   IF @EarnedDelta<0 INSERT dbo.Emp_LeaveBalanceTransactions(CmpID,BalanceID,TransactionDate,TransactionType,Quantity,BalanceDelta,Description,CreatedBy) VALUES(@CmpID,@BalanceID,CONVERT(date,SYSDATETIME()),5,ABS(@EarnedDelta),@EarnedDelta,N'عكس استحقاق',@UserID);
   IF @AdjustedDelta<>0 INSERT dbo.Emp_LeaveBalanceTransactions(CmpID,BalanceID,TransactionDate,TransactionType,Quantity,BalanceDelta,Description,CreatedBy) VALUES(@CmpID,@BalanceID,CONVERT(date,SYSDATETIME()),4,ABS(@AdjustedDelta),@AdjustedDelta,N'تسوية إدارية',@UserID);
  END;
  COMMIT TRANSACTION;
  SELECT BalanceID,ClosingBalance FROM dbo.Emp_LeaveBalances WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND BalanceID=@BalanceID;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH
  IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
  THROW;
 END CATCH;
END;
GO
GO

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Emp_TrainingSessions',N'U') IS NULL
BEGIN
 CREATE TABLE dbo.Emp_TrainingSessions
 (
  SessionID BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT PK_Emp_TrainingSessions PRIMARY KEY,
  CmpID INT NOT NULL,CourseID BIGINT NOT NULL,SessionName NVARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
  StartsAt DATETIME2(0) NOT NULL,EndsAt DATETIME2(0) NOT NULL,Trainer NVARCHAR(200) NULL,Location NVARCHAR(250) NULL,
  Capacity INT NULL,SessionState TINYINT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Emp_TrainingSessions_State DEFAULT(0),
  CreatedAt DATETIME2(0) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Emp_TrainingSessions_Created DEFAULT(SYSDATETIME()),CreatedBy BIGINT NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT UQ_Emp_TrainingSessions_Cmp_ID UNIQUE(CmpID,SessionID),
  CONSTRAINT CK_Emp_TrainingSessions_Values CHECK(EndsAt>StartsAt AND (Capacity IS NULL OR Capacity>0) AND SessionState IN(0,1,2)),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_TrainingSessions_Course FOREIGN KEY(CmpID,CourseID) REFERENCES dbo.Emp_TrainingCourses(CmpID,CourseID),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_TrainingSessions_Company FOREIGN KEY(CmpID) REFERENCES dbo.Mng_Company(CmpID),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_TrainingSessions_User FOREIGN KEY(CreatedBy) REFERENCES dbo.Mng_User(UsrID)
 );
END;
GO
IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Emp_TrainingSessionAttendance',N'U') IS NULL
BEGIN
 CREATE TABLE dbo.Emp_TrainingSessionAttendance
 (
  AttendanceID BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT PK_Emp_TrainingSessionAttendance PRIMARY KEY,
  CmpID INT NOT NULL,SessionID BIGINT NOT NULL,EmployeeID BIGINT NOT NULL,AttendanceState TINYINT NOT NULL,
  AttendedMinutes INT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Emp_TrainingSessionAttendance_Minutes DEFAULT(0),Score DECIMAL(7,2) NULL,
  CreatedAt DATETIME2(0) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Emp_TrainingSessionAttendance_Created DEFAULT(SYSDATETIME()),CreatedBy BIGINT NOT NULL,
  UpdatedAt DATETIME2(0) NULL,UpdatedBy BIGINT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT UQ_Emp_TrainingSessionAttendance_Cmp_ID UNIQUE(CmpID,AttendanceID),
  CONSTRAINT UQ_Emp_TrainingSessionAttendance_SessionEmployee UNIQUE(CmpID,SessionID,EmployeeID),
  CONSTRAINT CK_Emp_TrainingSessionAttendance_Values CHECK(AttendanceState IN(1,2,3) AND AttendedMinutes>=0 AND (Score IS NULL OR Score BETWEEN 0 AND 100)),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_TrainingSessionAttendance_Session FOREIGN KEY(CmpID,SessionID) REFERENCES dbo.Emp_TrainingSessions(CmpID,SessionID),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_TrainingSessionAttendance_Company FOREIGN KEY(CmpID) REFERENCES dbo.Mng_Company(CmpID),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_TrainingSessionAttendance_User FOREIGN KEY(CreatedBy) REFERENCES dbo.Mng_User(UsrID)
 );
END;
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_SaveTrainingSession
 @CmpID INT,@SessionID BIGINT=0,@CourseID BIGINT,@SessionName NVARCHAR(200),@StartsAt DATETIME2(0),@EndsAt DATETIME2(0),
 @Trainer NVARCHAR(200)=NULL,@Location NVARCHAR(250)=NULL,@Capacity INT=NULL,@SessionState TINYINT=0,@UserID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 IF NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@SessionName)),N'') IS NULL OR @StartsAt IS NULL OR @EndsAt IS NULL OR @EndsAt<=@StartsAt OR (@Capacity IS NOT NULL AND @Capacity<=0) OR @SessionState IS NULL OR @SessionState NOT IN(0,1,2) THROW 54600,N'بيانات جلسة التدريب غير صحيحة.',1;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_TrainingCourses WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND CourseID=@CourseID AND RecordState=0) THROW 54601,N'الدورة التدريبية غير نشطة أو لا تتبع للشركة.',1;
 BEGIN TRY
  BEGIN TRANSACTION;
  IF ISNULL(@SessionID,0)=0
  BEGIN
   INSERT dbo.Emp_TrainingSessions(CmpID,CourseID,SessionName,StartsAt,EndsAt,Trainer,Location,Capacity,SessionState,CreatedBy) VALUES(@CmpID,@CourseID,LTRIM(RTRIM(@SessionName)),@StartsAt,@EndsAt,@Trainer,@Location,@Capacity,@SessionState,@UserID);
   SET @SessionID=SCOPE_IDENTITY();
  END
  ELSE
  BEGIN
   IF @Capacity IS NOT NULL AND @Capacity<(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.Emp_TrainingSessionAttendance WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND SessionID=@SessionID AND AttendanceState=1) THROW 54602,N'السعة أقل من عدد المشاركين المسجلين.',1;
   UPDATE dbo.Emp_TrainingSessions SET CourseID=@CourseID,SessionName=LTRIM(RTRIM(@SessionName)),StartsAt=@StartsAt,EndsAt=@EndsAt,Trainer=@Trainer,Location=@Location,Capacity=@Capacity,SessionState=@SessionState
   WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND SessionID=@SessionID;
   IF @@ROWCOUNT<>1 THROW 54603,N'جلسة التدريب غير موجودة ضمن الشركة.',1;
  END;
  COMMIT TRANSACTION;
  SELECT @SessionID AS SessionID;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH
  IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
  THROW;
 END CATCH;
END;
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_SaveTrainingSessionAttendance
 @CmpID INT,@SessionID BIGINT,@EmployeeID BIGINT,@AttendanceState TINYINT,@AttendedMinutes INT=0,@Score DECIMAL(7,2)=NULL,@UserID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 IF @AttendanceState IS NULL OR @AttendanceState NOT IN(1,2,3) OR @AttendedMinutes IS NULL OR @AttendedMinutes<0 OR (@AttendanceState<>1 AND @AttendedMinutes<>0) OR (@Score IS NOT NULL AND @Score NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 100) THROW 54604,N'بيانات حضور جلسة التدريب غير صحيحة.',1;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_Employee WHERE EmpCompany=@CmpID AND EmpID=@EmployeeID AND EmpState=0) THROW 54605,N'الموظف غير نشط أو لا يتبع للشركة.',1;
 BEGIN TRY
  BEGIN TRANSACTION;
  DECLARE @StartsAt DATETIME2(0),@EndsAt DATETIME2(0),@Capacity INT,@Existing BIGINT;
  SELECT @StartsAt=StartsAt,@EndsAt=EndsAt,@Capacity=Capacity FROM dbo.Emp_TrainingSessions WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND SessionID=@SessionID AND SessionState<>2;
  IF @StartsAt IS NULL THROW 54606,N'جلسة التدريب غير موجودة أو ملغاة.',1;
  IF @AttendedMinutes>DATEDIFF(MINUTE,@StartsAt,@EndsAt) THROW 54607,N'دقائق الحضور تتجاوز مدة الجلسة.',1;
  IF @AttendanceState=1 AND @Capacity IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_TrainingSessionAttendance WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND SessionID=@SessionID AND EmployeeID=@EmployeeID AND AttendanceState=1) AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.Emp_TrainingSessionAttendance WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND SessionID=@SessionID AND AttendanceState=1)>=@Capacity THROW 54608,N'اكتملت سعة الجلسة.',1;
  SELECT @Existing=AttendanceID FROM dbo.Emp_TrainingSessionAttendance WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND SessionID=@SessionID AND EmployeeID=@EmployeeID;
  IF @Existing IS NULL INSERT dbo.Emp_TrainingSessionAttendance(CmpID,SessionID,EmployeeID,AttendanceState,AttendedMinutes,Score,CreatedBy) VALUES(@CmpID,@SessionID,@EmployeeID,@AttendanceState,@AttendedMinutes,@Score,@UserID);
  ELSE UPDATE dbo.Emp_TrainingSessionAttendance SET AttendanceState=@AttendanceState,AttendedMinutes=@AttendedMinutes,Score=@Score,UpdatedAt=SYSDATETIME(),UpdatedBy=@UserID WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND AttendanceID=@Existing;
  COMMIT TRANSACTION;
  SELECT ISNULL(@Existing,SCOPE_IDENTITY()) AS AttendanceID;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH
  IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
  THROW;
 END CATCH;
END;
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_SelectTrainingSessionAttendance @CmpID INT,@SessionID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON;
 SELECT s.SessionID,s.CourseID,c.CourseName,s.SessionName,s.StartsAt,s.EndsAt,s.Trainer,s.Location,s.Capacity,s.SessionState,
  a.AttendanceID,a.EmployeeID,e.EmpNum,e.EmpName,a.AttendanceState,a.AttendedMinutes,a.Score,a.CreatedAt,a.CreatedBy,a.UpdatedAt,a.UpdatedBy
 FROM dbo.Emp_TrainingSessions s JOIN dbo.Emp_TrainingCourses c ON c.CmpID=s.CmpID AND c.CourseID=s.CourseID
 LEFT JOIN dbo.Emp_TrainingSessionAttendance a ON a.CmpID=s.CmpID AND a.SessionID=s.SessionID
 LEFT JOIN dbo.Emp_Employee e ON e.EmpCompany=a.CmpID AND e.EmpID=a.EmployeeID
 WHERE s.CmpID=@CmpID AND s.SessionID=@SessionID ORDER BY e.EmpName,e.EmpID;
END;
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_SelectEmployeePaySlip @CmpID INT,@PayRunID BIGINT,@EmployeeID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_PayRuns WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND PayRunID=@PayRunID AND RunState IN(2,3)) THROW 54610,N'قسيمة الراتب متاحة بعد اعتماد المسير فقط.',1;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND PayRunID=@PayRunID AND EmployeeID=@EmployeeID) THROW 54611,N'لا توجد تفاصيل قسيمة للموظف ضمن المسير.',1;
 DECLARE @CalculationVersion INT=(SELECT CalculationVersion FROM dbo.Emp_PayRuns WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND PayRunID=@PayRunID);
 SELECT r.PayRunID,r.RunState,r.CurrencyID,r.CalculationVersion,p.PeriodName,p.DateFrom,p.DateTo,e.EmpID,e.EmpNum,e.EmpName,
  SUM(CASE WHEN d.LineKind=1 THEN d.Amount ELSE 0 END) AS EmployeeGross,
  SUM(CASE WHEN d.LineKind=2 THEN ISNULL(d.CollectedAmount,0) ELSE 0 END) AS DeductionCollected,
  SUM(CASE WHEN d.LineKind=2 THEN d.Amount ELSE 0 END) AS DeductionRequested,
  SUM(CASE WHEN d.LineKind=2 THEN ISNULL(d.DeferredAmount,0) ELSE 0 END) AS DeductionDeferred,
  CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN d.LineKind=1 THEN d.Amount ELSE 0 END)>SUM(CASE WHEN d.LineKind=2 THEN ISNULL(d.CollectedAmount,0) ELSE 0 END)
   THEN SUM(CASE WHEN d.LineKind=1 THEN d.Amount ELSE 0 END)-SUM(CASE WHEN d.LineKind=2 THEN ISNULL(d.CollectedAmount,0) ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END AS NetPayable,
  MAX(s.NetBeforeAllocation) AS NetBeforeAllocation,MAX(s.NetDeficit) AS NetDeficit,MAX(s.NetPayable) AS SnapshotNetPayable,
  MAX(s.MaxDeferredPerEmployee) AS MaxDeferredPerEmployee,MAX(s.MaxDeferredPerRun) AS MaxDeferredPerRun,MAX(s.ZeroNetApprovalMode) AS ZeroNetApprovalMode,MAX(r.NetDeficitTotal) AS RunNetDeficitTotal
 FROM dbo.Emp_PayRuns r JOIN dbo.Emp_PayPeriods p ON p.CmpID=r.CmpID AND p.PeriodID=r.PeriodID JOIN dbo.Emp_Employee e ON e.EmpCompany=r.CmpID AND e.EmpID=@EmployeeID
 JOIN dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails d ON d.CmpID=r.CmpID AND d.PayRunID=r.PayRunID AND d.EmployeeID=e.EmpID
 LEFT JOIN dbo.Emp_PayrollDeficitSnapshots s ON s.CmpID=r.CmpID AND s.PayRunID=r.PayRunID AND s.CalculationVersion=r.CalculationVersion AND s.EmployeeID=e.EmpID
 WHERE r.CmpID=@CmpID AND r.PayRunID=@PayRunID GROUP BY r.PayRunID,r.RunState,r.CurrencyID,r.CalculationVersion,p.PeriodName,p.DateFrom,p.DateTo,e.EmpID,e.EmpNum,e.EmpName;
 SELECT d.ComponentID,d.LineKind,d.Description,d.Quantity,d.Rate,d.Amount AS RequestedAmount,ISNULL(d.CollectedAmount,d.Amount) AS CollectedAmount,ISNULL(d.DeferredAmount,0) AS DeferredAmount,d.SourceType,d.SourceID,
  a.DeductionPriority,a.IsMandatoryDeduction,a.CanDefer,a.ArrearID
 FROM dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails d LEFT JOIN dbo.Emp_PayrollDeductionAllocations a ON a.CmpID=d.CmpID AND a.PayRunID=d.PayRunID AND a.CalculationVersion=@CalculationVersion AND a.PayrollDetailID=d.PayrollDetailID
 WHERE d.CmpID=@CmpID AND d.PayRunID=@PayRunID AND d.EmployeeID=@EmployeeID ORDER BY d.LineKind,d.PayrollDetailID;
END;
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_SelectExpiringEmployeeDocuments @CmpID INT,@AsOfDate DATE,@DaysAhead INT=30
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON;
 IF @AsOfDate IS NULL OR @DaysAhead<0 THROW 54612,N'فترة تنبيه انتهاء الوثائق غير صحيحة.',1;
 SELECT d.DocumentID,d.EmployeeID,e.EmpNum,e.EmpName,d.DocumentTypeID,t.DocTypeName,d.DocumentNo,d.IssueDate,d.ExpiryDate,d.FileName,d.FilePath,d.RecordState
 FROM dbo.Emp_EmployeeDocuments d JOIN dbo.Emp_Employee e ON e.EmpCompany=d.CmpID AND e.EmpID=d.EmployeeID JOIN dbo.Emp_DocumentTypes t ON t.DocTypeCmp=d.CmpID AND t.DocTypeID=d.DocumentTypeID
 WHERE d.CmpID=@CmpID AND d.RecordState=0 AND d.ExpiryDate>=@AsOfDate AND d.ExpiryDate<=DATEADD(DAY,@DaysAhead,@AsOfDate) ORDER BY d.ExpiryDate,e.EmpName;
END;
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_SelectExpiringContracts @CmpID INT,@AsOfDate DATE,@DaysAhead INT=30
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON;
 IF @AsOfDate IS NULL OR @DaysAhead<0 THROW 54613,N'فترة تنبيه انتهاء العقود غير صحيحة.',1;
 SELECT c.ConID AS ContractID,c.EmpID AS EmployeeID,e.EmpNum,e.EmpName,c.ConType AS ContractTypeID,t.EmpTypeName,c.ConStartDate,c.ConEndDate
 FROM dbo.Emp_Contract c JOIN dbo.Emp_Employee e ON e.EmpCompany=c.EmpCompany AND e.EmpID=c.EmpID JOIN dbo.Emp_EmploymentTypes t ON t.EmpTypeCmp=c.EmpCompany AND t.EmpTypeID=c.ConType
 WHERE c.EmpCompany=@CmpID AND c.ConEndDate>=@AsOfDate AND c.ConEndDate<=DATEADD(DAY,@DaysAhead,@AsOfDate) ORDER BY c.ConEndDate,e.EmpName;
END;
GO

CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_ProcessLeaveYearEndCarryForward
 @CmpID INT,@FromYear SMALLINT,@ToYear SMALLINT,@UserID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 IF @FromYear IS NULL OR @ToYear IS NULL OR @FromYear NOT BETWEEN 1900 AND 9998 OR @ToYear<>@FromYear+1 THROW 54620,N'يجب أن يكون عام الترحيل هو العام التالي مباشرة.',1;
 BEGIN TRY
  BEGIN TRANSACTION;
  DECLARE @Carry TABLE(EmployeeID BIGINT,LeaveTypeID BIGINT,CarryAmount DECIMAL(9,2),PolicyID BIGINT,SourceBalanceID BIGINT);
  INSERT @Carry(EmployeeID,LeaveTypeID,CarryAmount,PolicyID,SourceBalanceID)
  SELECT b.EmployeeID,b.LeaveTypeID,
   CONVERT(decimal(9,2),CASE WHEN pt.MaxBalance IS NOT NULL AND b.ClosingBalance>pt.MaxBalance THEN pt.MaxBalance ELSE b.ClosingBalance END),p.PolicyID,b.BalanceID
  FROM dbo.Emp_LeaveBalances b WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK)
  JOIN dbo.Emp_Employee e ON e.EmpCompany=b.CmpID AND e.EmpID=b.EmployeeID AND e.EmpState=0
  JOIN dbo.Emp_EmployeeLeavePolicies ep ON ep.CmpID=b.CmpID AND ep.EmployeeID=b.EmployeeID AND ep.RecordState=0 AND ep.EffectiveFrom<=DATEFROMPARTS(@ToYear,1,1) AND (ep.EffectiveTo IS NULL OR ep.EffectiveTo>=DATEFROMPARTS(@ToYear,1,1))
  JOIN dbo.Emp_LeavePolicies p ON p.CmpID=ep.CmpID AND p.PolicyID=ep.PolicyID AND p.RecordState=0 AND p.EffectiveFrom<=DATEFROMPARTS(@ToYear,1,1) AND (p.EffectiveTo IS NULL OR p.EffectiveTo>=DATEFROMPARTS(@ToYear,1,1))
  JOIN dbo.Emp_LeavePolicyTypes pt ON pt.CmpID=p.CmpID AND pt.PolicyID=p.PolicyID AND pt.LeaveTypeID=b.LeaveTypeID AND pt.RecordState=0
  JOIN dbo.Emp_LeaveTypes lt ON lt.LeaveTypeCmp=b.CmpID AND lt.LeaveTypeID=b.LeaveTypeID AND lt.LeaveTypeState=0 AND lt.LeaveTypePaid=1 AND lt.LeaveTypeCarryForward=1
  WHERE b.CmpID=@CmpID AND b.BalanceYear=@FromYear AND b.ClosingBalance>0
    AND (pt.CarryForwardLimit IS NULL OR pt.CarryForwardLimit>0)
    AND (lt.LeaveTypeMaxCarryForward IS NULL OR lt.LeaveTypeMaxCarryForward>0)
    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_LeaveBalances tgt WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE tgt.CmpID=b.CmpID AND tgt.EmployeeID=b.EmployeeID AND tgt.LeaveTypeID=b.LeaveTypeID AND tgt.BalanceYear=@ToYear);
  UPDATE c SET CarryAmount=CASE WHEN pt.CarryForwardLimit IS NOT NULL AND c.CarryAmount>pt.CarryForwardLimit THEN pt.CarryForwardLimit ELSE c.CarryAmount END
  FROM @Carry c JOIN dbo.Emp_LeavePolicyTypes pt ON pt.CmpID=@CmpID AND pt.PolicyID=c.PolicyID AND pt.LeaveTypeID=c.LeaveTypeID;
  UPDATE c SET CarryAmount=CASE WHEN lt.LeaveTypeMaxCarryForward IS NOT NULL AND c.CarryAmount>lt.LeaveTypeMaxCarryForward THEN lt.LeaveTypeMaxCarryForward ELSE c.CarryAmount END
  FROM @Carry c JOIN dbo.Emp_LeaveTypes lt ON lt.LeaveTypeCmp=@CmpID AND lt.LeaveTypeID=c.LeaveTypeID;
  DELETE FROM @Carry WHERE CarryAmount<=0;
  INSERT dbo.Emp_LeaveBalances(CmpID,EmployeeID,LeaveTypeID,BalanceYear,OpeningBalance,Earned,Used,Adjusted,RecordState,CreatedAt,CreatedBy)
  SELECT @CmpID,EmployeeID,LeaveTypeID,@ToYear,CarryAmount,0,0,0,0,SYSDATETIME(),@UserID FROM @Carry;
  INSERT dbo.Emp_LeaveBalanceTransactions(CmpID,BalanceID,TransactionDate,TransactionType,Quantity,BalanceDelta,SourceType,SourceID,Description,CreatedBy)
  SELECT @CmpID,tgt.BalanceID,DATEFROMPARTS(@ToYear,1,1),4,c.CarryAmount,c.CarryAmount,3,c.SourceBalanceID,N'ترحيل رصيد إجازة من السنة السابقة',@UserID
  FROM @Carry c JOIN dbo.Emp_LeaveBalances tgt ON tgt.CmpID=@CmpID AND tgt.EmployeeID=c.EmployeeID AND tgt.LeaveTypeID=c.LeaveTypeID AND tgt.BalanceYear=@ToYear;
  COMMIT TRANSACTION;
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS CarriedBalances FROM @Carry;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH
  IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
  THROW;
 END CATCH;
END;
GO
GO
IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Emp_LeaveAccrualSettings',N'U') IS NULL
BEGIN
 CREATE TABLE dbo.Emp_LeaveAccrualSettings
 (
  CmpID INT NOT NULL,PolicyID BIGINT NOT NULL,IntervalMonths TINYINT NOT NULL,AccrualDay TINYINT NOT NULL,ProrationMode TINYINT NOT NULL,
  CreatedAt DATETIME2(0) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Emp_LeaveAccrualSettings_Created DEFAULT(SYSDATETIME()),CreatedBy BIGINT NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT PK_Emp_LeaveAccrualSettings PRIMARY KEY(CmpID,PolicyID),
  CONSTRAINT CK_Emp_LeaveAccrualSettings_Values CHECK(IntervalMonths IN(1,2,3,4,6,12) AND AccrualDay BETWEEN 1 AND 31 AND ProrationMode IN(1,2)),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_LeaveAccrualSettings_Policy FOREIGN KEY(CmpID,PolicyID) REFERENCES dbo.Emp_LeavePolicies(CmpID,PolicyID),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_LeaveAccrualSettings_User FOREIGN KEY(CreatedBy) REFERENCES dbo.Mng_User(UsrID)
 );
END;
GO
IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Emp_LeaveAccrualRuns',N'U') IS NULL
BEGIN
 CREATE TABLE dbo.Emp_LeaveAccrualRuns
 (
  RunID BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT PK_Emp_LeaveAccrualRuns PRIMARY KEY,CmpID INT NOT NULL,PolicyID BIGINT NOT NULL,
  AccrualDate DATE NOT NULL,PeriodStart DATE NOT NULL,PeriodEnd DATE NOT NULL,IntervalMonths TINYINT NOT NULL,
  CreatedAt DATETIME2(0) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Emp_LeaveAccrualRuns_Created DEFAULT(SYSDATETIME()),CreatedBy BIGINT NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT UQ_Emp_LeaveAccrualRuns_PolicyDate UNIQUE(CmpID,PolicyID,AccrualDate),
  CONSTRAINT UQ_Emp_LeaveAccrualRuns_CmpID UNIQUE(CmpID,RunID),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_LeaveAccrualRuns_Policy FOREIGN KEY(CmpID,PolicyID) REFERENCES dbo.Emp_LeavePolicies(CmpID,PolicyID),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_LeaveAccrualRuns_Company FOREIGN KEY(CmpID) REFERENCES dbo.Mng_Company(CmpID),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_LeaveAccrualRuns_User FOREIGN KEY(CreatedBy) REFERENCES dbo.Mng_User(UsrID)
 );
END;
