IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Emp_LeaveAccrualDetails',N'U') IS NULL
BEGIN
 CREATE TABLE dbo.Emp_LeaveAccrualDetails
 (
  DetailID BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT PK_Emp_LeaveAccrualDetails PRIMARY KEY,CmpID INT NOT NULL,RunID BIGINT NOT NULL,
  EmployeeID BIGINT NOT NULL,LeaveTypeID BIGINT NOT NULL,AccruedAmount DECIMAL(9,2) NOT NULL,OpeningClosing DECIMAL(9,2) NOT NULL,
  CreatedAt DATETIME2(0) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Emp_LeaveAccrualDetails_Created DEFAULT(SYSDATETIME()),
  CONSTRAINT UQ_Emp_LeaveAccrualDetails_RunEmployeeType UNIQUE(CmpID,RunID,EmployeeID,LeaveTypeID),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_LeaveAccrualDetails_Run FOREIGN KEY(CmpID,RunID) REFERENCES dbo.Emp_LeaveAccrualRuns(CmpID,RunID),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_LeaveAccrualDetails_Company FOREIGN KEY(CmpID) REFERENCES dbo.Mng_Company(CmpID),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_LeaveAccrualDetails_Employee FOREIGN KEY(CmpID,EmployeeID) REFERENCES dbo.Emp_Employee(EmpCompany,EmpID),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_LeaveAccrualDetails_LeaveType FOREIGN KEY(CmpID,LeaveTypeID) REFERENCES dbo.Emp_LeaveTypes(LeaveTypeCmp,LeaveTypeID),
  CONSTRAINT CK_Emp_LeaveAccrualDetails_Amounts CHECK(AccruedAmount>0)
 );
END;
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_SaveLeaveAccrualSettings
 @CmpID INT,@PolicyID BIGINT,@IntervalMonths TINYINT,@AccrualDay TINYINT,@ProrationMode TINYINT,@UserID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 IF @IntervalMonths IS NULL OR @AccrualDay IS NULL OR @ProrationMode IS NULL OR @IntervalMonths NOT IN(1,2,3,4,6,12) OR @AccrualDay NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 31 OR @ProrationMode NOT IN(1,2) THROW 54630,N'إعداد دورية أو تجزئة الاستحقاق غير صحيح.',1;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_LeavePolicies WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND PolicyID=@PolicyID AND RecordState=0) THROW 54631,N'سياسة الإجازات غير نشطة أو لا تتبع للشركة.',1;
 BEGIN TRY
  BEGIN TRANSACTION;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_LeaveAccrualRuns WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND PolicyID=@PolicyID) THROW 54632,N'لا يمكن تغيير إعدادات الاستحقاق بعد بدء ترحيلها؛ أنشئ سياسة مؤرخة جديدة.',1;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_LeaveAccrualSettings WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND PolicyID=@PolicyID)
   UPDATE dbo.Emp_LeaveAccrualSettings SET IntervalMonths=@IntervalMonths,AccrualDay=@AccrualDay,ProrationMode=@ProrationMode,CreatedAt=SYSDATETIME(),CreatedBy=@UserID WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND PolicyID=@PolicyID;
  ELSE INSERT dbo.Emp_LeaveAccrualSettings(CmpID,PolicyID,IntervalMonths,AccrualDay,ProrationMode,CreatedBy) VALUES(@CmpID,@PolicyID,@IntervalMonths,@AccrualDay,@ProrationMode,@UserID);
  COMMIT TRANSACTION;
  SELECT @PolicyID AS PolicyID;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH
  IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
  THROW;
 END CATCH;
END;
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_ProcessLeaveAccrual
 @CmpID INT,@AccrualDate DATE,@UserID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 IF @AccrualDate IS NULL THROW 54633,N'تاريخ استحقاق الإجازة مطلوب.',1;
 BEGIN TRY
  BEGIN TRANSACTION;
  DECLARE @PolicyID BIGINT,@Interval TINYINT,@AccrualDay TINYINT,@ProrationMode TINYINT,@PolicyFrom DATE,@PolicyTo DATE,@RunID BIGINT,@PeriodStart DATE,@MonthIndex INT;
  SELECT @PolicyID=p.PolicyID,@PolicyFrom=p.EffectiveFrom,@PolicyTo=p.EffectiveTo,@Interval=s.IntervalMonths,@AccrualDay=s.AccrualDay,@ProrationMode=s.ProrationMode
  FROM dbo.Emp_LeavePolicies p WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) JOIN dbo.Emp_LeaveAccrualSettings s ON s.CmpID=p.CmpID AND s.PolicyID=p.PolicyID
  WHERE p.CmpID=@CmpID AND p.RecordState=0 AND p.EffectiveFrom<=@AccrualDate AND (p.EffectiveTo IS NULL OR p.EffectiveTo>=@AccrualDate);
  IF @PolicyID IS NULL THROW 54634,N'لا توجد سياسة واستحقاق دوري مهيآن وفعالان لهذا التاريخ.',1;
  IF NOT(DAY(@AccrualDate)=@AccrualDay OR (@AccrualDay>=DAY(EOMONTH(@AccrualDate)) AND @AccrualDate=EOMONTH(@AccrualDate))) THROW 54635,N'التاريخ ليس يوم الاستحقاق المحدد في السياسة.',1;
  SET @MonthIndex=(YEAR(@AccrualDate)-YEAR(@PolicyFrom))*12+MONTH(@AccrualDate)-MONTH(@PolicyFrom);
  IF @MonthIndex<0 OR @MonthIndex%@Interval<>0 THROW 54636,N'التاريخ لا يقع ضمن دورية الاستحقاق المحددة.',1;
  SELECT @RunID=RunID FROM dbo.Emp_LeaveAccrualRuns WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND PolicyID=@PolicyID AND AccrualDate=@AccrualDate;
  IF @RunID IS NOT NULL
  BEGIN
   COMMIT TRANSACTION;
   SELECT @RunID AS RunID,COUNT(*) AS AccruedEmployees FROM dbo.Emp_LeaveAccrualDetails WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND RunID=@RunID;
   RETURN;
  END;
  SET @PeriodStart=DATEADD(DAY,1,DATEADD(MONTH,-@Interval,@AccrualDate));
  IF @PeriodStart<@PolicyFrom SET @PeriodStart=@PolicyFrom;
  INSERT dbo.Emp_LeaveAccrualRuns(CmpID,PolicyID,AccrualDate,PeriodStart,PeriodEnd,IntervalMonths,CreatedBy)
  VALUES(@CmpID,@PolicyID,@AccrualDate,@PeriodStart,@AccrualDate,@Interval,@UserID);
  SET @RunID=SCOPE_IDENTITY();
  DECLARE @Eligible TABLE(EmployeeID BIGINT,LeaveTypeID BIGINT,BalanceID BIGINT,AnnualEntitlement DECIMAL(9,2),AnnualLimit DECIMAL(9,2),AnnualEarned DECIMAL(9,2),MaxBalance DECIMAL(9,2),HireDate DATE,EligibleFrom DATE,ClosingBalance DECIMAL(9,2));
  INSERT dbo.Emp_LeaveBalances(CmpID,EmployeeID,LeaveTypeID,BalanceYear,OpeningBalance,Earned,Used,Adjusted,RecordState,CreatedAt,CreatedBy)
  SELECT @CmpID,e.EmpID,pt.LeaveTypeID,YEAR(@AccrualDate),0,0,0,0,0,SYSDATETIME(),@UserID
  FROM dbo.Emp_Employee e
  JOIN dbo.Emp_EmployeeLeavePolicies ep ON ep.CmpID=@CmpID AND ep.EmployeeID=e.EmpID AND ep.PolicyID=@PolicyID AND ep.RecordState=0 AND ep.EffectiveFrom<=@AccrualDate AND (ep.EffectiveTo IS NULL OR ep.EffectiveTo>=@AccrualDate)
  JOIN dbo.Emp_LeavePolicyTypes pt ON pt.CmpID=@CmpID AND pt.PolicyID=@PolicyID AND pt.RecordState=0
  JOIN dbo.Emp_LeaveTypes lt ON lt.LeaveTypeCmp=@CmpID AND lt.LeaveTypeID=pt.LeaveTypeID AND lt.LeaveTypeState=0 AND lt.LeaveTypePaid=1
  WHERE e.EmpCompany=@CmpID AND e.EmpState=0 AND e.HireDate IS NOT NULL AND DATEADD(MONTH,pt.MinimumServiceMonths,e.HireDate)<=@AccrualDate
   AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_LeaveBalances b WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE b.CmpID=@CmpID AND b.EmployeeID=e.EmpID AND b.LeaveTypeID=pt.LeaveTypeID AND b.BalanceYear=YEAR(@AccrualDate));
  INSERT @Eligible(EmployeeID,LeaveTypeID,BalanceID,AnnualEntitlement,AnnualLimit,AnnualEarned,MaxBalance,HireDate,EligibleFrom,ClosingBalance)
  SELECT e.EmpID,pt.LeaveTypeID,b.BalanceID,pt.AnnualEntitlement,lt.LeaveTypeAnnualLimit,b.Earned,pt.MaxBalance,e.HireDate,
   (SELECT MAX(d) FROM (VALUES(e.HireDate),(ep.EffectiveFrom),(@PolicyFrom),(@PeriodStart)) v(d)),b.ClosingBalance
  FROM dbo.Emp_Employee e
  JOIN dbo.Emp_EmployeeLeavePolicies ep ON ep.CmpID=@CmpID AND ep.EmployeeID=e.EmpID AND ep.PolicyID=@PolicyID AND ep.RecordState=0 AND ep.EffectiveFrom<=@AccrualDate AND (ep.EffectiveTo IS NULL OR ep.EffectiveTo>=@AccrualDate)
  JOIN dbo.Emp_LeavePolicyTypes pt ON pt.CmpID=@CmpID AND pt.PolicyID=@PolicyID AND pt.RecordState=0
  JOIN dbo.Emp_LeaveTypes lt ON lt.LeaveTypeCmp=@CmpID AND lt.LeaveTypeID=pt.LeaveTypeID AND lt.LeaveTypeState=0 AND lt.LeaveTypePaid=1
  JOIN dbo.Emp_LeaveBalances b WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) ON b.CmpID=@CmpID AND b.EmployeeID=e.EmpID AND b.LeaveTypeID=pt.LeaveTypeID AND b.BalanceYear=YEAR(@AccrualDate)
  WHERE e.EmpCompany=@CmpID AND e.EmpState=0 AND e.HireDate IS NOT NULL AND DATEADD(MONTH,pt.MinimumServiceMonths,e.HireDate)<=@AccrualDate AND pt.AnnualEntitlement>0;
  DECLARE @Amounts TABLE(EmployeeID BIGINT,LeaveTypeID BIGINT,BalanceID BIGINT,AccruedAmount DECIMAL(9,2),ClosingBalance DECIMAL(9,2));
  INSERT @Amounts(EmployeeID,LeaveTypeID,BalanceID,AccruedAmount,ClosingBalance)
  SELECT EmployeeID,LeaveTypeID,BalanceID,a.Amount,ClosingBalance+a.Amount
  FROM @Eligible
  CROSS APPLY(SELECT CONVERT(decimal(9,2),ROUND(AnnualEntitlement*@Interval/12.0*CASE WHEN @ProrationMode=1 THEN 1.0 ELSE CONVERT(decimal(12,6),DATEDIFF(DAY,EligibleFrom,DATEADD(DAY,1,@AccrualDate)))/NULLIF(DATEDIFF(DAY,@PeriodStart,DATEADD(DAY,1,@AccrualDate)),0) END,2)) ScheduledAmount) p
  CROSS APPLY(SELECT CASE WHEN AnnualEntitlement-AnnualEarned<p.ScheduledAmount THEN AnnualEntitlement-AnnualEarned ELSE p.ScheduledAmount END PolicyCappedAmount) pc
  CROSS APPLY(SELECT CASE WHEN AnnualLimit IS NOT NULL AND AnnualLimit-AnnualEarned<pc.PolicyCappedAmount THEN AnnualLimit-AnnualEarned ELSE pc.PolicyCappedAmount END AnnualCappedAmount) ac
  CROSS APPLY(SELECT CASE WHEN MaxBalance IS NULL THEN ac.AnnualCappedAmount ELSE CASE WHEN MaxBalance-ClosingBalance<ac.AnnualCappedAmount THEN MaxBalance-ClosingBalance ELSE ac.AnnualCappedAmount END END Amount) a
  WHERE a.Amount>0;
  UPDATE b SET Earned=b.Earned+a.AccruedAmount FROM dbo.Emp_LeaveBalances b JOIN @Amounts a ON a.BalanceID=b.BalanceID WHERE b.CmpID=@CmpID;
  INSERT dbo.Emp_LeaveAccrualDetails(CmpID,RunID,EmployeeID,LeaveTypeID,AccruedAmount,OpeningClosing)
  SELECT @CmpID,@RunID,EmployeeID,LeaveTypeID,AccruedAmount,ClosingBalance FROM @Amounts;
  INSERT dbo.Emp_LeaveBalanceTransactions(CmpID,BalanceID,TransactionDate,TransactionType,Quantity,BalanceDelta,SourceType,SourceID,Description,CreatedBy)
  SELECT @CmpID,BalanceID,@AccrualDate,1,AccruedAmount,AccruedAmount,4,@RunID,N'استحقاق دوري وفق سياسة الشركة',@UserID FROM @Amounts;
  COMMIT TRANSACTION;
  SELECT @RunID AS RunID,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM @Amounts) AS AccruedEmployees;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH
  IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
  THROW;
 END CATCH;
END;
GO
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_SavePayrollAttendanceRule
 @CmpID INT,@RuleID BIGINT=0,@EffectiveFrom DATE,@EffectiveTo DATE=NULL,@EligibleAttendanceState TINYINT,
 @DeductRecordedAbsence BIT,@AbsenceComponentID BIGINT=NULL,@DailySalaryDivisor DECIMAL(12,6)=NULL,
 @DeductLate BIT=0,@LateComponentID BIGINT=NULL,@LateAmountPerMinute DECIMAL(12,6)=NULL,
 @DeductEarlyLeave BIT=0,@EarlyComponentID BIGINT=NULL,@EarlyAmountPerMinute DECIMAL(12,6)=NULL,
 @DeductUnpaidLeave BIT=0,@UnpaidLeaveComponentID BIGINT=NULL,@RuleCurrencyID BIGINT=NULL,@RecordState TINYINT=0,@UserID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 IF @EffectiveFrom IS NULL OR (@EffectiveTo IS NOT NULL AND @EffectiveTo<@EffectiveFrom) OR @EligibleAttendanceState IS NULL OR @EligibleAttendanceState NOT IN(1,2,3) OR @RecordState IS NULL OR @RecordState NOT IN(0,1)
  OR @DeductRecordedAbsence IS NULL OR @DeductLate IS NULL OR @DeductEarlyLeave IS NULL OR @DeductUnpaidLeave IS NULL
  OR (@DailySalaryDivisor IS NOT NULL AND @DailySalaryDivisor<=0) OR (@LateAmountPerMinute IS NOT NULL AND @LateAmountPerMinute<0) OR (@EarlyAmountPerMinute IS NOT NULL AND @EarlyAmountPerMinute<0)
  OR (@DeductRecordedAbsence=1 AND (@AbsenceComponentID IS NULL OR @DailySalaryDivisor IS NULL))
  OR (@DeductLate=1 AND (@LateComponentID IS NULL OR @LateAmountPerMinute IS NULL OR @RuleCurrencyID IS NULL))
  OR (@DeductEarlyLeave=1 AND (@EarlyComponentID IS NULL OR @EarlyAmountPerMinute IS NULL OR @RuleCurrencyID IS NULL))
  OR (@DeductUnpaidLeave=1 AND (@UnpaidLeaveComponentID IS NULL OR @DailySalaryDivisor IS NULL))
  THROW 54640,N'إعدادات خصم الحضور والإجازة غير مكتملة أو غير صحيحة.',1;
 IF @RuleCurrencyID IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Acc_Currency WHERE CurCmp=@CmpID AND CurID=@RuleCurrencyID AND CurState=0) THROW 54641,N'عملة مبالغ الحضور غير نشطة أو لا تتبع للشركة.',1;
 IF @AbsenceComponentID IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_PayComponents WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND ComponentID=@AbsenceComponentID AND ComponentKind=2 AND RecordState=0) THROW 54642,N'مكون خصم الغياب غير صالح.',1;
 IF @LateComponentID IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_PayComponents WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND ComponentID=@LateComponentID AND ComponentKind=2 AND RecordState=0) THROW 54643,N'مكون خصم التأخير غير صالح.',1;
 IF @EarlyComponentID IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_PayComponents WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND ComponentID=@EarlyComponentID AND ComponentKind=2 AND RecordState=0) THROW 54644,N'مكون خصم الانصراف المبكر غير صالح.',1;
 IF @UnpaidLeaveComponentID IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_PayComponents WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND ComponentID=@UnpaidLeaveComponentID AND ComponentKind=2 AND RecordState=0) THROW 54645,N'مكون خصم الإجازة غير المدفوعة غير صالح.',1;
 BEGIN TRY
  BEGIN TRANSACTION;
  IF @RecordState=0 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_PayrollAttendanceRules WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND RecordState=0 AND RuleID<>ISNULL(@RuleID,0) AND EffectiveFrom<=ISNULL(@EffectiveTo,CONVERT(date,'99991231')) AND ISNULL(EffectiveTo,CONVERT(date,'99991231'))>=@EffectiveFrom) THROW 54646,N'تتداخل سياسة خصم حضور فعالة أخرى للشركة.',1;
  IF ISNULL(@RuleID,0)=0
  BEGIN
   INSERT dbo.Emp_PayrollAttendanceRules(CmpID,EffectiveFrom,EffectiveTo,EligibleAttendanceState,DeductRecordedAbsence,DeductLate,DeductEarlyLeave,DeductUnpaidLeave,AbsenceComponentID,DailySalaryDivisor,LateComponentID,LateAmountPerMinute,EarlyComponentID,EarlyAmountPerMinute,UnpaidLeaveComponentID,RuleCurrencyID,RecordState,CreatedBy)
   VALUES(@CmpID,@EffectiveFrom,@EffectiveTo,@EligibleAttendanceState,@DeductRecordedAbsence,@DeductLate,@DeductEarlyLeave,@DeductUnpaidLeave,@AbsenceComponentID,@DailySalaryDivisor,@LateComponentID,@LateAmountPerMinute,@EarlyComponentID,@EarlyAmountPerMinute,@UnpaidLeaveComponentID,@RuleCurrencyID,@RecordState,@UserID);
   SET @RuleID=SCOPE_IDENTITY();
  END
  ELSE
  BEGIN
   UPDATE dbo.Emp_PayrollAttendanceRules SET EffectiveFrom=@EffectiveFrom,EffectiveTo=@EffectiveTo,EligibleAttendanceState=@EligibleAttendanceState,DeductRecordedAbsence=@DeductRecordedAbsence,DeductLate=@DeductLate,DeductEarlyLeave=@DeductEarlyLeave,DeductUnpaidLeave=@DeductUnpaidLeave,AbsenceComponentID=@AbsenceComponentID,DailySalaryDivisor=@DailySalaryDivisor,LateComponentID=@LateComponentID,LateAmountPerMinute=@LateAmountPerMinute,EarlyComponentID=@EarlyComponentID,EarlyAmountPerMinute=@EarlyAmountPerMinute,UnpaidLeaveComponentID=@UnpaidLeaveComponentID,RuleCurrencyID=@RuleCurrencyID,RecordState=@RecordState
   WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND RuleID=@RuleID;
   IF @@ROWCOUNT<>1 THROW 54647,N'سياسة خصم الحضور غير موجودة للشركة.',1;
  END;
  COMMIT TRANSACTION;
  SELECT @RuleID AS RuleID;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH
  IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
  THROW;
 END CATCH;
END;
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_GenerateAttendanceAbsences
 @CmpID INT,@DateFrom DATE,@DateTo DATE,@UserID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 IF @DateFrom IS NULL OR @DateTo IS NULL OR @DateTo<@DateFrom OR @DateTo>CONVERT(date,SYSDATETIME()) THROW 54650,N'فترة إنشاء حالات الغياب غير صحيحة أو تشمل تاريخاً مستقبلياً.',1;
 BEGIN TRY
  BEGIN TRANSACTION;
  INSERT dbo.Emp_AttendanceDaily(AttDayCmp,AttDayEmpID,AttDayDate,AttDayFirstIn,AttDayLastOut,AttDayWorkMinutes,AttDayLateMinutes,AttDayEarlyLeaveMinutes,AttDayOvertimeMinutes,AttDayState,AttDayDateTime,AttDayUser)
  SELECT DISTINCT @CmpID,e.EmpID,wd.WCalDetDate,NULL,NULL,0,0,0,0,0,SYSDATETIME(),@UserID
  FROM dbo.Emp_Employee e
  JOIN dbo.Emp_EmployeeSchedule es ON es.SchCmp=@CmpID AND es.SchEmpID=e.EmpID AND es.SchState=0 AND es.SchStartDate<=@DateTo AND (es.SchEndDate IS NULL OR es.SchEndDate>=@DateFrom)
  JOIN dbo.Emp_WorkCalendar wc ON wc.WCalCmp=@CmpID AND wc.WCalID=es.SchWCalID AND wc.WCalState=0
  JOIN dbo.Emp_WorkCalendarDetails wd ON wd.WCalDetCmp=@CmpID AND wd.WCalDetWCalID=wc.WCalID AND wd.WCalDetType=1 AND wd.WCalDetDate BETWEEN @DateFrom AND @DateTo AND wd.WCalDetDate BETWEEN es.SchStartDate AND ISNULL(es.SchEndDate,CONVERT(date,'99991231'))
  WHERE e.EmpCompany=@CmpID AND e.EmpState=0 AND e.HireDate<=wd.WCalDetDate
   AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_AttendanceDaily d WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE d.AttDayCmp=@CmpID AND d.AttDayEmpID=e.EmpID AND d.AttDayDate=wd.WCalDetDate)
   AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_LeaveRequests lr JOIN dbo.Emp_LeaveTypes lt ON lt.LeaveTypeCmp=lr.CmpID AND lt.LeaveTypeID=lr.LeaveTypeID WHERE lr.CmpID=@CmpID AND lr.EmployeeID=e.EmpID AND lr.RequestState=1 AND lr.IsHourly=0 AND lr.StartAt<DATEADD(DAY,1,wd.WCalDetDate) AND lr.EndAt>wd.WCalDetDate);
  DECLARE @Rows INT=@@ROWCOUNT;
  COMMIT TRANSACTION;
  SELECT @Rows AS AbsenceDaysCreated;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH
  IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
  THROW;
 END CATCH;
END;
GO
GO

 );

CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_SaveApprovalRouteStep
 @CmpID INT,@ProcessType TINYINT,@StepNo SMALLINT,@ApproverID BIGINT,@RecordState TINYINT=0,@UserID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 IF @ProcessType IS NULL OR @ProcessType=0 OR @StepNo IS NULL OR @StepNo<=0 OR @RecordState NOT IN(0,1) THROW 54700,N'نوع العملية أو مرحلة الموافقة غير صحيحة.',1;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_User WHERE UsrID=@ApproverID AND UsrCompany=@CmpID AND UsrState=0) THROW 54701,N'المعتمد غير نشط أو لا يتبع للشركة.',1;
 BEGIN TRY
  BEGIN TRANSACTION;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_ApprovalRequests WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND ProcessType=@ProcessType AND ApprovalState=0 AND CurrentStep>=@StepNo) THROW 54702,N'لا يمكن تغيير مرحلة مستخدمة في مسار موافقة جارٍ.',1;
DECLARE @MaxActiveStep SMALLINT=(SELECT MAX(StepNo) FROM dbo.Emp_ApprovalRouteSteps WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND ProcessType=@ProcessType AND RecordState=0),@CurrentRouteState TINYINT;
  SELECT @CurrentRouteState=RecordState FROM dbo.Emp_ApprovalRouteSteps WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND ProcessType=@ProcessType AND StepNo=@StepNo;
  IF ISNULL(@CurrentRouteState,1)=1 AND @RecordState=0 AND @StepNo>ISNULL(@MaxActiveStep,0)+1 THROW 54711,N'أضف مراحل الموافقة بالتتابع دون فجوات.',1;
  IF @RecordState=1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_ApprovalRouteSteps WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND ProcessType=@ProcessType AND RecordState=0 AND StepNo>@StepNo) THROW 54712,N'عطّل المراحل من الأخيرة إلى الأولى للحفاظ على تسلسل المسار.',1;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_ApprovalRouteSteps WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND ProcessType=@ProcessType AND StepNo=@StepNo)
   UPDATE dbo.Emp_ApprovalRouteSteps SET ApproverID=@ApproverID,RecordState=@RecordState WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND ProcessType=@ProcessType AND StepNo=@StepNo;
  ELSE INSERT dbo.Emp_ApprovalRouteSteps(CmpID,ProcessType,StepNo,ApproverID,RecordState,CreatedBy) VALUES(@CmpID,@ProcessType,@StepNo,@ApproverID,@RecordState,@UserID);
  COMMIT TRANSACTION;
  SELECT @ProcessType AS ProcessType,@StepNo AS StepNo;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH
  IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
  THROW;
 END CATCH;
END;
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_StartApproval
 @CmpID INT,@ProcessType TINYINT,@EntityID BIGINT,@SubmittedBy BIGINT,@SuppressResult BIT=0
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@SubmittedBy;
 BEGIN TRY
  BEGIN TRANSACTION;
  DECLARE @FirstStep SMALLINT,@StepCount INT,@MaxStep SMALLINT,@ApprovalID BIGINT,@ExistingState TINYINT,@ExistingSubmitter BIGINT;
  SELECT @FirstStep=MIN(StepNo),@MaxStep=MAX(StepNo),@StepCount=COUNT(*) FROM dbo.Emp_ApprovalRouteSteps WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND ProcessType=@ProcessType AND RecordState=0;
  IF @FirstStep IS NULL THROW 54703,N'مسار الموافقات غير مهيأ لهذه الشركة والعملية.',1;
  IF @FirstStep<>1 OR @StepCount<>@MaxStep THROW 54704,N'أرقام مراحل مسار الموافقة يجب أن تكون متصلة ابتداءً من المرحلة الأولى.',1;
  SELECT @ApprovalID=ApprovalID,@ExistingState=ApprovalState,@ExistingSubmitter=SubmittedBy FROM dbo.Emp_ApprovalRequests WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND ProcessType=@ProcessType AND EntityID=@EntityID;
  IF @ApprovalID IS NULL
  BEGIN
   INSERT dbo.Emp_ApprovalRequests(CmpID,ProcessType,EntityID,CurrentStep,ApprovalState,SubmittedBy) VALUES(@CmpID,@ProcessType,@EntityID,1,0,@SubmittedBy);
   SET @ApprovalID=SCOPE_IDENTITY();
  END
  ELSE IF @ExistingState=2
   UPDATE dbo.Emp_ApprovalRequests SET CurrentStep=1,ApprovalState=0,AttemptNo=AttemptNo+1,SubmittedBy=@SubmittedBy,CreatedAt=SYSDATETIME(),CompletedAt=NULL,CompletedBy=NULL WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND ApprovalID=@ApprovalID;
  ELSE IF @ExistingState<>0 OR @ExistingSubmitter<>@SubmittedBy THROW 54705,N'طلب الموافقة قائم أو مكتمل مسبقاً أو لا يخص مقدم الطلب.',1;
  COMMIT TRANSACTION;
  IF @SuppressResult=0 SELECT ApprovalID,CurrentStep,ApprovalState FROM dbo.Emp_ApprovalRequests WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND ApprovalID=@ApprovalID;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH
  IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
  THROW;
 END CATCH;
END;
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_DecideApprovalStep
 @CmpID INT,@ProcessType TINYINT,@EntityID BIGINT,@StepNo SMALLINT,@ApproverID BIGINT,@Decision TINYINT,@Comments NVARCHAR(1000)=NULL,
 @ApprovalState TINYINT OUTPUT,@NextStep SMALLINT OUTPUT,@SuppressResult BIT=0
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@ApproverID;
 IF @Decision NOT IN(1,2) OR @StepNo<=0 THROW 54706,N'قرار الموافقة أو المرحلة غير صحيح.',1;
 BEGIN TRY
  BEGIN TRANSACTION;
  DECLARE @ApprovalID BIGINT,@CurrentStep SMALLINT,@State TINYINT,@SubmittedBy BIGINT,@ExpectedApprover BIGINT,@Next SMALLINT,@AttemptNo SMALLINT;
  SELECT @ApprovalID=ApprovalID,@CurrentStep=CurrentStep,@State=ApprovalState,@AttemptNo=AttemptNo,@SubmittedBy=SubmittedBy FROM dbo.Emp_ApprovalRequests WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND ProcessType=@ProcessType AND EntityID=@EntityID;
  IF @ApprovalID IS NULL OR @State<>0 OR @CurrentStep<>@StepNo THROW 54707,N'طلب الموافقة غير قائم أو المرحلة الحالية مختلفة.',1;
  IF @SubmittedBy=@ApproverID THROW 54708,N'لا يجوز لمقدم الطلب اعتماد طلبه.',1;
  SELECT @ExpectedApprover=ApproverID FROM dbo.Emp_ApprovalRouteSteps WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND ProcessType=@ProcessType AND StepNo=@StepNo AND RecordState=0;
  IF @ExpectedApprover IS NULL OR @ExpectedApprover<>@ApproverID THROW 54709,N'المستخدم ليس المعتمد المحدد لهذه المرحلة.',1;
  INSERT dbo.Emp_ApprovalEvents(CmpID,ApprovalID,ProcessType,EntityID,StepNo,AttemptNo,ApproverID,Decision,Comments) VALUES(@CmpID,@ApprovalID,@ProcessType,@EntityID,@StepNo,@AttemptNo,@ApproverID,@Decision,@Comments);
  IF @Decision=2
   UPDATE dbo.Emp_ApprovalRequests SET ApprovalState=2,CompletedAt=SYSDATETIME(),CompletedBy=@ApproverID WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND ApprovalID=@ApprovalID;
  ELSE
  BEGIN
   SELECT @Next=MIN(StepNo) FROM dbo.Emp_ApprovalRouteSteps WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND ProcessType=@ProcessType AND RecordState=0 AND StepNo>@StepNo;
   IF @Next IS NULL UPDATE dbo.Emp_ApprovalRequests SET ApprovalState=1,CompletedAt=SYSDATETIME(),CompletedBy=@ApproverID WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND ApprovalID=@ApprovalID;
   ELSE UPDATE dbo.Emp_ApprovalRequests SET CurrentStep=@Next WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND ApprovalID=@ApprovalID;
  END;
  SELECT @ApprovalState=ApprovalState,@NextStep=CurrentStep FROM dbo.Emp_ApprovalRequests WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND ApprovalID=@ApprovalID;
  COMMIT TRANSACTION;
  IF @SuppressResult=0 SELECT @ApprovalID AS ApprovalID,@ApprovalState AS ApprovalState,@NextStep AS NextStep;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH
  IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
  THROW;
 END CATCH;
END;
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_SelectApprovalRoute @CmpID INT,@ProcessType TINYINT
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON;
 SELECT r.ProcessType,r.StepNo,r.ApproverID,u.UsrLogIn,CONCAT(e.EmpName,N'') AS ApproverName,r.RecordState,r.CreatedAt,r.CreatedBy
 FROM dbo.Emp_ApprovalRouteSteps r JOIN dbo.Mng_User u ON u.UsrID=r.ApproverID LEFT JOIN dbo.Emp_Employee e ON e.EmpCompany=r.CmpID AND e.EmpID=r.ApproverID
 WHERE r.CmpID=@CmpID AND r.ProcessType=@ProcessType ORDER BY r.StepNo;
END;
GO
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_RejectLoan
 @CmpID INT,@LoanID BIGINT,@ApproverID BIGINT,@StepNo SMALLINT=1,@Comments NVARCHAR(1000)=NULL
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@ApproverID;
 BEGIN TRY
  BEGIN TRANSACTION;
  DECLARE @CreatorID BIGINT,@ApprovalResult TINYINT,@NextApproval SMALLINT;
  SELECT @CreatorID=CreatedBy FROM dbo.Emp_Loans WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND LoanID=@LoanID AND LoanState=0;
  IF @CreatorID IS NULL OR @CreatorID=@ApproverID THROW 54730,N'طلب السلفة غير موجود أو لا يجوز لمنشئه رفضه.',1;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_ApprovalRequests WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND ProcessType=4 AND EntityID=@LoanID)
   EXEC dbo.Emp_DecideApprovalStep @CmpID,4,@LoanID,@StepNo,@ApproverID,2,@Comments,@ApprovalResult OUTPUT,@NextApproval OUTPUT,1;
  UPDATE dbo.Emp_Loans SET LoanState=2,ApprovedAt=SYSDATETIME(),ApprovedBy=@ApproverID WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND LoanID=@LoanID AND LoanState=0;
  IF @@ROWCOUNT<>1 THROW 54731,N'تغيرت حالة طلب السلفة أثناء الرفض.',1;
  COMMIT TRANSACTION;
  SELECT LoanID,LoanState,ApprovedAt,ApprovedBy FROM dbo.Emp_Loans WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND LoanID=@LoanID;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH
  IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
  THROW;
 END CATCH;
END;
GO
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_RejectPayRun
 @CmpID INT,@PayRunID BIGINT,@UserID BIGINT,@StepNo SMALLINT=1,@Comments NVARCHAR(1000)=NULL
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 BEGIN TRY
  BEGIN TRANSACTION;
  DECLARE @CreatorID BIGINT,@ApprovalResult TINYINT,@NextApproval SMALLINT;
  SELECT @CreatorID=CreatedBy FROM dbo.Emp_PayRuns WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND PayRunID=@PayRunID AND RunState=1;
  IF @CreatorID IS NULL OR @CreatorID=@UserID THROW 54740,N'المسير غير موجود أو لا يجوز لمنشئه رفضه.',1;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_ApprovalRequests WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND ProcessType=9 AND EntityID=@PayRunID)
   EXEC dbo.Emp_DecideApprovalStep @CmpID,9,@PayRunID,@StepNo,@UserID,2,@Comments,@ApprovalResult OUTPUT,@NextApproval OUTPUT,1;
  UPDATE dbo.Emp_PayRuns SET RunState=0,CalculatedAt=NULL,CalculatedBy=NULL WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND PayRunID=@PayRunID AND RunState=1;
  IF @@ROWCOUNT<>1 THROW 54741,N'تغيرت حالة المسير أثناء الرفض.',1;
  COMMIT TRANSACTION;
  SELECT PayRunID,RunState,NetTotal FROM dbo.Emp_PayRuns WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND PayRunID=@PayRunID;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH
  IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
  THROW;
 END CATCH;
END;
GO
-- MADAR HR financial extensions: salary advances and external deductions
IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Emp_ExternalDeductionPayees',N'U') IS NULL
BEGIN
 CREATE TABLE dbo.Emp_ExternalDeductionPayees
 (
  PayeeID BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT PK_Emp_ExternalDeductionPayees PRIMARY KEY,
  CmpID INT NOT NULL,PayeeCode NVARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,PayeeName NVARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,ContactInfo NVARCHAR(500) NULL,
  RecordState TINYINT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Emp_ExternalDeductionPayees_State DEFAULT(0),
  CreatedAt DATETIME2(0) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Emp_ExternalDeductionPayees_Created DEFAULT(SYSDATETIME()),CreatedBy BIGINT NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT UQ_Emp_ExternalDeductionPayees_Cmp_ID UNIQUE(CmpID,PayeeID),
  CONSTRAINT UQ_Emp_ExternalDeductionPayees_Code UNIQUE(CmpID,PayeeCode),
  CONSTRAINT CK_Emp_ExternalDeductionPayees_State CHECK(RecordState IN(0,1)),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_ExternalDeductionPayees_Company FOREIGN KEY(CmpID) REFERENCES dbo.Mng_Company(CmpID),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_ExternalDeductionPayees_User FOREIGN KEY(CreatedBy) REFERENCES dbo.Mng_User(UsrID)
 );
END;

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Emp_SalaryAdvances',N'U') IS NULL
BEGIN
 CREATE TABLE dbo.Emp_SalaryAdvances
 (
  AdvanceID BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT PK_Emp_SalaryAdvances PRIMARY KEY,
  CmpID INT NOT NULL,EmployeeID BIGINT NOT NULL,AdvanceNo NVARCHAR(40) NULL,Amount DECIMAL(15,3) NOT NULL,CurrencyID BIGINT NOT NULL,ComponentID BIGINT NOT NULL,
  IssueDate DATE NOT NULL,FirstDeductionDate DATE NOT NULL,InstallmentCount SMALLINT NOT NULL,InstallmentAmount DECIMAL(15,3) NOT NULL,
  AdvanceState TINYINT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Emp_SalaryAdvances_State DEFAULT(0),
  CreatedAt DATETIME2(0) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Emp_SalaryAdvances_Created DEFAULT(SYSDATETIME()),CreatedBy BIGINT NOT NULL,
  ApprovedAt DATETIME2(0) NULL,ApprovedBy BIGINT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT UQ_Emp_SalaryAdvances_Cmp_ID UNIQUE(CmpID,AdvanceID),
  CONSTRAINT CK_Emp_SalaryAdvances_Values CHECK(Amount>0 AND InstallmentCount>0 AND InstallmentAmount>0 AND AdvanceState IN(0,1,2,3) AND FirstDeductionDate>=IssueDate),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_SalaryAdvances_Company FOREIGN KEY(CmpID) REFERENCES dbo.Mng_Company(CmpID),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_SalaryAdvances_Employee FOREIGN KEY(CmpID,EmployeeID) REFERENCES dbo.Emp_Employee(EmpCompany,EmpID),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_SalaryAdvances_Currency FOREIGN KEY(CmpID,CurrencyID) REFERENCES dbo.Acc_Currency(CurCmp,CurID),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_SalaryAdvances_Component FOREIGN KEY(CmpID,ComponentID) REFERENCES dbo.Emp_PayComponents(CmpID,ComponentID),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_SalaryAdvances_Creator FOREIGN KEY(CreatedBy) REFERENCES dbo.Mng_User(UsrID),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_SalaryAdvances_Approver FOREIGN KEY(ApprovedBy) REFERENCES dbo.Mng_User(UsrID)
 );
END;
GO
IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Emp_SalaryAdvanceInstallments',N'U') IS NULL
BEGIN
 CREATE TABLE dbo.Emp_SalaryAdvanceInstallments
 (
  InstallmentID BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT PK_Emp_SalaryAdvanceInstallments PRIMARY KEY,
  CmpID INT NOT NULL,AdvanceID BIGINT NOT NULL,InstallmentNo SMALLINT NOT NULL,DueDate DATE NOT NULL,
  Amount DECIMAL(15,3) NOT NULL,PaidAmount DECIMAL(15,3) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Emp_SalaryAdvanceInstallments_Paid DEFAULT(0),
  PaidAt DATETIME2(0) NULL,InstallmentState TINYINT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Emp_SalaryAdvanceInstallments_State DEFAULT(0),
  CONSTRAINT UQ_Emp_SalaryAdvanceInstallments_Cmp_ID UNIQUE(CmpID,InstallmentID),
  CONSTRAINT UQ_Emp_SalaryAdvanceInstallments_No UNIQUE(CmpID,AdvanceID,InstallmentNo),
  CONSTRAINT CK_Emp_SalaryAdvanceInstallments_Values CHECK(InstallmentNo>0 AND Amount>0 AND PaidAmount>=0 AND PaidAmount<=Amount AND InstallmentState IN(0,1) AND ((InstallmentState=0 AND PaidAmount<Amount) OR (InstallmentState=1 AND PaidAmount=Amount))),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_SalaryAdvanceInstallments_Company FOREIGN KEY(CmpID) REFERENCES dbo.Mng_Company(CmpID),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_SalaryAdvanceInstallments_Advance FOREIGN KEY(CmpID,AdvanceID) REFERENCES dbo.Emp_SalaryAdvances(CmpID,AdvanceID)
 );
END;

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Emp_SalaryAdvancePayments',N'U') IS NULL
BEGIN
 CREATE TABLE dbo.Emp_SalaryAdvancePayments
 (
  PaymentID BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT PK_Emp_SalaryAdvancePayments PRIMARY KEY,
  CmpID INT NOT NULL,InstallmentID BIGINT NOT NULL,Amount DECIMAL(15,3) NOT NULL,PaymentDate DATE NOT NULL,
  PaymentSource TINYINT NOT NULL,PayRunID BIGINT NULL,CreatedAt DATETIME2(0) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Emp_SalaryAdvancePayments_Created DEFAULT(SYSDATETIME()),CreatedBy BIGINT NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT CK_Emp_SalaryAdvancePayments_Values CHECK(Amount>0 AND PaymentSource IN(1,2) AND ((PaymentSource=1 AND PayRunID IS NULL) OR (PaymentSource=2 AND PayRunID IS NOT NULL))),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_SalaryAdvancePayments_Installment FOREIGN KEY(CmpID,InstallmentID) REFERENCES dbo.Emp_SalaryAdvanceInstallments(CmpID,InstallmentID),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_SalaryAdvancePayments_PayRun FOREIGN KEY(CmpID,PayRunID) REFERENCES dbo.Emp_PayRuns(CmpID,PayRunID),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_SalaryAdvancePayments_User FOREIGN KEY(CreatedBy) REFERENCES dbo.Mng_User(UsrID)
 );
END;

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Emp_EmployeeExternalDeductions',N'U') IS NULL
BEGIN
 CREATE TABLE dbo.Emp_EmployeeExternalDeductions
 (
  DeductionID BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT PK_Emp_EmployeeExternalDeductions PRIMARY KEY,
  CmpID INT NOT NULL,EmployeeID BIGINT NOT NULL,PayeeID BIGINT NOT NULL,ReferenceNo NVARCHAR(100) NULL,Description NVARCHAR(500) NOT NULL,
  CurrencyID BIGINT NOT NULL,ComponentID BIGINT NOT NULL,DeductionMethod TINYINT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Emp_EmployeeExternalDeductions_Method DEFAULT(1),PercentageRate DECIMAL(9,6) NULL,CalculationBase TINYINT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Emp_EmployeeExternalDeductions_Base DEFAULT(1),FrequencyMonths TINYINT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Emp_EmployeeExternalDeductions_Frequency DEFAULT(1),NextDueDate DATE NULL,MonthlyAmount DECIMAL(15,3) NOT NULL,TotalAmount DECIMAL(15,3) NULL,WithheldTotal DECIMAL(15,3) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Emp_EmployeeExternalDeductions_Withheld DEFAULT(0),
  EffectiveFrom DATE NOT NULL,EffectiveTo DATE NULL,DeductionState TINYINT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Emp_EmployeeExternalDeductions_State DEFAULT(0),
  CreatedAt DATETIME2(0) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Emp_EmployeeExternalDeductions_Created DEFAULT(SYSDATETIME()),CreatedBy BIGINT NOT NULL,
  ApprovedAt DATETIME2(0) NULL,ApprovedBy BIGINT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT UQ_Emp_EmployeeExternalDeductions_Cmp_ID UNIQUE(CmpID,DeductionID),
  CONSTRAINT CK_Emp_EmployeeExternalDeductions_Values CHECK(MonthlyAmount>0 AND (TotalAmount IS NULL OR TotalAmount>0) AND WithheldTotal>=0 AND (TotalAmount IS NULL OR WithheldTotal<=TotalAmount) AND EffectiveFrom IS NOT NULL AND (EffectiveTo IS NULL OR EffectiveTo>=EffectiveFrom) AND DeductionState IN(0,1,2,3)),
  CONSTRAINT CK_Emp_EmployeeExternalDeductions_Method CHECK(DeductionMethod IN(1,2) AND CalculationBase IN(1,2) AND FrequencyMonths IN(1,2,3,4,6,12) AND ((DeductionMethod=1 AND PercentageRate IS NULL) OR (DeductionMethod=2 AND PercentageRate>0 AND PercentageRate<=100))),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_EmployeeExternalDeductions_Company FOREIGN KEY(CmpID) REFERENCES dbo.Mng_Company(CmpID),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_EmployeeExternalDeductions_Employee FOREIGN KEY(CmpID,EmployeeID) REFERENCES dbo.Emp_Employee(EmpCompany,EmpID),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_EmployeeExternalDeductions_Payee FOREIGN KEY(CmpID,PayeeID) REFERENCES dbo.Emp_ExternalDeductionPayees(CmpID,PayeeID),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_EmployeeExternalDeductions_Currency FOREIGN KEY(CmpID,CurrencyID) REFERENCES dbo.Acc_Currency(CurCmp,CurID),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_EmployeeExternalDeductions_Component FOREIGN KEY(CmpID,ComponentID) REFERENCES dbo.Emp_PayComponents(CmpID,ComponentID),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_EmployeeExternalDeductions_Creator FOREIGN KEY(CreatedBy) REFERENCES dbo.Mng_User(UsrID),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_EmployeeExternalDeductions_Approver FOREIGN KEY(ApprovedBy) REFERENCES dbo.Mng_User(UsrID)
 );
END;

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Emp_EmployeePayrollDestinations',N'U') IS NULL
BEGIN
 CREATE TABLE dbo.Emp_EmployeePayrollDestinations
 (
  DestinationID BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT PK_Emp_EmployeePayrollDestinations PRIMARY KEY,
  CmpID INT NOT NULL,EmployeeID BIGINT NOT NULL,MethodType TINYINT NOT NULL,ProviderName NVARCHAR(150) NULL,BeneficiaryName NVARCHAR(200) NULL,
  AccountNumber NVARCHAR(100) NULL,IBAN NVARCHAR(34) NULL,WalletIdentifier NVARCHAR(150) NULL,CurrencyID BIGINT NOT NULL,
  IsPrimary BIT NOT NULL,EffectiveFrom DATE NOT NULL,EffectiveTo DATE NULL,RecordState TINYINT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Emp_EmployeePayrollDestinations_State DEFAULT(0),
  CreatedAt DATETIME2(0) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Emp_EmployeePayrollDestinations_Created DEFAULT(SYSDATETIME()),CreatedBy BIGINT NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT UQ_Emp_EmployeePayrollDestinations_Cmp_ID UNIQUE(CmpID,DestinationID),
  CONSTRAINT CK_Emp_EmployeePayrollDestinations_Values CHECK(MethodType IN(1,2,3) AND RecordState IN(0,1) AND IsPrimary IN(0,1) AND EffectiveFrom IS NOT NULL AND (EffectiveTo IS NULL OR EffectiveTo>=EffectiveFrom) AND ((MethodType=1 AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(ProviderName)),N'') IS NOT NULL AND (NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(IBAN)),N'') IS NOT NULL OR NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(AccountNumber)),N'') IS NOT NULL)) OR (MethodType=2 AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(ProviderName)),N'') IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(WalletIdentifier)),N'') IS NOT NULL) OR MethodType=3)),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_EmployeePayrollDestinations_Company FOREIGN KEY(CmpID) REFERENCES dbo.Mng_Company(CmpID),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_EmployeePayrollDestinations_Employee FOREIGN KEY(CmpID,EmployeeID) REFERENCES dbo.Emp_Employee(EmpCompany,EmpID),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_EmployeePayrollDestinations_Currency FOREIGN KEY(CmpID,CurrencyID) REFERENCES dbo.Acc_Currency(CurCmp,CurID),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_EmployeePayrollDestinations_User FOREIGN KEY(CreatedBy) REFERENCES dbo.Mng_User(UsrID)
 );
END;

-- Company-configured deduction priority, calculation versions, allocations and carried balances
IF COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.Emp_PayComponents',N'DeductionPriority') IS NULL ALTER TABLE dbo.Emp_PayComponents ADD DeductionPriority SMALLINT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Emp_PayComponents_DeductionPriority DEFAULT(100);
IF COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.Emp_PayComponents',N'IsMandatoryDeduction') IS NULL ALTER TABLE dbo.Emp_PayComponents ADD IsMandatoryDeduction BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Emp_PayComponents_Mandatory DEFAULT(0);
IF COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.Emp_PayComponents',N'CanDefer') IS NULL ALTER TABLE dbo.Emp_PayComponents ADD CanDefer BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Emp_PayComponents_CanDefer DEFAULT(1);
IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys.check_constraints WHERE parent_object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Emp_PayComponents') AND name=N'CK_Emp_PayComponents_DeductionPolicy') ALTER TABLE dbo.Emp_PayComponents ADD CONSTRAINT CK_Emp_PayComponents_DeductionPolicy CHECK(DeductionPriority>=0 AND IsMandatoryDeduction IN(0,1) AND CanDefer IN(0,1));
IF COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.Emp_PayRuns',N'DeferredDeductionTotal') IS NULL ALTER TABLE dbo.Emp_PayRuns ADD DeferredDeductionTotal DECIMAL(19,3) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Emp_PayRuns_DeferredDeductionTotal DEFAULT(0);
IF COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.Emp_PayRuns',N'CalculationVersion') IS NULL ALTER TABLE dbo.Emp_PayRuns ADD CalculationVersion INT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Emp_PayRuns_CalculationVersion DEFAULT(0);
IF COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails',N'CollectedAmount') IS NULL ALTER TABLE dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails ADD CollectedAmount DECIMAL(19,3) NULL;
IF COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails',N'DeferredAmount') IS NULL ALTER TABLE dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails ADD DeferredAmount DECIMAL(19,3) NULL;
UPDATE dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails SET CollectedAmount=CASE WHEN LineKind=1 THEN Amount ELSE ISNULL(CollectedAmount,Amount) END,DeferredAmount=ISNULL(DeferredAmount,0) WHERE CollectedAmount IS NULL OR DeferredAmount IS NULL;
IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys.check_constraints WHERE parent_object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails') AND name=N'CK_Emp_PayrollDetails_Collection') ALTER TABLE dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails ADD CONSTRAINT CK_Emp_PayrollDetails_Collection CHECK(CollectedAmount IS NULL OR (CollectedAmount>=0 AND DeferredAmount>=0 AND ((LineKind=1 AND DeferredAmount=0) OR (LineKind=2 AND CollectedAmount+DeferredAmount=Amount))));
IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys.indexes WHERE object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails') AND name=N'UQ_Emp_PayrollDetails_Cmp_Detail') CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UQ_Emp_PayrollDetails_Cmp_Detail ON dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails(CmpID,PayrollDetailID);
GO

  Description NVARCHAR(250) NOT NULL,Quantity DECIMAL(15,4) NULL,Rate DECIMAL(15,6) NULL,Amount DECIMAL(19,3) NOT NULL,CollectedAmount DECIMAL(19,3) NOT NULL,DeferredAmount DECIMAL(19,3) NOT NULL,SourceType TINYINT NULL,SourceID BIGINT NULL,
  ArchivedAt DATETIME2(0) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Emp_PayrollDetailHistory_Archived DEFAULT(SYSDATETIME()),ArchivedBy BIGINT NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT UQ_Emp_PayrollDetailHistory_Version UNIQUE(CmpID,PayRunID,CalculationVersion,PayrollDetailID),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_PayrollDetailHistory_PayRun FOREIGN KEY(CmpID,PayRunID) REFERENCES dbo.Emp_PayRuns(CmpID,PayRunID),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_PayrollDetailHistory_Employee FOREIGN KEY(CmpID,EmployeeID) REFERENCES dbo.Emp_Employee(EmpCompany,EmpID),

 );

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Emp_PayrollDeductionArrears',N'U') IS NULL
BEGIN
 CREATE TABLE dbo.Emp_PayrollDeductionArrears
 (
  ArrearID BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT PK_Emp_PayrollDeductionArrears PRIMARY KEY,
  CmpID INT NOT NULL,EmployeeID BIGINT NOT NULL,ComponentID BIGINT NOT NULL,OriginalSourceType TINYINT NULL,OriginalSourceID BIGINT NULL,
  OriginPeriodID BIGINT NOT NULL,OriginPayRunID BIGINT NOT NULL,OriginPayrollDetailID BIGINT NOT NULL,CurrencyID BIGINT NOT NULL,
  OriginalAmount DECIMAL(19,3) NOT NULL,CollectedAmount DECIMAL(19,3) NOT NULL,OutstandingAmount DECIMAL(19,3) NOT NULL,
  DeductionPriority SMALLINT NOT NULL,IsMandatoryDeduction BIT NOT NULL,CanDefer BIT NOT NULL,ArrearState TINYINT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Emp_PayrollDeductionArrears_State DEFAULT(0),
  CreatedAt DATETIME2(0) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Emp_PayrollDeductionArrears_Created DEFAULT(SYSDATETIME()),UpdatedAt DATETIME2(0) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Emp_PayrollDeductionArrears_Updated DEFAULT(SYSDATETIME()),
  CONSTRAINT UQ_Emp_PayrollDeductionArrears_Cmp_ID UNIQUE(CmpID,ArrearID),
  CONSTRAINT UQ_Emp_PayrollDeductionArrears_Origin UNIQUE(CmpID,OriginPayrollDetailID),
  CONSTRAINT CK_Emp_PayrollDeductionArrears_Values CHECK(OriginalAmount>0 AND CollectedAmount>=0 AND OutstandingAmount>=0 AND CollectedAmount+OutstandingAmount=OriginalAmount AND DeductionPriority>=0 AND IsMandatoryDeduction IN(0,1) AND CanDefer IN(0,1) AND ((OutstandingAmount>0 AND ArrearState=0) OR (OutstandingAmount=0 AND ArrearState=1))),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_PayrollDeductionArrears_Company FOREIGN KEY(CmpID) REFERENCES dbo.Mng_Company(CmpID),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_PayrollDeductionArrears_Employee FOREIGN KEY(CmpID,EmployeeID) REFERENCES dbo.Emp_Employee(EmpCompany,EmpID),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_PayrollDeductionArrears_Component FOREIGN KEY(CmpID,ComponentID) REFERENCES dbo.Emp_PayComponents(CmpID,ComponentID),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_PayrollDeductionArrears_Currency FOREIGN KEY(CmpID,CurrencyID) REFERENCES dbo.Acc_Currency(CurCmp,CurID),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_PayrollDeductionArrears_Period FOREIGN KEY(CmpID,OriginPeriodID) REFERENCES dbo.Emp_PayPeriods(CmpID,PeriodID),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_PayrollDeductionArrears_PayRun FOREIGN KEY(CmpID,OriginPayRunID) REFERENCES dbo.Emp_PayRuns(CmpID,PayRunID)
 );
END;

  CmpID INT NOT NULL,PayRunID BIGINT NOT NULL,CalculationVersion INT NOT NULL,PayrollDetailID BIGINT NOT NULL,EmployeeID BIGINT NOT NULL,ComponentID BIGINT NOT NULL,
  SourceType TINYINT NULL,SourceID BIGINT NULL,ArrearID BIGINT NULL,RequestedAmount DECIMAL(19,3) NOT NULL,CollectedAmount DECIMAL(19,3) NOT NULL,DeferredAmount DECIMAL(19,3) NOT NULL,
  DeductionPriority SMALLINT NOT NULL,IsMandatoryDeduction BIT NOT NULL,CanDefer BIT NOT NULL,CreatedAt DATETIME2(0) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Emp_PayrollDeductionAllocations_Created DEFAULT(SYSDATETIME()),
  CONSTRAINT UQ_Emp_PayrollDeductionAllocations_Version UNIQUE(CmpID,PayRunID,CalculationVersion,PayrollDetailID),
  CONSTRAINT CK_Emp_PayrollDeductionAllocations_Values CHECK(RequestedAmount>=0 AND CollectedAmount>=0 AND DeferredAmount>=0 AND CollectedAmount+DeferredAmount=RequestedAmount AND DeductionPriority>=0 AND IsMandatoryDeduction IN(0,1) AND CanDefer IN(0,1)),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_PayrollDeductionAllocations_PayRun FOREIGN KEY(CmpID,PayRunID) REFERENCES dbo.Emp_PayRuns(CmpID,PayRunID),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_PayrollDeductionAllocations_Employee FOREIGN KEY(CmpID,EmployeeID) REFERENCES dbo.Emp_Employee(EmpCompany,EmpID),
  CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_PayrollDeductionAllocations_Component FOREIGN KEY(CmpID,ComponentID) REFERENCES dbo.Emp_PayComponents(CmpID,ComponentID)
 );

IF COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.Emp_EmployeeExternalDeductions',N'DeductionMethod') IS NULL ALTER TABLE dbo.Emp_EmployeeExternalDeductions ADD DeductionMethod TINYINT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Emp_EmployeeExternalDeductions_Method DEFAULT(1);
IF COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.Emp_EmployeeExternalDeductions',N'PercentageRate') IS NULL ALTER TABLE dbo.Emp_EmployeeExternalDeductions ADD PercentageRate DECIMAL(9,6) NULL;
