IF COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.Emp_EmployeeExternalDeductions',N'NextDueDate') IS NULL ALTER TABLE dbo.Emp_EmployeeExternalDeductions ADD NextDueDate DATE NULL;
UPDATE dbo.Emp_EmployeeExternalDeductions SET NextDueDate=EffectiveFrom WHERE NextDueDate IS NULL;
IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Emp_EmployeeExternalDeductions') AND name=N'NextDueDate' AND is_nullable=1)
 ALTER TABLE dbo.Emp_EmployeeExternalDeductions ALTER COLUMN NextDueDate DATE NOT NULL;
IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys.check_constraints WHERE parent_object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Emp_EmployeeExternalDeductions') AND name=N'CK_Emp_EmployeeExternalDeductions_Method')
 ALTER TABLE dbo.Emp_EmployeeExternalDeductions ADD CONSTRAINT CK_Emp_EmployeeExternalDeductions_Method CHECK(DeductionMethod IN(1,2) AND CalculationBase IN(1,2) AND FrequencyMonths IN(1,2,3,4,6,12) AND ((DeductionMethod=1 AND PercentageRate IS NULL) OR (DeductionMethod=2 AND PercentageRate>0 AND PercentageRate<=100))); AND name=N'UX_Emp_SalaryAdvances_PeriodEmployee')
 CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX_Emp_SalaryAdvances_PeriodEmployee ON dbo.Emp_SalaryAdvances(CmpID,PeriodID,EmployeeID) WHERE PeriodID IS NOT NULL;
GOIF COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.Emp_EmployeeExternalDeductions',N'AssessedTotal') IS NULL
BEGIN
 ALTER TABLE dbo.Emp_EmployeeExternalDeductions ADD AssessedTotal DECIMAL(15,3) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Emp_EmployeeExternalDeductions_Assessed DEFAULT(0) WITH VALUES;
 UPDATE dbo.Emp_EmployeeExternalDeductions SET AssessedTotal=WithheldTotal;
END;
IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys.check_constraints WHERE parent_object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Emp_EmployeeExternalDeductions') AND name=N'CK_Emp_EmployeeExternalDeductions_Assessed') ALTER TABLE dbo.Emp_EmployeeExternalDeductions ADD CONSTRAINT CK_Emp_EmployeeExternalDeductions_Assessed CHECK(AssessedTotal>=0 AND AssessedTotal>=WithheldTotal AND (TotalAmount IS NULL OR AssessedTotal<=TotalAmount));
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_SaveExternalDeductionPayee
 @CmpID INT,@PayeeID BIGINT=0,@PayeeCode NVARCHAR(40),@PayeeName NVARCHAR(200),@ContactInfo NVARCHAR(500)=NULL,@RecordState TINYINT=0,@UserID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 IF NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@PayeeCode)),N'') IS NULL OR NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@PayeeName)),N'') IS NULL OR @RecordState NOT IN(0,1)
  THROW 54801,N'بيانات جهة الاستقطاع الخارجي غير صحيحة.',1;
 IF @RecordState=1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_EmployeeExternalDeductions WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND PayeeID=@PayeeID AND DeductionState IN(0,1))
  THROW 54802,N'لا يمكن تعطيل جهة لها استقطاعات قائمة أو فعالة.',1;
 IF ISNULL(@PayeeID,0)=0
 BEGIN
  INSERT dbo.Emp_ExternalDeductionPayees(CmpID,PayeeCode,PayeeName,ContactInfo,RecordState,CreatedBy)
  VALUES(@CmpID,LTRIM(RTRIM(@PayeeCode)),LTRIM(RTRIM(@PayeeName)),NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@ContactInfo)),N''),@RecordState,@UserID);
  SET @PayeeID=SCOPE_IDENTITY();
 END
 ELSE
 BEGIN
  UPDATE dbo.Emp_ExternalDeductionPayees SET PayeeCode=LTRIM(RTRIM(@PayeeCode)),PayeeName=LTRIM(RTRIM(@PayeeName)),ContactInfo=NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@ContactInfo)),N''),RecordState=@RecordState
   WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND PayeeID=@PayeeID;
  IF @@ROWCOUNT<>1 THROW 54803,N'جهة الاستقطاع غير موجودة ضمن الشركة.',1;
 END;
 SELECT @PayeeID AS PayeeID;
END;
GO
IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys.indexes WHERE object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails') AND name=N'UX_Emp_PayrollDetails_SalaryAdvanceSource')
 CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX_Emp_PayrollDetails_SalaryAdvanceSource ON dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails(CmpID,PayRunID,SourceID) WHERE SourceType=20 AND SourceID IS NOT NULL;
IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys.indexes WHERE object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails') AND name=N'UX_Emp_PayrollDetails_ExternalDeductionSource')
 CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX_Emp_PayrollDetails_ExternalDeductionSource ON dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails(CmpID,PayRunID,SourceID) WHERE SourceType=21 AND SourceID IS NOT NULL;
GOCREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_SelectExternalDeductionPayees
 @CmpID INT,@RecordState TINYINT=NULL,@UserID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 SELECT PayeeID,PayeeCode,PayeeName,ContactInfo,RecordState,CreatedAt,CreatedBy
 FROM dbo.Emp_ExternalDeductionPayees WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND (@RecordState IS NULL OR RecordState=@RecordState) ORDER BY PayeeName,PayeeID;
END;
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_SaveSalaryAdvance
 @CmpID INT,@AdvanceID BIGINT=0,@EmployeeID BIGINT,@PayRunID BIGINT,@AdvanceNo NVARCHAR(40)=NULL,@Amount DECIMAL(15,3),@CurrencyID BIGINT,@ComponentID BIGINT,@IssueDate DATE,@UserID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 IF @Amount IS NULL OR @Amount<=0 OR @IssueDate IS NULL THROW 54810,N'مبلغ المرتب المقدم أو تاريخه غير صحيح.',1;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_Employee WHERE EmpCompany=@CmpID AND EmpID=@EmployeeID AND EmpState=0) THROW 54811,N'الموظف غير نشط أو لا يتبع للشركة.',1;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Acc_Currency WHERE CurCmp=@CmpID AND CurID=@CurrencyID AND CurState=0) THROW 54812,N'عملة المرتب المقدم غير نشطة أو لا تتبع للشركة.',1;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_PayComponents WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND ComponentID=@ComponentID AND ComponentKind=2 AND RecordState=0) THROW 54813,N'مكون استرداد المرتب المقدم غير نشط أو ليس استقطاعاً.',1;
 DECLARE @PeriodID BIGINT,@PeriodFrom DATE,@PeriodTo DATE,@RunCurrency BIGINT,@Available DECIMAL(19,3),@RunState TINYINT;
 SELECT @PeriodID=p.PeriodID,@PeriodFrom=p.DateFrom,@PeriodTo=p.DateTo,@RunCurrency=r.CurrencyID,@RunState=r.RunState
  FROM dbo.Emp_PayRuns r JOIN dbo.Emp_PayPeriods p ON p.CmpID=r.CmpID AND p.PeriodID=r.PeriodID
  WHERE r.CmpID=@CmpID AND r.PayRunID=@PayRunID AND r.RunState=1 AND p.PeriodState=0;
 IF @PeriodID IS NULL THROW 54823,N'يجب ربط المرتب المقدم بمسير محسوب وفترة موارد بشرية مفتوحة.',1;
 IF @RunCurrency<>@CurrencyID THROW 54824,N'عملة المرتب المقدم يجب أن تطابق عملة المسير للفترة المفتوحة.',1;
 IF @IssueDate<@PeriodFrom OR @IssueDate>@PeriodTo THROW 54825,N'تاريخ المرتب المقدم خارج الفترة المفتوحة المحددة.',1;
 SELECT @Available=SUM(CASE WHEN LineKind=1 THEN Amount ELSE -Amount END) FROM dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND PayRunID=@PayRunID AND EmployeeID=@EmployeeID;
 IF @Available IS NULL OR @Available<=0 THROW 54826,N'لا توجد مستحقات محسوبة للموظف في المسير المحدد.',1;
 IF @Amount>@Available THROW 54827,N'قيمة المرتب المقدم تتجاوز صافي مستحقات الموظف المحسوبة للفترة.',1;
 BEGIN TRY
  BEGIN TRANSACTION;
  IF ISNULL(@AdvanceID,0)=0
  BEGIN
   INSERT dbo.Emp_SalaryAdvances(CmpID,EmployeeID,AdvanceNo,Amount,CurrencyID,ComponentID,IssueDate,FirstDeductionDate,InstallmentCount,InstallmentAmount,PeriodID,CalculationPayRunID,CreatedBy)
   VALUES(@CmpID,@EmployeeID,@AdvanceNo,@Amount,@CurrencyID,@ComponentID,@IssueDate,@PeriodTo,1,@Amount,@PeriodID,@PayRunID,@UserID);
   SET @AdvanceID=SCOPE_IDENTITY();
  END
  ELSE
  BEGIN
   UPDATE dbo.Emp_SalaryAdvances SET AdvanceNo=@AdvanceNo,Amount=@Amount,CurrencyID=@CurrencyID,ComponentID=@ComponentID,IssueDate=@IssueDate,FirstDeductionDate=@PeriodTo,InstallmentCount=1,InstallmentAmount=@Amount,PeriodID=@PeriodID,CalculationPayRunID=@PayRunID,ApprovedAt=NULL,ApprovedBy=NULL
    WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND AdvanceID=@AdvanceID AND EmployeeID=@EmployeeID AND AdvanceState IN(0,2)
      AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_SalaryAdvanceInstallments WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND AdvanceID=@AdvanceID)
      AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND SourceType=20 AND SourceID=@AdvanceID);
   IF @@ROWCOUNT<>1 THROW 54814,N'طلب المرتب المقدم غير موجود أو لا يمكن تعديله بعد بدء التسوية.',1;
  END;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_ApprovalRouteSteps WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND ProcessType=11 AND RecordState=0)
   EXEC dbo.Emp_StartApproval @CmpID,11,@AdvanceID,@UserID,1;
  COMMIT TRANSACTION;
  SELECT AdvanceID,PeriodID,CalculationPayRunID,AdvanceState FROM dbo.Emp_SalaryAdvances WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND AdvanceID=@AdvanceID;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH
  IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
  THROW;
 END CATCH;
END;
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_ApproveSalaryAdvance
 @CmpID INT,@AdvanceID BIGINT,@ApproverID BIGINT,@StepNo SMALLINT=1,@Comments NVARCHAR(1000)=NULL
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@ApproverID;
 BEGIN TRY
  BEGIN TRANSACTION;
  DECLARE @EmployeeID BIGINT,@CreatorID BIGINT,@Amount DECIMAL(15,3),@PeriodID BIGINT,@PayRunID BIGINT,@PeriodTo DATE,@State TINYINT,@ApprovalResult TINYINT,@NextStep SMALLINT,@Available DECIMAL(19,3);
  SELECT @EmployeeID=a.EmployeeID,@CreatorID=a.CreatedBy,@Amount=a.Amount,@PeriodID=a.PeriodID,@PayRunID=a.CalculationPayRunID,@State=a.AdvanceState,@PeriodTo=p.DateTo
   FROM dbo.Emp_SalaryAdvances a WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) JOIN dbo.Emp_PayPeriods p ON p.CmpID=a.CmpID AND p.PeriodID=a.PeriodID JOIN dbo.Emp_PayRuns r ON r.CmpID=a.CmpID AND r.PayRunID=a.CalculationPayRunID
   WHERE a.CmpID=@CmpID AND a.AdvanceID=@AdvanceID AND p.PeriodState=0 AND r.RunState=1;
  IF @State IS NULL OR @State<>0 THROW 54815,N'طلب المرتب المقدم غير موجود أو أن فترته لم تعد مفتوحة.',1;
  IF @CreatorID=@ApproverID THROW 54816,N'لا يجوز لمنشئ الطلب اعتماده.',1;
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_Employee WHERE EmpCompany=@CmpID AND EmpID=@EmployeeID AND EmpState=0) THROW 54828,N'الموظف لم يعد نشطاً؛ لا يمكن اعتماد المرتب المقدم.',1;
  SELECT @Available=SUM(CASE WHEN LineKind=1 THEN Amount ELSE -Amount END) FROM dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND PayRunID=@PayRunID AND EmployeeID=@EmployeeID;
  IF @Available IS NULL OR @Amount>@Available THROW 54829,N'تغيرت مستحقات الموظف؛ أعد احتساب المسير قبل اعتماد المرتب المقدم.',1;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_ApprovalRequests WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND ProcessType=11 AND EntityID=@AdvanceID) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_ApprovalRouteSteps WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND ProcessType=11 AND RecordState=0)
  BEGIN
   IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_ApprovalRequests WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND ProcessType=11 AND EntityID=@AdvanceID) EXEC dbo.Emp_StartApproval @CmpID,11,@AdvanceID,@CreatorID,1;
   EXEC dbo.Emp_DecideApprovalStep @CmpID,11,@AdvanceID,@StepNo,@ApproverID,1,@Comments,@ApprovalResult OUTPUT,@NextStep OUTPUT,1;
   IF @ApprovalResult=0
   BEGIN
    COMMIT TRANSACTION;
    SELECT AdvanceID,PeriodID,CalculationPayRunID,AdvanceState FROM dbo.Emp_SalaryAdvances WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND AdvanceID=@AdvanceID;
    RETURN;
   END;
  END;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_SalaryAdvanceInstallments WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND AdvanceID=@AdvanceID) THROW 54817,N'تم إنشاء قيد تسوية المرتب المقدم مسبقاً.',1;
  INSERT dbo.Emp_SalaryAdvanceInstallments(CmpID,AdvanceID,InstallmentNo,DueDate,Amount) VALUES(@CmpID,@AdvanceID,1,@PeriodTo,@Amount);
  UPDATE dbo.Emp_SalaryAdvances SET AdvanceState=1,ApprovedAt=SYSDATETIME(),ApprovedBy=@ApproverID WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND AdvanceID=@AdvanceID AND AdvanceState=0;
  IF @@ROWCOUNT<>1 THROW 54818,N'تغيرت حالة طلب المرتب المقدم أثناء الاعتماد.',1;
  COMMIT TRANSACTION;
  SELECT AdvanceID,PeriodID,CalculationPayRunID,AdvanceState FROM dbo.Emp_SalaryAdvances WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND AdvanceID=@AdvanceID;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH
  IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
  THROW;
 END CATCH;
END;
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_RejectSalaryAdvance
 @CmpID INT,@AdvanceID BIGINT,@ApproverID BIGINT,@StepNo SMALLINT=1,@Comments NVARCHAR(1000)=NULL
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@ApproverID;
 BEGIN TRY
  BEGIN TRANSACTION;
  DECLARE @CreatorID BIGINT,@ApprovalResult TINYINT,@NextStep SMALLINT;
  SELECT @CreatorID=CreatedBy FROM dbo.Emp_SalaryAdvances WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND AdvanceID=@AdvanceID AND AdvanceState=0;
  IF @CreatorID IS NULL OR @CreatorID=@ApproverID THROW 54819,N'طلب المرتب المقدم غير موجود أو لا يجوز لمنشئه رفضه.',1;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_ApprovalRequests WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND ProcessType=11 AND EntityID=@AdvanceID) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_ApprovalRouteSteps WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND ProcessType=11 AND RecordState=0)
  BEGIN
   IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_ApprovalRequests WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND ProcessType=11 AND EntityID=@AdvanceID) EXEC dbo.Emp_StartApproval @CmpID,11,@AdvanceID,@CreatorID,1;
   EXEC dbo.Emp_DecideApprovalStep @CmpID,11,@AdvanceID,@StepNo,@ApproverID,2,@Comments,@ApprovalResult OUTPUT,@NextStep OUTPUT,1;
  END;
  UPDATE dbo.Emp_SalaryAdvances SET AdvanceState=2,ApprovedAt=SYSDATETIME(),ApprovedBy=@ApproverID WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND AdvanceID=@AdvanceID AND AdvanceState=0;
  IF @@ROWCOUNT<>1 THROW 54820,N'تغيرت حالة طلب المرتب المقدم أثناء الرفض.',1;
  COMMIT TRANSACTION;
  SELECT AdvanceID,AdvanceState FROM dbo.Emp_SalaryAdvances WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND AdvanceID=@AdvanceID;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH
  IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
  THROW;
 END CATCH;
END;
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_RegisterSalaryAdvancePayment
 @CmpID INT,@InstallmentID BIGINT,@Amount DECIMAL(15,3),@PaymentDate DATE,@UserID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 IF @Amount IS NULL OR @Amount<=0 OR @PaymentDate IS NULL THROW 54821,N'مبلغ أو تاريخ سداد المرتب المقدم غير صحيح.',1;
 BEGIN TRY
  BEGIN TRANSACTION;
  UPDATE i WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) SET PaidAmount=PaidAmount+@Amount,InstallmentState=CASE WHEN PaidAmount+@Amount=Amount THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,PaidAt=CASE WHEN PaidAmount+@Amount=Amount THEN SYSDATETIME() ELSE NULL END
   FROM dbo.Emp_SalaryAdvanceInstallments i JOIN dbo.Emp_SalaryAdvances a ON a.CmpID=i.CmpID AND a.AdvanceID=i.AdvanceID AND a.AdvanceState=1 AND a.Disbursed=1
   WHERE i.CmpID=@CmpID AND i.InstallmentID=@InstallmentID AND i.InstallmentState=0 AND i.PaidAmount+@Amount<=i.Amount;
  IF @@ROWCOUNT<>1 THROW 54822,N'القسط غير مستحق أو أن مبلغ السداد يتجاوز المتبقي.',1;
  INSERT dbo.Emp_SalaryAdvancePayments(CmpID,InstallmentID,Amount,PaymentDate,PaymentSource,CreatedBy) VALUES(@CmpID,@InstallmentID,@Amount,@PaymentDate,1,@UserID);
  UPDATE a SET AdvanceState=3 FROM dbo.Emp_SalaryAdvances a WHERE a.CmpID=@CmpID AND a.AdvanceID=(SELECT i.AdvanceID FROM dbo.Emp_SalaryAdvanceInstallments i WHERE i.CmpID=@CmpID AND i.InstallmentID=@InstallmentID)
   AND a.AdvanceState=1 AND a.Disbursed=1 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_SalaryAdvanceInstallments i WHERE i.CmpID=a.CmpID AND i.AdvanceID=a.AdvanceID AND i.InstallmentState=0);
  COMMIT TRANSACTION;
  SELECT InstallmentID,Amount,PaidAmount,InstallmentState FROM dbo.Emp_SalaryAdvanceInstallments WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND InstallmentID=@InstallmentID;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH
  IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
  THROW;
 END CATCH;
END;
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_SaveEmployeeExternalDeduction
 @CmpID INT,@DeductionID BIGINT=0,@EmployeeID BIGINT,@PayeeID BIGINT,@ReferenceNo NVARCHAR(100)=NULL,@Description NVARCHAR(500),
 @CurrencyID BIGINT,@ComponentID BIGINT,@MonthlyAmount DECIMAL(15,3),@DeductionMethod TINYINT,@PercentageRate DECIMAL(9,6)=NULL,@CalculationBase TINYINT=1,@FrequencyMonths TINYINT=1,
 @TotalAmount DECIMAL(15,3)=NULL,@EffectiveFrom DATE,@EffectiveTo DATE=NULL,@UserID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 IF NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@Description)),N'') IS NULL OR @MonthlyAmount IS NULL OR @MonthlyAmount<=0 OR (@TotalAmount IS NOT NULL AND @TotalAmount<=0)
  OR @DeductionMethod NOT IN(1,2) OR @CalculationBase NOT IN(1,2) OR @FrequencyMonths NOT IN(1,2,3,4,6,12)
  OR (@DeductionMethod=1 AND @PercentageRate IS NOT NULL) OR (@DeductionMethod=2 AND (@PercentageRate IS NULL OR @PercentageRate<=0 OR @PercentageRate>100))
  OR @EffectiveFrom IS NULL OR (@EffectiveTo IS NOT NULL AND @EffectiveTo<@EffectiveFrom)
  THROW 54830,N'بيانات الاستقطاع الخارجي أو طريقة احتسابه غير صحيحة.',1;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_Employee WHERE EmpCompany=@CmpID AND EmpID=@EmployeeID AND EmpState=0) THROW 54831,N'الموظف غير نشط أو لا يتبع للشركة.',1;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_ExternalDeductionPayees WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND PayeeID=@PayeeID AND RecordState=0) THROW 54832,N'جهة الاستقطاع غير نشطة أو لا تتبع للشركة.',1;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Acc_Currency WHERE CurCmp=@CmpID AND CurID=@CurrencyID AND CurState=0) THROW 54833,N'عملة الاستقطاع غير نشطة أو لا تتبع للشركة.',1;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_PayComponents WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND ComponentID=@ComponentID AND ComponentKind=2 AND RecordState=0) THROW 54834,N'مكون الاستقطاع الخارجي غير نشط أو ليس استقطاعاً.',1;
 BEGIN TRY
  BEGIN TRANSACTION;
  IF ISNULL(@DeductionID,0)=0
  BEGIN
   INSERT dbo.Emp_EmployeeExternalDeductions(CmpID,EmployeeID,PayeeID,ReferenceNo,Description,CurrencyID,ComponentID,DeductionMethod,PercentageRate,CalculationBase,FrequencyMonths,NextDueDate,MonthlyAmount,TotalAmount,EffectiveFrom,EffectiveTo,CreatedBy)
   VALUES(@CmpID,@EmployeeID,@PayeeID,@ReferenceNo,LTRIM(RTRIM(@Description)),@CurrencyID,@ComponentID,@DeductionMethod,@PercentageRate,@CalculationBase,@FrequencyMonths,@EffectiveFrom,@MonthlyAmount,@TotalAmount,@EffectiveFrom,@EffectiveTo,@UserID);
   SET @DeductionID=SCOPE_IDENTITY();
  END
  ELSE
  BEGIN
   UPDATE dbo.Emp_EmployeeExternalDeductions SET PayeeID=@PayeeID,ReferenceNo=@ReferenceNo,Description=LTRIM(RTRIM(@Description)),CurrencyID=@CurrencyID,ComponentID=@ComponentID,DeductionMethod=@DeductionMethod,PercentageRate=@PercentageRate,CalculationBase=@CalculationBase,FrequencyMonths=@FrequencyMonths,NextDueDate=@EffectiveFrom,MonthlyAmount=@MonthlyAmount,TotalAmount=@TotalAmount,WithheldTotal=0,AssessedTotal=0,EffectiveFrom=@EffectiveFrom,EffectiveTo=@EffectiveTo,ApprovedAt=NULL,ApprovedBy=NULL
    WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND DeductionID=@DeductionID AND EmployeeID=@EmployeeID AND DeductionState IN(0,2)
      AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND SourceType=21 AND SourceID=@DeductionID);
   IF @@ROWCOUNT<>1 THROW 54835,N'طلب الاستقطاع غير موجود أو تعذر تعديله بعد استخدامه في مسير.',1;
  END;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_ApprovalRouteSteps WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND ProcessType=12 AND RecordState=0)
   EXEC dbo.Emp_StartApproval @CmpID,12,@DeductionID,@UserID,1;
  COMMIT TRANSACTION;
  SELECT DeductionID,DeductionState,NextDueDate FROM dbo.Emp_EmployeeExternalDeductions WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND DeductionID=@DeductionID;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH
  IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
  THROW;
 END CATCH;
END;
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_DecideEmployeeExternalDeduction
 @CmpID INT,@DeductionID BIGINT,@ApproverID BIGINT,@Decision TINYINT,@StepNo SMALLINT=1,@Comments NVARCHAR(1000)=NULL
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@ApproverID;
 IF @Decision NOT IN(1,2) OR @StepNo<=0 THROW 54836,N'قرار أو مرحلة الاستقطاع الخارجي غير صحيحة.',1;
 BEGIN TRY
  BEGIN TRANSACTION;
  DECLARE @CreatorID BIGINT,@State TINYINT,@ApprovalResult TINYINT,@NextStep SMALLINT;
  SELECT @CreatorID=CreatedBy,@State=DeductionState FROM dbo.Emp_EmployeeExternalDeductions WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND DeductionID=@DeductionID;
  IF @State IS NULL OR @State<>0 THROW 54837,N'طلب الاستقطاع غير موجود أو سبق البت فيه.',1;
  IF @CreatorID=@ApproverID THROW 54838,N'لا يجوز لمنشئ الطلب البت فيه.',1;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_ApprovalRequests WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND ProcessType=12 AND EntityID=@DeductionID) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_ApprovalRouteSteps WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND ProcessType=12 AND RecordState=0)
  BEGIN
   IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_ApprovalRequests WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND ProcessType=12 AND EntityID=@DeductionID) EXEC dbo.Emp_StartApproval @CmpID,12,@DeductionID,@CreatorID,1;
   EXEC dbo.Emp_DecideApprovalStep @CmpID,12,@DeductionID,@StepNo,@ApproverID,@Decision,@Comments,@ApprovalResult OUTPUT,@NextStep OUTPUT,1;
   IF @ApprovalResult=0
   BEGIN
    COMMIT TRANSACTION;
    SELECT DeductionID,DeductionState FROM dbo.Emp_EmployeeExternalDeductions WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND DeductionID=@DeductionID;
    RETURN;
   END;
  END;
  UPDATE dbo.Emp_EmployeeExternalDeductions SET DeductionState=CASE WHEN @Decision=1 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,ApprovedAt=SYSDATETIME(),ApprovedBy=@ApproverID WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND DeductionID=@DeductionID AND DeductionState=0;
  IF @@ROWCOUNT<>1 THROW 54839,N'تغيرت حالة الاستقطاع أثناء البت فيه.',1;
  COMMIT TRANSACTION;
  SELECT DeductionID,DeductionState FROM dbo.Emp_EmployeeExternalDeductions WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND DeductionID=@DeductionID;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH
  IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
  THROW;
 END CATCH;
END;
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_SelectSalaryAdvances
 @CmpID INT,@EmployeeID BIGINT=NULL,@AdvanceState TINYINT=NULL,@UserID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 SELECT a.AdvanceID,a.EmployeeID,e.EmpNum,e.EmpName,a.AdvanceNo,a.Amount,a.CurrencyID,c.CurCode,c.CurName,a.ComponentID,a.IssueDate,a.FirstDeductionDate,a.InstallmentCount,a.InstallmentAmount,a.AdvanceState,a.CreatedAt,a.CreatedBy,a.ApprovedAt,a.ApprovedBy,a.PeriodID,a.CalculationPayRunID,a.Disbursed,a.DisbursementReference,a.DisbursedAt,a.DisbursedBy,
  ISNULL((SELECT SUM(i.Amount) FROM dbo.Emp_SalaryAdvanceInstallments i WHERE i.CmpID=a.CmpID AND i.AdvanceID=a.AdvanceID),0) AS ScheduledAmount,
  ISNULL((SELECT SUM(i.PaidAmount) FROM dbo.Emp_SalaryAdvanceInstallments i WHERE i.CmpID=a.CmpID AND i.AdvanceID=a.AdvanceID),0) AS PaidAmount,
  ISNULL((SELECT SUM(i.Amount-i.PaidAmount) FROM dbo.Emp_SalaryAdvanceInstallments i WHERE i.CmpID=a.CmpID AND i.AdvanceID=a.AdvanceID),0) AS OutstandingAmount
 FROM dbo.Emp_SalaryAdvances a JOIN dbo.Emp_Employee e ON e.EmpCompany=a.CmpID AND e.EmpID=a.EmployeeID JOIN dbo.Acc_Currency c ON c.CurCmp=a.CmpID AND c.CurID=a.CurrencyID
 WHERE a.CmpID=@CmpID AND (@EmployeeID IS NULL OR a.EmployeeID=@EmployeeID) AND (@AdvanceState IS NULL OR a.AdvanceState=@AdvanceState) ORDER BY a.IssueDate DESC,a.AdvanceID DESC;
END;
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_SelectEmployeeExternalDeductions
 @CmpID INT,@EmployeeID BIGINT=NULL,@DeductionState TINYINT=NULL,@UserID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 SELECT d.DeductionID,d.EmployeeID,e.EmpNum,e.EmpName,d.PayeeID,p.PayeeCode,p.PayeeName,d.ReferenceNo,d.Description,d.CurrencyID,c.CurCode,d.ComponentID,d.DeductionMethod,d.PercentageRate,d.CalculationBase,d.FrequencyMonths,d.NextDueDate,d.MonthlyAmount,d.TotalAmount,d.WithheldTotal,d.AssessedTotal,CASE WHEN d.TotalAmount IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE d.TotalAmount-d.AssessedTotal END AS RemainingAmount,d.EffectiveFrom,d.EffectiveTo,d.DeductionState,d.CreatedAt,d.CreatedBy,d.ApprovedAt,d.ApprovedBy
 FROM dbo.Emp_EmployeeExternalDeductions d JOIN dbo.Emp_Employee e ON e.EmpCompany=d.CmpID AND e.EmpID=d.EmployeeID JOIN dbo.Emp_ExternalDeductionPayees p ON p.CmpID=d.CmpID AND p.PayeeID=d.PayeeID JOIN dbo.Acc_Currency c ON c.CurCmp=d.CmpID AND c.CurID=d.CurrencyID
 WHERE d.CmpID=@CmpID AND (@EmployeeID IS NULL OR d.EmployeeID=@EmployeeID) AND (@DeductionState IS NULL OR d.DeductionState=@DeductionState) ORDER BY d.EffectiveFrom DESC,d.DeductionID DESC;
END;
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_SaveEmployeePayrollDestination
 @CmpID INT,@DestinationID BIGINT=0,@EmployeeID BIGINT,@MethodType TINYINT,@ProviderName NVARCHAR(150)=NULL,@BeneficiaryName NVARCHAR(200)=NULL,
 @AccountNumber NVARCHAR(100)=NULL,@IBAN NVARCHAR(34)=NULL,@WalletIdentifier NVARCHAR(150)=NULL,@CurrencyID BIGINT,@IsPrimary BIT,@EffectiveFrom DATE,@EffectiveTo DATE=NULL,@RecordState TINYINT=0,@UserID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 IF @MethodType IS NULL OR @MethodType NOT IN(1,2,3) OR @IsPrimary IS NULL OR @RecordState IS NULL OR @RecordState NOT IN(0,1) OR @EffectiveFrom IS NULL OR (@EffectiveTo IS NOT NULL AND @EffectiveTo<@EffectiveFrom)
  THROW 54850,N'بيانات وجهة صرف الموظف غير صحيحة.',1;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_Employee WHERE EmpCompany=@CmpID AND EmpID=@EmployeeID) THROW 54851,N'الموظف لا يتبع للشركة.',1;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Acc_Currency WHERE CurCmp=@CmpID AND CurID=@CurrencyID AND CurState=0) THROW 54852,N'عملة وجهة الصرف غير نشطة أو لا تتبع للشركة.',1;
 IF @MethodType=1 AND (NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@ProviderName)),N'') IS NULL OR (NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@IBAN)),N'') IS NULL AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@AccountNumber)),N'') IS NULL)) THROW 54853,N'بيانات المصرف ورقم الحساب أو الآيبان مطلوبة.',1;
 IF @MethodType=2 AND (NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@ProviderName)),N'') IS NULL OR NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@WalletIdentifier)),N'') IS NULL) THROW 54854,N'اسم المحفظة ومعرفها مطلوبان.',1;
 BEGIN TRY
  BEGIN TRANSACTION;
 IF @IsPrimary=1 AND @RecordState=0 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_EmployeePayrollDestinations WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND EmployeeID=@EmployeeID AND IsPrimary=1 AND RecordState=0 AND DestinationID<>ISNULL(@DestinationID,0) AND EffectiveFrom<=ISNULL(@EffectiveTo,CONVERT(date,'99991231')) AND ISNULL(EffectiveTo,CONVERT(date,'99991231'))>=@EffectiveFrom)
  THROW 54855,N'تتداخل وجهة الصرف الأساسية مع وجهة أخرى للموظف.',1;
 IF ISNULL(@DestinationID,0)=0
 BEGIN
  INSERT dbo.Emp_EmployeePayrollDestinations(CmpID,EmployeeID,MethodType,ProviderName,BeneficiaryName,AccountNumber,IBAN,WalletIdentifier,CurrencyID,IsPrimary,EffectiveFrom,EffectiveTo,RecordState,CreatedBy)
   VALUES(@CmpID,@EmployeeID,@MethodType,NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@ProviderName)),N''),NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@BeneficiaryName)),N''),NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@AccountNumber)),N''),NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@IBAN)),N''),NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@WalletIdentifier)),N''),@CurrencyID,@IsPrimary,@EffectiveFrom,@EffectiveTo,@RecordState,@UserID);
  SET @DestinationID=SCOPE_IDENTITY();
 END
 ELSE
 BEGIN
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_PayRuns r JOIN dbo.Emp_PayPeriods p ON p.CmpID=r.CmpID AND p.PeriodID=r.PeriodID JOIN dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails d ON d.CmpID=r.CmpID AND d.PayRunID=r.PayRunID AND d.EmployeeID=@EmployeeID WHERE r.CmpID=@CmpID AND r.RunState>=2 AND p.DateTo>=@EffectiveFrom AND p.DateFrom<=ISNULL(@EffectiveTo,CONVERT(date,'99991231')))
   THROW 54856,N'تعديل الوجهة سيغيّر تعليمات صرف مسير معتمد؛ أنشئ فترة سريان جديدة بدلاً من تعديل التاريخ السابق.',1;
  UPDATE dbo.Emp_EmployeePayrollDestinations SET MethodType=@MethodType,ProviderName=NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@ProviderName)),N''),BeneficiaryName=NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@BeneficiaryName)),N''),AccountNumber=NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@AccountNumber)),N''),IBAN=NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@IBAN)),N''),WalletIdentifier=NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@WalletIdentifier)),N''),CurrencyID=@CurrencyID,IsPrimary=@IsPrimary,EffectiveFrom=@EffectiveFrom,EffectiveTo=@EffectiveTo,RecordState=@RecordState
   WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND DestinationID=@DestinationID AND EmployeeID=@EmployeeID;
  IF @@ROWCOUNT<>1 THROW 54857,N'وجهة الصرف غير موجودة أو لا تتبع للموظف.',1;
 END;
 COMMIT TRANSACTION;
 SELECT @DestinationID AS DestinationID;
END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH
  IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
  THROW;
 END CATCH;
END;GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_SelectEmployeePayrollDestinations
 @CmpID INT,@EmployeeID BIGINT,@AsOfDate DATE=NULL,@UserID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 SET @AsOfDate=ISNULL(@AsOfDate,CONVERT(date,SYSDATETIME()));
 SELECT DestinationID,EmployeeID,MethodType,ProviderName,BeneficiaryName,AccountNumber,IBAN,WalletIdentifier,CurrencyID,IsPrimary,EffectiveFrom,EffectiveTo,RecordState,CreatedAt,CreatedBy
 FROM dbo.Emp_EmployeePayrollDestinations WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND EmployeeID=@EmployeeID AND EffectiveFrom<=@AsOfDate AND (EffectiveTo IS NULL OR EffectiveTo>=@AsOfDate) ORDER BY IsPrimary DESC,DestinationID DESC;
END;
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_SelectPayRunPaymentInstructions
 @CmpID INT,@PayRunID BIGINT,@UserID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 DECLARE @PeriodTo DATE,@CurrencyID BIGINT,@RunState TINYINT;
 SELECT @PeriodTo=p.DateTo,@CurrencyID=r.CurrencyID,@RunState=r.RunState FROM dbo.Emp_PayRuns r JOIN dbo.Emp_PayPeriods p ON p.CmpID=r.CmpID AND p.PeriodID=r.PeriodID WHERE r.CmpID=@CmpID AND r.PayRunID=@PayRunID;
 IF @PeriodTo IS NULL OR @RunState<2 THROW 54858,N'تعليمات الصرف متاحة بعد اعتماد المسير.',1;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_PayRuns WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND PayRunID=@PayRunID AND NetTotal<0) THROW 54959,N'صافي المسير سالب؛ يمنع إصدار تعليمات صرف.',1;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM
  (SELECT d.EmployeeID,SUM(CASE WHEN d.LineKind=1 THEN d.Amount ELSE 0 END) AS GrossAmount,SUM(CASE WHEN d.LineKind=2 THEN ISNULL(d.CollectedAmount,d.Amount) ELSE 0 END) AS CollectedAmount
   FROM dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails d WHERE d.CmpID=@CmpID AND d.PayRunID=@PayRunID GROUP BY d.EmployeeID) x
  CROSS APPLY(SELECT COUNT(*) AS Cnt FROM dbo.Emp_EmployeePayrollDestinations m WHERE m.CmpID=@CmpID AND m.EmployeeID=x.EmployeeID AND m.IsPrimary=1 AND m.RecordState=0 AND m.CurrencyID=@CurrencyID AND m.EffectiveFrom<=@PeriodTo AND (m.EffectiveTo IS NULL OR m.EffectiveTo>=@PeriodTo)) z
  WHERE x.GrossAmount>x.CollectedAmount AND z.Cnt>1)
  THROW 54860,N'توجد أكثر من وجهة صرف أساسية سارية لموظف في المسير.',1; ;WITH EmployeeNet AS
 (
  SELECT d.EmployeeID,SUM(CASE WHEN d.LineKind=1 THEN d.Amount ELSE 0 END) AS GrossAmount,SUM(CASE WHEN d.LineKind=2 THEN ISNULL(d.CollectedAmount,d.Amount) ELSE 0 END) AS CollectedAmount
  FROM dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails d WHERE d.CmpID=@CmpID AND d.PayRunID=@PayRunID GROUP BY d.EmployeeID
 )
 SELECT x.EmployeeID,e.EmpNum,e.EmpName,x.GrossAmount,x.CollectedAmount,CASE WHEN x.GrossAmount>x.CollectedAmount THEN x.GrossAmount-x.CollectedAmount ELSE 0 END AS NetAmount,@CurrencyID AS CurrencyID,c.CurCode,
  m.DestinationID,m.MethodType,m.ProviderName,m.BeneficiaryName,m.AccountNumber,m.IBAN,m.WalletIdentifier
 FROM EmployeeNet x JOIN dbo.Emp_Employee e ON e.EmpCompany=@CmpID AND e.EmpID=x.EmployeeID JOIN dbo.Acc_Currency c ON c.CurCmp=@CmpID AND c.CurID=@CurrencyID
 OUTER APPLY(SELECT TOP(1) z.* FROM dbo.Emp_EmployeePayrollDestinations z WHERE z.CmpID=@CmpID AND z.EmployeeID=x.EmployeeID AND z.IsPrimary=1 AND z.RecordState=0 AND z.CurrencyID=@CurrencyID AND z.EffectiveFrom<=@PeriodTo AND (z.EffectiveTo IS NULL OR z.EffectiveTo>=@PeriodTo) ORDER BY z.EffectiveFrom DESC,z.DestinationID DESC) m
 WHERE x.GrossAmount>x.CollectedAmount ORDER BY e.EmpName,x.EmployeeID;
END;
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_ConfirmSalaryAdvanceDisbursement
 @CmpID INT,@AdvanceID BIGINT,@DisbursementReference NVARCHAR(100),@DisbursedAt DATETIME2(0),@TreasuryActorID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@TreasuryActorID;
 IF NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@DisbursementReference)),N'') IS NULL OR @DisbursedAt IS NULL THROW 54920,N'مرجع أو وقت صرف المرتب المقدم مطلوب.',1;
 BEGIN TRY
  BEGIN TRANSACTION;
  DECLARE @State TINYINT,@AlreadyDisbursed BIT,@ExistingReference NVARCHAR(100),@PeriodState TINYINT;
  SELECT @State=a.AdvanceState,@AlreadyDisbursed=a.Disbursed,@ExistingReference=a.DisbursementReference,@PeriodState=p.PeriodState
   FROM dbo.Emp_SalaryAdvances a WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) JOIN dbo.Emp_PayPeriods p ON p.CmpID=a.CmpID AND p.PeriodID=a.PeriodID
   WHERE a.CmpID=@CmpID AND a.AdvanceID=@AdvanceID;
  IF @State IS NULL OR @State<>1 THROW 54921,N'المرتب المقدم غير معتمد أو غير موجود.',1;
  IF @AlreadyDisbursed=1
  BEGIN
   IF @ExistingReference<>LTRIM(RTRIM(@DisbursementReference)) THROW 54922,N'تم تسجيل مرجع صرف مختلف لهذا المرتب المقدم.',1;
   COMMIT TRANSACTION;
   SELECT AdvanceID,Disbursed,DisbursementReference,DisbursedAt,DisbursedBy FROM dbo.Emp_SalaryAdvances WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND AdvanceID=@AdvanceID;
   RETURN;
  END;
  IF @PeriodState<>0 THROW 54923,N'يجب تأكيد صرف المرتب المقدم خلال بقاء فترة الموارد البشرية مفتوحة.',1;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_SalaryAdvances WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND DisbursementReference=LTRIM(RTRIM(@DisbursementReference)) AND AdvanceID<>@AdvanceID)
   THROW 54924,N'مرجع الخزينة مستخدم لعملية مرتّب مقدم أخرى.',1;
  UPDATE dbo.Emp_SalaryAdvances SET Disbursed=1,DisbursementReference=LTRIM(RTRIM(@DisbursementReference)),DisbursedAt=@DisbursedAt,DisbursedBy=@TreasuryActorID
   WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND AdvanceID=@AdvanceID AND AdvanceState=1 AND Disbursed=0;
  IF @@ROWCOUNT<>1 THROW 54925,N'تغيرت حالة صرف المرتب المقدم أثناء التسجيل.',1;
  COMMIT TRANSACTION;
  SELECT AdvanceID,Disbursed,DisbursementReference,DisbursedAt,DisbursedBy FROM dbo.Emp_SalaryAdvances WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND AdvanceID=@AdvanceID;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH
  IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
  THROW;
 END CATCH;
END;
GOGO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_SelectPayRunDeficitReport
 @CmpID INT,@PayRunID BIGINT,@UserID BIGINT,@EmployeeID BIGINT=NULL
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_PayRuns WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND PayRunID=@PayRunID AND RunState IN(1,2,3))
  THROW 54960,N'تقرير العجز متاح بعد احتساب المسير فقط.',1;
 SELECT r.PayRunID,r.RunState,r.CalculationVersion,p.PeriodName,p.DateFrom,p.DateTo,s.EmployeeID,e.EmpNum,e.EmpName,r.CurrencyID,c.CurCode,
  s.GrossEntitlement,s.RequestedDeductionTotal,s.CollectedDeductionTotal,s.DeferredDeductionTotal,s.NetBeforeAllocation,s.NetDeficit,s.NetPayable,
  s.MaxDeferredPerEmployee,s.MaxDeferredPerRun,s.ZeroNetApprovalMode,s.DeferralApprovalRequired,s.PolicyApplied
 FROM dbo.Emp_PayRuns r JOIN dbo.Emp_PayPeriods p ON p.CmpID=r.CmpID AND p.PeriodID=r.PeriodID
 JOIN dbo.Emp_PayrollDeficitSnapshots s ON s.CmpID=r.CmpID AND s.PayRunID=r.PayRunID AND s.CalculationVersion=r.CalculationVersion
 JOIN dbo.Emp_Employee e ON e.EmpCompany=s.CmpID AND e.EmpID=s.EmployeeID JOIN dbo.Acc_Currency c ON c.CurCmp=r.CmpID AND c.CurID=r.CurrencyID
 WHERE r.CmpID=@CmpID AND r.PayRunID=@PayRunID AND (@EmployeeID IS NULL OR s.EmployeeID=@EmployeeID)
 ORDER BY s.NetDeficit DESC,e.EmpName,s.EmployeeID;
 SELECT d.EmployeeID,d.PayrollDetailID,d.ComponentID,d.LineKind,d.Description,d.Amount AS RequestedAmount,ISNULL(d.CollectedAmount,d.Amount) AS CollectedAmount,ISNULL(d.DeferredAmount,0) AS DeferredAmount,
  d.SourceType,d.SourceID,a.DeductionPriority,a.IsMandatoryDeduction,a.CanDefer,a.ArrearID,ar.OriginPeriodID,ar.OriginPayRunID,ar.OriginalSourceType,ar.OriginalSourceID,ar.OutstandingAmount
 FROM dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails d
 LEFT JOIN dbo.Emp_PayrollDeductionAllocations a ON a.CmpID=d.CmpID AND a.PayRunID=d.PayRunID AND a.CalculationVersion=(SELECT CalculationVersion FROM dbo.Emp_PayRuns WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND PayRunID=@PayRunID) AND a.PayrollDetailID=d.PayrollDetailID
 LEFT JOIN dbo.Emp_PayrollDeductionArrears ar ON d.SourceType=22 AND ar.CmpID=d.CmpID AND ar.ArrearID=d.SourceID
 WHERE d.CmpID=@CmpID AND d.PayRunID=@PayRunID AND (@EmployeeID IS NULL OR d.EmployeeID=@EmployeeID) AND d.LineKind=2
 ORDER BY d.EmployeeID,a.DeductionPriority,d.PayrollDetailID;
 SELECT ev.ArrearID,a.EmployeeID,ev.PayRunID,ev.PayrollDetailID,ev.EventType,ev.Amount,ev.OutstandingBefore,ev.OutstandingAfter,ev.CreatedAt,ev.CreatedBy
 FROM dbo.Emp_PayrollDeductionArrearEvents ev JOIN dbo.Emp_PayrollDeductionArrears a ON a.CmpID=ev.CmpID AND a.ArrearID=ev.ArrearID
 WHERE ev.CmpID=@CmpID AND ev.PayRunID=@PayRunID AND (@EmployeeID IS NULL OR a.EmployeeID=@EmployeeID)
 ORDER BY ev.ArrearID,ev.EventType;
END;
GO
/* ======================================================================
   HR completion block A (A1-A7): org integrity, shift swaps, grade scales,
   benefits, overtime rules, incidents/complaints, cost allocations.
   Re-runnable: objects are guarded by OBJECT_ID / CREATE OR ALTER.
   ====================================================================== */
USE [MADARERPDataBase]
GO
/* A1: organisation hierarchy integrity (no self parent, same company, no cycles) */
CREATE OR ALTER TRIGGER dbo.TR_Emp_OrganigramStructure_Integrity ON dbo.Emp_OrganigramStructure
AFTER INSERT,UPDATE AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON;
 IF NOT (UPDATE(EmpOrgStrParentID) OR UPDATE(EmpOrgStrCompany)) RETURN;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM inserted WHERE EmpOrgStrParentID=EmpOrgStrID)
  THROW 54900,N'لا يمكن أن تكون الوحدة التنظيمية أباً لنفسها.',1;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM inserted i JOIN dbo.Emp_OrganigramStructure p ON p.EmpOrgStrID=i.EmpOrgStrParentID WHERE p.EmpOrgStrCompany<>i.EmpOrgStrCompany)
  THROW 54901,N'الوحدة الأم تنتمي إلى شركة مختلفة.',1;
 DECLARE @Bad INT=0;
 ;WITH Up AS(
  SELECT i.EmpOrgStrID AS Origin,o.EmpOrgStrParentID AS ParentID,1 AS Lvl
  FROM inserted i JOIN dbo.Emp_OrganigramStructure o ON o.EmpOrgStrID=i.EmpOrgStrID
  WHERE o.EmpOrgStrParentID IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT u.Origin,o.EmpOrgStrParentID,u.Lvl+1
  FROM Up u JOIN dbo.Emp_OrganigramStructure o ON o.EmpOrgStrID=u.ParentID
  WHERE o.EmpOrgStrParentID IS NOT NULL AND u.Lvl<90)
 SELECT @Bad=COUNT(*) FROM Up WHERE ParentID=Origin;
 IF @Bad>0 THROW 54902,N'التسلسل التنظيمي يكوّن دورة غير مسموحة.',1;
END
GO
/* A2: shift assignments (overrides) and swap requests */
IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Emp_ShiftSwapSettings',N'U') IS NULL
CREATE TABLE dbo.Emp_ShiftSwapSettings(
 CmpID INT NOT NULL,
 IsEnabled BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Emp_ShiftSwapSettings_En DEFAULT(1),
 MaxDailyHours DECIMAL(5,2) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Emp_ShiftSwapSettings_Max DEFAULT(12),
 MaxDaysAhead SMALLINT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Emp_ShiftSwapSettings_Ahead DEFAULT(60),
 UpdatedAt DATETIME2(0) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Emp_ShiftSwapSettings_At DEFAULT(SYSDATETIME()),
 UpdatedBy BIGINT NULL,
 CONSTRAINT PK_Emp_ShiftSwapSettings PRIMARY KEY(CmpID),
 CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_ShiftSwapSettings_Cmp FOREIGN KEY(CmpID) REFERENCES dbo.Mng_Company(CmpID),
 CONSTRAINT CK_Emp_ShiftSwapSettings_V CHECK(MaxDailyHours>0 AND MaxDailyHours<=24 AND MaxDaysAhead>=0));
GO
IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Emp_ShiftAssignments',N'U') IS NULL
CREATE TABLE dbo.Emp_ShiftAssignments(
 AssignmentID BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL,
 CmpID INT NOT NULL,
 EmployeeID BIGINT NOT NULL,
 WorkDate DATE NOT NULL,
 SchTypeID BIGINT NOT NULL,
 SourceType TINYINT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Emp_ShiftAssignments_Src DEFAULT(1),
 SourceID BIGINT NULL,
 RecordState TINYINT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Emp_ShiftAssignments_St DEFAULT(0),
 CreatedAt DATETIME2(0) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Emp_ShiftAssignments_At DEFAULT(SYSDATETIME()),
 CreatedBy BIGINT NOT NULL,
 CancelledAt DATETIME2(0) NULL,
 CancelledBy BIGINT NULL,
 CONSTRAINT PK_Emp_ShiftAssignments PRIMARY KEY(AssignmentID),
 CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_ShiftAssignments_Emp FOREIGN KEY(CmpID,EmployeeID) REFERENCES dbo.Emp_Employee(EmpCompany,EmpID),
 CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_ShiftAssignments_Type FOREIGN KEY(CmpID,SchTypeID) REFERENCES dbo.Emp_WorkScheduleTypes(SchTypeCmp,SchTypeID),
 CONSTRAINT CK_Emp_ShiftAssignments_V CHECK(SourceType IN(1,2) AND RecordState IN(0,1)));
GO
IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys.indexes WHERE name=N'UX_Emp_ShiftAssignments_Active' AND object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Emp_ShiftAssignments'))
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX_Emp_ShiftAssignments_Active ON dbo.Emp_ShiftAssignments(CmpID,EmployeeID,WorkDate) WHERE RecordState=0;
GO
IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Emp_ShiftSwapRequests',N'U') IS NULL
CREATE TABLE dbo.Emp_ShiftSwapRequests(
 SwapID BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL,
 CmpID INT NOT NULL,
 RequesterID BIGINT NOT NULL,
 CounterpartID BIGINT NOT NULL,
 SwapDate DATE NOT NULL,
 RequesterSchTypeID BIGINT NOT NULL,
 CounterpartSchTypeID BIGINT NOT NULL,
 Reason NVARCHAR(500) NULL,
 SwapState TINYINT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Emp_ShiftSwapRequests_St DEFAULT(0),
 CreatedAt DATETIME2(0) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Emp_ShiftSwapRequests_At DEFAULT(SYSDATETIME()),
 CreatedBy BIGINT NOT NULL,
 DecidedAt DATETIME2(0) NULL,
 DecidedBy BIGINT NULL,
 DecisionNote NVARCHAR(500) NULL,
 CONSTRAINT PK_Emp_ShiftSwapRequests PRIMARY KEY(SwapID),
 CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_ShiftSwapRequests_A FOREIGN KEY(CmpID,RequesterID) REFERENCES dbo.Emp_Employee(EmpCompany,EmpID),
 CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_ShiftSwapRequests_B FOREIGN KEY(CmpID,CounterpartID) REFERENCES dbo.Emp_Employee(EmpCompany,EmpID),
 CONSTRAINT CK_Emp_ShiftSwapRequests_V CHECK(RequesterID<>CounterpartID AND SwapState IN(0,1,2,3)));
GO
IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys.indexes WHERE name=N'IX_Emp_ShiftSwapRequests_Lookup' AND object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Emp_ShiftSwapRequests'))
CREATE INDEX IX_Emp_ShiftSwapRequests_Lookup ON dbo.Emp_ShiftSwapRequests(CmpID,SwapState,SwapDate) INCLUDE(RequesterID,CounterpartID);
GO
/* Effective shift of an employee on a date: override first, then calendar. */
CREATE OR ALTER FUNCTION dbo.fn_Emp_GetScheduledShift(@CmpID INT,@EmpID BIGINT,@Date DATE)
RETURNS BIGINT AS
BEGIN
 DECLARE @T BIGINT;
 SELECT @T=SchTypeID FROM dbo.Emp_ShiftAssignments WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND EmployeeID=@EmpID AND WorkDate=@Date AND RecordState=0;
 IF @T IS NULL
  SELECT TOP(1) @T=d.WCalDetSchTypeID
  FROM dbo.Emp_EmployeeSchedule s
  JOIN dbo.Emp_WorkCalendar wc ON wc.WCalCmp=s.SchCmp AND wc.WCalID=s.SchWCalID AND wc.WCalState=0
  JOIN dbo.Emp_WorkCalendarDetails d ON d.WCalDetCmp=wc.WCalCmp AND d.WCalDetWCalID=wc.WCalID AND d.WCalDetDate=@Date AND d.WCalDetType=1
  WHERE s.SchCmp=@CmpID AND s.SchEmpID=@EmpID AND s.SchState=0
    AND s.SchStartDate<=@Date AND (s.SchEndDate IS NULL OR s.SchEndDate>=@Date)
  ORDER BY s.SchStartDate DESC;
 RETURN @T;
END
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_SaveShiftSwapSettings
 @CmpID INT,@UserID BIGINT,@IsEnabled BIT=1,@MaxDailyHours DECIMAL(5,2)=12,@MaxDaysAhead SMALLINT=60
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 BEGIN TRY
  IF @MaxDailyHours<=0 OR @MaxDailyHours>24 OR @MaxDaysAhead<0 THROW 54910,N'قيم إعدادات تبديل الورديات غير صحيحة.',1;
  BEGIN TRANSACTION;
  MERGE dbo.Emp_ShiftSwapSettings WITH(HOLDLOCK) AS t USING(SELECT @CmpID AS CmpID) s ON t.CmpID=s.CmpID
  WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET IsEnabled=@IsEnabled,MaxDailyHours=@MaxDailyHours,MaxDaysAhead=@MaxDaysAhead,UpdatedAt=SYSDATETIME(),UpdatedBy=@UserID
  WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT(CmpID,IsEnabled,MaxDailyHours,MaxDaysAhead,UpdatedBy) VALUES(@CmpID,@IsEnabled,@MaxDailyHours,@MaxDaysAhead,@UserID);
  COMMIT;
  SELECT CmpID,IsEnabled,MaxDailyHours,MaxDaysAhead FROM dbo.Emp_ShiftSwapSettings WHERE CmpID=@CmpID;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK; THROW; END CATCH
END
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_SaveShiftSwapRequest
 @CmpID INT,@UserID BIGINT,@RequesterID BIGINT,@CounterpartID BIGINT,@SwapDate DATE,@Reason NVARCHAR(500)=NULL
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 BEGIN TRY
  DECLARE @MaxAhead SMALLINT=60,@Enabled BIT=1,@A BIGINT,@B BIGINT,@Id BIGINT;
  SELECT @Enabled=IsEnabled,@MaxAhead=MaxDaysAhead FROM dbo.Emp_ShiftSwapSettings WHERE CmpID=@CmpID;
  IF @Enabled=0 THROW 54911,N'تبديل الورديات غير مفعّل لهذه الشركة.',1;
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_ApprovalRouteSteps WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND ProcessType=13 AND RecordState=0) THROW 54918,N'لا يُقبل طلب تبديل وردية قبل تهيئة مسار الموافقة (نوع العملية 13) للشركة.',1;
  IF @RequesterID=@CounterpartID THROW 54912,N'لا يمكن تبديل الوردية مع نفس الموظف.',1;
  IF @SwapDate<CAST(SYSDATETIME() AS DATE) OR @SwapDate>DATEADD(DAY,@MaxAhead,CAST(SYSDATETIME() AS DATE))
   THROW 54913,N'تاريخ التبديل خارج الحدود المسموحة.',1;
  IF (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.Emp_Employee WHERE EmpCompany=@CmpID AND EmpID IN(@RequesterID,@CounterpartID) AND EmpState=0)<>2
   THROW 54914,N'أحد الموظفين غير موجود أو غير نشط ضمن الشركة.',1;
  SET @A=dbo.fn_Emp_GetScheduledShift(@CmpID,@RequesterID,@SwapDate);
  SET @B=dbo.fn_Emp_GetScheduledShift(@CmpID,@CounterpartID,@SwapDate);
  IF @A IS NULL OR @B IS NULL THROW 54915,N'لا توجد وردية مجدولة لأحد الموظفين في التاريخ.',1;
  IF @A=@B THROW 54916,N'الورديتان متطابقتان ولا حاجة للتبديل.',1;
  BEGIN TRANSACTION;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_ShiftSwapRequests WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND SwapDate=@SwapDate AND SwapState=0
            AND (RequesterID IN(@RequesterID,@CounterpartID) OR CounterpartID IN(@RequesterID,@CounterpartID)))
   THROW 54917,N'يوجد طلب تبديل معلّق لأحد الموظفين في نفس التاريخ.',1;
  INSERT dbo.Emp_ShiftSwapRequests(CmpID,RequesterID,CounterpartID,SwapDate,RequesterSchTypeID,CounterpartSchTypeID,Reason,CreatedBy)
  VALUES(@CmpID,@RequesterID,@CounterpartID,@SwapDate,@A,@B,@Reason,@UserID);
  SET @Id=SCOPE_IDENTITY();
  EXEC dbo.Emp_StartApproval @CmpID,13,@Id,@UserID,1;
  COMMIT;
  SELECT SwapID,SwapState FROM dbo.Emp_ShiftSwapRequests WHERE SwapID=@Id;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK; THROW; END CATCH
END
GO
/* Applies (or rejects) a swap. With an approval route, call only after the route reaches a final state. */
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_DecideShiftSwapRequest
 @CmpID INT,@UserID BIGINT,@SwapID BIGINT,@Approve BIT,@Note NVARCHAR(500)=NULL
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 BEGIN TRY
  DECLARE @R BIGINT,@C BIGINT,@D DATE,@SA BIGINT,@SB BIGINT,@St TINYINT,@Creator BIGINT,@Max DECIMAL(5,2)=12;
  BEGIN TRANSACTION;
  SELECT @R=RequesterID,@C=CounterpartID,@D=SwapDate,@SA=RequesterSchTypeID,@SB=CounterpartSchTypeID,@St=SwapState,@Creator=CreatedBy
  FROM dbo.Emp_ShiftSwapRequests WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE SwapID=@SwapID AND CmpID=@CmpID;
  IF @R IS NULL THROW 54920,N'طلب التبديل غير موجود.',1;
  IF @St<>0 THROW 54921,N'الطلب ليس معلّقاً ولا يمكن البت فيه مرة أخرى.',1;
  IF @Creator=@UserID THROW 54922,N'لا يجوز لمنشئ الطلب اعتماده.',1;
  DECLARE @AprSt TINYINT;
  SELECT @AprSt=ApprovalState FROM dbo.Emp_ApprovalRequests WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND ProcessType=13 AND EntityID=@SwapID;
  IF @AprSt IS NULL THROW 54919,N'لا يوجد مسار موافقة لهذا الطلب؛ لا يُبَتّ فيه خارج المسار المعتمد.',1;
  IF @AprSt=0 THROW 54923,N'مسار الموافقة لم يكتمل بعد.',1;
  SET @Approve=CASE WHEN @AprSt=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END; /* outcome follows the approval route, not the caller */
  IF @Approve=1
  BEGIN
   SELECT @Max=MaxDailyHours FROM dbo.Emp_ShiftSwapSettings WHERE CmpID=@CmpID;
   IF dbo.fn_Emp_GetScheduledShift(@CmpID,@R,@D)<>@SA OR dbo.fn_Emp_GetScheduledShift(@CmpID,@C,@D)<>@SB
    THROW 54924,N'تغيّر جدول أحد الموظفين بعد تقديم الطلب.',1;
   IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_LeaveRequests WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND EmployeeID IN(@R,@C) AND RequestState=2 AND StartAt<DATEADD(DAY,1,CAST(@D AS DATETIME2(0))) AND EndAt>CAST(@D AS DATETIME2(0)))
    THROW 54925,N'يوجد تعارض مع إجازة معتمدة.',1;
   IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_WorkScheduleTypes WHERE SchTypeCmp=@CmpID AND SchTypeID IN(@SA,@SB) AND SchWorkingHours>@Max)
    THROW 54926,N'ساعات الوردية تتجاوز الحد المسموح في إعدادات الشركة.',1;
   UPDATE dbo.Emp_ShiftAssignments SET RecordState=1,CancelledAt=SYSDATETIME(),CancelledBy=@UserID
   WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND EmployeeID IN(@R,@C) AND WorkDate=@D AND RecordState=0;
   INSERT dbo.Emp_ShiftAssignments(CmpID,EmployeeID,WorkDate,SchTypeID,SourceType,SourceID,CreatedBy)
   VALUES(@CmpID,@R,@D,@SB,2,@SwapID,@UserID),(@CmpID,@C,@D,@SA,2,@SwapID,@UserID);
  END
  UPDATE dbo.Emp_ShiftSwapRequests SET SwapState=CASE WHEN @Approve=1 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,DecidedAt=SYSDATETIME(),DecidedBy=@UserID,DecisionNote=@Note WHERE SwapID=@SwapID;
  COMMIT;
  SELECT SwapID,SwapState FROM dbo.Emp_ShiftSwapRequests WHERE SwapID=@SwapID;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK; THROW; END CATCH
END
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_CancelShiftSwapRequest
 @CmpID INT,@UserID BIGINT,@SwapID BIGINT,@Reason NVARCHAR(500)
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 BEGIN TRY
  IF NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@Reason)),N'') IS NULL THROW 54930,N'سبب الإلغاء مطلوب.',1;
  DECLARE @St TINYINT,@D DATE;
  BEGIN TRANSACTION;
  SELECT @St=SwapState,@D=SwapDate FROM dbo.Emp_ShiftSwapRequests WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE SwapID=@SwapID AND CmpID=@CmpID;
  IF @St IS NULL THROW 54931,N'طلب التبديل غير موجود.',1;
  IF @St=3 THROW 54932,N'الطلب ملغى مسبقاً.',1;
  IF @St=2 THROW 54933,N'لا يمكن إلغاء طلب مرفوض.',1;
  IF @St=1
  BEGIN
   IF @D<=CAST(SYSDATETIME() AS DATE) THROW 54934,N'لا يمكن إلغاء تبديل معتمد بدأ سريانه.',1;
   UPDATE dbo.Emp_ShiftAssignments SET RecordState=1,CancelledAt=SYSDATETIME(),CancelledBy=@UserID WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND SourceType=2 AND SourceID=@SwapID AND RecordState=0;
  END
  UPDATE dbo.Emp_ShiftSwapRequests SET SwapState=3,DecidedAt=SYSDATETIME(),DecidedBy=@UserID,DecisionNote=@Reason WHERE SwapID=@SwapID;
  COMMIT;
  SELECT SwapID,SwapState FROM dbo.Emp_ShiftSwapRequests WHERE SwapID=@SwapID;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK; THROW; END CATCH
END
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_SelectShiftSwapRequests
 @CmpID INT,@UserID BIGINT,@FromDate DATE=NULL,@ToDate DATE=NULL,@SwapState TINYINT=NULL
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 SELECT SwapID,RequesterID,CounterpartID,SwapDate,RequesterSchTypeID,CounterpartSchTypeID,Reason,SwapState,CreatedAt,CreatedBy,DecidedAt,DecidedBy,DecisionNote
 FROM dbo.Emp_ShiftSwapRequests
 WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND (@FromDate IS NULL OR SwapDate>=@FromDate) AND (@ToDate IS NULL OR SwapDate<=@ToDate) AND (@SwapState IS NULL OR SwapState=@SwapState)
 ORDER BY SwapDate DESC,SwapID DESC;
END
GO
/* A3: job grades, effective-dated grade steps, position-grade link, transition rules */
IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Emp_JobGrades',N'U') IS NULL
CREATE TABLE dbo.Emp_JobGrades(
 GradeID BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL,
 CmpID INT NOT NULL,
 GradeCode NVARCHAR(30) NOT NULL,
 GradeName NVARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
 GradeLevel SMALLINT NOT NULL,
 JobCategory NVARCHAR(100) NULL,
 RecordState TINYINT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Emp_JobGrades_St DEFAULT(0),
 CreatedAt DATETIME2(0) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Emp_JobGrades_At DEFAULT(SYSDATETIME()),
 CreatedBy BIGINT NOT NULL,
 CONSTRAINT PK_Emp_JobGrades PRIMARY KEY(GradeID),
 CONSTRAINT UQ_Emp_JobGrades_Cmp_ID UNIQUE(CmpID,GradeID),
 CONSTRAINT UQ_Emp_JobGrades_Code UNIQUE(CmpID,GradeCode),
 CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_JobGrades_Cmp FOREIGN KEY(CmpID) REFERENCES dbo.Mng_Company(CmpID),
 CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_JobGrades_User FOREIGN KEY(CreatedBy) REFERENCES dbo.Mng_User(UsrID),
 CONSTRAINT CK_Emp_JobGrades_V CHECK(GradeLevel>0 AND RecordState IN(0,1)));
GO
IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Emp_GradeSteps',N'U') IS NULL
CREATE TABLE dbo.Emp_GradeSteps(
 GradeStepID BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL,
 CmpID INT NOT NULL,
 GradeID BIGINT NOT NULL,
 StepNo SMALLINT NOT NULL,
 CurrencyID BIGINT NOT NULL,
 BaseSalary DECIMAL(19,3) NOT NULL,
 PeriodicIncrement DECIMAL(19,3) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Emp_GradeSteps_PI DEFAULT(0),
 PromotionIncrement DECIMAL(19,3) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Emp_GradeSteps_PR DEFAULT(0),
 EffectiveFrom DATE NOT NULL,
 EffectiveTo DATE NULL,
 Reason NVARCHAR(300) NULL,
 RecordState TINYINT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Emp_GradeSteps_St DEFAULT(0),
 CreatedAt DATETIME2(0) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Emp_GradeSteps_At DEFAULT(SYSDATETIME()),
 CreatedBy BIGINT NOT NULL,
 CONSTRAINT PK_Emp_GradeSteps PRIMARY KEY(GradeStepID),
 CONSTRAINT UQ_Emp_GradeSteps_Version UNIQUE(CmpID,GradeID,StepNo,EffectiveFrom),
 CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_GradeSteps_Grade FOREIGN KEY(CmpID,GradeID) REFERENCES dbo.Emp_JobGrades(CmpID,GradeID),
 CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_GradeSteps_Cur FOREIGN KEY(CurrencyID) REFERENCES dbo.Acc_Currency(CurID),
 CONSTRAINT CK_Emp_GradeSteps_V CHECK(StepNo>=0 AND BaseSalary>=0 AND PeriodicIncrement>=0 AND PromotionIncrement>=0 AND (EffectiveTo IS NULL OR EffectiveTo>=EffectiveFrom) AND RecordState IN(0,1)));
GO
IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Emp_PositionGrades',N'U') IS NULL
CREATE TABLE dbo.Emp_PositionGrades(
 PositionGradeID BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL,
 CmpID INT NOT NULL,
 PosID BIGINT NOT NULL,
 GradeID BIGINT NOT NULL,
 EffectiveFrom DATE NOT NULL,
 EffectiveTo DATE NULL,
 CreatedAt DATETIME2(0) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Emp_PositionGrades_At DEFAULT(SYSDATETIME()),
 CreatedBy BIGINT NOT NULL,
 CONSTRAINT PK_Emp_PositionGrades PRIMARY KEY(PositionGradeID),
 CONSTRAINT UQ_Emp_PositionGrades_Version UNIQUE(CmpID,PosID,EffectiveFrom),
 CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_PositionGrades_Pos FOREIGN KEY(CmpID,PosID) REFERENCES dbo.Emp_Position(PosCmp,PosID),
 CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_PositionGrades_Grade FOREIGN KEY(CmpID,GradeID) REFERENCES dbo.Emp_JobGrades(CmpID,GradeID),
 CONSTRAINT CK_Emp_PositionGrades_V CHECK(EffectiveTo IS NULL OR EffectiveTo>=EffectiveFrom));
GO
IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Emp_GradeTransitionRules',N'U') IS NULL
CREATE TABLE dbo.Emp_GradeTransitionRules(
 RuleID BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL,
 CmpID INT NOT NULL,
 FromGradeID BIGINT NOT NULL,
 ToGradeID BIGINT NOT NULL,
 MinServiceMonths SMALLINT NOT NULL,
 RecordState TINYINT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Emp_GradeTransitionRules_St DEFAULT(0),
 CreatedAt DATETIME2(0) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Emp_GradeTransitionRules_At DEFAULT(SYSDATETIME()),
 CreatedBy BIGINT NOT NULL,
 CONSTRAINT PK_Emp_GradeTransitionRules PRIMARY KEY(RuleID),
 CONSTRAINT UQ_Emp_GradeTransitionRules_Pair UNIQUE(CmpID,FromGradeID,ToGradeID),
 CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_GradeTransitionRules_From FOREIGN KEY(CmpID,FromGradeID) REFERENCES dbo.Emp_JobGrades(CmpID,GradeID),
 CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_GradeTransitionRules_To FOREIGN KEY(CmpID,ToGradeID) REFERENCES dbo.Emp_JobGrades(CmpID,GradeID),
 CONSTRAINT CK_Emp_GradeTransitionRules_V CHECK(FromGradeID<>ToGradeID AND MinServiceMonths>=0 AND RecordState IN(0,1)));
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_SaveJobGrade
 @CmpID INT,@UserID BIGINT,@GradeID BIGINT=NULL,@GradeCode NVARCHAR(30),@GradeName NVARCHAR(150),@GradeLevel SMALLINT,@JobCategory NVARCHAR(100)=NULL,@RecordState TINYINT=0
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 BEGIN TRY
  SET @GradeCode=LTRIM(RTRIM(@GradeCode)); SET @GradeName=LTRIM(RTRIM(@GradeName));
  IF NULLIF(@GradeCode,N'') IS NULL OR NULLIF(@GradeName,N'') IS NULL OR @GradeLevel<=0 OR @RecordState NOT IN(0,1)
   THROW 54940,N'بيانات الدرجة الوظيفية غير صحيحة.',1;
  BEGIN TRANSACTION;
  IF @GradeID IS NULL
  BEGIN
   IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_JobGrades WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND GradeCode=@GradeCode) THROW 54941,N'رمز الدرجة مكرر.',1;
   INSERT dbo.Emp_JobGrades(CmpID,GradeCode,GradeName,GradeLevel,JobCategory,RecordState,CreatedBy) VALUES(@CmpID,@GradeCode,@GradeName,@GradeLevel,@JobCategory,@RecordState,@UserID);
   SET @GradeID=SCOPE_IDENTITY();
  END
  ELSE
  BEGIN
   IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_JobGrades WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND GradeID=@GradeID) THROW 54942,N'الدرجة غير موجودة.',1;
   IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_JobGrades WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND GradeCode=@GradeCode AND GradeID<>@GradeID) THROW 54941,N'رمز الدرجة مكرر.',1;
   IF @RecordState=1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_PositionGrades WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND GradeID=@GradeID AND EffectiveTo IS NULL)
    THROW 54943,N'لا يمكن إيقاف درجة مرتبطة بوظائف سارية.',1;
   UPDATE dbo.Emp_JobGrades SET GradeCode=@GradeCode,GradeName=@GradeName,GradeLevel=@GradeLevel,JobCategory=@JobCategory,RecordState=@RecordState WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND GradeID=@GradeID;
  END
  COMMIT;
  SELECT GradeID,GradeCode,GradeName,GradeLevel,JobCategory,RecordState FROM dbo.Emp_JobGrades WHERE GradeID=@GradeID;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK; THROW; END CATCH
END
GO
/* New version closes the previous open version the day before; history is never overwritten. */
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_SaveGradeStep
 @CmpID INT,@UserID BIGINT,@GradeID BIGINT,@StepNo SMALLINT,@CurrencyID BIGINT,@BaseSalary DECIMAL(19,3),
 @PeriodicIncrement DECIMAL(19,3)=0,@PromotionIncrement DECIMAL(19,3)=0,@EffectiveFrom DATE,@Reason NVARCHAR(300)=NULL
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 BEGIN TRY
  IF @StepNo<0 OR @BaseSalary<0 OR @PeriodicIncrement<0 OR @PromotionIncrement<0 OR @EffectiveFrom IS NULL THROW 54945,N'بيانات درجة الراتب غير صحيحة.',1;
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_JobGrades WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND GradeID=@GradeID AND RecordState=0) THROW 54946,N'الدرجة غير موجودة أو غير نشطة.',1;
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Acc_Currency WHERE CurID=@CurrencyID AND CurCmp=@CmpID AND CurState=0) THROW 54947,N'العملة غير صحيحة.',1;
  DECLARE @Id BIGINT;
  BEGIN TRANSACTION;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_GradeSteps WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND GradeID=@GradeID AND StepNo=@StepNo AND EffectiveFrom>=@EffectiveFrom)
   THROW 54948,N'يوجد إصدار بنفس التاريخ أو لاحق له؛ لا يجوز تعديل التاريخ الماضي مباشرة.',1;
  UPDATE dbo.Emp_GradeSteps SET EffectiveTo=DATEADD(DAY,-1,@EffectiveFrom)
  WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND GradeID=@GradeID AND StepNo=@StepNo AND EffectiveTo IS NULL AND RecordState=0;
  INSERT dbo.Emp_GradeSteps(CmpID,GradeID,StepNo,CurrencyID,BaseSalary,PeriodicIncrement,PromotionIncrement,EffectiveFrom,Reason,CreatedBy)
  VALUES(@CmpID,@GradeID,@StepNo,@CurrencyID,@BaseSalary,@PeriodicIncrement,@PromotionIncrement,@EffectiveFrom,@Reason,@UserID);
  SET @Id=SCOPE_IDENTITY();
  COMMIT;
  SELECT * FROM dbo.Emp_GradeSteps WHERE GradeStepID=@Id;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK; THROW; END CATCH
END
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_AssignPositionGrade
 @CmpID INT,@UserID BIGINT,@PosID BIGINT,@GradeID BIGINT,@EffectiveFrom DATE
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 BEGIN TRY
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_Position WHERE PosCmp=@CmpID AND PosID=@PosID) THROW 54950,N'الوظيفة غير موجودة.',1;
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_JobGrades WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND GradeID=@GradeID AND RecordState=0) THROW 54951,N'الدرجة غير موجودة أو غير نشطة.',1;
  BEGIN TRANSACTION;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_PositionGrades WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND PosID=@PosID AND EffectiveFrom>=@EffectiveFrom)
   THROW 54952,N'يوجد ربط بنفس التاريخ أو لاحق له.',1;
  UPDATE dbo.Emp_PositionGrades SET EffectiveTo=DATEADD(DAY,-1,@EffectiveFrom) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND PosID=@PosID AND EffectiveTo IS NULL;
  INSERT dbo.Emp_PositionGrades(CmpID,PosID,GradeID,EffectiveFrom,CreatedBy) VALUES(@CmpID,@PosID,@GradeID,@EffectiveFrom,@UserID);
  COMMIT;
  SELECT PositionGradeID,PosID,GradeID,EffectiveFrom,EffectiveTo FROM dbo.Emp_PositionGrades WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND PosID=@PosID ORDER BY EffectiveFrom DESC;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK; THROW; END CATCH
END
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_SaveGradeTransitionRule
 @CmpID INT,@UserID BIGINT,@FromGradeID BIGINT,@ToGradeID BIGINT,@MinServiceMonths SMALLINT,@RecordState TINYINT=0
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 BEGIN TRY
  IF @FromGradeID=@ToGradeID OR @MinServiceMonths<0 OR @RecordState NOT IN(0,1) THROW 54955,N'قاعدة الانتقال غير صحيحة.',1;
  IF (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.Emp_JobGrades WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND GradeID IN(@FromGradeID,@ToGradeID))<>2 THROW 54956,N'الدرجة غير موجودة ضمن الشركة.',1;
  BEGIN TRANSACTION;
  MERGE dbo.Emp_GradeTransitionRules WITH(HOLDLOCK) AS t USING(SELECT @CmpID c,@FromGradeID f,@ToGradeID o) s ON t.CmpID=s.c AND t.FromGradeID=s.f AND t.ToGradeID=s.o
  WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET MinServiceMonths=@MinServiceMonths,RecordState=@RecordState
  WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT(CmpID,FromGradeID,ToGradeID,MinServiceMonths,RecordState,CreatedBy) VALUES(@CmpID,@FromGradeID,@ToGradeID,@MinServiceMonths,@RecordState,@UserID);
  COMMIT;
  SELECT * FROM dbo.Emp_GradeTransitionRules WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND FromGradeID=@FromGradeID AND ToGradeID=@ToGradeID;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK; THROW; END CATCH
END
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_SelectGradeScale
 @CmpID INT,@UserID BIGINT,@AsOfDate DATE=NULL,@GradeID BIGINT=NULL
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 SET @AsOfDate=ISNULL(@AsOfDate,CAST(SYSDATETIME() AS DATE));
 SELECT g.GradeID,g.GradeCode,g.GradeName,g.GradeLevel,g.JobCategory,s.StepNo,s.CurrencyID,s.BaseSalary,s.PeriodicIncrement,s.PromotionIncrement,s.EffectiveFrom,s.EffectiveTo
 FROM dbo.Emp_JobGrades g
 LEFT JOIN dbo.Emp_GradeSteps s ON s.CmpID=g.CmpID AND s.GradeID=g.GradeID AND s.RecordState=0 AND s.EffectiveFrom<=@AsOfDate AND (s.EffectiveTo IS NULL OR s.EffectiveTo>=@AsOfDate)
 WHERE g.CmpID=@CmpID AND (@GradeID IS NULL OR g.GradeID=@GradeID)
 ORDER BY g.GradeLevel,s.StepNo;
END
GO

CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_SaveBenefitPlan
 @CmpID INT,@UserID BIGINT,@PlanID BIGINT=NULL,@PlanCode NVARCHAR(30),@PlanName NVARCHAR(150),@BenefitKind TINYINT,@ProviderName NVARCHAR(200)=NULL,
 @CoversDependents BIT=0,@CompanyContribution DECIMAL(19,3)=0,@EmployeeContribution DECIMAL(19,3)=0,@CurrencyID BIGINT=NULL,@EffectiveFrom DATE,@EffectiveTo DATE=NULL,@RecordState TINYINT=0
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 BEGIN TRY
  SET @PlanCode=LTRIM(RTRIM(@PlanCode));
  IF NULLIF(@PlanCode,N'') IS NULL OR NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@PlanName)),N'') IS NULL OR @BenefitKind NOT IN(1,2,3,4) OR @CompanyContribution<0 OR @EmployeeContribution<0
     OR (@EffectiveTo IS NOT NULL AND @EffectiveTo<@EffectiveFrom) OR @RecordState NOT IN(0,1) THROW 54960,N'بيانات خطة المزايا غير صحيحة.',1;
  IF (@CompanyContribution>0 OR @EmployeeContribution>0) AND @CurrencyID IS NULL THROW 54961,N'العملة مطلوبة عند وجود مساهمة مالية.',1;
  IF @CurrencyID IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Acc_Currency WHERE CurID=@CurrencyID AND CurCmp=@CmpID AND CurState=0) THROW 54962,N'العملة غير صحيحة.',1;
  BEGIN TRANSACTION;
  IF @PlanID IS NULL
  BEGIN
   IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_BenefitPlans WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND PlanCode=@PlanCode) THROW 54963,N'رمز الخطة مكرر.',1;
   INSERT dbo.Emp_BenefitPlans(CmpID,PlanCode,PlanName,BenefitKind,ProviderName,CoversDependents,CompanyContribution,EmployeeContribution,CurrencyID,EffectiveFrom,EffectiveTo,RecordState,CreatedBy)
   VALUES(@CmpID,@PlanCode,LTRIM(RTRIM(@PlanName)),@BenefitKind,@ProviderName,@CoversDependents,@CompanyContribution,@EmployeeContribution,@CurrencyID,@EffectiveFrom,@EffectiveTo,@RecordState,@UserID);
   SET @PlanID=SCOPE_IDENTITY();
  END
  ELSE
  BEGIN
   IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_BenefitPlans WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND PlanID=@PlanID) THROW 54964,N'الخطة غير موجودة.',1;
   IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_BenefitPlans WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND PlanCode=@PlanCode AND PlanID<>@PlanID) THROW 54963,N'رمز الخطة مكرر.',1;
   IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_EmployeeBenefits WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND PlanID=@PlanID AND CoverageState=0)
      AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_BenefitPlans WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND PlanID=@PlanID AND (BenefitKind<>@BenefitKind OR CoversDependents<>@CoversDependents OR CompanyContribution<>@CompanyContribution OR EmployeeContribution<>@EmployeeContribution))
    THROW 54965,N'لا تُعدَّل شروط خطة عليها اشتراكات سارية؛ أنشئ خطة جديدة بتاريخ سريان.',1;
   UPDATE dbo.Emp_BenefitPlans SET PlanCode=@PlanCode,PlanName=LTRIM(RTRIM(@PlanName)),BenefitKind=@BenefitKind,ProviderName=@ProviderName,CoversDependents=@CoversDependents,
    CompanyContribution=@CompanyContribution,EmployeeContribution=@EmployeeContribution,CurrencyID=@CurrencyID,EffectiveFrom=@EffectiveFrom,EffectiveTo=@EffectiveTo,RecordState=@RecordState
   WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND PlanID=@PlanID;
  END
  COMMIT;
  SELECT * FROM dbo.Emp_BenefitPlans WHERE PlanID=@PlanID;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK; THROW; END CATCH
END
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_EnrollEmployeeBenefit
 @CmpID INT,@UserID BIGINT,@PlanID BIGINT,@EmployeeID BIGINT,@DependentID BIGINT=NULL,@StartDate DATE,@EndDate DATE=NULL,@Notes NVARCHAR(500)=NULL
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 BEGIN TRY
  DECLARE @Cov BIT,@PF DATE,@PT DATE,@Id BIGINT;
  IF @EndDate IS NOT NULL AND @EndDate<@StartDate THROW 54970,N'تاريخ النهاية قبل البداية.',1;
  SELECT @Cov=CoversDependents,@PF=EffectiveFrom,@PT=EffectiveTo FROM dbo.Emp_BenefitPlans WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND PlanID=@PlanID AND RecordState=0;
  IF @Cov IS NULL THROW 54971,N'خطة المزايا غير موجودة أو غير نشطة.',1;
  IF @StartDate<@PF OR (@PT IS NOT NULL AND (@StartDate>@PT OR ISNULL(@EndDate,@PT)>@PT)) THROW 54972,N'فترة الاستفادة خارج سريان الخطة.',1;
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_Employee WHERE EmpCompany=@CmpID AND EmpID=@EmployeeID AND EmpState=0) THROW 54973,N'الموظف غير موجود أو غير نشط.',1;
  IF @DependentID IS NOT NULL
  BEGIN
   IF @Cov=0 THROW 54974,N'الخطة لا تشمل أفراد الأسرة.',1;
   IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_EmployeeDependents WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND DependentID=@DependentID AND EmployeeID=@EmployeeID AND RecordState=0) THROW 54975,N'الفرد غير تابع للموظف أو غير نشط.',1;
  END
  BEGIN TRANSACTION;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_EmployeeBenefits WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND PlanID=@PlanID AND EmployeeID=@EmployeeID AND ISNULL(DependentID,0)=ISNULL(@DependentID,0)
            AND CoverageState IN(0,1) AND StartDate<=ISNULL(@EndDate,'9999-12-31') AND ISNULL(EndDate,'9999-12-31')>=@StartDate)
   THROW 54976,N'يوجد اشتراك متداخل لنفس المستفيد في نفس الخطة.',1;
  INSERT dbo.Emp_EmployeeBenefits(CmpID,PlanID,EmployeeID,DependentID,StartDate,EndDate,Notes,CreatedBy) VALUES(@CmpID,@PlanID,@EmployeeID,@DependentID,@StartDate,@EndDate,@Notes,@UserID);
  SET @Id=SCOPE_IDENTITY();
  INSERT dbo.Emp_EmployeeBenefitEvents(CmpID,EnrollmentID,OldState,NewState,Reason,EventBy) VALUES(@CmpID,@Id,NULL,0,N'تسجيل اشتراك',@UserID);
  COMMIT;
  SELECT * FROM dbo.Emp_EmployeeBenefits WHERE EnrollmentID=@Id;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK; THROW; END CATCH
END
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_ChangeBenefitCoverageState
 @CmpID INT,@UserID BIGINT,@EnrollmentID BIGINT,@NewState TINYINT,@EndDate DATE=NULL,@Reason NVARCHAR(300)
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 BEGIN TRY
  DECLARE @Old TINYINT,@Start DATE;
  IF @NewState NOT IN(1,2) OR NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@Reason)),N'') IS NULL THROW 54980,N'الحالة أو السبب غير صحيح.',1;
  BEGIN TRANSACTION;
  SELECT @Old=CoverageState,@Start=StartDate FROM dbo.Emp_EmployeeBenefits WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND EnrollmentID=@EnrollmentID;
  IF @Old IS NULL THROW 54981,N'الاشتراك غير موجود.',1;
  IF @Old=2 THROW 54982,N'الاشتراك منتهٍ ولا يمكن تغييره.',1;
  IF @Old=@NewState THROW 54983,N'الاشتراك في هذه الحالة مسبقاً.',1;
  IF @NewState=2 AND (@EndDate IS NULL OR @EndDate<@Start) THROW 54984,N'تاريخ الانتهاء مطلوب وصحيح.',1;
  UPDATE dbo.Emp_EmployeeBenefits SET CoverageState=@NewState,EndDate=CASE WHEN @NewState=2 THEN @EndDate ELSE EndDate END WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND EnrollmentID=@EnrollmentID;
  INSERT dbo.Emp_EmployeeBenefitEvents(CmpID,EnrollmentID,OldState,NewState,Reason,EventBy) VALUES(@CmpID,@EnrollmentID,@Old,@NewState,@Reason,@UserID);
  COMMIT;
  SELECT * FROM dbo.Emp_EmployeeBenefits WHERE EnrollmentID=@EnrollmentID;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK; THROW; END CATCH
END
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_SelectEmployeeBenefits
 @CmpID INT,@UserID BIGINT,@EmployeeID BIGINT=NULL,@AsOfDate DATE=NULL
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 SELECT b.EnrollmentID,b.EmployeeID,b.DependentID,p.PlanCode,p.PlanName,p.BenefitKind,p.ProviderName,p.CompanyContribution,p.EmployeeContribution,p.CurrencyID,b.StartDate,b.EndDate,b.CoverageState
 FROM dbo.Emp_EmployeeBenefits b JOIN dbo.Emp_BenefitPlans p ON p.CmpID=b.CmpID AND p.PlanID=b.PlanID
 WHERE b.CmpID=@CmpID AND (@EmployeeID IS NULL OR b.EmployeeID=@EmployeeID)
   AND (@AsOfDate IS NULL OR (b.StartDate<=@AsOfDate AND (b.EndDate IS NULL OR b.EndDate>=@AsOfDate)))
 ORDER BY b.EmployeeID,b.StartDate DESC;
END
GO
/* A5: configurable overtime multipliers and limits */
IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Emp_OvertimeRules',N'U') IS NULL
CREATE TABLE dbo.Emp_OvertimeRules(
 RuleID BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL,
 CmpID INT NOT NULL,
 DayKind TINYINT NOT NULL,
 IsNight BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Emp_OvertimeRules_Night DEFAULT(0),
 Multiplier DECIMAL(8,4) NOT NULL,
 MaxHoursPerDay DECIMAL(5,2) NULL,
 MaxHoursPerMonth DECIMAL(6,2) NULL,
 EffectiveFrom DATE NOT NULL,
 EffectiveTo DATE NULL,
 RecordState TINYINT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Emp_OvertimeRules_St DEFAULT(0),
 CreatedAt DATETIME2(0) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Emp_OvertimeRules_At DEFAULT(SYSDATETIME()),
 CreatedBy BIGINT NOT NULL,
 CONSTRAINT PK_Emp_OvertimeRules PRIMARY KEY(RuleID),
 CONSTRAINT UQ_Emp_OvertimeRules_Version UNIQUE(CmpID,DayKind,IsNight,EffectiveFrom),
 CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_OvertimeRules_Cmp FOREIGN KEY(CmpID) REFERENCES dbo.Mng_Company(CmpID),
 CONSTRAINT CK_Emp_OvertimeRules_V CHECK(DayKind IN(1,2,3) AND Multiplier>0 AND (MaxHoursPerDay IS NULL OR (MaxHoursPerDay>0 AND MaxHoursPerDay<=24)) AND (MaxHoursPerMonth IS NULL OR MaxHoursPerMonth>0) AND (EffectiveTo IS NULL OR EffectiveTo>=EffectiveFrom) AND RecordState IN(0,1)));
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_SaveOvertimeRule
 @CmpID INT,@UserID BIGINT,@DayKind TINYINT,@IsNight BIT,@Multiplier DECIMAL(8,4),@MaxHoursPerDay DECIMAL(5,2)=NULL,@MaxHoursPerMonth DECIMAL(6,2)=NULL,@EffectiveFrom DATE
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 BEGIN TRY
  IF @DayKind NOT IN(1,2,3) OR @Multiplier<=0 OR @EffectiveFrom IS NULL OR @MaxHoursPerDay<=0 OR @MaxHoursPerDay>24 OR @MaxHoursPerMonth<=0 THROW 54990,N'قاعدة العمل الإضافي غير صحيحة.',1;
  BEGIN TRANSACTION;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_OvertimeRules WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND DayKind=@DayKind AND IsNight=@IsNight AND EffectiveFrom>=@EffectiveFrom)
   THROW 54991,N'يوجد إصدار بنفس التاريخ أو لاحق له.',1;
  UPDATE dbo.Emp_OvertimeRules SET EffectiveTo=DATEADD(DAY,-1,@EffectiveFrom) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND DayKind=@DayKind AND IsNight=@IsNight AND EffectiveTo IS NULL AND RecordState=0;
  INSERT dbo.Emp_OvertimeRules(CmpID,DayKind,IsNight,Multiplier,MaxHoursPerDay,MaxHoursPerMonth,EffectiveFrom,CreatedBy) VALUES(@CmpID,@DayKind,@IsNight,@Multiplier,@MaxHoursPerDay,@MaxHoursPerMonth,@EffectiveFrom,@UserID);
  COMMIT;
  SELECT TOP(1) * FROM dbo.Emp_OvertimeRules WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND DayKind=@DayKind AND IsNight=@IsNight ORDER BY EffectiveFrom DESC;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK; THROW; END CATCH
END
GO
/* Stamps the configured multiplier on a pending request after checking daily/monthly limits (no hard-coded rate). */
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_ApplyOvertimeRule
 @CmpID INT,@UserID BIGINT,@OvertimeID BIGINT,@DayKind TINYINT,@IsNight BIT
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 BEGIN TRY
  DECLARE @Emp BIGINT,@D DATE,@H DECIMAL(9,2),@St TINYINT,@Mult DECIMAL(8,4),@MaxD DECIMAL(5,2),@MaxM DECIMAL(6,2),@Month DECIMAL(9,2);
  BEGIN TRANSACTION;
  SELECT @Emp=EmployeeID,@D=WorkDate,@H=Hours,@St=RequestState FROM dbo.Emp_OvertimeRequests WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND OvertimeID=@OvertimeID;
  IF @Emp IS NULL THROW 54995,N'طلب العمل الإضافي غير موجود.',1;
  IF @St<>0 THROW 54996,N'لا يُطبَّق المعامل إلا على طلب معلّق.',1;
  SELECT @Mult=Multiplier,@MaxD=MaxHoursPerDay,@MaxM=MaxHoursPerMonth FROM dbo.Emp_OvertimeRules
  WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND DayKind=@DayKind AND IsNight=@IsNight AND RecordState=0 AND EffectiveFrom<=@D AND (EffectiveTo IS NULL OR EffectiveTo>=@D);
  IF @Mult IS NULL THROW 54997,N'لا توجد قاعدة عمل إضافي سارية لهذا النوع والتاريخ.',1;
  IF @MaxD IS NOT NULL AND (@H+ISNULL((SELECT SUM(Hours) FROM dbo.Emp_OvertimeRequests WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND EmployeeID=@Emp AND WorkDate=@D AND RequestState IN(0,1) AND OvertimeID<>@OvertimeID),0))>@MaxD
   THROW 54998,N'تجاوز الحد اليومي للعمل الإضافي.',1;
  SELECT @Month=ISNULL(SUM(Hours),0) FROM dbo.Emp_OvertimeRequests WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND EmployeeID=@Emp AND RequestState IN(0,1) AND OvertimeID<>@OvertimeID
   AND WorkDate>=DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@D),MONTH(@D),1) AND WorkDate<DATEADD(MONTH,1,DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@D),MONTH(@D),1));
  IF @MaxM IS NOT NULL AND @Month+@H>@MaxM THROW 54999,N'تجاوز الحد الشهري للعمل الإضافي.',1;
  UPDATE dbo.Emp_OvertimeRequests SET Multiplier=@Mult WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND OvertimeID=@OvertimeID;
  COMMIT;
  SELECT OvertimeID,Multiplier FROM dbo.Emp_OvertimeRequests WHERE OvertimeID=@OvertimeID;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK; THROW; END CATCH
END
GO
