CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_SaveEmployeeIncident
 @CmpID INT,@UserID BIGINT,@EmployeeID BIGINT,@IncidentKind TINYINT,@Severity TINYINT,@OccurredAt DATETIME2(0),@LocationText NVARCHAR(200)=NULL,@Description NVARCHAR(2000)
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 BEGIN TRY
  IF @IncidentKind NOT IN(1,2,3) OR @Severity NOT IN(1,2,3,4) OR NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@Description)),N'') IS NULL OR @OccurredAt>SYSDATETIME() THROW 54800,N'بيانات الحادثة غير صحيحة.',1;
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_Employee WHERE EmpCompany=@CmpID AND EmpID=@EmployeeID) THROW 54801,N'الموظف غير موجود ضمن الشركة.',1;
  INSERT dbo.Emp_EmployeeIncidents(CmpID,EmployeeID,IncidentKind,Severity,OccurredAt,LocationText,Description,CreatedBy) VALUES(@CmpID,@EmployeeID,@IncidentKind,@Severity,@OccurredAt,@LocationText,@Description,@UserID);
  SELECT SCOPE_IDENTITY() AS IncidentID;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK; THROW; END CATCH
END
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_UpdateEmployeeIncident
 @CmpID INT,@UserID BIGINT,@IncidentID BIGINT,@NewState TINYINT,@FollowUpNote NVARCHAR(1000)=NULL
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 BEGIN TRY
  DECLARE @Old TINYINT;
  IF @NewState NOT IN(1,2) THROW 54802,N'الحالة غير صحيحة.',1;
  BEGIN TRANSACTION;
  SELECT @Old=IncidentState FROM dbo.Emp_EmployeeIncidents WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND IncidentID=@IncidentID;
  IF @Old IS NULL THROW 54803,N'الحادثة غير موجودة.',1;
  IF @Old=2 THROW 54804,N'الحادثة مغلقة ولا يمكن تعديلها.',1;
  IF @NewState=2 AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@FollowUpNote)),N'') IS NULL THROW 54805,N'ملاحظة المتابعة مطلوبة عند الإغلاق.',1;
  UPDATE dbo.Emp_EmployeeIncidents SET IncidentState=@NewState,FollowUpNote=ISNULL(@FollowUpNote,FollowUpNote),
   ClosedAt=CASE WHEN @NewState=2 THEN SYSDATETIME() END,ClosedBy=CASE WHEN @NewState=2 THEN @UserID END WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND IncidentID=@IncidentID;
  COMMIT;
  SELECT IncidentID,IncidentState FROM dbo.Emp_EmployeeIncidents WHERE IncidentID=@IncidentID;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK; THROW; END CATCH
END
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_SaveEmployeeComplaint
 @CmpID INT,@UserID BIGINT,@EmployeeID BIGINT,@ComplaintKind TINYINT,@Subject NVARCHAR(200),@Details NVARCHAR(2000)
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 BEGIN TRY
  IF @ComplaintKind NOT IN(1,2,3) OR NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@Subject)),N'') IS NULL OR NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@Details)),N'') IS NULL THROW 54810,N'بيانات الشكوى غير صحيحة.',1;
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_Employee WHERE EmpCompany=@CmpID AND EmpID=@EmployeeID) THROW 54811,N'الموظف غير موجود ضمن الشركة.',1;
  INSERT dbo.Emp_EmployeeComplaints(CmpID,EmployeeID,ComplaintKind,Subject,Details,CreatedBy) VALUES(@CmpID,@EmployeeID,@ComplaintKind,LTRIM(RTRIM(@Subject)),@Details,@UserID);
  SELECT SCOPE_IDENTITY() AS ComplaintID;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK; THROW; END CATCH
END
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_ResolveEmployeeComplaint
 @CmpID INT,@UserID BIGINT,@ComplaintID BIGINT,@NewState TINYINT,@Resolution NVARCHAR(1000)
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 BEGIN TRY
  DECLARE @Old TINYINT,@Creator BIGINT;
  IF @NewState NOT IN(1,2) OR NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@Resolution)),N'') IS NULL THROW 54812,N'الحالة أو القرار غير صحيح.',1;
  BEGIN TRANSACTION;
  SELECT @Old=ComplaintState,@Creator=CreatedBy FROM dbo.Emp_EmployeeComplaints WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND ComplaintID=@ComplaintID;
  IF @Old IS NULL THROW 54813,N'الشكوى غير موجودة.',1;
  IF @Old<>0 THROW 54814,N'الشكوى حُسمت مسبقاً.',1;
  IF @Creator=@UserID THROW 54815,N'لا يجوز لمسجّل الشكوى حسمها.',1;
  UPDATE dbo.Emp_EmployeeComplaints SET ComplaintState=@NewState,Resolution=@Resolution,ResolvedAt=SYSDATETIME(),ResolvedBy=@UserID WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND ComplaintID=@ComplaintID;
  COMMIT;
  SELECT ComplaintID,ComplaintState FROM dbo.Emp_EmployeeComplaints WHERE ComplaintID=@ComplaintID;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK; THROW; END CATCH
END
GO
/* A7: cost allocation of employee cost to existing cost centres / org units (no parallel cost-centre or project tables) */
IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Emp_CostAllocations',N'U') IS NULL
CREATE TABLE dbo.Emp_CostAllocations(
 AllocationID BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL,
 CmpID INT NOT NULL,
 EmployeeID BIGINT NOT NULL,
 CostCenterID BIGINT NULL,
 OrgUnitID BIGINT NULL,
 ProjectRefID BIGINT NULL,
 Percentage DECIMAL(7,4) NOT NULL,
 EffectiveFrom DATE NOT NULL,
 EffectiveTo DATE NULL,
 SourceReference NVARCHAR(200) NULL,
 RecordState TINYINT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Emp_CostAllocations_St DEFAULT(0),
 CreatedAt DATETIME2(0) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Emp_CostAllocations_At DEFAULT(SYSDATETIME()),
 CreatedBy BIGINT NOT NULL,
 CONSTRAINT PK_Emp_CostAllocations PRIMARY KEY(AllocationID),
 CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_CostAllocations_Emp FOREIGN KEY(CmpID,EmployeeID) REFERENCES dbo.Emp_Employee(EmpCompany,EmpID),
 CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_CostAllocations_CC FOREIGN KEY(CostCenterID) REFERENCES dbo.Acc_CostCenter(CsCID),
 CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_CostAllocations_Org FOREIGN KEY(CmpID,OrgUnitID) REFERENCES dbo.Emp_OrganigramStructure(EmpOrgStrCompany,EmpOrgStrID),
 CONSTRAINT CK_Emp_CostAllocations_V CHECK(Percentage>0 AND Percentage<=100 AND (CostCenterID IS NOT NULL OR OrgUnitID IS NOT NULL OR ProjectRefID IS NOT NULL) AND (EffectiveTo IS NULL OR EffectiveTo>=EffectiveFrom) AND RecordState IN(0,1)));
GO
IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys.indexes WHERE name=N'IX_Emp_CostAllocations_Emp' AND object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Emp_CostAllocations'))
CREATE INDEX IX_Emp_CostAllocations_Emp ON dbo.Emp_CostAllocations(CmpID,EmployeeID,EffectiveFrom) INCLUDE(Percentage,EffectiveTo,RecordState);
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_SaveCostAllocation
 @CmpID INT,@UserID BIGINT,@EmployeeID BIGINT,@CostCenterID BIGINT=NULL,@OrgUnitID BIGINT=NULL,@ProjectRefID BIGINT=NULL,@Percentage DECIMAL(7,4),@EffectiveFrom DATE,@EffectiveTo DATE=NULL,@SourceReference NVARCHAR(200)=NULL
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 BEGIN TRY
  IF @Percentage<=0 OR @Percentage>100 OR @EffectiveFrom IS NULL OR (@EffectiveTo IS NOT NULL AND @EffectiveTo<@EffectiveFrom)
     OR (@CostCenterID IS NULL AND @OrgUnitID IS NULL AND @ProjectRefID IS NULL) THROW 54850,N'بيانات التوزيع غير صحيحة.',1;
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_Employee WHERE EmpCompany=@CmpID AND EmpID=@EmployeeID) THROW 54851,N'الموظف غير موجود ضمن الشركة.',1;
  IF @CostCenterID IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Acc_CostCenter WHERE CsCID=@CostCenterID AND CsCCompany=@CmpID AND CsCState=0) THROW 54852,N'مركز التكلفة غير صحيح أو غير نشط.',1;
  DECLARE @Total DECIMAL(9,4),@Id BIGINT;
  BEGIN TRANSACTION;
  SELECT @Total=ISNULL(SUM(Percentage),0) FROM dbo.Emp_CostAllocations WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK)
  WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND EmployeeID=@EmployeeID AND RecordState=0 AND EffectiveFrom<=ISNULL(@EffectiveTo,'9999-12-31') AND ISNULL(EffectiveTo,'9999-12-31')>=@EffectiveFrom;
  IF @Total+@Percentage>100 THROW 54853,N'مجموع نسب التوزيع يتجاوز 100% في الفترة.',1;
  INSERT dbo.Emp_CostAllocations(CmpID,EmployeeID,CostCenterID,OrgUnitID,ProjectRefID,Percentage,EffectiveFrom,EffectiveTo,SourceReference,CreatedBy)
  VALUES(@CmpID,@EmployeeID,@CostCenterID,@OrgUnitID,@ProjectRefID,@Percentage,@EffectiveFrom,@EffectiveTo,@SourceReference,@UserID);
  SET @Id=SCOPE_IDENTITY();
  COMMIT;
  SELECT * FROM dbo.Emp_CostAllocations WHERE AllocationID=@Id;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK; THROW; END CATCH
END
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_EndCostAllocation
 @CmpID INT,@UserID BIGINT,@AllocationID BIGINT,@EndDate DATE
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 BEGIN TRY
  DECLARE @From DATE,@To DATE;
  BEGIN TRANSACTION;
  SELECT @From=EffectiveFrom,@To=EffectiveTo FROM dbo.Emp_CostAllocations WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND AllocationID=@AllocationID AND RecordState=0;
  IF @From IS NULL THROW 54855,N'التوزيع غير موجود أو ملغى.',1;
  IF @EndDate<@From OR (@To IS NOT NULL AND @EndDate>=@To) THROW 54856,N'تاريخ الإنهاء غير صحيح.',1;
  UPDATE dbo.Emp_CostAllocations SET EffectiveTo=@EndDate WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND AllocationID=@AllocationID;
  COMMIT;
  SELECT * FROM dbo.Emp_CostAllocations WHERE AllocationID=@AllocationID;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK; THROW; END CATCH
END
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_SelectCostAllocations
 @CmpID INT,@UserID BIGINT,@EmployeeID BIGINT=NULL,@AsOfDate DATE=NULL
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 SELECT AllocationID,EmployeeID,CostCenterID,OrgUnitID,ProjectRefID,Percentage,EffectiveFrom,EffectiveTo,SourceReference
 FROM dbo.Emp_CostAllocations
 WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND RecordState=0 AND (@EmployeeID IS NULL OR EmployeeID=@EmployeeID)
   AND (@AsOfDate IS NULL OR (EffectiveFrom<=@AsOfDate AND (EffectiveTo IS NULL OR EffectiveTo>=@AsOfDate)))
 ORDER BY EmployeeID,EffectiveFrom DESC;
END
GO
/* C1: employee movements with effective date (future-dated moves never alter current data before their date) */
IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Emp_EmployeeMovements',N'U') IS NULL
CREATE TABLE dbo.Emp_EmployeeMovements(
 MovementID BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL,
 CmpID INT NOT NULL,
 EmployeeID BIGINT NOT NULL,
 MovementType TINYINT NOT NULL,
 FromPosID BIGINT NULL,
 ToPosID BIGINT NULL,
 EffectiveDate DATE NOT NULL,
 Reason NVARCHAR(500) NOT NULL,
 MovementState TINYINT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Emp_EmployeeMovements_St DEFAULT(0),
 RegisteredAt DATETIME2(0) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Emp_EmployeeMovements_At DEFAULT(SYSDATETIME()),
 CreatedBy BIGINT NOT NULL,
 DecidedAt DATETIME2(0) NULL,
 DecidedBy BIGINT NULL,
 AppliedAt DATETIME2(0) NULL,
 CancelledAt DATETIME2(0) NULL,
 CancelledBy BIGINT NULL,
 CancelReason NVARCHAR(500) NULL,
 CONSTRAINT PK_Emp_EmployeeMovements PRIMARY KEY(MovementID),
 CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_EmployeeMovements_Emp FOREIGN KEY(CmpID,EmployeeID) REFERENCES dbo.Emp_Employee(EmpCompany,EmpID),
 CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_EmployeeMovements_From FOREIGN KEY(CmpID,FromPosID) REFERENCES dbo.Emp_Position(PosCmp,PosID),
 CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_EmployeeMovements_To FOREIGN KEY(CmpID,ToPosID) REFERENCES dbo.Emp_Position(PosCmp,PosID),
 /* MovementType: 1 hire,2 confirmation,3 promotion,4 transfer,5 position change,6 grade change,7 schedule change,8 work-site change,9 secondment,10 assignment,11 suspension,12 return,13 pay change,14 termination.
    MovementState: 0 registered,1 approved,2 applied,3 rejected,4 cancelled. */
 CONSTRAINT CK_Emp_EmployeeMovements_V CHECK(MovementType BETWEEN 1 AND 14 AND MovementState BETWEEN 0 AND 4 AND (MovementType NOT IN(3,4,5) OR ToPosID IS NOT NULL)));
GO
IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys.indexes WHERE name=N'IX_Emp_EmployeeMovements_Due' AND object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Emp_EmployeeMovements'))
CREATE INDEX IX_Emp_EmployeeMovements_Due ON dbo.Emp_EmployeeMovements(CmpID,MovementState,EffectiveDate) INCLUDE(EmployeeID,MovementType,ToPosID);
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_SaveEmployeeMovement
 @CmpID INT,@UserID BIGINT,@EmployeeID BIGINT,@MovementType TINYINT,@ToPosID BIGINT=NULL,@EffectiveDate DATE,@Reason NVARCHAR(500)
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 BEGIN TRY
  DECLARE @From BIGINT,@Id BIGINT;
  IF @MovementType NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 14 OR @EffectiveDate IS NULL OR NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@Reason)),N'') IS NULL THROW 54700,N'بيانات الحركة الوظيفية غير صحيحة.',1;
  IF @MovementType IN(3,4,5) AND @ToPosID IS NULL THROW 54701,N'الوظيفة الجديدة مطلوبة لهذا النوع من الحركات.',1;
  IF @ToPosID IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_Position WHERE PosCmp=@CmpID AND PosID=@ToPosID AND PosState=0) THROW 54702,N'الوظيفة الجديدة غير موجودة أو غير نشطة.',1;
  BEGIN TRANSACTION;
  SELECT @From=PosID FROM dbo.Emp_Employee WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE EmpCompany=@CmpID AND EmpID=@EmployeeID;
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_Employee WHERE EmpCompany=@CmpID AND EmpID=@EmployeeID) THROW 54703,N'الموظف غير موجود ضمن الشركة.',1;
  IF @MovementType IN(3,4,5) AND @From=@ToPosID THROW 54704,N'الوظيفة الجديدة مطابقة للحالية.',1;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_EmployeeMovements WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND EmployeeID=@EmployeeID AND MovementType=@MovementType AND EffectiveDate=@EffectiveDate AND MovementState IN(0,1,2))
   THROW 54705,N'توجد حركة من نفس النوع بنفس تاريخ السريان.',1;
  INSERT dbo.Emp_EmployeeMovements(CmpID,EmployeeID,MovementType,FromPosID,ToPosID,EffectiveDate,Reason,CreatedBy) VALUES(@CmpID,@EmployeeID,@MovementType,@From,@ToPosID,@EffectiveDate,@Reason,@UserID);
  SET @Id=SCOPE_IDENTITY();
  COMMIT;
  SELECT MovementID,MovementState,EffectiveDate FROM dbo.Emp_EmployeeMovements WHERE MovementID=@Id;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK; THROW; END CATCH
END
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_DecideEmployeeMovement
 @CmpID INT,@UserID BIGINT,@MovementID BIGINT,@Approve BIT
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 BEGIN TRY
  DECLARE @St TINYINT,@Creator BIGINT;
  BEGIN TRANSACTION;
  SELECT @St=MovementState,@Creator=CreatedBy FROM dbo.Emp_EmployeeMovements WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND MovementID=@MovementID;
  IF @St IS NULL THROW 54710,N'الحركة غير موجودة.',1;
  IF @St<>0 THROW 54711,N'الحركة ليست في حالة مسجّلة.',1;
  IF @Creator=@UserID THROW 54712,N'لا يجوز لمسجّل الحركة اعتمادها.',1;
  UPDATE dbo.Emp_EmployeeMovements SET MovementState=CASE WHEN @Approve=1 THEN 1 ELSE 3 END,DecidedAt=SYSDATETIME(),DecidedBy=@UserID WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND MovementID=@MovementID;
  COMMIT;
  SELECT MovementID,MovementState FROM dbo.Emp_EmployeeMovements WHERE MovementID=@MovementID;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK; THROW; END CATCH
END
GO
/* Applies approved movements whose effective date has arrived. Only position-changing types (3,4,5) change Emp_Employee here;
   other types are history records consumed by their owning functions. Idempotent: applied rows are skipped. */
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_ApplyDueEmployeeMovements
 @CmpID INT,@UserID BIGINT,@AsOfDate DATE=NULL
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 IF @AsOfDate IS NULL OR @AsOfDate>CONVERT(date,SYSDATETIME()) SET @AsOfDate=CONVERT(date,SYSDATETIME());
 DECLARE @Failed TABLE(MovementID BIGINT NOT NULL,ErrorNumber INT NOT NULL,ErrorMessage NVARCHAR(2048) NOT NULL);
 DECLARE @Ignore TABLE(ServiceID BIGINT,EmployeeID BIGINT,EffectiveDate DATE,EventType TINYINT);
 DECLARE @Applied INT=0,@M BIGINT,@E BIGINT,@Type TINYINT,@To BIGINT,@Eff DATE,@Reason NVARCHAR(500),@Ref NVARCHAR(100);
 DECLARE c CURSOR LOCAL FAST_FORWARD FOR
  SELECT MovementID,EmployeeID,MovementType,ToPosID,EffectiveDate,Reason FROM dbo.Emp_EmployeeMovements
  WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND MovementState=1 AND EffectiveDate<=@AsOfDate AND MovementType IN(3,4,5) ORDER BY EffectiveDate,MovementID;
 OPEN c; FETCH NEXT FROM c INTO @M,@E,@Type,@To,@Eff,@Reason;
 WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS=0
 BEGIN
  SET @Ref=CONCAT(N'MOV-',@M);
  BEGIN TRY
   /* Idempotent: if the history row for this movement already exists (earlier run stopped before the state update), only the state is completed. */
   IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_ServiceHistory WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND EmployeeID=@E AND ReferenceNo=@Ref AND RecordState=0)
    INSERT @Ignore EXEC dbo.Emp_ApplyServiceChange @CmpID,@E,@Eff,@Type,@To,NULL,NULL,@Ref,@Reason,@UserID;
   UPDATE dbo.Emp_EmployeeMovements SET MovementState=2,AppliedAt=SYSDATETIME() WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND MovementID=@M AND MovementState=1;
   SET @Applied+=@@ROWCOUNT;
  END TRY
  BEGIN CATCH
   IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK;
   INSERT @Failed(MovementID,ErrorNumber,ErrorMessage) VALUES(@M,ERROR_NUMBER(),ERROR_MESSAGE());
  END CATCH
  FETCH NEXT FROM c INTO @M,@E,@Type,@To,@Eff,@Reason;
 END
 CLOSE c; DEALLOCATE c;
 SELECT @Applied AS AppliedCount,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM @Failed) AS FailedCount;
 SELECT MovementID,ErrorNumber,ErrorMessage FROM @Failed ORDER BY MovementID;
END
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_CancelEmployeeMovement
 @CmpID INT,@UserID BIGINT,@MovementID BIGINT,@Reason NVARCHAR(500)
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 BEGIN TRY
  DECLARE @St TINYINT;
  IF NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@Reason)),N'') IS NULL THROW 54715,N'سبب الإلغاء مطلوب.',1;
  BEGIN TRANSACTION;
  SELECT @St=MovementState FROM dbo.Emp_EmployeeMovements WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND MovementID=@MovementID;
  IF @St IS NULL THROW 54716,N'الحركة غير موجودة.',1;
  IF @St=2 THROW 54717,N'الحركة مطبقة؛ تُصحَّح بحركة جديدة وليس بالإلغاء.',1;
  IF @St IN(3,4) THROW 54718,N'الحركة مرفوضة أو ملغاة مسبقاً.',1;
  UPDATE dbo.Emp_EmployeeMovements SET MovementState=4,CancelledAt=SYSDATETIME(),CancelledBy=@UserID,CancelReason=@Reason WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND MovementID=@MovementID;
  COMMIT;
  SELECT MovementID,MovementState FROM dbo.Emp_EmployeeMovements WHERE MovementID=@MovementID;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK; THROW; END CATCH
END
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_SelectEmployeeMovements
 @CmpID INT,@UserID BIGINT,@EmployeeID BIGINT=NULL,@MovementState TINYINT=NULL
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 SELECT MovementID,EmployeeID,MovementType,FromPosID,ToPosID,EffectiveDate,Reason,MovementState,RegisteredAt,CreatedBy,DecidedAt,DecidedBy,AppliedAt,CancelledAt,CancelReason
 FROM dbo.Emp_EmployeeMovements WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND (@EmployeeID IS NULL OR EmployeeID=@EmployeeID) AND (@MovementState IS NULL OR MovementState=@MovementState)
 ORDER BY EffectiveDate DESC,MovementID DESC;
END
GO
/* C2: statutory deductions (tax / social security / solidarity). Rates are data with a mandatory legal reference; nothing is hard-coded. */
IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Emp_StatutoryRules',N'U') IS NULL
CREATE TABLE dbo.Emp_StatutoryRules(
 RuleID BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL,
 CmpID INT NOT NULL,
 RuleKind TINYINT NOT NULL,
 RuleName NVARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
 BeneficiaryName NVARCHAR(200) NULL,
 EmployeeRate DECIMAL(9,6) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Emp_StatutoryRules_ER DEFAULT(0),
 EmployerRate DECIMAL(9,6) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Emp_StatutoryRules_CR DEFAULT(0),
 ExemptionAmount DECIMAL(19,3) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Emp_StatutoryRules_EX DEFAULT(0),
 CeilingAmount DECIMAL(19,3) NULL,
 LegalReference NVARCHAR(300) NOT NULL,
 EffectiveFrom DATE NOT NULL,
 EffectiveTo DATE NULL,
 RecordState TINYINT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Emp_StatutoryRules_St DEFAULT(0),
 CreatedAt DATETIME2(0) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Emp_StatutoryRules_At DEFAULT(SYSDATETIME()),
 CreatedBy BIGINT NOT NULL,
 CONSTRAINT PK_Emp_StatutoryRules PRIMARY KEY(RuleID),
 CONSTRAINT UQ_Emp_StatutoryRules_Cmp_ID UNIQUE(CmpID,RuleID),
 CONSTRAINT UQ_Emp_StatutoryRules_Version UNIQUE(CmpID,RuleName,EffectiveFrom),
 CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_StatutoryRules_Cmp FOREIGN KEY(CmpID) REFERENCES dbo.Mng_Company(CmpID),
 CONSTRAINT CK_Emp_StatutoryRules_V CHECK(RuleKind IN(1,2,3,4) AND EmployeeRate BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND EmployerRate BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND ExemptionAmount>=0 AND (CeilingAmount IS NULL OR CeilingAmount>0)
   AND LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(LegalReference)))>0 AND (EffectiveTo IS NULL OR EffectiveTo>=EffectiveFrom) AND RecordState IN(0,1)));
GO
IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Emp_EmployeeStatutoryEnrollments',N'U') IS NULL
CREATE TABLE dbo.Emp_EmployeeStatutoryEnrollments(
 EnrollmentID BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL,
 CmpID INT NOT NULL,
 EmployeeID BIGINT NOT NULL,
 RuleName NVARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
 MembershipNo NVARCHAR(60) NULL,
 StartDate DATE NOT NULL,
 EndDate DATE NULL,
 CreatedAt DATETIME2(0) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Emp_EmployeeStatutoryEnrollments_At DEFAULT(SYSDATETIME()),
 CreatedBy BIGINT NOT NULL,
 CONSTRAINT PK_Emp_EmployeeStatutoryEnrollments PRIMARY KEY(EnrollmentID),
 CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_EmployeeStatutoryEnrollments_Emp FOREIGN KEY(CmpID,EmployeeID) REFERENCES dbo.Emp_Employee(EmpCompany,EmpID),
 CONSTRAINT CK_Emp_EmployeeStatutoryEnrollments_V CHECK(EndDate IS NULL OR EndDate>=StartDate));
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_SaveStatutoryRule
 @CmpID INT,@UserID BIGINT,@RuleKind TINYINT,@RuleName NVARCHAR(150),@BeneficiaryName NVARCHAR(200)=NULL,@EmployeeRate DECIMAL(9,6),@EmployerRate DECIMAL(9,6),
 @ExemptionAmount DECIMAL(19,3)=0,@CeilingAmount DECIMAL(19,3)=NULL,@LegalReference NVARCHAR(300),@EffectiveFrom DATE
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 BEGIN TRY
  SET @RuleName=LTRIM(RTRIM(@RuleName));
  IF @RuleKind NOT IN(1,2,3,4) OR NULLIF(@RuleName,N'') IS NULL OR @EmployeeRate NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 100 OR @EmployerRate NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 100 OR @ExemptionAmount<0
     OR @CeilingAmount<=0 OR @EffectiveFrom IS NULL THROW 54720,N'بيانات القاعدة النظامية غير صحيحة.',1;
  IF NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@LegalReference)),N'') IS NULL THROW 54721,N'المرجع القانوني مطلوب؛ لا تُسجَّل نسبة بدون مرجع معتمد.',1;
  BEGIN TRANSACTION;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_StatutoryRules WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND RuleName=@RuleName AND EffectiveFrom>=@EffectiveFrom)
   THROW 54722,N'يوجد إصدار بنفس التاريخ أو لاحق له.',1;
  UPDATE dbo.Emp_StatutoryRules SET EffectiveTo=DATEADD(DAY,-1,@EffectiveFrom) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND RuleName=@RuleName AND EffectiveTo IS NULL AND RecordState=0;
  INSERT dbo.Emp_StatutoryRules(CmpID,RuleKind,RuleName,BeneficiaryName,EmployeeRate,EmployerRate,ExemptionAmount,CeilingAmount,LegalReference,EffectiveFrom,CreatedBy)
  VALUES(@CmpID,@RuleKind,@RuleName,@BeneficiaryName,@EmployeeRate,@EmployerRate,@ExemptionAmount,@CeilingAmount,LTRIM(RTRIM(@LegalReference)),@EffectiveFrom,@UserID);
  COMMIT;
  SELECT TOP(1) * FROM dbo.Emp_StatutoryRules WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND RuleName=@RuleName ORDER BY EffectiveFrom DESC;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK; THROW; END CATCH
END
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_EnrollEmployeeStatutory
 @CmpID INT,@UserID BIGINT,@EmployeeID BIGINT,@RuleName NVARCHAR(150),@MembershipNo NVARCHAR(60)=NULL,@StartDate DATE,@EndDate DATE=NULL
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 BEGIN TRY
  IF @EndDate IS NOT NULL AND @EndDate<@StartDate THROW 54725,N'تاريخ النهاية قبل البداية.',1;
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_StatutoryRules WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND RuleName=@RuleName AND RecordState=0) THROW 54726,N'القاعدة النظامية غير موجودة.',1;
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_Employee WHERE EmpCompany=@CmpID AND EmpID=@EmployeeID) THROW 54727,N'الموظف غير موجود ضمن الشركة.',1;
  BEGIN TRANSACTION;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_EmployeeStatutoryEnrollments WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND EmployeeID=@EmployeeID AND RuleName=@RuleName
            AND StartDate<=ISNULL(@EndDate,'9999-12-31') AND ISNULL(EndDate,'9999-12-31')>=@StartDate) THROW 54728,N'يوجد اشتراك متداخل في نفس القاعدة.',1;
  INSERT dbo.Emp_EmployeeStatutoryEnrollments(CmpID,EmployeeID,RuleName,MembershipNo,StartDate,EndDate,CreatedBy) VALUES(@CmpID,@EmployeeID,@RuleName,@MembershipNo,@StartDate,@EndDate,@UserID);
  COMMIT;
  SELECT SCOPE_IDENTITY() AS EnrollmentID;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK; THROW; END CATCH
END
GO
/* Read-only calculation: applies only rules the employee is enrolled in and that are effective on @AsOfDate. Rounds to 3 decimals. */
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_CalculateStatutoryContributions
 @CmpID INT,@UserID BIGINT,@EmployeeID BIGINT,@GrossAmount DECIMAL(19,3),@AsOfDate DATE
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 IF @GrossAmount<0 THROW 54730,N'المبلغ الخاضع غير صحيح.',1;
 SELECT r.RuleID,r.RuleKind,r.RuleName,r.BeneficiaryName,r.LegalReference,b.Base AS TaxableBase,
        CAST(ROUND(b.Base*r.EmployeeRate/100.0,3) AS DECIMAL(19,3)) AS EmployeeShare,
        CAST(ROUND(b.Base*r.EmployerRate/100.0,3) AS DECIMAL(19,3)) AS EmployerShare
 FROM dbo.Emp_StatutoryRules r
 JOIN dbo.Emp_EmployeeStatutoryEnrollments e ON e.CmpID=r.CmpID AND e.RuleName=r.RuleName AND e.EmployeeID=@EmployeeID AND e.StartDate<=@AsOfDate AND (e.EndDate IS NULL OR e.EndDate>=@AsOfDate)
 CROSS APPLY(SELECT CASE WHEN @GrossAmount-r.ExemptionAmount<0 THEN CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(19,3))
                         WHEN r.CeilingAmount IS NOT NULL AND @GrossAmount-r.ExemptionAmount>r.CeilingAmount THEN r.CeilingAmount
                         ELSE @GrossAmount-r.ExemptionAmount END AS Base) b
 WHERE r.CmpID=@CmpID AND r.RecordState=0 AND r.EffectiveFrom<=@AsOfDate AND (r.EffectiveTo IS NULL OR r.EffectiveTo>=@AsOfDate)
 ORDER BY r.RuleKind,r.RuleName;
END
GO
/* ======================================================================
   PayrollManagement (prefix Pay_): payroll sheet approval + partial/multiple disbursement.
   Consumes HR calculation results (Emp_PayRuns / Emp_PayrollDetails) read-only; no HR object is altered.
   Treasury executes actual payment; General Accounting posting is intentionally NOT done here (link mechanism pending).
   ====================================================================== */
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Pay_ValidateActor @CmpID INT,@UserID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON;
 IF ISNULL(@CmpID,0)<=0 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_Company WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND CmpState=0) THROW 55000,N'الشركة غير صحيحة أو غير نشطة.',1;
 IF ISNULL(@UserID,0)<=0 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Mng_User WHERE UsrID=@UserID AND UsrState=0 AND UsrCompany=@CmpID) THROW 55001,N'المستخدم غير نشط أو غير مرتبط بالشركة.',1;
END
GO

/* ---- integrity triggers ---- */
CREATE OR ALTER TRIGGER dbo.TR_Pay_PayrollSheets_StateFlow ON dbo.Pay_PayrollSheets AFTER UPDATE AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON;
 IF UPDATE(CmpID) OR UPDATE(PayRunID) OR UPDATE(CurrencyID) THROW 55010,N'لا يجوز تعديل مرجع المسير أو عملته.',1;
 IF UPDATE(SheetState) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM inserted i JOIN deleted d ON d.SheetID=i.SheetID WHERE i.SheetState<>d.SheetState
    AND NOT ((d.SheetState=0 AND i.SheetState=1) OR (d.SheetState=1 AND i.SheetState IN(2,3)) OR (d.SheetState=3 AND i.SheetState=0) OR (d.SheetState=2 AND i.SheetState IN(0,4))))
  THROW 55011,N'انتقال حالة المسير غير مسموح.',1;
END
GO
CREATE OR ALTER TRIGGER dbo.TR_Pay_SheetLines_Frozen ON dbo.Pay_SheetLines AFTER INSERT,UPDATE,DELETE AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT CmpID,SheetID FROM inserted UNION SELECT CmpID,SheetID FROM deleted) x JOIN dbo.Pay_PayrollSheets s ON s.CmpID=x.CmpID AND s.SheetID=x.SheetID WHERE s.SheetState<>0)
  THROW 55012,N'لا يجوز تعديل بنود مسير غير مسودة؛ استخدم إجراء التصحيح الموثق.',1;
END
GO
CREATE OR ALTER TRIGGER dbo.TR_Pay_DisbursementLines_Cap ON dbo.Pay_DisbursementLines AFTER INSERT,UPDATE AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON;
 IF EXISTS(
  SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CmpID,SheetID,EmployeeID FROM inserted) x
  JOIN dbo.Pay_SheetLines sl ON sl.CmpID=x.CmpID AND sl.SheetID=x.SheetID AND sl.EmployeeID=x.EmployeeID
  CROSS APPLY(SELECT ISNULL(SUM(l.Amount),0) AS Used FROM dbo.Pay_DisbursementLines l JOIN dbo.Pay_Disbursements d ON d.CmpID=l.CmpID AND d.DisbursementID=l.DisbursementID
              WHERE l.CmpID=x.CmpID AND l.SheetID=x.SheetID AND l.EmployeeID=x.EmployeeID AND d.DisbursementState IN(0,1)) u
  WHERE u.Used>sl.NetAmount)
  THROW 55013,N'مجموع الدفعات يتجاوز صافي المستحق المعتمد.',1;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM inserted i JOIN dbo.Pay_PayrollSheets s ON s.CmpID=i.CmpID AND s.SheetID=i.SheetID WHERE s.SheetState<>2)
  THROW 55014,N'لا يُصرف إلا من مسير معتمد.',1;
END
GO
CREATE OR ALTER TRIGGER dbo.TR_Pay_Disbursements_Guard ON dbo.Pay_Disbursements AFTER UPDATE AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON;
 IF UPDATE(SheetID) OR UPDATE(CmpID) OR UPDATE(BatchNo) OR UPDATE(IdempotencyKey) OR UPDATE(PaymentMethod) OR UPDATE(DisbursementDate)
  THROW 55015,N'لا يجوز تعديل بيانات دفعة مسجّلة.',1;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM inserted i JOIN deleted d ON d.DisbursementID=i.DisbursementID WHERE i.DisbursementState<>d.DisbursementState AND NOT(d.DisbursementState=0 AND i.DisbursementState IN(1,2)))
  THROW 55016,N'انتقال حالة الدفعة غير مسموح.',1;
END
GO
CREATE OR ALTER TRIGGER dbo.TR_Pay_NoDelete_Disbursements ON dbo.Pay_Disbursements INSTEAD OF DELETE AS BEGIN THROW 55017,N'لا يُحذف سجل صرف؛ يُلغى بسبب موثق.',1; END
GO
CREATE OR ALTER TRIGGER dbo.TR_Pay_NoChange_DisbursementLines ON dbo.Pay_DisbursementLines INSTEAD OF DELETE AS BEGIN THROW 55018,N'لا تُحذف بنود الدفعات.',1; END
GO
CREATE OR ALTER TRIGGER dbo.TR_Pay_NoChange_DisbursementAudit ON dbo.Pay_DisbursementAudit INSTEAD OF UPDATE,DELETE AS BEGIN THROW 55019,N'سجل التدقيق غير قابل للتعديل أو الحذف.',1; END
GO
CREATE OR ALTER TRIGGER dbo.TR_Pay_NoChange_SheetApprovalLog ON dbo.Pay_SheetApprovalLog INSTEAD OF UPDATE,DELETE AS BEGIN THROW 55020,N'سجل الاعتماد غير قابل للتعديل أو الحذف.',1; END
GO
/* ---- derived balances (not stored) ---- */
CREATE OR ALTER VIEW dbo.Pay_vw_SheetLineBalances AS
SELECT sl.CmpID,sl.SheetID,sl.EmployeeID,sl.NetAmount,
       ISNULL(p.Paid,0) AS ReservedOrPaid,ISNULL(p.Executed,0) AS Executed,
       sl.NetAmount-ISNULL(p.Paid,0) AS Remaining,
       CASE WHEN ISNULL(p.Paid,0)=0 THEN 0 WHEN ISNULL(p.Paid,0)<sl.NetAmount THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS PayStatus /* 0 unpaid,1 partial,2 fully paid */
FROM dbo.Pay_SheetLines sl
OUTER APPLY(SELECT SUM(l.Amount) AS Paid,SUM(CASE WHEN d.DisbursementState=1 THEN l.Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Executed
            FROM dbo.Pay_DisbursementLines l JOIN dbo.Pay_Disbursements d ON d.CmpID=l.CmpID AND d.DisbursementID=l.DisbursementID AND d.DisbursementState IN(0,1)
            WHERE l.CmpID=sl.CmpID AND l.SheetID=sl.SheetID AND l.EmployeeID=sl.EmployeeID) p;
GO
CREATE OR ALTER VIEW dbo.Pay_vw_SheetBalances AS
SELECT s.CmpID,s.SheetID,s.PayRunID,s.CurrencyID,s.SheetState,s.RevisionNo,
       ISNULL(SUM(b.NetAmount),0) AS NetPayable,ISNULL(SUM(b.ReservedOrPaid),0) AS TotalDisbursed,ISNULL(SUM(b.Remaining),0) AS TotalRemaining,
       CASE WHEN ISNULL(SUM(b.ReservedOrPaid),0)=0 THEN 0 WHEN ISNULL(SUM(b.Remaining),0)>0 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS PayStatus
FROM dbo.Pay_PayrollSheets s LEFT JOIN dbo.Pay_vw_SheetLineBalances b ON b.CmpID=s.CmpID AND b.SheetID=s.SheetID
GROUP BY s.CmpID,s.SheetID,s.PayRunID,s.CurrencyID,s.SheetState,s.RevisionNo;
GO
/* ---- procedures ---- */
/* Fills (or refreshes, while draft) sheet lines from HR calculation lines. Net = earnings(1) - collected part of deductions(2) (deferred deductions are not netted). */
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Pay_ReceivePayRun @CmpID INT,@UserID BIGINT,@PayRunID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Pay_ValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 BEGIN TRY
  DECLARE @State TINYINT,@Cur BIGINT,@SheetID BIGINT,@SheetState TINYINT;
  BEGIN TRANSACTION;
  SELECT @State=RunState,@Cur=CurrencyID FROM dbo.Emp_PayRuns WITH(HOLDLOCK) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND PayRunID=@PayRunID;
  IF @State IS NULL THROW 55030,N'نتيجة الاحتساب غير موجودة ضمن الشركة.',1;
  /* RunState 2/3 = passed HR technical approval (deficit/deferral policy checks live in Emp_ChangePayRunState). */
  IF @State NOT IN(2,3) THROW 55031,N'لم يُعتمد احتساب الموارد البشرية فنياً بعد (ضوابط العجز والاستقطاعات المؤجلة).',1;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND PayRunID=@PayRunID AND LineKind NOT IN(1,2)) THROW 55032,N'توجد أنواع بنود غير معروفة في نتيجة الاحتساب.',1;
  SELECT @SheetID=SheetID,@SheetState=SheetState FROM dbo.Pay_PayrollSheets WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND PayRunID=@PayRunID;
  IF @SheetID IS NOT NULL AND @SheetState<>0 THROW 55033,N'المسير مستلم مسبقاً وليس مسودة.',1;
  IF @SheetID IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Pay_Disbursements WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND SheetID=@SheetID AND DisbursementState IN(0,1)) THROW 55034,N'لا تُحدَّث مسودة عليها دفعات.',1;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM(SELECT EmployeeID,SUM(CASE LineKind WHEN 1 THEN Amount ELSE -ISNULL(CollectedAmount,Amount) END) Net FROM dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND PayRunID=@PayRunID GROUP BY EmployeeID) x WHERE Net<0)
   THROW 55035,N'يوجد موظف صافي مستحقه سالب؛ تُعاد المعالجة في الموارد البشرية.',1;
  IF @SheetID IS NULL
  BEGIN
   INSERT dbo.Pay_PayrollSheets(CmpID,PayRunID,CurrencyID,ReceivedBy) VALUES(@CmpID,@PayRunID,@Cur,@UserID);
   SET @SheetID=SCOPE_IDENTITY();
   INSERT dbo.Pay_SheetApprovalLog(CmpID,SheetID,ActionType,FromState,ToState,Note,ActionBy) VALUES(@CmpID,@SheetID,1,NULL,0,N'استلام نتائج الاحتساب',@UserID);
  END
  ELSE
  BEGIN
   DELETE FROM dbo.Pay_SheetLines WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND SheetID=@SheetID;
   INSERT dbo.Pay_SheetApprovalLog(CmpID,SheetID,ActionType,FromState,ToState,Note,ActionBy) VALUES(@CmpID,@SheetID,9,0,0,N'إعادة سحب البنود من الاحتساب',@UserID);
  END
  INSERT dbo.Pay_SheetLines(CmpID,SheetID,EmployeeID,NetAmount)
  SELECT @CmpID,@SheetID,EmployeeID,SUM(CASE LineKind WHEN 1 THEN Amount ELSE -ISNULL(CollectedAmount,Amount) END)
  FROM dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND PayRunID=@PayRunID GROUP BY EmployeeID HAVING SUM(CASE LineKind WHEN 1 THEN Amount ELSE -ISNULL(CollectedAmount,Amount) END)>0;
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Pay_SheetLines WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND SheetID=@SheetID) THROW 55036,N'لا توجد مستحقات موجبة في نتيجة الاحتساب.',1;
  COMMIT;
  SELECT * FROM dbo.Pay_vw_SheetBalances WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND SheetID=@SheetID;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK; THROW; END CATCH
END
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Pay_SubmitSheet @CmpID INT,@UserID BIGINT,@SheetID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Pay_ValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 BEGIN TRY
  DECLARE @St TINYINT;
  BEGIN TRANSACTION;
  SELECT @St=SheetState FROM dbo.Pay_PayrollSheets WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND SheetID=@SheetID;
  IF @St IS NULL THROW 55040,N'المسير غير موجود.',1;
  IF @St<>0 THROW 55041,N'لا يُرسل للاعتماد إلا مسير في حالة مسودة.',1;
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Pay_SheetLines WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND SheetID=@SheetID) THROW 55042,N'المسير بلا بنود.',1;
  UPDATE dbo.Pay_PayrollSheets SET SheetState=1 WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND SheetID=@SheetID;
  INSERT dbo.Pay_SheetApprovalLog(CmpID,SheetID,ActionType,FromState,ToState,ActionBy) VALUES(@CmpID,@SheetID,2,0,1,@UserID);
  COMMIT;
  SELECT SheetID,SheetState FROM dbo.Pay_PayrollSheets WHERE SheetID=@SheetID;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK; THROW; END CATCH
END
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Pay_DecideSheet @CmpID INT,@UserID BIGINT,@SheetID BIGINT,@Approve BIT,@Note NVARCHAR(500)=NULL
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Pay_ValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 BEGIN TRY
  DECLARE @St TINYINT,@Receiver BIGINT,@Submitter BIGINT;
  IF @Approve=0 AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@Note)),N'') IS NULL THROW 55045,N'سبب الرفض مطلوب.',1;
  BEGIN TRANSACTION;
  SELECT @St=SheetState,@Receiver=ReceivedBy FROM dbo.Pay_PayrollSheets WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND SheetID=@SheetID;
  IF @St IS NULL THROW 55046,N'المسير غير موجود.',1;
  IF @St<>1 THROW 55047,N'المسير ليس بانتظار الاعتماد.',1;
  SELECT TOP(1) @Submitter=ActionBy FROM dbo.Pay_SheetApprovalLog WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND SheetID=@SheetID AND ActionType=2 ORDER BY LogID DESC;
  IF @UserID IN(@Receiver,@Submitter) THROW 55048,N'يجب أن يختلف المعتمد عن مستلم المسير ومرسله.',1;
  UPDATE dbo.Pay_PayrollSheets SET SheetState=CASE WHEN @Approve=1 THEN 2 ELSE 3 END WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND SheetID=@SheetID;
  INSERT dbo.Pay_SheetApprovalLog(CmpID,SheetID,ActionType,FromState,ToState,Note,ActionBy) VALUES(@CmpID,@SheetID,CASE WHEN @Approve=1 THEN 3 ELSE 4 END,1,CASE WHEN @Approve=1 THEN 2 ELSE 3 END,@Note,@UserID);
  COMMIT;
  SELECT SheetID,SheetState FROM dbo.Pay_PayrollSheets WHERE SheetID=@SheetID;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK; THROW; END CATCH
END
GO
/* Rejected sheet returns to draft so it can be refreshed via Pay_ReceivePayRun and resubmitted. */
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Pay_ReopenRejectedSheet @CmpID INT,@UserID BIGINT,@SheetID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Pay_ValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 BEGIN TRY
  DECLARE @St TINYINT;
  BEGIN TRANSACTION;
  SELECT @St=SheetState FROM dbo.Pay_PayrollSheets WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND SheetID=@SheetID;
  IF @St IS NULL THROW 55050,N'المسير غير موجود.',1;
  IF @St<>3 THROW 55051,N'المسير ليس مرفوضاً.',1;
  UPDATE dbo.Pay_PayrollSheets SET SheetState=0,RevisionNo=RevisionNo+1 WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND SheetID=@SheetID;
  INSERT dbo.Pay_SheetApprovalLog(CmpID,SheetID,ActionType,FromState,ToState,ActionBy) VALUES(@CmpID,@SheetID,9,3,0,@UserID);
  COMMIT;
  SELECT SheetID,SheetState,RevisionNo FROM dbo.Pay_PayrollSheets WHERE SheetID=@SheetID;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK; THROW; END CATCH
END
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Pay_RequestSheetCorrection @CmpID INT,@UserID BIGINT,@SheetID BIGINT,@Reason NVARCHAR(500)
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Pay_ValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 BEGIN TRY
  DECLARE @St TINYINT,@Id BIGINT;
  IF NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@Reason)),N'') IS NULL THROW 55055,N'سبب التصحيح مطلوب.',1;
  BEGIN TRANSACTION;
  SELECT @St=SheetState FROM dbo.Pay_PayrollSheets WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND SheetID=@SheetID;
  IF @St IS NULL THROW 55056,N'المسير غير موجود.',1;
  IF @St<>2 THROW 55057,N'التصحيح الموثق يخص المسير المعتمد فقط.',1;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Pay_SheetCorrections WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND SheetID=@SheetID AND CorrectionState=0) THROW 55058,N'يوجد طلب تصحيح مفتوح.',1;
  INSERT dbo.Pay_SheetCorrections(CmpID,SheetID,Reason,RequestedBy) VALUES(@CmpID,@SheetID,@Reason,@UserID);
  SET @Id=SCOPE_IDENTITY();
  INSERT dbo.Pay_SheetApprovalLog(CmpID,SheetID,ActionType,FromState,ToState,Note,ActionBy) VALUES(@CmpID,@SheetID,5,2,2,@Reason,@UserID);
  COMMIT;
  SELECT CorrectionID,CorrectionState FROM dbo.Pay_SheetCorrections WHERE CorrectionID=@Id;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK; THROW; END CATCH
END
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Pay_DecideSheetCorrection @CmpID INT,@UserID BIGINT,@CorrectionID BIGINT,@Approve BIT
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Pay_ValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 BEGIN TRY
  DECLARE @Sheet BIGINT,@CSt TINYINT,@Req BIGINT,@SSt TINYINT;
  BEGIN TRANSACTION;
  SELECT @Sheet=SheetID,@CSt=CorrectionState,@Req=RequestedBy FROM dbo.Pay_SheetCorrections WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND CorrectionID=@CorrectionID;
  IF @Sheet IS NULL THROW 55060,N'طلب التصحيح غير موجود.',1;
  IF @CSt<>0 THROW 55061,N'طلب التصحيح محسوم مسبقاً.',1;
  IF @Req=@UserID THROW 55062,N'لا يجوز لمقدّم الطلب اعتماده.',1;
  SELECT @SSt=SheetState FROM dbo.Pay_PayrollSheets WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND SheetID=@Sheet;
  IF @Approve=1
  BEGIN
   IF @SSt<>2 THROW 55063,N'المسير ليس معتمداً.',1;
   IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Pay_Disbursements WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND SheetID=@Sheet AND DisbursementState IN(0,1))
    THROW 55064,N'لا يُعاد فتح مسير عليه دفعات؛ تُلغى الدفعات غير المنفذة أولاً، وما نُفذ يُعالج بتسوية مستقلة.',1;
   UPDATE dbo.Pay_PayrollSheets SET SheetState=0,RevisionNo=RevisionNo+1 WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND SheetID=@Sheet;
  END
  UPDATE dbo.Pay_SheetCorrections SET CorrectionState=CASE WHEN @Approve=1 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,DecidedAt=SYSDATETIME(),DecidedBy=@UserID WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND CorrectionID=@CorrectionID;
  INSERT dbo.Pay_SheetApprovalLog(CmpID,SheetID,ActionType,FromState,ToState,ActionBy) VALUES(@CmpID,@Sheet,CASE WHEN @Approve=1 THEN 6 ELSE 7 END,@SSt,CASE WHEN @Approve=1 THEN 0 ELSE @SSt END,@UserID);
  COMMIT;
  SELECT SheetID,SheetState,RevisionNo FROM dbo.Pay_PayrollSheets WHERE SheetID=@Sheet;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK; THROW; END CATCH
END
GO
/* @Lines JSON: [{"employeeId":1,"amount":3000.000},...]. Replaying the same @IdempotencyKey returns the original batch and writes nothing. */
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Pay_RegisterDisbursement
 @CmpID INT,@UserID BIGINT,@SheetID BIGINT,@IdempotencyKey NVARCHAR(100),@PaymentMethod TINYINT,@DisbursementDate DATE,@Lines NVARCHAR(MAX),@Reference NVARCHAR(200)=NULL
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Pay_ValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 BEGIN TRY
  SET @IdempotencyKey=LTRIM(RTRIM(@IdempotencyKey));
  IF NULLIF(@IdempotencyKey,N'') IS NULL OR @PaymentMethod NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 4 OR @DisbursementDate IS NULL OR ISJSON(@Lines)<>1 THROW 55070,N'بيانات الدفعة غير صحيحة.',1;
  DECLARE @Id BIGINT,@Batch INT,@St TINYINT,@ExistingSheet BIGINT;
  DECLARE @L TABLE(EmployeeID BIGINT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,Amount DECIMAL(19,3) NOT NULL);
  BEGIN TRANSACTION;
  SELECT @Id=DisbursementID,@ExistingSheet=SheetID FROM dbo.Pay_Disbursements WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND IdempotencyKey=@IdempotencyKey;
  IF @Id IS NOT NULL
  BEGIN
   IF @ExistingSheet<>@SheetID THROW 55071,N'مفتاح عدم التكرار مستخدم لمسير آخر.',1;
   INSERT dbo.Pay_DisbursementAudit(CmpID,DisbursementID,EventType,Note,EventBy) VALUES(@CmpID,@Id,4,N'طلب مكرر لم يُنفَّذ',@UserID);
   COMMIT;
   SELECT DisbursementID,BatchNo,DisbursementState,CAST(1 AS BIT) AS IsReplay FROM dbo.Pay_Disbursements WHERE DisbursementID=@Id;
   RETURN;
  END
  SELECT @St=SheetState FROM dbo.Pay_PayrollSheets WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND SheetID=@SheetID;
  IF @St IS NULL THROW 55072,N'المسير غير موجود.',1;
  IF @St<>2 THROW 55073,N'لا يُصرف قبل اعتماد المسير.',1;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM OPENJSON(@Lines) WITH(employeeId BIGINT '$.employeeId') GROUP BY employeeId HAVING COUNT(*)>1) THROW 55074,N'موظف مكرر داخل الدفعة.',1;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM OPENJSON(@Lines) WITH(employeeId BIGINT '$.employeeId',amount DECIMAL(19,3) '$.amount') WHERE employeeId IS NULL OR amount IS NULL) THROW 55079,N'بند دفعة بلا موظف أو بلا مبلغ.',1;
  INSERT @L(EmployeeID,Amount) SELECT employeeId,amount FROM OPENJSON(@Lines) WITH(employeeId BIGINT '$.employeeId',amount DECIMAL(19,3) '$.amount');
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM @L) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM @L WHERE Amount<=0) THROW 55075,N'بنود الدفعة فارغة أو بقيم غير موجبة.',1;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM @L l WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Pay_SheetLines sl WHERE sl.CmpID=@CmpID AND sl.SheetID=@SheetID AND sl.EmployeeID=l.EmployeeID)) THROW 55076,N'موظف غير وارد في المسير.',1;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM @L l JOIN dbo.Pay_vw_SheetLineBalances b ON b.CmpID=@CmpID AND b.SheetID=@SheetID AND b.EmployeeID=l.EmployeeID WHERE l.Amount>b.Remaining)
   THROW 55077,N'مبلغ الدفعة يتجاوز المتبقي من صافي المستحق.',1;
  SELECT @Batch=ISNULL(MAX(BatchNo),0)+1 FROM dbo.Pay_Disbursements WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND SheetID=@SheetID;
  INSERT dbo.Pay_Disbursements(CmpID,SheetID,BatchNo,IdempotencyKey,DisbursementDate,PaymentMethod,Reference,CreatedBy) VALUES(@CmpID,@SheetID,@Batch,@IdempotencyKey,@DisbursementDate,@PaymentMethod,@Reference,@UserID);
  SET @Id=SCOPE_IDENTITY();
  INSERT dbo.Pay_DisbursementLines(CmpID,DisbursementID,SheetID,EmployeeID,Amount) SELECT @CmpID,@Id,@SheetID,EmployeeID,Amount FROM @L;
  INSERT dbo.Pay_DisbursementAudit(CmpID,DisbursementID,EventType,Note,EventBy) VALUES(@CmpID,@Id,1,N'تسجيل تعليمات صرف',@UserID);
  COMMIT;
  SELECT DisbursementID,BatchNo,DisbursementState,CAST(0 AS BIT) AS IsReplay FROM dbo.Pay_Disbursements WHERE DisbursementID=@Id;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK; THROW; END CATCH
END
GO
/* Records the executed result reported by Treasury/Banks (no accounting posting here). */
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Pay_ConfirmDisbursement @CmpID INT,@UserID BIGINT,@DisbursementID BIGINT,@TreasuryReference NVARCHAR(100)
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Pay_ValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 BEGIN TRY
  DECLARE @St TINYINT,@Creator BIGINT;
  IF NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@TreasuryReference)),N'') IS NULL THROW 55080,N'مرجع الخزينة/المصرف مطلوب.',1;
  BEGIN TRANSACTION;
  SELECT @St=DisbursementState,@Creator=CreatedBy FROM dbo.Pay_Disbursements WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND DisbursementID=@DisbursementID;
  IF @St IS NULL THROW 55081,N'الدفعة غير موجودة.',1;
  IF @St<>0 THROW 55082,N'الدفعة منفذة أو ملغاة مسبقاً.',1;
  IF @Creator=@UserID THROW 55083,N'لا يجوز لمسجّل الدفعة تأكيد تنفيذها.',1;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Pay_Disbursements WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND TreasuryReference=@TreasuryReference) THROW 55084,N'مرجع الخزينة مستخدم لدفعة أخرى.',1;
  UPDATE dbo.Pay_Disbursements SET DisbursementState=1,TreasuryReference=@TreasuryReference,ConfirmedAt=SYSDATETIME(),ConfirmedBy=@UserID WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND DisbursementID=@DisbursementID;
  INSERT dbo.Pay_DisbursementAudit(CmpID,DisbursementID,EventType,Note,EventBy) VALUES(@CmpID,@DisbursementID,2,@TreasuryReference,@UserID);
  COMMIT;
  SELECT DisbursementID,DisbursementState,TreasuryReference FROM dbo.Pay_Disbursements WHERE DisbursementID=@DisbursementID;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK; THROW; END CATCH
END
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Pay_CancelDisbursement @CmpID INT,@UserID BIGINT,@DisbursementID BIGINT,@Reason NVARCHAR(500)
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Pay_ValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 BEGIN TRY
  DECLARE @St TINYINT;
  IF NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@Reason)),N'') IS NULL THROW 55085,N'سبب الإلغاء مطلوب.',1;
  BEGIN TRANSACTION;
  SELECT @St=DisbursementState FROM dbo.Pay_Disbursements WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND DisbursementID=@DisbursementID;
  IF @St IS NULL THROW 55086,N'الدفعة غير موجودة.',1;
  IF @St=1 THROW 55087,N'الدفعة منفذة فعلاً؛ لا تُلغى بل تُعالج بتسوية مستقلة.',1;
  IF @St=2 THROW 55088,N'الدفعة ملغاة مسبقاً.',1;
  UPDATE dbo.Pay_Disbursements SET DisbursementState=2,CancelledAt=SYSDATETIME(),CancelledBy=@UserID,CancelReason=@Reason WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND DisbursementID=@DisbursementID;
  INSERT dbo.Pay_DisbursementAudit(CmpID,DisbursementID,EventType,Note,EventBy) VALUES(@CmpID,@DisbursementID,3,@Reason,@UserID);
  COMMIT;
  SELECT DisbursementID,DisbursementState FROM dbo.Pay_Disbursements WHERE DisbursementID=@DisbursementID;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK; THROW; END CATCH
END
GO
/* Closing requires full payment of every line and every batch executed or cancelled. */
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Pay_CloseSheet @CmpID INT,@UserID BIGINT,@SheetID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Pay_ValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 BEGIN TRY
  DECLARE @St TINYINT;
  BEGIN TRANSACTION;
  SELECT @St=SheetState FROM dbo.Pay_PayrollSheets WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND SheetID=@SheetID;
  IF @St IS NULL THROW 55090,N'المسير غير موجود.',1;
  IF @St<>2 THROW 55091,N'يُغلق المسير المعتمد فقط.',1;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Pay_vw_SheetLineBalances WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND SheetID=@SheetID AND Remaining>0) THROW 55092,N'يوجد رصيد متبقٍ غير مصروف.',1;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Pay_Disbursements WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND SheetID=@SheetID AND DisbursementState=0) THROW 55093,N'توجد دفعات لم يُؤكَّد تنفيذها.',1;
  UPDATE dbo.Pay_PayrollSheets SET SheetState=4 WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND SheetID=@SheetID;
  INSERT dbo.Pay_SheetApprovalLog(CmpID,SheetID,ActionType,FromState,ToState,ActionBy) VALUES(@CmpID,@SheetID,8,2,4,@UserID);
  COMMIT;
  SELECT SheetID,SheetState FROM dbo.Pay_PayrollSheets WHERE SheetID=@SheetID;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK; THROW; END CATCH
END
GO

AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; EXEC dbo.Pay_ValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 SELECT * FROM dbo.Pay_vw_SheetBalances WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND (@SheetID IS NULL OR SheetID=@SheetID) AND (@SheetState IS NULL OR SheetState=@SheetState) ORDER BY SheetID DESC;
END

CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Pay_SelectEmployeeBalances @CmpID INT,@UserID BIGINT,@SheetID BIGINT,@EmployeeID BIGINT=NULL
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; EXEC dbo.Pay_ValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 SELECT * FROM dbo.Pay_vw_SheetLineBalances WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND SheetID=@SheetID AND (@EmployeeID IS NULL OR EmployeeID=@EmployeeID) ORDER BY EmployeeID;
END

CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Pay_SelectDisbursements @CmpID INT,@UserID BIGINT,@SheetID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; EXEC dbo.Pay_ValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 SELECT d.DisbursementID,d.BatchNo,d.DisbursementDate,d.PaymentMethod,d.Reference,d.DisbursementState,d.TreasuryReference,d.CreatedAt,d.CreatedBy,d.ConfirmedAt,d.ConfirmedBy,d.CancelledAt,d.CancelReason,
        (SELECT SUM(Amount) FROM dbo.Pay_DisbursementLines l WHERE l.CmpID=d.CmpID AND l.DisbursementID=d.DisbursementID) AS BatchAmount
 FROM dbo.Pay_Disbursements d WHERE d.CmpID=@CmpID AND d.SheetID=@SheetID ORDER BY d.BatchNo;
END

/* Shift swaps: attendance engine resolves the effective shift through fn_Emp_GetScheduledShift (approved overrides first, then the employee calendar). */
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE [dbo].[Emp_ProcessAttendance]
    @CmpID    INT,
    @DateFrom DATE,
    @DateTo   DATE,
    @UserID   BIGINT,@SuppressResult BIT=0
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;
    EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;

    DECLARE
        @ProcID BIGINT,
        @ReceivedCount INT = 0,
        @ProcessedCount INT = 0,
        @SkippedCount INT = 0,
        @FailedCount INT = 0,
        @FinalStatus TINYINT = 1,
        @Error NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL;

    IF ISNULL(@CmpID, 0) <= 0
        THROW 53101, N'الشركة المحددة غير صحيحة.', 1;

    IF @DateFrom IS NULL OR @DateTo IS NULL OR @DateTo < @DateFrom
        THROW 53102, N'فترة المعالجة غير صحيحة.', 1;

    IF NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1
        FROM dbo.Mng_Company
        WHERE CmpID = @CmpID
    )
        THROW 53103, N'الشركة غير موجودة.', 1;

    IF NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1
        FROM dbo.Mng_User
        WHERE UsrID = @UserID
    )
        THROW 53104, N'المستخدم غير موجود.', 1;

    DECLARE @Log TABLE
    (
        ProcID BIGINT,
        ProcStatus TINYINT
    );

    INSERT INTO @Log
    EXEC dbo.Emp_InsertAttendanceProcessingLog
        @CmpID = @CmpID,
        @DateFrom = @DateFrom,
        @DateTo = @DateTo,
        @UserID = @UserID;

    SELECT @ProcID = ProcID
    FROM @Log;

    BEGIN TRY

        BEGIN TRANSACTION;

        /* 1. تحميل الحركات الجديدة */

        SELECT T.AttID,T.AttCmp,T.AttEmpID,T.AttDateTime,T.AttType,
            CASE WHEN EXISTS
            (
                SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_EmployeeSchedule ES
                JOIN dbo.Emp_WorkCalendar WC ON WC.WCalCmp=ES.SchCmp AND WC.WCalID=ES.SchWCalID AND WC.WCalState=0
                JOIN dbo.Emp_WorkCalendarDetails WD ON WD.WCalDetCmp=WC.WCalCmp AND WD.WCalDetWCalID=WC.WCalID AND WD.WCalDetDate=DATEADD(DAY,-1,CONVERT(date,T.AttDateTime)) AND WD.WCalDetType=1
                JOIN dbo.Emp_WorkScheduleTypes ST ON ST.SchTypeCmp=WD.WCalDetCmp AND ST.SchTypeID=dbo.fn_Emp_GetScheduledShift(T.AttCmp,T.AttEmpID,DATEADD(DAY,-1,CONVERT(date,T.AttDateTime))) AND ST.SchTypeState=0 AND ST.SchCrossesMidnight=1
                WHERE ES.SchCmp=T.AttCmp AND ES.SchEmpID=T.AttEmpID AND ES.SchState=0 AND ES.SchStartDate<=DATEADD(DAY,-1,CONVERT(date,T.AttDateTime)) AND (ES.SchEndDate IS NULL OR ES.SchEndDate>=DATEADD(DAY,-1,CONVERT(date,T.AttDateTime)))
                  AND CONVERT(time(0),T.AttDateTime)<=ST.SchEndTime
            ) THEN DATEADD(DAY,-1,CONVERT(date,T.AttDateTime)) ELSE CONVERT(date,T.AttDateTime) END AS WorkDate
        INTO #Raw
        FROM dbo.Emp_AttendanceTransactions T WITH (UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK)
        WHERE T.AttCmp=@CmpID AND T.AttState=0
          AND T.AttDateTime>=DATEADD(DAY,-1,CONVERT(datetime2(0),@DateFrom))
          AND T.AttDateTime<DATEADD(DAY,2,CONVERT(datetime2(0),@DateTo));

        SELECT @ReceivedCount = COUNT(*) FROM #Raw WHERE WorkDate BETWEEN @DateFrom AND @DateTo;

        /* 2. استبعاد الأيام التي سبق اعتمادها */

        SELECT DISTINCT
            R.AttEmpID,
            R.WorkDate
        INTO #ProtectedDays
        FROM #Raw AS R
        INNER JOIN dbo.Emp_AttendanceDaily AS D
            ON D.AttDayCmp = R.AttCmp
           AND D.AttDayEmpID = R.AttEmpID
           AND D.AttDayDate = R.WorkDate
        WHERE D.AttDayState <> 0;

        /* 3. الحركات القابلة للمعالجة */

        SELECT R.*
        INTO #Eligible
        FROM #Raw AS R
        WHERE R.WorkDate BETWEEN @DateFrom AND @DateTo AND NOT EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM #ProtectedDays AS P
            WHERE P.AttEmpID = R.AttEmpID
              AND P.WorkDate = R.WorkDate
        );

        SELECT @ProcessedCount = COUNT(*)
        FROM #Eligible;

        SET @SkippedCount = @ReceivedCount - @ProcessedCount;

        /* 4. ترتيب الحركات لكل موظف ويوم */

        ;WITH OrderedPunches AS
        (
            SELECT
                AttID,
                AttEmpID,
                WorkDate,
                AttDateTime,
                AttType,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER
                (
                    PARTITION BY AttEmpID, WorkDate
                    ORDER BY AttDateTime, AttID
                ) AS RowNo
            FROM #Eligible
        ),
        PairedPunches AS
        (
            SELECT A.AttEmpID,A.WorkDate,A.AttDateTime AS InTime,B.OutTime,A.AttType AS InType,CONVERT(tinyint,2) AS OutType
            FROM OrderedPunches A
            OUTER APPLY
            (
                SELECT TOP(1) X.AttDateTime AS OutTime
                FROM OrderedPunches X
                WHERE X.AttEmpID=A.AttEmpID AND X.WorkDate=A.WorkDate AND X.RowNo>A.RowNo AND X.AttType=2
                  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM OrderedPunches BetweenEvents WHERE BetweenEvents.AttEmpID=A.AttEmpID AND BetweenEvents.WorkDate=A.WorkDate AND BetweenEvents.RowNo>A.RowNo AND BetweenEvents.RowNo<X.RowNo AND BetweenEvents.AttType=1)
                ORDER BY X.RowNo
            ) B
            WHERE A.AttType=1
        )
        SELECT AttEmpID,WorkDate,MIN(CASE WHEN InTime IS NOT NULL THEN InTime END) AS FirstIn,
            MAX(OutTime) AS LastOut,
            SUM(CASE WHEN OutTime>=InTime THEN DATEDIFF(MINUTE,InTime,OutTime) ELSE 0 END) AS WorkMinutes
        INTO #Daily FROM PairedPunches GROUP BY AttEmpID,WorkDate;

        /* Compute schedule-based tardiness and early departure using the employee calendar. */
        UPDATE A SET
            A.AttDayLateMinutes=CASE WHEN A.FirstIn>DATEADD(MINUTE,S.GraceMinutes,S.StartAt) THEN DATEDIFF(MINUTE,DATEADD(MINUTE,S.GraceMinutes,S.StartAt),A.FirstIn) ELSE 0 END,
            A.AttDayEarlyLeaveMinutes=CASE WHEN A.LastOut IS NOT NULL AND A.LastOut<S.EndAt THEN DATEDIFF(MINUTE,A.LastOut,S.EndAt) ELSE 0 END,
            A.AttDayOvertimeMinutes=CASE WHEN A.WorkMinutes>S.RequiredMinutes THEN A.WorkMinutes-S.RequiredMinutes ELSE 0 END
        FROM #Daily A
        OUTER APPLY
        (
            SELECT TOP(1)
                DATEADD(SECOND,DATEDIFF(SECOND,CONVERT(time(0),'00:00:00'),ST.SchStartTime),CONVERT(datetime2(0),A.WorkDate)) AS StartAt,
                DATEADD(DAY,CASE WHEN ST.SchCrossesMidnight=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,DATEADD(SECOND,DATEDIFF(SECOND,CONVERT(time(0),'00:00:00'),ST.SchEndTime),CONVERT(datetime2(0),A.WorkDate))) AS EndAt,
                ST.SchGraceMinutes AS GraceMinutes,CONVERT(int,ROUND(ST.SchWorkingHours*60,0)) AS RequiredMinutes
            FROM dbo.Emp_EmployeeSchedule ES
            JOIN dbo.Emp_WorkCalendar WC ON WC.WCalCmp=ES.SchCmp AND WC.WCalID=ES.SchWCalID AND WC.WCalState=0
            JOIN dbo.Emp_WorkCalendarDetails WD ON WD.WCalDetCmp=WC.WCalCmp AND WD.WCalDetWCalID=WC.WCalID AND WD.WCalDetDate=A.WorkDate AND WD.WCalDetType=1
            JOIN dbo.Emp_WorkScheduleTypes ST ON ST.SchTypeCmp=WD.WCalDetCmp AND ST.SchTypeID=dbo.fn_Emp_GetScheduledShift(@CmpID,A.AttEmpID,A.WorkDate) AND ST.SchTypeState=0
            WHERE ES.SchCmp=@CmpID AND ES.SchEmpID=A.AttEmpID AND ES.SchState=0 AND ES.SchStartDate<=A.WorkDate AND (ES.SchEndDate IS NULL OR ES.SchEndDate>=A.WorkDate)
            ORDER BY ES.SchStartDate DESC,ES.SchID DESC
        ) S;
        /* 5. تحديث الملخص اليومي الموجود */

        UPDATE D
        SET
            D.AttDayFirstIn = A.FirstIn,
            D.AttDayLastOut = A.LastOut,
            D.AttDayWorkMinutes = A.WorkMinutes,
            D.AttDayLateMinutes = A.AttDayLateMinutes,
            D.AttDayEarlyLeaveMinutes = A.AttDayEarlyLeaveMinutes,
            D.AttDayOvertimeMinutes = A.AttDayOvertimeMinutes,
            D.AttDayDateTime = SYSDATETIME(),
            D.AttDayUser = @UserID
        FROM dbo.Emp_AttendanceDaily AS D
        INNER JOIN #Daily AS A
            ON A.AttEmpID = D.AttDayEmpID
           AND A.WorkDate = D.AttDayDate
        WHERE D.AttDayCmp = @CmpID
          AND D.AttDayState = 0;

        /* 6. إضافة الأيام غير المسجلة */

        INSERT INTO dbo.Emp_AttendanceDaily
        (
            AttDayCmp,
            AttDayEmpID,
            AttDayDate,
            AttDayFirstIn,
            AttDayLastOut,
            AttDayWorkMinutes,
            AttDayLateMinutes,
            AttDayEarlyLeaveMinutes,
            AttDayOvertimeMinutes,
            AttDayUser
        )
        SELECT
            @CmpID,
            A.AttEmpID,
            A.WorkDate,
            A.FirstIn,
            A.LastOut,
            A.WorkMinutes,
            A.AttDayLateMinutes,
            A.AttDayEarlyLeaveMinutes,
            A.AttDayOvertimeMinutes,
            @UserID
        FROM #Daily AS A
        WHERE NOT EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM dbo.Emp_AttendanceDaily AS D
            WHERE D.AttDayCmp = @CmpID
              AND D.AttDayEmpID = A.AttEmpID
              AND D.AttDayDate = A.WorkDate
        );

        /* 7. تعليم الحركات التي تمت معالجتها */

        UPDATE T
        SET
            T.AttState = 1,
            T.AttStateDateTime = SYSDATETIME(),
            T.AttStateUser = @UserID
        FROM dbo.Emp_AttendanceTransactions AS T
        INNER JOIN #Eligible AS E
            ON E.AttID = T.AttID
        WHERE T.AttCmp = @CmpID
          AND T.AttState = 0;

        /* 8. إنهاء سجل المعالجة */

        SET @FinalStatus =
            CASE WHEN @SkippedCount > 0 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END;

        IF @SkippedCount > 0
            SET @Error = N'تم تجاوز حركات الأيام التي سبق اعتماد ملخص حضورها.';

        EXEC dbo.Emp_UpdateAttendanceProcessingLog
            @CmpID = @CmpID,
            @ProcID = @ProcID,
            @Status = @FinalStatus,
            @ReceivedCount = @ReceivedCount,
            @ProcessedCount = @ProcessedCount,
            @SkippedCount = @SkippedCount,
            @FailedCount = 0,
            @Error = @Error,
            @UserID = @UserID;

        COMMIT TRANSACTION;

        IF @SuppressResult=0 SELECT @ProcID AS ProcID,@FinalStatus AS ProcStatus,@ReceivedCount AS ReceivedCount,@ProcessedCount AS ProcessedCount,@SkippedCount AS SkippedCount,0 AS FailedCount;

    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH

        IF XACT_STATE() <> 0
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;

        SET @Error = ERROR_MESSAGE();
        SET @FailedCount = @ReceivedCount;

        UPDATE dbo.Emp_AttendanceProcessingLog
        SET
            ProcStatus = 3,
            ProcReceivedCount = @ReceivedCount,
            ProcProcessedCount = 0,
            ProcSkippedCount = 0,
            ProcFailedCount = @FailedCount,
            ProcError = @Error,
            ProcFinishedAt = SYSDATETIME()
        WHERE ProcCmp = @CmpID
          AND ProcID = @ProcID
          AND ProcStatus = 0;

        THROW;

    END CATCH;
END;

mp,AttEmpID,AttDateTime,AttType,AttSource,AttDeviceID,AttDeviceRecordID,AttState,AttDateTimeCreated,AttUser,AttSyncID,AttDedupHash)
 SELECT @CmpID,v.EmployeeID,v.PunchAt,v.PunchType,@Source,@DeviceID,v.DeviceRecordID,0,SYSDATETIME(),@UserID,@SyncID,v.DedupHash
 FROM Ranked v
 WHERE v.rn=1 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_AttendanceTransactions t WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE t.AttCmp=@CmpID AND t.AttDedupHash=v.DedupHash);
 SET @Inserted=@@ROWCOUNT;
 SET @Duplicates=@ValidCount-@Inserted;
 IF @SyncID IS NOT NULL
  UPDATE dbo.Emp_AttendanceDeviceSyncLog
   SET SyncReceivedCount=@Received,SyncInsertedCount=@Inserted,SyncDuplicateCount=@Duplicates,SyncRejectedCount=@Rejected,
       SyncFinishedAt=SYSDATETIME(),SyncStatus=CASE WHEN @Rejected>0 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END,SyncUser=@UserID
   WHERE SyncCmp=@CmpID AND SyncID=@SyncID;
 COMMIT;
 SELECT @Received ReceivedCount,@Inserted InsertedCount,@Duplicates DuplicateCount,@Rejected RejectedCount;
 SELECT r.* FROM @Rows r WHERE r.PunchType NOT IN(1,2)
    OR (@Source=1 AND NULLIF(r.DeviceRecordID,N'') IS NULL)
    OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_Employee e WHERE e.EmpCompany=@CmpID AND e.EmpID=r.EmployeeID);
END;

SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
/* ======================================================================
   Phase 3 foundation: direct-manager source (org unit heads), ESS (self-only) and MSS (reporting line) read services.
   Access model = relationship-based: ESS sees only EmpID=UserID (existing convention EmpID=UsrID);
   MSS sees only employees whose resolved direct manager is the caller. No permission table is read or created.
   ====================================================================== */
IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Emp_OrgUnitHeads',N'U') IS NULL
CREATE TABLE dbo.Emp_OrgUnitHeads(
 HeadID BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL,
 CmpID INT NOT NULL,
 OrgUnitID BIGINT NOT NULL,
 HeadEmployeeID BIGINT NOT NULL,
 EffectiveFrom DATE NOT NULL,
 EffectiveTo DATE NULL,
 CreatedAt DATETIME2(0) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Emp_OrgUnitHeads_At DEFAULT(SYSDATETIME()),
 CreatedBy BIGINT NOT NULL,
 CONSTRAINT PK_Emp_OrgUnitHeads PRIMARY KEY(HeadID),
 CONSTRAINT UQ_Emp_OrgUnitHeads_Version UNIQUE(CmpID,OrgUnitID,EffectiveFrom),
 CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_OrgUnitHeads_Unit FOREIGN KEY(CmpID,OrgUnitID) REFERENCES dbo.Emp_OrganigramStructure(EmpOrgStrCompany,EmpOrgStrID),
 CONSTRAINT FK_Emp_OrgUnitHeads_Emp FOREIGN KEY(CmpID,HeadEmployeeID) REFERENCES dbo.Emp_Employee(EmpCompany,EmpID),
 CONSTRAINT CK_Emp_OrgUnitHeads_V CHECK(EffectiveTo IS NULL OR EffectiveTo>=EffectiveFrom));
GO
IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys.indexes WHERE name=N'UX_Emp_OrgUnitHeads_Open' AND object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Emp_OrgUnitHeads'))
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX_Emp_OrgUnitHeads_Open ON dbo.Emp_OrgUnitHeads(CmpID,OrgUnitID) WHERE EffectiveTo IS NULL;
GO
IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys.indexes WHERE name=N'IX_Emp_OrgUnitHeads_Lookup' AND object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Emp_OrgUnitHeads'))
CREATE INDEX IX_Emp_OrgUnitHeads_Lookup ON dbo.Emp_OrgUnitHeads(CmpID,OrgUnitID,EffectiveFrom) INCLUDE(HeadEmployeeID,EffectiveTo);
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_SaveOrgUnitHead @CmpID INT,@UserID BIGINT,@OrgUnitID BIGINT,@HeadEmployeeID BIGINT,@EffectiveFrom DATE
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 BEGIN TRY
  IF @EffectiveFrom IS NULL THROW 54400,N'تاريخ السريان مطلوب.',1;
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_OrganigramStructure WHERE EmpOrgStrCompany=@CmpID AND EmpOrgStrID=@OrgUnitID) THROW 54401,N'الوحدة التنظيمية غير موجودة ضمن الشركة.',1;
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_Employee WHERE EmpCompany=@CmpID AND EmpID=@HeadEmployeeID AND EmpState=0) THROW 54402,N'الموظف غير موجود أو غير نشط.',1;
  BEGIN TRANSACTION;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_OrgUnitHeads WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND OrgUnitID=@OrgUnitID AND EffectiveFrom>=@EffectiveFrom)
   THROW 54403,N'يوجد رئيس بنفس تاريخ السريان أو لاحق له.',1;
  UPDATE dbo.Emp_OrgUnitHeads SET EffectiveTo=DATEADD(DAY,-1,@EffectiveFrom) WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND OrgUnitID=@OrgUnitID AND EffectiveTo IS NULL;
  INSERT dbo.Emp_OrgUnitHeads(CmpID,OrgUnitID,HeadEmployeeID,EffectiveFrom,CreatedBy) VALUES(@CmpID,@OrgUnitID,@HeadEmployeeID,@EffectiveFrom,@UserID);
  COMMIT;
  SELECT HeadID,OrgUnitID,HeadEmployeeID,EffectiveFrom,EffectiveTo FROM dbo.Emp_OrgUnitHeads WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND OrgUnitID=@OrgUnitID ORDER BY EffectiveFrom DESC;
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK; THROW; END CATCH
END
GO
/* Direct manager = effective head of the employee's unit (via position); if the employee is that head, or the unit has none, climb to the parent unit. NULL when none. */
CREATE OR ALTER FUNCTION dbo.fn_Emp_GetDirectManager(@CmpID INT,@EmpID BIGINT,@AsOf DATE)
RETURNS BIGINT AS
BEGIN
 DECLARE @Unit BIGINT,@Head BIGINT,@I INT=0;
 SELECT @Unit=p.EmpOrgStrID FROM dbo.Emp_Employee e JOIN dbo.Emp_Position p ON p.PosCmp=e.EmpCompany AND p.PosID=e.PosID WHERE e.EmpCompany=@CmpID AND e.EmpID=@EmpID;
 WHILE @Unit IS NOT NULL AND @I<30
 BEGIN
  SET @Head=NULL;
  SELECT TOP(1) @Head=h.HeadEmployeeID FROM dbo.Emp_OrgUnitHeads h JOIN dbo.Emp_Employee he ON he.EmpCompany=h.CmpID AND he.EmpID=h.HeadEmployeeID AND he.EmpState=0
  WHERE h.CmpID=@CmpID AND h.OrgUnitID=@Unit AND h.EffectiveFrom<=@AsOf AND (h.EffectiveTo IS NULL OR h.EffectiveTo>=@AsOf) AND h.HeadEmployeeID<>@EmpID ORDER BY h.EffectiveFrom DESC;
  IF @Head IS NOT NULL RETURN @Head;
  SELECT @Unit=EmpOrgStrParentID FROM dbo.Emp_OrganigramStructure WHERE EmpOrgStrCompany=@CmpID AND EmpOrgStrID=@Unit;
  SET @I+=1;
 END
 RETURN NULL;
END
GO
CREATE OR ALTER FUNCTION dbo.fn_Emp_GetDirectReports(@CmpID INT,@ManagerID BIGINT,@AsOf DATE)
RETURNS TABLE AS
RETURN SELECT e.EmpID AS EmployeeID FROM dbo.Emp_Employee e WHERE e.EmpCompany=@CmpID AND e.EmpState=0 AND e.EmpID<>@ManagerID AND dbo.fn_Emp_GetDirectManager(@CmpID,e.EmpID,@AsOf)=@ManagerID;
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_ESS_RequireEmployee @CmpID INT,@UserID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_HRValidateActor @CmpID,@UserID;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_Employee WHERE EmpCompany=@CmpID AND EmpID=@UserID AND EmpState=0) THROW 54410,N'المستخدم غير مرتبط بموظف نشط في الشركة.',1;
END
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_ESS_Context @CmpID INT,@UserID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_ESS_RequireEmployee @CmpID,@UserID;
 DECLARE @Today DATE=CONVERT(date,SYSDATETIME()),@Mgr BIGINT=dbo.fn_Emp_GetDirectManager(@CmpID,@UserID,CONVERT(date,SYSDATETIME()));
 SELECT e.EmpID AS EmployeeID,e.EmpNum,e.EmpName,e.HireDate,e.PosID,p.PosName,p.EmpOrgStrID AS OrgUnitID,u.EmpOrgStrName AS OrgUnitName,
        @Mgr AS DirectManagerID,m.EmpName AS DirectManagerName,
        CAST(CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.fn_Emp_GetDirectReports(@CmpID,@UserID,@Today)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BIT) AS IsManager
 FROM dbo.Emp_Employee e
 LEFT JOIN dbo.Emp_Position p ON p.PosCmp=e.EmpCompany AND p.PosID=e.PosID
 LEFT JOIN dbo.Emp_OrganigramStructure u ON u.EmpOrgStrCompany=p.PosCmp AND u.EmpOrgStrID=p.EmpOrgStrID
 LEFT JOIN dbo.Emp_Employee m ON m.EmpCompany=@CmpID AND m.EmpID=@Mgr
 WHERE e.EmpCompany=@CmpID AND e.EmpID=@UserID;
END
GO

CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_ESS_MyShiftSwaps @CmpID INT,@UserID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN

 SELECT SwapID,RequesterID,CounterpartID,SwapDate,RequesterSchTypeID,CounterpartSchTypeID,Reason,SwapState,CreatedAt,DecidedAt,DecisionNote
 FROM dbo.Emp_ShiftSwapRequests WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND (RequesterID=@UserID OR CounterpartID=@UserID) ORDER BY SwapDate DESC,SwapID DESC;
END

/* Pay data is exposed only for runs that passed HR approval (RunState 2/3). */
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_ESS_MyPayRuns @CmpID INT,@UserID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_ESS_RequireEmployee @CmpID,@UserID;
 SELECT r.PayRunID,r.PeriodID,r.RunNo,r.RunState,r.CurrencyID FROM dbo.Emp_PayRuns r
 WHERE r.CmpID=@CmpID AND r.RunState IN(2,3) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_PayrollDetails d WHERE d.CmpID=r.CmpID AND d.PayRunID=r.PayRunID AND d.EmployeeID=@UserID)
 ORDER BY r.PayRunID DESC;
END
GO

AS
BEGIN

 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Emp_PayRuns WHERE CmpID=@CmpID AND PayRunID=@PayRunID AND RunState IN(2,3)) THROW 54411,N'كشف الراتب غير متاح قبل اعتماد المسير.',1;
 EXEC dbo.Emp_SelectEmployeePaySlip @CmpID,@PayRunID,@UserID;
END

/* Disbursement status per payroll sheet, from PayrollManagement (Pay_*). */
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_ESS_MyPaymentStatus @CmpID INT,@UserID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_ESS_RequireEmployee @CmpID,@UserID;
 SELECT b.SheetID,s.PayRunID,s.SheetState,b.NetAmount,b.Executed AS PaidAmount,b.ReservedOrPaid-b.Executed AS InstructedNotExecuted,b.Remaining,b.PayStatus
 FROM dbo.Pay_vw_SheetLineBalances b JOIN dbo.Pay_PayrollSheets s ON s.CmpID=b.CmpID AND s.SheetID=b.SheetID
 WHERE b.CmpID=@CmpID AND b.EmployeeID=@UserID AND s.SheetState IN(2,4) ORDER BY b.SheetID DESC;
END
GO
/* ---- MSS: scope = employees whose resolved direct manager is the caller ---- */
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_MSS_MyTeam @CmpID INT,@UserID BIGINT,@AsOfDate DATE=NULL
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_ESS_RequireEmployee @CmpID,@UserID;
 SET @AsOfDate=ISNULL(@AsOfDate,CONVERT(date,SYSDATETIME()));
 SELECT e.EmpID AS EmployeeID,e.EmpNum,e.EmpName,e.HireDate,e.PosID,p.PosName,u.EmpOrgStrName AS OrgUnitName
 FROM dbo.fn_Emp_GetDirectReports(@CmpID,@UserID,@AsOfDate) t JOIN dbo.Emp_Employee e ON e.EmpCompany=@CmpID AND e.EmpID=t.EmployeeID
 LEFT JOIN dbo.Emp_Position p ON p.PosCmp=e.EmpCompany AND p.PosID=e.PosID
 LEFT JOIN dbo.Emp_OrganigramStructure u ON u.EmpOrgStrCompany=p.PosCmp AND u.EmpOrgStrID=p.EmpOrgStrID
 ORDER BY e.EmpName;
END
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_MSS_TeamLeaveRequests @CmpID INT,@UserID BIGINT,@State TINYINT=NULL,@DateFrom DATE=NULL,@DateTo DATE=NULL
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_ESS_RequireEmployee @CmpID,@UserID;
 SELECT r.RequestID,r.EmployeeID,e.EmpName,r.LeaveTypeID,r.StartAt,r.EndAt,r.Quantity,r.Reason,r.RequestState
 FROM dbo.Emp_LeaveRequests r JOIN dbo.fn_Emp_GetDirectReports(@CmpID,@UserID,CONVERT(date,SYSDATETIME())) t ON t.EmployeeID=r.EmployeeID
 JOIN dbo.Emp_Employee e ON e.EmpCompany=r.CmpID AND e.EmpID=r.EmployeeID
 WHERE r.CmpID=@CmpID AND (@State IS NULL OR r.RequestState=@State) AND (@DateFrom IS NULL OR r.EndAt>=CAST(@DateFrom AS DATETIME2(0))) AND (@DateTo IS NULL OR r.StartAt<DATEADD(DAY,1,CAST(@DateTo AS DATETIME2(0))))
 ORDER BY r.StartAt DESC;
END
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_MSS_TeamAttendanceSummary @CmpID INT,@UserID BIGINT,@DateFrom DATE,@DateTo DATE
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_ESS_RequireEmployee @CmpID,@UserID;
 IF @DateFrom IS NULL OR @DateTo IS NULL OR @DateTo<@DateFrom OR DATEDIFF(DAY,@DateFrom,@DateTo)>92 THROW 54420,N'الفترة غير صحيحة (الحد الأقصى 93 يوماً).',1;
 SELECT t.EmployeeID,e.EmpName,COUNT(a.AttDayID) AS DaysRecorded,ISNULL(SUM(a.AttDayWorkMinutes),0) AS WorkMinutes,ISNULL(SUM(a.AttDayLateMinutes),0) AS LateMinutes,
        ISNULL(SUM(a.AttDayEarlyLeaveMinutes),0) AS EarlyLeaveMinutes,ISNULL(SUM(a.AttDayOvertimeMinutes),0) AS OvertimeMinutes
 FROM dbo.fn_Emp_GetDirectReports(@CmpID,@UserID,@DateTo) t JOIN dbo.Emp_Employee e ON e.EmpCompany=@CmpID AND e.EmpID=t.EmployeeID
 LEFT JOIN dbo.Emp_AttendanceDaily a ON a.AttDayCmp=@CmpID AND a.AttDayEmpID=t.EmployeeID AND a.AttDayDate BETWEEN @DateFrom AND @DateTo
 GROUP BY t.EmployeeID,e.EmpName ORDER BY e.EmpName;
END
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.Emp_MSS_TeamDashboard @CmpID INT,@UserID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON; EXEC dbo.Emp_ESS_RequireEmployee @CmpID,@UserID;
 DECLARE @Today DATE=CONVERT(date,SYSDATETIME()),@MonthStart DATE=DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(SYSDATETIME()),MONTH(SYSDATETIME()),1);
 DECLARE @T TABLE(EmployeeID BIGINT PRIMARY KEY);
 INSERT @T SELECT EmployeeID FROM dbo.fn_Emp_GetDirectReports(@CmpID,@UserID,@Today);
 SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM @T) AS TeamSize,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.EmployeeID) FROM dbo.Emp_LeaveRequests r JOIN @T t ON t.EmployeeID=r.EmployeeID WHERE r.CmpID=@CmpID AND r.RequestState=2 AND r.StartAt<DATEADD(DAY,1,CAST(@Today AS DATETIME2(0))) AND r.EndAt>CAST(@Today AS DATETIME2(0))) AS OnApprovedLeaveToday,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.Emp_LeaveRequests r JOIN @T t ON t.EmployeeID=r.EmployeeID WHERE r.CmpID=@CmpID AND r.RequestState=0) AS PendingLeaveRequests,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.Emp_OvertimeRequests o JOIN @T t ON t.EmployeeID=o.EmployeeID WHERE o.CmpID=@CmpID AND o.RequestState=0) AS PendingOvertimeRequests,
  (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(o.Hours),0) FROM dbo.Emp_OvertimeRequests o JOIN @T t ON t.EmployeeID=o.EmployeeID WHERE o.CmpID=@CmpID AND o.RequestState=1 AND o.WorkDate>=@MonthStart AND o.WorkDate<=@Today) AS ApprovedOvertimeHoursThisMonth,
  (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(a.AttDayLateMinutes),0) FROM dbo.Emp_AttendanceDaily a JOIN @T t ON t.EmployeeID=a.AttDayEmpID WHERE a.AttDayCmp=@CmpID AND a.AttDayDate>DATEADD(DAY,-30,@Today) AND a.AttDayDate<=@Today) AS LateMinutesLast30Days,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.Emp_Contract c JOIN @T t ON t.EmployeeID=c.EmpID WHERE c.EmpCompany=@CmpID AND c.ConEndDate>=@Today AND c.ConEndDate<=DATEADD(DAY,60,@Today)) AS ContractsExpiringIn60Days;
END
GO
